name: Mateus
chapters: Dore aya ni yo mavu n’amavuuko ya Yesu Kristo, mwene Dawudi, ukomooka kuri Aburahamu.
Aburahamu yabyaye Isaaka, Isaaka abyara Yaakobo, Yaakobo abyara Yuda na beene se,
Yuda yabyaranye na Tamari Peresi na Zeera, Peresi abyara Hezirooni, Hezirooni abyara Aramu,
Aramu yabyaye Amiinadabu, Amiinadabu abyara Nahasoni, Nahasoni abyara Saalumooni,
kandi Saalumooni abyara Bowazi amubyaranye na Rahabu, Bowazi yabyaye Obedi amubyaranye na Ruusi, Obedi abyara Yese,
kandi Yese ni we wabyaye umwami Dawudi. Kandi Dawudi yabyaye Solomooni, amubyarana n’umugore wa Uriya,
Solomooni abyara Rehobowamu, Rehobowamu abyara Abiya, Abiya abyara Asafu.
Asafu yabyaye Yehoshafaati, Yehoshafaati abyara Yoramu, Yoramu abyara Uziya,
Uziya ni we wabyaye Yosamu, Yosamu abyara Ahazi na Ahazi abyara Heezekiya.
Heezekiya yabyaye Manase, Manase abyara Amosi , Amosi abyara Yosiya.
Yosiya yabyaye Yekoniya hamwe na beene se, baabayeho mu gihe Abayuuda baajanwaga bunyago i Babilooni.
Nyuma yo kwimurirwa i Babilooni, Yekoniya yabyaye Salatiyeli, Salatiyeli abyara Zerubabeeli.
Kandi Zerubabeeli abyara Abiyuudi, Abiyuudi abyara Eliyakimu wabyaye Azori,
kandi Azori na we abyara Zadoki, Zadoki abyara Akiimu, Akiimu abyara Eliyuudi,
Eliyuudi ni we wabyaye Eliyazaari, kandi Eliyazaari abyara Matani ise wa Yaakobo,
Yaakobo yabyaye Yozefu umugabo wa Mariya, ari we wabyaye Yesu wiitwa Kristo.

Nuuko kuva kuri Aburahamu kugeza kuri Dawudi ni amaseekuruza cumi n’ane, kandi kuva kuri Dawudi kugeza ku bajanywe i Babilooni na yo ni amaseekuruza cumi n’ane. Kuva ku baajanywe i Babilooni kugera kuri Kristo, na yo ni amaseekuruza cumi n’ane.
Uku ni ko byagenze mu kuvuuka kwa Yesu Kristo. Ubwo Mariya nyina wa Yesu yari aseezeranye na Yozefu, ariko bataraashingiranwa, Mariya asangwa afite inda y’Umwuka Weera.
Umugabo we Yozefu yari umuntu w’intungaane kandi ntiyashaakaga kumukoza isoni kumugaragaro, nuuko yigiira inaama yo kumubenga rwihishwa.
Akibiteekerezaho, malayika w’Imaana amubonekera mu nzozi, aramubwira ati, "Yozefu mwene Dawudi, ntutinye gusohoza umugeni waawe Mariya, kuko iyo nda yasamye ari iy’Umwuka Weera.
Azaabyara umwana w’umuhungu uzamwite Yesu, kuuko ni we uzaakiza abantu be ibyaha byabo."
Ibi byose byabaayeho kugira ngo bibe nk’uko Uhoraho yari yaravugiye mu muhanuuzi ati,
"Dore, umukoobwa w’isugi azaasama inda abyare umwana w’umuhungu, kandi bazamwita Emanweli," risobaanurwa ngo, "Imaana iri kumwe naatwe."
Yozefu akangutse, abigenza nk’uko malayika w’Uhoraho yamutegetse, ajaana Mariya nk’umugore we,
ariko ntibigeze baryamana kugeza igihe yabyariye umwana w’umuhungu, nuuko uwo mwana amwita Yesu.
Yesu yavuukiye i Beetelehemu mu gice c’i Yudeeya, ku ngoma y’Umwami Herodi. Amaze kuvuuka, abagabo baari abahanga mu bumenyi bw’inyenyeeri bava iburasirazuuba beerekeza i Yerusaalemu
barabaza bati, "Mbese umwami w’Abayuuda uheruutse kuvuuka ari heehe? Twaboonye inyenyeeri ye iri guhingukira iburasirazuuba, noone tuuje kumuramya."
Umwami Herodi n’abatuuye i Yerusaalemu boose babyumviise batyo, bahagarika imitima.
Herodi ahamagara abatware b’abaheerezabitambo boose hamwe n’abiigiishamategeko, ababaza aho Kristo azaavuukira.
Baramusubiza bati, "Azaavuukira i Beetelehemu mu gice c’i Yudeeya, nk’uko byanditswe n’umuhanuuzi ngo,
‘Kandi naawe Beetelehemu yo muri Yudeeya, ntaabwo uri uwanyuma mu butegetsi bwa Yuda, kuko muri wowe hazaavuuka umutegetsi uzaaba umushumba w’ubwoko bwanje bwa Isirayeli.’ "
Nuuko Herodi ahamagaza abo banyabwenge , arabiihereerana maze ababaza neeza igihe iyo nyenyeeri yabonekeye.
Aboohereza i Beetelehemu maze arababwira ati, "Nimugende mubaririze neeza iby’uwo mwana, nimumubona, muzaagaruke muumenyeeshe nuuko nanje nje kumuramya."
Bamaze kumva amagambo y’umwami, baragenda. Bageze imbere babona ya nyenyeeri baari baaboneye iburasirazuuba, ibaja imbere kugeza ubwo yahagaze aho uwo mwana yari ari.
Baboonye ko iyo nyenyeeri yahagaze, barishiima birenze urugero.

Binjiye mu nzu, babona umwana hamwe na nyina Mariya, barapfukama maze baheerako baramuramya. Bapfunduura ubusanduku bubiikwamo ibintu by’agaciiro, bamuheereza impaano z’izaahabu, Ububani hamwe n’imibavu ihuumura neeza.
Nuuko bafata inzira basubira iwaabo bakoreesheje iyindi nzira kuko Imaana yari yabiihanangirije mu nzozi ngo badasubira kwa Herodi.

Abanyabwenge bamaze kugenda, Malayika w’Imaana abonekera Yozefu mu nzozi, aramubwira ati, "Haguruka uhunze umwana na nyina, muje mu gihugu ca Igiputi, maze mugumeyo kugeza igihe nzaakubwirira, kuko Herodi arenda gushaakiisha uwo mwana ngo amwice."
Nuuko iryo joro Yozefu arahaguruka, afata inzira, ajaana umwana na nyina bahungira muri Igiputi.
Bagumayo kugeza igihe Herodi yapfiiriye. Ibi byabaayeho kugira ngo ibyo Uhoraho yavugiye mu muhanuuzi bisohore ati, "Nahamagaye umwana wanje ngo ave muri Igiputi."

Herodi amaze kumenya ko ba banyabwenge baari baturutse iburasirazuuba bamuhenze ubwenge, biramuraakaza caane. Ategeka ko abaana b’abahungu bafite imyaka ebyiri hamwe n’abataraayigeza boose batuuye i Beetelehemu n’ibice biheereranye naho biicwa. Yagereranyije igihe co baabanyabwenge bari baamubwiye ko ariho baaboonye inyenyeeri.
Ni bwo ibyavugiwe mu muhanuuzi Yeremiya byasohoye ngo,
"Induuru yumviikana i Rama, induuru y’umuboroogo ukabije. Rasheeli aririra abaana be, ntibyashoboka ko ahozwa, kuko batakiriho."
Herodi amaze gupfa, malayika w’Imaana abonekera Yozefu mu nzozi bakiri muri Igiputi,
aramubwira ati, "Haguruka usubize umwana na nyina mu gihugu ca Isirayeli, kuko abaashaakaga kumwica baapfuuye."
Nuuko Yozefu afata inzira ajaana umwana na nyina, basubira mu gihugu ca Isirayeli.

Ariko yumviise yuuko Arikelawosi mwene Herodi ari we wazunguuye se akaba ari we wabaaye umwami w’i Yudeeya, agira ubwoba bwo kujayo. Ariko kuko yari yihanangirijwe mu nzozi, aja mu disiturikiti y’i Galileeya,
atuura mu tawuni y’i Nazaareeti kugira ngo ibyavugiwe mu bahanuuzi bibe nk’uko byavuuzwe ngo, "Aziitwa Umunyanazaareeti."
Ico gihe, Yohaana Umubatiza aja mu butaayu i Yudeeya abwiriza ati,
"Nimwihane ibyaha byanyu kuko Ubwami bwo mu ijuru bwegereje!"
Yohaana uwo ni we wari waravuzweho n’umuhanuuzi Yesaaya ati, "Ijwi ry’uvugira mu butaayu aranguruye ati, ‘Nimutungaanye inzira y’Uhoraho, mugorore aho azanyura.’ "
Yohaana yambaraga umwambaro ukozwe mu bwoya bw’ingamiya akawukenyeza umushumi w’uruhu. Yaryaga inzige hamwe n’ubuuki bw’ubuhura.
Abantu b’i Yerusaalemu no mu bice byose by’i Yudeeya, no mu bice byitoorooye uruuzi rwa Yorodaani bazaga bamusanga
bakihana ibyaha byabo maze akababatiriza mu ruuzi rwa Yorodaani.
Ariko Yohaana aboonye Abafarisaayo n’Abasadukaayo benshi bamuuzaho ngo ababatize, arababwira ati, "Mwa rubyaro rw’inshiira mwe! Ni nde wabagiiriye inaama ngo muhunge uburakari bw’Imaana bwegereje?
Nimukore ibikorwa bikwiriye abiihannye.
Ntimwibeeshe muti, ‘Dukomooka kuri Aburahamu,’ ndabahamiriza yuuko Imaana ishobora kurema muri aya mabuye beene Aburahamu.
Ndetse n’ubu, intorezo yo gutema igiti irateguuwe. Igiti coose kiteera imbuto nziiza kigiiye gutemwa gitwikwe mu muriro.

Njeewe mbabatiriisha amaazi nk’ikimenyeetso ceerekana yuuko mwihannye ibyaha byanyu, ariko uzaaza nyuma yanje andusha ububaasha, sinkwiriye no kumukuuramo ingato. We azaababatiriisha Umwuka Weera n’umuriro.
Dore afashe intaara ngo agosoore impeke azihunike mu kigega, naho umurama, awucaaniishe umuriro utazima."
Ico gihe, Yesu ava i Galileeya aja ku ruuzi rwa Yorodaani ngo Yohaana amubatize.
Ariko Yohaana agerageza kumuhakanira ati, "Ni wowe ukwiriye kumbatiza, noone unjeho ngo nkubatize?"
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Emera ubikore ubu, kuko ari byo bikwiriye mu kuzuuza ibyo Imaana ishaaka." Nuuko Yohaana arabyemera.
Yesu amaze kubatizwa, yuunamuka mu maazi, ijuru rirakinguuka nuuko abona Umwuka w’Imaana amumanukiraho asa n’inuma.
Maze ijwi ry’Imaana rivugira mu ijuru riti, "Uyu ni Umwana wanje nkunda nkamwishiimira."
Nuuko Yesu ajanwa n’Umwuka w’Imaana mu butaayu kugira ngo ahageragerezwe na Sataani.
Ubwo yari amaze iminsi mirongo ine n’amajoro mirongo ane asiibye, Yesu arasonza.
Umushukanyi aramwegeera aramubwira ati, "Niiba uri Umwana w’Imaana koko, tegeka aya mabuye ahinduke imigaati."
Ariko Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Biranditswe ngo, ‘Umuntu ntaabwo atungwa n’umugaati gusa, ahuubwo abeeshwaho n’ijambo ryose riva mu kanwa k’Imaana.’ "
Nuuko Sataani arongera ajaana Yesu mu tawuni nkuru Yeera, amuhagarika ku gasongeero k’Inzu y’Imaana,

maze aramubwira ati, "Niiba uri Umwana w’Imaana, simbukira haasi, kuko byanditswe ngo, ‘Imaana izaagutegekera abaamalayika baayo, bagutegere amaboko bakuramire, kugira ngo ikirenge caawe kidasiitaara ku ibuye.’ "
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Kandi, byanditswe ngo, ‘Ntukagerageze Uhoraho Imaana yaawe.’ "
Nuuko Sataani arongera ajaana Yesu mu mpinga y’ikirunga kireekire caane, amwereka ubwami bwose bwo ku isi n’icuubahiro caabwo,
aramubwira ati, "Biriiya byose ndabiguha, n’upfukama ukandamya."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Hoshi genda, Sataani! Kuko byanditswe ngo, ‘Uramye Uhoraho Imaana yaawe, abe ari yo yoonyine ukorera.’ "
Sataani amusiga ahongaho, haaza abaamalayika baramukorera.
Yesu yumviise ko Yohaana yashizwe mu gihome, aja i Galileeya.
Ava i Nazaareeti, yimukira i Kaperenawumu, i tawuni yegeranye n’inyanja y’i Galileeya mu gice ca Zebulooni na Nafutaali,
kugira ngo bibe nk’uko byavugiwe mu muhanuuzi Yesaaya ngo,
"Gihugu ca Zebulooni n’ica Nafutaali, ahagana ku nyanja, haakurya ya Yorodaani, i Galileeya ituuwe n’abanyamahanga.
Abantu baari mu mwijima, baaboonye umuco mwinshi, naabo baari mu gihugu gicuze umwijima w’igicuucu c’urupfu umuco warabamurikiye."
Uheereye ico gihe, Yesu atangira kwamamaza ubutumwa ati, "Nimwihane kuko Ubwami bw’ijuru bureegeereje."
Ubwo Yesu yanyuraga ku nkengeero y’inyanja ya Galileeya, abona abarobyi babiri baari ibyenenyina, Simooni witwaga Peetero na Andereya, bari gushira ubutimba bwabo mu nyanja ngo barobe isamaaki.
Nuuko arababwira ati, "Nimunkurikire, nzaabahindura abarobyi b’abantu."
Ako kaanya, basiga ubutimba bwabo baramukurikira.
Akomejemo abona abandi babiri, b’ibyenenyina ari bo, Yaakobo na Yohaana beene Zebedaayo bari mu bwato basana ubutimba bwabo. Yesu arabahamagara,
baheerako basigira se ubwato, bakurikira Yesu.
Yesu yitooroora i Galileeya yoose, yiigiishiriza abantu mu masinagoogi yaabo, ababwiriza Ubutumwa Bwiza bw’Ubwami bw’ijuru, kandi akiza abantu uburwayi n’indwara z’uburyo bwose.
Inkuru y’ibyiza bye yamamara mu gihugu ca Siriya hoose, nuuko bamuzanira abantu boose barwaye indwara z’amooko atari amwe, imbabare n’abateewe na dayimooni, abarwaye ibicuri n’abarema, arabakiza.
Nuuko imbaga y’abantu iramukurikira, bamwe baturutse i Galileeya, mu gice c’i Dekapolisi, abandi baturutse i Yerusaalemu n’i Yudeeya, no haakurya ya Yorodaani.
Yesu aboonye imbaga y’abantu, azaamuka umusozi. Amaze kwicara, abiigiishwa be baramwegeera.
Nuuko atangira kuvuga kandi arabiigiisha ati:
"Hahiirwa abakene mu mitima yaabo, kuko Ubwami bw’ijuru ari ubwabo.
Hahiirwa abashavura, kuko bazaahuumurizwa.
Hahiirwa abiiciisha bugufi, kuko ari bo bazaragwa isi.
Hahiirwa abasonzera ubutungaane bakabugirira imyota, kuko bazaahaazwa.
Hahiirwa abanyampuhwe, kuko bazaazigirirwa.
Hahiirwa abafite imitima itunganye, kuko bazaabona Imaana.
Hahiirwa abaharanira amahoro, kuko baziitwa abaana b’Imaana.
Hahiirwa abatootezwa bazira gukiraanuka, kuko Ubwami bw’ijuru ari ubwabo.
Murahiirwa ni babatuka, bakabatooteza, bakababeeshera mu buryo byinshi ari nje babaryoza.
Muziishiime kandi muneezeerwe, kuko mufite ibihembo bihebuuje mu ijuru, kuko ni ko n’abahanuuzi baababanjirije baatootejwe.
Muri umuunyu w’isi, ariko se umuunyu wamaze gukayuka, wakongera kuryoshwa ute? Ntaaco uba ukimaze keretse kujugunywa hanze abantu bakawukandagira.
Muri umuco w’isi. I tawuni yubatswe ku mpinga y’umusozi ntiyahishwa.
Ntaamuntu ucaana itaara ngo aryubikeho intonga, ahuubwo riterekwa ku gitereko caaryo, rikamurikira abari mu nzu boose.
No ku bw’iyo mpamvu reero, mucaane amataara yaanyu amurikire abandi, kugira ngo babone imirimo yaanyu myiza maze baheereko bahe So wo mu ijuru ikuzo.
Ntimuteekereze ko nazanywe no gukuraho amategeko cangwa ibyanditswe n’abahanuuzi, sinazanywe no kubivaanaho ahuubwo naaje kubisohoza.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko, ijuru n’isi bikiriho, ntakanyuguti na kamwe cangwa akadomo na kamwe kazaakurwa ku mategeko byose bitari byarangira.

Noone reero uziica rimwe muri aya mategeko n’aho ryaba ryoroshe kuruta ayandi, akiigiisha abandi kugenza nka we, azaagirwa uwanyuma mu Bwami bw’ijuru. Ariko uzaayakurikiza, akayiigiisha abandi aziitwa mukuru mu Bwami bw’ijuru.
Kandi ndababwira yuuko nimutaba abakiraanutsi kuruta Abiigiishamategeko n’Abafarisaayo, ntaabwo muzinjira mu Bwami bw’ijuru.
Mwumviise ko abaakeera babwiwe bati, ‘Ntuukiice, uwishe weese azaahanwa.’

Ariko ndababwira yuuko uraakarira umuvandimwe we, akwiriye guhanwa n’ubucaamanza. Kandi uzaatuka mwene nyina cangwa mushiki we akwiriye kujanwa imbere y’urukiko agaciirwa urubanza, kandi uvuga ati, ‘Wa gipfaapfa we,’ aba ari uwo gushirwa mu nyenga y’umuriro utazima .
Nuuko n’ujaana ituuro ryawe ku rutambiro rw’Imaana, wahagera ukiibuka ko ufite ico upfa n’umuvandimwe waawe,
usige iryo tuuro aho imbere y’urutambiro, maze ubanze ugende wikiraanure n’uwo muvandimwe, ubone kuuza gutanga ituuro ryawe.
Wikiranure vuba n’ukurega mukiri mu nzira kugira ngo atakujaanira umucaamanza, umucaamanza na we akagushikiriza umusirikare nuuko ugashirwa mu gihome.
Ndakubwira ukuri yuuko utazaavamo utabanje kwishura umwenda woose ntihasigare na gake.
Mwumviise ko byavuzwe ngo, ‘Ntuugasambane.’
Ariko ndababwira yuuko umuntu weese ureeba umugore akamurarikira, aba amaze gusambana na we mu biteekerezo bye.
Ijiisho ryawe ry’iburyo nirikuguusha mu caaha, urinogooremo urite, biraruta ko wabura rumwe mu ngingo zaawe, aho kugira ngo umubiri waawe woose utaabwe mu muriro w’iteeka.
Kandi ukuboko kwawe kw’iburyo nikukuguusha mu caaha, uguceho ugute. Biraruta ko wabura rumwe mu ngingo zaawe, aho kugira ngo umubiri waawe woose utaabwe mu muriro w’iteeka.
Kandi byaravuzwe ngo, ‘Uzaashaaka kwirukana umugore we akwiriye kumuha urwandiko rwemeza ko batandukanye.’

Ariko nje ndababwira ko umuntu weese wirukana umugore we atamuhooye gusambana, nyuma agatungwa n’undi mugabo, aba amuteeye ubusambanyi. Byongeye kandi, ushohoje uwo mugore wirukanywe na we aba asambanye.
Byongeye, mwumviise ko abaakeera baabwiwe bati, ‘Ntuukarahire ibinyoma, ahuubwo uzaakorere Uhoraho ibyo wamuseezeranyije mu ndahiro.’
Ariko nje ndababwira ngo, ntimukarahire na hato, kwaba kurahira mushingiye ku ijuru kuko ari ryo ntebe ya caami y’Imaana,
cangwa ku isi, kuko ari yo kabaaho ikandagizaho ibirenge, cangwa kuri i Yerusaalemu kuko ari yo tawuni nkuru y’Umwami ukomeye.
Kandi ntuuzaarahire n’umutwe waawe, kuko udashobora guhindura n’umwe mu misatsi yaawe ngo ube umweru cangwa umukara.
Ahuubwo muje muvuga muti, ‘Yeego’, cangwa ‘Oya,’ ibirenze ibyo biba bituruka kuri Seekibi.
Mwumviise ko byavuzwe ngo, ‘Umennye undi ijiisho, na we barimumene kandi ukuye undi iryinyo na we barimukuure.’
Ariko nje ndababwira kutiituura inaabi abaayibagiriye. Ahuubwo nihagira ugukubita ku musaya w’i buryo, umuhindurire n’undi awukubite.
Kandi umuntu naashaaka kukubuuranya ngo akunyage isaati yaawe, umuhe n’ikooti,
ndetse nihagira ugutegeka kugenda urugendo rwa mayilo imwe, uzakomezemo ugende n’iya kabiri.
Nihagira ugira ico agusaba uzaakimuhe, nihagira ugira ico agutiira, uzaakimutiize.
Mwumviise ko byavuzwe ngo, ‘Uje ukunda mugenzi waawe, wange umwanzi waawe.’
Ariko nje ndababwira ngo, ‘mukunde abanzi baanyu kandi muje musabira ababatooteza,’
kugira ngo mube abaana ba So uri mu ijuru, kuko avuusha izuuba rye ku babi no ku beeza, kandi akagwisha imvura ku batunganye no kubadatunganye.
Nimukunda ababakunda gusa, muzaagira bihembo ki? Mbese abasoreesha bo ntibagenza batyo?
Kandi n’uramutsa abavandimwe baawe gusa, uba urushije iki abandi bantu? Mbese abapagaani bo ntibabigenza batyo?
Mube intungaane nk’uko na So wo mu ijuru ari intungaane.
Mwirinde gukorera ibikorwa by’ubukiraanutsi kumugaragaro kugira ngo babareebe, kuko nimugira mutyo, ntimuzaabona ingororano ya So wo mu ijuru.
Ahuubwo igihe utanze imfashanyo, ntukabyamamaze nk’uko indyarya zibigenzereza mu masinagoogi no ku mihanda kugira ngo zishimwe. Ndababwira ukuri yuuko abo baba bamaze guhaabwa ingororano yaabo.
Ariko igihe utanze imfashanyo, ukuboko kwawe kwa bumoso ntikukamenye ico ukwa buryo gutanze,
kugira ngo ibyo utanze bibe ibanga, nuuko So wo mu ijuru ureeba ibyihereereye azaabagororera.

Kandi igihe musenga, ntimukabe nk’abantu b’indyarya, bakunda gusenga bahagaze mu masinagoogi no ku mihanda, kugira ngo abantu babareebe. Ndababwira ukuri yuuko abo baba bamaze guhaabwa ingororano yaabo.
Ahuubwo igihe usenga, uje winjira mu gisenge caawe ukinge, maze usenge So mwihereeranye. Kandi So ureeba ibyiherereye azaakugororera.
Igihe usenga, ntuugatondagure amagambo atagira ico avuga nk’uko abapagaani babigenza, kuko bateekereza ko kuvuga amagambo menshi bituma bumvwa.
Ntimukabe nka bo, kuko So azi ibyo mukeneye mutaraabimusaba.
Nuuko reero muje musenga mutya: Daata wa twese uri mu Ijuru, izina ryawe ryubahwe.
Ubwami bwawe buuze. Ibyo ushaaka bikorwe mu isi nk’uko bikorwa mu ijuru.
Uduhe ifunguro ridutunga uko bukeeye .
Utubabarire ibyaha byacu, nk’uko naatwe tubabarira abaducumuraho.
Ntuuduteererane ngo tugwe mu bitugerageza, ahuubwo udukize Umubi .
Kuko nimubabarira abandi ibyaha baabakoreye, So uri mu ijuru na we azaabababarira ibyaha byanyu.
Ariko nimutababarira abandi, So uri mu ijuru na we ntaabwo azaabababarira ibyaha byanyu.

Kandi igihe musiiba, ntimukiijime ku maaso ngo mugaragaze umubabaro nk’uko indyarya zibikora, zikambya agahanga kugira ngo abantu bamenye ko ziri mu gisiibo. Ndababwira ukuri yuuko abo baba baamaze guhaabwa ingororano yaabo.
Ariko mwebwe nimusiiba, mwisiige amavuta mu mutwe, kandi mukarabe mu maaso,
kugira ngo abantu batamenya ko mwasiibye ahuubwo bimenywe na So wenyine utagaragara, kandi So ureeba ibyihereereye azaabaha ingororano.
Ntimugakungaanyirize ubukungu bwanyu ku isi aho bwononwa n’ibiseesamuzinga n’ingese , kandi n’aho abajuura baapfumura bakabwiba.
Ahuubwo, mwikungaanyirize ubukungu bwo mu ijuru, aho ibiseesamuzinga n’ingese bitagera, n’aho abajuura badashobora gupfumura.
Kuko aho ubutunzi bwawe buri, ni ho uzaahoza umutima.
Ijiisho ni itaara rimurikira umubiri waawe. Iyo amaaso yaawe areeba neeza, umubiri woose ugira umuco,
ariko ijiisho ryawe niiba ritameze neeza, umubiri waawe woose wuzura umwijima. Reero niiba umuco ukurimo ari umwijima, mbeega ukuntu uwo mwijima uzaaba mwinshi!
Nta mugaragu ushobora gukorera abatware babiri, kuko yakwanga umwe agakunda undi, cangwa akiitangira umwe agasuuzugura undi. Ntimushobora gukorera Imaana n’ubutunzi .

Ni co gitumye mbabwira ngo, ntimugahagarike imitima yaanyu ku byerekeye ubuzima bwanyu muti, mbese tuzaarya iki, cangwa tuzanywa iki, cangwa ibifashe ku mubiri waanyu muti, mbese tuzambara iki. Mbese ubuzima ntiburuta ibyo kurya, n’umubiri ukaruta imyambaro?
Nimureebe inyoni zo mu kireere, ntizibiba, ntizisaaruura cangwa ngo zihunike mu bigega, ariko So wo mu ijuru arazigaburira. Mbese ntimuzirusha agaciiro?
Kandi hari n’umwe muri mwe ushobora kwiyongeereraho niibura akaanya gato ku buzima bwe ku bwo guhagarika umutima?
Noone n’iki gituma muhagarika imitima yaanyu mwibaza ico muzambara? Mwitegereze ukuntu ibimori byo mu gasozi bikura, nta murimo bikora, nta n’imyenda biboha,
ariko ndababwira ukuri yuuko na Solomooni mu cuubahiro yari afite coose, atiigeze yambara nka kimwe muri ibyo bimori.
Noone se niiba Imaana yambika ityo ibyatsi byo mu gasozi biriho noone, ejo bikajugunywa mu muriro, mwe ntizaarushaho kubambika mwabanyakwizeera guke mwe?
Nuuko reero ntimugahagarike imitima, mwibaza muti, ‘Tuzaarya iki?’ Cangwa muti, ‘Tuzanywa iki?’ Cangwa muti, ‘Tuzambara iki?’
Ibyo byose abanyamahanga ni byo baharanira, nyamara So wo mu ijuru azi ko ibyo byose mubikeneye.
Ariko mbere ya byose muharanire Ubwami bw’Imaana no gukiraanuka kwayo, ni ho ibindi byose muzaabyongeererwa.
Noone reero ntimugahagarike imitima yaanyu mwibaza iby’ejo, kuko iby’ejo bibara ab’ejo, kandi ingoorane za buri munsi zirahaagije.
Ntimugaciire abandi urubanza, kugira ngo namwe mutazaaruciirwa.
Kuko urubanza muciira abandi ari rwo muzaaciirwa, kandi urugero mugeramo ari rwo muzaagererwamo.
Kuki ureeba igitokoozi co mu jiisho rya mugenzi waawe, ariko ukirengagiza umugogo uri mu ryawe?
Cangwa se, wabwira ute mugenzi waawe uti, ‘Reka ngutokoore igitokoozi kiri mu ijiisho ryawe,’ kandi utareeba umugogo uri mu ryawe?
Wa ndyarya we, banza utokoore umugogo uri mu jiisho ryawe, nuuko ubone uko wakiza mugenzi waawe igitokoozi kiri mu jiisho rye.
Ibyejejwe ntimukabihe imbwa, kandi ntimugate amasaro yaanyu y’umutaako y’igiciiro imbere y’ingurube, kuko zaayakandagira, zikabiihiindukana maze zikabatanyaguza.
Musabe muzaahaabwa, mushaake muzaabona, mukomange, urugi ruzakinguurwa.
Kuko usaba weese arahaabwa, ushaaka arabona, kandi ukomanga arakinguurirwa.
Muri mwe ni nde wo umwana we yaasaba umugaati akamuha ibuye?
Cangwa yaamusaba isaamaaki akamuha inzoka?
Noone se mwe ko muri babi mukaba muuzi kugenera abaana baanyu ibyiza, So uri mu ijuru we ntaazaarushaho guha ibyiza ababimusabye?
Muri byose, muje mugirira abandi uko mwifuuza kugirirwa, kuko iri ni ryo tegeko n’ibyahanuuwe.
Mwinjire mu irembo rifunganye, kuko irembo rijaana abantu kurimbuka ni rinini kandi n’inzira ijayo ntiiruhije, n’abayinyuramo ni benshi.
Na ho irembo rija mu bugingo rirafungaanye kandi n’inzira ijayo iraruhije, n’abarinyuramo ni bake.
Mwirinde abahanuuzi b’ibinyoma, baaza biigize nk’intaama ariko munda ari amasega aryana.
Muzaabamenyera ku mbuto beera. Mbese wasoroma imbuto z’imizaabibu ku giti c’amahwa, cangwa imbuto z’umutiini ku matovu?
Ni na ko, buri giti ciiza ceera imbuto nziiza, naho igiti kibi kikeera imbuto mbi.
Igiti ciiza ntigishobora kwera imbuto mbi, kandi n’igiti kibi ntigishobora kwera imbuto nziiza.
Igiti coose kiteera imbuto nziiza kiratemwa kikajugunywa mu muriro.
Nuuko reero, muzaabamenyera ku mbuto zaabo.
Umuntu weese umbwira ati, ‘Nyagasani, Nyagasani,’ si we uzinjira mu Bwami bwo mu ijuru, keretse abo bakora ibyo Daata uri mu ijuru ashaaka.
Kuri uwo munsi, benshi bazambwira bati, ‘Nyagasani, Nyagasani, mbese ntitwahanuuye mu izina ryawe, kandi tukiirukana abadayimooni mu izina ryawe, tugakora n’ibitangaaza byinshi mu izina ryawe?’
Ni bwo nzaabeerurira nti, ‘Siniigeeze mbamenya, nimumve imbere mwa nkozi z’ibibi mwe!’
Umuntu weese wumva aya magambo yanje akayakurikiza, ameze nk’umunyabwenge wuubatse inzu ye ku rutare.
Nyuma, imvura iragwa, imyuzure iratemba, umuyaga urahuuha byose byihuura kuri iyo nzu, ariko ntiyagwa kuko yari yubatswe ku rutare.
Kandi umuntu weese wumva aya magambo yanje ntaayakurikize, azaamera nk’umupfaapfa wuubatse inzu ye ku umuseenyi.
Imvura iragwa, imyuzure iratemba, umuyaga urahuuha, byose bikoranira kuri iyo nzu ihita igwa. Si ukugwa gusa ahuubwo yahindutse ubushingwe!"
Yesu amaze kuvuga ibyo byose, rubanda rutangaarira imyigiishirize ye,
kuko yabiigiishaga nk’ufite ububaasha atari nk’uko Abiigiishamategeko baabo biigiishaga.
Yesu amanutse kuri uwo musozi, abantu benshi baramukurikira.
Maze haaza umubembe aramwegeera, aramupfukamira aramubwira ati, "Nyagasani, ubishaatse wankiza ."
Yesu arambuura ukuboko amukoraho aravuga ati, "Ndabishaaka, kira!" Ako kaanya ibibembe bye birakira.
Nuuko Yesu aramubwira ati, "Uramenye ntihagire uwo ubwira, ariko, ugende wiyereke umuheerezabitambo, maze utange ituuro Moose yategetse, ribabeere iceemezo c’uko wakize."
Yesu ageze i Kaperenawumu, umutware w’abasirikare ijana aramwegeera, aramwinginga
aramubwira ati, "Nyagasani, nasize umugaragu wanje mu rugo aryamye, kandi arababara bikabije."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ndaaza mukize."
Uwo mutware w’abasirikare ijana aramusubiza ati, "Nyagasani, ntibinkwiriye ko winjira mu nzu yanje, ahuubwo vuga ijambo ryawe gusa, umugaragu wanje arakira.

Kuko nanje ndi umuntu ufite ububaasha, kandi mfite abasirikare ntegeka. Iyo mbwiye umwe muri bo nti, ‘Genda,’ aragenda, naabwira undi nti, ‘Ngwino,’ akaaza, naabwira umugaragu wanje nti, ‘Kora iki,’ akagikora."
Yesu abyumviise, aratangaara abwira abaari bamukurikiye ati, "Ndababwira ukuri ko muri Isirayeli ntiigeze mbona umuntu ufite kwizeera nk’uku.
Kandi ndababwira yuuko benshi bazaaturuka iburasirazuuba n’iburengerazuuba, bagasangira na Aburahamu, Isaaka na Yaakobo mu Bwami bwo mu ijuru,
naho abaari baragenewe kuba abazunguura b’ubwo Bwami bakajugunywa hanze mu mwijima, aho bazaaririra bagahekenya ameenyo."
Nuuko Yesu abwira uwo mutware w’abasirikare ijana ati, "Genda, bikubeere nk’uko ubyizeeye." Muri ako kaanya, umugaragu we arakira.
Yesu ageze kwa Peetero abona nyirabukwe wa Peetero aryamye afite umuriro mwinshi.
Yesu amufata ukuboko, umuriro umuvamo, nuuko arahaguruka atangira kumuzimaanira.
Bugoroobye, baazana abantu benshi bateewe n’abadayimooni, nuuko yiirukana abadayimooni abakabukira, kandi abaari barwaye boose arabakiza.
Ibi byabaaye kugira ngo ibyavuzwe n’umuhanuuzi Yesaaya bisohore ngo, "Ubwe, yiishizeho ubumuga bwacu, yiikorera indwara zaacu."
Yesu aboonye ko akiikijwe n’abantu benshi, ategeka ko bambuka bakaja haakurya y’inyanja.
Umwe mu biigiishamategeko aramwegeera aravuga ati, "Mwigiisha, nzaagukurikira aho uzaaja hoose."
Yesu aramubwira ati, "Ibisamagwe bifite imyobo, kandi n’inyoni zo mu kireere zifite ibyari, ariko Umwana w’Umuntu ntaabwo afite aho arambika umusaya."
Undi mu biigiishwa be aramubwira ati, "Nyagasani, reka mbanze nje guhamba daata."
Ariko Yesu aramubwira ati, "Nkurikira, ureke abapfu bahambe abapfu baabo."
Nuuko Yesu agiiye mu bwato, abiigiishwa be baramukurikira.
Habyuka umuyaga mwinshi mu nyanja kugeza ubwo ubwato bwari bugiiye kurengerwa n’imivumba. Ariko Yesu we yari asinziiriye.
Nuuko baja aho ari maze baramukangura, baramubwira bati, "Nyagasani, dutabaare turarimbutse!"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Ni iki kibateeye ubwoba, mwa banyakwizeeraguke mwe?" Nuuko arahaguruka acaaha umuyaga n’inyanja, maze haratuuza caane.
Abantu boose baratangaara baravuga bati, "Uyu ni muntu ki utegeka imiyaga n’inyanja bikamwumvira?"

Yesu ageze haakurya mu gihugu c’Abagadareeni , abagabo babiri baari bateewe n’abadayimooni baaza bamusanga baturutse mu bituuro. Baari bateeye ubwoba, ku buryo ari nta muntu wari ukinyura muri iyo nzira.
Ako kaanya bateera heejuru bati, "Udushaakaho iki Mwana w’Imaana? Mbese uzanywe hano no kutwiciisha agashinyaguro igihe kitaraagera?"
Haafi aho haari umugana w’ingurube ziriisha.
Nuuko abo badayimooni binginga Yesu bati, "Nuutwirukana, utwohereze muri uriiya mugana w’ingurube."
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Nimugende." Nuuko bava muri abo bagabo baja mu ngurube, maze umugana woose umanuka ku gacuri ugwa mu nyanja urarohama.
Abashumba baari baragiye izo ngurube barahunga. Bageze mu tawuni, bateekerereza abantu ibyabaye byose n’ibyerekeye ba bagabo baari bateewe n’abadayimooni.
Bityo abantu boose bo muri iyo tawuni baja gusanganira Yesu. Bamuboonye, baramwinginga ngo abaviire mu gihugu.
Nuuko Yesu amaze kuja mu bwato, arambuka aja mu tawuni y’iwaabo .
Bamuuzanira umugabo umugaye bamuheetse mu ngobyi, aboonye ko bafite kwizeera, abwira uwo mugabo ati, "Huumura mwana wanje, ibyaha byawe urabibabariwe."
Bamwe mu biigiishamategeko babyumviise batangira kwitootomba mu mutima bati, "Uyu mugabo ariigereranya n’Imaana."
Ariko Yesu amenya ibyo biibwira, arababaza ati, "Mbese ni kuki mugira ibiteekerezo bidatunganye mu mitima yaanyu?
Icooroshe ni ikihe? Ni ukuvuga ngo ‘Ibyaha byawe urabibabariwe,’ cangwa ngo, ‘Haguruka ugende’?
Nyamara ibi ni ukugira ngo mumenye ko Umwana w’Umuntu afite ububaasha hano ku isi bwo kubabarira ibyaha." Nuuko abwira uwo mugabo umugaye ati, "Haguruka, wikorere ingobyi yaawe, utaahe."
Uwo mugabo arahaguruka, arataaha.
Abantu babiboonye, bateerwa n’ubwoba, basingiza Imaana yahaaye abantu ububaasha nk’ubwo.
Yesu ava muri uwo mwanya, akigenda abona umugabo witwaga Matayo yiicaye ahantu basorooreza imisoro, maze aramubwira ati, "Nkurikira." Matayo aheerako aramukurikira.
Ubwo Yesu yari yiicaye n’abiigiishwa be bari kurya ifunguro rya nimugoroba , abasoreesha benshi n’abanyabyaha baraaza basangira na bo.
Bamwe mu Bafarisaayo babiboonye babaza abiigiishwa be bati, "Ni kuki umwigiisha waanyu asangira n’abasoreesha n’abanyabyaha?"
Yesu abumviise arababwira ati, "Abazima si bo bakeneye umuvuuzi, ahuubwo ni abarwayi bamukeneye.
Nimugende mwige ico ibi byanditswe bisobaanura, ‘Ico mbashaakaho si ibitambo, ahuubwo ni uko mwagira impuhwe.’ Sinazanywe no guhamagara intungaane, ahuubwo naaje guhamagara abanyabyaha."
Nuuko abiigiishwa ba Yohaana beegeera Yesu baramubaza bati, "Ni kuki twebwe n’Abafarisaayo dusiiba, naho abiigiishwa baawe bo ntibasiibe?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Abatumirwa ntibaashobora gushavura bakiri n’umukwe. Ahuubwo igihe kizaagera ubwo umukwe azaabavanwamo, baheereko basiibe.
Ntaamuntu uteera ikiremu gisha ku mwenda ushaaje, uwaabikora atyo, yatuma ikiremu gisha kiwukurura, ugashishimuka, umwenge ukarushaho kuba munini.

Kandi ntawaasuka divaayi nsha mu mifuka y’impu ishaaje kuko uwaabikora atyo, iyo divaayi yaaturitsa imifuka y’impu ndetse na yo ikameneka maze byombi akabipfiirwa. Ahuubwo, divaayi nsha bayisuka mu mifuka y’impu ikiri misha ntihagire icangirika muri byombi."
Akivuga ibyo, haaza umutware w’isinagoogi aramupfukamira aramubwira ati, "Umukoobwa wanje amaze gupfa, ariko ngwino umurambikeho ibiganza yongere abeho."
Nuuko Yesu arahaguruka, ajaana n’abiigiishwa be, bakurikira uwo mutware.
Ako kaanya haaza umugore wari urwaye indwara yo kuva, ayimaranye imyaka cumi n’ebyiri. Amuturuka inyuma afata ku mukugiro w’umwenda we,
kuko yibwiraga ati, "Ninkora ku mwenda we gusa, ndakira."
Yesu arahinduka, amuboonye, aramubwira ati, "Huumura mwana wanje, kwizeera kwawe kuragukijije." Ako kaanya, uwo mugore arakira.
Yesu ageze mu rugo rwa wa mutware, abona abavuza imyironge baririra uwapfuuye hamwe n’abandi benshi bacura umuboroogo,
arababwira ati, "Nimusohoke, umukoobwa ntiyapfuuye ahuubwo arasinziiriye." Nuuko baramuseka.
Boose bamaze kugera hanze, Yesu arinjira amufata ukuboko, umukoobwa arahaguruka.
Iyo nkuru ikwira hoose.
Yesu akiva aho hantu, abagabo babiri b’impumyi bamukurikira bamutakambira bati, "Mwana wa Dawudi, tugirire impuhwe!"
Yinjiye mu nzu, abo bantu bahumye bakomeza kumukurikira, Yesu arababaza ati, "Mbese mwizeera ko nshobora kubakiza?" Baramusubiza bati, "Yeego, Nyagasani."
Nuuko afata ku maaso yaabo arababwira ati, "Bibabeere nk’uko mwizeera."
Amaaso yaabo aheerako arahumuuka. Nuuko Yesu arabiihanangiriza ati, "Muramenye ntihagire ubimenya."
Ariko bakiva aho, baheerako batangira kubyamamaza babikwiza mu gihugu coose.
Bamaze kuva aho, bamuuzanira umuntu wari uteewe na dayimooni y’uburagi.
Yesu amaze kwirukana dayimooni, uwo muragi aravuga. Rubanda baratangaara caane baravuga bati, "Ntihigeze kuboneka ibintu nk’ibi muri Isirayeli."
Ariko Abafarisaayo bo baravuga bati, "Umutware w’abadayimooni ni we umuha ububaasha bwo kwirukana abadayimooni."
Yesu aja mu matawuni yoose no mu byaro yiigiishiriza mu masinagoogi kandi yaamamaza Inkuru Nziiza y’Ubwami, akiza buri ndwara n’abarwayi b’uburyo bwose.
Aboonye abo bantu benshi caane, abagirira impuhwe kuko baari bashobewe kandi bafite intege nke nk’intaama zitagira umushumba.
Nuuko abwira abiigiishwa be ati, "Dore imyaka yeze ni myinshi, ariko abasaaruuzi ni bake,
noone reero ni musabe Nyagasani yohereze abasaaruuzi mu myaka ye."
Nuuko Yesu ahamagara abiigiishwa be cumi na babiri abaha ububaasha bwo gutegeka imyuka mibi no kuyiirukana, n’ubwo gukiza indwara z’uburyo bwose.
Aya ni yo mazina y’abo cumi na babiri: Uwa mbere ni Simooni witwaga Peetero na mwene nyina Andereya, Yaakobo na Yohaana beene Zebedaayo,
Filipo na Barutolomayo, Tomasi na Matayo umusoreesha, Yaakobo mwene Alufaayo na Tadeeyo,
Simooni w’umurwanashaka w’igihugu , na Yuda Isikariyoti, wa wundi wagambaaniye Yesu.
Yesu atuma abo cumi na babiri abaha izi ngenderwaho ati, "Ntihagire abanyamahanga mujamo cangwa ngo muje mu ma tawuni y’Abanyasamariya,
ahuubwo muje mu ntaama zaazimiye z’umuryango wa Isirayeli.
Mugenda, mwamamaze ubutumwa muti, ‘Ubwami bwo mu ijuru bureegeereje.’
Mukize abarwayi, muzuure abaapfuuye, mukize ababembe, mwirukane abadayimooni. Mwaheerewe ubuntu, mutangire ubuntu.
Ntihagire izaahabu, ifeeza cangwa umuringa mwitwaza.
Ntimujaane igikapu c’urugendo, cangwa ngo mujaane isaati ebyiri, cangwa inkweto, cangwa inkoni kuko umukozi akwiriye guhaabwa ibyo yiifuuza.
I tawuni cangwa icaaro muzinjiramo, mushaakiishemo umuntu wishiimira kubacumbikira, maze mubaane na we, kugeza igihe muzaahaviira.
Nimugera mu rugo rwe, mubaramutse.
Niiba ab’urwo rugo bakwiriye amahoro yaanyu, agumane na bo, ariko niiba batabikwiriye, amahoro yaanyu abagarukire.
Nihagira uwanga kubacumbikira, cangwa kubatega amatwi, mukunkumure umucuucu wo mu birenge byanyu mukiva muri urwo rugo cangwa iyo tawuni ngo bibabeere ikimenyeetso co kubashinja.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko ab’i Sodomu n’i Gomora bazaahaabwa igihano gito ku munsi wo guca urubanza ugereranyije nab’iyo tawuni."
"Dore mboohereje nk’intaama hagati y’amasega aryana, nuuko reero mugire ubwenge nk’ubw’inzoka kandi mugire ubucureezi nk’ubw’inuma.
Mwirinde abo bantu, kuko bazaabajaana mu nkiiko bakabakubitira no mu masinagoogi,
kandi muzaagabizwa abategetsi n’abaami babampoora, ubwo muzambeera abahamya imbere yaabo n’abanyamahanga.
Igihe bazaabagabiza mu nkiiko, ntimuzaahagarike imitima mwibaza uko muzaavuga n’ibyo muzaavuga, kuko ibyo kuvuga muzaabihaabwa ico gihe.
Kuko si mwe muzaaba muvuga, ahuubwo Umwuka wa So ni we uzaabavugiramo.
Umuntu azaagambaanira uwo bava inda imwe ngo yicwe, se w’umwana azaamugambaanira, n’abaana bazaagomera ababyeyi baabo babiiciishe.
Muzangwa na boose ku bw’izina ryanje. Ariko uziihangaana kugeza ku iherezo azaakizwa.
Ni babatootereza mu tawuni imwe, muzaahungire mu yindi. Ndabahamiriza yuuko mutazaazenguruka amatawuni yoose yo muri Isirayeli Umwana w’Umuntu ataraaza.
Ntamwigiishwa uruta umwigiisha we, ntaan’umugaragu uruta sheebuja.
Birahagije ko umwigiishwa amera nk’umwigiisha, ndetse n’umugaragu akamera nka sheebuja. Nuuko reero niiba nyir’urugo yiswe Bbelizebuulu, abo muri urwo rugo baziitwa amazina mabi kurutaho.
Nuuko reero ntimukabatinye, kuko ntaagihishwe kitazaahishuurwa, kandi ntaagikorerwa mu ibanga kitazaamenyekana.
Ibyo mbabwirira mu mwijima, muzaabivugire mu muco, kandi ibyo mwongorerwa, muzaabyamamarize ku gasozi.
Ntimugatinye abiica umubiri ariko badashobora kwica ubugingo, ahuubwo mutinye uwo ufite ububaasha bwo kurimburira umubiri n’ubugingo muri gehenoomu.
Mbese ibishwi bibiri ntibigurwa igiceri ? Ariko nta na kimwe gishobora kwikubita haasi, So wo mu ijuru atabyemeye.
Kandi n’imisatsi yo ku mitwe yaanyu irabazwe.
Noone reero, ntimugire ubwoba, kuko mufite agaciiro kuruta ibishwi byinshi.
Nuuko reero umuntu weese uzanyemera mu ruhame rw’abantu, nanje nzamwemera imbere ya Daata wo mu ijuru.
Ariko uzanyihakanira mu ruhame rw’abantu, nanje nzamwihakanira imbere ya Daata wo mu ijuru.
Ntimugateekereze ko nazanywe no kuuzana amahoro ku isi, oya, si nazanywe no kuuzana amahoro ku isi, ahuubwo nazanye inkoota.
Kuko naaje gutandukanya umuhungu na se, umukoobwa na nyina, n’umukazaana na nyirabukwe.
Kandi, abanzi b’umuntu bazaaturuka mu nzu ye.
Umuntu weese ukunda se cangwa nyina kuruta uko ankunda, ntakwiriye kuba uwanje. Kandi ukunda umuhungu we cangwa umukoobwa we kuruta uko ankunda, ntaakwiriye kuba uwanje.
Utiikorera umusaraba we ngo ankurikire, ntaabwo akwiriye kuba uwanje.
Urengera ubuzima bwe azaabubura, ariko uzaahara ubuzima bwe ku bwanje, azaabubona.
Ubaakiiriye neeza weese ninje aba yaakiiriye, kandi unyakiiriye aba yaakiiriye uwantumye.
Uwakiira umuhanuuzi mu izina ry’umuhanuuzi azaahaabwa ingororano y’abahanuuzi, kandi uwaakiira umukiraanutsi mu izina ry’abakiraanutsi azaahaabwa ingororano y’abakiraanutsi.
Kandi uzaaha umwe muri aba baana bato niibura igikopu c’amaazi akonje yo kunywa mu izina ry’abiigiishwa, ndababwira ukuri yuuko atazaabura guhembwa."
Yesu arangije guha abiigiishwa be cumi na babiri ingenderwaho, avayo aja kwigiisha no kwamamaza Ubutumwa mu matawuni y’aho.
Igihe Yohaana yari mu gihome, yumviise ibyo Kristo akora, amutumaho abiigiishwa be
baramubaza bati, "Mbese uri wa wundi ugomba kuzaaza, cangwa dutegereze undi?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Nimugende mubwire Yohaana ibyo mwiyumviye n’ibyo mwiboneye,
impumyi zirahumuuka, abarema baragenda, ababembe barakira, abapfaamatwi barumva, abaapfuuye barazuurwa, n’abakene bakagezwaho Ubutumwa Bwiza.
Hahiirwa abo bizeera ibyanje badashidiikanya."
Abiigiishwa ba Yohaana bakiva aho, Yesu atangira kubwira abantu ibya Yohaana ati, "Mwagiiye mu butaayu kureeba iki? Urubingo ruhungabanywa n’umuyaga?
Noone se mwagiiye kureeba iki? Umuntu wambaye imyambaro y’agaciiro kenshi? Umva, abambara imyambaro ihenze baba ibwami.
Noone se mwagiiye kureeba iki? Umuhanuuzi? Yeego, ni koko ndababwira ko, ndetse aruta umuhanuuzi.
Uwo Yohaana Umubatiza ni we ibyanditswe bivuga, ngo, ‘Dore noohereje intumwa yanje mbere yaawe, kugira ngo akubanzirize, maze agutungaanyirize inzira.’
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko, mu baabyawe n’umugore, hatiigeze kubaho umuntu ukomeye nka Yohaana Umubatiza, ariko nyamara, uworoheje mu bo mu Bwami bw’ijuru aramuruta.
Uheereye mu minsi ya Yohaana Umubatiza ukageza n’ubu Ubwami bwo mu ijuru buraharanirwa, intwari zibweguukanisha imbaraga.
Kuko abahanuuzi boose, n’amategeko byahanuuye kugeza igihe Yohaana yaziye.
Kandi niiba mushaatse kubyemera, uwo Yohaana ni we umeze nka Eliya wahanuuwe ko azaaza.
Ufite amatwi yumva, niyumve!
Ariko abantu b’iki gihe nabagereranya n’iki? Bameze nk’abaana biicaye mu maguriro bahamagarana bati,
‘Twabavugirije imyironge, ntimwabyina. Twateye indirimbo z’amaganya, ariko ntimwarira.’
Nk’uko Yohaana yaje atarya kandi atanywa, baravuga bati, ‘Afite dayimooni.’
Umwana w’Umuntu aje arya kandi anywa, baravuga bati, ‘Dore, uriiya ni igisambo kandi ni umusinzi, n’inshuti y’abasoreesha n’abanyabyaha!’ Nyamara, ubwenge bugaragazwa n’imirimo yabwo."
Nuuko atangira gucaaha abatuuye mu matawuni yo yakoreyemo ibitangaaza byinshi, ariko bakanga kwihana.

Arababwira ati, "Muzaabona ishano mwa bantu b’i Koraziini mwe! Namwe ab’i Betsayida muzaabona ishano. Kuko ibitangaaza byakorewe muri mwe, iyo bikorerwa i Tiiro n’i Sidoni, abaaho baba barambaye ibiguniya baakisiiga itaazi nk’ikimenyeetso co kwihana.
Ariko ndababwira yuuko, ku munsi wo guciirwaho urubanza, bizooroha kwihanganira ab’i Tiiro n’i Sidoni kuruta mwe.
Kandi namwe ab’i Kaperenawumu, mbese mushizwe heejuru ngo mugere ku ijuru? Oya, muzaamanurwa mugezwe ikuzimu. Kuko iyo ibitangaaza byabakorewemo bikorerwa i Sodomu, iba igihagaze kugeza nan’ubu.
Ariko ndababwira yuuko ku munsi wo guciirwa imanza, ab’i Sodomu baziihangaanirwa kurusha uko mwe muziihangaanirwa."
Ico gihe Yesu aravuga ati, "Ndagushiima Daata, Nyir’ijuru n’isi, kuko ibyo wabihishe abanyabwenge n’abahanga ukabihishuurira abaciiye bugufi.
Yeego, Daata, kuko ari ko wabishaatse.
Ibintu byose nabihaawe na Daata. Ntaawe uzi Umwana keretse Se, kandi ntaawe uzi Se keretse Umwana, n’uwo Umwana ashaatse guhishuurira se.
Nimuuze mwese abarushe n’abaremeererewe, ndabaruhuura.
Nimunyumvire kandi mundeebereho, kuko norooheje kandi nkaba nshiye bugufi mu mutima, ni ho muzaabona uburuhukiro mu mitima yaanyu.
Kuko kunkurikira bitaruhije, n’umutwaro wanje utaremeereye."
Muri ico gihe, Yesu anyura mu mirima y’ingano ku Isaabato, abiigiishwa be baari bashonje, maze batangira guca amahundo bararya.
Abafarisaayo babiboonye, baramubwira bati, "Dore, abiigiishwa baawe barakora ibidakwiriye gukorwa ku Isaabato."
Na we arabasubiza ati, "Mbese ntaabwo mwasomye uko Dawudi n’abo baari kumwe baabigenjeje ubwo baari bashonje?
Yinjiye mu Nzu y’Imaana arya imigaati yari igenewe ituuro ry’Imaana, kandi we n’abo baari kumwe ntaabwo bari beemerewe kuyirya, kuko yari igenewe abaheerezabitambo bonyine.
Cangwa se ntimwasomye mu mategeko ko ku Isaabato abaheerezabitambo mu Nzu y’Imaana biica itegeko rigenga Isaabato kandi ntibibabeere icaaha?
Ndababwira yuuko hano hari igisumba Inzu y’Imaana.
Ariko iyo muba muuzi ico aya magambo amenyeesha, ‘Ico nshaaka ni imbabazi atari ibitambo,’ ntimuba mwaciiriye urubanza abatagira icaaha,
kuko Umwana w’Umuntu ari we ufite ububaasha bugenga Isaabato."
Ava muri uwo mwanya aja mu isinagoogi yaabo,
ahasanga umugabo ufite ikiganza kinyunyutse, maze baramubaza bati, "Mbese amategeko yeemera gukiza umuntu ku Isaabato?" Ibi baabimubajije kugira ngo babone uko bamurega.
Na we arabasubiza ati, "Mbese umwe muri mwe yaaba afite intaama imwe yoonyine, ikagwa mu coobo ku munsi w’Isaabato, ntaayikuuremo?
Nyamara umuntu arusha intaama agaciiro! Nuuko reero, byemewe n’amategeko gukora neeza ku munsi w’Isaabato."
Haanyuma abwira wa mugabo ati, "Rambuura ikiganza caawe." Arakirambuura, maze kirakira, kiba kizima nk’ikindi.
Ariko Abafarisaayo barasohoka nuuko baja inaama yo kumwica.
Yesu amenye imigambi y’Abafarisaayo, arahava. Abantu benshi baramukurikira, maze abaari barwaye boose arabakiza,
kandi abategeka kutamwamamaza.
Ibi yabikoze kugira ngo ibyavuzwe n’umuhanuuzi Yesaaya byuzuzwe ngo,
"Uyu ni umugaragu wanje, niitooranyirije, nkunda caane, umutima wanje ukamwishiimira. Nzaamushiraho Umwuka wanje, maze na we azaamamaze ubutabeera ku banyamahanga.
Ntaazaatongana, kandi ntaazaasakuza, cangwa ngo hagire uwumva ijwi rye mu mihanda.
Azaagirira impuhwe abafite intege nke, kandi agirire imbabazi imburabure. Azaakomeza kugeza igihe ubutabeera buzaatsinda.
Bityo reero abanyamahanga baziiringira izina rye."
Nuuko bamuuzanira umuntu uhumye kandi ari n’umuragi kuko yari ateewe na dayimooni, maze Yesu aramukiza. Uwo muntu aravuga kandi arareeba.
Abantu nyamwinshi baari aho, boose baratangaara maze bariibaza bati, "Uyu ntiyaaba ari we mwene Dawudi?"
Ariko Abafarisaayo babyumviise, baravuga bati, "Ntaawundi umuha imbaraga zo kwirukana abadayimooni, keretse Bbelizebuulu, umutware w’abadayimooni."
Kuko Yesu yari azi ico baateekereza, ni ko kubabwira ati, "Ubwami bwose bwigabyemo ibice burarimbuka, kandi ntaatawuni cangwa umuryango wisubiranamo ngo urambe .
Niiba Sataani yiirukana Sataani, ubwo aba yiirwanya, noone se ubwami bwe bwakomera bute?
Kandi niiba nkoreesha Bbelizebuulu kwirukana abadayimooni, noone se abayoboke baanyu ni nde ubaha ububaasha bwo kwirukana abadayimooni? Ni co gituma reero bazaabaciira urubanza.
Ariko niiba ari Umwuka w’Imaana nkoreesha kwirukana abadayimooni, reero Ubwami bw’Imaana bwabagezemo.
Cangwa se, umuntu yashobora ate kumena inzu y’umunyambaraga maze agasahura ibye, atabanje kumuboha? Ubwo ni bwo yashobora gusahura ibyo mu rugo rwe.
Umuntu weese utari nanje aba andwanya, kandi uwo tudateeranyiriza hamwe arataataanya.
Ni co gituma mbabwira ko abantu bazaababarirwa icaaha coose ndetse no gutuka Imaana, ariko gutuka Umwuka Weera ntaabwo bizaababarirwa.
Umuntu weese uzaavuga naabi Umwana w’Umuntu azaababarirwa, ariko uzaavuga naabi Umwuka Weera ntaabwo azaababarirwa, haaba mu gihe turimo cangwa ikizaaza.
Niiba mufite igiti ciiza, kizeera imbuto nziiza, niiba mufite igiti kibi, kizeera imbuto mbi, kuko igiti kirangwa n’imbuto zaaco.
Mwa rubyaro rw’inciira mwe! Mwashobora mute kuvuga amagambo meeza, kandi muri babi? Kuko akuuzuye umutima ni ko gaseesekara ku rurimi.
Umuntu mwiza avaana ibyiza mu mutima we, naho umuntu mubi akavaana ibibi byuzuye mu mutima we.
Ndababwira yuuko, ku munsi Imaana izaaca imanza muzaabazwa buri jambo ryose ry’impfaabusa mwavuze,
kuko amagambo yaawe ari yo azaatuma utsinda, cangwa utsindwa n’urubanza."
Nuuko bamwe mu banditsi n’Abafarisaayo baramubwira bati, "Mwigiisha, turiifuuza kureeba igitangaaza kiguturukaho."
Ariko we arabasubiza ati, "Ab’igihe c’inkozi z’ibibi hamwe n’ubuhemu barasaba igitangaaza, ariko ntaagitangaaza kindi bazaahaabwa, keretse ic’umuhanuuzi Yona.
Nk’uko Yona yamaze iminsi itatu n’amajoro atatu mu nda y’isamaaki nini, ni ko n’Umwana w’Umuntu azaamara iminsi itatu n’amajoro atatu ikuzimu.
Ku munsi w’urubanza abantu b’i Ninevi bazaahagurukira ab’iki gihe maze babashinje, kuko biihannye ku bw’inyigiisho ya Yona, kandi dore uruta Yona ari hano!
Umwamikazi w’amajeepfo azaahagurukira ab’iki gihe kuri uwo munsi w’urubanza maze abatsinde, kuko yaturutse ku mpera y’isi aje kumva ubuhanga bwa Solomooni, kandi hano hari uruta Solomooni!
Iyo umwuka mubi uvuuye mu muntu, uzereera mu butaayu ushaakiisha uburuhuukiro, maze ukabubura.
Nuuko ukavuga uti, ‘Reka nsubire mu nzu yanje navuuyemo.’ Iyo ugarutse ugasanga irimo ubusa, ikondoowe, kandi iteguuwe,
uragenda ukaazana indi myuka mibi irindwi iyirusha ubukana, maze ikinjira ikahatuura kandi imibeereho ye ya nyuma ikarusha iya mbere kuba mibi. Uko ni ko bizaabeera inkozi z’ibibi z’iki gihe."
Igihe Yesu yari akivugana n’abantu benshi, nyina n’abavandimwe be baari bahagaze hanze, bashaaka kuvugana na we.
Umuntu aramubwira ati, "Dore, nyoko n’abavandimwe baawe bahagaze hanze, barashaaka kuvugana naawe."
Yesu asubiza uwari amaze kumubwira ati, "Maama ni nde, kandi abavandimwe banje ni bande?"
Nuuko atunga urutoki ku biigiishwa be, maze aravuga ati, "Dore maama n’abavandimwe banje!
Kuko umuntu weese ukora ibyo Daata wo mu ijuru ashaaka ni we mwene daata, ni we mushiki wanje kandi ni we maama."
Uwo munsi Yesu ava mu nzu maze yicara ku nkengeero y’inyanja.
Abantu benshi baramwitooroora bimuteera kuja mu bwato maze yiicaramo, naho abo bantu bahagarara ku nkengeero.
Ababwira ibintu byinshi akoreesheje imigani ati, "Nimwumve! Umubibyi yagiiye kubiba.
Ubwo yabibaga, imbuto zimwe zigwa mu nzira, maze inyoni ziraaza zirazirya.
Izindi mbuto zigwa ku kaara, maze zimera vuba, kuko ubutaka bwari buke.
Ariko izuuba rivuuye ziraraba, kuko imizi itaari igeze kure, ziruuma.
Izindi mbuto zigwa mu mahwa, amahwa arakura, arazipfukiriranya ntizaakura.
Izindi mbuto zigwa mu butaka bwiza maze zeera imbuto, zimwe ijana, izindi mirongo itandatu, izindi mirongo itatu.
Ufite amatwi yumva niyumve!"
Abiigiishwa be baramwegeera maze baramubaza bati, "Ni iki gituma ubiigiishiriza mu migani?"
Arabasubiza ati, "Mwebwe mwahaawe kumenya amabanga y’Ubwami bw’ijuru, ariko bo ntibaabihaawe.
Kuko abafite, bazongeererwa kandi bahaabwe byinshi, ariko abadafite, bazaakwa n’ico bafite.
Igituma mbiigishiriza mu migani ni uko ‘Bareeba ntibabone, baatega amatwi ntibumve kandi ntibasobaanukirwe.’
Muri bo, hazuuzurizwa ubuhanuuzi bwa Yesaaya buvuga ngo, ‘Koko muzumva, ariko ntimuzaasobaanukirwa, kandi muzaareeba, ariko ntimuzaabona.

Kuko imitima yaabo yiinangiye, kandi amatwi yaabo akaba atumva neeza, ndetse biipfutse amaaso, kugira ngo batareeba, atari ibyo, amaaso yaabo yakareebye, n’amatwi yaabo yakumviise, kandi imitima yaabo igasobaanukirwa, maze bakampindukira, nkabakiza.’
Ariko mwebwe murahiirwa, kuko amaaso yaanyu arabona, kandi n’amatwi yaanyu arumva.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko abahanuuzi benshi n’abantu bintungaane biifuuzaga kureeba ibyo mureeba, ariko ntibabibone, ndetse no kumva ibyo mwumva, ariko ntibabyumve.
Nuuko nimwumve ico umugani w’umubibyi umenyeesha.
Iyo umuntu yumviise ijambo ry’Imaana ariko ntaarisobaanukirwe, Umubi araaza agasahura ikibibwe mu mutima we, uwo ameze nk’imbuto zaabibwe ku nzira.
Naho izaabibwe ku kaara, ni uwumva ijambo ako kaanya akaryakiirana umuneezeero,
ariko ntirimwuzure ngo rishinge imizi, yiihangaana umwanya muto. Iyo haaje amakuba cangwa gutootezwa biteewe n’iryo jambo, uwo muntu ashooka avuuye mu kwizeera.
Naho izaaguuye mu mahwa, zisobaanura umuntu wumva neeza ijambo, ariko akiita ku by’isi maze irari ry’ubutunzi rikaniga rya jambo, maze ntiryere imbuto.
Naho izaabibwe mu butaka bwiza, abo ni abumva ijambo bakarisobaanukirwa, bakeera imbuto, umwe ijana, undi mirongo itandatu, undi mirongo itatu."
Yesu aciira abantu undi mugani ati, "Ubwami bw’ijuru bwagereranywa n’umuntu wabibye imbuto nziiza mu murima we.
Ariko abantu basinziiriye, umwanzi araaza abiba urumamfu mu ngano, maze ariigendera.
Ingano zimaze kumera no kugaragaza imbuto, urumamfu na rwo ruragaragara.
Abagaragu be baraaza baramubaza bati, ‘Daatabuja, ntiwari warabibye imbuto nziiza mu murima waawe? Noone se, urumamfu rwaje rute?’
Arabasubiza ati, ‘Umwanzi ni we wabikoze.’ Abagaragu barongera bati, ‘Noone urashaaka ko tuja kururandura?’
Ariko we arabasubiza ati, ‘Oya, muri uko kurandura urumamfu, mushobora kururandurana n’ingano.

Reka byombi bikurane kugeza igihe c’isaaruura, maze mu gihe co gusaaruura nzaabwira abasaaruuzi nti, nimubanze mutoranye urumamfu maze muruhambiremo imiganda murutwike, ingano muzihunike mu kigega canje.’ "
Yesu abaciira undi mugani ati, "Ubwami bw’ijuru bumeze nk’akabuto gato kitwa sinaapi ko umuntu yabibye mu murima we.
Ni ko kabuto gatooya kuruta izindi mbuto zoose, ariko iyo gakuze kaba igiti kinini gifite amashami ndetse inyoni zo mu kireere zaarika mu mashami yaaco."
Ababwira undi mugani ati, "Ubwami bw’ijuru bumeze nk’umusemburo umugore yavanze mo ibyibo bitatu by’ifu kugeza aho byose bitutumba."
Yesu yigishirizaga abantu benshi mu migani kandi ntaaco yiigiishije adakoreesheje imigani y’amarenga.
Uku kwari ukugira ngo iby’umuhanuuzi yavuze bisohore ati, "Nzaabumbuura akanwa kanje mvuge mu migani y’amarenga. Nzaamamaza ibyahishwe kuva isi ikiremwa."
Haanyuma asiga rubanda maze yinjira mu nzu. Nuuko abiigiishwa be baramwegeera, baramubaza bati, "Dusobaanurire umugani w’urumamfu mu murima."
Arabasubiza ati, "Uwabibye imbuto nziiza ni Umwana w’Umuntu,
umurima ni isi, imbuto nziiza ni abaana b’Ubwami, urumamfu ni abaana b’Umubi,
naho umwanzi wateeye urumamfu ni Seekibi, isaaruura n’imperuuka y’isi, naho abasaaruuzi ni abaamalayika.
Nk’uko urumamfu rukunganywa rukajugunywa mu muriro, ni nako bizaaba ku mperuuka y’isi.
Umwana w’Umuntu azoohereza abaamalayika be, maze batandukanye abo boose baatumye abandi bagomera Imaana hamwe n’inkozi z’ibibi,
maze babajugunye mu itanuura y’umuriro, aho bazaaririra bakahahekenyera ameenyo.
Ico gihe intungaane zizaarabagirana nk’izuuba mu Bwami bwa Se. Ufite amatwi ni yumve!

Ubwami bw’ijuru bumeze nk’ikintu c’agaciiro gihishwe mu murima. Iyo umuntu akiguuyeho , aragihisha maze akagenda n’umuneezeero mwinshi akaguriisha ibyo yari atunze byose kugira ngo abone uko yagura wa murima.
Byongeye kandi, Ubwami bw’ijuru bumeze nk’umucuruuzi washaakaga amabuye y’agaciiro meeza,
aboonye ibuye rimwe ry’agaciiro kanini, aragenda aguriisha ibyo atunze byose maze ararigura.
Byongeye kandi, Ubwami bw’ijuru bumeze nk’agatimba baajugunye mu nyanja kagafata isamaaki z’amooko yoose,
kaamara kuuzura, bakagakururira ku nkengeero, bakiicara, maze isamaaki nziiza bakazishira mu bisobane naho imbi bakazijugunya.
Uko ni ko bizaaba ku mperuuka y’isi. Abaamalayika b’Imaana bazaaza batandukanye intungaane n’inkozi z’ibibi
bazijugunye mu itanuura y’umuriro, aho bazaaririra bakahahekenyera ameenyo."
Yesu arababaza ati, "Ibi bintu murabisobaanukiwe?" Baramusubiza bati, "Yee."
Arababwira ati, "Nuuko reero umwanditsi weese wiigiishijwe iby’Ubwami bw’ijuru yagereranywa na nyir’urugo wakuuye mu bubiiko ibisha n’ibishaaje."
Yesu amaze kubaciira iyo migani, ava muri uwo mwanya.
Aja mu tawuni y’iwaabo atangira kwigiishiriza abantu mu masinagoogi yaabo, maze baratangaara, baravuga bati, "Uyu mugabo akuura he ubu buhanga n’ububaasha bwo gukora ibi bitangaaza?
Uyu si umwana wa wa mubaaji? Nyina siyitwa Mariya? Beene se si Yaakobo, Yozefu, Simooni na Yuda?
Bashiki be ntidutuuranye na bo? Noone se yakuuye he ubuhanga n’ububaasha bwo gukora ibintu nk’ibi?"
Nuuko baramwanga. Ariko Yesu arababwira ati, "Ntaahandi abahanuuzi basuuzugurirwa, keretse mu gihugu caabo ndetse no mu miryango yaabo."
Kandi ntiyongera kuhakorera ibitangaaza, abiteewe no kuteemera kwabo.
Ico gihe Herodi, umutware w’i Galileeya, yumva ibifashe kuri Yesu,
nuuko abwira abagaragu be ati. "Uyu ni Yohaana Umubatiza wazuutse mu baapfuuye, kandi ni co gituma akora ibitangaaza nk’ibi."
Kuko Herodi yari yarafashe Yohaana, akamuboha, akamushira mu gihome ku bwa Herodiyaasi, umugore wa mwene nyina Filipo,
kuko Yohaana yaramubwiraga ati, "Amategeko ntaabwo akwemerera kumutunga."
Nuubwo Herodi yashaakaga kumwica, yatiinyaga rubanda, kuko bamujaanaga nk’umuhanuuzi.
Umunsi wo kwibuka kuvuuka kwa Herodi ugeze, umukoobwa wa Herodiyaasi abyinira imbere y’abaatumiwe, maze ashiimiisha Herodi
ku buryo yaseezeranyije uwo mukoobwa arahira ko aribumuhe ico amusaba coose.
Nyina amaze kumwosha, aravuga ati, "Mpa igihanga ca Yohaana Umubatiza ku mbeehe."
Umwami arababara caane, ariko kubw’indahiro yari yarahiriye imbere y’abashitsi be, ategeka ko bakimuha.
Nuuko yoohereza abo kuja guciira igihanga ca Yohaana mu gihome.
Igihanga bakiizana ku mbeehe maze bagiheereza wa mukoobwa, na we agiheereza nyina.
Abiigiishwa ba Yohaana baraaza bajaana umurambo we maze barawuhamba, haanyuma baja kubimenyeesha Yesu.
Yesu amaze kubyumva, aja mu bwato, agana ahantu hadatuuwe kwihereera. Ariko rubanda babimenye, bava mu matawuni yaabo n’amaguru maze baramukurikira.
Amaze kwambuka, abona rubanda nyamwinshi, abagirira impuhwe maze akiiza abarwayi baari muri bo.
Bugoroobye, abiigiishwa baramusanga maze baramubwira bati, "Aha ni ahantu hadatuuwe, kandi n’umunsi urakuze, seezerera aba bantu baje mu byaro byabo maze biigurire ibyokurya."
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Singombwa ko bagenda, nimubagaburire mwebwe ubwanyu."
Baramusubiza bati, "Ntaaco dufite hano, keretse imigaati itaanu n’isamaaki ebyiri gusa."
Arababwira ati, "Nimubinzanire hano."

Maze ategeka abo bantu kwicara haasi mu byatsi. Afata ya migaati itaanu n’isamaaki ebyiri, areeba mu ijuru, ashiimira Imaana maze amanyagura ya migaati, ayiha abiigiishwa, na bo bayigaburira rubanda nyamwinshi.
Boose bararya, barahaaga, nuuko barundanyiriza hamwe ibisigaye, byuzura intonga cumi n’ebyiri.
Abaariiye baari nk’abagabo ibihumbi bitaanu, abagore n’abaana batabariwemo.
Ako kaanya Yesu ategeka abiigiishwa kwinjira mu bwato ngo bamubanzirize haakurya, mu gihe we agiseezerera rubanda.
Amaze kubaseezerera, azaamuuka umusozi wenyine aja gusenga. Bwagoroobye ari yo wenyine,
kandi ubwato bwari bugeze kure y’inkengeero buhungabanywa n’imivumba kuko umuyaga wari ubaturutse imbere.
Nuuko mu gitondo ca kare kare, aza abagana agendeesha amaguru heejuru y’inyanja.
Ariko abiigiishwa bamuboonye agendera ku nyanja, basha ubwoba, ni ko kuvuza induuru bati, "Ni umuzimu!"
Ako kaanya Yesu avugana na bo arababwira ati, "Nimuhuumure, ni njeewe, mwitiinya."
Peetero ni ko kumusubiza ati, "Nyagasani, niiba ari wowe koko, ntegeka ngusange, ngendera heejuru y’amaazi."
Yesu ati, "Ngwino." Nuuko Peetero ava mu bwato, atangira kugendera heejuru y’amaazi, asanga Yesu.
Ariko aboonye umuyaga ubaaye mwinshi, agira ubwoba, maze atangira kurohama, nuuko ateera heejuru ati, "Nyagasani, ntabaara!"
Ako kaanya Yesu arambuura ukuboko kwe aramusingiira, aramubwira ati, "Wa mwemera gato we, kuki washidikanyije?"
Nuuko bageze mu bwato, umuyaga uratuuza.
Abaari mu bwato baramuramya, bavuga bati, "Ni ukuri uri Umwana w’Imaana!"
Bamaze kwambuka, bagera mu gihugu ca Genezareti.
Abantu b’uwo mwanya bamaze kumumenya, bakwirakwiza inkuru muri ico gihugu coose maze bamuuzanira abarwayi boose.
Nuuko binginga Yesu ngo niibura yeemerere abarwayi bafate ku nshonda z’umwenda we kandi abo boose baazikozeho barakira.
Muri ico gihe, Abafarisaayo hamwe n’Abiigiishamategeko basanga Yesu bavuuye i Yerusaalemu, baramubaza bati,
"Kuki abiigiishwa baawe badakurikiza umuco karande w’abakurambere? Dore ntibakaraba intoki bagiiye kurya."
Arabasubiza ati, "Mwebwe kuki mwica itegeko ry’Imaana mwishigikirije umuco karande waanyu?
Kuko Imaana yaravuze iti, ‘Uje wubaha so na nyoko,’ kandi iti, ‘Uzaatuka se cangwa nyina agomba kwicwa.’
Ariko umuntu weese ubwira se cangwa nyina ati, ‘Ico najaga kugufaashiisha nagituuye Imaana.’ Umuntu umeze atyo ntaabwo yakuubaha se cangwa nyina.
Bityo, muba mushigikiye umuco karande, ijambo ry’Imaana hamwe n’amategeko mukabihindura ubusa.
Mwa ndyarya mwe! Yesaaya yabahanuuyeho neeza ubwo yavuze ati,
‘Aba bantu banyubahiisha ururimi, ariko imitima yaabo imba kure,
barushwa n’ubusa bansenga, kuko biigiisha amategeko y’abantu nk’aho ari amategeko yanje.’ "
Nuuko ahamagara rubanda maze arababwira ati, "Nimutege amatwi kandi musobaanukirwe,
ntaabwo ari ikija mu kanwa gihumaanya umuntu, ahuubwo ikiva mu kanwa ni co kiimuhumaanya."
Maze abiigiishwa baramwegeera baramubaza bati, "Uzi yuuko Abafarisaayo baababajwe no kumva amagambo umaze kuvuga?"
Arabasubiza ati, "Igiti coose kitaateewe na Daata wo mu ijuru kigomba kurandurwa.
Nimubiihorere, ni impumyi ziyobora izindi mpumyi. Kandi iyo impumyi iyoboye indi mpumyi, zombi zigwa mu coobo."
Ariko Peetero aramubwira ati, "Dusobaanurire uyu mugani."
Nuuko aramusubiza ati, "Mbese namwe ntimuraasobaanukirwa?
Ntimuuzi yuuko ikintu coose kigiiye mu kanwa kija munda, maze kigasohoka kikaja mu coroone?
Ariko ibiva mu kanwa biba biturutse mu mutima, kandi ni byo bihumaanya umuntu.
Kuko mu mutima ni ho haturuka ibiteekerezo bibi nk’ubwicanyi, ubusambanyi, ubuheeheesi, ubujuura, ububeeshi no gusebya abandi.
Ibi ni byo bihumaanya umuntu, ariko kuriisha intoki zidakarabye ntibihumaanya."
Yesu arahava aja mu disiturikiti y’i Tiiro n’i Sidoni.
Muri ako kaanya haba haaje Umunyakanaanikazi wari utuuye muri ako gace, asanga Yesu, ateera heejuru caane ati, "Nyagasani, Mwana wa Dawudi, ngirira imbabazi, umukoobwa wanje yateewe na dayimooni."
Ariko ntiyagira ico amusubiza. Nuuko abiigiishwa be baramwegeera baramwinginga, baramubwira bati, "Mwirukane kuko ayombera inyuma yaacu."
Arabasubiza ati, "Ntaahandi nooherejwe, keretse mu ntaama za Isirayeli zaazimiye."
Uwo mugore araaza apfukama imbere ye, aravuga ati, "Nyagasani, ntabaara."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ntaabwo bikwiriye gufata ibyokurya by’abaana maze ukabijugunyira imbwa."
Umugore na we ati, "Ni koko Nyagasani, ariko imbwa na zo zirya ibisigarizwa bigwa bivuuye ku meeza ya sheebuja."
Maze Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Mugore, ufite kwizeera gukomeye! Bikubeere nk’uko ubishaaka." Ako kaanya umukoobwa we arakira.
Yesu amaze kuva muri uwo mwanya, anyura ku nkengeero y’inyanja ya Galileeya, maze azaamuuka umusozi nuuko ariicara.
Abantu benshi baaza aho ari, bazaana abacumbagira, abamuga, abahumye, abaragi n’abandi benshi. Baabashiraga imbere ye, akabakiza,
ku buryo rubanda baatangaaye ubwo bareebaga abaragi bavuga, abamugaye bakira, abacumbagira bagenda, n’abahumye bareeba, maze basingiza Imaana ya Isirayeli.

Yesu ahamagara abiigiishwa be maze avugana na bo ababwira ati, "Aba bantu nyamwinshi ndabababariye, kuko maranye na bo iminsi itatu yoose noone bakaba ntaaco kurya bafite, kandi sinshaaka kubaseezerera bafite inzara, kugira ngo batagwa mu nzira."
Abiigiishwa baramubwira bati, "Twakuura he imigaati ihaagije aba bantu boose muri ubu butaayu?"
Yesu arababaza ati, "Mufite imigaati ingaahe?" Baramusubiza bati, "Dufite imigaati irindwi n’udusamaaki dukeeya."
Maze ategeka rubanda kwicara haasi,
afata ya migaati irindwi na za samaaki, amaze gushiimira Imaana arayimaanyagura, abiha abiigiishwa be, maze n’abiigiishwa babiha abantu.
Boose bararya barahaaga, maze bashira hamwe ubuvungunyukira busigaye, bwuzura ibisobane birindwi.
Abaariiye baari abagabo ibihumbi bine, batabariyemo abagore n’abaana.
Amaze guseezerera rubanda, yinjira mu bwato maze aja mu gace ka Magadani.
Abafarisaayo n’Abasadukaayo baraaza, basaba Yesu kubeereka ikimenyeetso kivuuye mu ijuru kugira ngo bamutege.
Arabasubiza ati, "Muri iki gihugu iyo bugoroobye, muravuga muti, ‘Haraba umuco kuko ijuru ritukura.’

Naho mu gitondo muti, ‘Haraba umuvumbi uyu munsi, kuko ijuru ritukura kandi ryijimye.’ Muuzi neeza kureeba ikireere mukamenya niiba haraba umuco cangwa umuvumbi, ariko ntimushobora kumenya ibimenyeetso by’ibihe.
Abantu b’iki gihe c’ubugizi bwa naabi n’ubutamenya Imaana barashaaka ikimenyeetso, ariko ntaakimenyeetso bazaabona keretse ica Yona." Nuuko abasiga aho aragenda
Abiigiishwa ba Yesu bageze haakurya, baari biibagiwe kujaana imigaati.
Yesu arababwira ati, "Murabe maaso, kandi mwirinde umusemburo w’Abafarisaayo n’uw’Abasadukaayo."
Bo reero baravugana bati, "Ni uko tutaazanye imigaati."
Nuuko Yesu amaze kubimenya, arababwira ati, "Mwa beemera gato mwe, kuki muvuga ibyerekeye uko mutaazanye imigaati?
Na n’ubu ntimuraasobaanukirwa? Ntimwibuka ya migaati itaanu ku bantu ibihumbi bitaanu, kandi haasigaye ibisobane bingaahe?
Cangwa ya migaati irindwi ku bantu ibihumbi bine, kandi haasigaye ibisobane bingaahe?
Mushobora mute kudasobaanukirwa ko atari imigaati navugaga? Mwirinde imisemburo y’Abafarisaayo n’Abasadukaayo!"
Nuuko basobaanukirwa ko ataababwiraga kwirinda umusemburo w’imigaati, ahuubwo ko ari ukwirinda inyigiisho z’Abafarisaayo n’iz’Abasadukaayo.
Nuuko Yesu ageze mu gice c’i Kayisaariya ya Filipo, abaza abiigiishwa be ati, "Abantu bavuga ko Umwana w’Umuntu ari nde?"
Baramusubiza bati, "Bamwe bavuga ko uri Yohaana Umubatiza, abandi ngo uri Eliya, abandi ngo uri Yeremiya, cangwa ngo uri umwe mu bahanuuzi."
Yongera kubabaza ati, "Ariko se mwebwe muvuga ko ndi nde?"
Simooni Peetero aramusubiza ati, "Uri Kristo , Umwana w’Imaana nzima!"
Yesu aramubwira ati, "Urahiirwa Simooni mwene Yona! Kuko atari umuntu wabiguhishuuriye, ahuubwo ni Daata uri mu ijuru.
Kandi ndakubwira, ko uri Peetero kimenyeesha Urutare, kandi kuri urwo rutare ni ho nzubaka Itoorero ryanje, ndetse n’imbaraga z’urupfu ntizizaarishobora.
Nzaaguha ibishumuruzo by’Ubwami bw’ijuru, kandi ico uzaaboha mu isi, kizaaba kiboshwe no mu ijuru, kandi ico uzaabohoora mu isi kizaaba kibohoowe no mu ijuru."
Nuuko yihanangiriza abiigiishwa be kutagira uwo babwira ko ari we Kristo.

Uheereye ubwo, Yesu atangira kumenyeesha abiigiishwa be ko ari ngombwa kuja i Yerusaalemu, akababazwa caane n’abakuru b’imiryango n’abatware b’abaheerezabitambo n’Abiigiishamategeko, bakamwica, maze ku munsi wa gatatu akazuurwa.
Nuuko Peetero aramwihereerana maze atangira kumucaaha ati, "Ibyo biragatsindwa, Nyagasani! Ibi ntibikakubeho."
Ariko we arahinduka maze abwira Peetero ati, "Mva iruhande Sataani! Umbereye igisiitaaza, kuko ibiteekerezo byawe bitavuuye ku Maana ahuubwo ni iby’abantu."
Nuuko Yesu abwira abiigiishwa be ati, "Niiba hari ushaaka kunkurikira, niyiyange maze aheeke umusaraba we ankurikire.
Kuko abashaaka gukiza ubugingo bwabo bazaabubura, naho uzaabura ubugingo bwe ku bwanje azaabubona.
Umuntu byamumarira iki gutunga ibintu byose byo mu isi ariko agataakaza ubugingo bwe? Cangwa se ubugingo bw’umuntu yabugurana iki?
Kuko Umwana w’Umuntu agiiye kuuzaagarukana n’abaamalayika be ari mu ikuzo rya Se, maze agororere umuntu weese akurikije ibyo yakoze.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko, hari bamwe bahagaze hano batazaapfa bataboonye Umwana w’Umuntu aziye mu cuubahiro c’Ubwami bwe."
Hashize iminsi itandatu, Yesu ajaana na Peetero, na Yaakobo na mwene nyina Yohaana maze abajaana ku mpinga y’umusozi mureemure, bonyine.
Nuuko ishusho ye ihinduka ukundi imbere yaabo, mu maaso he harabagirana nk’izuuba, n’imyambaro ye ireererana.
Muri ako kaanya Moose na Eliya barababonekera, bavugana na Yesu.
Nuuko Peetero abwira Yesu ati, "Nyagasani, ni byiza ko twibeera hano. Nuubishaaka, ngiiye kuubaka ibiraaro bitatu hano, kimwe caawe, ikindi ca Moose, n’ikindi ca Eliya."
Akivuga, igicu kibengerana kirababundikira, maze muri ico gicu havamo ijwi rivuga riti, "Uyu ni Umwana wanje nkunda caane, nimumwumvire!"
Abiigiishwa babyumviise, biituura haasi buubamye, bagira ubwoba bwinshi caane.
Ariko Yesu araaza abafataho, arababwira ati, "Muhaguruke, mwigira ubwoba."
Buubuuye amaaso, ntihaagira undi babona keretse Yesu wenyine.
Bakimanuka umusozi, Yesu arabiihanangiriza ati, "Ntimugire uwo mubwira ibyo mumaze kwerekwa, kugeza aho Umwana w’Umuntu azaaba amaze kuzuuka mu baapfuuye."
Nuuko abiigiishwa baramubaza bati, "Kuki Abiigiishamategeko bavuga ko Eliya ari we ugomba kubanza kuuza?"
Arabasubiza ati, "Ni koko Eliya akwiriye kubanza kuuza kandi agatungaanya ibintu byose,
ariko ndababwira yuuko Eliya yaaje ntibamumenye, ahuubwo bamugirira naabi uko biishaakiye. Uko ni ko n’Umwana w’Umuntu bagiiye kumubabaza."
Nuuko abiigiishwa bamenya ko uwo yavugaga ari Yohaana Umubatiza.
Bageze ku bantu benshi, umugabo yegeera Yesu, aramupfukamira,
maze aramubwira ati, "Nyagasani, girira umuhungu wanje imbabazi, kuko arwaye igicuri kikaba kimubabaza caane. Akunda kugwa mu muriro ndetse no mu maazi.
Namuuzaniye abiigiishwa baawe, ariko ntibaashobora kumukiza."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Yemwe bantu b’iki gihe batiizeera kandi baayobye, nzabaana namwe kugeza ryari? Nzabiihanganira kugeza ryari? Nimumunzanire hano."
Yesu acaaha ya dayimooni, maze imuvamo, umuhungu aheerako arakira.
Nuuko abiigiishwa biihereerana Yesu, baramubaza bati, "Kuki twebwe tutaashoboye kuyiirukana?"

Arababwira ati, "Ni ku bwo kwizeera kwanyu guke. Ndababwira ukuri, iyo ufite kwizeera naaho kwangana n’akabuto gato kitwa sinaapi, mwabwira uyu musozi muti, ‘Va hano uje hariiya,’ maze ukahaja, kandi ntaakizaabananira.
Ariko dayimooni nkiiyi ntishoborwa n’ikindi keretse gusenga no gusiiba."
Igihe abiigiishwa baari bateeraniye i Galileeya, Yesu arababwira ati, "Umwana w’Umuntu agiiye kugambanirwa kandi agabizwe abantu,
maze bamwice, ariko ku munsi wa gatatu azuurwe." Nuuko bagira agahinda kenshi.
Ubwo baari bageze i Kaperenawumu, abasoreesha b’umusoro w’Inzu y’Imaana basanga Peetero maze baramubaza bati, "Mbese umwigiisha waanyu atanga umusoro w’Inzu y’Imaana?"

Na we aramusubiza ati, "Yee, arawutanga." Peetero yinjiye mu nzu, Yesu ni co yabanje kuvugaho, aramubaza ati, "Urateekereza iki Simooni? Ni bande bo abaami b’isi basaba imisoro cangwa amasoko? N’abaturage cangwa ni abanyamahanga?"
Peetero arasubiza ati, "Ni abanyamahanga." Yesu aramubwira ati, "Nooneho reero abatuurage ntibagomba gusoreeshwa.
Ariko, kugira ngo tutabaraakaza, ja ku nyanja ujugunyemo ururobo, isamaaki ya mbere uri bufate, uyaasamure, uribusangemo igiceri, ukijaane ukibahe nk’umusoro w’Inzu y’Imaana ku bwawe nanje."
Ico gihe abiigiishwa beegeera Yesu baramubaza bati, "Umukuru mu Bwami bwo mu ijuru ni nde?"
Ahamagara umwana muto, amushira hagati yaabo
maze arababwira ati, "Ndababwira ukuri, nimudahinduka ngo mube nk’abaana bato, ntaabwo muzinjira mu Bwami bw’ijuru.
Uwiiciisha bugufi nk’uyu mwana ni we uruta abandi mu Bwami bwo mu ijuru.
Uwaakiira umwana muto nk’uyu mu izina ryanje, aba ari nje yaakiiriye.
Nihagira uwo muri mwe ucumuza umwe muri aba bato banyiizeera, iciiza ni uko baahambiira urusyo runini ku ijosi rye maze akarohwa mu nyanja hagati.
Abo ku isi baguushije ishano ku bw’imitego ibaguusha mu byaha! Ibiguusha abantu mu byaha ntibyabura kubaho, ariko umuntu ubiteera azaabona ishano!

Niiba ikiganza caawe cangwa ikirenge caawe biguteera gukora icaaha, biceho ubijugunye kure yaawe. Iciiza ni uko waakwinjira mu bugingo buhoraho nta kiganza cangwa ikirenge ufite, aho kugira ibiganza bibiri n’ibirenge bibiri maze ukajugunywa mu muriro utazima.

Kandi ijiisho ryawe niriguteera gukora icaaha, urinogooremo maze urijugunye kure yaawe. Nibyiza ko waakwinjira mu bugingo buhoraho n’ijiisho rimwe aho kugira amaaso abiri ukajugunywa mu muriro utazima.
Mwirinde mudasuuzuugura umwe muri abo baana bato. Ndababwira yuuko, abaamalayika baabo bo mu ijuru bahora imbere ya Daata wo mu ijuru.
Kuko Umwana w’Umuntu yaaje gukiza abaazimiye.
Mwebwe murabivugaho iki? Niiba umuntu afite intaama ijana, maze imwe muri zo ikazimira, ntaabwo asiga za zindi mirongo cenda n’icenda ku musozi maze akaja gushaaka iyazimiye?
Kandi ndababwira ukuri yuuko iyo ayiboonye, arayiishiimira caane kuruta za mirongo cenda n’icenda zitaazimiye.
Noone reero ni na ko So wo mu ijuru adashaaka ko hagira n’umwe muri aba bato uzimira.
Niiba umuvandimwe mu itoorero agushobereje , musange maze umusobaanurire inshobe ye mwihereereye. Aramutse yumviise ko yashobeje, uzaaba wiigarurije uwo muvandimwe.
Ariko naateemera ko yagushobereje, jaana n’undi muntu umwe cangwa babiri, kugira ngo babihamye bari babiri cangwa batatu.
Uwo muvandimwe niyanga kubumva, ubibwire itoorero, kandi naaramuka yanze no kumva itoorero, umujaane nk’aho ari umunyamahanga cangwa umusoreesha.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko, ibyo muzaaboha mu isi bizaaba biboshwe no mu ijuru, kandi ibyo muzaabohoora mu isi bizaaba bibohoowe no mu ijuru.
Ndongera kubabwira ukuri, iyo babiri muri mwe ku isi beemeranyije ico basaba, bazaagihaabwa na Daata wo mu ijuru.
Kuko aho babiri cangwa batatu bateeraniye hamwe mu izina ryanje, mba ndi hagati yaabo."
Nuuko Peetero yegeera Yesu maze aramubaza ati, "Nyagasani, umuvandimwe wanje mu itoorero akomeje kunshobereza, nkwiriye kumubabarira kangahe? Nzageze karindwi?"
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Oya, ntaabwo ari karindwi, ahuubwo ndakubwira ko ari mirongo irindwi, karindwi.
Ku bw’iyo mpamvu, Ubwami bwo mu ijuru bwagereranywa n’umwami washaatse ko abagaragu be bakuru bamumurikira ibintu bye.
Atangiye kumurikiisha, bamuuzanira umwe mu bagaragu wari umurimo Italanta ibihumbi icumi.
Kuko yananiwe kwishura, sheebuja ategeka ko yaguriishwa, hamwe n’umugore we n’abaana be n’ibyo atunze byose, kugira ngo umwenda wishurwe.
Nuuko wa mugaragu aramupfukamira maze aramwinginga ati, ‘Nyihangaanira, nzaakwishura byose.’
Kubw’impuhwe yamugiriye, sheebuja wa wamugaragu aramurekura kandi amubabarira na wa mwenda we.
Ariko wa mugaragu agisohoka, ahuura n’umugaragu mugenzi we wari umurimo idinaari ijana, nuuko amutunga umunigo, amubwira ati, ‘Nyishura umwenda wanje.’
Umugaragu mugenzi we aramupfukamira amusaba imbabazi ati, ‘Nyihangaanira, nzaakwishura.’
Ariko aranga, maze aragenda amushira mu gihome kugeza aho aziishurira umwenda we.
Abagaragu bagenzi baabo baboonye ibibaaye birabababaza caane, nuuko ni ko kuja kwa sheebuja bamubwira ibyabaaye byose.
Maze sheebuja atumiisha kuri wa mugaragu nuuko aramubwira ati, ‘Yeewe mugaragu mubi we! Nakubabariye umwenda waawe woose kuko wansabye imbabazi,
wowe ntugomba kuba wababariye umugaragu mugenzi waawe, nk’uko nanje naakubabariye?’
Nuuko sheebuja araraakara maze amuheereza abasirikare bo kumubabaza kugeza igihe azaarangiriza kwishura umwenda we woose.
Uko ni ko Daata wo mu ijuru azaabagirira, nimutababarira abavandimwe baanyu mubikuuye ku mutima."
Yesu arangije kuvuga aya magambo, ava i Galileeya aja mu gihugu ca Yudeeya hiirya ya Yorodaani.
Abantu benshi baramukurikira, maze abakirizayo.
Bamwe mu Bafarisaayo baramwegeera, maze kugira ngo bamugerageze baramubaza bati, "Mbese bireemewe ko umugabo yiirukana umugore we ku mpamvu ibonetse yoose?"
Arabasubiza ati, "Ntimwari mwasoma yuuko mu ntangiriro Rurema yabaremye nk’umugabo n’umugore,
kandi akavuga ati, ‘Ni co gituma umugabo azaasiga se na nyina akabaana n’umugore we nuuko bombi bakaba umubiri umwe’?
Noone baba batakiri babiri, ahuubwo baba babaaye umubiri umwe. Bityo reero ico Imaana yafatanyije, ntihakagire ugitandukanya."
Baramubaza bati, "Noone se kuki Moose yategetse ko umugabo akwiriye gutanga urwandiko rwo kwirukana umugore we maze bakabona gutandukana?"
Arabasubiza ati, "N’imitima yaanyu ikomeye kwigiisha yatumye Moose abeemerera kwirukana abagore baanyu, ariko si ko byahoze kuva kare.
Kandi ndababwira ko, umuntu weese wiirukana umugore we, bitavuuye kubusambanyi, maze akaazana undi aba asambanye."
Abiigiishwa baramubwira bati, "Niiba iby’umugabo n’umugore ariko bimeze, icaaruta ni ukutarongora."
Ariko arasubiza ati, "Ntaabwo ari buri muntu wakwemera iyi nyigiisho, keretse abo baabihaawe bonyine.

Hariho abataarongora kuko baavuutse ari ibiremba, hariho n’abandi bataarongora kuko bagizwe inkone n’abandi bantu, hari n’abandi bahitamo kutarongora ku bw’Ubwami bw’ijuru. Ushobora kumva ni yumve iyi nyigiisho."
Nuuko hagira abantu baazanira Yesu abaana bato ngo abarambikeho ibiganza maze abasabire. Abiigiishwa bakabukira abaari babaazanye,
ariko Yesu arababwira ati, "Mureke abaana bato bansange, ntimubabuze, kuko Ubwami bw’ijuru ari ubw’abameze nk’abo."
Nuuko abarambikaho ibiganza maze aragenda.
Nuuko umuntu asanga Yesu maze aramubaza ati, "Mwigiisha, n’ikihe kintu ciiza naakora kugira ngo mbone ubugingo buhoraho?"
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ni kuki umbaza ikiri ciiza? Umwiza ni umwe gusa. Ariko niiba ushaaka kwinjira mu bugingo, kurikiza amategeko."
Wa musore aramubaza ati, "Ni ayahe?" Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ntuukiice, ntuugasambane, ntuukiibe, ntuugashinje abandi ibinyoma,
Uje wubaha so na nyoko kandi uje ukunda mugenzi waawe nk’uko wikunda."
Wa musore aramubwira ati, "Ibyo byose narabikurikije, noone ico nshigaje ni iki?"
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Niiba ushaaka kuba intungaane, genda uguriishe ibyo utunze byose, maze ibivuuyemo ubihe abakene, ni bwo uzaagira ubutunzi mu ijuru, uheereko uze unkurikire."
Uwo musore yumviise iryo jambo, agenda ababaye, kuko yari afite ubutunzi bwinshi caane.
Nuuko Yesu abwira abiigiishwa be ati, "Ndababwira ukuri, birakomeye kugira ngo umukire yinjire mu Bwami bwo mu ijuru.
Ndongera kubabwira yuuko byoroheye ingamiya kunyura mu gapfumure k’urusindaani, kuruta ko umukire yakwinjira mu Bwami bw’Imaana."
Abiigiishwa babyumviise, baratangaara maze baramubaza bati, "Noone se, ni nde ushobora kurokoka?"
Yesu arabiitegereza maze arababwira ati, "Ku bantu ntibishoboka, ariko ku Maana byose birashoboka."
Peetero aramubaza ati, "Dore twebwe twasize ibyacu byose turagukurikira, noone se tuzaabyungukiramo iki?"

Yesu arababwira ati, "Ndababwira ukuri yuuko igihe Umwana w’Umuntu azaazira, akiicara ku ntebe ye y’icuubahiro mu isi nsha, mwebwe mwankurikiye muziicara ku ntebe cumi n’ebyiri nuuko mutegeke imiryango cumi n’ebyiri y’Abiisirayeli.

Maze umuntu weese wasize amazu, cangwa beene se, cangwa bashiki be, cangwa se, cangwa nyina, cangwa abaana, cangwa imirima ku bw’izina ryanje, azaahaabwa nka byo inshuro ijana, kandi ahaabwe n’ubugingo buhoraho.
Ariko abenshi baari abambere bazaaba abaanyuma, kandi abaanyuma babe abambere."
Yesu akomeza kubabwira ati, "Ubwami bwo mu ijuru bwagereranywa na nyir’umurima wazindutse kare mu gitondo gushaaka abakozi bo gukorera imizaabibu ye.
Amaze kwemeranya na bo igihembo gikwiye umubyizi w’umunsi, aboohereza mu murima we w’imizaabibu.
Asohotse nko ku saaha itatu, abona abandi biihagarariye mu guriro ntaaco bakora,
maze na bo arababwira ati, ‘Namwe muje mu mizaabibu, ndibubiishure igihembo gikwiriye.’
Yongeye gusohoka nka saaha itandatu na saaha icenda, na bwo abigenza atyo.
Nka saaha icumi n’imwe nabwo arasohoka maze asanga abandi bahagaze, arababaza ati, ‘Kuki mwahagaze aho ntaaco mukora umunsi woose?’
Baramusubiza bati, ‘Ni uko ntaawe twaboonye wo kuduteereza.’ Arababwira ati, ‘Namwe nimuje gukora mu mizaabibu.’
Bugoroobye, nyir’umurima abwira umukoreesha ati, ‘Hamagara abakozi maze ubiishure, uheereye ku baaje nyuma kugeza ku baaje mbere.’
Abaateerejwe ku saaha cumi n’imwe baaje, buri umwe muri bo yiishuwe igihembo c’umubyizi w’umunsi cuzuye.
Aba mbere baaje, baateekerezaga ko bari buhembwe ibirenzeho, ariko na bo buri umwe yiishuwe ibingana n’umubyizi w’umunsi.
Bamaze kubibona, biitotombera nyir’imizaabibu,
bavuga bati, ‘Aba ba nyuma baakoze isaaha imwe yoonyine, noone ubanganyije naatwe twiriwe dukoboka umunsi woose duhangana n’izuuba!’
Ariko we asubiza umwe muri bo ati, ‘Nshuti yanje, sinkugiriye naabi, ntitwemeranyije igihembo c’umubyizi w’umunsi?
Fata ikiri icaawe maze ugende, mpisemo kwishura uwaaje nyuma igihembo kingana n’icaawe.
Mbese ntaabwo mfite uburenganzira bwo gukoreesha amashilingi yanje? Cangwa se, ugize ishari kuko ndi umunyabuntu?’
Noone reero abaanyuma bazaaba aba mbere, kandi n’abambere bazaaba abaanyuma."
Ubwo Yesu yazaamuukaga aja i Yerusaalemu, yihereerana abiigiishwa be cumi na babiri, kandi ababwirira mu nzira ati,
"Dore turazaamuuka tuja i Yerusaalemu, kandi Umwana w’Umuntu agiiye kugabizwa abatware b’abaheerezabitambo n’Abiigiishamategeko, maze bamuciire urubanza rwo gupfa.
Bazaamugabiza abanyamahanga kugira ngo bamushinyagurire, bamukubite maze bamubambe ku musaraba, ariko ku munsi wa gatatu azaazuurwe."
Nuuko nyina w’abahungu ba Zebedaayo asanga Yesu ari n’abahungu be, aramupfukamira, maze amusaba ubutoni.
Yesu aramubaza ati, "Urashaaka iki?" Na we aramusubiza ati, "Naagusabaga ngo abahungu banje babiri baziicare mu Bwami bwawe, umwe mu kuboko kwa buryo undi mu kuboko kwa bumoso."
Ariko Yesu we arabasubiza ati, "Ntaabwo muuzi ico musaba. Mbese mwashobora kunywera ku gikopu co ndi haafi kunyweraho?" Baramubwira bati, "Turabishobora."
Arababwira ati, "Ni koko muzanywera ku gikopu canje, ariko kwicara iburyo bwanje n’ibumoso bwanje, si nje ubitanga, ahuubwo bihaabwa abo Daata yabigeneye."
Nuuko abandi icumi babyumviise, baraakarira abo bavandimwe bombi.
Yesu arabahamagara boose maze arababwira ati, "Muuzi yuuko abategetsi b’abanyamahanga bategekeesha abo bayobora agahato, kandi ko abayobozi bo muri bo babakandamiza.
Ariko muri mwe si ko bimeze, ahuubwo ushaaka kuba mukuru muri mwe, agomba kuba umuheereza wa boose,
kandi ushaaka kuba uwa mbere muri mwe, agomba kuba umugaragu waanyu,
nk’uko Umwana w’Umuntu ataazanywe no kugira ngo bamukorere, ahuubwo yaaje gukorera abandi no gutanga ubugingo bwe ngo bube inshungu ya benshi."
Igihe Yesu n’abiigiishwa be baavaga i Yeriko, abantu benshi barabakurikira.
Abantu babiri bahumye baari biicaye iruhande rw’inzira. Bumviise yuuko Yesu ari kunyuraho, bateera heejuru bati, "Nyagasani, Mwana wa Dawudi, tugirire imbabazi!"
Abantu barabacaaha ngo baceceke, ariko barushaho guteera heejuru bati, "Tugirire imbabazi, Nyagasani, Mwana wa Dawudi!"
Yesu arahagarara maze arabahamagara, arababaza ati, "Murashaaka ko mbakorera iki?"
Baramusubiza bati, "Nyagasani, turashaaka ko amaaso yaacu ahumuuka."
Yesu abagirira impuhwe, abakora ku maaso, ako kaanya barareeba maze baramukurikira.
Yesu n’abiigiishwa be beegeereje i Yerusaalemu, bagera i Betifage ku musozi wa Elayoni. Nuuko Yesu yoohereza abiigiishwa babiri
arababwira ati, "Ni muje mu caaro kiri imbere yaanyu, mukihagera, murabona indogobe izirikanywe n’iyaayo, muziziture muzinzanire.
Nihagira ugira ico ababaza, mumubwire muti, ‘Daatabuja arazishaaka.’ Kandi arazibagarurira vuba."
Ibi byabayeho kuzuza ibyo umuhanuuzi yari yaravuze ati,
"Mubwire ab’i tawuni y’i Siyoni muti, Dore umwami waanyu arikuuza! Yiciishije bugufi, aheetswe n’indogobe, aheetswe n’icana c’indogobe."
Nuuko abiigiishwa baragenda, bakora nk’uko Yesu yabategetse.
Baazana ya ndogobe n’icaana caayo, babisasaho imyenda yaabo nuuko Yesu yiicaraho.
Rubanda nyamwinshi basasa imyenda yaabo mu nzira, abandi baca amashami y’ibiti bayasasa mu nzira.
Abantu benshi baagendaga imbere n’inyuma ya Yesu batangira guteera heejuru bati, "Hozaana, asingizwe Umwana wa Dawudi! Hasingizwe uje mu izina rya Nyagasani! Hozaana ahasumba hoose mu ijuru!"
Yesu yinjiye i Yerusaalemu, i tawuni nkuru yoose irakangarana. Abantu barabaza bati, "Uwo ni nde?"
Rubanda nyamwinshi baravuga bati, "Uyu n’umuhanuuzi Yesu, w’i Nazaareeti y’i Galileeya."
Yesu yinjira mu Nzu y’Imaana yiirukana abacuruuzi n’abaguzi boose baarimo. Yubika imeeza z’abaaguraanaga amashilingi n’abaaguriishaga inuma.
Arababwira ati, "Ibyanditswe biravuga biti, ‘Inzu yanje iziitwa Urusengero,’ ariko mwe mwayihinduye ubwihisho bw’abajuura."
Nuuko Impumyi n’abarema bamusanga mu Nzu y’Imaana maze arabakiza.
Abatware b’abaheerezabitambo hamwe n’Abiigiishamategeko baboonye ibitangaaza akoze, n’abaana bateera heejuru mu Nzu y’Imaana bati, "Hozaana, aragasingizwa Umwana wa Dawudi," bararaakara
nuuko babaza Yesu bati, "Uri kumva ibyo bari kuvuga?" Arabasubiza ati, "Yeego ndi kubyumva, mbese ntimuraasoma ibyanditswe ngo, ‘Wateguuye ko abaana bato n’abakiri ku ibeere bagusingiza’?"
Yesu abasiga aho, aja mu tawuni y’i Bbetaniya aho yaraaye.
Mu gitondo, ubwo Yesu yasubiye mu tawuni nkuru, yari ashonje.
Aboonye igiti ciitwa umutiini iruhande rw’inzira, aracegeera, ariko asanga ari amababi gusa. Maze arakibwira ati, "Ntuziigere weera imbuto ukundi!" Ako kaanya ico giti c’umutiini kiruuma.
Abiigiishwa be babiboonye, batangaara bavuga bati, "Kiriya giti c’umutiini cuumiyeho gite?"

Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Ndababwira ukuri, nimwizeera mudashidiikanya, muzaashobora gukora nk’ibyo nkoreye iki giti c’umutiini. Ndetse atari ibyo gusa, ahuubwo muzaashobora kubwira uyu musozi muti, ‘Shiguka ujugunywe mu nyanja,’ nuuko bibe.
Ibyo muzaasaba byose musenga mufite kwizeera, muzaabihaabwa."
Yesu amaze kwinjira mu Nzu y’Imaana, abatware b’aheerezabitambo n’abakuru b’imiryango baaza aho ari baramubaza bati, "Ni bubaasha ki bugukoreesha ibyo kandi ni nde waguhaaye ubwo bubaasha?"
