Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Nanje ndababaza ikibazo kimwe, nimunsubiza ni ho ndababwira aho nkuura ububaasha bwo gukora ibi bintu.
Mbese ububaasha bwa Yohaana bwo kubatiza bwavuuye mu ijuru cangwa se bwakomootse ku bantu?" Batangira kubazanya bati, "Nituvuga ngo, ‘Ni mu ijuru,’ aratubaza ati, ‘Kuki mutamwemeye?’
Kandi nituvuga ngo ‘Bwakomootse ku bantu,’ ntaabwo turibukire abantu kuko beemera badashidiikanya ko Yohaana ari umuhanuuzi."
Nuuko basubiza Yesu bati, "Ntitubiizi." Yesu arababwira ati, "Nanje reero sindababwira aho nkura ububaasha bwo gukora ibyo."
Yesu arababaza ati, "Mbese uyu mugani muwuteekerezaho iki? Haabaayeho umugabo wari ufite abahungu babiri. Abwira umuhungu mukuru ati, ‘Mwana wanje, genda ukorere imizaabibu mu murima.’
Uwo muhungu aramusubiza ati, ‘Sinshaaka, ageze nyuma yisubiraho, aja yo.’
Nuuko se aja kubwira umuhungu we wakabiri nk’ibyo yabwiye uwa mbere. Uwo we aramusubiza ati, ‘Yeego daata, ndibujeyo,’ ariko ntiyajayo.

Mbese muri abo bombi ni nde wakoze ibyo se ashaaka?" Baramusubiza bati, "Ni uwa mbere." Yesu arababwira ati, "Ndababwira ukuri yuuko abasoreesha na ba malaaya bagiiye kubabanziriza kwinjira mu Bwami bw’Imaana.
Kuko Yohaana yaje kubeereka inzira yo gukiraanuka ntimwamwemera, ariko abasoreesha na ba malaaya baramwemera, n’ubwo mubona ibikorwa byabo, ntimwisubiraho ngo mumwemere."

Yesu arababwira ati, "Nimwumve undi mugani, haabaayeho umuntu wari ufite umurima, ateeramo imizaabibu, arayizitirira, acukuramo urwina maze yubakamo umunaara w’abarinzi. Nuuko awaatira abahinzi, aja mu kindi gihugu.
Igihe co gusaaruura kigeze, yoohereza abagaragu be ku baatiisha kugira ngo babahe ubwatamurima bw’imizaabibu.
Ariko abaatiisha barabafata, umwe baramukubita, undi baramwica kandi undi bamuteera amabuye.
Arongera yoohereza abandi bagaragu benshi kuruta aba mbere, na bo babagenza batyo.
Haanyuma yoohereza umuhungu we, yibwira ati, ‘Umwana wanje baramwubaha.’
Ariko abaatiisha bamuboonye baravugana bati, ‘Uyu ni we uzaazunguura ibya se, nimuuze tumwice tujaane ibyo yari kuzaazunguura.’
Baheerako baramufata, bamujugunya hiirya y’umurima maze baramwica.
Noone se nyir’umurima naaza azaabagenza ate?"
Baramubwira bati, "Abo bagome azaabiica nuuko umurima awaatire abandi baazaamuha umusaaruuro igihe kigeze."
Yesu arababwira ati, "Ntimuraasoma ibyanditswe ngo, ‘Ibuye abuubatsi banze ni ryo ryabaaye urufatiro rw’inzu, ibi ni Imaana yabikoze, kandi ni ibitangaaza mu maaso yaacu’?
Noone ndababwira yuuko, Ubwami bw’Imaana buzaabakuurwaho bugahaabwa abo beera imbuto zibukwiriye.
Uzaagwa kuri iri buye azaavunagurika, kandi uwo rizaagwira azaajanjagurika."
Abatware b’abaheerezabitambo n’Abafarisaayo bumviise uyu mugani, bamenya ko ari bo avugaho.
Nuuko baashaka kumufata, ariko Batiinya rubanda nyamwinshi, kuko beemeraga ko ari umuhanuuzi.
Yesu yongera kubabwirira mu migani ati,
"Ubwami bw’ijuru bwagereranywa n’umwami wakoreye umuhungu we ubukwe.
Yoohereza abagaragu be guhamagara abaatumiwe mu bukwe, ariko ntibaaza.
Arongera atuma abandi bagaragu, arababwira ati, ‘Mubwire abaatumiwe muti, dore, nateguuye ifunguro rya nimugorooba, nabaaze ibimasa n’inyana z’imishishe, byose birateguuwe nimuuze mu bukwe.’
Ariko ntibaabyitaho baragenda, umwe aja mu murima we, undi mu bucuuruzi bwe,
naho abandi bafata abagaragu be babagirira naabi, barabiica.
Umwami araraakara. Yoohereza abasirikare be batsemba abo biicanyi, n’itawuni nkuru yaabo barayootsa.
Nuuko abwira abagaragu be ati, ‘Ubukwe bwateguuwe ariko abaatumiwe ntibaari babukwiriye.
Nuuko nimugende mu mihanda migari, muraarike buri weese gutaaha ubukwe.’
Abo bagaragu baja mu mihanda migari bakungaanya abo baboonye boose, hari abeeza cangwa ababi, maze igisenge c’ubukwe kiruuzura.
Ariko umwami aje kureeba abashitsi, abonamo umugabo wari utambaye umwenda w’ubukwe,
nuuko aramubwira ati, ‘Nshuti yanje, wageze hano ute utambaye umwenda w’ubukwe?’ Uwo mugabo abura ico avuga.
Nuuko umwami abwira abaheereza ati, ‘Nimumuhambiire amaboko n’amaguru, mumujugunye hanze mu mwijima, aho bazaaririra bakahahekenyera ameenyo.’
Kuko hahamagarwa benshi, hagatooranywa bake."
Nuuko Abafarisaayo baja inaama yo gutegera Yesu mu magambo avuga.

Boohereza abiigiishwa baabo hamwe n’abo mu kibiina c’Abaherodi ngo babaze Yesu bati, "Mwigiisha, tuuzi yuuko uri umunyakuri, kandi ko wiigiisha inzira y’Imaana ushingiye ku kuri, ntaawe utinya, kandi ntuurobaanura kubutoni.
Nuuko reero tubwire ico uteekereza. Mbese byemewe n’amategeko gutanga umusoro wa Kayisaari cangwa ntibyemewe?"
Ariko kuko Yesu yari azi imigambi yaabo mibi arababaza ati, "Kuki mungerageza mwa ndyarya mwe?
Nimunyereke igiceri mukoreesha mu gutanga umusoro." Maze bamuuzanira idinaari.
Nuuko arababaza ati, "Iri shusho n’iri zina ni ibya nde?"
Baramusubiza bati, "Ni ibya Kayisaari." Yesu arababwira ati, "Nuuko reero ibya Kayisaari mubihe Kayisaari, n’iby’Imaana mubihe Imaana."
Babyumviise baratangaara, baramusiga, baragenda.
Uwo munsi Abasadukaayo bamwe baaza aho Yesu ari bavuga ko ari ntaakuzuuka kw’abaapfuuye kubaho. Baramubaza bati,
"Mwigiisha, Moose yaravuze ati, ‘Umugabo n’azaapfa atabyaye, murumuna we azaacuure uwo mupfaakazi, kugira ngo aciikuure mwene nyina amubyarire abaana.’
Haabaayeho ibyene nyina birindwi, uwa mbere arasohoza ariko apfa ntamwana asize, maze mwene nyina asigarana uwo mupfaakazi.
N’uwa kabiri biba bityo, n’uwa gatatu, kugeza ku wa karindwi.
Haanyuma na wa mugore arapfa.
Noone mu gihe co kuzuuka, muri abo barindwi uwo mugore azaaba uwa nde, ko boose baamutunze?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Mwarayobye, kuko mutaazi ibyanditswe cangwa imbaraga z’Imaana.
Kuko mu izuuka ntihabamo gusohoza cangwa gushingirwa, ahuubwo baba nk’abaamalayika bo mu ijuru.
Naho ibyerekeye izuuka ry’abaapfuuye, mbese ntimwasomye ibyo Imaana yababwiye iti,
‘Ndi Imaana ya Aburahamu, Imaana ya Isaaka n’Imaana ya Yaakobo?’ Ntaabwo ari Imaana y’abaapfuuye, ahuubwo ni iy’abazima."
Nuuko rubanda nyamwinshi babyumviise, batangaazwa n’inyigiisho ye.
Abafarisaayo bamaze kumva ko Yesu yazibije Abasadukaayo akanwa bakabura ico basubiza, bakungaanira hamwe,
nuuko umwe muri bo wari umunyamategeko, abaza Yesu ikibazo co kumutega, ati,
"Mwigiisha, mu mategeko yoose iriruta ayandi ni iriihe?"
Aramubwira ati, " ‘Ukunde Uhoraho Imaana yaawe n’umutima waawe woose, n’ubugingo bwawe bwose, n’ubwenge bwawe bwose.’
Iryo ni ryo tegeko rya mbere riruta ayandi yoose.
Irya kabiri rimeze nka ryo, ‘Ukunde mugenzi waawe nk’uko wiikunda.’
Kuri ayo mategeko yombi ni yo shingiro y’amategeko yoose n’ibyanditswe n’abahanuuzi."
Ubwo Abafarisaayo baari bateeranye, Yesu ababaza iki kibazo ati,
"Kristo mu muteekerezaho iki? Mbese ni mwene nde?" Baramusubiza bati, "Ni mwene Dawudi."
Arababaza ati, "Noone se ni kuki Dawudi abihishuuriwe n’Umwuka amwita Umwami, avuga ati,
‘Uhoraho yabwiye Umwami wanje ati; Icara iruhande rw’ukuboko kwanje kw’iburyo, kugeza aho nzaashirira abanzi baawe haasi y’ibirenge byawe’?
Noone niiba Dawudi amwita Umwami we, yaaba umwana we ate?"
Ntaawashoboye kumusubiza, kandi ntaanuwigeze yongera kugira ico amubaza kuva uwo munsi.
Nuuko Yesu abwira abantu nyamwinshi n’abiigiishwa be ati,
"Abiigiishamategeko n’abafarisaayo ni bo baagiiye mu mwanya wa Moose mu gusobaanura amategeko,
nuuko reero mukore ibyo babiigiisha kandi mubikurikize, ariko mwegukurikiza ibyo bakora kuko ibyo bavuga atari byo bakora.
Bahambiira imitwaro iremeereye caane bakayishira ku ntugu z’abantu, ariko bo ntibeemere kuba bayikozaho n’urutoki rwabo ngo babafashe.

Ibyo bakora byose babikora ngo bareebwe n’abantu, ni co gituma bakunda kwambara udufuka batwaramo udupapuro tw’Ibyanditswe bakatugira tunini kuruta abandi, kandi bagahinuura imihino y’imyenda yaabo ngo ibe miremire kurushaho.
Bakunda imyamya y’icuubahiro mu mashitsi n’ibyicaro byiza mu masinagoogi,
bakunda ko baramutswa mu cuubahiro mu maguriro, no kumva abantu babiita ‘Mwigiisha.’
Mwe ntimukeemere ko babiita ‘Mwigiisha,’ kuko mufite Umwigiisha umwe gusa, mwebwe mukaba muri abiiga.
Ntimukagire uwo mwita so kuri iyi si kuko mufite So umwe uri mu ijuru.
Kandi ntimukeemere ko babiita abatooza, kuko mufite umutooza umwe, ari we Kristo.
Umukuru muri mwe agomba kuba umugaragu waanyu.
Abiishira heejuru boose bazaaciishwa bugufi, kandi abiiciisha bugufi boose bazaashirwa heejuru.
Muzaabona ishano mwa ndyarya mwe z’Abiigiishamategeko n’Abafarisaayo! Kuko mukingiranya abantu hanze y’Ubwami bw’ijuru, kandi namwe ubwanyu ntimwinjire, ahuubwo mukabuza n’abandi kwinjira.

Muzaabona ishano mwa ndyarya mwe z’Abiigiishamategeko n’Abafarisaayo, kuko murya ingo z’abapfaakazi, mukavuga amasengeesho mareemare mwiyerekana ngo babareebe. Muzaaciirwa urubanza rukomeye kurusha abandi.

Muzaabona ishano mwa ndyarya mwe z’Abiigiishamategeko n’Abafarisaayo! Kuko mwambuka inyanja n’ibihugu guhindura umuntu umwe, mwamubona mukamugira uwo kujugunywa mu muriro utazima birenze ibyanyu inshuro ebyiri.
Muzaabona ishano mwa barandasi bahumye mwe, muvuga muti, ‘Urahiye Inzu y’Imaana ntaaco biba bitwaye, ariko urahiye izaahabu yo mu Nzu y’Imaana azaafatwa n’iyo ndahiro.’
Mwa bapfaapfa mwe b’impumyi! Ikiruta ikindi ni ikiihe, izaahabu cangwa Inzu y’Imaana yeeza iyo zaahabu?
Kandi muravuga muti, ‘urahiye igicaaniro ntaaco biba bitwaye, ariko urahiye ituuro riri ku gicaaniro azaaba aboshwe n’iyo ndahiro.’
Mbeega ukuntu muri impumyi! Ikiruta ikindi ni ikiihe, ituuro cangwa igicaaniro ceeza iryo tuuro?
Nuuko reero, urahiye igicaaniro, aba akirahiye n’ibikiriho byose,
kandi urahiye Inzu y’Imaana aba ayirahiye hamwe n’Imaana iyituuyemo,
kandi urahiye ijuru, aba arahiye intebe y’Ubwami bw’Imaana n’uyiicaraho.

Muzaabona ishano mwa ndyarya mwe z’Abiigiishamategeko n’Abafarisaayo! Kuko mutanga kimwe ca cumi c’ibimera by’ifashiishwa nk’ibirungo nk’umujaaja, umudarasiini, n’umuteete, ariko mukirengagiza ingingo z’ingenzi z’amategeko, ari zo ubutabeera, imbabazi no kwizeera. Ibyo ni byo mwagombaga kwitooza mutaretse n’ibindi.
Mwa barandasi muhumye mwe! Mwubahiriza amategeko yoroshe ariko mukiyobagiza ingingo z’amategeko y’ingenzi mutabiizi.
Muzaabona ishano mwa ndyarya mwe z’Abiigiishamategeko n’Abafarisaayo! Mwoza igikopu n’isahaani inyuma, naho munda huzuyemo ibyo mwaboonye mu bwambuzi no kwikunda.
Wa Mufarisaayo uhumye we! Banza wooze munda y’igikopu nuuko n’inyuma habone kubonera.

Muzaabona ishano mwa ndyarya mwe z’Abiigiishamategeko n’Abafarisaayo! Mumeze nk’ibituro bisiize irangi ry’umweru, bireebeka neeza inyuma, ariko munda bikaba byuzuyemo amagufa y’abaapfuuye n’imyanda y’ingeri zoose.
Namwe inyuma mureebeka muri abakiraanutsi ariko munda mwuzuye uburyarya n’ubugome.
Muzaabona ishano mwa ndyarya mwe z’Abiigiishamategeko n’Abafarisaayo, kuko mwubaka imva z’abahanuuzi mugataaka imyanya y’urwibutso rw’abakiraanutsi,
maze mukavuga muti, ‘Yabaaye twarabaayeho mu gihe ca ba sogokuruza, ntaabwo twari gufatanya na bo kumena amaraso y’abahanuuzi.’
Noone murabihamya ubwanyu ko mukomooka ku biishe abo bahanuuzi.
Nuuko namwe nimurangize umurimo watangiwe na basookuruza baanyu.
Mwa nzoka mwe, mwa baana b’inshiira mwe! Muzaahunga mute igihano c’i gehenoomu?

Nuuko reero ngiiye kubooherereza abahanuuzi, n’abanyabwenge, n’Abiigiishamategeko, bamwe muri bo muzaabiica kandi mubabambe, abandi muzaabakubitira mu masinagoogi yaanyu, muzaabiirukana mu ma tawuni yoose bazaajamo.

Nuuko reero muzaabarweho amaraso y’abakiraanutsi yamenetse ku isi, uheereye ku maraso y’umukiraanutsi Abeli kugeza ku maraso ya Zakariya mwene Barakiya, uwo mwiciye hagati y’aheera h’Inzu y’Imaana n’igicaaniro.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko, ibi byose bizaasohora ku b’iki gihe.
Yemwe bantu b’i Yerusaalemu, biica abahanuuzi bagateera amabuye ababatumwemo! Ni kangaahe nashaatse kubarundarunda nk’uko inkoko ibundikiira ubushwi bwayo munda y’amababa yaayo, ariko ntimunkundire!
Dore iwaanyu hasigaye ari amatongo.
Ndababwira yuuko mutazongera kumbona kugeza ubwo muzaavuga muti, ‘Hahiirwa uje mu izina ry’Uhoraho.’ "
Ubwo Yesu yavaga mu Nzu y’Imaana, arikugenda, abiigiishwa be baramusanga maze bamwereka imyubakire y’Inzu y’Imaana.
Nuuko arababaza ati, "Ntimureeba ibi byose? Ndababwira ukuri yuuko aha hatazaasigara ibuye rigeretse ku rindi, byose bizaajugunywa haasi."
Yesu yiicaye ku musozi wa Elayoni, abiigiishwa baaza aho ari biihereereye, baravuga bati, "Tubwire, ibyo bizaaba ryari, ni kimenyeetso ki kizeerekana kuuza kwawe hamwe n’imperuuka y’isi?"
Arabasubiza ati, "Mwirinde hatagira umuntu ubayobya.
Kuko benshi bazaaza mu izina ryanje bavuga bati, ‘Ni nje Kristo!’ Kandi bazaayobya benshi.
Muzumva intambara n’impuuha z’intambara, ariko ntimuzaakuuke umutima, kuko ibi bitazaabura kubaho, ariko si byo herezo.
Igihugu kizaateera ikindi, kandi ubwami buteere ubundi, hazaabaho inzara n’imishitsi mumyanya myinshi,
ibyo byose bizaaba bimeze nk’imigendo ibanziriza ibise by’umubyeyi yenda kubyara.
Ico gihe muzaatangwa ngo mutootezwe, ndetse mwicwe, kandi ibihugu byose bizaabanga ku bw’izina ryanje.
Maze benshi bazaagwa, bagambaanirane kandi bangane.
Abahanuuzi b’ibinyoma bazaaduka kandi bayobye benshi.
Kandi ku bwo kwiyongera k’ubugome, urukundo rwa benshi ruzaakonja.
Ariko uziihangaana kugeza ku mperuuka azaakizwa.
Kandi ubu Butumwa Bwiza bw’Ubwami buzaamamazwa mu isi yoose, bubeere amahanga yoose ubuhamya, nuuko imperuuka iheereko ize.
Nimuzaabona ikizira kirimbura gihagaze aheera, nk’uko byahanuuwe n’umuhanuuzi Daniyeli (ubisoma abyitondere),
maze abazaaba bari i Yudeeya bahungire ku misozi,
uzaaba ari heejuru y’inzu yekuzaamanuka ngo ajaane ikiri mu nzu,
n’uzaaba ari mu murima yekuzaasubira inyuma gushikiira umwambaro.
Muri iyo minsi, abagore batwite n’abari konsa bazaabona ishano.
Musenge kugira ngo ico gihe co guhunga kitazaabaho mu minsi y’imbeho cangwa ku Isaabato.
Kuko muri iyo minsi hazaabaho kubabara caane, kutigeze kubaho kuva kukuremwa ku isi kugeza ubu kandi ntikuzongera kubaho ukundi.
Kandi Imaana iyo itagabanya iyo minsi nta wari kuzaarokoka, ariko ku bw’abo yiitooranyirije, iyo minsi izaagabanywa.
Nuuko nihagira ubabwira ati, ‘Dore, hano hari Kristo!’ Cangwa ati, ‘Dore, ari hariya!’ Ntimuzaabyemere.
Kuko hazaaduka abiiyita Kristo n’abahanuuzi b’ibinyoma kandi bakore ibimenyeetso n’ibitangaaza, kugira ngo babayobye, ndetse nibishoboka bayobye n’abo Imaana yiitooranyirije.
Murumve! Dore mbibamenyeesheje bitari byaba.
Nuuko nibababwira bati, ‘Dore, ari mu butaayu,’ ntimukajeyo. Ni bababwira bati, ‘Dore, ari mu nzu, ntimuzaabyemere.’
Nk’uko umurabyo urabiriza iburasirazuuba ukagera iburengerazuuba, ni ko no kuuza k’Umwana w’Umuntu kuzaaba.
Aho intumbi iri hoose, ni ho ibisiiga biteeranira.
Bidatinze, nyuma y’iyo minsi y’imibabaro, izuuba riziijima, n’ukwezi ntikuzaava, inyenyeeri zizaagwa ziva mu kireere, n’imbaraga zo mu kireere zizanyeganyezwa.
Nuuko ikimenyeetso c’Umwana w’Umuntu kizaaboneka mu ijuru, kandi amooko yoose yo ku isi azaacura umuboroogo, maze babone Umwana w’Umuntu aziye ku bicu byo mu ijuru afite imbaraga n’ikuzo ryinshi.
Azoohereza abaamalayika be mu nshonda enye z’isi, bavuze impanda iranguruye, bakungaanye abo yatooranyije, uheereye aho isi itangiriye ukageza aho irangiriye.
Reka igiti ciitwa umutiini kitwigiishe isomo. Iyo amashami yaaco ashishe akameraho amababi, mumenya yuuko igihe kiba kiri bugufi guhinduka.
Nuuko reero, nimubona ibi byose, mumenye yuuko Umwana w’Umuntu ari haafi, kandi ko ageze ku irembo.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko, ab’iki gihe batazaashiraho mbere yuuko ibi byose biba.
Ijuru n’isi bizaashira, ariko amagambo yanje ntaazaashira.
Ariko ibyerekeye uwo munsi n’isaaha ntaawe ubiizi, naaho baaba abaamalayika bo mu ijuru, cangwa Umwana, keretse Daata wenyine.
Uko mu minsi ya Nowa byari bimeze, ni ko no kuuza kw’Umwana w’Umuntu kuzaaba.
Nk’uko baari bameze muri iyo minsi yabanjirije umwuzure, abantu baararyaga, kandi bakanywa, abagabo baararongoraga, abagore bagashingirwa, kugeza umunsi Nowa yinjiriye mu nkuge,
ariko ntibaabimenya kugeza aho umwuzure waaziye ukabajaana boose, ni ko no kuuza k’Umwana w’Umuntu kuzaaba.
Uwo munsi abantu babiri bazaaba bari mu murima, umwe azaajanwa, undi asigare.
Abagore babiri bazaaba basya hamwe, umwe azaajanwa, undi asigare.
Nuuko reero mube maaso, kuko mutaazi umunsi wo Umwami waanyu azaazira.
Ariko ibi mubimenye, iyo nyir’urugo aza kumenya igihe c’ijoro umujuura azaaziramo, yaakabaaye maaso ntamwemerere kwinjira mu nzu ye.
Namwe mwiteguure, kuko Umwana w’Umuntu azaaza igihe mudateekereza.
Mbese ni nde mugaragu w’umwiringirwa kandi ufite ubwenge? Ni uwo sheebuja yasigiye kuja aheereza abandi bagaragu ibyokurya mu gihe gikwiriye.
Hahiirwa umugaragu wo sheebuja azaagaruka agasanga ari gukora ibyo yamushinze.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko, azamwegurira ibintu bye byose.
Ariko umugaragu mubi niyibwira mu mutima we ati, ‘Daatabuja aratinze,’
maze agatangira gukubita abagaragu bagenzi be, no gusangira n’abasinzi,
sheebuja azaagaruka igihe umugaragu we adateekereza kandi ataazi.
Azaamuhana yihanikiiriye , amushire aho indyarya ziri, aho bazaarira kandi bagahekenya ameenyo."
Yesu akomeza kubabwira ati, "Ico gihe Ubwami bw’Imaana buzaagereranywa n’uyu mugani. Abakoobwa cumi baajanye amataara yaabo, baja gusanganira umukwe.
Bataanu muri bo baari abapfaapfa, abandi bataanu baari abanyabwenge.
Abo bapfaapfa baajaanye amataara yaabo, ariko ntibaajaana amavuta yo kongeramo,
ariko abanyabwenge bo bajaana amataara n’amavuta yaayo mu macupa.
Umukwe atinze kuuza, abakoobwa boose batangira guhunikiira, barasinziira.
Ariko n’ijoro mu gicuku, haba urusaku bati, ‘Umukwe araaje! Nimusohoke muje kumusanganira!’
Nuuko abakoobwa boose barabaduka, batungaanya amataara yaabo.
Abapfaapfa babwira abanyabwenge bati, ‘Muduhe ku mavuta y’itaara yaanyu kuko amataara yaacu agiiye kuzima.’
Ariko abanyabwenge barabahakanira bati, ‘Ntibishoboka! Ntiyaadukwira twese, ahuubwo byaba byiza mugiiye mu bacuruuzi mukiigurira ayaanyu.’
Ariko bagiiye kuyagura, umukwe araaza, abari biiteguuye binjirana na we mu nzu y’ubukwe, nuuko urugi rurakingwa.
Haanyuma baabakoobwa b’abapfaapfa bagarutse, barahamagara bati, ‘Daatabuja, daatabuja, dukinguurire.’
Na we arabasubiza ati, ‘Ndababwira ukuri, simbaazi!’ "
Nuuko Yesu arababwira ati, "Mube maaso, kuko mutaazi umunsi cangwa igihe Umwana w’Umuntu azaazira.
Ubwami bw’Imaana bwagereranywa n’uyu mugani. Haabaayeho umugabo washaatse kuja ku rugendo, ataraagenda ahamagara abagaragu be, abaha kureeberera ibintu bye.
Umwe amuha italanta itaanu, undi ebyiri, undi imwe, buri umwe amuha akurikije uko ashoboye. Haanyuma aragenda.
Ako kaanya uwahaawe italanta itaanu aja kuzikoreesha, yunguka izindi itaanu.
Uwahaawe italanta ebyiri na we yungukamo izindi ebyiri.
Ariko uwahaawe italanta imwe aragenda acukura icoobo mu taka atabamo italanta ya sheebuja.
Nyuma y’igihe kireekire sheebuja w’abo bagaragu araaza, ahamagara abagaragu be kugira ngo bamurike ibyo yabasigiye.
Umugaragu wahaawe italanta itaanu araaza, aramubwira ati, ‘Daatabuja, wampaaye italanta itaanu, dore nungutsemo izindi talanta itaanu.’
Sheebuja aramusubiza ati, ‘Wakoze mugaragu mwiza kandi wiringirwa, wabaye umwiringirwa mu bintu bike, nzagushinga ibisumbaho, ngwino wiishiimane na shoobuja!’
Uwahaawe italanta ebyiri na we araaza abwira sheebuja ati, ‘Daatabuja wampaaye italanta ebyiri, dore nungutsemo izindi talanta ebyiri.’
Sheebuja aramusubiza ati, ‘Nuuko mugaragu mwiza kandi wiringirwa, wabaaye umwiringirwa mu bintu bike, nzagushinga ibisumbaho, ngwino wiishiimane na shoobuja!’
Naho uwahaawe italanta imwe araaza, aravuga ati, ‘Daatabuja, namenye ko uri umuntu utagira imbabazi, usaaruura aho utaabibye, ukaanura aho utaanitse.
Bityo reero naratiinye, ndagenda mpisha italanta yaawe mu taka. Dore fata ibyawe!’
Ariko sheebuja aramusubiza ati, ‘Wa mugaragu mubi we kandi w’umunebwe! Wari uzi ko nsaaruura aho ntaabibye kandi nkaanura aho ntaanitse?
Wari ukwiriye kuba warashize italanta yanje mu bbanka, maze naagaruka nkabona ibyanje n’amagoba yabyo.
Noone nimuyimwake, muyiheereze ufite italanta cumi.
Kuko umuntu weese ufite, azongereerwa byinshi, naho udafite na busa azaakuurwaho na gake yari afite.
Naho uyu mugaragu utagira ico amaze, nimumujugunye hanze mu mwijima, aho bazaaririra bakahahekenyera ameenyo.’
Igihe Umwana w’Umuntu azaagaruka mu cuubahiro ashagawe n’abaamalayika, aziicara ku ntebe ye y’Ubwami.
Amahanga yoose azaateeranyirizwa imbere ye, maze atandukanye abantu, nk’uko umushumba atandukanya intaama n’ihene.
Intungaane azaazishira iburyo bwe naho abanyabyaha bashirwe ibumoso.
Nuuko reero, Umwami azaabwira abari iburyo bwe ati, ‘Nimuuze abo Daata yahaaye umugisha muragwe ubwami bwabateguuriwe uheereye ku kuremwa kw’isi,
kuko nari nshonje muramfungurira, nari mfite imyota mumpa ico kunywa, nari mu rugendo murancumbikira,
nari nambaye ubusa muranyambika, nari ndwaye muransuura, nari mu gihome muuza kundeeba.’
Nuuko intungaane nazo zizaamubaza ziti, ‘Nyagasani, twakuboonye ryari ushonje tukagufungurira, cangwa ufite imyota tukaguha ico kunywa,
uri mu rugendo tukagucumbikira, cangwa wambaye ubusa tukakwambika?
Ni gihe ki twakuboonye urwaye cangwa uri mu gihome tukaaza kugusuura?’
Nuuko Umwami azaabasubiza ati, ‘Ndababwira ukuri yuuko ibyo mwakoreye umwe mu bavandimwe banje baciiye bugufi, burya ni nje mwabikoreraga.’
Nuuko azaabwira n’abari ibumoso ati, ‘Nimumve iruhande, mwabivume mwe, muje mu muriro w’iteeka wateguuriwe Sataani n’abaamalayika be,
kuko nari nshonje, ntimwamfungurira, kandi nari mfite imyota ntimwampa ico kunywa,
nari mu rugendo ntimwancumbikira, nari nambaye ubusa, ntimwampa ico kwambara, nari ndwaye kandi ndi mu gihome, ntimwansuura.’
Nuuko na bo bazaamusubiza bati, ‘Nyagasani, ni gihe ki twakuboonye ushonje cangwa ufite imyota, uri mu rugendo wifuza ubufasha, wambaye ubusa, cangwa urwaye cangwa uri mu gihome ntitugufashe?’
Nawe azaabasubiza ati, ‘Ndababwira ukuri yuuko, ibyo mutaakoreye umwe mu bantu banje baciiye bugufi, ni nje mutaabikoreye.’
Abo bazaaja aho bazaahanirwa iteeka ryose, naho intungaane zije mu bugingo buhoraho iteeka."
Yesu arangije kwigiisha ibyo, abwira abiigiishwa be ati,
"Muuzi ko nihashira iminsi ebyiri, tuziizihiza umunsi wo Kunyurwaho, haanyuma Umwana w’Umuntu agatangwa kugira ngo abambwe k’umusaraba."
Nuuko abatware b’abaheerezabitambo n’abakuru b’imiryango bateeranira mu gikaari c’Umuheerezabitambo mukuru wiitwa Kayafa,
kugira ngo baje inaama yo gufata Yesu rwihishwa no kumwica.
Ariko baravuga bati, "Twekubikora mu minsi mikuru yo Kunyurwaho, kuko tubikoze, abantu bateera agasasamaro."
Ubwo Yesu yari i Bbetaniya mu rugo rwa Simooni wo Yesu yari yarakijije ibibembe,
umugore aza aho Yesu ari afite icupa ry’uzuye amavuta ahuumura neeza kandi y’igiciiro kinini caane, ayasuka ku mutwe wa Yesu igihe yari ku meeza afungura.
Ariko abiigiishwa be babiboonye bararaakara baravuga bati, "Mbese aya mavuta apfuuye iki?
Aya mavuta yari akwiriye kuguriishwa akavamo amashilingi menshi, haanyuma agahaabwa abakene".
Yesu amenya byose baavugaga, arababwira ati, "Uyu mugore muramuryoza iki, ankoreye ikintu ciiza.
Abakene muzaahorana nabo, ariko nje ntimuzamporana iteeka.
Kunsukaho aya mavuta ni ukugira ngo atungaanye umubiri wanje mbere yo guhambwa.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko, iyi nkuru nziza izaamamazwa ku isi yoose, kandi ico akoze kizaavugwa ngo bamwibuke".
Ico gihe umwe mu biigiishwa cumi na babiri witwaga Yuda Isikariyooti, aja kureeba abatware b’abaheerezabitambo
arababaza ati, "Mbese murampa iki, nimbagabiza Yesu?" Nuuko bamuha ibiceri by’ifeeza mirongo itatu.
Kuva ubwo atangira gushaaka uburyo bwo kugambaanira Yesu.
Ku munsi wa mbere w’imihango yo kurya Imigaati Idasembuwe, abiigiishwa baaza aho Yesu ari baramubaza bati, "Mbese urashaaka ko duteguurira he aho urariira ifunguro ryo Kunyurwaho?"

Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Nimuje mu tawuni nkuru, kwa kaanaaka, mumubwire muti, ‘Umwigiisha aravuze ngo, igihe canje kireegeereje, noone ndashaaka gusangirira iwaawe n’abiigiishwa banje ifunguro ryo Kunyurwaho.’ "
Nuuko abiigiishwa baragenda bakora ico Yesu yari yaabategetse, batungaanyiriza mu nzu y’uwo mugabo iby’umuhango wo Kunyurwaho.
Bugoroobye, Yesu yiicarana n’abiigiishwa be cumi na babiri, barafungura.
Bagifungura Yesu arababwira ati, "Ndababwira ukuri yuuko, umwe muri mwe agiiye kungambaanira."
Birabababaza caane, batangira kumubaza umwe umwe bati, "Nyagasani, yaaba ari njeewe?"
Arabasubiza ati, "Uwo duhuuriza intoki ku sahaane, ni we ugiiye kungambaanira.
Ni koko Umwana w’umuntu agiiye gupfa nk’uko byamwanditsweho, ariko uwo muntu uzaamugambaanira azaabona ishano! Icaakabaaye ciiza ni uko uwo muntu aba ataaravuutse."
Yuda wari ugiiye kumugambaanira aramubaza ati, "Mwigiisha, ni nje?" Yesu aramusubiza ati "Urabyivugiye."
Bakirya, Yesu afata umugaati, amaze kuwushiimira Imaana, arawumaanyagura, awuha abiigiishwa be, ababwira ati, "Mwakiire murye, uyu ni umubiri wanje."
Haanyuma afata igikopu, arangije kugishiimira Imaana arabaheereza avuga ati, "Nimunyweho mwese,
aya ni amaraso yanje y’iseezerano risha agiiye kumenerwa benshi kugira ngo bababarirwe ibyaha.
Ndababwira ko ntazongera kunywa ku mbuto z’imizaabibu ukundi kugeza ku munsi nzanywera divaayi nsha mu Bwami bwa Daata."
Nuuko bamaze kuririmba indirimbo, baja ku musozi wa Elayoni.
Yesu arababwira ati, "Iri joro mwese mugiiye kumpunga kandi munsige, nk’uko byanditswe ngo, ‘Nziica umushumba, maze umukumbi w’intaama utaataane.’
Ariko niimara kuzuuka, nzaababanziriza i Galileeya."
Peetero aramusubiza ati, "Naaho abandi boose baaguhunga, njeewe sinzigera ngusiga."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ndakubwira ukuri yuuko, iri joro, isaaki itaraabika uribunyiihakane gatatu."
Peetero aramubwira ati, "Naaho kwaba gupfa, ndeemera mpfaane na we, ariko sindibukwihakane na hato." N’abandi biigiishwa boose bavuga batyo.
Nuuko Yesu ajaana n’abiigiishwa be ahantu hiitwa i Getsemaani, maze arababwira ati, "Nimube mwicaye aha nje hirya gusenga."
Ajaana na Peetero, na beene Zebedaayo bombi ari bo, Yaakobo na Yohaana, maze atangira kugira agahinda n’ishavu.
Yesu arababwira ati, "Mfite agahinda kenshi mu mutima, kenda kunyica. Nimugume aha, kandi mube maaso hamwe nanje."
Yigira imbere gato, yuubama haasi maze asenga avuga ati, "Daata, niiba bishoboka, nkiza ubu bubabare, ariko byekuba uko nshaaka ahuubwo bibe uko ushaaka."
Nuuko agaruka aho abiigiishwa be bari, asanga basinziiriye, maze abwira Peetero ati, "Ntimushobora kuba maaso nanje kumara isaaha imwe yoonyine?
Nimube maaso kandi musenge kugira ngo mutagwa mu bishuko. Umutima urakunze, ariko umubiri ufite intege nke."
Asubirayo ubwa kabiri maze arasenga ati, "Daata, niiba ari ngombwa ko nyura muri ubu bubabare, bibe nk’uko ubishaaka."
Agarutse asanga bongeye gusinziira, kuko amaaso yaabo yari afite ibitotsi byinshi.
Yesu yongera kubasiga, asubirayo asenga ubwa gatatu asubira muri ya magambo.
Arongera asanga abiigiishwa be, arababwira ati, "Muracasinziiriye, muracaruhuutse? Dore igihe kirageze Umwana w’Umuntu akagambaanirwa, agashirwa mu maboko y’abanyabyaha.
Nimuhaguruke tugende! Dore ungambaanira ari hano."
Yesu akivuga ayo magambo, Yuda umwe mu biigiishwa be, abageraho. Yari aherekejwe n’igiteero kinini gifite inkoota n’ubuhiri. Baari booherejwe n’abatware b’abaheerezabitambo na bakuru b’imiryango.
Umugambaanyi yari yabahaaye ikimenyeetso ati, "Uwo ndi buramutse musoma, ni we uwo, mumufate."
Yuda ageze aho Yesu ari aramubwira ati, "Muraho Mwigiisha! Aramusoma."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Nshuti yanje, kora ikikuuzanye." Maze abagabo baari na Yuda baraaza basingiira Yesu, baramufata.
Ako kaanya umwe mu baari kumwe na Yesu, akuura inkoota mu rwubati, ayikubita umugaragu w’Umuheerezabitambo mukuru, amuca ugutwi.
Nuuko Yesu aramubwira ati, "Subiza inkoota yaawe mu rwubati , kuko abarwaniisha inkoota na bo bazaarimburwa n’inkoota.
Mbese uteekereza ko ntabaasha kwambaza Daata, maze akanyoherereza imitwe y’abaamalayika irenga cumi n’ebyiri?
Ariko se bibaye bityo, ibyanditswe byasohozwa bite, kandi bivuga ko ari ko bikwiriye kuba?"

Ako kaanya Yesu abwira rubanda nyamwinshi ati, "Mbese mwagombaga kuuza kumfata mwitwaje inkoota n’ubuhiri, nk’aho muje gufata umwambuzi? Buri gihe niicaraga mu Nzu y’Imaana niigiisha, kandi ntimwamfata.
Ariko ibi byose bibaaye kugira ngo ibyanditswe n’abahanuuzi bisohore." Nuuko abiigiishwa baramuteererana, barahunga.
Abaari baafashe Yesu bamujaana kwa Kayafa Umuheerezabitambo mukuru. Mu rugo rwe ni ho Abiigiishamategeko n’abakuru b’imiryango baari bateeraniye.
Ariko Peetero amukurikirira kure, agera mu gikaari c’Umuheerezabitambo mukuru, yicarana n’abarinzi kugira ngo areebe amaherezo ya byose.
Nuuko abatware b’abaheerezabitambo n’abagize urukiiko rukuru boose batangira gushaakiisha ibirego by’ibinyoma ngo biiciishe Yesu,
ariko ntibaabibona, n’ubwo haaje abajurizi bo kumushinja ibinyoma benshi. Haanyuma abagabo babiri mubaaje kumushinja,
baravuga bati, "Uyu mugabo yaravuze ati, ‘Nshobora gusenya Inzu y’Imaana maze nkayubaka mu minsi itatu.’ "
Umuheerezabitambo mukuru arahaguruka, abwira Yesu ati, "Wakwireguura iki ku byo bakurega? Ntaaco ushobora kubivugaho?"
Ariko Yesu we ariicecekera. Umuheerezabitambo mukuru aramubwira ati, "Rahira mu izina ry’Imaana Ihoraho, utubwire niiba ari wowe Kristo, Umwana w’Imaana."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Urabyivugiye. Ariko ndababwira yuuko, uheereye ubu muzaabona Umwana w’Umuntu yiicaye iburyo bw’Imaana Nyir’ububaasha kandi aje ku bicu byo mu ijuru."
Nuuko Umuheerezabitambo mukuru ashishimura imyambaro ye aravuga ati, "Uyu mugabo arasebya Imaana! Abandi bajurizi turashaaka ab’iki? Mwiyumviye ukuntu akoze amaroreerwa yo gusebya Imaana.
Murabivugaho iki?" Baramusubiza bati, "Akwiriye gupfa."
Nuuko bamuciira mu maaso, bamukubita ibipfunsi, abandi bamukubita inshi
bavuga bati, "Duhanuurire Kristo we! Ugukubise ni nde?"
Ubwo Peetero yari yiicaye hanze mu gikaari, haaza umuja aramubwira ati, "Naawe wari kumwe na Yesu w’i Galileeya."
Ariko Peetero ahakanira imbere ya boose avuga ati, "Ibyo uvuga simbiizi."
Arasohoka, ageze ku irembo ry’igikaari, undi muja aramubona, nuuko abwira abaari bahagaze aho ati, "Uyu mugabo na we yari na Yesu w’i Nazaareeti."
Peetero yongera kubihakana arahira ati, "Uwo mugabo siimuuzi!"
Hashize umwanya muke, abaari bahagaze aho baraaza beegeera Peetero, baramubwira bati, "Ni ukuri naawe uri umwe muri bo, imvugo yaawe irakuranga."
Peetero atangira kuvugira heejuru no gucurikiranya indahiro ati, "Niiba ndi kubeesha, Imaana impane! Uwo mugabo siimuuzi!" Ako kaanya isaaki irabika.
Maze Peetero yiibuka amagambo Yesu yari yaamubwiye ati, "Isaaki itaraabika, uraba wanyihakanye gatatu." Nuuko Peetero asohoka arira caane.
Kare kare mu gitondo, abatware b’Abaheerezabitambo boose n’abakuru b’imiryango barateerana ngo baje inaama yo kwica Yesu.
Baramuboha, baramujaana bamushikiriza Pilaato Umutegetsi mukuru w’i Rooma.

Ubwo Yuda wamugambaaniye aboonye ko Yesu baamuciiriye urubanza rwo gupfa, yiisubiraho ariicuza agarura bya biceri by’ifeeza mirongo itatu abiheereza abatware b’Abaheerezabitambo n’Abakuru b’imiryango.
Aravuga ati, "Naacumuye kuko nagambaaniye umuntu w’umwere ngo yiicwe." Ariko bo baramusubiza bati, "Ibyo birakureeba! Ntibidufasheho!"
Nuuko Yuda ajugunya ibyo biceri mu Nzu y’Imaana, aragenda aja kwimanika.

Ariko abatware b’Abaheerezabitambo, batoragura bya biceri baravuga bati, "Amategeko ntiyeemera ko ibi biceri bivangwa n’ibindi byo mu bubiiko bw’Inzu y’Imaana, kuko byatanzwe nk’ikiguzi co kumena amaraso."
Bamaze kuja inaama, bahitamo ko ibyo biceri babiguramo Umurima w’Umubumbyi kugira ngo uzaabe irimbi ryo kuja bahambamo abanyamahanga.
Ni co gituma uwo murima wiitwa, Umurima w’Amaraso kugeza na n’ubu.
Nuuko huuzuzwa ibyari byarahanuuwe n’umuhanuuzi Yeremiya ati, "Bajanye ibiceri by’ifeeza mirongo itatu, ari co giciiro bamwe mu Biisirayeli baari biyemeje kumugura,
babiguramo umurima w’Umubumbyi, nk’uko Nyagasani yabitegetse."
Yesu ahagarara imbere y’umutegetsi w’i Rooma wiitwaga Pilaato. Uwo mutegetsi abaza Yesu ati, "Ni wowe mwami w’Abayuuda?" Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Urabyivugiye".
Ariko abatware b’Abaheerezabitambo n’abakuru b’imiryango baamureze, ntiyagira ico abasubiza.
Nuuko Pilaato aramubaza ati, "Mbese ntiwumva ibyo birego byose bakurega?"
Ariko Yesu ntiyagira ijambo na rimwe asubiza Pilaato ku byo bamurega maze Pilaato biramutangaaza caane.
Buri munsi mukuru wo Kunyurwaho, umutegetsi w’i Rooma yari yaramenyeereje abantu kubarekurira umwe mu basibe wo biishaakiraga.
Muri ico gihe haari umusibe w’ikirangirire wiitwaga Yesu Baraba.
Nuuko abantu bamaze guteerana, Pilaato arababaza ati, "Muri aba babiri uwo mushaaka ko mbarekurira ni nde, Yesu Baraba cangwa Yesu wiitwa Kristo?"
Kuko yari azi neeza ko abayobozi b’Abayuuda bamugabije Yesu biteewe n’ishari baamugiriye.
Ubwo yari aciicaye ku ntebe y’imanza, umugore we amwoherereza ubutumwa ati, "Ntuugire ico utwara uwo mugabo w’umuziranenge, naraaye ndoose byinshi bifashe kuri we, kandi byambujije amahoro."
Nuuko abatware b’Abaheerezabitambo n’abakuru b’imiryango boosha rubanda ko bakwiriye gusaba Baraba akarekurwa ariko Yesu we bakamwica.
Nuuko umutegetsi yongera kubabaza ati, "Mbese muri aba bombi, mushaaka ngo mbarekurire uwuuhe?" Baramusubiza bati, "Ni Baraba."
Pilaato arababaza ati, "Yesu wiitwa Kristo we mukorere iki?" Boose bavugira hamwe bati, "Naabambwe!"
Pilaato arongera arababaza ati, "Kuki, yakoze caaha ki?" Ariko bakomeza guteera heejuru bavuga bati, "Naabambwe!"
Pilaato aboonye ko ntaaco yaabikorera, ahuubwo ko byateera agasasamaro, afata amaazi akarabira intoki imbere ya rubanda, aravuga ati, "Ndi umwere w’amaraso y’uyu muntu, birabe ibyanyu."
Rubanda basubiriza hamwe bati, "Amaraso ye azaatubarweho n’abaana baacu!"
Nuuko abarekurira Baraba, ategeka ko bakubita Yesu , haanyuma aramubaha ngo bamubambe.
Nuuko abasirikare ba Pilaato bajaana Yesu mu gikaari c’umutegeka, umutwe w’abasirikare woose uramwitooroora.
Bamukuuramo imyambaro ye, bamwambika igishuura gitukura,
bamaze kuboha ikamba ry’amahwa, barimwambika ku mutwe. Bamufatiisha urubingo mu kuboko kwe kw’iburyo, maze baramupfukamira kandi bamushinyagurira bavuga bati, "Urakarama, Mwami w’Abayuuda!"
Nuuko bamuciiraho, bafata urubingo barumukubita mu mutwe.
Barangije kumushinyagurira, bamukuuramo ca gishuura, bamwambika imyambaro ye, bamujaana kumubamba.
Bagisohoka, bahuura na Simooni w’Umunyakureeni, bamuhata kwikorera umusaraba wa Yesu.
Bageze mu mwanya wiitwa Gorogota, kimenyeesha Ku k’igihanga,
bamusomya divaayi ivanze n’indurwe , asogongeye yanga kuyinywa.
Bamaze kumubamba, bagabana imyenda ye bakoreesheje ubufindo.
Abasirikare biicara aho, barinda Yesu.
Heejuru y’umutwe wa Yesu bashiraho icaapa canditsweho ngo, "Uyu ni Yesu Umwami w’Abayuuda"
Nuuko bamubamba n’abambuzi babiri, umwe iburyo bwe undi ibumoso bwe.
Abantu baanyuragaho baaramutukaga, bakazunguza umutwe
bati, "Woowe waaseenya Inzu y’Imaana ukayubaka mu minsi itatu, ikize! Niiba uri Umwana w’Imaana koko, manuka uve ku musaraba!"
Abatware b’Abaheerezabitambo hamwe, n’Abiigiishamategeko n’abakuru b’imiryango na bo bashinyagurira Yesu batyo
bavuga bati, "Yakijije abandi ariko we ntiyakwikiza. Ni umwami w’Abiisirayeli, naamanuke ku musaraba noone aha nuuko naatwe tumwemere.
Yiringira Imaana, reka reero Imaana imukize ubu, niiba ibishaaka, kuko yavuze ngo, ‘Ndi Umwana w’Imaana.’ "
Ba bambuzi baari babambwe hamwe na Yesu na bo bamutuka batyo.
Kuva saaha itandatu z’amanywa kugeza saaha cenda z’umugorooba isi yoose icura umwijima.
Maze nko ku saaha icenda z’umugorooba, Yesu ataka n’ijwi rirenga ati, "Eli Eli lama sabakitani?" Bisobaanura ngo, "Maana yanje, Maana yanje, ni iki gitumye unteererana?"
Bamwe mu baari bahagaze aho babyumviise baravuga bati, "Uyu mugabo aratabaaza Eliya!"
Ako kaanya umwe muri bo ariiruka afata icangwe, acuuzuza divaayi ishaariira, agishira ku rubingo, aramuheereza ngo anywe.
Ariko abandi baravuga bati, "Reka tureebe niiba Eliya araaza kumukiza."
Nuuko Yesu yongera gutaka n’ijwi rirenga maze arapfa.
Ako kaanya umwenda wari umanitswe mu Nzu y’Imaana ushishimukamo kabiri, kuva heejuru kugera haasi. Isi ihinda umushitsi maze ibitare birasaduka.
Ibituuro birakinguuka, n’imibiri y’abeera baapfuuye irazuurwa,
maze iva mu bituuro. Yesu amaze kuzuuka, baja mu tawuni yeera y’i Yerusaalemu, babonekera abantu benshi.
Umutware utegeka abasirikare ijana n’abaari kumwe na we barinda Yesu, baboonye umushitsi n’ibibaaye bagira ubwoba bwinshi caane, baratiinya, baravuga bati, "Uyu yari Umwana w’Imaana."
Haariho abagore benshi bahagaze bareebera kure. Baari baherekeje Yesu kuva i Galileeya bamuheereza ibyo yifuuza.
Muri bo haarimo, Mariya Magadaleena, Mariya nyina wa Yaakobo na Yozefu, na nyina wa beene Zebedaayo.
Bugoroobye, haaza umugabo w’umukire uturuka Arimatiya, witwaga Yozefu, kandi na we yari Umwigiishwa wa Yesu.
Aja kwa Pilaato amusaba umurambo wa Yesu. Pilaato ategeka ko bawumuha.
Yozefu ajaana umurambo wa Yesu awuzinga mu mwenda w’umweru usukuuye,
awuhamba mu mva ye nsha yari yaracukuye mu ibuye ry’urutare. Haanyuma abirindurira ikibuye kinini ku muryango w’igituuro maze ariigendera.
Mariya Magadaleena na Mariya wundi baari aho, biicaye ahateeganye n’ico gituuro.
Umunsi wakurikiyeho ari wo Saabato, abatware b’Abaheerezabitambo n’Abafarisaayo bateeranira kwa Pilaato
baramubwira bati, "Nyakuubahwa, ibuka neeza yuuko wa mubeeshi akiriho yavuze ati, ‘Haanyuma y’iminsi itatu nzaazuuka.’

Nuuko reero tegeka habeho kurinda igituuro kugeza ku munsi wa gatatu. Naho ubundi abiigiishwa be baaza bakamwiba, bakabwira abantu bati, ‘Yazuutse mu baapfuuye!’ Nuuko ikinyoma ca nyuma kikaruta ica mbere."
Pilaato arababwira ati, "Mufite abasirikare b’abarinzi, nimugende murinde ico gituuro nk’uko mushoboye."
Nuuko bagenda n’abarinzi maze bareeba ngo igituuro kirinzwe neeza, kandi kuri rya buye ripfundikiyeho bashiraho akamenyeetso.
Isaabato irangiye, ku munsi wa mbere w’icumweru, bugiiye guca, Mariya Magadaleena na Mariya wundi baja kureeba ca gituuro.
Ako kaanya habaho umushitsi, malayika wa Nyagasani, amanuka avuuye mu ijuru, abirindura ca kibuye kinini, aciicaraho.
Ishusho ye yasaga nk’umurabyo kandi imyambaro ye yari umweru nk’urubura.
Abarinzi bagira ubwoba bwinshi caane bahinda umushitsi, bamera nk’abapfuuye.
Nuuko malayika abwira ba bagore ati, "Mwitiinya. Nzi yuuko mushaaka Yesu wabambwe ku musaraba.
Ntaabwo ari hano. Imaana yamuzuuye, nk’uko yabivuze. Muuze mureebe aho umubiri we wari uri.
Ni mugende mwihuuta mubwire abiigiishwa be ko yazuutse, kandi ko agiiye kubatanga kugera i Galileeya, ni ho namwe muzaamubonera. Ubu ni bwo butumwa nari mbafitiye."
Nuuko bava ku gituuro bafite ubwoba n’umuneezeero mwinshi, bagenda biruka baja kubibwira abiigiishwa.
Bakigenda, bahuura na Yesu, arabaramutsa agira ati, "Amahoro abe muri mwe" Baramwegeera, bapfukama imbere ye, bafata ku birenge bye, baramuramya.
Yesu arababwira ati, "Mwitiinya, ni mugende mubwire beene Daata kuja i Galileeya ni ho bazambonera."
Ba bagore bakigenda, bamwe mu barinzi baja mu tawuni nkuru maze babwira abatware b’abaheerezabitambo ibyabaye byose.
Abatware b’abaheerezabitambo bahuura n’abakuru b’imiryango, nuuko baja inaama, yo guha abarinzi amashilingi menshi,
barababwira bati, "Muzaavuge muti, ‘Abiigiishwa be baaje n’ijoro biiba umurambo we dusinziiriye.’
Umutegetsi mukuru ni abyumva, turabimwemeza kandi namwe tubarinde ingoorane mwari kugira."
Nuuko abarinzi bajaana ya mashilingi, kandi babikora nk’uko baategetswe. Iyi nkuru iracaavugwa mu Bayuuda kugeza n’uyu munsi.
Nuuko ba biigiishwa cumi n’umwe baja i Galileeya, ku musozi Yesu yari yarabategetse.
Bamuboonye, baramuramya, ariko bamwe barashidiikanya.
Yesu aja aho bari arababwira ati, "Nahaawe ububaasha bwose mu ijuru no mu isi.
Nuuko reero, ni mugende mwigiishe abantu boose, mubabatiza mu izina rya Daata wa twese, n’iry’Umwana, n’iry’Umwuka wera,
mubiigiishe kumvira ibyo nabategetse byose. Kandi dore ndi kumwe namwe kugeza ku mperuuka y’isi."

name: Marcos
chapters: Ubu ni Ubutumwa bwiza bwa Yesu Kristo Umwana w’Imaana .
Bwatangiye nk’uko umuhanuuzi Yesaaya yanditse ati, " ‘Nzaatuma integuuza yanje mbere yaawe, Izaaguteguurira inzira yaawe.’
Ijwi ry’uvugira mu butaayu aranguruye ati, ‘Nimutungaanye inzira y’Uhoraho, mugorore inzira ze!’ "
Yohaana Umubatiza yaje mu butaayu abwiriza abantu iby’umubatizo wo kwihana kugira ngo bababarirwe ibyaha.
Abantu batuuye mu gice c’i Yudeeya n’ab’i Yerusaalemu boose baja aho ari, ababatiriza mu ruuzi rwa Yorodaani, baatura ibyaha byabo.
Yohaana yambaraga imyambaro ikozwe mu bwoya bw’ingamiya, agakenyeza umushumi w’uruhu. Ibyokurya bye byari inzige n’ubuuki bw’ubuhura.
Yabwirizaga avuga ati, "Undusha ububaasha azaaza haanyuma yanje, sinkwiriye no kuunama ngo mfunduure udushumi tw’ingato ze.
Njeewe ndababatiriisha amaazi, ariko we azaababatiriisha Umwuka Weera."
Muri iyo minsi, Yesu ava i Nazaareeti muri Galileeya aza ngo Yohaana amubatirize muri Yorodaani.
Akiva mu maazi abona ikireere gitandukanye, Umwuka Weera amumanukiraho asa n’inuma.
Nuuko ijwi rituruka mu ijuru riti, "Uri Umwana wanje nkunda nkakwishiimira."
Ako kaanya, Umwuka amujaana mu butaayu.
Yamaze mu butaayu iminsi mirongo ine, ageragezwa na Sataani. Yabaanaga n’inyamaaswa zo mu ishamba, abaamalayika bamuheereza.
Haanyuma yo gusibwa kwa Yohaana, Yesu aja i Galileeya yaamamaza Ubutumwa Bwiza bw’Imaana,
avuga ati, "Dore igihe kirasohoye, Ubwami bw’Imaana buri haafi. Mwihane, mwizeere Ubutumwa Bwiza."
Yesu anyura iruhande rw’ingezi y’i Galileeya, abona Simooni na mwene se Andereya barobeesha ubutimba mu ngezi, kuko baari abarobyi.
Yesu arababwira ati, "Nimunkurikire, nzaabagira abarobyi b’abantu."
Ako kaanya basiga ubutimba baarobeshaga baramukurikira.
Yigiye imbere gato abona Yaakobo mwene Zebedaayo na Yohaana mwene se, na bo bari aho batunganya ubutimba bwabo mu bwato.
Arabahamagara, maze ako kaanya basiga se Zebedaayo mu bwato n’abakozi be, baramukurikira.
Yesu n’abiigiishwa be baja i Kaperenawumu, ku Isaabato yakurikiyeho, yinjira mu isinagoogi, ariigiisha.
Abantu batangaarira inyigiisho ze kuko yiigiishaga nk’ufite ububaasha, atameze nk’Abiigiishamategeko.
Ako kaanya mu isinagoogi haarimo umuntu urimo umwuka mubi.
Arataka caane ati, "Uradushaakaho iki Yesu w’i Nazaareeti? Uje kuturimbura? Nzi uwo uri we, uri Uweera w’Imaana."
Yesu ategeka uwo mwuka mubi ati, "Ceceka, kandi muvemo."
Nuuko uwo mwuka mubi uramutigita, uteera heejuru n’ijwi rirenga maze umuvamo.
Boose baratangaara, maze bariibaza bati, "Ibi ni ibiki? Ko ari imyigiishirize idasanzwe! Ategeka n’imyuka mibi ikamwumvira."
Nuuko iyo nkuru yaamamara hoose muri Galileeya.
Bamaze gusohoka mu isinagoogi, binjira mu nzu ya Simooni na Andereya, bari kumwe na Yaakobo na Yohaana.
Nyirabukwe wa Simooni yari aryamye afite umuriro mwinshi, haanyuma bamubwira ibimufasheho.
Yesu aramwegeera, amufata ukuboko, aramuhagurutsa, umuriro umuvamo, atangira kubazimaanira.
Kuri uwo mugorooba, izuuba rirenze bamuuzanira abarwayi boose n’abateewe n’abadayimooni.
Abo muri iyo tawuni boose bateeranira imbere y’iyo nzu.
Maze akiza benshi baari barwaye indwara zitandukanye, yiirukana abadayimooni benshi, kandi ntiyabeemerera ko bavuga, kuko baari baazi uwo ari we.
Mu gitondo kare kare, hataraabona, Yesu arahaguruka, arasohoka, aja kwihereera mu mwanya utarimo abantu, nuuko arasenga.
Simooni n’abandi baari kumwe baja kumushaaka.
Bamuboonye, baramubwira bati, "Buri muntu ari kugushaaka."
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Nimureke tuje mu ma tawuni mato atwegeereye, kugira ngo na bo mbabwirize, kuko ari co canzanye."
Yitooroora igice c’i Galileeya coose, abwiriza mu masinagoogi kandi yiirukana abadayimooni.
Umuntu wari urwaye ibibembe aza aho ari, apfukama imbere ye, aramwinginga amubwira ati, "Ubishaatse wankiza."
Yesu amugirira imbabazi, arambuura ukuboko, amukoraho aravuga ati, "Ni co nshaaka, kira!"
Ako kaanya ibibembe birakira, arahumaanuka.
Mukumuseezerera Yesu aramwihanangiriza caane,
aramubwira ati, "Uramenye, utagira uwo ubibwira, ariko ugende, wiiyereke Umuheerezabitambo, kandi utuure n’ituuro ryo kwihumaanura nk’uko Moose yategetse, kugira ngo bibabeere ubuhamya ko wakize."
Ariko uwo muntu akigenda, atangira kwamamaza iyo nkuru, ayikwiza hoose mu tawuni. Ibyo byatumye Yesu aguma mu myanya idatuuwe n’abantu, abaamushaakaga kuva mu mpande zoose akaba ari yo bamusanga.
Hashize iminsi mike, Yesu asubira i Kaperenawumu, abantu boose bamenya ko ari mu rugo.
Benshi bateeranira hamwe, ntihaagira akaanya na gato gasigara ko kwinjiriramo. Nuuko Yesu ababwiriza ubutumwa.
Bidatinze, haaza abantu bane baheetse umuntu umugaye.
Kubw’ubwinshi bw’abantu bari buuzuye aho, baabuze aho kumunyuza, maze bapfumura heejuru y’inzu aharinganiye n’aho Yesu yari ari, buururutsa ingobyi baari baheetsemo uwo wari umugaye.
Yesu aboonye uko kwizeera kwabo, abwira uwo wari umugaye ati, "Mwana wanje, ibyaha byawe urabibabariwe."
Bamwe mu biigiishamategeko baari biicaye aho batangira kwibaza mu mitima yaabo bati,
"Ni iki giteeye uyu kuvuga atyo? Asebya Imaana! Ni nde waabaasha kubabarira ibyaha atari Imaana yoonyine?"
Muri ako kaanya Yesu amenya ibyo baateekerezaga nuuko arababwira ati, "Ni iki kibateera guteekereza mutyo?
Mbese ikibooroheye ni iki? Ni uko nabwira uyu muntu umugaye nti, ‘ubabariwe ibyaha,’ cangwa kumubwira ngo, ‘Haguruka, wikorere ingobyi yaawe, ugende’?
Ndabahamiriza yuuko, Umwana w’Umuntu afite ububaasha hano ku isi bwo kubabarira ibyaha." Abwira wa mugabo umugaye ati,
"Ndagutegetse, haguruka, wiikorere ingobyi yaawe, ugende!"
Ako kaanya, uwo mugabo arahaguruka, yiikorera ingobyi yari aheetswemo agenda vuba vuba boose babireeba. Abantu baratangaara caane, basingiza Imaana bati, "Nta na rimwe twigeze tubona ibintu nk’ibi!"
Yesu yongera kuja iruhande rw’inyanja, abantu benshi baramwitooroora, maze arabiigiisha.
Nuuko akigenda, abona Leevi mwene Alufaayo yiicaye aho yasoreesherezaga, aramubwira ati, "Nkurikira." Leevi aheerako, arahaguruka aramukurikira.
Ubwo Yesu yari kwa Leevi barya ifunguro rya nimugoroba, abasoreesha benshi n’abanyabyaha na bo baari biicaranye na Yesu n’abiigiishwa be kuko haari benshi baamukurikiye.
Bamwe mu biigiishamategeko b’Abafarisaayo baboonye Yesu ari gusangira n’abanyabyaha hamwe n’abasoreesha, babaza abiigiishwa be bati, "Ni iki gituma asangira n’abantu bameze batyo?"
Yesu abyumviise arabasubiza ati, "Abazima si bo bakeneye umuvuuzi, ahuubwo abarwayi ni bo bamukenera. Sinazanywe no guhamagara intungaane ahuubwo naaziye abanyabyaha."

Igihe kimwe abiigiishwa ba Yohaana hamwe n’Abafarisaayo baari biyirije ubusa. Abantu baaza kubaza Yesu bati, "Ni mpamvu ki abiigiishwa ba Yohaana n’Ababafarisayo baja biiyiriza ubusa, ariko wowe abawe ntibabikore?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Mbese muteekereza ko abashitsi baaraaritswe mu bukwe baabwirirwa bakiri n’umukwe? Ntibishoboka! Bakiri n’umukwe ntibaakwiyiriza ubusa.
Ariko igihe kizaagera ubwo umukwe azaabavanwamo nuuko baheereko biiyirize ubusa.
Dore ntaawe uteera ikiremu gisha ku mwambaro ushaaje, uwabikora atyo, ikiremu gisha caawukurura ukarushaho gushishimuka.

Kandi ntawaasuka divaayi nsha mu mifuka y’impu ishaaje kuko uwaabikora atyo, iyo divaayi yaaturitsa imifuka y’impu kandi na yo ikameneka byombi akabipfiirwa. Ahuubwo, divaayi nsha bayisuka mu mifuka y’impu misha."
Igihe kimwe Yesu yari ari kunyura mu mirima y’ingano hari ku Isaabato. Bakigenda, abiigiishwa be batangira guca amahundo.
Abafarisaayo babwira Yesu bati, "Ni kuki abiigiishwa baawe bakora ibiteemerewe ku munsi w’i Isaabato?"
Yesu nawe arabasubiza ati, "Mbese ntimuraasoma uko Dawudi yabigenje ubwo yashaakaga icokurya kandi n’abo yari kumwe n’abo bashonje?

Yinjiye mu nzu y’Imaana ubwo Abiyatari yari Umuheerezabitambo mukuru, arya imigaati yari igenewe ituuro ry’Imaana, kandi ntaawemererwaga kuyirya keretse abaheerezabitambo. Ariko Dawudi we yarayiriiye, ahaho abaari kumwe na we."
Yesu arababwira ati, "Isaabato yakorewe umuntu, ntaabwo ari umuntu wakorewe Isaabato.
Nuuko reero Umwana w’Umuntu n’umugenga w’Isaabato."
Nuuko Yesu yinjira mu sinagoogi, ahaari umugabo ufite ukuboko kunyuunyuukaye.
Baaramureebuuje kugira ngo bareebe niiba aramukiza ku Isaabato, maze babone uko bamurega.
Yesu abwira wa mugabo ufite ukuboko kunyuunyuukaye ati, "Ngwino hano."
Nuuko abaza abantu ati, "Amategeko atwemerera gukora iki ku Isaabato? Gukora neeza cangwa kwangiriza, gukiza cangwa kwica?" Ariko ntibaagira ico bavuga.
Yesu abareebana uburaakari, ababazwa nuuko imitima yaabo yiinangiye ni ko kubwira wa muntu ati, "Rambuura ukuboko kwawe." Arakurambuura kurakira.
Abafarisaayo barasohoka batangira kuja imigambi hamwe n’aba Herodi ngo babone uburyo bwo kwica Yesu.
Yesu n’abiigiishwa be baja ku nyanja y’i Galileeya abantu benshi baramukurikira. Baari baturutse i Galileeya n’i Yudeeya,
bumviise ibyo ari gukora, bamuuzaho mu bwinshi bavuuye i Yudeeya, i Yerusaalemu, Idumeya, no hiirya ya Yorodaani no mu gace k’i Tiiro n’i Sidoni.
Abantu baari benshi caane ku buryo Yesu yabwiye abiigiishwa be kumuteguurira ubwato, agira ngo abantu batamubyiga.
Yari akijije n’abantu benshi, naho abo baari bakirwaye baguma babyigana kugira ngo bamukoreho.
Buri uko imyuka mibi yamubonaga, yatumaga abo baari bateewe na yo, bikubita imbere ye, bagateera heejuru bavuga bati, "Uri Umwana w’Imaana!"
Yesu yategekaga imyuka mibi kutagira uwo ibwira uwo ari we.
Haanyuma Yesu azaamuuka umusozi ahamagara abo ashaaka, baramusanga.
Atooranyamo cumi na babiri, abo yiise intumwa kugira ngo babaane na we nuuko abatume kuvuga ubutumwa,
kandi abaha ububaasha bwo kwirukana abadayimooni.
Aba ni bo ntumwa cumi n’ebyiri; Simooni uwo yiise Peetero,
Yaakobo mwene Zebedaayo na Yohaana mwene se wa Yaakobo uwahaawe izina Bowanerige, risobanurwa ngo Abaana b’inkuba,
Andereya, Filipo, Baritimaayo, Matayo, Tomasi, Yaakobo mwene Alufaayo, Tadewo, Simooni umurwanashaka,
na Yuda Isikariyoti, uwagambaaniye Yesu.
Nuuko Yesu aja mu rugo rwo yataahagamo. Abantu benshi bongera guteerana, Yesu n’Intumwa ze babura umwanya wo kugira ico bafungura.
Beene waabo babyumviise, biihuutira kuhamuvaana, kuko abantu baavugaga bati, "Yaasaze!"
Bamwe mu biigiishamategeko bavuuye i Yerusaalemu baravuga bati, "Yahanzweho na Bbelizebuulu! Ni umutware w’abadayimooni umuha ububaasha bwo kwirukana abadayimooni."
Nuuko Yesu arabakoranya avugana na bo mu migani ati, "Sataani yaashobora ate kwirukana Sataani?
Iyo igihugu ciigabyemo ibice gihora gishaamiranye, ico gihugu kirasenyuka.
N’umuryango wigabanyijemo ibice, nawo uba waaseenyutse.
Niiba reero ubwami bwa Sataani bwigabamo ibice, ntibwaramba, buraseenyuka bugashiraho.
Nta muntu ushobora kwinjira mu nzu y’umunyambaraga ngo asahure ibye keretse abanje kumuboha, haanyuma akabona uko asahura ibyo mu nzu ye.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko abantu baababarirwa ibyaha byabo byose, ndetse n’ibitutsi baaba baaratutse Imaana.
Ariko umuntu weese utuka Umwuka Weera, ntaabwo azaababarirwa bibaho, kuko aba akoze icaaha c’iteeka ryose."
Yesu yavuze ibi abiteewe nuuko abantu bamwe baavugaga bati, "Yahanzweho n’umwuka mubi."
Nyina wa Yesu n’abavandimwe be baraaza, bageze hanze, bamutumaho ngo aze babonane.
Abantu benshi baari bamukiikije nuuko baramubwira bati, "Nyoko na beene nyoko na bashiki baawe barihanze baragushaaka."
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Maama ni nde na beene maama ni bande?"
Areeba abaari biicaye bamwitoorooye, aravuga ati, "Dore Maama na beene maama!
Umuntu weese ukora ibyo Imaana ishaaka, ni we mwene maama, ni we mushiki wanje, kandi ni we maama."
Arongera atangira kwigiishiriza iruhande rw’inyanja. Abantu benshi caane barateerana, yinjira mu bwato bwari mu nyanja, abwicaramo, abandi bantu boose baguma imusozi, iruhande rw’inyanja.
Yesu abiigiisha byinshi mu migani ababwira ati,
"Nimutege amatwi! Umubibyi yasohoye imbuto aja kubiba.
Ubwo yabibaga, imbuto zimwe zigwa mu nzira, inyoni ziraaza zirazirya.
Izindi mbuto zigwa ku rutare rudafite itaka ryinshi, zimera vuba, kuko ubutaka bwari buke.
Izuuba rivuuye ziraraba, kuko zitaari zifite imizi ziruuma.
Izindi mbuto zigwa mu mahwa, zikurana nayo, amahwa arazipfukiranya, ntizeera imbuto.
Naho izindi zigwa mu butaka bwiza, zeera imbuto, zimwe mirongo itatu, izindi mirongo itandatu, izindi ijana."
Yesu amaze kubaciira uwo mugani, arababwira ati, "Ufite amatwi yumva, niyumve!"
Ubwo yari asigaye wenyine, abaari bamwegeereye na ba cumi na babiri bamusaba kubasobaanurira iby’iyo migani.
Nuuko arababwira ati, "Mwe mwahaawe kumenya amabanga y’Ubwami bw’Imaana, ariko abandi bo hanze, babyumva mu migani,
ku buryo, ‘Bareeba, ariko ntibiitegereze, bashobora kumva, ariko ntibasobaanukirwe, kugira ngo badahinduka maze bakababarirwa.’ "
Yesu arababaza ati, "Mbese uwo mugani ntimuwusobaanukirwa? Noone se indi migani yoose muzaayisobaanukirwa mute?
Umubibyi ni ubiba ijambo ry’Imaana.
Imbuto zaaguuye mu nzira zigereeranywa n’abantu bumva iryo jambo, bamara kuryumva uwo mwanya Sataani akaaza akarikuura muri bo.
Kandi izaabibwe ku rutare, ni abaakiira ijambo ry’Imaana n’umuneezeero.
Ariko ntibashoore imizi muri ryo, biihangaana akaanya gato. Iyo bageze mu bikomeye cangwa kugeragezwa bahoorwa iryo jambo, uwo mwanya bava mu kwizeera.
Abandi bagereranywa n’izibibwa mu mahwa, ni abo bumva ubutumwa,
ariko bakaguushwa n’iby’isi, nk’ubutunzi, irari ryo kwifuuza ibindi, reero iyo bibaaye byinshi mu mitima, bipfukiranya iryo jambo ntiryere imbuto.
Kandi izaabibwe ku butaka bwiza, ni abumva ijambo ry’Imaana, bakaryakiira, bakeera imbuto, umwe mirongo itatu, undi mirongo itandatu, undi ijana."
Yesu arababwira ati, "Mbese hari uwaakongeeza itaara maze akaryubikaho intonga cangwa akarishira munsi y’uburiri? Ahuubwo rishirwa ahagaragara kugira ngo rimurikire abari mu nzu.
Nuuko reero, nta caahishwe kitazaahishuurwa, cangwa icaakorewe mu ibanga kitazaamenyekana.
Ufite amatwi yumva, niyumve!"
Arongera arababwira ati, "Mushire umutima ku byo mwumva. Indengo mugeramo ni yo namwe muzaagererwamo, ndetse muzaarushirizwaho.
Abafite bazongeererwaho, ariko abadafite, bazaakwa n’ico baari bafite."
Yesu arongera arababwira ati, "Ubwami bw’Imaana bwagereranywa n’umuntu wabibye imbuto mu butaka,
iyo asinziriye akongera akabyuka n’ijoro no ku manywa, izo mbuto zikomeza gukura ku bwazo we ataazi uko zikura.
Ubutaka ubwabwo ni bwo bwera imyaka, habanza ingemwe zigakura, haanyuma hakaaza urusagi, hagaheruuka amahundo arimo impeke.
Imyaka iyo yeeze, nyirayo ayisaaruuriisha indiga kuko igihe c’isaaruura kiba kigeze."
Arongera arababwira ati, "Mbese ubwami bw’Imaana bwagereranywa n’iki? Cangwa se twabusobaanuza mugani ki?
Bwagereranywa n’akabuto ka Sinaapi, ni akabuto karusha izindi mbuto kuba gato ku isi.
Iyo kabibwe mu murima, karakura kakaba igiti kinini, kakagira amashami manini, inyoni zo mu kireere zikaarika ibyari byazo muri ayo mashami."
Uko ni ko Yesu yabwirizaga ubutumwa akoreesha imigani nk’iyo, na bo bagashobora kubisobaanukirwa,
ntiyigiishaga atabaciiriye imigani, ariko haanyuma agasobaanurira abiigiishwa be byose biihereereye.
Uwo munsi bugoroobye, Yesu arababwira ati, "Reka twambuke tuje haakurya y’inyanja."
Abandi bantu benshi basigara aho, we n’abiigiishwa be baja mu bwato bwo yahozemo, andi maato aramukurikira.
Bacambuka haaza umuyaga mwinshi, imivumba itangira kwisuka mu bwato, maze bwenda kurengerwa.
Yesu we, yari inyuma mu bwato, aryamye asinziiriye yiiseguye umusego, baramukangura baramubwira bati, "Mwigiisha, ntuubyitaayeho ko tugiiye gupfa?"
Arakanguka maze ategeka umuyaga, abwira inyanja ati, "Ceceka! Tuuza!" Nuuko umuyaga urahoosha, habaho ituuze.
Yesu arababaza ati, "Ni iki kibateeye ubwoba? Nta kwizeera mufite?"
Abiigiishwa baratiinya caane, barabazanya bati, "Mbese uyu ni muntu ki, wumvirwa n’umuyaga n’inyanja?"
Yesu n’abiigiishwa be bagera haakurya y’inyanja y’i Galileeya, mu gihugu ca Geraseni .
Akiva mu bwato, asanganirwa n’umuntu uvuye mu irimbi. Uwo muntu yari ateewe n’abadayimooni.
Yari atuuye mu bituuro. Nta muntu washoboraga kumuboha, nuubwo haaba gukoreesha injegeri.

Akenshi, baamuboheeshaga injegeri mu maboko, bakamwambika imihama mu maguru, ariko buri uko baamubohaga, injegeri zo mu maboko n’imihama yarabicaagaguraga. Nta muntu wari ufite imbaraga zo kumushobora.
Igihe coose, ku manywa na n’ijoro yazereeraga mu irimbi no ku busozi, ari kuvuza induuru kandi yiikebaguriisha amabuye.
Abona Yesu ahinguka haakurya, yiruka amusanga, amugezeho, aramupfukamira.
Amutakambira mu ijwi rirenga ati, "Yesu, Mwana w’Imaana isumba byose, uranshaakaho iki? Ndakwinginze, ntuunyice urupfu rw’agashinyaguro!"
Kuko yari yamubwiye ati, "Dayimooni, va muri uwo muntu!"
Yesu aramubaza ati, "Witwa nde?" Aramusubiza ati, "Nitwa Giteeronyamwinshi, kuko turi benshi!"
Nuuko yinginga Yesu caane kutabiirukana muri ico gihugu.
Haafi aho kuri uwo musozi, haari umugana w’ingurube ziri kuriisha.
Abo badayimooni binginga Yesu bati, "Niibura, twohereze twinjire muri ziriiya ngurube."

Arabeemerera, nuuko abo badayimooni bava muri wa muntu binjira muri izo ngurube, maze uwo mugana woose urindimukira kuri ako gacuri wisuuka mu nyanja urarohama. Izo ngurube zoose hamwe zaari nk’ibihumbi bibiri.
Abashumba baari baziragiye babiboonye, bariiruka, iyo nkuru bayikwiza hoose mu ma tawuni no mu byaro. Abantu baaza kureeba ibyabaaye iby’ari byo.
Bageze aho Yesu ari, basanga uwari uteewe n’abadayimooni benshi yiicaye kandi atuuje. Yari yambaye kandi afite ubwenge, bibateera ubwoba.
Abari baabyiboneye n’amaaso babiteekerereza abandi uko byagendeye uwo muntu wari uteewe n’abadayimooni n’ibyabaye kuri za ngurube.
Baheerako binginga Yesu kugira ngo abaviire mu caaro.
Yinjira mu bwato, wa muntu wo yari amaze gukiza abadayimooni aramwinginga ati, "Reka tugendane!"
Yesu ntiyabimwemerera, ahuubwo aramubwira ati, "Subira mu rugo muri beene waanyu ubabwire ibyiza Nyagasani agukoreye n’uko akugiriye impuhwe."
Uwo muntu aheerako aragenda anyura mu ma tawuni cumi yaamamaza ibyo Yesu yamukoreye. Abaabyumviise boose baratangaara.
Ubwo Yesu yari amaze kwambukira mu bwato aja haakurya y’inyanja, abantu benshi barahateeranira, kandi yari iruhande rw’inyanja.
Umwe mu batware b’i Sinagoogi witwaga Yayiro araaza, amuboonye yikubita imbere y’ibirenge bye
aramwinginga caane ati, "Agakoobwa kanje kararembye, kagiiye gupfa. Nyaabuna ngwino ukarambikeho ibiganza, gakire, kabeho."
Yesu agendana na we. Abantu benshi bakurikira Yesu bamubyiga.
Muri bo, haari umugore wari urwaye indwara yo kuva, ayimaranye imyaka cumi n’ebyiri,
yari amaze igihe yiihangaanira ububabare bwinshi, kandi yari yaramariye ibye mu bavuuzi ariko ntihagire ico bamumarira ahuubwo akarushaho kuremba.
Yari yarumviise ibifashe kuri Yesu, nuuko aca mu imbaga y’abantu amuturuka inyuma akora ku mwenda we,
kuko yibwiraga mu mutima ati, "Naaho naafata ku mwambaro we byonyine, ndakira."
Ako kaanya aratsina, abyiyumvamo ko akize iyo ndwara.
Yesu ahita amenye ko imbaraga zimuvuuyemo, ahindukira abantu arababaza ati, "Ni nde ufashe ku mwambaro wanje?"
Abiigiishwa be baramusubiza bati, "Urabona ukuntu abantu bari kukubyiganiraho, naawe ukabaza ngo ‘Ni nde ufashe ku mwambaro wanje?’ "
Ariko Yesu akomeza kureeba impande zoose kugira ngo abone uwamufasheho.
Uwo mugore agira ubwoba bwinshi ahinda umushitsi, maze amwikubita imbere amubwiza ukuri kuko yari azi ibimaze kumubaho.
Yesu aramubwira ati, "Mwana wanje, kwizeera kwawe kuragukijije, genda amahoro maze ukire indwara yaawe."
Yesu akivuga ibyo, hagira intumwa zivuuye kwa Yayiro zimubwira ziti, "Umukoobwa waawe amaze gupfa. Uracaaruhiriza iki Umwigiisha?"
Yesu ntiyiita ku byo baavugaga, maze abwira wa mutware w’i Sinagoogi ati, "wiitiinya, ahuubwo izeere."
Ntihaagira uwo yeemerera kumukurikira keretse Peetero, Yaakobo na Yohaana mwene nyina wa Yaakobo.
Bageze kwa Yayiro, Yesu abona ko hari urusaku rw’abarira bacura imiboroogo.
Yinjira mu nzu arababwira ati, "Ni iki kibateera umudugararo no kuborooga? Umwana ntaabwo yapfuuye ahuubwo arasinziiriye!"
Baramuseka caane, abategeka ko baja hanze maze asigarana na se w’umwana na nyina hamwe n’abiigiishwa batatu yari yazanye na bo nuuko baja mu gisenge aho umwana ari.
Amufata ukuboko aramubwira ati, "Talisa, kumi," gisobaanurwa ngo, "Gakoobwa, byuka!"
Ako kaanya ako gakoobwa karahaguruka gatangira kwitoorora aho ngaho. Kaari kamaze imyaka cumi n’ebyiri y’ubukuru. Birabatangaaza caane.
Yesu arabiihanangiriza ngo hatagira uwo babibwira, nuuko abategeka kugaburira uwo mwana.
Yesu avayo aja mu tawuni y’iwaabo, abiigiishwa be baramukurikira.

Ku munsi w’i Isaabato, atangira kwigiisha mu Sinagoogi, abenshi bamwumviise baratangaara, baravuga bati, "Uyu mugabo ibyo avuga abikuura he? Ubu ni buhanga ki yahaawe? Biriiya bitangaaza akora bikomooka he?
Uriiya si wa mubaaji tuuzi, umuhungu wa Mariya, akaba na mwene nyina wa Yaakobo na Yozesi, na Yuda na Simooni, kandi bashiki be ntidutuuranye?" Baheerako ntibamwemera.
Yesu arababwira ati, "Nta handi abahanuuzi basuuzugurirwa keretse mu gihugu c’iwaabo, muri beene waabo, ndetse no mu mago yaabo."
Nuuko ntiyahakorera igitangaaza na kimwe, keretse abarwayi bake abo yarambikagaho ibiganza bagakira.
Yatangaajwe no kuteemera kwabo. Nuuko aja mu byaro yiigiisha abantu.
Ahamagara ba bandi cumi na babiri, aboohereza babiri babiri, kandi abaha ububaasha bwo gutegeka abadayimooni.
Abategeka kutagira ico biitwaza ku rugendo, keretse inkoni yoonyine, nta mugaati, nta gikapu, nta mashilingi mu mifuka yaabo,
ariko bambare ingato z’urugendo kandi bekwitwaza undi mwambaro.
Arababwira ati, "Inzu muzinjiramo yoose, muzaayigumemo kugeza igihe muzaaviira muri uwo mwanya.
Aho muzaagera ntibabaakiire bakanga no kubumva, mukihava, muzakunkumure umucuucu wo mu birenge byanyu, bibabeere ikimenyeetso co kubashinja."
Nuuko baragenda babwira boose ko bakwiriye kwihana.
Biirukana abadayimooni benshi, kandi basiiga amavuta abarwayi benshi barakira.
Umwami Herodi arabyumva, kuko izina rya Yesu ryari ryamamaye hoose. Bamwe baaravugaga bati, "Yohaana Umubatiza yazuutse mu bapfuuye ni co gituma afite ububaasha bwinshi bumukoreramo."
Ariko abandi bakavuga bati, "Ni Eliya." Naho abandi bati, "Ni umuhanuuzi nk’umwe mu bakeera."
Ariko Herodi abyumvise, aravuga ati, "Yohaana wo naciiye igihanga, yaazuutse!"
Herodi ubwe yari yaroohereje abantu ngo bafate Yohaana, bamubohe bamushire mu gihome bamuryoje Herodiyaasi, muka mwene nyina Filipo, kuko Herodi yari amutunze.
Yohaana yari yarabwiye Herodi ati, "Binyuranye n’amategeko kugira ngo utunge muka mwene nyoko."
Ku bw’iyo mpamvu, Herodiyaasi amugirira inziika ashaaka no kumwica ariko ntiyabishobora.
Herodi yatiinyaga Yohaana, kuko yari azi ko ari intungaane kandi umuziranenge, bigatuma amurengera. Yakundaga kumva ibyo yamubwiraga n’ubwo byamubuzaga amahoro.
Nuuko Herodiyaasi abona umugisha ubwo Herodi yiizihizaga umunsi yavuukiyeho. Herodi yatumiye abatware, bakuru b’ingabo n’abandi banyacuubahiro b’i Galileeya.
Umukoobwa wa Herodiyaasi araaza arabyina, ashiimiisha Herodi n’abo yari yaatumiye, nuuko umwami abwira uwo mukoobwa ati, "Nsaba ico ushaaka coose, ndakiguha."
Aramurahira ati, "Ico uri bunsabe coose ndakiguha n’ubwo caaba kimwe ca kabiri c’igihugu canje."
Umukoobwa arasohoka abaza nyina ati, "Nsabe iki?" Aramusubiza ati, "Saba igihanga ca Yohaana Umubatiza."
Ako kaanya agaruka aho umwami ari yiihuuta, aramusaba ati, "Nshaaka ngo umpe noone aha igihanga ca Yohaana Umubatiza ku mbeehe."
Umwami arababara caane, ariko ku bw’indahiro yari yarahiriye imbere y’abashitsi, atiinya guhemuka.
Ako kaanya umwami yoohereza umusirikare, amutegeka ko azana igihanga ca Yohaana. Aragenda amusanga mu gihome amuca umutwe,
awuuzana ku mbeehe, maze awuha uwo mukoobwa, na we awuheereza nyina.
Abiigiishwa ba Yohaana babyumviise, baraaza bajaana umurambo we, barawuhamba.
Intumwa ziitooroora Yesu, zimubwira byose byo zaakoze n’ibyo ziigiishije.
Arazibwira ati, "Nimuuze mwenyine mu mwanya udatuuwe, maze muruhuukeho." Kuko benshi baaraazaga bakagenda, bigatuma batabona umwanya wo kuruhuuka ndetse no kurya.
Maze binjira mu bwato boonyine baja ahadatuuwe.
Benshi bababoonye bagenda barabamenya, bagenda biihuuta n’amaguru bavuuye mu ma tawuni menshi babatangayo.
Yesu amaze kwambuka abona abantu benshi, abagirira impuhwe, kuko baari bameze nk’intama zitagira umushumba, maze atangira kubiigiisha byinshi.
Umunsi ukuze, abiigiishwa be baramwegeera baramubwira bati, "Dore aha turi ntihatuuwe, kandi buriije,
baseezerere kugira ngo baje mu mpande zoose z’ibyaro bashobore kwigurira ibyokurya."
Ariko we arababwira ati, "Nimubahe ibyokurya." Baramubwira bati, "Uragira ngo tuje kugura imigaati iguze idinaari magana abiri, maze tubahe barye?"
Arababaza ati, "Mufite imigaati ingahe? Nimuje kureeba." Babiboonye, baramubwira bati, "Dufite imigaati itaanu, n’isamaaki ebyiri."
Nuuko ategeka ko biicaza abantu ku gacaaca, mu dutsiko.
Maze biicara mu dutsiko tw’abantu ijana ijana, na mirongo itaanu mirongo itaanu.
Afata ya migaati itaanu n’isamaaki ebyiri, areeba ku ijuru, ashiimira Imaana, amaanyura ya migaati, ayiha abiigiishwa be ngo na bo bayihe abantu, nuuko na za samaaki ebyiri arazibagaburira.
Boose bararya barahaaga,
kandi hasigara intonga cumi n’ebyiri z’ubuvungunyukira bw’imigaati hamwe n’ubw’isamaaki.
Abo baariiye banganaga abagabo ibihumbi bitaanu.
Ako kaanya abwira abiigiishwa be kuja mu bwato kugira ngo bamubanzirize haakurya, i Beetsayida, we asigara aseezerera abantu.
Amaze kubaseezerera, azaamuuka umusozi aja gusenga.
Bugoroobye, ubwato bwari bugeze mu nyanja hagati, naho we yari akiri imusozi wenyine.
Aboonye ko barwana n’ingashi ku bw’umuyaga mwinshi, aza abasanga butari bwaca, agendera ku maazi. Yashaakaga kubanyuraho.
Ariko baboonye agendera heejuru y’inyanja, bateekereza ko ari umuzimu maze bateera induuru.
Boose bamuboonye bakuuka umutima. Ariko ako kaanya avugana na bo arababwira ati, "Muhuumure, ni njeewe, mureke gutiinya."
Abasanga mu bwato, maze umuyaga uratuuza. Barushaho gutangaara,
kuko baari bataraasobaanukirwa iby’imigaati kandi n’imitima yaabo yari ikinangiye.
Bamaze kwambuka, bagera i Genezareeti, bazirika ubwato.
Bakiva mu bwato, ako kaanya abantu baramumenya.
Nuuko birukanka muri ako gace koose, batangira kuuzana abarwayi mu ngobyi babamusangiisha aho bumvaga ageze hoose.

Aho yajaga hoose, haaba mu byaro, mu ma tawuni, mu mirima, cangwa mu maguriro, baazanaga abarwayi maze bakamwinginga kugira ngo bishobotse abeemerere bakore ku nshonda y’umwenda we kandi abaawukoragaho boose baarakiraga.
Bamwe mu Bafarisaayo n’Abiigiishamategeko baari bavuuye i Yerusaalemu bateeranira aho Yesu ari.
Babona bamwe mu biigiishwa be bariisha intoki zihumaanye, kimenyeesha ngo badakarabye intoki.
Abayuuda boose na caane Abafarisaayo ntibaaryaga batabanje gukaraba intoki mu maazi ngo zibe zihumaanuwe, nk’uko baaseekuruza baabigenzaga.
Ubwo baabaga bavuuye mu maguriro, ntibakozaga ikintu ku munwa badakarabye. Hari n’indi migenzo baakuuye kuri baaseekuruza nko; kooza ibikopu, ibibindi n’amabbinika y’ibyuma.
Abafarisaayo n’Abiigiishamategeko babaza Yesu bati, "Ni iki gituma abiigiishwa baawe badakurikiza imigenzo karande y’abaatubanjirije, ahuubwo bakariisha intoki zihumaanye?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Yesaaya yabahanuuyeho neeza mwa ndyarya mwe, nk’uko byanditswe ngo, ‘Uyu muryango unyubahiisha akanwa ariko imitima yaabo iri kure yanje.
Bansengera ubusa kuko inyigiisho biigiisha ari amategeko y’abantu.’
Mwaretse itegeko ry’Imaana mukurikiza imigenzo y’abantu."
Arababwira ati, "Mushaakashaakiisha uburyo bwo kwirengagiza itegeko ry’Imaana kugira ngo mukomeze imigenzo yaanyu.
Kuko Moose yavuze ati, ‘Wuubahe ababyeyi baawe’ kandi, ‘Uzaatuka se cangwa nyina akwiriye gupfa.’
Na ho mwebwe mukavuga muti, umuntu naabwira se cangwa nyina ati, ‘Ubufasha naakaguhaaye, nabugize Ituuro ry’Imaana.’
Bibaaye bityo yemerewe kutagira ico afashiisha se cangwa nyina,
nuuko reero ijambo ry’Imaana mukariha agaciiro gake kugira ngo mukurikize imigenzo yaanyu yababaayemo akarande. Kandi mukora n’ibindi byinshi bisa bityo."
Yongera guhamagara abantu benshi arababwira ati, "Muntege amatwi mwese, musobaanukirwe.
Nta kintu kija mu nda y’umuntu kivuuye hanze caamuhumaanya, ukuuyeho icaamuhumaanya, n’ikiva mu mutima we."
Ufite amatwi yumva ni yumve.
Amaze kuva muri abo bantu, yinjira mu nzu, nuuko abiigiishwa be bamusaba ko yabasobaanurira ico uwo mugani umenyeesha.
Yesu arababaza ati, "Koko namwe nta co muuzi? Ntimureeba ko nta kija mu nda kivuuye inyuma caabaasha guhumaanya umuntu,
kuko kitaja mu mutima we ahuubwo kija munda, kikongera kigasohoka kikaja mu coorooni?" Bityo reero yemeza ko nta byokurya bihumaanya.
Nuuko arababwira ati, "Ikiva mu muntu ni co kimuhumaanya,
Kuko mu mitima y’abantu haturukamo ibiteekerezo bibi, uburaaya, ubujuura, ubwicanyi,
ubusambanyi, umururu, ubugome, ububeeshi, gukora ibibi, ishari, amafuti, ubwiraasi n’ubupfu.
Ibi bibi byose bituruka mu mutima, kandi ni byo bihumaanya umuntu."
Yesu ava muri uwo mwanya aja mu gace k’i Tiiro . Yinjira mu nzu, ntiyashaaka ko hagira umenya ko arimo. Ariko banararenga barabimenya.
Umugore wari ufite umwana muto w’umukoobwa wateerwaga n’imyuka mibi, amenye ko Yesu ahari, araaza, yiikubita imbere ye.
Uwo mugore yari umunyamahanga w’Umusirofoyinike. Amwinginga kwirukana dayimooni mu mukoobwa we.
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ashwi daa! Reka abaana babanze bagaburirwe, kuko bidakwiriye gufata ibyokurya by’abaana ukabijugunyira imbwa."
Uwo mugore asubiza Yesu ati, "Nyagasani, n’ibibwana birya ubuvungunyukira abaana bataaye munsi y’imeeza"
Nuuko aramubwira ati, "Ku bw’iryo jambo, igendere, dayimooni ivuuye mu mukoobwa waawe."
Uwo mugore asubira i we, asanga umwana aryamye ku buriri dayimooni yamuvuuyemo.
Yesu ava mu gace k’i Tiiro, yambuka i Sidoni agera ku ngezi y’i Galileeya mu gace gafite ama tawuni cumi.
Abantu bamuuzanira umuntu wapfuuye amatwi kandi avuga imitepfu, baramwinginga ngo amurambureho ikiganza.
Yesu amujaana ahiitaaruuye amuvaana mu bantu, ashira intoki ze mu matwi y’uwo muntu, aciira amacandwe, amufata ku rurimi.
Yesu areeba heejuru, asuhuuza umutima, abwira uwo muntu ati, Efafata, bisobaanurwa ngo Zibuuka.
Ako kaanya amatwi ye atangira kumva, n’ururimi rwe rurabohooka atangira kuvuga neeza.
Yesu abategeka ko batagira uwo babibwira, ariko uko yarushaga kubabuza, ni ko baarushagaho kubyamamaza.
Baratangaara caane baravuga bati, "Byose abikoze neeza, atuma abapfaamatwi bumva kandi akavugiisha n’abaragi!"
Muri iyo minsi ubwo abantu benshi baari badafite ico kurya, ahamagara abiigiishwa be arababwira ati,
"Aba bantu banteeye imbabazi kuko tumaranye iminsi itatu kandi bakaba badafite ico kurya.
Nimbaseezerera ngo basubire iwaabo hatagize ico barya, baragwira isari mu nzira kuko bamwe muri bo baturuka kure."
Abiigiishwa be baramusubiza bati, "Mbese muri ubu butaayu, umuntu yakuura he ibyokurya byahaaza aba bantu boose?"
Yesu arababaza ati, "Mbese mufite imigaati ingana iki?" Na bo baramusubiza bati, "Dufite imigaati indwi."
Ategeka abantu kwicara haasi. Nuuko afata iyo migaati indwi, ayishiimira Imaana, arayimaanyagura, nuuko ayiha abiigiishwa be ngo bayigaburire abantu.
Baari bafite n’udusamaaki duke, na two Yesu adushiimira Imaana, ategeka abiigiishwa be kutugabura.
Boose bararya barahaaga, bakungaanya ubuvungunyukira busigaye, buuzuza intonga indwi.
Boose hamwe baari nk’abantu ibihumbi bine, arabaseezera.
Uwo mwanya aheerako aja mu bwato n’abiigiishwa be, baja mu disiturikiti ya Dalumanuta.
Abafarisaayo baraaza batangira kumugiisha impaka, bamushaakaho ikimenyeetso kivuuye mu ijuru, bamugerageza.
Asuhuza umutima, aravuga ati, "Ni iki giteera ab’iki gihe gushaaka ikimenyeetso? Ndabahamiriza yuuko nta kimenyeetso bazaahaabwa."
Abasiga aho, aja mu bwato asubira haakurya y’inyanja.
Abiigiishwa ba Yesu bari biibagiwe kwihemba imigaati, baari bafite umugaati umwe gusa mu bwato.
Nuuko Yesu arabiihanangiriza ati, "Muje mwirinda umusemburo w’Abafarisaayo n’uwa Herodi."
Batangira kubazanya bati, "Ahaari ni uko tudafite imigaati?"

Amaze kumenya ibyo biibwira, Yesu arababaza ati, "Ni iki kibateera kwitonganya ibyerekeye kutagira imigaati? Mbese na n’ubu ntaabwo mwari mwajijuuka ngo musobaanukirwe? Mbese imitima yaanyu iraciinangiye?
Ko mufite amaaso, ntaabwo mubona? Ko mufite amatwi, ntaabwo mwumva? Ntaabwo mwakwibuka?
Ubwo namaanyaguye imigaati itaanu nkagaburira abantu ibihumbi bitaanu, haasaagutse intonga zingahe?" Bati, "zaari cumi n’ebyiri."
Yongera kubabaza ati, "Kandi ubwo namaanyaguraga imigaati indwi nkagaburira abantu ibihumbi bine, ico gihe haasaagutse intonga zingahe?" Baramusubiza bati, "Ni indwi."
Ni ko kongera kubabaza ati, "No kugeza ubu ntaabwo mwari mwasobaanukirwa?"
Bageze i Beetsayida, hagira abaazanira Yesu umuntu uhumye baramwinginga bashaaka ko yaamufataho.
Yesu amufata ukuboko amuvaana muri ico caaro. Amaze gusiiga amacandwe ku maaso ye no kumurambikaho ibiganza, aramubaza ati, "Mbese hari ico ureeba?"
Nuuko uwo muntu areeba heejuru, aravuga ati, "Yeego, ndikureeba abantu, ariko basa n’ibiti bigenda."
Yesu yongera kurambika ibiganza ku maaso ye, nooneho amaaso ararambuuka, ahumuukira kimwe areeba ibintu byose neeza.
Amwohereza iwaabo, aramubwira ati, "Ntiwiirirwe usubira mu caaro ."
Yesu n’abiigiishwa be barakomeza baja mu caaro ciitwa Kayisaariya yo muri Filipo. Bakigenda, abaza abiigiishwa be ati, "Mbese abantu biibwira ko ndi nde?"
Baramusubiza bati, "Bamwe bavuga ko uri Yohaana Umubatiza, abandi bati uri Eliya, kandi hari n’abagira ngo uri umwe mu bahanuuzi."
Akomeza kubabaza ati, "Mwebwe, muvuga ko ndi nde?" Peetero aramusubiza ati, "Uri Kristo. "
Arabiihanangiriza ngo hatagira uwo babibwira.

Yesu aheerako atangira kwigiisha abiigiishwa be ati, "Ni ngombwa ko Umwana w’Umuntu ababazwa caane, akangwa n’abakuru b’imiryango, abatware b’abaheerezabitambo hamwe n’Abiigiishamategeko maze bakamwica, ariko nyuma y’iminsi itatu akazuuka."
Ibi yabivugaga rwatu. Peetero aramwihereerana atangira kumucaaha.
Ariko Yesu arahinduka areeba abiigiishwa be, akabukana Peetero ati, "Mva iruhande Sataani, kuko ibyo wiibwira bitavuuye ku Maana ahuubwo ari iby’abantu!"
Nuuko Yesu ahamagara rubanda n’abiigiishwa be, arababwira ati, "Niiba hari ushaaka kunkurikira, yiyange, yikorere umusaraba we ankurikire.
Abashaaka gukiza ubugingo bwabo bazaabubura, kandi ababura ubugingo bwabo ku bwanje no ku bw’Ubutumwa bwiza, bazaabukiza.
Mbese byamarira iki umuntu kwigarurira ibintu byose byo ku isi, ariko agataakaza ubugingo bwe?
Mbese ubugingo bw’umuntu yabuguraana iki?

Umuntu weese ugira isoni ku bwanje no kwemera ijambo ryanje muri iki gihe co gutinyuuka Imaana n’uburiganya, Umwana w’Umuntu na we azaamugirira isoni igihe azaagaruka n’icuubahiro ca se ari n’abaamalayika beera."
Nuuko arababwira ati, "Ndababwira ukuri, yuuko bamwe muri mwe batazaapfa bataboonye Ubwami bw’Imaana buuza bufite ububaasha."
Iminsi itandatu ishize, Yesu ajaana na Peetero na Yaakobo na Yohaana, maze abajaana mu mpinga y’umusozi mureemure bonyine. Ahindukira ukundi imbere yaabo,
imyambaro ye irarabagirana, yeera de, ku buryo ko ari ntamumeshi wo mu isi wakabashije kuyeeza atyo.
Maze Eliya na Moose barababonekera bagaanira na Yesu.
Haanyuma Peetero abwira Yesu ati, "Mwigiisha, byakabaaye byiza kwibeera hano, reka twubake amahema atatu, rimwe ryawe, irindi rya Moose, n’irindi rya Eliya."
Ntaabwo yari azi ico kuvuga, kuko baari baagize ubwoba bwinshi caane.
Maze igicu kirababundikira, nuuko giturukamo ijwi rivuga riti, "Uyu ni Umwana wanje nkunda caane, mumwumvire!"
Bareebye hiirya no hiino, ntihaagira undi muntu babona, uretse Yesu wenyine.
Ubwo baamanukaga umusozi, abategeka kutagira uwo babwira ibyo baaboonye, kugeza ubwo Umwana w’Umuntu azaaba amaze kuzuuka.
Bakomeza kuzirikana iryo jambo, ariko biibaza ico iryo zuuka mu baapfuuye rimenyeesha.
Nuuko babaza Yesu bati, "Kuki abanditsi bavuga ko Eliya akwiriye kubanza yaaza?"
Arababwira ati, "Ni byo koko, Eliya agiiye kuuza asubizeho byose bundi busha. Ntibyanditswe ko Umwana w’Umuntu azaababazwa, kandi agashinyagurirwa?
Ariko ndababwira yuuko Eliya yamaze kuuza, kandi ko bamukoreye ibyo bashaaka, nk’uko byamwanditsweho."
Bageze ku bandi biigiishwa, babona abantu benshi babiitoorooye, kandi baja impaka n’Abiigiishamategeko.
Abantu benshi baboonye Yesu, baratangaara caane, bamusanga birukanka baja kumuramutsa.
Arababaza ati, "Ico mujaho impaka na bo ni iki?"
Umwe mu baari aho aramusubiza ati, "Mwigiisha, nkuuzaniye umwana wanje, yateewe na dayimooni ituma atavuga.
Iyo imufashe, imutuura haasi, akaazana urufuzi, agahekenya ameenyo kandi akagambarara. Nasabye abiigiishwa baawe ngo bayirukane, ariko ntibaabishobora."
Arabasubiza ati, "Yemwe bantu b’iki gihe, kuki mutiizeera? Nzaabaana namwe kugeza ryari? Nimuumunzanire."
Umwana baramuuzana. Dayimooni iboonye Yesu, itigisa wa mwana caane, maze yiikubita haasi ariigaragura, azana urufuzi mu kanwa.
Yesu abaza se ati, "Hashize igihe kingana iki ibi bimubaho?" Na we aramusubiza ati, "Byamufashe kuva mu bwana.
Ihora imusuka mu muriro no mu maazi ishaaka ku mwica, ariko niiba hari ico waashobora gukora, tugirire imbabazi maze udufashe."
Yesu aramubwira ati, "Kuki uvuze ngo, ‘Niiba waabishobora?’ Byose bishobokera uweemera."
Ako kaanya se w’uwo mwana ateera heejuru avuga ati, "Ndeemera, nyongeerera ukwemera!"
Yesu aboonye abantu benshi baazira hamwe biirukanka, acaaha dayimooni, avuga ati, "Wowe dayimooni utuma uyu mwana atavuga kandi ntiyumve, ndagutegetse, muvemo, kandi ntukazaamugarukemo ukundi!"
Nyuma yo kuvuza induuru no kumutigisa caane, imuvamo maze umwana amera nk’upfuuye, bituma benshi bavuga bati, "Yapfuuye."
Ariko Yesu amufata ukuboko maze aramuhagurutsa, ashobora guhagarara.
Yinjiye mu nzu, abiigiishwa be baramwihereerana maze baramubaza bati, "Kuki twebwe tutaashoboye kuyiirukana?"
Arababwira ati, "Beene ubwo bwoko ntibupfa kwirukanwa uretse amasengeesho no kwiyiriza ubusa."
Bavayo, banyura i Galileeya. Ntiyashaakaga ko hagira ubimenya,
kuko yiigiishaga abiigiishwa be ababwira ati, "Umwana w’Umuntu agiiye kugambaanirwa ashirwe mu maboko y’abantu, maze bamwice, ariko nyuma y’iminsi itatu, azuuke."
Ariko ntibaasobaanukirwa ico yababwiraga kandi batiinyaga no kumubaza.
Bagera i Kaperenawumu, Yesu ari mu nzu arababaza ati, "Ni iki mwajagaho impaka muri mu nzira?"
Ariko bariihorera, kuko bari mu nzira baari baagiiye impaka zo kumenya umukuru muri bo uwo ari we.
Ariicara, yakura abo cumi na babiri, maze arababwira ati, "Ushaaka kuba uwa mbere agomba kuba uwa nyuma kandi akaba n’umugaragu wa boose."
Azana umwana muto, amuhagarika hagati yaabo, aramukiikira, maze arababwira ati,
"Uwaakiira umwana nk’uyu mu izina ryanje ni nje aba yaakiiriye, kandi unyakiira aba atari nje yaakiiriye ahuubwo aba yakiiriye uwantumye."
Yohaana abwira Yesu ati, "Mwigiisha, twaboonye umuntu wiirukana abadayimooni mu izina ryawe turamubuza, kuko atari umwe muri twe."
Ariko Yesu aravuga ati, "Ntimumubuze, kuko nta muntu ukora igitangaaza mu izina ryanje, wansebya.
Utari umwanzi waacu aba ari uwaacu.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko, uzaabaha igikopu c’amaazi yo kunywa ku bw’izina rya Kristo, ntaabwo azaabura ingororano.
Umuntu weese muri mwe uzaabeera igisiitaaza umwe muri aba bato baanyemera, ibyiza ni uko yaahambiirwa urusyo mu ijosi, akajugunywa mu nyanja.
Ukuboko kwawe ni gutuma ucumura, uguceho, ni byiza ko waakwinjira mu bugingo buhoraho umugaye, kuruta kuja mu muriro utazima n’amaboko yombi. [
Aho hantu, inyo z’abapfu ntizishira kandi umuriro ubatwika ntuuzima.]
Kandi ikirenge caawe ni kigucumuza, ugiceho, ni byiza kwinjira ubuzima buhoraho uremaye kuruta kujugunywa i gehenoomu ufite ibirenge byombi. [
Aho hantu, inyo z’abapfu ntizishira kandi umuriro ubatwika ntuuzima.]
Kandi ijiisho ryawe nirigucumuza, urinogooremo, ibyiza ni uko waakwinjira mu bwami bw’Imaana n’ijiisho rimwe, aho kugira amaaso abiri ukajugunywa mu muriro,
aho inyo zaabo zidapfa, kandi umuriro ubatwika ntuuzime.
Kuko buri weese azaasukuurwa n’umuunyu n’umuriro.
Umunyu ni mwiza, ariko iyo ukayutse, mwakongera mute kuwusubizamo uburyohe? Namwe ni ko mukwiriye kugirira Imaana akamaro nk’ako umuunyu ugira mu byokurya kandi mubaane amahoro."
Yesu ava muri uwo mwanya aja i Yudeeya, no haakurya ya Yorodaani. Haaza abantu benshi atangira kubiigiisha nk’uko yabigenzaga.
Abafarisaayo bamwe bamuuzaho bagerageza kumutega baramubaza bati, "Tubwire, itegeko ryemerera umugabo kwirukana umugore we?"
Arabasubiza ati, "Moose yabategetse iki?"
Baravuga bati, "Moose yeemereye umugabo kwandikira umugore urwandiko rumwirukana nuuko akamwirukana."
Yesu arababwira ati, "Moose yabemereye iryo tegeko kuko mwari mufite imitima yiinangiye.
Ariko mbere na mbere, ubwo Imaana yaremaga umuntu, ‘yabaremye umugabo n’umugore.’
‘Ni co gituma umugabo azaasiga se na nyina akabaana n’umugore we,
bombi bakaba umubiri umwe.’ Baba batakiri babiri ahuubwo bakaba umubiri umwe.
Nuuko reero abo Imaana yateeranyije, ntihakagire ubatandukanya."
