Basubiye mu nzu, abiigiishwa bongera kubaza Yesu ku byo yavuze.
Arababwira ati, "Umugabo weese wiirukana umugore we agasohoza undi, aba asambanye kandi ahemukiye umugore wa mbere.
Kandi n’umugore utandukana n’umugabo we agashingirwa ku wundi mugabo aba asambanye".
Bamuuzanira abaana bato ngo abarambikeho ibiganza, ariko abiigiishwa be barabacaaha.
Yesu abiboonye biramuraakaza abwira abiigiishwa be ati, "Mureke abaana bato baaze aho ndi, ntimubabuze, kuko Ubwami bw’Imaana ari ubwabo.
Ndabahamiriza yuuko utaakiira ubwami bw’Imaana nk’Umwana muto atazaabwinjiramo na hato."
Nuuko akiikira abo baana, abarambikaho ibiganza, abaha umugisha.
Yesu agitangira urugendo, haaza umugabo yiirukanka, aramupfukamira, aramubaza ati, "Mwigiisha mwiza, nakora iki kugira ngo mpaabwe ubugingo buhoraho?"
Yesu aramubaza ati, "Kuki unyita mwiza? Nta mwiza uriho uretse Imaana yoonyine.
Uzi amategeko, ‘ntuukiice, ntuugasambane, ntuukiibe, ntuukabeeshere abandi, ntuukarenganye, wubahe so na nyoko.’ "
Uwo mugabo asubiza Yesu ati, "Mwigiisha, ibyo byose narabikurikije kuva mu buto bwanje."

Yesu aramureeba, aramukunda, aramubwira ati, "Ubuzeho ikintu kimwe gusa, genda uguriishe ubutunzi bwawe bwose, nuuko amashilingi avuuyemo uyahe abakene, uzaagira ubutunzi mu ijuru, maze uheereko unkurikire."
Uwo mugabo yumviise ibyo, aratangaara agenda ababaye, kuko yari afite ubutunzi bwinshi.
Yesu areeba abiigiishwa be arababwira ati, "Mbeega ukuntu bikomereye abatunzi kwinjira mu bwami bw’Imaana!"
Abiigiishwa be batangaazwa n’ayo magambo. Ariko Yesu arongera arababwira ati, "Baana banje, mbeega ukuntu bikomeye kwinjira mu bwami bw’Imaana!
Icooroshe ni uko ingamiya yaanyura mu gapfumure gato nk’ak’urusindani kuruta uko umukire ya kwinjira mu bwami bw’Imaana."
Barushaho gutangaara babazanya bati, "Noone ni nde ushobora gukizwa?"
Yesu arabareeba aravuga ati, "Ku muntu n’ibidashoboka, ariko siko biri ku Maana, ku Maana byose birashoboka."
Peetero atangira kuvuga ati, "Reeba! Twebwe twasize byose turagukurikira."
Yesu aravuga ati, "Ndababwira ukuri yuuko ntawasize urugo rwe, abavandimwe, nyina, ise, abaana, cangwa imirima kubwa nje n’ubutumwa bwiza,
utazaahaabwa ibirutaho inshuro ijana mur’iki gihe ca noone, ari amazu, abavandimwe, abaana n’imirima. Icakora bizaaza hamwe no kurenganywa, maze mu gihe kizaaza azaahaabwa ubugingo buhoraho.
Ariko benshi baari aba mbere bazaaba abaanyuma, kandi abaanyuma bazaaba aba mbere".

Ubwo baari mu nzira bagana i Yerusaalemu, Yesu yari imbere yaabo. Abiigiishwa baratangaara, kandi abaari babakurikiye baratiinya. Ajaana abiigiishwa cumi na babiri iruhande atangira kubabwira ibigiiye kumubaho
ati, "Dore tugiiye i Yerusaalemu, Umwana w’Umuntu agashikirizwa abaheerezabitambo bakuru n’Abiigiishamategeko, bamuciire urubanza rwo gupfa, nuuko bamushikirize abanyamahanga.
Bazaamushinyagurira, bamuciireho, bamukubite inkoni, bamwice, maze haanyuma y’iminsi itatu azuuke."
Yaakobo na Yohaana, beene Zebedaayo, baramwegeera baramubwira bati, "Mwigiisha, dushaaka ko udukorera ibyo tugusaba byose."
Arababaza ati, "Murashaaka ko mbakorera iki?"
Baramubwira bati, "Uduhe kwicara naawe, umwe iburyo undi ibumoso, mu ikuzo ryawe."
Ariko Yesu arababwira ati, "Ntaabwo muuzi ico musaba. Mbese mwashobora kunywera ku gikopu c’umubabaro nzanyweraho, cangwa kubatizwa umubatizo nzaabatizwa?".
Baramusubiza bati, "Twabishobora." Nuuko Yesu arababwira ati, "Ni koko igikopu nzanyweraho muzaakinyweraho, kandi n’umubatizo nzaabatizwa ni wo namwe muzaabatizwa.
Naho kwicara iburyo cangwa ibumoso bwanje si nje ubigaba ahuubwo bifite abo byateguuriwe."
Bagenzi baabo cumi babyumviise batangira kurakarira Yaakobo na Yohaana.
Yesu arabahamagara arababwira ati, "Muuzi yuuko abaahaawe gutegeka amahanga bayatwaza igitugu, kandi n’abakomeye bo muri bo bakayabuza amahoro.
Ariko muri mwe si ko bimeze, kuko ushaaka kuba mukuru muri mwe, akwiriye kuba umugaragu waanyu mwese,
kandi ushaaka kuba uwa mbere muri mwe akwiriye kuba imbaata ya boose.
Kuko Umwana w’Umuntu ataazanywe no gukorerwa, ahuubwo yazanywe no gukorera abandi, no gutanga ubugingo bwe nk’inshungu ya benshi."
Bagera i Yeriko, Yesu n’abiigiishwa be bahavaana n’abantu benshi. Baritimaayo mwene Timayasi, impumyi yasabirizaga yari yiicaye iruhande rw’inzira.
Yumviise ko Yesu w’i Nazaareeti aje, arataka caane ati, "Yesu, mwene Dawudi, ngirira imbabazi!"
Benshi baramucaaha ngo aceceke, ahuubwo we arushaho gutaka caane ati, "Yesu mwene Dawudi, ngirira imbabazi!"
Yesu arahagarara aravuga ati, "Nimumuhamagare." Bahamagara Baritimaayo, baramubwira bati, "Ihangane, haguruka, araguhamagara."
Ajugunya umwiteero we, arabaduka asanga Yesu.
Yesu aramubaza ati, "Ushaaka ko ngukorera iki?" Aramusubiza ati, "Mwigiisha, mpumuura."
Yesu aramubwira ati, "Genda, kwizeera kwawe kuragukijije." Ako kaanya, arahumuuka, amukurikira mu nzira.
Bari haafi kugera i Yerusaalemu, bari i Betifage n’i Beetaniya, haafi y’umusozi wa Elayoni, yoohereza babiri mu biigiishwa be
arababwira ati, "Mugende mu caaro kiri imbere yaanyu, mukimara kwinjira mo, murahasanga icaana c’indogobe kiziritse kandi kitiigeze giheekaho umuntu, mukiziture mukiizane.
Nihagira ubabaza ati, ‘Kuki mukora ibyo?’ Mumubwire muti, ‘Umwami Yesu aragishaaka kandi arakigarura vuba.’ "
Baragenda basanga icaana c’indogobe kiziritswe haafi y’irembo, hanze ku nzira. Bakikizitura,
abaari bahagaze aho barababaza bati, "Muri gukora iki, kuzitura icaana c’indogobe?"
Abiigiishwa bababwira ibyo Yesu yari yaavuze maze abo bantu beemera ko bakijaana.
Bakiizanira Yesu bakirambuuraho imyenda yaabo nuuko aciicaraho.
Abantu benshi basasa imyenda yaabo mu nzira, abandi basasa amashami y’ibiti baaciiye mu mirima.
Abaamugendaga imbere n’abaari bamukurikiye bagenda barangurura amajwi yaabo bati, "Hozaana! Hahiirwa uje mu izina rya Nyagasani!
Hahiirwa n’ubwami bwa sogokuruza Dawudi buuje! Mu ijuru ni basingize Imaana bati, Hozaana!"
Nuuko Yesu ageze i Yerusaalemu, yinjira mu Nzu y’Imaana, amaze kwitegereza buri kimwe coose, kandi aboonye ko bumaze kwira, aja i Beetaniya na ba cumi na babiri.
Bukeeye bwaho, bavuuye i Beetaniya, Yesu yari ashonje.
Akiri kure areeba igiti gishishe ciitwa umutiini, araceegeera kureeba ko haagira ico yaabonamo. Akigezeho, asanga ari amababi yoonyine, kuko kitaari igihe caaco co kwera imbuto.
Yesu avuma ico giti avuga ati, "Nta muntu uziigera kukuryaho imbuto ukundi!" Abiigiishwa be bumva abivuga.
Bageze i Yerusaalemu, Yesu aja mu Nzu y’Imaana atangira kwirukana abaaguriishirizagamo no kuguriramo ibintu. Yuubika imeeza z’abaavunjaga amashilingi n’intebe z’abaaguriishaga inuma,
kandi ntiyeemerera umuntu weese kugira ico anyuza muri uwo mwanya w’Inzu y’Imaana.
Yiigiishaga abantu avuga ati, "Nti byanditswe ngo, ‘Inzu yanje iziitwa Inzu y’Imaana y’amahanga yoose?’ Ariko mwe mwayihinduye ubwihisho bw’abajuura!"
Abatware b’abaheerezabitambo n’Abiigiishamategeko babyumviise, batangira gushaaka uburyo bwo kwica Yesu. Baaramutiinye kuko abantu benshi baatangaazwaga n’inyigiisho ze.
Bugoroobye, Yesu n’abiigiishwa be bava mur’iyo tawuni.
Mu gitondo kare ubwo baanyuragaho, babona ca giti c’umutiini cumye kugeza mu mizi.
Peetero yiibuka ibyabaayeho, maze abwira Yesu ati, "Mwigiisha, dore ca giti c’umutiini wavumye cumye!"
Yesu arababwira ati, "Mugire kwizeera Imaana.
Ndabahamiriza yuuko uzaabwira uyu musozi ati, ‘Shiguka utaabwe mu nyanja,’ adashidiikanya mu mutima we, ahuubwo akizeera, ibyo avuze bizaaba.
Ni co gituma mbabwira nti, nimusenga musaba ikintu, mwizeere ko mukiboonye, kandi kizaaba icaanyu.
N’igihe muhagaze gusenga, muje mubabarira abo mwaba mufite ico mupfa, kugira ngo namwe So wo mu ijuru abababarire ibyaha byanyu."
Ariko nimutababarira abandi, So wo mu ijuru nawe ntaazaabababarira ibyaha byanyu.
Bongera kuja i Yerusaalemu. Ubwo Yesu yagendagendaga mu Inzu y’Imaana, abatware b’abaheerezabitambo, Abiigiishamategeko, na bakuru b’imiryango baaza aho ari
baramubaza bati, "Uvaana he ububaasha bwo gukora ibyo? Ninde waguhaaye ubwo bubaasha ukoreesha?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Ndababaza ikibazo kimwe, nimunsubiza, nanje ndababwira iyo mvaana ubwo bubaasha.
Umubatizo wa Yohaana ukomooka mu ijuru, cangwa ukomooka ku bantu? Nimunsubize."
Batangira kuja inaama bati, "Nituvuga tuti, ‘Wavuuye mu ijuru,’ aravuga ati, ‘Kuki mutamwemeye?’
Ariko se tuvuge ngo, ‘Yawukuuye mu bantu’?" Batiinya rubanda, kuko boose baajaanaga Yohaana nk’umuhanuuzi w’ukuri.
Nuuko basubiza Yesu bati, "Ntaabwo tubiizi." Yesu arababwira ati, "Nanje sindibubabwire aho nkuura ububaasha bwo gukora ibi."

Yesu atangira kubiigiishiriza mu migani ati, "Umugabo yahinze umurima w’imizaabibu, arawuzitira, acukuramo urwina, kandi yuubakamo umunaara w’abarinzi. Nuuko nyir’umurima awatira abahinzi aja mu kindi gihugu.
Igihe co gusaaruura kigeze, yoohereza umugaragu we ku bahinzi ngo yaakiire umugabane we w’imbuto z’imizaabibu.
Agezeyo, baramufata, baramukubita, asubirayo amaara masa.
Nyir’umurima yongera kohereza undi mugaragu, nawe baramukubita, bamurema uruguma mu mutwe kandi baramuhemura.
Yongera kohereza undi mugaragu, maze uyu we baramwica. Uku ni ko byagendeye n’abandi benshi, bamwe baarakubiswe abandi bariicwa.
Uwo yari asigaranye wo kohereza yari umwe gusa, umwana we yakundaga. Bigeze aho na we aramwohereza yiibwira mu mutima ati, ‘Umwana wanje baramwubaha.’
Ariko abo bahinzi bo baravugana bati, ‘Dore uwarazwe ibintu araaje, nimuuze tumwice maze tuzaazungure ibye.’
Baramufata, baramwica maze bamujugunya hanze y’uruzitiro rw’uwo murima.
Noone nyir’umurima azaakora iki? Azaaza yiice abo bahinzi nuuko umurima awuheereze abandi.
Mbese ntimwasomye ibyanditswe ngo, ‘Ibuye abuubatsi banze ni ryo ryahindutse urufatiro rw’inzu.
Ibyo ni Nyagasani wabikoze, noone bitubeereye igitangaaza’!"
Bamaze kumenya ko umugani yaciiye ubashinja, bashaaka kumufata ariko Batiinya rubanda. Bageze aho baramureka maze baragenda.
Abayobozi b’Abayuuda boohereza Abafarisaayo na bamwe mu Baherodiya kuri Yesu kugira ngo bamutegere mu byo avuga.

Baraaza baramubaza bati, "Mwigiisha, tuuzi ko uri inyangamugayo kandi ko utarobaanura abantu ku butoni, kandi ukiigiisha ubuyoboka Maana ushingiye ku kuri. Amategeko yeemera ko dutanga umusoro w’umwami cangwa ntaabyemera?
Mbese tuwutange cangwa tuwureke?" Ariko kuko yari azi uburyarya bwabo, arababaza ati, "Kuki mungerageza? Ni munzanire igiceri ndeebe."
Bakimuuzaniye arababaza ati, "Iri shusho n’izina n’ibyande?" Baramusubiza bati, "N’iby’umwami."
Yesu arababwira ati, "Iby’umwami mubihe umwami, kandi n’iby’Imaana mubihe Imaana". Nuuko baramutangaarira caane.
Bamwe mu Basadukaayo, bavuga ko kuzuuka kutabaho baraaza babaza Yesu bati,
"Mwigiisha, Moose yanditse atya ati, ‘Umugabo naapfa agasiga umugore batabyaranye, mwene nyina agomba gucura uwo mugore kugira ngo aciikuure mwene nyina.’
Haabaayeho ibyenenyina birindwi, umukuru asohoza umugore ariko apfa bataraabyarana.
Umukurikira acuura uwo mugore, nawe apfa bataraabyarana. N’uwagatatu biba bityo.
Nta numwe muri abo barindwi wasize umwana. Amaheerezo uwo mugore nawe arapfa.
Mbese igihe c’izuuka uwo mugore azaaba uwande? Ko boose barindwi baamurongoye?"
Yesu arababwira ati, "Mwarayobye! Muuzi impamvu? Ni uko mutaazi ibyanditswe hamwe n’imbaraga z’Imaana.
Mu izuuka, ntaawe usohoza cangwa ngo ashingirwe. Ahuubwo bamera nk’abaamalayika bo mu ijuru.
Ku byerekeye kuzuuka kw’abaapfuuye, nti mwasomye mu gitabo ca Moose igihe yari ku gihuru caaka umuriro, ko Imaana yamubwiye iti, ‘Ndi Imaana ya Aburahamu, Imaana ya Isaaka, n’Imaana ya Yaakobo.’
Ntaabwo ari Imaana yabapfu, ahuubwo ni Imaana y’abazima, Mwarayobye caane!"
Umwe mu biigiishamategeko arabeegeera yumva baja impaka. Aboonye ko Yesu yashubije b’Abasadukaayo neeza, aramubaza ati, "Itegeko riruta ayandi ni irihe?"
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Irya mbere ni, ‘Umva, Isirayeli! Uhoraho Imaana yaacu ni yo Maana yoonyine.
Ukunde Uhoraho Imaana yaawe n’umutima waawe woose, n’ubugingo bwawe bwose, n’ubwenge bwawe bwose, n’imbaraga zaawe zoose.’
Irya kabiri ni iri, ‘Ukunde mugenzi waawe nk’uko wikunda.’ Nta rindi tegeko riruta ayo gukomera."
Umwigiishamategeko abwira Yesu ati, "Urashitsa Mwigiisha, uvuze ukuri uti, ‘Imaana ni imwe, kandi nta yindi Maana keretse yo yoonyine’.
Kandi ‘gukunda Imaana n’umutima waawe woose, n’ubugingo bwawe bwose, n’imbaraga zaawe zoose,’ no ‘gukunda mugenzi waawe nk’uko wikunda.’ Ibi biruta ibitambo byose byokejwe n’ibitookejwe."
Yesu aboonye ko ashubije neeza aramubwira ati, "Ntaabwo uri kure y’Ubwami bw’Imaana." Nyuma yaho ntaawundi wahangaaye kongera kumubaza.
Ubwo Yesu yiigiishirizaga mu Nzu y’Imaana aravuga ati, "Ni iki gituma Abiigiishamategeko bavuga bati Kristo ni umwana wa Dawudi?
Dawudi ubwe, ayobowe n’Umwuka Weera yaravuze ati, ‘Uhoraho yabwiye Umwami wanje ati, Icara iburyo bwanje, kugeza aho nzaashirira abanzi baawe munsi y’ibirenge byawe.’
Dawudi ubwe yiitaga Yesu Umwami, noone ashobora ate kuba Umwana we?" Abantu benshi bumvirizaga Yesu n’umuneezeero.
Ubwo yiigiishaga, arababwira ati, "Mwirinde Abiigiishamategeko bakunda kugenda bambaye amakanzu no kuramutswa mu cuubahiro mu maguriro,
no guhaabwa ibyicaro byiza mu masinagoogi n’imyanya y’ibyubahiro mu birori.
Baryarya amago y’abapfaakazi, bakiiha kuvuga amasengeesho y’urudaca. Abo bazaaciirwa urubanza rukomeye kurusha abandi."
Yesu yiicara ahateeganye n’ibiikiro ry’amatuuro, nuuko yiitegereza uko abantu bari gutuura. Abakire benshi baashiragamo amashilingi menshi.
Umupfaakazi w’umukene na we ashiramo uduceri tubiri tw’umuringa.
Ahamagara abiigiishwa be arababwira ati, "Ndababwira ukuri yuuko uyu mupfaakazi w’umukene arushije abandi boose gutuura.
Abandi batuuye ibisaaze ku butunzi bwabo, ariko we mu bukene bwe, atuuye ibyo yari afite byose, ibyari bimubeeshejeho."
Yesu agisohoka mu Nzu y’Imaana, umwe mu biigiishwa be aramubwira ati, "Mwigiisha, ireebere naawe! Mbeega inzu nini yuubakiishijwe amabuye manini meeza! Mbeega imyubakire y’igitangaaza!"
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Nti ureeba iki cuubakwa gitangaaje? Nta buye na rimwe rizaasigara rigeretswe ku rindi, byose bizaasenywa."
Yesu yiicaye ku musozi wa Elayoni, ahateebanye n’Inzu y’Imaana, Peetero, Yaakobo, Yohaana na Andereya baramwihereerana, baramubaza bati,
"Tubwire, ibi byose bizaaba ryari kandi ni kimenyeetso ki kizaagaragaza ko bisohoye?"
Yesu atangira kubabwira ati, "Muramenye, ntihazaagire ubayobya.
Kuko benshi bazaaza mu izina ryanje bavuga bati, ‘Ni nje Kristo!’ Kandi bazaashuka benshi.
Ntimugahagarike imitima yaanyu ni mwumva intambara n’impuuha z’intambara. Ibi bigomba kuzaabaho, ariko imperuuka izaaba itaraagera.
Igihugu kizarwana n’ikindi gihugu, ubwami buteere ubundi bwami, hirya no hiino hazaahinda imishitsi hateere n’inzara, ibyo bizaaba bimeze nk’imigendo ibanziriza ibise by’umubyeyi umwana ataraavuuka.
Ariko mwebweho, mube maaso kuko bazaabajaana mu nkiiko no mu masinagoogi babakubitiremo, muzaahagarikwa imbere y’abaami n’abandi bategetsi babampoora, ngo mumbeere abahamya.
Icakora, Ubutumwa Bwiza bukwiriye kubanza bwabwirizwa mu mahanga yoose.

Ni babafata bakabajaana mu bucaamanza, ntimuzaahagarike imitima yaanyu ngo mwibaze uko muziireguura. Ahuubwo ico gihe ni kigera, muzaahabwa ico mukwiriye kuvuga, kuko atari mwe muzaaba muvuga ahuubwo n’Umwuka Weera.
Umuvandimwe azaagambaanira mwene nyina amwiciishe, umubyeyi azaagambaanira umwana we, abaana baziihindukana ababyeyi baabo babiiciishe.
Muzangwa na boose ku bw’izina ryanje, ariko uziihangaana kugeza ku mperuuka azaakizwa."
"Nimuzaabona ‘ikizira kirimbura’ gihagaze aho kitagomba kuba, (usoma ibi asobaanukirwe neeza), abazaaba bari i Yudeeya bazaahungire ku misozi,
uzaaba ari heejuru y’inzu aramenye yekuzaamanuka ngo yinjire mu nzu kugira ngo agire ico avaanamo.
Uzaaba ari mu murima, yekuzaasubira mu rugo gushaaka umwiteero.
Abagore batwite n’abo bazaaba bari konsa bazaaguusha ishano ico gihe!
Nuuko musenge caane kugira ngo ibyo bitazaabaho mu gihe c’imbeho.
Kuko muri iyo minsi hazaabaho amakuba akabije ataariigeze abaho uheereye mu intangiriro ubwo Imaana yaremaga ukageza noone, kandi ntaazongera kubaho ukundi.
Iyo Uhoraho atagabanya iyo minsi, nta wari kuzaarokoka. Ariko ku bw’abo yiitooranyirije, iyo minsi yarayigabanyije.
Ico gihe, nihazaagira ubabwira ati, ‘Dore, Kristo nguuyu’ cangwa ati, ‘Nguuriiya’, ntimuzaabyemere.
Hazaaza abiyita Kristo n’abahanuuzi b’ibinyoma beerekana ibimenyeetso, bakora n’ibitangaaza kugira ngo bayobye abantu, kandi byashoboka bakayobya na ba bandi Imaana yiitooranyirije.
Murabe maaso reero! Ibi byose mbaaye mbibabwiye igihe kitaraagera.
Ariko muri iyo minsi, haanyuma y’iyo mibabaro, izuuba riziijima kandi n’ukwezi nti kuzaava ngo kumurike,
n’inyenyeeri zizaahanantuka ziva mu kireere, kandi imbaraga zo mu ijuru nazo, zizanyeganyezwa.
Ubwo nibwo bazaabona Umwana w’Umuntu aturutse mu bicu, afite imbaraga nyinshi n’ikuzo.
Nuuko azoohereza abaamalayika be mu nshonda enye z’isi gukungaanya abo yiitooranyirije uheereye ku mpera y’isi ukageza ku mpera y’ijuru."
"Reka igiti ciitwa umutiini kibabeere urugero. Iyo mubona amashami yaaco yoroheereye akameraho amababi, mumenya yuuko igihe kiba kirenda guhinduka.
Noone reero, nimuzaabona ibyo nababwiye bibaaye, muzaamenye ko Umwana w’Umuntu ari haafi kuuza, ndetse ko azaaba ageze ku irembo.
Ni ukuri ndabahamiriza yuuko ab’iki gihe batazaashira, ibi bitaraasohora.
Ijuru n’isi bizaashiraho, ariko amagambo yanje ntaabwo azaashira.
Icakora, kubyerekeye umunsi cangwa igihe bizaabeeraho, nta we ubiizi, haaba abaamalayika bo mu ijuru cangwa Umwana w’Imaana, biizwi na Daata weenyine.
Nuuko reero mwirinde, mube maaso kandi musenge , kuko mutaazi igihe co ibyo bizaasohorera.
Byagereranywa n’uko umuntu yaaja ku rugendo, agasigira abagaragu urugo rwe, buri umwe akamusigira ico gukora. Agategeka umurinzi wo ku irembo guhora ari maaso.
Ni mube maaso reero kuko ntaawe uzi igihe shoobuja, ariwe nyir’urugo azaazira. Niiba ari kumugorooba, mu gicuku cangwa mu rukeereera.
Muramenye atazaabatungura akabasanga musinziiriye.
Kandi ibyo mbabwira, ndabibwira boose, mube maaso."

Haari hasigaye iminsi ebyiri hakabaho iminsi mikuru yo kwizihiza iminsi y’ibirori byo Kunyurwaho, hamwe n’ubushitsi bwo kurya Imigaati Idasembuwe. Abakuru b’abaheerezabitambo hamwe n’Abiigiishamategeko baashaakaga ukuntu bafata Yesu rwihishwa, bakamwica.
Icakora baribwira bati, "Ntibyashoboka ko tumufata muri iki gihe c’iminsi y’ibirori kuko byateera agasasamaro muri rubanda."

Igihe Yesu yari i Beetaniya kwa Simooni wari umubembe yiicaye afungura, umugore azana icupa ryuzuye amavuta ahuumura neeza yiitwa Naridi. Ayo mavuta yari amininnye kandi ahenze caane. Apfunduura iryo cupa maze asuka ya mavuta ku mutwe wa Yesu.
Bamwe mu baari aho bararaakara bariitotomba bati, "Aya mavuta apfuuye iki?
Mbese ntiyari kuguriishwa idinaari zirenga magana atatu, maze ayo mashilingi akagabirwa abakene?" Babivuga batonganya uwo mugore caane.
Yesu arababwira ati, "Ni mumureke, muramuhoora iki? Ico ankoreye ni ciiza caane.
Abakene, muhorana na bo kandi mwabagirira neeza igihe coose mushaakiye, ariko njeeweho ntituzaahorana iteeka.
Akoze ico ashoboye, ansiize aya mavuta ku mutwe ngo antunganye umubiri mbere y’igihe, anteguurira guhambwa.
Na noone ndababwiza ukuri yuuko, mu isi yoose aho Ubutumwa Bwiza buzaabwirizwa, ibyo akoze bizaavugwa kugira ngo yiibukwe."
Umwe mu biigiishwa cumi na babiri wiitwaga Yuda Isikariyoti aja kuvugana n’abatware b’abaheerezabitambo kugira ngo areebe uburyo yagambaanira Yesu.
Babyumvise batyo, baraneezeerwa, bamuseezeranya kumuha amashilingi. Aheerako atangira gushaakiisha igihe gikwiriye co kumugambaanira.

Ku munsi wa mbere wo mu minsi y’ibirori by’Imigaati Idasembuwe, kandi anari wo munsi baatambiragaho umwana w’intaama wo Kunyurwaho, abiigiishwa baramubaza bati, "Mbese ni he ushaaka ko tugutungaanyiriza iby’ibirori byo Kunyurwaho?"
Atuma babiri mu biigiishwa be arabategeka ati, "Ni mugende mu tawuni, muri buhuure n’umugabo wiikoreye ikibindi c’amaazi, mumukurikire
mu nzu yo aribwinjiremo, mubwire nyirayo muti, ‘Umwigiisha aradutumye ngo utwereke igisenge c’abashitsi wateguuye aho ari busangirire ifunguro ry’ibirori byo Kunyurwaho n’abiigiishwa be.’
Na we aribubeereke igisenge kigari mu karinaabiri heejuru kirimo aho kwicara kandi giteguuwe neeza. Aho abe ariho mudutungaanyiriza."
Abo biigiishwa baragenda, binjira mu tawuni, basanga byose bimeze nk’uko yababwiye. Batangira kwiteguurira ifunguro ry’ibirori byo Kunyurwaho.
Bugoroobye, azana n’abiigiishwa be cumi na babiri.
Bamaze kwicara bari kurya, Yesu aravuga ati, "Ndababwira ukuri yuuko umwe muri mwe, uwo dusangira aribungambaanire."
Batangira kugira ishavu, maze baramubaza umwe umwe bati, "Ahaari yaaba ari njeewe?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Ni umwe muri mwe cumi na babiri, uwo turi buhuurize intoki mu sahaane.
Umwana w’Umuntu azaapfa nk’uko ibyanditswe bimuvugaho. Nyamara umugambaanira azaabona ishano! Icaakabaaye ciiza ni uko uwo muntu aba ataaravuutse."
Bakirya, Yesu afata umugaati, amaze kuwushiimira Imaana, arawumanyagura, awuha abiigiishwa be avuga ati, "Ni mwakiire murye, uyu ni umubiri wanje."
Afata n’igikopu, arangije kugishiimira Imaana arakibaha, banywaho boose.
Arababwira ati, "Aya ni amaraso yanje y’iseezerano risha, amenwe ku bwa benshi.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko ntazongera kunywa kuri iyi divaayi, kugeza ubwo nzanywera divaayi nsha mu bwami bw’Imaana."
Nuuko baririmba indirimbo zo guhimbaaza Imaana, baja ku musozi wa Elayoni .
Yesu arababwira ati, "Mwese muzansiga njenyine, nk’uko byanditswe ngo, ‘Nzaakubita umushumba, intaama zitaataane.’
Ariko niimara kuzuuka, nzaababanziriza i Galileeya."
Peetero aramubwira ati, "Naaho abandi baaguhunga, njeewe sinzaagusiga."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ndakubwiza ukuri yuuko muri iri joro, isaaki itaraabika kabiri, uri bube wanyiihakanye gatatu."
Ariko Peetero arushaho guhamya ati, "Naaho nagomba gupfaana naawe, ntaabwo nzaakwihakana na hato!" Nuuko n’abandi boose bavuga batyo.
Haanyuma baja ahantu hiitwa i Getsemaani. Bahageze abwira abiigiishwa be ati, "Ni mube mwicaye hano, ngiye gusenga."
Ajaana Peetero, na Yaakobo na Yohaana, atangira guhagarika umutima no gushavura.
Nuuko arababwira ati, "Umutima wanje ufite agahinda gasaaze, kenda kunyica. Ni mugume hano mube maaso."
Yiigira hirya gato, yuubama haasi, arasenga ngo niiba bishoboka, ico gihe c’umubabaro kimurenge.
Aravuga ati, "Daata, kuri wowe byose birashoboka, ntabaara unkize uyu mubabaro. Ariko bye kuba nk’uko mbishaaka, ahuubwo bibe uko ushaaka."
Agarutse asanga basinziiriye, abaza Peetero ati, "Simooni, urasinziiriye? Ntaabwo washobora kuba maaso niibura isaaha imwe?"
Nuuko arababwira ati, "Ni mube maaso kandi musenge kugira ngo mutagwa mu bishuko. Umutima urashaaka ariko umubiri ufite intege nke."
Yongera gusubirayo arasenga, asubira muri ya magambo.
Agarutse nabwo asanga abiigiishwa basinziiriye. Ibitotsi byari byabaganjije, maze babura ico kumusubiza.
Agarutse ubwa gatatu, arababwira ati, "Mbese muracasinziiriye, muraruhuutse? Birahaagije! Igihe kirageze, Umwana w’Umuntu agabijwe mu maboko y’abanyabyaha.
Ni muhaguruke tugende, dore ungambaanira arasohoye."

Yesu akivuga, umwe mu biigiishwa be wiitwaga Yuda abe araaje. Yari kumwe n’igiteero c’abantu biitwaje inkoota n’ubuhiri booherejwe n’umutware w’abaheerezabitambo, n’Abiigiishamategeko hamwe n’abakuru b’imiryango.
Umugambanyi yari yarababwiye akamenyeetso azaakoreesha ati, "Ni mubona uwo ndaramutsa nkamusoma araba ari we uwo, mumufate mumujaane ntaabacike."
Muri ako kaanya Yuda ahageze, aja aho Yesu ari aramuramutsa ati, "Mwigiisha!" Maze aramusoma.
Baramusingiira, baramufata.
Ariko umwe mu baari bahagaze aho akuurayo inkoota ayikubita umugaragu w’umutware w’abaheerezabitambo amuca ugutwi.
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Harya mwagombaga kuuza kumfata mwitwaje inkoota n’ubuhiri nk’aho nd’igisambo?
Buri munsi ko nahoraga ndi namwe mu nzu y’Imaana ndi kwigiisha, ntihagire ico muntwara? Ariko nyamara, reka ibyanditswe bisohore."
Nuuko abiigiishwa be boose baramuteererana, barahunga.
Haari umusore wambaye umwenda w’umweru akurikira Yesu, bagerageza kumufata,
ata wa mwenda yiiruka yambaye ubusa.
Bajaana Yesu imbere y’Umuheerezabitambo mukuru, aho abatware b’abaheerezabitambo, abakuru b’imiryango hamwe n’Abiigiishamategeko baari bateeraniye.
Peetero yari yaamukurikiye, bakarenga ahinguka, kugera mu gikaari c’Umuheerezabitambo mukuru, yiicara n’abarinzi baaho, boota umuriro.
Umutware w’abaheerezabitambo n’abandi boose baari mu rukiiko bashaakiisha ubujurizi bwahamya kugira ngo biice Yesu, ariko barabubura.
Haabonetse benshi bamushinja ibinyoma, ariko bakanyuranya.
Bamwe bahaguruka bamushinja ibinyoma bati,
"Twamwumviise avuga ati, ‘Nzaaseenya iyi nzu y’Imaana yubatswe n’amaboko y’abantu, maze mu minsi itatu nuubake iyindi ituubatswe n’amaboko.’ "
Ariko na bo ibirego byabo byari binyuranye.
Umuheerezabitambo mukuru ahagarara imbere yaabo abaza Yesu ati, "Koko nta co wiireguura? Nti wumvise ibyo bakurega?"
Ariko Yesu araceceka ntihaagira ico asubiza. Yongera kumubaza ati, "Harya ni wowe Kristo Umwana w’Imaana idahinyuka?"
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ndi we, kandi muzaabona Umwana w’Umuntu yiicaye iburyo bwa Nyir’ububaasha, muzaamubona aje mu bicu byo mu ijuru."
Umuheerezabitambo mukuru abyumviise, atandura imyambaro ye aravuga ati, "Turacashaakira iki abo kumushinja?
Mwiyumviye neeza ko asebya Imaana! Noone murabiteekerezaho iki?" Boose bamushinja urubanza ko, akwiriye kwicwa.
Bamwe batangira kumuciiraho, bamupfuka ku maaso bakamukubita bamubwira bati, "Ngaho hanuura utubwire ugukubise!" Abarinzi baaho na bo baramujaana bamukubita inshi.
Peetero yari yiicaye mu gikaari, haaza umuja w’Umuheerezabitambo mukuru.
Uwo muja aboonye Peetero yoota umuriro aramwitegereza aravuga ati, "Naawe wari hamwe na Yesu w’i Nazaareeti!"
Peetero aramuhakanira ati, "Ntaabwo nitegereza ibyo uvuga," arasohoka arigendera, ageze ku irembo isaaki irabika.
Wa muja yongera kumubona atangira kubwira abaari bahagaze aho bashungeera ati, "Uyu ni umwe muri bo!"
Peetero yongera guhakanira kure. Haciiyeho akaanya gato, abaari bahagaze aho bakomeza gushinja Peetero bati, "Reka kwihakana ko utari umwe muri bo kuko naawe uturuka i Galileeya."
Nuuko Peetero acurikiranya indahiro ati, "Ni ukuri uwo muntu muvuga siimuuzi!"
Muri ako kaanya, isaaki ibika ubwa kabiri. Peetero yiibuka ibyo Yesu yari yaamubwiye ati, "Isaaki itaraabika kabiri, uraba waanyihakanye gatatu." Ateerwa n’agahinda gasaaze ararira.
Kare mugitondo, abatware b’abaheerezabitambo baja inaama hamwe na bakuru b’imiryango n’Abiigiishamategeko, ndetse n’abagize inaama nkuru boose. Baboha Yesu, maze baramujaana bamushikiriza Pilaato.
Pilaato aramubaza ati, "Mbese uri umwami w’Abayuuda?" Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Urabyivugiye."
Abatware b’abaheerezabitambo bamurega byinshi.
Pilaato yongera kumubaza ati, "Ntaaco wasubiza? Ntiwumva ibyo bakurega byose?"
Ariko Yesu ntiyagira ico yongera gusubiza, maze Pilaato biramutangaaza.
Mu minsi mikuru y’ibirori byo Kunyurwaho, Pilaato yabarekuriraga umusibe uwo baabaga bamusabye.
Ico gihe haariho umugabo wiitwa Baraba wari warafunganywe n’abagambanyi b’igihugu bari baarakoze icaaha co kwica mu gihe c’impagarara.
Abantu benshi baraaza batangira gusaba Pilaato ngo abagenzereze nk’uko yabamenyeereje.
Nuuko arababaza ati, "Murashaaka ko mbarekurira umwami w’Abayuuda?"
Kuko yari azi neeza ko abatware b’abaheerezabitambo baamutanze ku bw’ishari.
Ariko abatware b’abaheerezabitambo boosha rubanda ngo ahuubwo basabe ko abarekurira Baraba.
Pilaato arongera arababaza ati, "Noone se murashaaka ko ngenza nte uyu mugabo wo mwise umwami w’Abayuuda?"
Bateera heejuru bavuga bati, "Mubambe!"
Pilaato arababaza ati, "Kuki, ikibi yakoze ni ikihe?" Maze barushaho guteera heejuru bati, "Mubambe!"
Nuuko Pilaato, ahitamo gushiimiisha abantu, maze abarekurira Baraba. Bamaze gukubita Yesu, aramutanga ngo baje kumubamba.
Nuuko abasirikare bamujaana mu gikaari c’ingoro y’umwami, maze bakoranya umutwe w’ingabo zoose zirateerana.
Bamwambika umwenda w’umuhengeri, bamaze kuboha ikamba ry’amahwa, barimwambika ku mutwe.
Batangira kumuramutsa bamunnyega bati, "Turakuramutsa mwami w’Abayuuda!"
Bamukubita urubingo mu mutwe, bamuciiraho, barapfukama baramuramya.
Bamaze kumushinyagurira, bamwambura wa mwenda w’umuhengeri maze bamwambika imyenda ye, bamujaana ku mubamba.
Abasirikare bakigenda bahuura na Simooni w’umunyakureeni watambuukaga avuuye mu caaro, bamuhata kwikorera umusaraba wa Yesu. Simooni yari se wa Alekizanda na Rufusi.
Nuuko bajaana Yesu ahantu hiitwa Gologota bisobaanura ku k’ibihanga.
Bamuha divaayi ivanze n’umuti wiitwa maya , ariko ntiyayinywa.
Nuuko baramubamba, maze bagabana imyenda ye, bakoreesheje ubufindo ngo bamenye ico buri umwe aribujaane.
Baamubambye isaaha itatu zo mugitondo.
Inyandiko y’ikirego yandikwa heejuru ye, ngo, "Umwami w’Abayuuda."
Maze bamubambana n’abambuzi babiri, umwe iburyo, undi ibumoso. [
Nuuko biba nk’uko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo "Yabazwe mu bagome."]
Abaanyuraga aho bakamutuka, bakazunguza imitwe bavuga bati, "Ahaa! Wowe waashobora guseenya Inzu y’Imaana maze ukayubaka mu minsi itatu,
ikize ubwawe, maze umanuke k’umusaraba!"
Abatware b’abaheerezabitambo, hamwe n’abanditsi na bo bakamushinyagurira bavuga bati, "Yakijije abandi, ariko yananiwe kwikiza.
Kristo, Umwami wa Isirayeli, manuka k’umusaraba noone aha, kugira ngo tureebe maze twemere." Ndetse n’abaari babambanywe na we na bo baramutuka.
Zibaaye saaha itandatu, isi yoose icura umwijima kugeza saaha icenda.
Isaaha icenda zigeze, Yesu ataka mu ijwi rirenga ati, "Eloyi, Eloyi, lama sabakitani?" Bisobaanura ngo, "Maana yanje, Maana yanje, n’iki gitumye unteererana?"
Bamwe mu baari bahagaze aho babyumviise, baravuga bati, "Murumva! Aratabaaza Eliya."
Nuuko umwe ariiruka, afata icangwe acuuzuza divaayi ishaariira, agihambiira ku rubingo, aramuheereza ngo anywe, avuga ati, "Reka tureebe ko Eliya yaza kumumanura ku musaraba."
Yesu ataka caane maze ahuumeeka uwanyuma.
Umwenda ukingiriza aheera ho mu nzu y’Imaana utandukamo kabiri, uheereye heejuru ukageza haasi.
Umutware w’abasirikare wari uhagaze imbere ye, aboonye uko apfuuye, aravuga ati, "Koko uyu mugabo yari Umwana w’Imaana."
Haari abagore baareeberaga kure, baarimo Mariya Magadaleena, na Mariya nyina wa Yaakobo muto, Yozesi na Salome.
Aba bagore baakurikiraga Yesu bakanamufasha akiri i Galileeya, kandi baari kumwe n’abandi bagore benshi bamuherekeje aja i Yerusaalemu.
Bugoroobye, ku munsi ubanziriza i Saabato anariwo munsi wo kwiteguura,
Yozefu w’i Arimatiya, umujaanaama w’icuubahiro w’urukiiko rw’Abayuuda, na we wari utegereje Ubwami bw’Imaana, aja kwa Pilaato ashirutse ubwoba asaba umurambo wa Yesu.
Maze Pilaato atangaazwa n’uko Yesu yaaba yaapfuuye, ahamagaza umutware w’abasirikare, amubaza niiba Yesu yapfuuye koko.
Amaze kubyemezwa, yeemerera Yozefu kujaana umurambo.
Nuuko Yozefu agura umwenda w’umweru, amaze kumanura umurambo, awupfunyika muri wa mwenda, awushira mu mva yari yaracukuwe mu rutare. Haanyuma ahirikira ibuye rinini ku muryango w’imva.
Mariya Magadaleena na Mariya nyina wa Yozesi babona aho umurambo uhambwe.
Isaabato irangiye, Mariya Magadaleena, Mariya nyina wa Yaakobo na Salome, bagura amavuta ahuumura neeza, ngo baje gusiiga umubiri wa Yesu.
Mu gitondo kare kare ku cumweru, baja ku mva bagerayo izuuba rirashe.
Baravuganaga bati, "Ni inde uribuduhirikire rya buye riri ku muryango w’imva?"
Biitegereje, babona rya buye ryari rinini caane ryahirikiwe iruhande.
Binjiye mu mva, babona umusore wiicaye iburyo, yambaye ikanzu yeera, maze bagira ubwoba.
Arababwira ati, "Mwigira ubwoba, murashaaka Yesu w’i Nazaareeti, wabambwe ku musaraba? Yaazuutse, ntaabwo ari hano. Ntimureeba aho baari bamushize!
Nimugende mubwire abiigiishwa be, na Peetero ko ari bubatange i Galileeya. Muzaamubona nk’uko yabibabwiye."

Bava mu mva bahunga, kuko ubwoba bwari bwabataashe, kandi ntihaagira uwo babibwira ku bwo gutiinya . [Kandi ibyo baategetswe babibwira abaari begeereye Peetero muri make. Nyuma yaaho, Yesu ubwe yaboohereje kwamamaza ibyera by’agakiza gahoraho iteeka uheereye iburasirazuuba ukageza iburengerazuuba. ] [
Ku cumweru mu gitondo, Yesu amaze kuzuuka, abanza kubonekera Mariya Magadaleena, wo yari yariirukanyemo abadayimooni barindwi.
Aja kubimenyeesha abaabaanaga na Yesu, bakiri mumaganya n’amarira.
Bamaze kumva ko ari muzima kandi ko yamuboonye, ntibaabyemera.
Haanyuma y’ibyo, abonekera abiigiishwa babiri afite irindi shusho, ubwo baagendaga baja mu caaro.
Maze basubirayo babibwira abandi, ariko ntibaabeemera.
Haanyuma yiiyereka ba cumi n’umwe ubwo baari ku meeza bafungura, maze abagayira kuteemera kwabo no kwinangira umutima, kuko baari banze kwemera abari baamuboonye amaze kuzuuka.
Arababwira ati, "Nimuje mu bihugu byose, mwamamaze Ubutumwa Bwiza ku bantu boose.
Uzeemera akabatizwa azaakira, naho utazeemera azaaciirwaho iteeka.
Kandi ibi bimenyeetso ni byo bizaaranga abiizeera; kwirukana abadayimooni mu izina ryanje, bazaavuga indimi nsha,
bazaafata inzoka mu ntoki zaabo, kandi nibagira ico banywa ciica, ntaaco bazaaba, bazaarambuura ibiganza ku barwayi, maze bakire."
Umwami Yesu amaze kuvugana na bo, ajanwa mu ijuru, nuuko yiicara iburyo bw’Imaana.
Abiigiishwa baja hoose baamamaza Ubutumwa Bwiza, naho Nyagasani aguma kubafasha no gutanga ibimenyeetso bigaragaza ibikorwa byabo .]

name: Lucas
chapters: Nyakuubahwa Tewofilo , Abantu benshi baagerageje kwandika ibyabaaye muri twe.
Banditse nk’uko twabibwiwe n’abaabyireebeye n’amaaso yaabo bigitangira kandi bakabyamamaza.
Nuuko reero nanje ubwanje maze kubibaririza neeza uko byagiiye, bimbeera byiza kubikwandikira uko byagiiye bikurikirana,
kugira ngo bigufashe kumenya neeza ukuri kw’ibyo wiigiishijwe byose.

Ku ngoma ya Herodi umwami w’i Buyuda, haariho Umuheerezabitambo witwaga Zaakariya. Yari akomooka mu muryango w’abaheerezabitambo wa Abiya. Umugore we yitwaga Elizaabeeti, akaba yari akomooka mu muryango wa Arooni, Umuheerezabitambo Mukuru.
Zaakariya na Elizaabeeti baari intungaane imbere y’Imaana kandi baakurikizaga amategeko n’amabwiriza y’Imaana.
Ntamwana baari bafite kuko Elizaabeeti yari ingumba kandi bombi baari bageze mu zaabukuru.
Umunsi umwe, umuryango w’abaheerezabitambo wa Zaakariya ni wo wari ugenewe gukora mu Nzu y’Imaana kandi Zaakariya ni we wari uramukiwe.
Ukurikije umugenzo w’abaheerezabitambo, ubufindo bufata Zaakariya maze atooranywa kuja mu Nzu y’Imaana kootsa ibihuumura neeza.
Mu gihe yabyotsaga, abantu benshi baari hanze basenga.
Nuuko malayika w’Uhoraho aramubonekera, ahagarara iburyo bw’igicaaniro c’ibihuumura neeza.
Zaakariya amuboonye ariikanga agira ubwoba,
ariko malayika aramubwira ati, "wiitiinya Zaakariya, kuko Imaana yumviise gusenga kwawe. Umugore waawe Elizaabeeti azaakubyarira umuhungu nuuko uzamwite Yohaana.
Azaakubeera umuneezeero n’ibyishiimo, ndetse benshi baziishiimira kuvuka kwe.
Azaaba umuntu ukomeye imbere y’Imaana. Ntaazanywa divaayi cangwa igisindiisha coose, kandi azuuzuzwa Umwuka Weera uheereye akiri mu nda ya nyina.
Azaayobora Abiisirayeli kugira ngo biihane ibyaha byabo bagarukire Imaana,

kandi azaagendera imbere y’Imaana mu Mwuka n’ububaasha nka Eliya. Azaahuuza imitima y’abaana n’ababyeyi, hamwe n’abatumvira Imaana, azaabayobora mu bwenge bwo kuyumvira, kugira ngo ateguure abantu maze batungaanire Imaana."
Zaakariya abaza malayika ati, "Ibyo naabyemera nte ko ndi umusaaza kandi n’umugore wanje akaba ari umukeecuru?"
Malayika aramusubiza ati, "Ninje malayika Gaburyeri uhora imbere y’Imaana, kandi natumwe kuvugana naawe ngo nkubwire ubwo butumwa bwiza.
Uheereye noone, ntuuribwongere kuvuga ku bwo gushidiikanya kwawe, kugeza umunsi ibyo nkubwiye bizaakubaho kuko amagambo yanje azaasohora mu gihe caayo."
Abantu baari bategereje Zaakariya, batangaazwa n’uko atinze mu Nzu y’Imaana.
Asohotse, ntiyashobora kuvugana na bo. Nuuko abantu bareebera ku bimenyeetso yakoreeshaga no guceceka kwe maze bateekereza ko agomba kuba yaboonye iyerekwa akiri mu Nzu y’Imaana.
Iminsi ya Zaakariya yo guheereza ibitambo ishize, asubira iwe.
Hashize igihe, umugore we Elizaabeeti asama inda, nuuko amara ameezi ataanu ataja ahagaragara. Aravuga ati,
"Mbeega ibyo Imaana yankoreye muri iyi minsi! Yarantabaaye, inkiza ibyankozaga isoni mu bantu."
Igihe Elizaabeeti yari afite inda y’ameezi atandatu, Imaana ituma malayika Gaburyeri mu tawuni y’i Galileeya yitwa Nazaareeti.
Imutuma ku mwari w’isugi wiitwa Mariya wari usabwe n’umugabo witwaga Yozefu wo mu muryango wa Dawudi.
Malayika abonekera Mariya aramubwira ati, "Ni amahoro uhiiriwe! Uhoraho ari kumwe naawe."
Mariya ariikanga, ahagarika umutima ku bw’iyo ndamutso ateekereza ico imenyeesha.
Malayika aramubwira ati, "Ntuugire ubwoba Mariya, kuko uhiiriwe ku Maana.
Dore uzaasama inda, ubyare umuhungu, uzamwite Yesu.
Azaaba ukomeye, kandi aziitwa Umwana w’Isumbabyose. Imaana izaamugira Umwami nka seekuruza Dawudi.
Azaaba Umwami mu nzu ya Isirayeli iteeka ryose, ndetse Ubwami bwe ntibuzaashira."
Mariya abaza uwo malayika ati, "Ibyo bizaabaho bite ko ntaamugabo mfite?"
Malayika aramusubiza ati, "Umwuka Weera azaakuuzaho, n’ububaasha bw’Isumbabyose bukubundikire mu gicuucu ce, ni co gituma umwana uzaavuuka azaaba Uweera, akiitwa Umwana w’Imaana.
Dore mwene waanyu Elizaabeeti na we afite inda y’umuhungu yo mu bukeecuru. Uwitwaga ingumba, ubu ni ukwezi kwe kwa gatandatu atwite,
kuko ari ntaajambo Imaana ivuga ngo rihere."
Mariya aramubwira ati, "Dore ndi umuja w’Imaana, byose bimbeho uko uvuze." Nuuko malayika amusiga aho aragenda.
Muri ico gihe, Mariya arahaguruka agenda yihuuta, aja mu tawuni yo mu gihugu c’imisozi y’i Yudeeya.
Mariya yinjira mu nzu ya Zaakariya, aramukanya na Elizaabeeti.
Mariya akimuramutsa, umwana wa Elizaabeeti yisimbiza mu nda. Maze Elizaabeeti yuzura Umwuka Weera,
avuga mu ijwi rirenga ati, "Mariya, mu bagore boose urahiirwa, n’umwana uzaabyara arahiirwa.
Mbese ni nje nde kubona nyina w’Umwami wanje ambaramiye?
Numviise indamutso yaawe, ako kaanya umwana asimbizwa mu nda yanje ku bw’umuneezeero mwinshi.
Kandi urahiirwa kuko wizeeye ibyo wabwiwe n’Uhoraho ko bizaabaho."
Maze Mariya aravuga ati, "Umutima wanje uhimbaaze Uhoraho,
kandi wishiimire Imaana Umukiza wanje,
kuko yitaaye ku kwiciisha bugufi ku muja we. Kuva ubu, ab’ibihe byose bazanyita uhiiriwe,
kuko Ushoborabyose yankoreye ibikomeye, izina rye ni iryera.
Imbabazi z’Uhoraho zihora ku bamwubaha, b’ibihe byose.
Imaana yakoreesheje ukuboko kwayo gukomeye, gutaatanya abiibone n’imigambi yaabo.
Yimuye abaami ku ngoma, ishira heejuru abiiciisha bugufi.
Imaana yahaagije ibyiza abafite inzara, ariko abakire yabaseezereye amaara masa.
Yatabaaye Isirayeli umugaragu waayo, kandi yibutse kugirira imbabazi
Aburahamu n’urubyaro rwe iteeka ryose, nk’uko yabwiye ba sogokuruza."
Nuuko Mariya aguma kwa Elizaabeeti kumara ameezi atatu, abona gutaaha.
Igihe ca Elizaabeeti co kubyara kigeze, abyara umwana w’umuhungu.
Abatuuranyi be na beene waabo bumva ko Nyagasani Imaana yamugiriye imbabazi nyinshi, abantu boose biishiimana na we.
Umwana amaze iminsi munaane avuutse, bamujaana gukebwa. Bashaaka kumwitirira izina rya se Zaakariya,
ariko nyina arababwira ati, "Oya, akwiriye kwitwa Yohaana."
Baramubwira bati, "Ko ari ntaawe wo mu muryango waanyu wiitwa iryo zina!"
Baciira se amarenga kugira ngo bamenye izina ryo ashaaka kumwita.
Asaba ico kwandikaho, arandika ati, "Izina rye ni Yohaana." Boose baratangaara.
Muri ako kaanya Zaakariya atangira kuvuga ashiima Imaana.
Abatuuranyi be bateerwa n’ubwoba, ibyo byose byamamara mu misozi yoose y’i Yudeeya.
Abaabyumviise barabizirikana, bariibaza bati, "Mbese uyu mwana azaaba iki?" Nuuko Imaana ikomeza kubaana n’uwo mwana.
Zaakariya se wa Yohaana, ayoborwa n’Umwuka Weera, arahanuura ati,
"Nyagasani ahimbaazwe, Imaana y’Abiisirayeli, kuko igendereye abantu baayo, kubacungura.
Kandi itwoherereje Umukiza ukomeye, kuva mu rubyaro rw’umugaragu waayo Dawudi.
Nk’uko Imaana yakoreesheje abahanuuzi baayo kuva keera, yaseezeranyije
yuuko izaadukiza abanzi n’amaboko y’abatwanga boose.
Yagiriye ba sogokuruza imbabazi, yibuka iseezerano ryayo ryera,
n’indahiro yarahiye sogokuruza Aburahamu
yuuko nitumara gukizwa amaboko y’abanzi baacu, tuzaayikorera tudatiinya,
turi abeera, dukiraanuka imbere yayo iminsi yoose yo kubaho kwacu.
Kandi naawe mwana wanje, uziitwa umuhanuuzi w’Imaana Isumbabyose. Uzaabanziriza Umukiza kugira ngo utungaanye inzira ze.
Uzaamenyeesha abantu yuuko inzira y’agakiza, ari ukubabarirwa ibyaha byabo.
Urukundo rw’Imaana n’imbabazi zaayo, bizaatuuzaho nk’uko izuuba ritumurikira umuseke utambitse,
ukamurikira abiicaye mu mwijima no mu gicuucu c’urupfu, no kuyobora ibirenge byacu mu nzira y’amahoro."
Uwo mwana arakura, agwiza ubutwari, aguma mu butaayu kugeza igihe yigaragarije mu Biisirayeli.
Muri ico gihe Umwami mukuru w’ubutegetsi bw' i Rooma witwaga Agusito, yatanze itegeko ryo kubara abantu boose bo mu butegetsi bwe bwose.
Iri ni ryo baruura ryabanje kubaho muri ubwo butegetsi bw’umwami Kureniyo yategekaga i Siriya.
Nuuko buri muntu aja kwiyandikiisha mu tawuni y’akomookamo.
Yozefu na we kuko yari akomooka mu muryango wa Dawudi, ava mu tawuni y’i Nazaareeti muri Galileeya, aja kwandikirwa i Beetelehemu muri Yudeeya itawuni ya Dawudi.
Ajaana na Mariya wo yari aseezeranyije baja kwiyandikiisha, kandi ico gihe Mariya yari atwite yegeereje igihe co kubyara.
Bakiri i Beetelehemu, igihe ce co kubyara kiragera.
Abyara umuhungu we w’imfura amufubika mu twenda, amuryamiisha mu muvure w’inka kuko ari ntamwanya bari baaboonye mu icumbi.
Iryo joro muri ako gace haarimo abashumba baaraariiraga amatungo yaabo bayarinda.
Malayika w’Imaana arababonekera, maze ubwiza bw’Imaana burabamurikira, burabagota, baheerako bagira ubwoba.
Malayika arababwira ati, "Nimuhuumure kuko mbaazaniye inkuru nziiza izaabeera abantu boose umuneezeero mwinshi.
Uyu munsi mu tawuni ya Dawudi, Umukiza yabavuukiye, ni we Kristo Umwami.
Iki ni co kiri bubabeere ikimenyeetso, murasanga umwana w’uruhinja afubitswe mu twenda, aryamiishijwe mu muvure w’inka."
Ako kaanya haboneka abaamalayika benshi bavuuye mu ijuru biifatanya na wa malayika, baririmba basingiza Imaana bati,
"Icuubahiro kibe ic’Imaana nyir’ijuru kandi amahoro mu isi abe mu bo yishiimira."
Nuuko abo baamalayika bamaze gusubira mu ijuru, abashumba baravugana bati, "Nimuuze tuje i Beetelehemu tureebe ibibaayeyo iby' Imaana itumenyesheje."
Bagenda biihuuta, bageze i Beetelehemu basangayo Mariya na Yozefu, n’umwana w’uruhinja aryamiishijwe mu muvure.
Bamuboonye batangira kwamamaza ibyabaaye hamwe n’ibyo malayika yari yaavuze kuri uwo mwana.
Abaabyumviise boose batangaazwa n’ibyo baabwiwe n’abo bashumba.
Ariko ayo magambo Mariya ayagira ibanga aja ayazirikana.
Abo bashumba basubira mu matungo yaabo, baririmba kandi bahimbaaza Imaana ku bw’ibyo baari bumviise kandi baaboonye byose, nk’uko baari baabibwiwe na malayika.
Ku munsi wa munaane ari co gihe co gukebwa, bamwita Yesu. Iryo ni ryo zina ryari ryaravuzwe na malayika, nyina wa Yesu ataraasama inda.
Nuuko iminsi yo kwezwa ishize, nk’uko umuhango wari uri ukurikije amategeko ya Moose, Yozefu na Mariya bajaana Yesu i Yerusaalemu kumumurikira Imaana.
Nk’uko byanditswe mu mategeko y’Uhoraho ngo, "Umuhungu weese w’imfura akwiriye kumurikirwa Imaana."
Nuuko baja no gutuura igitambo nk’uko byavuzwe mu mategeko ya Nyagasani ngo, "Inuma ebyiri cangwa inyoni ebyiri zisa n’inuma."

Muri ico gihe, haariho umugabo witwaga Simiyooni. Uwo yari atuuye i Yerusaalemu kandi yari intungaane, yitonda, atiinya Imaana. Yahoraga ategereje uzaazanira Abiisirayeli agakiza, kandi Umwuka Weera yari muri we.
Yari yarahishuuriwe n’Umwuka Weera ko atazaapfa ataraabona Kristo w’Imaana.
Uwo munsi, ayoborwa n’Umwuka Weera aja mu Nzu y’Imaana i Yerusaalemu. Maze Mariya na Yozefu baaje kumurikira Imaana uwo mwana, nk’uko umuhango w’amategeko wari uri,
basangayo Simiyooni. Simiyooni aboonye uwo mwana aramukiikira, maze ashiima Imaana ati,
"Mwami Maana, nooneho umugaragu waawe yigendere amahoro nk’uko wabivuze.
Kuko amaaso yanje aboonye agakiza kaawe,
ako wateguuriye abantu boose kuba
umuco uzaahishuurira Imaana abanyamahanga. Kandi ari ko gakiza kazaazana icuubahiro ku bwoko bwawe Isirayeli."
Maze ababyeyi be batangaazwa n’amagambo Simiyooni avuze kuri uwo mwana.

Nuuko Simiyooni abasabira umugisha kandi abwira Mariya ati, "Uyu mwana yaratooranyijwe kugira ngo bamwe mu Biisirayeli bagwe, abandi babyuke kandi azaaba ikimenyeetso kivuuye ku Maana co benshi bazaagiraho impaka.
Maze ibyo abantu bateekereza mu mitima yaabo bizaahishuurwa kandi naawe uzaagira agahinda kenshi, kagukuure umutima."
Haariho n’umuhanuuzikazi witwaga Anna umukoobwa wa Fanuweli wo mu muryango wa Asheeli. Yamaranye n’umugabo we imyaka irindwi gusa arapfaakara
kugeza ku myaka mirongo inaane n’enye. Yahoraga mu Nzu y’Imaana, asenga ku manywa na nijoro yiyiriza ubusa.
Muri ako kaanya arabeegeera maze ashiima Imaana avuga ku by’uwo mwana amwamamaza mu bantu boose baari bategereje gucungurwa kw’i Yerusaalemu kuvuuye ku Maana.
Nuuko Yozefu na Mariya bamaze kurangiza byose nk’uko itegeko ry’Uhoraho ryari riri, basubira i Galileeya mu tawuni y’iwaabo yitwa Nazaareeti.
Maze uwo mwana akurirayo, agwiza imbaraga n’ubwenge kandi ubuntu bw’Imaana bwari kuri we.
Buri mwaka ababyeyi ba Yesu baajaga kwizihiza iminsi mikuru yo Kunyurwaho i Yerusaalemu.
Nuuko Yesu amaze imyaka cumi n’ibiri y’ubukuru, bazaamuukana na we baja kwizihiza iyo minsi mikuru nk’uko umugenzo waabo wari uri.
Iyo minsi irangiye, ababyeyi be basubira iwaabo. Maze Yesu we asigara i Yerusaalemu ababyeyi be batabiizi.
Baateekereje ko yaaba yaajaanye n’abandi bantu, nuuko bakomeza kugenda urugendo rw’umunsi woose. Bamushaakira mu bavandimwe no mu nshuti.
Bamubuze, basubira i Yerusaalemu kumushaakirayo.
Hashize iminsi itatu, bamubona mu Nzu y’Imaana yicaranye n’abiigiishamategeko abateze amatwi kandi ababaza ibibazo.
Abamwumvaga boose baatangaariraga ubwenge bwe no gusubiza kwe.
Se na nyina bamuboonye baratangaara, maze nyina aramubaza ati, "Mwana wanje, ni iki caatumye utugenza utya? Nje na so twagushaatse duhagaritse umutima turakubura."
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Mwanshaakiraga iki? Ntimwari muuzi ko nkwiriye kuba mu nzu ya Daata?"
Ariko ntibaasobaanukirwa ico Yesu yamenyeeshaga.
Nuuko Yesu amanukana na bo aja i Nazaareeti, agahora abumvira. Ariko ibyo byose nyina abigira ibanga kandi agahora abiteekerezaho.
Yesu akomeza kugwiza ubwenge, akura ashimwa n’Imaana n’abantu.

Mu mwaka wa cumi n’itaanu ubwo Tibeeriyo yari umwami mukuru wategekaga Rooma, Imaana yahaaye Yohaana mwene Zaakariya ubutumwa ari mu butaayu. Ico gihe Pontiyo Pilaato yari umutegetsi w’i Yudeeya, naho Herodi ari umutegetsi w’i Galileeya. Mwene se Filipo yari umutegetsi wa Itureya n’i Turakonite, Lusaniya yari umutegetsi w’Abileeni,
naho Anaasi na Kayafa baari Abaheerezabitambo bakuru.
Nuuko Yohaana agenda ava mu mwanya aja mu wundi ku mpande zoose z’uruuzi rwa Yorodaani, abwiriza abantu ko bakwiriye kwihana, bakabatizwa kugira ngo bababarirwe ibyaha byabo.
Nk’uko byanditswe mu gitabo c’umuhanuuzi Yesaaya ati, "Nimwumve uwo urangururira mu butaayu ati, ‘Nimutungaanye inzira y’Uhoraho, mugorore aho azanyura.
Imibande yoose izuuzuzwa, ibirunga n’imisozi bizaaringanizwa. Ibigoramye bizaagororoka, inzira zidaharuwe zizaaharurwa.
Kandi abantu boose bazaabona agakiza k’Imaana.’ "
Abantu benshi baaza kuri Yohaana kugira ngo ababatize, maze arababwira ati, "Mwa rubyaro rw’inzoka mwe! Ni nde wabagiiriye inaama yo guhunga uburaakari bw’Imaana bwegeereje?

Kwihana kwanyu kwerekanirwe mu byo muteekereza no mu byo mukora nk’uko Imaana ibishaaka. Mureke gukomeza kwibwira ko ubwo mukomooka kuri Aburahamu, ngo ahaari Imaana ntiyabahanira ibyaha byanyu. Ndababwira yuuko Imaana ibaasha guhindura aya mabuye abaana ba Aburahamu.
Kandi n’ubu intoorezo igezwe ku biti. Nk’uko bayimanikiira gutema igiti, ni ko igiiye kumanukira abanyabyaha. Bityo reero, igiti coose kiteera imbuto nziiza gikwiriye gutemwa kikajugunywa mu muriro."
Abantu baramubaza bati, "Noone se tugire dute?"
Yohaana arabasubiza ati, "Ufite imyenda ebyiri, umwe awuhe utawufite, n’ufite ibyokurya, na we akore atyo."
Abasoreesha na bo baaje ngo babatizwe, baramubaza bati, "Mwigiisha, tugire dute?"
Arabasubiza ati, "Ntimugasoreeshe abantu ibiruta ibyo mwategetswe."
Abasirikare na bo baramubaza bati, "Twebwe tugire dute?" Arabasubiza ati, "Ntimukagire umuntu uwo mutugiisha cangwa ngo mumurege ibinyoma, ahuubwo ibihembo byanyu bibanyure."
Nuuko abo bantu bagira ibyiringiro, biibwira ko ahaari Yohaana yaba ari we Kristo.

Maze Yohaana arababwira ati, "Ni koko njeewe ndabatiriisha amaazi, ariko hazaaza undusha ububaasha, ndetse ntibinkwiriye ko naapfunduura udushumi tw’ingato ze. Uwo ni we uzaababatiriisha Umwuka Weera n’umuriro.
Intaara ye iri mu kuboko kwe, kandi azaazambuura imbuga ye caane, amasaka ayahunike mu kigega, naho umurama azaawucaaniisha umuriro utazima."
Yohaana akomeza kubwiriza abantu Ubutumwa Bwiza, kandi abashiishikariza guhindura imibeereho yaabo.
Muri ico gihe, Yohaana acaaha umwami Herodi ku bwo gucuura Herodiyaasi muka mwene se, no ku bw’ibindi byaha yari yarakoze.
Maze Herodi akora ikindi caaha, afata Yohaana amushira mu gihome.
Yohaana ataraashirwa mu nzu y’imbohe, yabatije Yesu n’abandi bantu benshi. Yesu amaze kubatizwa, arasenga, agisenga, ijuru rirakinguuka,
maze Umwuka Weera ava mu ijuru aramumanukira ari mu ishusho isa n’inuma. Maze ijwi ry’Imaana rivugira mu ijuru riti, "Ni wowe Mwana wanje nkunda nkakwishiimira."
Ubwo Yesu yatangiraga kwigiisha, yari amaze imyaka nka mirongo itatu avuutse. Nk’uko abantu biibwiraga ko ari we mwene Yozefu, mwene Heeli,
mwene Matati, mwene Leevi, mwene Meluki, mwene Yonaayi, mwene Yozefu,
mwene Matatiya, mwene Amosi, mwene Nahumu, mwene Esili, mwene Nagayi,
mwene Mati, mwene Matatiya, mwene Semeyini, mwene Yoseki, mwene Yoda,
mwene Yonani, mwene Resa, mwene Zerubabeeli, mwene Shayalutiyeeli, mwene Neeri,
mwene Meluki, mwene Adi, mwene Kosamu, mwene Elumadamu, mwene Eri,
mwene Yosuwa, mwene Eliyezeeri, mwene Yorimu, mwene Matati, mwene Leevi,
mwene Simiyooni, mwene Yuda, mwene Yozefu, mwene Yonamu, mwene Eliyakimu,
mwene Meleya, mwene Mena, mwene Matata, mwene Natani, mwene Dawudi,
mwene Yese, mwene Obedi, mwene Bowazi, mwene Solomooni, mwene Nahashoni,
mwene Amiinadabu, mwene Aruni, mwene Hesirooni, mwene Peresi, mwene Yuda,
mwene Yaakobo, mwene Isaaka, mwene Aburahamu, mwene Tera, mwene Nahori,
mwene Serugi, mwene Rewu, mwene Pelegi, mwene Heberi, mwene Shela,
mwene Kenani, mwene Alupakisadi, mwene Shemu, mwene Nowa, mwene Lameki,
mwene Metuseera, mwene Henoki, mwene Yeredi, mwene Mahalaleeli, mwene Kenani,
mwene Enoshi, mwene Seeti, mwene Adamu, ukomooka ku Maana.
Yesu amaze kubatizwa, yuzura Umwuka Weera. Nuuko ava ku ruuzi rwitwa Yorodaani, Umwuka amujaana mu butaayu,
amarayo iminsi mirongo ine ageragezwa na Sataani. Iyo minsi yayimaze atarya, nuuko ishize arasonza caane.
Nuuko umwanzi Sataani aramubwira ati, "Niiba koko uri Umwana w’Imaana tegeka iri buye umutsima."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, ‘Umuntu ntaabeeshwaho n’umutsima gusa.’ "
Nyuma y’aho umwanzi amujaana ku musozi mureemure caane, mu kaanya gato, amwereka ubwami bwose bw’iyi si.
Aramubwira ati, "Ubu butware bwose n’icuubahiro byose ndabiguha, kuko nabihaawe kandi mbiha uwo niishaakiye.
Nuuko nuupfukama ukandamya, byose biraba ibyawe."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ibyanditswe biravuga ngo, ‘Uramye Uhoraho Imaana yaawe abe ari yo ukorera yoonyine.’ "
Umwanzi arongera amujaana i Yerusaalemu, amuhagarika ku munaara w’Inzu y’Imaana aramubwira ati, "Niiba koko uri umwana w’Imaana, simbukira haasi,
kuko byanditswe ngo: ‘Imaana izaagutegekera abaamalayika baayo bakurinde,
kandi bazaagutegera amaboko ngo udakubita ikirenge caawe ku ibuye.’ "
Maze Yesu aramubwira ati, "Kandi byanditswe ngo, ‘Ntuukagerageze Uhoraho Imaana yaawe.’ "
Nuuko Sataani arangije kumugerageza muri byose, aramureka ngo azaamutege ikindi gihe.
Nyuma y’aho Yesu asubira i Galileeya aho yakuriye, ayobowe n’Umwuka w’Imaana. Nuuko amenyekana muri ibyo bice byose,
kandi akomeza kugenda yigiisha mu masinagoogi yaabo yoose. Abamwumviise boose baramuhimbaaza kandi baramushiima.
Nuuko Yesu aja i Nazaareeti aho yakuriye. Nk’uko yari amenyereye, ku munsi w’i Saabato aja mu isinagoogi. Arahaguruka ngo asome ijambo ry’Imaana.
Bamuhereza umuzingo w’ibyanditswe n’umuhanuuzi Yesaaya, arambuura ahanditswe ngo,
"Umwuka w’Imaana ari kuri nje kuko yantooranyirije kwamamaza Inkuru Nziiza mu bakene. Yantumye kumenyeesha imbohe ko zibohoorwa, n’impumyi ko zihumuuka, kandi no kubohooza abarengana.
No kumenyeesha abantu igihe Imaana igiriyemo imbabazi."
Arangije, azinga igitabo maze arakibasubiza, ariicara. Abantu boose mu isinagoogi bamuhanga amaaso.
Nuuko atangira kwigiisha ababwira ati, "Uyu munsi ibi byanditswe mbasomeye birasohoye kandi murabyiyumviye."
Abaari aho boose batangaazwa kandi bashimiishwa n’amagambo meeza y’ubuntu avuuye mu kanwa ke. Barabazanya bati, "Ariko uyu si mwene Yozefu?"
Na we arababwira ati, "Nzi neeza ko mwanshiraho uyu mugani muti, ‘Muvuuzi banza wivuure,’ Ibitangaaza twumviise ko wakoreye i Kaperenawumu ngaaho bikorere na hano iwaanyu."
Yesu arongera arababwira ati, "Ndababwira ukuri yuuko ari ntaamuhanuuzi ugira icuubahiro iwaabo.

Nimunyumve, mu gihe c’umuhanuuzi Eliya haariho abapfaakazi benshi mu gihugu ca Isirayeli, nuuko ijuru rirakingwa, imvura imara imyaka itatu n’ameezi atandatu itagwa, bituma haba inzara nyinshi mu gihugu.
Ariko Imaana ntiyohereje umuhanuuzi Eliya kuja kuri umwe mu bapfaakazi bo muri Isirayeli, uretse yamubwiye kuja ku mupfaakazi w’i Zarefaati haafi y’itawuni y’i Sidoni.
Kandi mu gihugu c’Isirayeli haarimo ababembe benshi, mu gihe c’umuhanuuzi Elisa. Ariko Imaana ntiyakijije n’umwe muri bo uretse umubembe umwe gusa ari we Namani umunyamahanga w’i Siriya."
Abantu boose mu isinagoogi bamaze kumva ayo magambo, bagira uburaakari bwinshi.
Bahagurutswa no guhata Yesu ngo bamwirukane mu tawuni yaabo. Baramukurubana ngo bamutembagaze ku manga y’umusozi aho itawuni yaabo yari iri.
Ariko Yesu abacamo, arigendera.
Nuuko Yesu aramanuka aja i Kaperenawumu, indi tawuni y’i Galileeya. Ku Isaabato atangira kwigiisha abantu ijambo ry’Imaana.
Maze abantu batangaarira kwigiisha kwe, kuko yavuganye ubutware n’ububaasha.
Mu isinagoogi haarimo umugabo wari uteewe na dayimooni, ateera heejuru ati,
"Ayii wee! Yesu w’i Nazaareeti, udushaakaho iki? Uzanywe no kuturimbura? Nzi ko uri Uweera w’Imaana."
Maze Yesu ategeka dayimooni ati, "Ceceka! Muvemo!" Nuuko dayimooni imukubita haasi imbere ya boose, ariko ntiyashobora kumukomeretsa.
Abantu boose birabatangaaza barabazanya bati, "Ni bushobozi ki, n’ubutware biri mu magambo ye, bituma ategeka abadayimooni bakava mu bantu bakamwumvira?"
Maze iyo nkuru yamamazwa hoose mu matawuni hamwe n’impande z’ako gace.
Yesu amaze kuva mu isinagoogi aja kwa Simooni. Agezeyo asanga nyirabukwe wa Simooni arwaye, afite umushwiza mwinshi. Maze abantu bamusaba kumukiza.
Yesu aramusanga, aramwegeera, ategeka umushwiza kumuvamo. Ako kaanya umuvamo, arakira. Na we arahaguruka maze arabafungurira.
Kuri uwo mugorooba izuuba rirenze, abantu boose bafite abarwayi barwaye indwara z’uburyo bwinshi babaazanira Yesu, abarambikaho ibiganza, umwe umwe arabakiza.
Nuuko abantu benshi baari bateewe n’abadayimooni, babavamo bateera heejuru bati, "Uri Umwana w’Imaana!" Ariko Yesu arabakabukira, ababuza kuvuga kuko baari baazi ko ari we Kristo.
Bukeeye mu gitondo, Yesu aja ahantu kwihereera, nuuko abantu benshi baaza kumushaaka. Bamuboonye, bagerageza kumubuza ngo ye kubasigaho.
Ariko Yesu arababwira ati, "Nkwiriye kubwiriza Ubutumwa Bwiza bw’Ubwami bw’Imaana no mu zindi tawuni kuko ico ari co canzanye."
Nuuko Yesu akomeza kugenda hoose, avuga ubutumwa mu masinagoogi yoose y’i Yudeeya.
Umunsi umwe, Yesu yigiishirizaga iruhande rw’ingezi yitwa Genezareeti. Abantu benshi bamubyiganiraho bashaaka kumva ijambo ry’Imaana.
Maze Yesu abona amaato abiri yo abarobyi baari baaziritse ku nkengeero y’ingezi, kuko boozaga ubutimba bwabo.
Yesu yinjira mu bwato bumwe muri ayo, bwari ubwa Simooni. Amusaba kubusunika ngo bwigire imbere mu maazi. Abwicaramo, maze yigiisha abantu.
Arangije kuvuga, abwira Simooni ati, "Igiza ubwato imbere mu maazi mareemare maze ujugunye ubutimba ufate isamaaki."
Simooni aramusubiza ati, "Daatabuja twakeesheje ijoro ryose dusoha nyamara ntaaco twafashe. Ariko kuko ubivuze ndasubira kubuteereramo."
Babikoze, bafata isamaaki nyinshi caane ubutimba buruuzura butangira guciika.
Batabaaza bagenzi baabo baari mu bundi bwato, maze amaato yombi yuzura isamaaki yenda kurengerwa.
Nuuko Simooni Peetero aboonye ibibaaye, apfukama imbere ya Yesu aravuga ati, "Nyagasani, va aho ndi, kuko ndi umunyabyaha, sinkwiriye kukwegeera."
Ibi yabivuze kuko yari atangaajwe n’ubwinshi bw’isamaaki, zo we na bagenzi be baari baafashe.
Bagenzi be ari bo Yaakobo na Yohaana beene Zebedaayo na bo birabatangaaza. Yesu abwira Simooni ati, "wiitiinya, uheereye noone, uzaaja uroba abantu."
Bamaze kugeza amaato yaabo ku nkengeero, basiga byose bakurikira Yesu.
Igihe kimwe, Yesu ari mu tawuni, haaza umugabo wari urembejwe n’ibibembe. Aboonye Yesu, apfukama imbere ye aramwinginga ngo amukize. Aramubwira ati "Nyagasani, ubishaatse wanyeza ngakira."
Yesu aramwegeera maze amukoraho, aravuga ati, "Ndabishaaka kira." Muri ako kaanya bya bibembe birakira.

Yesu amutegeka kutagira uwo abibwira. Arongera aramubwira ati, "Genda, wiyereke umuheerezabitambo kugira ngo agusuuzume maze utange n’igitambo nk’uko biri mu mategeko ya Moose ku bahumaanutse, bibabeere ubuhamya yuuko wakize."
Nyamara inkuru ya Yesu irushaho kwamamara hoose, maze abantu benshi baazanwa no kumwumva hamwe no gukizwa indwara zaabo.
Ariko Yesu we, yabavagamo akaja kwihereera mu butaayu gusenga.

Umunsi umwe Yesu ari kwigiisha, Abafarisaayo n’abiigiishamategeko baturutse impande zoose z’i Galileeya, i Yudeeya hamwe n’i Yerusaalemu biicara muri rubanda nyamwinshi bumviriza. Kandi ububaasha bw’Imaana bwo gukiza bwari kuri we.
Nuuko haaza abagabo baheetse umurema mu ngobyi, bashaaka uburyo baamushikiriza Yesu,
ariko ntibabishobora kuko abantu baari benshi caane. Nuuko babuze uburyo bamwinjiza, buurira inzu basambuuraho amatebura make, bamwururutsa mu ngobyi bamushira hagati y’abantu imbere ya Yesu.
Aboonye kwizeera kwabo kwinshi, abwira uwo murema ati, "Nshuti yanje ibyaha byawe urabibabariwe."
Abafarisaayo n’abiigiishamategeko batangira kubazanya bati, "Uyu ni nde wigereranya n’Imaana? Imaana yoonyine si yo ishobora kubabarira ibyaha?"
Yesu amenye ibiteekerezo byabo arababaza ati, "Kuki muteekereza mutyo?
Mbese icooroshe ni ikiihe? Ni ukuvuga ngo ibyaha byawe urabibabariwe, cangwa ngo haguruka ugende?
Ariko ndababwira yuuko Umwana w’Umuntu afite ububaasha bwo kubabarira ibyaha kuri iyi si." Yesu abwira uwo murema ati, "Haguruka, wikorere ingobyi yaawe ugende."
Ako kaanya uwo mugabo arabaduka afata ingobyi ye boose babireeba, asubira iwe ahimbaaza Imaana.
Boose baratangaara, bahimbaaza Imaana kandi bagira ubwoba baravuga bati, "Uyu munsi tuboonye ibitangaaje!"
Nyuma y’ibyo, Yesu abona umusoreesha witwaga Leevi yiicaye aho yakoreraga. Yesu aramubwira ati, "Nkurikira."
Leevi arahaguruka asiga ibye byose aramukurikira.
Nuuko Leevi atumira Yesu amujaana iwe, habayo ibirori. Bamwe mu bashitsi baasangiraga na we baari abasoreesha n’abandi bantu.
Ariko Abafarisaayo n’abiigiishamategeko baabo, bagiisha impaka abiigiishwa ba Yesu bati, "Ni kuki musangira n’abasoreesha hamwe n’abanyabyaha?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Abazima si bo biifuuza umuvuuzi ahuubwo abarwayi ni bo bamukeneye.
Sinaaje mu isi guhamagara intungaane, ahuubwo naaziye abanyabyaha ngo biihane."
Abantu baramubwira bati, "Abiigiishwa ba Yohaana Umubatiza biiyiriza ubusa, bagasenga kandi n’abiigiishwa b’Abafarisaayo na bo ni uko. Ni kuki abiigiishwa baawe bo, bakomeza kwiriira no kwinywera?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Mbese abashitsi baakwiyiriza ubusa bakiri kumwe n’umukwe biishiima?
Ariko igihe umukwe azaabakuurwaho, ni bwo baziiyiriza ubusa."

Maze Yesu abaciira umugani ati, "Ntaamuntu ushobora gutandura ikiremu ku mwenda musha ngo agiteere ku mwenda ushaaje. Uwakora atyo, yaba yangirije umwenda musha, kandi umwenda ushaaje na wo yatuma uciika naabi bikabije. Nuuko reero ikiremu gisha nticaahwana n’umwenda ushaaje.
Kandi ntaawe ushobora gusuka divaayi nsha mu mifuka y’impu ishaaje. Uwakora atyo, divaayi nsha yaaturitsa iyo mifuka y’impu maze divaayi igasandaara haasi, n’iyo mifuka y’impu ikonoonekara.
Ahuubwo divaayi nsha isukwa mu mifuka y’impu misha.
Kandi ntaawakwifuuza kunywa divaayi nsha amaze kunywa divaayi ikuze, ahuubwo yavuga ati, ‘Ikuze ni yo nziiza caane.’ "
Igihe kimwe, Yesu n’abiigiishwa be banyura mu mirima irimo imyaka y’impeke ku munsi w’i Isaabato. Abiigiishwa be baca amahundo bayavungira mu ntoki barayakenya.
Abafarisaayo baari aho barababaza bati, "Kuki mukora ico amategeko yaacu ateemera ku munsi w’Isaabato?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Mbese ntimwari mwasoma ibyo Dawudi n’abantu baari kumwe na we baakoze ubwo baari bashonje?
Yagiiye mu Nzu y’Imaana, ashikiira umugaati wejejwe, arawurya, ahaho n’abaari kumwe na we, kandi wari ugenewe abaheerezabitambo."
Yesu arongera arababwira ati, "Umwana w’Umuntu, n’Umwami w’Isaabato."
Nuuko ku yindi Saabato, Yesu aja mu isinagoogi ariigiisha. Muri iryo teeraniro haarimo umugabo unyunyutse ukuboko kw’iburyo.
Abiigiishamategeko n’Abafarisaayo bakomeza kureebuuza Yesu ngo bareebe niiba ari bumukize ku munsi w’Isaabato maze babone uburyo bamurega.
Ariko Yesu amenya ibiteekerezo byabo, abwira uwari unyunyutse ukuboko ati, "Haguruka, uhagarare aho boose bakureeba." Uwari unyunyutse ukuboko arahaguruka abigenza atyo.
Nuuko Yesu abwira Abafarisaayo n’abiigiishamategeko ati, "Reka mbabaze, mbese amategeko atwemerera gukora iki ku Saabato? Neeza, cangwa naabi, kwica cangwa gukiza?"
Yesu arabareeba maze abwira uwari urwaye ati, "Rambuura ukuboko kwawe." Nuuko arakurambuura kurakira.
Babiboonye buuzura uburaakari bwinshi, batangira kuja imigambi y’uko bazaamugenza.
Haanyuma y’ibyo, Yesu aja ku musozi gusenga, akeesha ijoro ryose asenga Imaana.
Bukeeye, ahamagara abiigiishwa be atooranyamo cumi na babiri, abagira intumwa.
Amazina yaabo, ni Simooni wo yiise Peetero, na Andereya mwenenyina, na Yaakobo, na Yohaana, na Filipo, na Batulumaayo,
na Matayo na Tomasi na Yaakobo mwene Alufaayo, na Simooni witwaga Umurwanashaka,
na Yuda mwene Yaakobo, na Yuda Isikariyoti wamugambaaniye.

Nuuko Yesu n’abiigiishwa be bamanuka umusozi, ahagarara aharinganiye ari kumwe n’abayoboke be n’abandi bantu benshi baari baturutse i Yudeeya n’i Yerusaalemu hoose, no mu bice by’i tawuni y’i Tiiro n’i Sidoni bihereeranye n’inyanja nini.
Abo bantu benshi baari baaje kumwumva no gukizwa indwara. Abaari bateewe n’imyuka mibi, na bo barakira.
Abantu boose baashaakaga kumukoraho kuko imbaraga zaamuvagamo zikabakiza. Yari afite ububaasha bwo gukiza buri weese.
Nuuko Yesu arakebuka areeba abiigiishwa be arababwira ati, "Murahiirwa mwebwe abakene, kuko Ubwami bw’Imaana ari ubwanyu.
Murahiirwa mwebwe abashonje ubu kuko muzaahaazwa. Murahiirwa mwebwe abarira ubu kuko muzaaseka.
Murahiirwa abantu niibabanga, bakabahinyura, bakabatuka, bakabavuga naabi babahoora kuba abayoboke b’Umwana w’Umuntu.
Bazaabakorera naabi nk’uko baaseekuruza baabo baagenjeje abahanuuzi. Ico gihe muziishiime kandi muneezeerwe kuko ingororano zaanyu ari nyinshi mu ijuru.
Muzaabona ishano mwebwe abakire, kuko mumaze kudamarara.
Muzaabona ishano mwebwe abahaaze ubu, kuko muzaasonza. Muzaabona ishano mwebwe abaseka ubu kuko muzaaganya muborooga.
Muzaabona ishano ubwo abantu bazaabavuga neeza, uko ni ko baaseekuruza baabo baavuze ibyiza ku bahanuuzi b’ibinyoma."
"Ndababwira mwese abaanyumva, mukunde abanzi baanyu, mugirire neeza ababanga,
musabire umugisha ababavuma, musengere ababarenganya.
Nihagira ugukubita ku musaya, umuhindurire n’undi. Nihagira ukwambura ikooti, ntuuzamwime n’isaati yaawe.
Ugusabye weese umuhe, ukwambuye ibyawe ubimurekere.
Kandi uko mushaaka ko abantu babagirira, abe ari ko namwe mubagirira.
Ntimuuzi yuuko abanyabyaha na bo bakunda ababakunda, noone se muzaashiimirwa iki nimukunda ababakunda gusa?
Nimwituura ineeza abayibagirira gusa muzaashiimirwa iki? Abanyabyaha bo ntibagirira ineeza abayibagirira?
Nimuguza abo muteekereza ko bazaabiishura muzaashiimirwa iki? Abanyabyaha bo ntibaguza abandi biizeeye ko bazaabiishura?
Ahuubwo mukunde abanzi baanyu, mubagirire neeza, muguze abantu mudateekereza ko bazaabiishura, ni ho ingororano zaanyu zizaaba nyinshi. Muziitwa abaana b’Imaana, kuko igirira neeza ababi n’abeeza."
"Mugirire abandi impuhwe nk’uko So na we ari umunyampuhwe.
Ntimugaciire abandi imanza kugira ngo namwe Imaana itazaabaciira urubanza. Ntimugashinje abandi, kugira ngo namwe itazaabashinja. Mubabarire bagenzi baanyu, namwe Imaana izaabababarira.
Mutange namwe muzaahaabwa. Urugero rwiza rutsindagiye, rucugushije kandi ruseesekaye ni rwo muzaagererwamo namwe. Urugero mugeramo ni rwo namwe muzaagererwamo."
Yesu abaciira umugani ati, "Mbese impumyi yabaasha kurandata indi mpumyi? Bombi ntibaagwa mu rwobo?
Umwigiishwa ntaaruta umwigiisha, ahuubwo umwigiishwa weese wiigiishijwe neeza, azaamera nk’umwigiisha we.
Ni iki gituma ureeba agatotsi kari mu ijiisho rya mugenzi waawe ariko ukiirengagiza umugogo uri mu ijiisho ryawe?

Wabaasha ute kubwira mugenzi waawe uti, ‘Mwene daata, reka ngutokoore agatotsi kari mu ijiisho ryawe?’ Kandi naawe ubwawe utaareeba umugogo uri mu ryawe? Wa ndyarya we, banza witokoore umugogo uri mu ijiisho ryawe ubone uko utokoora agatotsi kari mu ijiisho rya mugenzi waawe."
Yesu akomezamo ati, "Igiti ciiza nticeera imbuto mbi, n’igiti kibi nticeera imbuto nziiza.
Igiti coose kirangwa n’imbuto zaaco. Erega, ntaamuntu wasoroma imbuto z’igiti c’umutiini ku giti c’amahwa, cangwa ngo asorome imbuto z’imizaabibu ku mifatangwe.
Umuntu mwiza, avaana mu mutima we ibyiza bibitswemo, naho umuntu mubi, akawuvaanamo ibibi. Ibyuzuye umutima ni byo akanwa kavuga."
Yesu arababaza ati, "Ni kuki mumpamagara muti, ‘Nyagasani, Nyagasani, ariko ntimukore ibyo mbabwira?’
Umuntu weese unkurikira, akumva amagambo yanje, akayakurikiza, ameze atya:
Ni nk’umuntu wubatse inzu, agacukura haasi caane, akuubaka urufatiro ku rutare. Umwuzure utembera kuri iyo nzu, ariko ntiwabaasha kuyinyeganyeza, kuko yubatswe ku rutare.
Naho umuntu wumva ibyo mvuga ntaabikurikize ameze nk’uwuubatse inzu ku butaka, ntiyuubake urufatiro. Umwuzure uje, uteera iyo nzu, iheerako iragwa kandi ihinduka ubushingwe."
Yesu amaze kubwira abantu ibyo byose, aja mu tawuni yitwa Kaperenawumu.
Iyo haariyo mukuru w’abasirikare wari ufite umugaragu wo yakundaga caane kandi uwo mugaragu yari arwaye ari haafi gupfa.
Uwo mutware yumviise inkuru ya Yesu, atuma abakuru b’Abayuuda ngo binginge Yesu, aze akize uwo mugaragu.
Bageze aho Yesu ari, baramwinginga bati, "Uyu mutware akwiriye ubufasha bwawe,
kuko akunda ubwoko bwacu bw’Abayuuda ndetse yaritanze atwubakira isinagoogi."
Nuuko Yesu ajaana na bo. Bari haafi kugera iwe, uwo musirikare atuma bamwe mu nshuti ze ngo bamubwire bati, "Nyagasani, ntiwiirushe kuko ntibinkwiriye ko wakwinjira mu nzu yanje.
Ndetse nanje ubwanje nteekereza ko bitankwiriye kuuza aho uri. Ahuubwo tegeka nuuko umugaragu wanje arakira.
Dore nanje ndi umuntu utwarwa n’abandi nkabumvira, kandi mfite abasirikare ntegeka bakanyumvira. Iyo mbwiye umwe nti, ‘Genda’ aragenda. Naabwira undi nti, ‘Ngwino’ akaaza."
Yesu abyumviise, biramuneezeeza caane, atangaazwa n’amagambo y’uwo mutware. Maze arakebuka abona abantu benshi bamukurikiye arababwira ati, "Sindaabona ukwizeera kungana gutya haaba no mu Isirayeli."
Abo baari baatumwe basubirayo, bageze mu nzu, basanga wa mugaragu yakize.
Haanyuma y’ibyo, Yesu aja mu tawuni yitwa Nayini. Abiigiishwa be n’abantu benshi bajaana na we.

Ageze haafi y’irembo ahuura n’abantu benshi baheetse umurambo bagiiye guhamba. Uwari wapfuuye yari umwana w’umuhungu w’ikinege, kandi nyina yari umupfaakazi. Abantu benshi bo muri iyo tawuni baari kumwe na we.
Yesu aboonye uwo mupfaakazi amugirira impuhwe nyinshi, aramubwira ati, "Wirira."
Maze yeegeera ingobyi yari irimo umupfu, ayikoraho nuuko abari baheetse barahagarara. Aravuga ati, "Musore, ndagutegetse haguruka."
Uwari wapfuuye areeguuka, ariicara atangira kuvuga. Maze Yesu amusubiza nyina.
Abantu boose babiboonye bigira ubwoba, bahimbaaza Imaana bavuga bati, "Umuhanuuzi ukomeye yatugezemo." Naho abandi bati, "Imaana igendereye ubwoko bwayo uyu munsi."
Nuuko inkuru y’ibyo Yesu yakoze yamamara mu gihugu c’i Yudeeya, no mu bindi bice byose bihahereereye.
Abiigiishwa ba Yohaana Umubatiza bamuteekerereza ibyo Yesu yakoraga byose.
Maze Yohaana atuma babiri mu biigiishwa be kuri Yesu ngo bamubaze bati, "Mbese ni wowe Kristo cangwa dutegereze undi?"
Abo biigiishwa baragenda, bageze aho Yesu ari, baramubaza bati, "Yohaana Umubatiza aradutumye ngo tukubaze niiba ari wowe Kristo, cangwa niiba tugomba gutegereza undi"
Ako kaanya Yesu akiza abantu benshi baari barwaye indwara zitari zimwe. Abohoora abateewe n’abadayimooni, n’ibyago, ndetse ahumuura n’impumyi.

Yesu arababwira ati, "Musubireyo maze mubwire Yohaana ibyo muboonye hamwe n’ibyo mwumviise. Mumubwire yuuko impumyi zihumuuka, abacumbagira bakagenda neeza, ababembe bagakira, abapfaamatwi barumva, abaapfuuye barazuurwa kandi abakene barabwirizwa Ubutumwa Bwiza. Kandi muti,
‘Hahiirwa umuntu weese udashidiikanya ibyanje.’ "
Abiigiishwa ba Yohaana bamaze gusubirayo, Yesu atangira kubwira abantu ibya Yohaana Umubatiza ati, "Mwajanywe mu butaayu no kureeba iki? Mwagiiye mu butaayu kureeba urubingo ruhungabanywa n’umuyaga?
Noone se mwajanywe no kureeba iki? Ni umuntu wambaye imyenda myiza y’abarimbyi yoroheereye? Oya, kuko abambara imyenda nk’iyo n’abarimbyi bagaburirwa neeza baba ibwami.
Ngaaho nimumbwire, mwagiiye mu butaayu kureeba iki? Umuhanuuzi? Ni koko ni umuhanuuzi, ndetse aruta abandi bahanuuzi."
Yohaana ni we wavuzweho mu byanditswe ngo, "Dore ngiiye gutuma intumwa yanje mbere yaawe, integuuza izaakubanziriza kugira ngo itunganye inzira yaawe."
Yesu arongera aravuga ati, "Ndababwira yuuko mu baabyawe n’umugore, ntaan’umwe uruta Yohaana. Ariko umuntu wiciisha bugufi kandi woroheje mu Bwami bw’Imaana ni we umuruta."
Abasoreesha n’abandi bantu boose bumviise ayo magambo, beemera ko Imaana idaca urwa kibeera kuko baari baarabatijwe na Yohaana.
Ariko Abafarisaayo hamwe n’abiigiishamategeko bakuru ntaabwo beemeye imigambi y’Imaana kuko banze umubatizo wa Yohaana.
Yesu akomeza kubabwira ati, "Mbese abantu b’iki gihe naabagereranya n’iki? Kandi bahwanye n’iki?
Bameze nk’abaana bato biicaye mu iguriro bakina, bahamagarana, bavuga bati, ‘Twabavugirije inanga, ntimwabyina, twaririmbye indirimbo z’umubabaro, ariko ntimwarira.’ "
Yesu arababwira ati, " ‘Dore Yohaana Umubatiza yaaje atarya umutsima ndetse atanywa na divaayi, muravuga ngo afite dayimooni.’
Umwana w’Umuntu aje arya, ndetse anywa, muravuga ngo, ‘Nimureebe iki gisambo, umusinzi kandi inshuti y’abasoreesha n’abanyabyaha!’
Nyamara ubwenge bw’Imaana bugaragazwa n’ababwemera boose ko ari ubw’ukuri."
Umwe mu Bafarisaayo witwaga Simooni, araarika Yesu ngo basangire. Nuuko Yesu yinjira mu nzu ye ariicara ngo arye.
Maze umugore wari umunyabyaha wo muri iyo tawuni amenye inkuru ko Yesu ari buriire muri iyo nzu y’Umufarisaayo, azana agacupa k’amavuta ahuumura neeza.
Maze ahagarara nk’inyuma iruhande rw’ibirenge bya Yesu, arira atonyanza amarira ku birenge bya Yesu kandi abihanaguza umusatsi we. Akomeza no kumusoma ibirenge, abisiiga ya mavuta ahuumura neeza.
Nuuko Umufarisaayo wari waraaritse Yesu abiboonye arashoberwa, ariibaza ati, "Iyo uyu muntu aba ari umuhanuuzi, aba amenye yuuko uyu mugore umukozeho ari umunyabyaha."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Simooni hari ico niifuuza kukubwira." Maze Simooni aramusubiza ati, "Yeego mwigiisha mbwira."
Yesu aramubwira ati, "Haari umuntu wagujije abantu babiri amashilingi. Umwe amuha amashilingi angana imibyizi magana ataanu. Naho undi amuguza amashilingi angana imibyizi mirongo itaanu gusa.
Ariko abo bantu bombi ntaan’umwe washoboye kwishura. Maze uwabagujije arabababarira. Noone Simooni ndakubaza, muri abo babiri, ni nde warushije mugenzi we gukunda nyakubaguza?"
Simooni aramusubiza ati, "Nteekereza ko ari uwo yababariye umwenda munini." Yesu aramubwira ati, "Uvuze ukuri."

Yesu arakebuka areeba wa mugore, nuuko abwira Simooni ati, "Urareeba uyu mugore? Ninjiye mu nzu yaawe, ntiwampa amaazi yo gukaraba ibirenge. Ariko we, yabikarabishije amarira kandi abisiimuuza umusatsi we."
Ntaabwo wigeze kumpoobera unyakiira, ariko aho uyu mugore yagereye hano, ntaabwo yigeze ahwema kunsoma ibirenge antabaarutsa.
Ntaabwo wigeze unsiiga amavuta mu mutwe, ariko uyu mugore we ansiize amavuta ahuumura neeza ku birenge.
Ndababwira yuuko uyu mugore ababariwe ibyaha bye byinshi. Ni co gitumye anyeretse urukundo rwinshi amfitiye. Ariko umuntu weese ubabariwe bike, agira urukundo ruke.
Yesu abwira uwo mugore ati, "Ibyaha byawe urabibabariwe."
Nuuko abantu baasangiraga na Yesu, batangira kwibaza bati, "Uyu ni nde uhangaara kubabarira abantu ibyaha?"
Yesu abwira uwo mugore ati, "Kwizeera kwawe kuragukijije genda amahoro."
Nyuma y’ibyo, Yesu aja mu matawuni no mu byaro yaamamaza Ubutumwa Bwiza bw’Ubwami bw’Imaana kandi yari kumwe n’abiigiishwa be cumi na babiri
hamwe n’abagore bamwe bo yari yarakijije indwara n’abadayimooni. Abo bagore baarimo, Mariya wiitwaga Magadaleena wo Yesu yakijije abadayimooni barindwi,
na Yowana umugore wa Ekuza wari umukozi mukuru wa Herodi, na Suzaana, hamwe n’abandi bagore benshi. Boose hamwe, baakoraga ku byabo bagafasha Yesu n’abiigiishwa be.
Nuuko abantu benshi baari baturutse mu matawuni atari amwe baaza aho Yesu ari barakungaana. Nuuko Yesu abaciira umugani ati,
"Umubibyi yasohoye imbuto aja kubiba. Akibiba, zimwe zigwa mu nzira abantu barazikandagira n’inyoni zo mu kireere zirazitooragura.
Izindi zigwa ku rutare ziramera. Zimaze kumera, ziruuma kuko zaabuze amaazi.
Izindi mbuto zigwa mu mahwa, zikurana na yo, bituma zinyunyuka.
Izindi zigwa mu butaka bwiza, zeera imbuto nyinshi, buri imwe ikubiishamo inshuro ijana." Yesu amaze kuvuga ibyo, abwira abantu ati, "Ufite amatwi yumva niyumve."
Nuuko abiigiishwa bamusaba kubasobaanurira ico uwo mugani umenyeesha.

Yesu arababwira ati, "Mwebweho mwahaawe kumenya amabanga y’Ubwami bw’Imaana, ariko abandi bo babibwirwa mu marenga kugira ngo ‘kureeba bareebe, ariko beekubibona. Kandi no kumva bumve, ariko beegusobaanukirwa.’ "
Nuuko Yesu akomeza kubabwira ati, "Uku ni ko uwo mugani usobaanurwa: Imbuto ni ijambo ry’Imaana.
Imbuto zaaguuye mu nzira, ni abumva ijambo ry’Imaana maze Sataani akaaza akarikuura mu mitima yaabo kugira ngo batizeera bagakizwa.
Izaaguuye ku rutare, ni abo baakiira ubutumwa n’umuneezeero, ariko ntibakomerere muri bwo. Abo bantu biizeera umwanya muto haanyuma baagera mu bigeragezo bakava mu kwizeera.
Imbuto zaaguuye mu muhwa, ni abo bumva ubutumwa ariko bagikomezamo bagasubizwa inyuma n’amaganya, n’ubutunzi, hamwe n’ibineezeeza byo muri ubu bugingo bikababuza kwera imbuto.
Naho imbuto zaaguuye ku butaka bwiza, ni abo bumva ijambo ry’Imaana bakarifata neeza, n’umutima wubaha kandi unyuzwe, ku bwo kwihangaana bakeera imbuto."

Nuuko Yesu arababwira ati, "Ntaawe ukongeeza itaara, ngo aryubikeho intonga cangwa ngo arishire muusi y’uburiri kuko ntiryamurikira abantu. Ahuubwo rishirwa ahagaragara kugira ngo abantu boose baaza mu nzu ribamurikire.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko ntaabyahishwe bitazaahishuurwa, cangwa icaakorewe mu ibanga kitazaamenyekana.
Nuuko reero mwirinde uko mwumva aya magambo. Abo bafite bazongeererwa, ariko abadafite, bazaakwa n’ako bateekereza ko bafite."
Nuuko nyina n’abavandimwe ba Yesu baaza kumureeba, ariko ntibaashobora kumugeraho ku bw’abantu benshi.
Umuntu araaza abwira Yesu ati, "Nyoko na beene so bahagaze hanze bashaaka kuvugana naawe."
Aramusubiza ati, "Maama na beene daata ni abo bumva ijambo ry’Imaana bakarikurikiza."
Umunsi umwe, Yesu n’abiigiishwa be baja mu bwato, arababwira ati, "Reka twambuke tuje haakurya y’ingezi." Nuuko bazitura ubwato batangira urugendo.
Bacambuka, Yesu arasinziira. Maze umuyaga mwinshi uteera mu ngezi, imivumba yisuka mu bwato bwenda kurengerwa n’amaazi, biisanga mu kaaga.
Biihuutira kumukangura, bati, "Daatabuja, Daatabuja! Tugiiye gupfa!" Nuuko akangutse, acaaha umuyaga n’imivumba birahoosha, habaho ituuze.
Yesu arababaza ati, "Kwizeera kwanyu kuri he?" Baratiinya kandi baruumirwa, baravugana bati, "Mbese uyu ni muntu ki, utegeka umuyaga no gucura kw’ingezi bikamwumvira!"
Nuuko Yesu n’abiigiishwa be barambuka bafata haakurya, bagera mu gice c’Abagadereeni hateeganye n’i Galileeya.

Yesu avuuye mu bwato, asanganirwa n’umugabo wabaga muri iyo tawuni wari uteewe n’abadayimooni. Uwo mugabo yari amaze igihe kireekire yambara ubusa, kandi ntiyaraaraga mu nzu ahuubwo yaraaraga mu irimbi.
Aboonye Yesu arataka caane, apfukama imbere ye ateera heejuru ati, "Unshaakaho iki Yesu Mwana w’Imaana Isumbabyose? Nyaabuna ndakwinginze, ntunyice urupfu rw’agashinyaguro."

Yavuze atyo, kuko Yesu yari ategetse abadayimooni kumuvamo. Uwo mugabo baari baaramuhambije injegeri mu maboko no mu maguru, kandi baahoraga bamurinze kuko kenshi abadayimooni baajaga bamuteera. Ariko ibyo baamuhambizaga byose yarabicagaguraga maze dayimooni zikamujaana mu butaayu.
Yesu abaza uwo mugabo ati, "Witwa nde?" Aramusubiza ati, " ‘Igiteero’ ni ryo zina ryanje." Yavuze atyo kuko abadayimooni baari bamurimo baari benshi.
Abo badayimooni binginga Yesu bati, "Nyaabuna turakwinginze ntudusuke ikuzimu."
Haafi aho, haari ingurube nyinshi zaariishirizaga ku musozi. Nuuko abo badayimooni binginga Yesu caane ngo abeemerere baje muri izo ngurube. Nuuko arabeemerera.
Maze abo badayimooni bava muri uwo mugabo, binjira muri izo ngurube. Izo ngurube zoose ziiruka zirindimuka agacuri maze ziisuka mu ngezi, zirarohama.
Abashumba baaragiraga izo ngurube, baboonye ibibaaye barahunga maze baamamaza iyo nkuru mu tawuni no mu bindi bice biyegeereye.

Maze abantu barahaguruka baja kureeba ibyabaaye. Baaza aho Yesu ari, babona uwo mugabo wabagamo abadayimooni yiicaye haasi imbere ya Yesu yambaye kandi afite ubwenge nk’abandi. Babiboonye baratiinya caane.
Abaaboonye ibyabaaye byose, babibwira abandi, ndetse n’uko uwari warateewe n’abadayimooni yakize.
Maze abatuurage boose bo muri ico gice c’Abagadereeni basaba Yesu ngo ave mu gihugu caabo kuko ibyari byabaaye byabateeye ubwoba bwinshi. Nuuko aja mu bwato avayo.
Ariko ataraavayo, uwo mugabo wari wavanywemo abadayimooni aramwinginga ngo bajaane. Ariko Yesu aramuseezerera ati,
"Subira iwaawe mu rugo maze ubateekerereze ibitangaaza Imaana yagukoreye." Nuuko uwo mugabo agenda yamamaza mu tawuni yoose ibyo Yesu yamukoreye.
Yesu asubiye haakurya y’ingezi, abantu benshi bamwakiira n’umuneezeero kuko boose baari biiriwe bamutegereje.
Nuuko haaza umuntu witwaga Yayiro wari umutware w’isinagoogi y’Abayuuda. Apfukama imbere ya Yesu aravuga ati, "Ndakwinginze ngwino tujaane iwanje."

Yavuze atyo kuko yari afite umukoobwa w’ikinege wari amaze imyaka cumi n’ebyiri y’ubukuru kandi yari arwaye arembye ari haafi gupfa. Nuuko Yesu aramwemerera barajaana. Bakigenda, abantu benshi baramubyiga.
Muri abo, haarimo umugore wari amaze imyaka cumi n’ebyiri arwaye indwara y’abagore yo kuva. Yari yaramariye ibye mu bavuuzi ariko ntaawashoboye kumukiza.
Nuuko uwo mugore yegeera Yesu amuturutse inyuma akora ku mukugiro w’umwenda we, ako kaanya amaraso aratsina.
Yesu arabaza ati, "Ni inde unkozeho?" Abantu boose barahakana. Peetero aramubwira ati, "Daatabuja, abantu benshi baragukurikiye kandi barakubyiga ndetse bakanagufataho."
Ariko Yesu aravuga ati, "Hari umuntu unkozeho abigendereye kuko numviise imbaraga zimvamo."
Nuuko uwo mugore amenye ko Yesu adahishwa, aza afite ubwoba bwinshi, apfukama imbere ye. Abwira rubanda impamvu yatumye amukoraho, ababwira n’ukuntu indwara yo kuva yashootse ikize.
Yesu aramubwira ati, "Mwana wanje, kwizeera kwawe kuragukijije, genda amahoro."
Yesu akivuga ibyo, haaza umuntu uvuuye mu rugo rwa Yayiro, maze abwira uwo mutware w’isinagoogi ati, "Umukoobwa waawe amaze gupfa. Reka kurusha umwigiisha."
Yesu yumviise ibibaaye abwira Yayiro ati, "wiitiinya, izeere gusa umukoobwa waawe arakira."
Nuuko Yesu ageze mu muryango w’inzu ya Yayiro, ntiyakundira umuntu weese kwinjirana na we uretse Peetero, Yohaana, Yaakobo hamwe na Yayiro na nyina w’uwo mukoobwa.
Bageze mu nzu, basanga abantu boose baririra uwo mukoobwa, bateera heejuru. Maze Yesu arababwira ati, "Murekeraho kurira kuko umukoobwa ntiyapfuuye ahuubwo arasinziiriye."
