Baramuseka kuko baari baazi neeza yuuko uwo mukoobwa yapfuuye.
Yesu abwira abantu baari mu nzu ngo baje hanze, maze amufata ukuboko avuga mu ijwi rirenga ati, "Mukoobwa kanguka."
Uwo mukoobwa atangira guhuumeeka neeza ako kaanya arahaguruka. Yesu ategeka ko bamuha icokurya.
Ababyeyi b’uwo mukoobwa baratangaara caane. Ariko Yesu abategeka kutagira umuntu wo babibwira.
Yesu ahamagara abiigiishwa be cumi na babiri, abaha ubushobozi n’ubutware bwo kwirukana abadayimooni boose, no gukiza indwara.
Abatuma kubwiriza ubutumwa bw’Ubwami bw’Imaana no gukiza abarwayi.
Arababwira ati, "Ntimugire ico mujaana mu rugendo, yaaba inkoni, uruhago, ibyokurya, amashilingi cangwa undi mwambaro.
Urugo muzaacumbikamo, abe ari rwo mugumamo kugeza igihe muzaaviira muri iyo tawuni.
Abantu bo muri iyo tawuni niibatabaakiira, muzaayivemo maze mukunkumure umucuucu wo ku birenge byanyu, kugira ngo bibe ubuhamya bwo kubeemeza ko Imaana izaabahana ibahooye kwanga ubutumwa bwayo."
Nuuko abiigiishwa baragenda, banyura mu byaro byose baamamaza Ubutumwa bwiza kandi bakiza abantu indwara aho baajaga hoose.
Herodi umutegetsi w’i Galileeya yumviise ibyo Yesu yakoraga, biramuyobera kuko abantu baavugaga ko ari Yohaana wazuutse.
Abandi baavugaga ko ari Eliya wagarutse mu isi, ndetse abandi biibwiraga ko ari umwe mu bahanuuzi baakeera wazuutse.
Ariko Herodi aravuga ati, "Ko ari nje wategetse yuuko Yohaana aciibwa igihanga, noone kandi uyu bavuga yaaba ari nde?" Maze Herodi atangira gushaaka ukuntu yazaabona Yesu.
Intumwa za Yesu zigarutse zimuteekerereza ibyo zaari zaakoze byose. Nuuko Yesu azijaana ahiihereereye haafi y’itawuni yitwa Beetsayida.
Ariko abantu benshi babimenye, bamusangayo. Maze Yesu arabaakiira, ababwira iby’Ubwami bw’Imaana kandi abaari barwaye boose arabakiza.

Nuuko bugiiye kwira, abiigiishwa be cumi na babiri baramwegeera, baramubwira bati, "Mwigiisha, seezerera abantu babone uko baja hakurya gushaaka ibyokurya n’aho kuraara kuko aha turi ntihatuuye abantu."

Ariko Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Ahuubwo mube ari mwe mubagaburira." Abiigiishwa baramusubiza bati, "Dore dufite imigaati itaanu n’isamaaki ebyiri gusa, keretse niiba twaja kugura ibyahaaza aba bantu boose."
Haariho abagabo nk’ibihumbi bitaanu. Nuuko Yesu abwira abiigiishwa be ati, "Mubabwire biicare, buri gatsiko kabemo abantu mirongo itaanu."
Abiigiishwa bagenza nk’uko ababwiye, maze abantu boose bariicara.
Nuuko Yesu yakiira iyo migaati itaanu n’isamaaki ebyiri, areeba heejuru. Maze ashiima Imaana, arabimanyagura aheereza abiigiishwa na bo baheereza abantu.
Boose bararya barahaaga, maze abiigiishwa buuzuza intonga cumi n’ebyiri z’imigaati n’isamaaki byo abantu baari baasigaje.
Umunsi umwe Yesu yari ahiihereereye asenga, kandi abiigiishwa be baari kumwe na we. Amaze gusenga arababaza ati, "Abantu bavuga ko ndi nde?"
Abiigiishwa baramusubiza bati, "Bamwe bavuga ko uri Yohaana Umubatiza, abandi bakavuga ko uri Eliya umuhanuuzi, ndetse abandi bavuga ko uri umwe mu bahanuuzi ba keera wazuutse."
Arababaza ati, "Ariko se mwe muvuga ko ndi nde?" Peetero aramusubiza ati, "Uri Kristo wavuuye ku Maana."
Yesu abiihanangiriza abategeka ngo hatagira undi babibwira.

Arabasobaanurira ati, "Ni ngombwa ko Umwana w’Umuntu ababazwa bikomeye, ndetse akangwa n’abakuru b’Abayuuda, n’abatware b’abaheerezabitambo, hamwe n’abiigiishamategeko. Kandi ko agomba kwicwa akazuurwa ku munsi wa gatatu."
Yesu abwira abantu boose ati, "Umuntu weese nashaaka kuba umwigiishwa wanje, akwiriye kwiyanga, akiikorera umusaraba we buri munsi, maze akankurikira.
Ndababwira yuuko ushaaka kurengera ubugingo bwe azaabubura, ariko utiita ku bugingo bwe ku bwo kunkurikira, azaabukiza.
Mbese umuntu byamumarira iki kunguka ibyo mu si byose, ariko agapfiirwa ubugingo buhoraho?
Umuntu weese ugira isoni zo kunyemera no kwemera ibyo niigiisha, Umwana w’Umuntu na we azaagira isoni zo kumwemera, igihe azaaba aziye mu ikuzo rye, irya Se hamwe ni ry’abaamalayika beera.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko, bamwe muri mwe bari aha, batazaapfa batari bareeba Ubwami bw’Imaana."
Hashize iminsi nk’umunaane avuze ibyo, Yesu ajaana na Peetero, na Yohaana na Yaakobo bazaamuukana umusozi gusenga.
Yesu agisenga, mu maaso he hahinduka ukundi maze hararabagirana caane. Imyenda ye na yo ihinduka umweru dede irarabagirana.
Ako kaanya haboneka abagabo babiri, Moose na Eliya bavugana na we.
Baboneka bafite ubwiza bw’ijuru burabagirana, bavugana na Yesu iby’urupfu rwe, urwo yari agiiye kuzaapfiira i Yerusaalemu.
Ibyo byabaaye, Peetero na bagenzi be babiri basinziiriye. Muri ako kaanya barakanguka babona ikuzo rya Yesu n’abagabo babiri bamuhagaze iruhande.

Nuuko Moose na Eliya bari haafi gutandukana na we, Peetero aravuga ati, "Mwigiisha ni byiza ko turi hano! Mbona ko twakubaka amahema atatu, rimwe ribe iryawe, irindi ribe irya Moose, naho irindi ribe irya Eliya." Yavuze atyo kuko ntiyari azi ibyo avuga.
Peetero akivuga, igicu kirabatwikiira maze kirabazenguruka, abiigiishwa baratiinya.
Ijwi ry’Imaana rivugira muri ico gicu riti, "Uyu ni Umwana wanje natooranyije, mumwumvire."
Iryo jwi rimaze kumviikana, abiigiishwa babona Yesu ari wenyine. Maze abo biigiishwa batatu babigira ibanga, ntibaagira uwo babibwira.
Bukeeye, Yesu amanuka umusozi ari kumwe n’abiigiishwa be batatu, abantu benshi baaza kumusanganira.
Ako kaanya umugabo ateera heejuru, asakuza ari mu bantu avuga ati, "Mwigiisha ndakwinginze girira umwana wanje imbabazi kuko ari we mwana mfite wenyine.
Buri gihe dayimooni imufata imutunguye ikamuteera kuborooga. Iyo imufashe, iramutigita akaazana ifuro mu kanwa. Ntaabwo imuvaho vuba, ahuubwo iramubabaza ikamuvaho biruhije.
Ninginze abiigiishwa baawe ngo bamukize ariko ntibaabishoboye."
Yesu aravuga ati, "Yemwe bantu b’iki gihe mudafite kwizeera, kandi mwibwira ibibi gusa. Nzaageza ryari kubaana na mwe no kubiihangaanira?" Nuuko Yesu aramubwira ati, "Ngaaho nzanira uwo mwana waawe."
Uwo mwana bakimuuzana aho Yesu ari, dayimooni imukubita haasi, iramutigita. Nuuko Yesu acaaha dayimooni ako kaanya imuvamo. Amaze gukiza uwo mwana, amusubiza se.
Nuuko abantu boose batangaazwa n’ububaasha bw’Imaana buhebuuje. Bagitangaaye, Yesu abwira abiigiishwa be ati,
"Nimwumve ibyo mbabwira, Umwana w’Umuntu agiiye kugambaanirwa maze ashirwe mu maboko y’abantu."
Ariko abiigiishwa ntibaamenya iryo jambo kuko baari baarihishwe ngo batarisobaanukirwa, ndetse Batiinya no kumubaza ngo abasobaanurire.
Abiigiishwa batangira kuja impaka bashaaka kumenya umukuru ubaruta muri bo uwo ari we.
Ariko Yesu amenya ibyari biri mu mitima yaabo, azana umwana muto amuhagarika iruhande rwe.

Yesu arababwira ati, "Umuntu weese uzaakiira umwana muto nk’uyu mu izina ryanje, azaaba ari nje yakiriye. Kandi unyakiira azaaba yakiiriye uwantumye. Ndababwira yuuko uwo Imaana ireeba ko ari mukuru muri mwe, ni uwiiciisha bugufi."
Nuuko Yohaana aramubwira ati, "Mwigiisha twaboonye umuntu yiirukana abadayimooni mu izina ryawe maze turamubuza kuko atari umwe muri twe."
Maze Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ntimukabuze beene uwo, ndababwira yuuko utabarwanya aba ari ku ruhande rwanyu."
Maze igihe ceegereje ngo Yesu asubire mu ijuru, amaramaza kuja i Yerusaalemu.
Nuuko atuma abantu ngo bamubanzirize imbere. Baragenda, banyura i Samariya kumuteguuriza.
Ariko abantu b’aho banga kumwakiira kuko yakomezagamo aja i Yerusaalemu.
Abiigiishwa be Yaakobo na Yohaana, baboonye ko Abanyasamariya banze kwakiira Yesu baramubwira bati, "Nyagasani, urashaaka ko dutegeka umuriro kuva mu ijuru ugakongoora aba bantu?"
Maze Yesu arahindukira, arabacaaha.
Nuuko we n’abiigiishwa be baja mu kindi caaro.
Nuuko Yesu n’abiigiishwa be bakigenda, umuntu aramubwira ati, "Ndagukurikira aho uja hoose."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ingunzu zifite imyobo yo kuraaramo, n’inyoni zo mu kireere zifite ibyari byo kubamo, ariko Umwana w’Umuntu ntaafite aho kurambika umusaya."
Nuuko Yesu abwira undi muntu ati, "Nkurikira." Ariko uwo muntu aramusubiza ati, "Nyagasani, nyemerera manze nsubire mu rugo nteguure ibyo guhamba daata."
Yesu aramubwira ati, "Reka abapfu bahambe abapfu baabo. Ariko wowe genda wamamaze iby’Ubwami bw’Imaana."
Undi muntu na we aramubwira ati, "Nyagasani, ndagukurikira, ariko nyemerera mbanze nje guseezera ku bo mu rugo."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ntaamuntu ufashe isuka ihinga, ureeba inyuma uba ukwiriye Ubwami bw’Imaana."
Haanyuma Umwami Yesu, atooranya abandi biigiishwa mirongo irindwi na babiri, atuma babiri, babiri ngo bamubanzirize aho yari agambiriye kuja hoose.
Arababwira ati, "Ibisaaruurwa ni byinshi, ariko abasaaruuzi ni bake. Nuuko musabe Imaana nyiribisaaruurwa, yohereze abasaaruuzi mu murima waayo.
Nimugende! Dore mbatumye muri nk’abaana b’intaama, hagati y’amasega aryana.
Ntihagire ishilingi mwitwaza mu mufuka, cangwa agakapu, cangwa ingato, kandi ntimumare igihe muramukanya n’abantu mu nzira mukigenda.
Buri nzu yoose mwinjiramo, mubanze muvuge muti, ‘Amahoro y’Imaana abe muri iyi nzu.’
Niiba muri iyo nzu harimo umuntu ukunda amahoro, azaayahaabwa, ariko niiba ntaawe, ayo mahoro azaabagarukira.
Mugume muri iyo nzu, murye kandi munywe ibyo babahaaye, ibyo birakwiriye kuko umukozi akwiriye guhembwa.
Itawuni yoose mugeramo bakabaakiira, murye ibyo babazimaaniye,
mukize abarwayi bo muri yo, mubabwire muti, ‘Ubwami bw’Imaana burabeegeereye.’
Ariko nimugera mu tawuni, abantu b’aho ntibabaakiire, muzaaje mu nzira zaaho mubabwire muti,
‘Umucuucu wo mu tawuni yaanyu wari ufashe ku birenge byacu tuwikunkumuyeho byerekana ko Imaana izaabahanira ibicumuro byabo, ariko mumenye ko Ubwami bw’Imaana bubeegereeye.’
Ndababwira yuuko, ku munsi w’urubanza, Imaana izaagirira Sodomu imbabazi nyinshi ziruta iz’abo muri iyo tawuni."

Yesu akomeza kubwira abiigiishwa ati, "Mbeega ishano rizaagwira abantu b’i Koraziini! Mbeega ishano rizaagwira abantu b’i Beetsayida! Iyaaba abanyabyaha b’i Tiiro n’i Sidoni baraboonye ibitangaaza byakorewe muri Koraziini, n’i Beetsayida, baba baariihannye barira kandi baborooga.
Ni co gituma ku munsi Imaana izaaca imanza ab’i Tiiro n’i Sidoni bazaahanwa igihano cooroshe kuruta icaanyu.
Namwe ab’i Kaperenawumu, mbese muzaashirwa heejuru, ngo mugere ku ijuru? Oya, ahuubwo muzaaja i kuzimu!"
Maze Yesu abwira abiigiishwa be ati, "Umuntu weese wemera ibyo muvuga, aba yemeye ibyo mvuga. Ubanga, ni nje aba yanze kandi unyanga aba yanze Imaana yantumye."
Abo mirongo irindwi na babiri bagaruka baneezeerewe caane maze babwira Yesu bati, "Nyagasani, abadayimooni na bo baatwumviye ku bw’ububaasha bw’izina ryawe."
Arabasubiza ati, "Naboonye Sataani agwa avuuye mu ijuru nk’umurabyo.
Dore mbahaaye ubutware bwo gukandagira inzoka n’ibindi binyabusabwe byose, hamwe no gutsinda umwanzi Sataani n’ubutware bwe bwose. Ntaakintu na kimwe kizaagira ico kibatwara.
Ariko ntimwishimire yuuko imyuka mibi ibumvira, ahuubwo mwishimire ko amazina yaanyu yanditswe mu ijuru."

Ako kaanya Yesu yuzura umuneezeero mu Mwuka Weera, maze aravuga ati, "Ndagushiima, Daata, wowe utegeka ijuru n’isi, kuko ibyo wabihishe abanyabwenge ukabihishuurira abiiciishije bugufi. Ni koko Daata, ni ko wabikunze.
Imaana Daata yampaaye ububaasha n’ubwenge bwose. Imaana Daata yoonyine ni yo izi Umwana uwo ari we. Kandi Umwana ni we uzi Se uwo ari we, n’umuntu weese wo Umwana ashaatse kugira ngo amenye Imaana."
Maze Yesu ahindukira abiigiishwa be, ababwira biihereereye ati, "Hahiirwa abareeba ibyo mureeba.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko abahanuuzi n’abaami benshi biifuuje kureeba ibyo mwiboneye, nyamara ntibaabiboonye. Ndetse biifuuje no kumva ibyo mwumviise ariko ntibaabyumviise."
Umwe mu biigiishamategeko ya Moose, ahagurutswa no kugerageza Yesu aramubaza ati, "Mwigiisha, naakora iki kugira ngo ndagwe ubugingo buhoraho?"
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Amategeko ya Moose avuga iki? Uyasobaanukirwa ute?"
Na we aramusubiza ati, "Ukundiishe Uhoraho Imaana yaawe umutima waawe woose, n’ubugingo bwawe bwose, n’imbaraga zaawe zoose, n’ubwenge bwawe bwose, kandi ukunde mugenzi waawe nk’uko wikunda."
Yesu aramubwira ati, "Uvuze neeza. Nuugenza utyo uzaabona ubugingo."
Uwo mwigiisha w’amategeko, ashaatse kwishigikira, abaza Yesu ati, "Harya mugenzi wanje ni nde?"

Yesu amusubiza amuciira umugani ati, "Umunsi umwe Umuyuuda yavuuye i Yerusaalemu amanuka aja i Yeriko. Akigenda agwa mu bambuzi, baramusuumiira, baramukubita, bamwaka ibyo yari afite byose. Ndetse bamwambura n’imyenda ye. Nyuma bariiruka bamusiga ari indembe.
Akiri aho haaza umuheerezabitambo, amuboonye, arakiikira anyuraho ariigendera.
Nyuma y’aho haaza umuleevi na we amuboonye abigenza atyo, ntiyamwitaho, ariigendera.
Nuuko haaza Umusamariya wari mu rugendo na we amugeraho, we amuboonye, amugirira impuhwe.
Amwoza ibikomere na divaayi, amwomoza amavuta ya elayo, kandi amupfuka inguma. Amushira ku ndogobe ye, amujaana ahantu ho gucumbika, aramurwaza.
Bukeeye aha nyir’icumbi idenariyo ebyiri aramubwira ati, ‘Umurwaze kandi ibyo uzaatanga birenze ibyo ngusigiye nzaabikwishura ngarutse.’ "
Yesu ni ko kubaza wa mwigiisha w’amategeko ati, "Uteekereza ute? Muri abo batatu ni nde wamugiriye neeza? Ni nde wabaaye mugenzi we?"
Na we aramusubiza ati, "Ni uwamugiriye imbabazi." Yesu aramubwira ati, "Genda naawe ukore utyo."
Yesu n’abiigiishwa be bakomeza kugenda bagera iwaabo w’umugore witwaga Marita, arabaakiira.
Mwenenyina witwaga Mariya, yiicara yeegeereye Yesu, yumva ibyo yiigiishaga.

Ariko Marita we yari yahagaritswe umutima no gukora imirimo ashaaka ibyo kuzimaana. Nuuko asanga Yesu aramubaza ati, "Nyagasani, ntuubyitaayeho ko mwenemaama yanteereranye mu mirimo, akiiyicarira? Mubwire aze ampfashe."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Nyaabuna Marita urarushwa n’ubusa muri byinshi.
Nyamara ica ngombwa ni kimwe gusa, Mariya ni co yahisemo kandi ntaazigera acaakwa."
Yesu yari ahantu asenga. Arangije gusenga, umwe mu biigiishwa be aramubwira ati, "Nyagasani, twigiishe gusenga nk’uko Yohaana Umubatiza yiigiishije abiigiishwa be."
Yesu arababwira ati, "Nimusenga muje muvuga muti, ‘Daata, izina ryawe ryubahwe, Ubwami bwawe buuze.
Uduhe ifunguro ryo kudutunga buri munsi.
Utubabarire ibyaha byacu, nk’uko naatwe tubabarira abaducumuraho. Ntuuduteererane ngo tugwe mu bitugerageza.’ "
Yesu akomeza kubabwira ati, "Nk’ubu mwe muri mwe agiiye kwa mugenzi we nijoro akamubwira ati, ‘Mugenzi wanje nguza imigaati itatu,
kuko inshuti yanje ingezeho kandi simfite ico kumuzimaanira.’
Maze mugenzi we akamusubiza ari mu nzu ati, ‘Reka kundusha, namaze gukinga kandi n’abaana banje baaryamye. Sinshobora guhaguruka ngo ngire ico nguha.’
Ndababwira yuuko naaho uwo muntu ataahagurutswa n’ubushuti bafitanye, amaheerezo yahagurutswa n’uko yamutiitirije bigatuma amuha ibyo asabye.
Ni co gituma mbabwira nti, musabe muzaahaabwa, mushaake muzaabona, mukomange ku rugi, muzaakinguurirwa.
Ni koko usabye weese arahaabwa, ushaatse weese arabona, kandi n’ukomanga weese arakinguurirwa.
Babyeyi, ni nde muri mwe w’umwana we yasaba isamaaki akamuha inzoka?
Cangwa yamusaba igi akamuha indyaniishamiriizo?
Noone ko muri babi mukaba muuzi guha abaana baanyu ibyiza, So wo mu ijuru we ntiyarushaho guha Umwuka Weera abamumusabye!"
Umunsi umwe, Yesu yirukanye dayimooni iteera uburagi mu muntu. Iyo dayimooni imaze kumuvamo, uwari umuragi atangira kuvuga, maze abantu benshi baari aho, baratangaara.
Ariko bamwe muri bo baravuga bati, "Umutware w’abadayimooni wiitwa Bbelizebuulu ni we umuha ububaasha bwo kwirukana abadayimooni."
Abandi bantu baramugerageza ngo abeereke ikimenyeetso kigaragaza ko kiva ku Maana.
Yesu amenya ibyo bateekereza, arababwira ati, "Iyo ubwami bwigabyemo ibice, burarimbuka. Ndetse n’urugo rudafatanya, rurasenyuka.
Muvuga yuuko Sataani ari we umpa ububaasha bwo kwirukana abadayimooni. Noone se niiba ubwami bwa Sataani bwigabamo ibice bukiirwanya, bwakomera bute?

Niiba Bbelizebuulu ari we umpa ububaasha bwo kwirukana abadayimooni, ni nde uha abayoboke baanyu ubushobozi bwo kwirukana abadayimooni? Ni co gituma abo ari bo bazaabaciira urubanza ku bw’ibyo mumaze kuvuga.
Nuuko reero niiba imbaraga z’Imaana ari zo zinshoboza kwirukana abadayimooni, Ubwami bw’Imaana bubagezemo.
Umuntu ufite imbaraga n’intwaro, akarinda urugo rwe, ibintu bye ntaawabikoraho.
Ariko iyo ateewe n’umurusha imbaraga, aramutsinda, akamunyaga intwaro zoose yari yiringiye, n’ibintu bye akabigabira abandi.
Umuntu weese tudafatanya, aba ari umwanzi wanje. Ndetse udakoranyiriza hamwe nanje aba ataatanya."
Yesu akomezamo ati, "Iyo dayimooni ivuuye mu muntu, izeereera mu butaayu ishaaka uburuhuukiro, yabubura, ikavuga iti, ‘Reka niisubirire mu nzu navuuyemo.’
Iyo igezeyo, igasanga aho yabaga haakondoowe kandi hateguuwe neeza,
iragenda, ikaazana abandi badayimooni barindwi bayirusha kuba babi. Boose bakinjira mu muntu bakamubamo, nooneho uwo muntu akaba mubi birenze uko yari ari."
Yesu akivuga ayo magambo, umugore avuga mu ijwi rirenga ati, "Hahiirwa uwakubyaye n’amabeere yakonkeje."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ahuubwo hahiirwa abo bumva ijambo ry’Imaana, bakarikurikiza."
Abantu bakomeza kugwira, bamubyiganiraho. Yesu arababwira ati, "Abantu b’iki gihe ni babi bashaaka ko mbeereka igitangaaza kiva ku Maana. Ariko nta co bazaabona keretse ic’umuhanuuzi Yona.
Nk’uko Imaana yoheereje Yona kuba ikimenyeetso c’abantu bo mu tawuni y’i Ninevi, ni ko n’Umwana w’Umuntu woherejwe n’Imaana, azaaba ikimenyeetso ku bantu b’iki gihe.

Umwamikazi w’i Sheba yaturutse mu gihugu ca kure, azanywe no kumva ubwenge bw’umwami Solomooni. Noone dore uruta Solomooni ari hano ariko ntimushaaka kumwumvira. Ni co gituma azaahagurukira ab’iki gihe, akabaciiraho iteeka ku munsi w’imperuuka.
Abantu b’i Ninevi bumviise inyigiisho za Yona, bariihana. Kandi dore urusha Yona ubuhanga ari hano. Ni co gituma ku munsi w’urubanza, abantu b’i Ninevi bazaatuma ab’iki gihe batsindwa.
Ntaamuntu ucaana itaara ngo arihishe cangwa ngo aryubikeho intonga. Ahuubwo arishira ku gitereko caryo kugira ngo abinjira mu nzu babone umuco.
Ijiisho ryawe ni itaara rimurikira umubiri waawe. Iyo amaaso yaawe areeba neeza, umubiri woose ugira umuco, ariko areebye naabi, umubiri woose wuuzura umwijima.
Nuuko reero mwirinde kugira ngo umuco waanyu utaba umwijima.
Iyo umaze kumenya ukuri, kandi ntaanenge ikurimo, uba weese umurikiwe n’umuco nk’umuntu umurikiweho n’itaara ryaka caane."
Yesu amaze kuvuga ayo magambo, umwe mu Bafarisaayo aramuraarika ngo aje gufungura iwe mu rugo. Yinjira mu nzu, ariicara, ngo afungure.
Umufarisaayo atangaazwa no kubona Yesu atabanje gukaraba intoki nk’uko umugenzo waabo wari uri.
Umwami Yesu aramubwira ati, "Mwa Bafarisaayo mwe, muboneza igikopu n’isahaani inyuma ariko munda mwuzuyemo ubusambo n’ubugome.
Mwa bapfaapfa mwe! Iyaremye inyuma si yo yaremye no munda?
Ahuubwo mugire ubuntu bwo guha abakene ni bwo muzaabonera hoose.

Mwa Bafarisaayo mwe, muzaabona ishano kuko muha Imaana kimwe ca cumi c’agace ka buri kintu kiva mu mboga ziri mu mirima yaanyu, mukirengagiza gukora ibikwiriye no gukunda Imaana. Ibyo byose mukwiriye kubikora ntihagire ibyo mureka by’ingirakamaro.
Muzaabona ishano mwa Bafarisaayo mwe kuko mushaaka kwicazwa mu ntebe z’ibyubahiro zisangwa mu masinagoogi mugashaaka kuramutswa mu byubahiro mu mateeraniro y’abantu no mu maguriro.
Muzaabona ishano, kuko mumeze nk’ibituuro bitareebeka maze abantu bakabigenda heejuru kuko bitagaragara."
Nuuko umuhanga mu biigiishamategeko aramusubiza ati, "Mwigiisha mu byo uvuze uradututse."
Yesu aramubwira ati, "Namwe biigiishamategeko muzaabona ishano kuko mwikoreza abantu imitwaro iremeereye, badashoboye kwikorera kandi namwe ubwanyu ntimuyikozeho n’urutoki ngo mubaakiire.
Muzaabona ishano kuko mwubaka ibituuro by’abahanuuzi biishwe na ba sogokuruza baanyu.
Ibyo mukora, bigaragaza ko mushiima ibyo ba sogokuruza baanyu baakoze, kuko biishe abahanuuzi naho mwebwe mukabuubakira ibituuro.
Ni yo mpamvu Imaana mu bwenge bwayo yaravuze iti, ‘Nzaabatumaho intumwa n’abahanuuzi. Bamwe muri bo baziicwa, naho abandi babarenganye’
kugira ngo abantu b’iki gihe babarweho amaraso y’abahanuuzi boose biishwe uheereye ku kuremwa kw’isi.
Uheereye ku kwicwa kwa Abeeli , ukageza ku kwa Zaakariya wo biiciye hagati y’aheera h’Inzu y’Imaana ku gicaaniro. Ni ukuri ndababwira yuuko ayo maraso yoose azaabazwa ab’iki gihe.
Muzaabona ishano mwebwe abiigiishamategeko kuko mwakinze inzira ituma abantu bamenya Imaana. Mwebwe ubwanyu ntimwinjira, n’abaashaaka kwinjira murababuza."
Nuuko Yesu asohotse, Abafarisaayo n’abiigiishamategeko batangira kumuhakanya bafite ubukana bwinshi,
kuko bari bashaaka kumutegeesha amagambo ngo babone uko bamushinja.
Nuuko abantu ibihumbi n’ibihumbi bateeranira aho Yesu ari, bagera n’aho bakandagirana. Abwira abiigiishwa be ati, "Mwirinde umusemburo w’Abafarisaayo ari wo buryarya.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko ari ntaacahishwe kitazaahishuurwa, kandi ko ari ntaabanga ritazaamenyekana.
Nuuko reero ibyo mwavugiye mu rwihereero byose, bizumvikanira ku mugaragaro. Ndetse n’ibyo mwongoreraniye ahiihereereye bizaarangururirwa ku mugaragaro."
Yesu akomezamo ati, "Nshuti zanje, ntimugatinye abantu bashobora kubiica ariko ntaakindi baashobora kubatwara.
Ahuubwo ndababwira yuuko mutinya Imaana ifite ububaasha bwo kwica umuntu ikanamujugunya mu muriro utazima. Koko ndabibabwiye, uwo abe ari we mutinya.
Mbese, ibishwi bitaanu ntibigura ibiceri bibiri gusa? Imaana ntiyakwibagirwa na kimwe muri byo.
Ndetse n’umusatsi wo ku mitwe yaanyu woose warabazwe. Nuuko ntimugatinye kuko murusha agaciiro ibishwi byinshi."
Nuuko Yesu arababwira ati, "Ndababwira ukuri yuuko umuntu weese uzampamiriza imbere y’abantu, Umwana w’Umuntu na we azaamuhamiriza imbere y’abaamalayika b’Imaana.
Ariko unyihakanira imbere y’abantu, Umwana w’umuntu azamwihakanira imbere y’abaamalayika b’Imaana.
Umuntu weese uvuga naabi Umwana w’Umuntu azaababarirwa, ariko utuka Umwuka Weera, ntaazaababarirwa na hato.
Nibabashira imbere mu masinagoogi, no mu batware hamwe no mu bacaamanza, ntimuzaahagarike umutima w’ibyo muziireguuza cangwa w’ibyo muzaavuga.
Ico gihe Umwuka Weera azaabamenyeesha ico mukwiriye kuvuga."
Maze umwe muri abo bantu abwira Yesu ati, "Mwigiisha bwira mukuru wanje tugabane umurage twasigiwe na daata."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Nshuti yanje, ni nde wangize umucaamanza cangwa uwo kubagabira ibintu byanyu."
Arongera arababwira ati, "Mwitonde kandi mube maaso ku bintu byo kurarikira, kuko ubugingo bw’umuntu butava mu bukire bw’ibyo afite."
Maze Yesu abaciira uyu mugani ati, "Haabaayeho umugabo w’umukire wari ufite itaka ryeraga caane.
Yiigiira inaama ati, ‘Nzaakora nte, ko ntafite umwanya uhaagije wo guhunikamo imyaka yanje?’
Maze aravuga ati, ‘Nzaakora ntya: Ndasenya ibigega mpunikamo, maze nuubake binini birutaho umwo nzaaja mpunika imyaka yanje yoose hamwe n’ibindi bintu byanje ntunze.
Nooneho niibwire nti: Ubu ufite ibyiza byinshi wibiikiye bizaagutunga igihe kireekire wiriire kandi winywere maze udamarare.’
Ariko Imaana iramubwira iti, ‘Wa mupfaapfa we! Iri joro urakuurwaho ubugingo bwawe. Noone se ibyo washaatse bizaaba ibya nde?’
Uku ni ko bizaaba ku muntu weese wirundaanyiriza ubukire bwo mu isi adafitanye ubumwe n’Imaana."

Nuuko Yesu abwira abiigiishwa be ati, "Ni co gituma mbabwira nti, ‘Ntimukiiganyire ku bw’ubugingo bwanyu ngo muhagarike umutima muti, tuzaarya iki, cangwa muteekereze ibyerekeye umubiri ngo tuzambara iki?’
Ubugingo buruta caane ibyokurya n’imyambaro.
Mureebere ku nyoni zo mu kireere, ntaabwo zihinga cangwa ngo zisaaruure. Ntizifite n’amazu zihunikamo cangwa ibigega, nyamara Imaana irazigaburira. Ntimuuzi se ko muziruta inshuro nyinshi?
Ni nde muri mwe wakwiyongeraho n’isaaha imwe yoonyine ku bugingo bwe ku bwo guhagarika umutima?
Noone se niiba mutashobora gukora ikintu gito nk’iki, ni iki kibahagarikiisha umutima ku bindi bintu.
Nimureebe kandi uko ibimori byo mu gasozi bikura. Ntibigira umurimo bikora cangwa ngo bigire imyambaro bidoda ariko ndababwira yuuko na Solomooni mu bukire bwe, atiigeze yambara neeza nka byo.
Imaana iha ubwiza ibimera byose byo mu gasozi, bibaho uyu munsi, ariko ejo bigataabwa mu muriro. Noone se ntizaabakorera ibirutaho mwa bafite kwizeera guke mwe?
Nuuko ntimugahagarike umutima w’ibyokurya cangwa ibyokunywa ngo abe ari byo muhozaho umutima.
Ibi byose abatiizeera Imaana bo mu isi na bo barabishaakiisha. Naho mwe So wo mu ijuru azi ko mubyifuuza.
Ahuubwo mbere ya byose, mushaake Ubwami bw’Imaana, niho ibyo muzaabyongererwa.
Mwa biigiishwa banje mwe, nuubwo muri bake, ntimugaatinye kuko So aneezeezwa no kubaha Ubwami bwe.
Muguriishe ubutunzi bwanyu maze amashilingi muyafashishe abakene. Mwishaakire ubutunzi buhoraho ari bwo bukire bwo mu ijuru butagira iherezo kandi aho abajuura bataabwiba cangwa inyenzi ngo ziburye.
Ndababwira ko aho ubukire bw’umuntu buri, ari ho n’umutima we uzaaba.
Nuuko muhore mwiteguuye kandi amataara yaanyu yake.
Mumere nk’abagaragu bategereza sheebuja ngo ave mu bukwe kugira ngo naagaruka agakomanga, baheereko bamukinguurire.
Abagaragu bo sheebuja azaasanga biiteguuye, ni bo bazaagororerwa. Ndababwira ukuri yuuko azaakenyera, akabiicaza, akabagaburira.
Abagaragu bo sheebuja azaasanga bari maaso aho azaazira hoose, haba nijoro cangwa mu gitondo kare, bazaagororerwa.
Mwibuke ko iyo nyirirugo aza kumenya isaaha umujuura aribuuzire mu nzu ye, ntiyakwemeye ko inzu ye icukurwa.
Namwe reero mukwiriye kwiteeguura, kuko Umwana w’Umuntu azaaza mu gihe mudateekereza."
Nuuko Peetero aravuga ati, "Nyagasani, uyu mugani ni twe uwuciiriye twenyine cangwa ni abantu boose?"
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ni nde mugaragu w’ubwenge kandi udahemuka wo sheebuja azaasigira umurimo wo kugaburira abandi bagaragu mu gihe gikwiriye?
Uwo mugaragu wo sheebuja azaaza agasanga yarakoze ibikwiriye azaagororerwa.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko sheebuja azaamuha gutegeka ibye byose.
Ariko uwo umugaragu natangira kwibwira ko sheebuja atari bugaruke vuba, agatangira gukubita bagenzi be, akiiriira, akinywera ndetse agasinda,
sheebuja azaaza umunsi uwo mugaragu atamwiteguuye n’igihe ataazi. Azaamuhana bikabije hamwe n’abantu batiizeera.
Umugaragu weese uzi ico sheebuja ashaaka ntaaciteho, ngo agikore nk’uko yategetswe, azaakubitwa inkoni nyinshi.
Ariko umugaragu utaazi byinshi byo sheebuja ashaaka, agakora ibidakwiriye, azaakubitwa inkoni nke. Uwahaawe byinshi azaabazwa byinshi kandi n’uwahaawe byinshi birutaho, aziishuzwa byinshi kurutaho.
Nazanywe no gukongeza umuriro ku isi, icampa uwo muriro ukaba umaze gufata!
Mfite umubatizo w’umubabaro uteeye ubwoba nzaabatizwa, bimpagaritse umutima kugeza igihe bizaarangirira.
Mbese mwibwira ko naaje kuuzana amahoro mu isi? Oya rwose! Ahuubwo naaje gutandukanya abantu.
Kuva ubu, abantu bataanu bo mu muryango umwe, ntibazaahuuza. Batatu bazaarwanya babiri, n’abandi babiri barwanye batatu.
Umuhungu ntaazaahuuza na se, na se ntaazaahuuza n’umuhungu we. Umukoobwa ntazaahuuza na nyina, kandi nyina yeguhuuza n’umukoobwa we, ndetse n’umukazaana na nyirabukwe, ntibazaahuuza."
Arongera abwira abantu ati, "Iyo muboonye igicu giturutse iburengerazuuba, muravuga muti, ‘Imvura igiiye kugwa’ kandi koko ikagwa.
Kandi iyo umuyaga uhuuha uturutse mu majeepfo, muravuga muti, ‘Haraba ubushuhe bwinshi’ kandi ni ko biba.
Mwa ndyarya mwe! Mbese ko muuzi gusobaanura impindahinduka y’umunsi n’ikireere, ni kuki mutamenya gusobaanura iby’iki gihe?
Mwebwe se ni kuki mutamenya guhitamo igikwiriye?
Nuujaana n’umuntu ukurega ku mucaamanza, ugerageze wiyuzuze na we mutaraagera imbere y’umucaamanza, bigatuma umucaamanza agushikiriza umusirikare, maze na we akagushira mu gihome.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko utazaavamo utari wishura umwenda woose hadasigayeyo n’ishilingi n’imwe."
Muri ico gihe, haari abantu baabwiye Yesu ibyabaaye ku Banyagalileeya. Bamuteekerereza uko Pilaato yiciishije bamwe mu gihe baatambaga ibitambo.
Yesu arababaza ati, "Mbese muteekereza ko abo Banyagalileeya baababajwe batyo, baari abanyabyaha kuruta abandi Banyagalileeya boose?
Oya, si byo rwose! Ahuubwo namwe nimutiihana muzaarimbuka mutyo mwese.
Cangwa se ba bantu cumi n’umunaane bo umunaara w’i Silowamu wagwiriye ukabiica, muteekereza ko baari abanyabyaha kuruta abandi bantu boose b’i Yerusaalemu?
Oya, si byo rwose. Ahuubwo namwe nimutiihana muzaarimbuka mutyo mwese."
Yesu abaciira uyu mugani ati, "Umuntu yari afite igiti ciitwa umutiini yateeye mu murima we w’imizaabibu. Yahoraga agishaakaho imbuto, ariko ntaazibone.
Nuuko nyir’umurima abwira umuhinzi w’imizaabibu ye ati, ‘Dore hashize imyaka itatu nza gushaaka imbuto kuri uyu mutiini sinzibone, uwurandure kuko ari nta mpamvu ituma ukomeza kunyuunyusa ubutaka.’
Umuhinzi aramusubiza ati, ‘Daatabuja, wureke umare undi mwaka umwe gusa. Ngiiye kuwuhingira, ngufumbire,
ahaari wazaageraho ukeera imbuto umwaka utaaha. Ariko nuuteera imbuto, uzaawurandure.’ "
Igihe kimwe ku munsi w’Isaabato, Yesu yigiishirizaga abantu mu isinagoogi.
Mu bo yigiishaga, haarimo umugore ufite dayimooni iteera ubumuga. Uwo mugore yari amaze imyaka cumi n’umunaane ahetamye umugongo adashobora kuunama na hato.
Yesu amuboonye aramuhamagara ngo aze aho ari, aramubwira ati, "Mugore ubohoowe ubumuga bwawe."
Amurambikaho ibiganza, ako kaanya uwo mugore arakira, ahagarara yemye, ahimbaza Imaana.

Ariko umutware mukuru w’isinagoogi biramuraakaza caane kuko Yesu akijije umuntu ku Isaabato. Abwira abantu ati, "Mu cumweru harimo iminsi itandatu gusa yo gukorerwamo imirimo. Iyo minsi, abe ari yo muja muuziramo gukizwa indwara, ariko umunsi w’Isaabato ni uwo kuruhuukiraho."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Mwa ndyarya mwe! Mbese ni nde utaazitura inka cangwa indogobe ye ku Isaabato mu kiraaro ngo ayijaane kuyuhira cangwa kuyiragira?
Noone uyu mugore, dore imyaka ibaaye cumi n’umunaane aboshwe na Sataani kandi ari umukoobwa w’Aburahamu. Mbese ntibyari ngombwa ko abohoorwa ku munsi w’Isaabato?"
Yesu amaze kuvuga ibyo, abaamuhakanyaga boose bakorwa n’isoni. Naho abandi boose baari bateeraniye aho, biishiimira imirimo myiza akoze.
Maze Yesu arababaza ati, "Mbese Ubwami bw’Imaana bumeze bute cangwa nabugereranya n’iki?
Bwagereranywa n’akabuto gato kitwa sinaapi, ko umuntu yajaanye mu murima we akakabiba. Haanyuma karakura, kavamo igiti. Inyoni zo mu kireere zaarika ibyari mu mashami yaaco."
Yongera kubaza abantu ati, "Ubwami bw’Imaana naabugereranya n’iki?
Bwagereranywa n’umusemburo wo umugore yavanze mu ndengo itatu z’ifu kugeza aho byose byatutumbiye."
Nuuko Yesu aja i Yerusaalemu, anyura mu matawuni menshi no mu byaro, agenda yigiisha abantu.
Umuntu aramubaza ati, "Nyagasani, mbese abazaakizwa si bake?" Yesu aramusubiza ati,
"Mugire umwete wo kunyura mu muryango ufunganye. Ndababwira ukuri yuuko benshi bazaashaaka kuwunyuramo, ariko ntibabishobore.
Nyir’urugo naamara gukinga uruugi rw’inzu, mwebwe abari hanze mugakomanga mumwinginga muti, ‘Daatabuja, dukinguurire,’ na we azaabasubiza ati, ‘Simbaazi ndetse sinzi n’aho muturuka.’
Nyuma muzaavuga muti, ‘Twasangiye naawe ibyokurya n’ibyokunywa, kandi wigiishirizaga mu nzira z’iwaacu.’
Ariko azaababwira ati, ‘Simbaazi, sinzi n’aho muturuka, nimumve imbere mwese mwa nkozi z’ibibi mwe!’
Hazaabaho kurira no guhekenya ameenyo ubwo muzaabona Aburahamu, Isaaka na Yaakobo n’abandi bahanuuzi boose bari mu Bwami bw’Imaana naho mwe mukajugunywa hanze.
Abandi bantu bazaaza baturutse i burasirazuuba n’iburengerazuuba, abandi baturuke amajeepfo n’amajaaruguru basangire mu Bwami bw’Imaana.
Nuuko reero hariho ab’inyuma bazaaba ab’imbere, n’ab’imbere bazaaba ab’inyuma."
Uwo munsi, Abafarisaayo bamwe baaza aho Yesu ari, baramubwira bati, "Va hano uhunge kuko Herodi ashaaka kukwica."

Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Nimugende mumbwirire iyo ngunzu yiyoberanya muti, ‘Dore ndakomeza kwirukana abadayimooni no gukiza abarwayi uyu munsi n’ejo, nuuko ku munsi wa gatatu nzaaba ndangije gukora ibyanzanye.’
Uko byaba koose, nkwiriye gukomeza urugendo rwanje uyu munsi, ejo ndetse n’ejobundi, kuko bidashoboka ko umuhanuuzi yicirwa ahandi, hatari i Yerusaalemu.

Bantu b’i Yerusaalemu, bantu b’i Yerusaalemu! Mwica abahanuuzi kandi mukiiciisha amabuye ababatumweho! Ni kangaahe nashaatse kurundarunda abaana baanyu nk’uko inkoko ibundikira ubushwi mu mababa yaayo, ariko ntimunkundire?
Nooneho reero nimwumve, inzu yaanyu ibasigiwe ari umusaka. Ndababwira yuuko mutazambona kugeza ubwo muzaavuga muti, ‘Hahiirwa uje mu izina ry’Imaana.’ "
Ku munsi w’Isaabato, Yesu aja mu rugo rw’Umufarisaayo mukuru ngo basangire. Nuuko Abafarisaayo hamwe n’abiigiishamategeko baari aho, baramugenzuura.
Imbere ye haari umugabo ubyimbye amaguru n’amaboko.
Yesu abaza Abafarisaayo n’abiigiishamategeko ati, "Mbese amategeko yemerera gukiza umuntu ku munsi w’Isaabato?"
Ariko ntibaagira ico bamusubiza. Nuuko Yesu amufataho, aramukiza, aramuseezerera.

Maze Yesu arababaza ati, "Umwana waawe aramutse aguuye mu kidiba ntiwamuvaanamo ako kaanya nuubwo haaba ku munsi w’Isaabato? Cangwa se ikimasa caawe kiguuye mu kidiba ku munsi w’Isaabato ntiwagikuuramo?"
Ntibaagira ico bamusubiza.
Yesu yitegereje uko bamwe mu baaraaritswe bashaaka kwicara mu myanya y’ibyubahiro, abaciira umugani ati,
"Umuntu naagutumira mu bushitsi ntukiihitiremo kwicara mu ntebe y’icuubahiro, kuko haaba hari undi muntu waraaritswe ukurusha icuubahiro,
maze uwabatumiye akakubwira ati, ‘Imukira uyu yicare’. Ibyo reero byagukoza isoni baguhagurukije ukaja mu mwanya w’inyuma.
Ahuubwo nuutumirwa uziicare inyuma y’abandi boose, maze uwagutumiye naaza aho uri, akubwire ati, ‘Nshuti yanje ngwino wicare mu mwanya mwiza.’ Nuuko naawe uzaabona icuubahiro boose babireeba.
Ndababwira yuuko uwishira heejuru weese, azaaciishwa bugufi. Ariko umuntu wiciisha bugufi, azaashirwa heejuru."

Yesu abwira uwamuraaritse ati, "Nuutumira abantu ngo musangire ku manywa cangwa nijoro, ntugatumire inshuti zaawe, cangwa beene so, cangwa abavandimwe baawe, cangwa abatuuranyi b’abakire, kuko bazaakuraarika naawe bakwituura ineeza wabagiriye.
Ahuubwo nuutumira, uzaatumire abakene, n’abafite uburema, n’abacumbagira hamwe n’impumyi.
Nugenza utyo, Imaana izaaguha umugisha, kuko abo uzaaba watumiye ntaaco bazaakwituura, ahuubwo uziishurwa intungaane zizuutse."
Maze umwe mu baari baatumiwe, yumviise ibyo Yesu avuze, aramubwira ati, "Hahiirwa umuntu weese uzeemererwa gufungurira mu Bwami bw’Imaana."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Hari umuntu wateguuye ibirori bihebuuje, maze atumira abantu benshi.
Igihe c’ubukwe kigeze, atuma umugaragu kubwira abaaraaritswe ati, ‘Nimuuze byose byateguuwe.’
Ariko boose batangira gutanga impamvu z’urwitwazo. Uwa mbere aravuga ati, ‘Naguze umurima kandi ngomba kuja kuwureeba, nyaabuna mbabarira.’
Undi na we ati, ‘Naguze ibimasa cumi byo guhingiisha, noone ubu ngiiye kubigerageza nyaabuna umbabarire.’
Undi na we aravuga ati, ‘Naarongoye, sinshobora kuuza.’

Nuuko umugaragu wari watumwe asubiyeyo, abiteekerereza sheebuja. Maze sheebuja araraakara caane aramutegeka ati, ‘Genda wihuuta uje mu nzira ngari no mu nzira zipfundanye mu tawuni, maze uraarike abakene, abarema, abacumbagira hamwe n’impumyi.’
Uwo mugaragu agarutse aravuga ati, ‘Daatabuja ibyo wantegetse byose naabikoze ariko reero ibyicaro biracaariho.’
Sheebuja aramusubiza ati, ‘Ja mu nzira zoose no mu mirombero maze ubahate baaze, kugira ngo inzu yanje yuzure abantu.’
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko ntan’umwe mu baatumiwe mbere, uzaarya ku byo nateguuye."
Abantu benshi bakurikira Yesu aja i Yerusaalemu. Arahindukira abwira abamukurikiye ati,
"Umuntu weese uza aho ndi, ntankunde kurusha uko akunda se na nyina, n’umugore we, n’abaana be, na beene se, na bashiki be, ndetse n’ubugingo bwe, ntaashobora kuba umwigiishwa wanje.
Kandi umuntu uteemera kwikorera umusaraba we ngo ankurikire, ntaakwiriye kuba umwigiishwa wanje.
Mbese muri mwe ni nde waba ashaaka kuubaka umunaara mureemure, ntaabanze kwicara ngo abare igiciiro caawo, akamenya niiba afite ibyo kuwurangiza?
Bitabaaye bityo, yakuubaka urufatiro gusa, ntaashobore kurangiza ahasigaye, maze ababiboonye boose bakamuseka.
Nyuma bakavuga bati, ‘Uyu muntu yatangiye kuubaka umunaara ariko ntiyawuzuza.’

Cangwa se, umwami ufite abasirikare ibihumbi cumi, yakora iki ngo arwanye undi mwami ugiiye kumuteera afite abasirikare ibihumbi makumyabiri? Ataraaja ku rugamba ntaakwiriye kubanza yicara akareeba niiba yatsinda iyo ntambara?
Iyo amenye ko atazaayitsinda, yoohereza intumwa kuri uwo mwami akiri kure akamusaba ko babaana mu mahoro.
Nuuko reero umuntu weese muri mwe udahara ibyo atunze byose, ntaashobora kuba umwigiishwa wanje."
Yesu akomeza kubabwira ati, "Umunyu ni mwiza, ariko se iyo umaze gukayuka wakongera kuryoha ute?
Ntaakamaro uba ugifite, habe no kurumbuura umurima cangwa kuboza ifumbire, ahuubwo ujugunywa hanze. Ufite amatwi yumva, niyumve."
Umunsi umwe, abasoreesha boose hamwe n’abanyabyaha, beegeera Yesu ngo bumve ibyo avuga.
Nuuko Abafarisaayo n’abiigiishamategeko bariitotomba bati, "Uyu muntu ni inshuti y’abanyabyaha, ndetse asangira na bo."
Yesu yumviise kwitootomba kwabo, abaciira umugani ati,
"Mbese ni nde muri mwe waba afite intaama ijana akazimiza imwe muri zo, ntaasige mirongo cenda n’icenda ngo aje gushaaka intaama imwe yazimiye kugeza aho aribuyibonere?
Iyo amaze kuyibona, araneezeerwa caane, akayiterura akayishira ku bitugu
akayijana iwe. Nuuko reero agatumira inshuti n’abatuuranyi be akababwira ati, ‘Twishiimane kuko naboonye intaama yanje yari yazimiye.’
Ndababwira yuuko ari ko no mu ijuru biishiimira umunyabyaha umwe wihannye kuruta intungaane mirongo cenda n’icenda zidakeneye kwihana."

Yesu akomeza kuvuga ati, "cangwa se ni nde mugore waba afite ibiceri by’ifeeza cumi yasanga kimwe muri byo caazimiye, ntaacaane itaara, ngo akondoore inzu yoose, agashaaka yitonze kugeza ubwo aribukibonere?
Iyo amaze kukibona, atumira inshuti n’abavandimwe kuuza iwe, akababwira ati, ‘Nimuuze twishiimane kuko naboonye igiceri nari naabuze.’
Ndababwira yuuko abaamalayika b’Imaana biishiimira umunyabyaha umwe wihannye."
Yesu abaciira undi mugani ati, "Haariho umugabo wari ufite abahungu babiri.
Umuhungu muto abwira se ati, ‘Daata mpa umugabane w’ibintu nkwiriye kugabana.’ Nuuko se abagabanya ibintu bye.
Hashize iminsi mike, umuhungu muto afata umugabane we ava mu rugo aja mu gihugu ca kure. Agezeyo, aseesagura ibyo yagabanye, abikoreesha uko yishaakiye.
Ibintu bye bishize, inzara ikomeye iteera muri ico gihugu, maze arakena.
Nuuko aragenda yinginga umuntu wo muri co gihugu amuhakwaho maze amuha umurimo wo kuragira ingurube.
Uwo muhungu yabuze uwamuha ico kurya agera n’aho kwifuuza ibyokurya by’ingurube.
Atangira kwibwira ati, ‘Abakozi ba daata ni benshi, kandi bafite ibyokurya bihaagije ndetse bararya bakabisigaza, naho nje inzara igiiye kunyicira hano!
Reka mpaguruke nje kwa daata mubwire nti, daata, nacumuye ku Maana no kuri wowe,
ntibinkwiriye kwitwa umwana waawe, ndakwinginze ndeka mbe nk’umwe mu bakozi baawe.’
Nuuko arahaguruka asubira kwa se. Akiri kure, se aramubona, maze amugirira impuhwe. Arirukanka, aramuhoobera, maze aramusoma.
Nuuko uwo mwana abwira se ati, ‘Daata, nacumuye ku Maana no kuri wowe. Ntibinkwiriye kwitwa umwana waawe.’
Ariko se ahamagara abagaragu be arababwira ati, ‘Mumuuzanire imyambaro myiza, muyimwambike. Mumwambike impeta mu rutoki, n’ingato mu birenge.
Muuzane n’ikimasa c’umushishe, mukibaage maze turye, twishiime,
kuko uyu mwana wanje yari yarapfuuye, noone yazuutse. Yari yarazimiye, noone dore arabonetse.’ Nuuko batangira kwishiima.
Mu gihe biishiimaga, mukuru we abe araaje avuuye mu murima gukora, yumva baririmba, babyina.
Ahamagara umwe mu bagaragu, amubaza ibyabaaye.
Uwo mugaragu aramusubiza ati, ‘Murumuna waawe yagarutse mu rugo, noone so yategetse ko bamubagira ikimasa c’umushishe kuko yagarutse ari muzima.’
Mukuru we aheerako araakara, yanga kwinjira mu nzu. Se arasohoka, aja kumuhendahenda ngo yinjire.

Ariko uwo muhungu asubiza se ati, ‘Dore, maze imyaka myinshi ngukorera nk’umugaragu, nta tegeko ryawe na rimwe niigeze ngomera. Ntaaco wigeze umpa nuubwo kaaba agahene ngo niishiimane n’inshuti zanje.
Noone uyu mwana waawe wagarutse amaze guseesagura ibyawe mu ndaaya ni we wabaagiye ikimasa c’umushishe?’
Se aramusubiza ati, ‘Mwana wanje ibihe byose turabaana kandi ibyanje byose ni ibyawe.
Ariko byari bikwiriye rwose ko tugira umunsi wo kuneezeerwa kuko uyu murumuna waawe yari yarapfuuye noone yazuutse. Yari yarazimiye noone dore arabonetse.’"
Yesu aciira abiigiishwa be uyu mugani ati, "Haariho umukire wari ufite umutegeka wo yashinze ibintu bye byose. Igihe kimwe uwo mutegeka bamurega kuri sheebuja ko aseesagura umutungo we.
Nuuko sheebuja amutumaho aramubwira ati, ‘Ibyo nkumvaho ni ibiki? Nyanzurira ibyanje byose kuko utakiri umutegeka w’ibintu byanje.’
Uwo mutegeka ariibaza ati, ‘Ndakora iki ko daatabuja agiiye kunyirukana ku murimo? Dore sinashobora guhinga, kandi no gusabiriza byankoza isoni.
Ubu mboonye uko nzaabigenza kugira ngo niimara kubura umurimo, nzaabone abanyakiira mu mago yaabo.’
Nuuko ahamagara buri muntu wari urimo umwenda wa sheebuja. Abaza uwa mbere ati, ‘Urimo umwenda wa daatabuja ungana iki?’
Aramusubiza ati, ‘Ibibindi ijana by’amavuta ya elayo.’ Uwo mutegeka aramubwira ati, ‘Fata urwandiko rw’inyishu rwawe, wicare vuba, wandike mirongo itaanu.’

Arongera abaza undi ati, ‘Kandi se wowe urimo umwenda ungana iki?’ Aramusubiza ati, ‘Ni indengo ijana z’ingano.’ Nuuko uwo mutegeka aramubwira ati, ‘Fata urwandiko rw’inyishu rwawe, maze wandike mirongo inaane.’

Sheebuja ashiimagiza uwo mutegeka w’umuhemu kuko yagize ubwenge bwo kwiteguurira igihe kizaaza." Nuuko Yesu akomeza kubasobaanurira ati, "Ni ukuri, abantu b’iyi si ni abanyabwenge mu mibaanire, no mu butunzi bwabo kuruta abaana b’umuco.
Nuuko reero mukoreeshe ubutunzi bw’isi mubushaakiishe inshuti kugira ngo nibushira muzaakiirwe aho muziibeera iteeka.
Buri muntu wiringirwa mu bike, yiringirwa no mu byinshi. Kandi uhemuka mu bike, ahemuka no mu byinshi.
Noone se niiba muhemuka mubiikijwe ubutunzi bw’iyi si, ni nde uzaababiitsa ubutunzi nyakuri?
Kandi niiba mutaarabaaye abiiringirwa mubiikijwe ubutunzi bw’abandi, ni nde uzaabaha ubutunzi bwo mwigengaho?
Nta mugaragu ushobora gukorera abaami babiri ngo bombi abaneezeeze. Ahuubwo yakunda umwe akanga undi. Cangwa yakuubaha umwe agasuuzugura undi. Ntimushobora gukorera Imaana n’ubutunzi."
Abafarisaayo bumviise ibyo, baramukwena kuko baakundaga amashilingi.
Yesu arababwira ati, "Mwebwe mukunda kwigira intungaane imbere y’abantu, ariko Imaana izi ibiri mu mitima yaanyu. Ico abantu baha agaciiro, kiba kigayitse imbere y’Imaana.

Mwayoborwaga n’amategeko ya Moose n’abahanuuzi kugeza igihe ca Yohaana Umubatiza. Uheereye ico gihe, ubutumwa bw’Ubwami bw’Imaana butangira kwamamazwa kandi abantu benshi bashiishiikarira kubwinjiramo.
Birooroshe ko ijuru n’isi bishira, kuruta ko agace gato k’inyugute imwe yo mu mategeko kaavaho.
Umugabo wirukana umugore we, agashaaka undi aba akoze icaaha c’ubusambanyi. Kandi n’umugabo ushohoje umugore wirukanywe n’umugabo we, aba asambanye."
Yesu arababwira ati, "Haabaayeho umuntu w’umukire, yahoraga yambaye imyambaro myiza y’igiciiro, agahora adamaraye iminsi yoose.
Haariho n’umugabo witwaga Laazaaro w’umukene kandi yahoraga aryamye ku muryango w’inzu y’uwo mukire. Umubiri we wari wuzuye ibisebe.
Yifuuzaga kurya ubuvungunyukira bw’ibyokurya bwagwaga haasi y’imeeza y’uwo mukire akabubura. Imbwa zaajaga zirigata ibisebe bye.
Igihe kigeze, wa mukene arapfa, nuuko abaamalayika bamujaana kubaana na Aburahamu. Umukire na we arapfa arahambwa.
Ageze ikuzimu, ubugingo bwe burababazwa caane. Yubuura amaaso areeba heejuru, abona Aburahamu ari kure, ari kumwe na Laazaaro iruhande rwe.
Nuuko ahamagara Aburahamu ataka caane ati, ‘Sogokuru Aburahamu! Nyaabuna mbabarira wohereze Laazaaro akoze agatoki mu maazi, abobeeze ururimi rwanje, kuko mbabazwa n’uyu muriro.’
Aburahamu aramusubiza ati, ‘Mwana wanje, wibuke ko wahaawe ibyo wari ushaaka byose ukiri ku isi, naho Laazaaro we, akagira imibeereho mibi. Ariko ubu aguuwe neeza naho wowe urababaye caane.’
Uretse n’ibyo, hari umworera hagati yaacu naawe. Ntaamuntu n’umwe ushobora kuwambuka ngo ave aho turi maze ngo aze aho uri. Cangwa ngo ave aho uri aze hano, ntibyashoboka.
Nuuko uwo mukire arongera abwira Aburahamu ati, ‘Sogokuru mbabarira, ndakwinginze ohereza Laazaaro aje i waacu mu rugo,
kuko mfite beene daata bataanu, maze abiihanangirize kugira ngo na bo batazaaza aha hantu ho kubabazwa.’
Aburahamu aramubwira ati, ‘Beene so bafite Moose n’abahanuuzi bakwiriye kubumvira.’
Maze umukire aramusubiza ati, ‘Oya sogokuru Aburahamu ibyo ntibihaagije! Ahuubwo nihagira umuntu uzuuka akabasanga, baziihana ibyaha byabo, bagarukire Imaana.’
Aburahamu aramubwira ati, ‘Niibanga kumvira Moose n’abahanuuzi, ntibaakwemera naaho umuntu yazuuka.’ "
Yesu abwira abiigiishwa be ati, "Ibituma abantu bacumura, ntibyabura kubaho. Ariko umuntu utuma abandi bacumura, azaabona ishano.
Icaaruta ni uko yahambiirwa urusyo mu ijosi, maze akarohwa mu nyanja ariko ntaacumuze umwe muri aba baana bato.
Nuuko reero mwirinde mu byo mukora byose. Mwene so naakora icaaha, umucaahe, niyihana umubabarire.
Nuubwo yagucumuraho karindwi mu munsi umwe, akagusaba imbabazi karindwi, ugomba kumubabarira."
Intumwa za Yesu ziramubwira ziti, "Daatabuja twongerere kwizeera."
Arazisubiza ati, "Mugize kwizeera kungana n’akabuto gato kitwa sinaapi, mwabwira igiti kinini c’umuvumu muti, ‘Randuka n’imizi yoose, maze witeerere mu nyanja,’ nuuko kikabumvira."
Yesu arababaza ati, "Noone se ni nde muri mwe waba afite umugaragu akamwohereza guhinga cangwa kuragira intaama, yavayo sheebuja akamubwira ati, ‘Ngwino wicare, uruhuuke maze dusangire.’
Ahuubwo ntiyavuga ati, ‘Ngaaho reero nteguurira ico kurya maze wambare neeza ungaburire, nimara kurya, naawe ubone gufungura?’
Mbese sheebuja yashiima umugaragu ku bwo kumukorera ico yamutegetse? Oya, ntiyamushiima na hato.
Nuuko reero namwe ni uko, nimwumvira, mugakora ibyo Imaana ibategetse byose, mukwiriye kuvuga muti, ‘Ntaabwo turi abagaragu bakwiriye gushimwa, kuko twakoze ibyo dushinzwe.’ "
Yesu n’abiigishwa be bakomeza urugendo baja i Yerusaalemu, banyura ku mupaka wo hagati ya Samariya na Galileeya.
Bageze mu caaro kimwe, bahuura n’ababembe cumi. Abo babembe bahagarara ahitaaruuye,
bateera heejuru bati, "Yesu, Daatabuja tubabarire, udukize!"
Yesu ababoonye arababwira ati, "Nimugende mwiyereke Abaheerezabitambo." Bakigenda, barakira.
Haanyuma umwe muri abo aboonye ko akize, agaruka ahimbaaza Imaana mu ijwi rirenga.
Apfukama imbere ya Yesu yiciishije bugufi, aramushiima caane, kandi yari Umusamariya.
Yesu arabaza ati, "Mbese sinakijije ababembe cumi? Abandi icenda bari he?
Ni kuki ari ntaawundi wagarutse gushiima Imaana uretse uyu munyamahanga?"
Maze Yesu aramubwira ati, "Haguruka ugende, kwizeera kwawe kuragukijije."
Umunsi umwe, Abafarisaayo baramubaza bati, "Ubwami bw’Imaana buzaaza ryari?" Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Ubwami bw’Imaana ntibuzaaza kumugaragaro ngo mubureebe n’amaaso yaanyu.
Kandi ntibazaavuga bati, ‘Dore nguubu hano’ cangwa ngo, ‘Nguubwo hariiya.’ Ahuubwo Ubwami bw’Imaana buri hagati muri mwe."
Nuuko Yesu abwira abiigiishwa be ati, "Igihe kizaagera co muzifuuza kubona umunsi umwe w’Umwana w’Umuntu, ariko ntimuzaawubona.
Abantu bazaababwira bati, ‘Dore Umwana w’Umuntu nguuriiya cangwa ngo nguuyu hano.’ Ariko ntimuzaajeyo ngo mubakurikire.
Igihe Umwana w’Umuntu azaaziraho, kizaamera nk’uko umurabyo, urabiriza mu ruhande rumwe rw’ikireere, ukarabagiranira mu rundi.
Ariko Umwana w’Umuntu akwiriye kubanza kubabazwa mu buryo bwinshi, ndetse no kwangwa n’abantu b’iki gihe.
Nk’uko byari bimeze mu gihe ca Nowa, ni ko bizaamera no mu gihe co kugaruka k’Umwana w’Umuntu.
Muri ico gihe, abantu baariineezeezaga, baararyaga, baaranywaga, ndetse baarashingiranwaga, kugeza umunsi Nowa yinjiriye mu nkuge . Nuuko umwuzure uraaza urabarimbura boose.
Uko ni ko byabaaye no mu gihe ca Looti. Abantu baararyaga, baranywaga, baaraguraga, bakaguriisha, bagahinga, ndetse bakuubaka,
kugeza igihe Looti yavuuye i Sodomu. Maze umuriro n’ibirimi byawo, biva mu ijuru, biragwa, birimbura abantu boose.
Uko ni ko bizaamera ku munsi Umwana w’Umuntu azeerekanwa.
Kuri uwo munsi, umuntu uzaaba ari heejuru y’inzu, ntaakazaamanuke ngo asubire mu nzu gushikiira ibintu birimo. Kandi n’uzaaba ari mu murima, ntaazaasubire mu rugo.
Mwibuke ibyabaaye ku mugore wa Looti.
Umuntu weese urengera ubugingo bwe azaabubura, ariko uhara ubugingo bwe azaaburokora.
Ndababwira yuuko muri iryo joro abantu babiri bazaaba baryamye ku buriri bumwe, umwe azaajanwa undi asigare.
Abagore babiri bazaaba bari hamwe basya, umwe azaajanwa, undi asigare."
(Abagabo babiri bazaaba bari mu murima, umwe azaajanwa naho undi asigare.)
Abiigiishwa be baramubaza bati, "Nyagasani ibyo bizaabeera he?" Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Aho intumbi iri, ni ho inkongoro ziteeranira."
Yesu aciira abiigiishwa be umugani ubiigiisha ko bakwiriye gusenga batarambirwa no kudaciika intege.
Arababwira ati, "Mu tawuni imwe, haari umucaamanza utaaruubahaga Imaana, ntiyite no ku bantu.
Kandi muri iyo tawuni, haari hatuuyemo umupfaakazi, wahoraga aza kuri uwo mucaamanza amwinginga ati, ‘Nyaabuna nkiraanura nuuwo tubuurana.’
Ariko uwo mucaamanza amara igihe kireekire atabyitaho. Haanyuma ariibwira ati, ‘Nuubwo ntubaha Imaana, kandi siniite ku bantu,
ariko kuko uyu mupfaakazi anduhije caane, ndamurengera kugira ngo adahora aza kundusha.’ "
Nuuko Yesu arongera aravuga ati, "Ntimwumva iby’umucaamanza udatunganye yavuze?
Noone se, Imaana yo ntizaatabaara intoore zaayo ziyitakira ku manywa na nijoro? Mbese izaatinda kuziitaho?
Ndababwira yuuko Imaana izaazitabaara bidatinze. Ariko se Umwana w’Umuntu naagaruka azaasanga abantu bafite ukwizeera hano ku isi?"
Yesu arongera aciira umugani bamwe mu bantu biibwiraga ko ari intungaane, kandi bagahinyura abandi boose.
Aravuga ati, "Abantu babiri baagiiye mu Nzu y’Imaana gusenga. Umwe yari Umufarisaayo, undi ari umusoreesha.
Umufarisaayo ahagarara yemye arasenga ati, ‘Ndagushiima Maana kuko ntameze nk’abandi bantu. Si ndi umunyabyaha, si ndi umujuura ndetse sinsambana, simeze nk’uriya musoreesha.
Niiyiriza ubusa kabiri mu minsi irindwi kandi ntanga kimwe ca cumi mu byo nungutse byose.’

Ariko umusoreesha ahagarara hiirya ahiitaaruuye ntiyahangaara no kuubuura amaaso ngo areebe heejuru. Ahuubwo yikubita mu gituuza yeerekana umubabaro avuga ati, ‘Nyaabuna Maana mbabarira, ndi umunyabyaha.’ "

Maze Yesu aravuga ati, "Ndababwira yuuko uyu musoreesha, yasubiye iwe ababariwe ibyaha bye byose kuruta Umufarisaayo. Umuntu weese wishira heejuru, azaaciishwa bugufi, naho uwiiciisha bugufi, azaashirwa heejuru."
Nuuko baazanira Yesu abaana bato ngo abafateho. Abiigiishwa be babiboonye barabacaaha,
ariko Yesu ahamagara abo baana ngo bamusange. Abwira abiigiishwa be ati, "Nimureke abaana bato baaze aho ndi, ntimubabuze kuko Ubwami bw’Imaana ni ubw’abameze nka bo.
Ndababwira yuuko umuntu weese utaakiira Ubwami bw’Imaana nk’umwana muto, ntiyabwinjiramo."
Maze umwe mu bakuru b’Abayuuda abaza Yesu ati, "Mwigiisha mwiza, ngomba gukora iki ngo nzaahaabwe ubugingo buhoraho?"
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Kuki unyita mwiza? Ntamwiza uriho keretse Imaana yoonyine.
Uzi amategeko ngo, ‘Ntuugasambane, ntuukiice, ntuukiibe, ntuukabeeshere abandi, wubahe so na nyoko.’ "
Na we aramusubiza ati, "Uheereye mu buto bwanje, ayo yoose narayakurikije."
Yesu yumviise ibyo aramubwira ati, "Hari ico usigaje gukora. Guriisha ubutunzi bwawe bwose, maze ibivuuyemo ubigabire abakene, nuurangiza ubone kunkurikira. Ubwo ni bwo uzunguka ibihembo mu ijuru."
Ariko uwo mugabo yumviise ibyo biramubabaza caane kuko yari umukire uhebuuje.
Yesu abiboonye abwira abantu ati, "Mbeega ukuntu biruhije ko abakire baakwinjira mu Bwami bw’Imaana!
Birooroshe caane ko ingamiya inyura mu gapfumure k’urusindaani kuruta ko umukire yakwinjira mu Bwami bw’Imaana."
Abantu bumviise Yesu avuze ibyo, baravuga bati, "Noone se ubwo bimeze bityo, ni nde ubaasha gukizwa?"
Yesu arababwira ati, "Ibidashobokera abantu, ku Maana birashoboka."
Peetero abwira Yesu ati, "Dore twebwe twasize ibyacu byose turagukurikira."
Yesu arababwira ati, "Ndababwira yuuko umuntu weese usiga urugo rwe, cangwa umugore we, cangwa beene nyina, cangwa ababyeyi be, cangwa abaana be ku bw’Ubwami bw’Imaana,
azaahaabwa ibirutaho inshuro nyinshi muri iki gihe, kandi no mu gihe kizaaza, azaahaabwa ubugingo buhoraho."
Yesu yihereerana abiigiishwa be cumi na babiri arababwira ati, "Dore turazaamuuka i Yerusaalemu, maze ibyanditswe ku Mwana w’Umuntu byose bizuuzuzwa.
Azaagabizwa Abanyamahanga, azaashinyagurirwa, kandi bazaamuciiraho amacandwe.
Kandi nibamara kumukubita inkoni, bazamwica. Ariko ku munsi wa gatatu azaazuuka."
Abiigiishwa be ntibaabisobaanukirwa, kuko ayo magambo baari bayahishwe, ntibaamenya ico yamenyeeshaga.
Igihe Yesu yari haafi kugera i Yeriko, haari umuntu uhumye wicaye iruhande rw’inzira asabiriza.
Yumviise abantu banyuraho basakuza, ababaza ibyo ari byo.
Baramusubiza bati, "Ni Yesu w’i Nazaareeti unyuraho."
Nuuko ateera heejuru avuga ati, "Yesu Mwana wa Dawudi, ngirira imbabazi!"
Abantu baari imbere ya Yesu baramucaaha ngo aceceke, ariko we arushaho gusakuza ati, "Mwene Dawudi, ngirira imbabazi!"
Yesu arahagarara, ategeka ko bamumuzanira. Bamugejeje aho ari, aramubaza ati,
"Urashaaka ko ngukorera iki?" Aramusubiza ati, "Nyagasani, ndashaaka kongera kureeba."
Nuuko Yesu aramubwira ati, "Reeba! Kwizeera kwawe kuragukijije."
Muri ako kaanya arahumuuka, akurikira Yesu asingiza Imaana. Abantu boose baboonye ibibaaye, na bo basingiza Imaana.
Yesu yinjira i Yeriko maze ayinyuramo.
Haariho umugabo witwaga Zaakaayo, wari mukuru w’abasoreesha kandi ari umukire.
Yagerageje kureeba Yesu ngo amumenye, ariko ntiyabishobora kuko yari mugufi kandi abantu baari benshi.
Nuuko ariiruka aja imbere, yurira igiti kugira ngo areebe Yesu, kuko yari azi ko agiiye kunyuraho.
Yesu ageze kuri ico giti, areeba heejuru abona Zaakaayo maze aramubwira ati, "Zaakaayo, manuka vuba muri ico giti, kuko uyu munsi ndaraara mu nzu yaawe."
Ako kaanya Zaakaayo yururuka vuba yakiira Yesu aneezeerewe.
Abaabiboonye boose, batangira kwitootomba bavuga bati, "Agiiye kubaramira umunyabyaha."
Haanyuma Zaakaayo arahaguruka abwira Yesu ati, "Nyagasani, kimwe ca kabiri c’ibintu mfite, ndagiha abakene. Kandi uwo nambuye weese nsoreesha, ndamuriha inshuro enye."
Yesu aravuga ati, "Uyu munsi agakiza kaaje muri iyi nzu, kuko uyu mugabo na we ari umwana wa Aburahamu.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko Umwana w’Umuntu yaaje gushaaka no gukiza abaazimiye."

Yesu n’abantu baari bamukurikiye bagera bugufi bw’i Yerusaalemu. Abantu, baari kumwe na we baatekerezaga ko Ubwami bw’Imaana buribugaragare bagezeyo. Bacumva ibyo yababwiraga, abaciira uyu mugani ati,
"Haabaayeho umuntu w’igikomangoma, azindukira mu gihugu ca kure kugira ngo yimikirweyo, byarangira akagaruka mu gihugu ce.
Ataraagenda, ahamagara icumi mu bagaragu be, abaheereza ibiceri icumi by’ifeeza. Arababwira ati, ‘Mubikoreeshe neeza mu bucuruuzi, kugeza igihe nzaagarukira.’
Ariko abatuurage be baaramwangaga. Amaze kugenda, boohereza intumwa zo kumukurikira zivuga ziti, ‘Ntidushaaka ko uyu mugabo atubeera umwami.’
Amaze kwimikwa aragaruka, ategeka ko bamuuzanira abagaragu yasigiye ibiceri cumi by’ifeeza kugira ngo amenye ico buri muntu yungutse.
Umugaragu wa mbere araaza aravuga ati, ‘Mwami, ifeeza wampaaye yungutse izindi cumi.’
Umwami aramusubiza ati, ‘Warakoze mugaragu mwiza. Kuko wabaaye umwiringirwa mu bintu bike, nguhaaye kuba umutware w’amatawuni makuru cumi.’
Umugaragu wa kabiri na we araaza aramubwira ati, ‘Mwami, ifeeza wampaaye yungutse izindi itaanu.’
Umwami aramusubiza ati, ‘Ube umutware w’itawuni itaanu.’
Undi mugaragu na we araaza aramubwira ati, ‘Mwami, dore ifeeza yaawe ngiiyi, nayipfunyitse neeza mu gitambaaro.
Naragutinye kuko uri umugabo w’umunyamwaga. Ujaana ibitari ibyawe, ugasaaruura ibyo utaabibye.’
Umwami aramusubiza ati, ‘Ndaguciira urubanza nkurikije ibiturutse mu kanwa kaawe wa mugaragu mubi we. Uvuga yuuko ndi umunyamwaga, kandi ko njaana ibyo ntaabiitse, ngasaaruura ibyo ntaabibye!
Kuki utaahaaye iyo feeza abacuruuzi ngo bayikoreeshe ivemo indamu?’
Nuuko umwami abwira abaari bahagaze aho ati, ‘Nimuyimwake, muyiheereze umugaragu ufite ifeeza icumi.’
Ariko baramubwira bati, ‘Daatabuja, dore asanzwe afite ifeeza cumi!’
Umwami arabasubiza ati, ‘Ndababwira ukuri yuuko ufite weese, azongererwaho, naho udafite, na gake afite azaagakuurwaho.
Naho abanzi banje bataashaakaga ko mbabeera umwami, nimubaazane hano biicirwe imbere yanje.’ "
Yesu arangije kuvuga ibyo, akomeza urugendo yeerekeje i Yerusaalemu.
Ageze bugufi bw’i Betifaage n’i Beetaniya ku musozi wiitwa Elayoni, yoohereza abiigiishwa be babiri,
arababwira ati, "Nimugende mu caaro kiri imbere yaanyu, nimuhagera, murahasanga icaana c’indogobe kiziritse kitari caaheeka umuntu. Mukiziture maze mukinzanire.
Nihagira ubabaza ati, ‘Kuki mukizitura?’ Mumubwire muti, ‘Daatabuja ni we ugishaaka.’"
Baragenda, babona ico caana c’indogobe nk’uko Yesu yari yababwiye.
Bakizitura ico caana c’indogobe, ba nyiraco baraaza barababaza bati, "Murakiziturira iki?"
Barabasubiza bati, "Daatabuja ni we ugishaaka."
Nuuko abo biigiishwa baazaanira Yesu ico caana c’indogobe. Bakirambikaho imyenda yaabo maze aciicaraho.
Yagendaga basasa imyenda yaabo mu nzira.
Ageze bugufi n’inzira imanuka ku musozi wa Elayoni, iteeraniro rinini ry’abiigiishwa be batangira guhimbaaza Imaana n’ijwi rirenga ku bw’ibitangaaza baboonye byose bati,
"Hahiirwa Umwami uje mu izina rya Nyagasani! Amahoro abe mu ijuru, n’icuubahiro kibe ic’Imaana mu ijuru."
Ariko Abafarisaayo baari muri iryo teeraniro babwira Yesu bati, "Mwigiisha, bwira abiigiishwa baawe baceceke."
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Ndababwira ukuri yuuko aba bacecetse, amabuye yarangurura."
Yesu yegeereje itawuni y’i Yerusaalemu, arayiitegereza maze arayiririra kuko yagiriye impuhwe abantu bayituuyemo ndetse na yo ubwayo.
Aravuga ati, "Iyo umenya uyu munsi ibyaguheesha amahoro! Ariko reero dore bihishwe amaaso yaawe.
Igihe kiregeereje ubwo abanzi baawe bazaakuzitirira, bakakugota baguteeye impande zoose.
Bazaakurimbura, n’abaana baawe bagutuuyemo, nta buye rizaasigara rigeretse ku rindi, kuko utaamenye igihe Imaana yaziye kugutabaara."
Haanyuma y’ibyo, Yesu yinjira mu Nzu y’Imaana atangira kwirukana abantu baacururizagamo.
Arababwira ati, "Handitswe ngo, ‘Inzu yanje izaaba inzu yo gusengeramo,’ ariko mwebwe mwayihinduye iteeraniro ry’abajuura."
Buri munsi Yesu yigiishirizaga mu Nzu y’Imaana. Abaheerezabitambo bakuru n’abiigiishamategeko n’abakuru b’imiryango y’Abayuuda, baashaakaga kumwica,
ariko babura aho bamuturuka kuko abantu benshi baazaga kumutega amatwi biitaaye ku magambo ye.
Umunsi umwe, Yesu yigiishaga abantu avuga Ubutumwa Bwiza mu Nzu y’Imaana. Aciigiisha, abakuru b’abaheerezabitambo n’abiigiishamategeko hamwe n’abakuru b’Abayuuda baja aho ari
baramubaza bati, "Tubwire, ni bubaasha ki butuma ushobora gukora ibi bintu? Ni nde waguhaaye ubwo bubaasha?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Reka nanje mbabaze.
Mbese ububaasha Yohaana yari afite bwo kubatiza bwaturutse ku Maana cangwa ni ku bantu?"
Batangira kubwirana bati, "Nituvuga ko bwaturutse ku Maana, aratubaza icaatumye tutamwemera,
kandi nituvuga ngo bwaturutse mu bantu, abantu baraduteera amabuye, kuko beemera ko Yohaana yari umuhanuuzi woherejwe n’Imaana."
Bagezaho baramusubiza bati, "Ntituuzi aho bwaturutse."
Yesu arababwira ati, "Nuuko reero nanje simbabwira ububaasha bunteera gukora ibi."
Haanyuma Yesu aciira abantu umugani ati, "Umugabo yateeye imizaabibu mu murima we, awatira abahinzi maze ariigendera, aja mu kindi gihugu amarayo igihe kireekire.

Igihe c’isaaruura kigeze, nyir’umurima atuma umwe mu bagaragu be kuri abo baatiishwa ngo bamumuheere ubwatamurima bw’imbuto zo mu murima we. Ariko abo baatiisha baramukubita, baramwirukana, asubirayo ubusa.
Nyir’umurima arongera atuma undi mugaragu ariko uwo mugaragu baramutuka, baramukubita, baramuhemura agenda ubusa.
Yoohereza intumwa ya gatatu nuuko na yo barayikomeretsa barayiirukana.
Haanyuma nyir’umurima ariibaza ati, ‘Nzaakora iki? Nzaatuma umwana wanje nkunda ahaari we bazaamwumvira.’
Ariko abo bahinzi baboonye uwo mwana baja inaama bati, ‘Dore umuragwa araaje, reka tumwice maze uyu murima w’imizaabibu uzaabe uwaacu.’
Nuuko bamujugunya inyuma y’uwo murima w’imizaabibu, baramwica." Yesu abaza abamwumvaga ati, "Mbese nyir’umurima azaagenza ate abo batiishwaga umurima we?
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko azaaza akabarimbura maze umurima we akawatira abandi." Abantu babyumviise baravuga bati, "Ibyo ntibikabeho!"
Yesu arabiitegereza arababaza ati, "Mbese ibi byanditswe bivuga iki? ‘Ibuye abuubatsi banze ni ryo ryabaaye inkomezamfuruka.’
Uzaagwira iryo buye weese, azaashenjagurika ahinduke ubushingwe kandi uwo rizaagwira, azaahinduka ivu."
Maze ako kaanya abiigiishamategeko hamwe n’abakuru b’abaheerezabitambo bashaaka kumufata kuko baamenye ko ari bo yavugaga muri uwo mugani w’abahinzi b’abagome, ariko Batiinya abantu.
Batuma abantu kumutata, bamugenzuuza biiyoberanya nk’aho batunganye. Bashaakaga uko baamubonaho impamvu mu byo yavugaga kugira ngo babone uko bamugabiza abategetsi hamwe n’umutware mukuru w’igihugu.
Baramubaza bati, "Mwigiisha tuuzi ko uvuga ukuri kandi ukiigiisha ibitunganye. Ntuurobaanura k’ubutoni ahuubwo wiigiisha inzira y’Imaana mu kuri.
Mbese amategeko yemera ko duha Umwami mukuru w’ubutegetsi bwa Rooma umusoro, cangwa ntabyemera?"
Yesu amenya uburyarya bwabo arababwira ati,
"Nimunyereke igiceri. Iri shusho hamwe n’izina byanditsweho ni ibyande?" Baramusubiza bati, "Ni irya Kayisaari."
Yesu arababwira ati, "Nuuko reero muhe Umwami ibye, n’Imaana muyihe ibyayo."
Babura uko bamufatira mu magambo yavugiye ku mugaragaro, ahuubwo batangaazwa n’igisubizo ce maze baraceceka.
Nuuko Abasadukaayo bamwe bateemeraga ko abaapfuuye bazaazuuka, baaza aho Yesu ari baramubaza bati,
"Mwigiisha, Moose yatwandikiye iri tegeko ngo, ‘Umuntu apfuuye agasiga umugore batabyaranye, mwenenyina agomba gucuura uwo mupfaakazi kugira ngo babyarane abaana bitirirwe nyakwigendera.’
Haabaayeho abagabo barindwi bava inda imwe, umukuru ashaaka umugore ariko apfa batabyaranye.
Nuuko uwo mupfaakazi acuurwa na muramu we, ariko na we apfa bataraabyarana.
N’undi muramu we wa gatatu amucuuye, biba bityo. Nuuko boose uko ari barindwi bariihetuura, bapfa ari nta n’umwe umubyayemo umwana.
Haanyuma n’uwo mugore arapfa.
Noone tubwire, mbese mu gihe co kuzuuka, uwo mugore azaaba muka nde ko yatunzwe n’abagabo barindwi?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Abantu b’iki gihe ni bo bagira abagabo cangwa abagore.
Ariko abo Imaana izaasanga bakwiriye kuba muri iyo si nsha, no kuzuuka mu bapfu, ntibazaagira abagore cangwa abagabo.
Kandi muri iyo si, ntibazaapfa nk’uko biriho ubu, kuko bazaamera nk’abaamalayika badapfa. Bazaaba abaana b’Imaana kuko ari bo izaaba yarazuuye mu bapfu, kugira ngo babone ubugingo buhoraho.

Ariko niiba abaapfuuye bazaazuuka, Moose na we yarabigaragaje ubwo yanditse ibyerekeye gusha kw’igishamba. Ico gihe, Aburahamu, Isaaka na Yaakobo baari baarapfuuye. Haanyuma Moose yeerekana ko Uwiteeka, ari Imaana ya Aburahamu, na Isaaka, na Yaakobo.
Nuuko reero ni Imaana y’abazima ntaabwo ari iy’abaapfuuye, kuko ku bwayo, abo boose bavuzweho ni bazima."
Bamwe mu biigiishamategeko baari aho, baravuga bati, "Mwigiisha uvuze neeza."
Maze ntihaagira undi weese utiinyuka kugira ikindi amubaza.
Maze Yesu arababaza ati, "Ni iki gituma abantu bavuga ngo Kristo ni mwene Dawudi?
Mu gitabo ca Zaaburi, Dawudi ubwe ahamya yeruye ati, ‘Imaana yabwiye Kristo Umwami wanje iti, Icara iburyo bwanje
kugeza igihe nzaashirira abanzi baawe muusi y’ibirenge byawe.’
Mbese ko Dawudi yita Kristo Umwami we, byashoboka bite ko Kristo aba umwuzukuruza we?"
Nuuko abantu benshi bumva Yesu abwira abiigiishwa be ati,
"Mwirinde Abiigiishamategeko. Bakunda kugenda bambaye amakanzu mareemare no kuramutswa mu maguriro, ndetse no kwicara mu ntebe z’ibyubahiro mu masinagoogi no mu myanya y’ibyubahiro mu mashitsi.
Barya ingo z’abapfaakazi bakiiha kuvuga amasengeesho y’urudaca biiyererutsa. Abo bazaahanwa bikabije."
Mu gihe Yesu yari mu Nzu y’Imaana, abona abakire batuura amatuuro yaabo mu bubiiko bwayo.
Abona n’umupfaakazi w’umukene atuura ibiceri bibiri.
Yesu arababwira ati, "Ndababwira ukuri yuuko uyu mupfaakazi w’umukene atuuye kuruta abandi boose,
kuko abandi boose batanze amatuuro y’ibisaagutse. Ariko uyu mupfaakazi mu bukene bwe, atanze ibyo yari atezeho amakiriro."
Maze bamwe mu biigiishwa be batangira kuvuga ku Nzu y’Imaana, ukuntu itaatswe n’amabuye meeza, ndetse n’amatuuro atuurwa Imaana. Yesu aravuga ati,
"Ibi byose mureeba, igihe kizaagera ubwo hatazaagira ibuye na rimwe rizaasigara rigeretse ku rindi ritajugunywe haasi."
Bamwe mu bantu baramubaza bati, "Mwigiisha, ibi bizaaba ryari? Kandi se n’ikimenyeetso ki ceerekana gusohora kwabyo?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Muramenye ntihakagire ubayobya kuko benshi bazaaza biitwaje izina ryanje bavuga bati, ‘Ni nje Kristo,’ kandi bati, ‘Igihe kirageze’ ariko ntimuzaabyemere.
Ubwo muzumva intambara hamwe n’umwiryane, ntimuzaahagarike imitima kuko ibi bizaabanza kubaho. Ariko imperuuka izaaba itaraagera."
Arongera arababwira ati, "Ubwoko buzaateera ubundi, ndetse n’ubwami buteere ubundi.
Hazaabaho imishitsi iteeye ubwoba, kandi hazaaba inzara n’indwara z’ibyorezo. Hazaabaho ibintu biteeye ubwoba hamwe n’ibimenyeetso bikomeye biturutse mu kireere.
Ariko mbere y’ibi byose, bazaabafata, bazaabarenganya, kandi muzaaregwa mu masinagoogi, ndetse muzaashirwa no mu bihome. Bazaabaazana imbere y’abaami n’imbere y’abategetsi muzira izina ryanje.
Iki kizaaba ari co gihe caanyu co kuba abahamya banje.
Ntimuhagarike imitima y’ibyo muzaasubiza.
Kuko nzaabaha amagambo n’ubwenge, byo ababarwanya boose batazaashobora gutsinda cangwa ngo bavuguruze.
Muzaagambaanirwa n’ababyeyi, na beene so, n’abavandimwe, n’inshuti kandi baziiciisha bamwe muri mwe.
Muzangwa na boose muzira izina ryanje.
Ariko ntihazaagira agasatsi na kamwe ko ku mitwe yaanyu kazaagira ico kaba.
Nimwihangaana, muzaakiza ubugingo bwanyu.
Ariko ubwo muzaabona Yerusaalemu igoswe n’ingabo, muzaamenye ko kurimbuka kwayo kwegeereje.
Muri ico gihe, abazaaba bari i Yudeeya bazaahungire mu misozi, n’abazaaba bari mu tawuni hagati, bazaayivemo. Abazaaba bari mu caaro ntibazinjire mu tawuni.
Kuko iyo izaaba ari iminsi yo guhoora kw’Imaana kugira ngo ibyanditswe bisohore.
Muri iyo minsi abazaaba batwite, n’abonsa muri iyo minsi bazaabona ishano. Kuko hazaabaho ububabare mu isi, n’umujinya ku bantu.
Baziicwa n’inkota cangwa bajanwe ari imbohe mu mahanga yoose. I Yerusaalemu hazanyukwanyukwa n’abanyamahanga kugeza ubwo igihe caabo kizaagera ku iherezo.
Hazaaba ibimenyeetso ku izuuba, no ku kwezi no ku nyenyeeri. Amahanga yo mu isi azaababara, akuurwe umutima no guhoorera kw’inyanja n’imivumba.
Abantu bazaagwa gihuubara biteewe n’ubwoba, bahagarike imitima biteewe n’amakuba azaaba yadutse. Hazaabaho gushaakashaaka ibigiiye kuba ku isi, kuko ijuru ryose rizatigiswa n’imbaraga z’Imaana.
Nuuko Umwana w’Umuntu aheereko agaragare mu bicu, afite ububaasha, n’ikuzo ryinshi.
Ibi nibitangira kubaho, muzaahaguruke mureebe heejuru, kuko gucungurwa kwanyu kuzaaba kuri bugufi."
Nuuko Yesu abaciira umugani ati, "Mwitegereze igiti c’umutiini cangwa ibindi biti byose,
iyo amababi yabyo ashibutse, mumenya ko igihe c’urugaryi ceegereje.
Nuuko reero, nimubona ibi bibaaye, muzaamenye yuuko Ubwami bw’Imaana buri haafi.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko abantu b’iki gihe batazaashiraho ibi byose bitaraaba
Ijuru n’isi bizaashira, ariko amagambo yanje ntaazaashira.
Mwirinde imitima yaanyu itazaatwarwa n’ingeso mbi, gusinda hamwe no kwiganyira ko muri ubu bugingo. Nimukora mutyo, uwo munsi ntuzaabatungura
nk’uko umutego ubashuka. Kuko uzaazira abantu boose batuuye ku isi.
Nuuko reero mube maaso buri gihe, kandi musenge kugira ngo mubone uko murokoka ibizaabaho byose, ndetse mushobore guhagarara imbere y’Umwana w’Umuntu."
Buri munsi, Yesu yajaga mu Nzu y’Imaana kwigiisha, ariko nimugorooba akaja kuraara ku musozi wiitwa Elayoni.
Abantu boose baahagurukaga kare mu gitondo baaza mu Nzu y’Imaana kumva ibyo yigiishaga.
Nuuko igihe c’ubushitsi bwo kurya Imigaati Idasembuwe ceegereje,
abakuru b’abaheerezabitambo n’abiigiishamategeko baakomeje gushaakiisha ukuntu baakwiciisha Yesu, kuko baatiinyaga rubanda.
Nuuko Sataani yinjira mu mutima wa Yuda Isikariyoti wari umwe mu biigiishwa cumi na babiri.
Maze Yuda asanga abakuru b’abaheerezabitambo, n’abakuru b’abasirikare hamwe n’abarinzi b’Inzu y’Imaana, aja inaama na bo ukuntu azaabagenzereza Yesu ngo bamufate.
Bituma baneezeerwa caane, kandi bamuseezeranya ikiguzi bazaamuha.
Yuda arabibeemerera, atangira gushaakashaaka uko yabafasha kumufata rubanda rutariho.
Umunsi wo kwiteguurira ibirori by’Imigaati Idasembuwe uragera. Kuri uwo munsi buri muryango watambaga umwana w’intaama w’ibirori byo Kunyurwaho.
Maze Yesu atuma Peetero na Yohaana, arababwira ati, "Muje mu tawuni muduteguurire uko turibusangire ifunguro ryo Kunyurwaho."
Baramubaza bati, "Tubiteguurire he?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Nimugera mu tawuni muribuhuure n’umugabo wiikoreye ikibindi cuuzuye amaazi, mujaane na we mu nzu aribwinjiremo
nuuko mubwire nyir’inzu muti, ‘Umwigiisha adutumye kukubaza ngo, mbese umwanya ndibusangiriremo ifunguro ryo Kunyurwaho n’abiigiishwa banje uri he?’
Uwo mugabo aribubeereke igisenge kinini co mu nzu yo heejuru. Ibyo mwifuuza byose murabisangamo, abe ari ho mutunganya."
Na bo baja mu tawuni basanga ibyo yababwiye byose biri nk’uko yabivuze. Nuuko bateguura ifunguro ryo Kunyurwaho.
Igihe kigeze, Yesu n’abiigiishwa be bariicara ngo barye.
Maze Yesu arababwira ati, "Niifuuje caane gusangira namwe ibi birori byo Kunyurwaho ntaraagera igihe co kubabazwa.
Ibyo mbibabwiye nkomeje ko ntazongera kurya irindi funguro ryo Kunyurwaho, kugeza igihe bizuuzurizwa mu Bwami bw’Imaana."
Nuuko afata igikopu ca divaayi ashiima Imaana, abwira abiigiishwa be ati, "Nimwakiire iki gikopu ca divaayi maze musangire.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko ntazongera kunywa ku mbuto z’imizaabibu kugeza ubwo Ubwami bw’Imaana buzaazira."
Yesu afata umugaati, ashiima Imaana, arawumanyagura maze aheereza abiigiishwa be avuga ati, "Uyu mugaati ni umubiri wanje utanzwe ku bwanyu. Muje muhora mugenza mutya kugira ngo munyibuke."
Bamaze kurya, Yesu afata igikopu ca divaayi nk’uko yari yafashe umugaati aravuga ati, "Iki gikopu ni iseezerano risha Imaana iseezerana n’abantu ku bw’amaraso yanje azaamenwa ku bwanyu.
Ariko, dore uwo ugiiye kungambaanira ni uwo dusangira kuri iyi meeza.
Koko Umwana w’Umuntu azaapfa nk’uko byateguuwe n’Imaana, ariko kandi uwo umugambaanira azaagira iheerezo ribi."
Abiigiishwa batangira kubazanya ubwabo, uzaamugambaanira uwo ari we muri bo.
Nuuko abiigiishwa baja impaka bashaaka kumenya ukwiriye kuba mukuru uwo ari we.
Yesu arababwira ati, "Abaami b’iyi si bategekeesha abantu agahato, kandi abo batware bafite ububaasha kuri abo bantu, bagashaaka kwiyita abagiraneeza.
Ariko mwebweho ntimukagenze mutyo. Ahuubwo umukuru muri mwe akwiriye kuba nk’umwana muto. Uyobora abandi akwiriye kuba nk’umugaragu.
Noone se umukuru ni uwuhe, uwiicaye agaburirwa cangwa ugabura? Mbese ntaabwo ari uwo ugaburirwa? Dore mbaana na mwe nsa nk’ubaheereza.
Nimwe mwagumanye nanje muri byose no mu ngoorane zanje zoose.
Nk’uko nanje Daata yampaaye ubushobozi bwo kuba Umwami, nanje mbahaaye ubutware bwo gutegeka abaami.
Ibyo nzaabibakorera kugira ngo musangire nanje mu bihe byose uko nzaaba ntegeka ndi Umwami. Muziicara nk’abaami muciira imanza imiryango cumi n’ibiri y’abantu ba Isirayeli."
Nuuko Yesu abwira Peetero ati, "Simooni, Simooni, Umva! Sataani yasabye Imaana ngo abagosoore nk’uko umuhinzi agosoora amasaka.
Ariko wowe Simooni naagusabiye ku Maana ngo kwizeera kwawe kudacoogora buheriheri. Kandi nuumara gukomera ufashe bagenzi baawe na bo bakomere mu kwizeera."
Simooni aramusubiza ati, "Nyagasani, niiyemeje kujaana na we mu nzu y’imbohe ndetse no mu rupfu."
Ariko Yesu aramubwira ati, "Peetero, reka nkwerurire yuuko iri joro isaaki itaraabika, uribube unyihakanye gatatu."
Nuuko Yesu abaza abiigiishwa be ati, "Ubwo nabatumaga kuvuga Inkuru Nziza mutagira amashilingi mu mifuka, igikapu cangwa ingato, muri ibyo hari na kimwe mwakeneye?" Baramusubiza bati, "Ntaaco."

Nuuko Yesu arababwira ati, "Ariko ubu si ko bimeze. Ufite amashilingi ayitwaze, ndetse n’ufite igikapu ntakagisige. Kandi niiba muri mwe hari utagira inkoota, kandi akaba nta mashilingi yo kuyigura, naguriishe umwiteero we kugira ngo agire inkoota.

Ndababwira yuuko ibyanyanditsweho bigomba kumbaho. Mu byanditswe havuga ngo, ‘Kandi yabaranywe n’abanyabyaha.’ Kandi ndababwira yuuko ayo magambo asohorezwa muri nje. Kuko ibyanditswe kuri nje bigiiye kuba."
Baramubwira bati, "Nyagasani, dore inkoota ibiri ngiizi." Arabasubiza ati, "Izo zirahaagije."
Yesu arasohoka aja ku musozi wa Elayoni nkuko yari yaramenyereye, maze abiigiishwa be baramukurikira.
Agezeyo arababwira ati, "Musenge kugira ngo mutagwa mu moosha."
Yigira imbere ho gato, arapfukama arasenga ati,
"Daata niiba ari ubushaake bwawe unkize uyu mubabaro. Ariko bye kuba uko mbishaaka ahuubwo bibe nk’uko wowe ubishaaka."
[Agisenga, malayika ava mu ijuru aramubonekera aramukomeza.
Yesu arushaho gusenga afite ishavu ryinshi n’agahinda kenshi. Atangira kubira ibyuya byinshi caane bigwa haasi bisa n’ibitonyanga by’amaraso.]
Amaze gusenga asubira aho yari yasize abiigiishwa be, asanga basinziiriye ku bw’agahinda.
Yesu arababaza ati, "Ni iki gitumye musinziira? Nimubyuke, musenge mutagwa mu moosha."
Yesu akivugana n’abiigiishwa be, haaza igiteero c’abantu kiyobowe na Yuda Isikariyoti, maze yegeera Yesu ngo amuramutse amusome.
Yesu aramubaza ati, "Yuda, uragambaanira Umwana w’Umuntu umusoma?"
Ba biigiishwa baari na Yesu, baboonye ibigiiye kubaho babaza Yesu bati, "Nyagasani, tubakubite inkoota?"
Umwe muri bo ayikubita umugaragu w’Umuheerezabitambo Mukuru, amuca ugutwi kw’iburyo.
Yesu arababwira ati, "Mureke kurwana." Maze afata kwa gutwi agusubizaho aramukiza.

Nuuko Yesu abaza Bakuru b’Abaheerezabitambo, n’abarinzi b’Inzu y’Imaana n’abandi bantu bakuru baari baaje kumufata ati, "Mwari mugomba kunteera nk’abateeye umwambuzi? Dore muuje kumfata mufite inkoota n’ubuhiri.
Igihe nabaaniye na mwe mu Nzu y’Imaana ntiimwigeze munkozaho urutoki cangwa ngo murambuure amaboko mumfate. Ariko nooneho igihe caanyu c’ubutegetsi bw’umwijima kirageze."
Nuuko bafata Yesu, baramujaana bamushira mu nzu y’Umuheerezabitambo Mukuru. Maze Peetero amukurikira arenga ahinguka.
Abantu bacaana umuriro batangira koota. Peetero na we yicara muri bo.
Maze umwe wari umuja aramwitegereza aravuga ati, "Uyu mugabo na we yari kumwe na Yesu."
Ariko Peetero arahakana aravuga ati, "Mugore, uwo uvuga siimuuzi."
Hashize umwanya muto undi muntu ashinja Peetero abikomeje caane ati, "Naawe uri umwe mu biigiishwa be." Peetero ati, "Wa muntu we si ndi umwe muri bo."
Nyuma y’umwanya muto, undi muntu aramushinja ati, "N’uyu baari kumwe kuko na we ari Umunyaagalileeya."
Peetero aramusubiza ati, wa muntu we, ibyo simbiizi. Akibivuga muri ako kaanya yumva isaaki irabitse.
Umwami Yesu arakebuka areeba Peetero, bombi bakubitana amaaso. Nuuko Peetero yibuka amagambo Yesu yari yamubwiye mbere, ati, "Uyu munsi, isaaki itaraabika, uraba umaze kunyihakana gatatu."
Nuuko Peetero aja hanze ararira caane.
Abagabo baari baafashe Yesu batangira kumushinyagurira no kumukubita.
Bamupfuka ku maaso, baramubaza bati, "Niiba uri umuhanuuzi tubwire ugukubise uwo ari we?"
Bakomeza kumutuka, bamubwira n’ibindi byinshi bibabaje.
Bukeeye abakuru babanyarukiko, abakuru b’abaheerezabitambo n’abiigiishamategeko, barateerana, bajaana Yesu mu rukiiko.
Baramubwira bati, "Niiba uri Kristo, bitubwire!" Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Nuubwo naababwira, ntimwabyemera.
Naaho naababaza ntaaco mwansubiza.
Ariko uheereye noone, Umwana w’Umuntu azaaba yiicaye iburyo bw’Uhoraho Imaana Isumbabyose."
Boose bamubariza icaarimwe bati, "Erega nooneho wowe uri Umwana w’Imaana?" Arabasubiza ati, "Murabwivugiye ko ndi we!"
Nuuko baravuga bati, "Mbese, hari ubundi buhamya twifuuza? Ko twumviise abyivugiye ubwe."
Nuuko iryo koraniro ry’abantu rijaana Yesu kwa Pilaato.
Bamurega bavuga bati, "Uyu mugabo agomeesha abantu ababuza gutanga umusoro w’Umwami. Yiyita Kristo, umwami."
Pilaato abaza Yesu ati, "Uri umwami w’Abayuuda?" Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Urabyivugiye."
Maze Pilaato abwira abakuru b’abaheerezabitambo n’abo bantu boose ati, "Nta caaha muboonyeho."
Bakomeza kumurega bavuga bati, "Yagomeesheje abantu n’inyigiisho ze atangiriye i Galileeya n’i Yudeeya hoose noone dore ageze n’ino i Yerusaalemu."
Pilaato abyumviise atyo, ababaza neeza niiba Yesu ari Umunyegalileeya.
Amenye ko ari Umunyegalileeya, amwoherereza kwa Herodi kuko ari we wari umutegetsi w’aho kandi ico gihe akaba yari i Yerusaalemu.
Herodi aboonye Yesu, biramuneezeeza kuko yahoraga yifuuza kumubona ku bw’ibitangaaza yamwumvagaho. Kandi yifuuzaga kubona Yesu akora igitangaaza.
Nuuko Herodi amubaza ibibazo byinshi ariko Yesu ntiyagira ico amusubiza.
Abakuru b’abaheerezabitambo n’abiigiishamategeko baari aho, bakomeza kumurega bamushinja caane.
Nyuma y’aho Herodi hamwe n’abasirikare be, bamushinyagurira bamuseka, kandi bamwambika igishuura ciiza bamwoherereza Pilaato.
Kuva uwo munsi, Herodi na Pilaato baruuzura baba inshuti, kandi mbere baari basanzwe batumviikana.
Maze Pilaato ahamagaza abakuru b’abaheerezabitambo n’abategetsi, hamwe n’abo bantu boose
arababwira ati, "Mwanzaniye uyu mugabo muvuga ko agomeesha abantu ariko noone mboonye ko ari ntaaco yakoze mu byo mumurega
ndetse na Herodi na we ntaaco yamuboonyeho, ni co gitumye yongeye kumutwoherereza. Noone nta caaha yakoze gikwiriye kumwiciisha,
ahuubwo ndategeka ko akubitwa ibibooko maze murekure."
(Ibi yabivuze kuko byari ngombwa ko ababohoorera imbohe imwe mu minsi mikuru.)
Boose basakuriza icaarimwe bati, "Uwo mwice, uturekurire Baraba."
Uwo Baraba yari yarashizwe mu gihome kubeera ubwicanyi no guteeza urugomo mu tawuni y’i Yerusaalemu.
Pilaato ashaatse kurekura Yesu, yongera kubasubiriramo ayo magambo.
Ariko boose barushaho gusakuza bati, "Naabambwe! Naabambwe!"
Pilaato ababaza ubwa gatatu ati, "Kuki? Yakoze caaha ki? Nta mpamvu muboonyeho yo kumwiciisha. Noone ndategeka ko bamukubita ibibooko murekure."
Ariko barushaho kuvugana ubukana basakuza, bamuhata kubamba Yesu maze Pilaato urwo rusaku ruramuganza.
Nuuko Pilaato aramubaha baja kumubamba nk’uko baabishaakaga.
Maze arekura Baraba wari mu gihome kubeera urugomo n’ubwicanyi nk’uko baari baabishaatse, abaha Yesu ngo bamugenze uko bashaaka.
Maze Yesu baramujaana, bakigenda bafata umugabo w’Umunyakureeni witwaga Simooni wavaga mu caaro, bamwikoreza umusaraba wa Yesu. Bamuhata kuwikorera ngo akurikire Yesu.
Abantu benshi baakurikira Yesu baarimo n’abagore baamuririraga baborooga.
Maze arakebuka arababwira ati, "Bagore b’i Yerusaalemu, mwindirira ahuubwo mwiririre n’abaana baanyu
kuko igihe kizaaza bazaavuga bati, ‘Hahiirwa ingumba n’inda zitaabyaye n’amabeere ataaronkeje!’
Ubwo ni bwo bazaabwira ibirunga bati, ‘Nimuturidukire’ bakabwira n’imisozi bati, ‘Nimudutwikiire!’
Niiba bagenza batya igiti kibisi, igiti cumye co bazaakigenza bate?"
Nuuko bamujaana n’inkozi z’ibibi ebyiri ngo baziicane na we.
Bageze ahiitwa Nyabihanga, baramubamba na za nkozi z’ibibi barazibamba. Imwe ibumoso bwe, indi iburyo.
Maze Yesu aravuga ati, "Daata bababarire kuko bataazi ico bakora." Abasirikare bagabana imyenda ya Yesu bakoreesheje ubufindo.
Abantu barashungeera, maze abatware baramushinyagurira bati, "Yakijije abandi, ngaaho niyiikize ubwe niiba ari we Kristo intoore y’Imaana."
Abasirikare na bo baramukwena, maze bamuuzanira divaayi ishaariira
baravuga bati, "Niiba uri umwami w’Abayuuda ikize."
Nuuko heejuru ku musaraba wa Yesu, bashiraho icaapa canditsweho ngo: "Uyu ni Umwami w’Abayuuda."
Umwe mu nkozi z’ibibi zaari zibambanywe na we, iramutuka iti, "Mbese si uri Kristo? Ngaaho ikize naatwe udukize."
Ariko indi nkozi y’ibibi irayicaaha iti, "Wowe ntiwaatiinya Imaana! Ntuubona ko twahaawe igihano gisa?
Dore twebwe turaryora ibibi twakoze, ariko uyu we ntaakibi yakoze."
Irongera iravuga iti, "Yesu, uraanyibuke ugeze mu Bwami bwawe."
Yesu arayisubiza ati, "Ndakubwira ukuri, yuuko uyu munsi turi bubaane muri Paradizo."
Nko ku saaha itandatu z’amanywa, umwijima ukwira igihugu coose ugeza ku saaha ya cenda.
Umuco w’izuuba uvaho, maze umwenda wari ukingirije aheera ho mu Nzu y’Imaana utandukamo kabiri.
Nuuko Yesu aravuga ati, "Daata nshize ubugingo bwanje mu maboko yaawe." Amaze kuvuga atyo, umwuka urahera.
Nuuko umutware w’abasirikare w’Umunyerooma aboonye ibibaaye, asingiza Imaana. Aravuga ati, "Koko uyu yari umuziranenge."
Abantu baari bashungeereye na bo baboonye ibibaaye, buuzura umubabaro maze baragenda.
