Ariko abaari bamuuzi boose hamwe n’abagore baari bamukurikiye kuva i Galileeya bo bahagarara ahiitaaruuye bareeba ibyo byose.
Haariho umugabo witwaga Yozefu wo mu gihugu c’i Yudeeya mu tawuni yitwa Arimateya. Yari umunyangeso nziiza kandi intungaane. Yari umwe muri bakuru b’urukiiko rw’Abayuuda.
Yari ategereje kuuza k’Ubwami bw’Imaana. Ariko we ntaabwo yari yareemeranyije n’abandi bakuru b’urukiiko mu migambi n’ibikorwa byabo.
Maze aja kwa Pilaato kumusaba umurambo wa Yesu.
Nuuko awukuura ku musaraba, bawuzinga mu mwenda mwiza w’igiciiro. Awujaana kuwuhamba mu mva nsha itaraahambwamo yari yaracukuwe mu rutare.
Ibi byabaaye bugoroobye kandi ari co gihe co kwiteguurira i Isaabato kuko yari haafi gutangira.
Nuuko abagore baari bavanye na Yesu i Galileeya, bakurikira Yozefu babona imva amuhambyemo n’uburyo ahambwemo.
Basubira mu rugo guteeguura imibavu n’ibindi bihuumura neeza. Nuuko ku Saabato, bararuhuuka nk’uko itegeko ribisaba.
Ku cumweru karekare mu gitondo ari wo munsi ukurikira Isaabato, ba bagore baja ku mva bajaanye bya bihuumura neeza baari baateguuye.
Babona ibuye rihirikiwe iruhande rw’umwinjiriro w’imva,
binjiramo ariko ntibaasangamo umurambo wa Yesu.
Bagihagaze aho buumiwe, ako kaanya haboneka abagabo babiri bambaye imyenda irabagirana.
Abo bagore baratiinya maze buunika imitwe. Abo bagabo barababaza bati, "Ni iki gitumye mushaakira umuzima mu baapfuuye?
Ntaawe uri hano ahuubwo yazuutse. Mwibuke ibyo yavuganye na mwe akiri i Galileeya ati,
‘Umwana w’Umuntu akwiriye kugabizwa mu maboko y’abanyabyaha, akabambwa kandi ku munsi wa gatatu akazuuka’."
Nuuko na bo biibuka amagambo ye.
Bava ku mva basubirayo. Ibyo byose babiteekerereza i ntumwa cumi n’imwe n’abandi biigiishwa boose.
Abo bagore ni Mariya Magadaleena na Yowana, na Mariya nyina wa Yaakobo, n’abandi bagore baari hamwe na bo, babwira intumwa ibyo baaboonye.
Ariko ayo magambo ababeera nk’impuuha ntibaabyemera.
Maze Peetero arabaduka yiruka aja ku mva. Agezeho, aruunama arungurukamo, abona imyenda y’umweru iri yoonyine. Asubirayo atangaazwa n’ibyabaaye.
Nuuko uwo munsi babiri mu bayoboke ba Yesu baajaga ahiitwa Emawuusi. Kuva i Yerusaalemu kugerayo haari nka kilomita icumi.
Baagaaniiraga ku byari byabaaye byose.
Bakigaaniira kandi bakibazanya, Yesu arabeegeera ajaana na bo,
ariko ntibaamenya uwo ari we.
Arababaza ati, "Muragenda mubazanya ibiki?" Maze bahagarara bagaragaje ishavu.
Umwe witwaga Kilewopaasi aramusubiza ati, "Ni wowe mushitsi wenyine muri Yerusaalemu utaazi ibyahabaaye muri iyi minsi?"
Arababaza ati, "Ni ibiki?" Baramusubiza bati, "Ni ibyerekeye Yesu w’i Nazaareeti, wari umuhanuuzi ukomeye mu byo yavugaga n’ibyo yakoraga imbere y’Imaana n’imbere y’abantu boose.
Ariko noone abakuru b’abaheerezabitambo n’abatware baacu, baaramutanze ngo aciirwe urubanza rwo gupfa maze baramubamba.
Kandi ni we twiringiraga ko azaacungura Abiisirayeli. Uretse ibyo, dore uyu munsi ni uwa gatatu uheereye aho ibyo bibeereye.
Ariko abagore baadutangaaje, kuko baazindutse kare baja ku mva
ntibaasangamo umurambo we nuuko batubwira ko baabonekewe n’abaamalayika, bakababwira ko ari muzima.
Kandi bamwe mu baari kumwe naatwe baagiiye ku mva, basanga ari nk’uko abo bagore baari baatubwiye, ariko we ntibaamubona."
Arababwira ati, "Mwa bapfaapfa mwe, mutinda kwemera ibyo abahanuuzi baavuze byose.
Noone se Kristo ntiyari akwiriye kubabazwa atyo akabona kwinjira mu ikuzo rye?"
Atangirira kuri Moose no ku bahanuuzi boose, abasobaanurira ibyanditswe byose kuri we.
Bageze bugufi y’umwanya baajagamo wiitwa Emawuusi, asa nk’ushaaka gukomeza urugendo.
Baramwinginga bati, "Reka twibaanire kuko bugiiye kwira kandi igihe kiragiiye." Nuuko arinjira aguma na bo.
Amaze kwicara, afata umugaati ashiima Imaana, arawumanyagura arawubaha.
Amaaso yaabo arahumuuka, baramumenya, maze ako kaanya arabura ntibongera kumubona.
Baravugana bati, "Yeewe, ntiwiibuka ukuntu imitima yaacu yari ineezeerewe, ubwo yavuganaga naatwe turi mu nzira adusobaanurira ibyanditswe!"
Uwo mwanya barahaguruka basubira i Yerusaalemu, basanga abo cumi n’umwe bateeranye hamwe n’abandi.
Bumva bavuga bati, "Ni ukuri Umwami Yesu yazuutse, ndetse yabonekeye Simooni."
Nuuko ba bandi babiri na bo babateekerereza ibyabeereye mu nzira, n’ukuntu baamumenyeshejwe n’uko yamanyaguye umugaati.
Bakivuga ibyo, Yesu ahagarara hagati muri bo arababwira ati, "Amahoro abe muri mwe."
Maze bariikanga, bagira ubwoba bwinshi ngo ahaari ni umuzimu baboonye.
Arababwira ati, "Ikibahagaritse imitima ni iki, kandi ni iki gitumye mushidiikanya?
Nimureebe ibiganza byanje n’ibirenge byanje, mumenye ko ari nje ubwanje. Ndetse nimunkoreho mureebe, kuko umuzimu utagira umubiri n’amagufa nk’ibyo mundeebana."
Amaze kuvuga ibyo, abeereka ibiganza bye n’ibirenge bye.
Nuuko ibineezaneeza bikibabujije kubyemera kandi bagitangaara, arababaza ati, "Hari ico kurya mufite hano?"
Bamuha igice c’isamaaki yookeje,
arayaakiira ayiriira imbere yaabo.
Maze arababwira ati, "Aya ni yo magambo nababwiraga nkiri kumwe namwe, yuuko ibyanditswe kuri nje byose mu mategeko ya Moose, no mu byahanuuwe no muri Zaaburi bikwiriye gusohora."
Maze abaha ubushobozi bwo gusobaanukirwa ibyanditswe,
ati, "Ni ko byanditswe ko Kristo akwiriye kubabazwa no kuzuuka ku munsi wa gatatu,
kandi ko kwihana no kubabarirwa ibyaha bikwiriye kubwirwa amahanga yoose mu izina rye, uheereye i Yerusaalemu.
Ni mwe bahamya b’ibyo.
Kandi dore ngiiye kubooherereza uwo Daata yaseezeranyije, ariko mugume i Yerusaalemu kugeza ubwo muzaahabwa imbaraga zivuuye mu ijuru."
Abavaana i Yerusaalemu, abageza i Beetaniya arambuurira amaboko heejuru abaha umugisha.
Akibaha umugisha atandukanywa na bo, ajanwa mu ijuru.
Na bo baramuramya, basubira i Yerusaalemu buuzuye umuneezeero mwinshi,
baguma mu Nzu y’Imaana iteeka bashiima Imaana.

name: João
chapters: Mu ntangiriro ya byose, haariho Jambo, Jambo yahoranye n’Imaana kandi uwo Jambo yari Imaana.
Imaana itaraagira ico irema, Jambo yabaanaga na yo.
Imaana yaremye ibintu byose ibinyujije muri we, nta kintu na kimwe caaremwe atari ku bwe.
Jambo uwo ni we sooko y’ubugingo, kandi ubugingo bwazaniye abantu boose urumuri.
Urwo rumuri rumurikira mu mwijima, kandi umwijima ntiwarusobaanukirwa.
Haabaayeho umugabo watumwe n’Imaana, witwaga Yohaana.
Yazanywe no kuba umuhamya w’iby’urwo rumuri, kugira ngo atume boose biizeera.
We ku bwe nti yari urumuri, ahuubwo yaaje kuba umuhamya w’iby’urwo rumuri.
Urwo ni rwo rumuri nyakuri rwaje muri iyi si kumurikira abantu boose.
Jambo yari mu isi, kandi isi yaremwe ku bwe, ariko abo mu isi ntibaamumenya.
Yaaje mu gihugu ce, ariko abantu be ntibamwemera.
Icakora abo boose bamwakiiriye, bakiizeera izina rye, yabahaaye ububaasha bwo kuba abaana b’Imaana.
Ntibaabaaye abaana b’Imaana mu buryo busanzwe bw’abantu babyaramo, ariko Imaana ubwayo ni yo yabiibyariye mu mwuka.
Jambo yabaaye umuntu aba muri twe, tubona ikuzo rye risa n’iry’umwana w’ikinege wa se, yuuzuye imbabazi n’ukuri.
Yohaana yahamije ibye avuga ati, "Uyu ni we navuzeho ubwo navugaga nti, ‘Uzaaza nyuma yanje, aranduta kuko yariho ntaraabaho.’ "
Twese twahaawe ku migisha ye myinshi caane, kandi duhaabwa ubuntu ku bundi.
Amategeko yatanzwe anyuze kuri Moose, naho ubuntu n’ukuri byatugezeho binyuze muri Yesu Kristo.
Nta muntu wigeze kubona Imaana. Keretse Umwana waayo w’ikinege kandi umeze nk’Imaana, akaba ari iruhande rwa Se, ni we wayitumenyeesheje.
Yohaana yatanze ubu buhamya ubwo Abayuuda boohereje abaheerezabitambo n’Abaleevi kuva i Yerusaalemu kumubaza bati, "Mbese uri nde?"
Yohaana ntiyabahakaniye, ahuubwo yarabeeruriye ati, "Si nje Kristo."
Barongera baramubaza bati, "Noone se uri nde? Uri Eliya?" Arabasubiza ati, "Ntaabwo ndi we." Bakomeza kumubaza bati, "Mbese uri wa muhanuuzi?" Arabasubiza ati, "Oya"
Nuuko baramubaza bati, "Mbese noone wowe uri nde? Duhe igisubizo co kujaanira abaadutumye. Wowe wivugaho iki?"
Yohaana abasubiza avuga ibyahanuuwe n’umuhanuuzi Yesaaya ati, "Ndi ijwi rirangururira mu butaayu riti, ‘Nimugorore inzira y’Uhoraho!’ "
Abo bantu baari baatumwe n’Abafarisaayo,
barongera babaza Yohaana bati, "Noone se niiba utari Mesiya, nt’ube Eliya, nt’ube umuhanuuzi, kuki ubatiza?"
Yohaana arabasubiza ati, "Njeewe ndabatiriisha amaazi, ariko muri mwe hari uwo mutaazi,
kandi ni we ugiiye kuuza ankurikiye, ntibinkwiriye no gupfunduura udushumi tw’ingato ze."
Ibi byabeereye i Beetaniya hakurya y’uruuzi rwa Yorodaani, aho Yohaana yabatirizaga abantu.
Umunsi wakurikiyeho, Yohaana abona Yesu aje amusanga. Nuuko Yohaana aravuga ati, "Dore Umwana w’Intaama w’Imaana ukuraho ibyaha by’abari mu isi.
Uyu ni we navuze nti, ‘Nyuma yanje hazaaza umugabo unduta kuko yabaayeho mbere yanje.’
Icakora nje ubwanje sinari muuzi, uretse yuuko naaje mbatiriisha amaazi ku bw’iyo mpamvu, kugira ngo amenyekane mu Biisirayeli."
Kandi Yohaana atanga ubuhamya agira ati, "Naboonye Umwuka amanuka avuuye mu ijuru mu ishusho y’inuma, nuuko aguma kuri Yesu.
Nje ubwanje sinari muuzi, ariko uwantumye kubatiriisha amaazi yarambwiye ati, ‘Uwo uzaabona Umwuka wanje amumanukiraho kandi akamugumaho, ni we ubatiriisha Umwuka Weera.’
Nje ubwanje narabyiboneye, kandi ndahamya ko ari we Mwana w’Imaana."
Bukeeye bwaho, Yohaana yongera guhagarara hamwe n’abiigiishwa be babiri.
Aboonye Yesu anyuzeho aravuga ati, "Dore, uyu ni Umwana w’Intaama w’Imaana!"
Ba biigiishwa babiri bumviise avuga atyo, bakurikira Yesu.
Yesu arahinduka maze abona bamukurikiye, arababaza ati, "Murashaaka iki?" Baramusubiza bati, " Rabbi (bisobaanurwa ngo Mwigiisha), utuuye he?"
Arabasubiza ati, "Nimuuze muhareebe." Bajaana na we, babona aho yataahaga. Nuuko bagumana nawe uwo munsi woose. Zaari nka saaha cumi z’umugorooba.
Umwe muri abo bagabo babiri wumviise Yohaana avuga maze agakurikira Yesu yari Andereya, mwenenyina wa Simooni Peetero.
Muri ako kaanya abona mwenenyina Simooni aramubwira ati, "Twaboonye Mesiya." (Kimenyeesha uwasiizwe amavuta )
Nuuko amuuzanira Yesu, maze Yesu amwitegereje aramubwira ati, "Uri Simooni mwene Yohaana, uziitwa keefa." (Iri zina ni co kimwe na Peetero kandi rimenyeesha Urutare).
Umunsi wakurikiyeho, Yesu ahitamo kuja i Galileeya. Ahuura na Filipo aramubwira ati, "Nkurikira."
Filipo yari akomooka i Beetsayida, ari na yo tawuni nkuru yo Andereya na Peetero batuuyemo.
Filipo abona Natanayeli, nuuko aramubwira ati, "Twaboonye Mesiya, uwo Moose yanditse mu mategeko, n’abahanuuzi bakamwandikaho. Ni Yesu w’i Nazaareeti, mwene Yozefu."
Natanayeli asubiza Filipo ati, "Mbese i Nazaareeti naho hari iciiza caahaturuka?" Filipo aramusubiza ati, "Ngwino wiireebere."
Yesu abona Natanayeli aza aho ari, nuuko amuvugaho agira ati, "Uyu mugabo ni umu Isirayeli nyakuri udafite uburyarya."
Natanayeli aramubaza ati, "Wamenyeye he?" Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Nakuboonye ubwo wari munsi y’igiti ciitwa umutiini Filipo ataraaguhamagara."
Natanayeli aramusubiza ati, "Mwigiisha, koko uri Umwana w’Imaana! Uri Umwami wa Isirayeli!"
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Wemejwe n’uko nkubwiye ko nakuboonye ubwo wari munsi y’igiti c’umutiini? Uzaabona n’ibindi bitangaaje gusumba ibyo."
Arongera aramubwira ati, "Ndababwira ukuri yuuko, muzaabona ijuru rikinguutse, mubone abaamalayika b’Imaana bazaamukira kandi bamanukira ku Mwana w’Umuntu."
Ku munsi wa gatatu haari ubukwe mu tawuni y’i Kaana mu disiturikiti y’i Galileeya. Nyina wa Yesu yari yaataashe ubwo bukwe.
Yesu n’abiigiishwa be na bo baari baatumiwe muri ubwo bukwe.
Divaayi imaze gushira, nyina wa Yesu aramubwira ati, "Nta divaayi bagifite."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Mubyeyi, nje na we ibyo ntibitureeba. Igihe canje ntikiraagera"
Nyina wa Yesu abwira abagabuzi ati, "Mukore ico ari bubabwire coose."
Imbere yaabo haari hateretswe ibibindi bitandatu bibaajwe mu mabuye. Abayuuda baasukagamo amaazi agakoreeshwa mu mihango yaabo yo kwiyeza. Buri kibindi caajagamo nka lita ijana.
Yesu arababwira ati, "Nimwuzuze amaazi muri ibyo bibindi." Nuuko barabyuzuza kugeza ku rugaara.
Yesu arongera arababwira ati, "Noone reero nimudaheho, maze mujaanire mukuru w’ubukwe."
Mukuru w’ubukwe asogongeye ku maazi yahindutse divaayi, ntiyamenya aho iturutse, (ukuyeho abagabuzi baadashe ayo maazi ni bo baari bahaazi), mukuru w’ubukwe ahamagara umukwe
aramubwira ati, "Ubusanzwe, babanza kugabura divaayi nziiza, haanyuma abantu baamara guhaaga bakagabura itaryoshe. Ariko wowe wakomeje kugabura divaayi iryoshe kugeza n’ubu."
Yesu yakoreye iki gitangaaza ce ca mbere i Kaana y’i Galileeya. Mu gukora ibi, yeerekanye ikuzo rye, nuuko abiigiishwa be baramwizeera.
Haanyuma y’ibyo, Yesu aja i Kaperenawumu ari kumwe na nyina, na beenenyina, hamwe n’abiigiishwa be, nuuko bamarayo iminsi mike.
Iminsi yo kwizihiza ibirori byo Kunyurwaho kw’Abayuuda yegeereje, Yesu aja i Yerusaalemu.
Asanga abantu baguriisha inka, intaama, n’inuma, kandi n’abandi baavunjaga amashilingi biicaye ku meeza zaabo mu Nzu y’Imaana.
Nuuko Yesu akora inkoni mu migozi, ayikoreesha kwirukana amatungo yoose yari mu nzu y’Imaana, yiirukanamo intaama, n’inka. Amena haasi ibiceri by’abaavunjaga, kandi ahirika n’imeeza zaabo.
Maze abwira abaaguriishaga inuma ati, "Ni muzikuure hano! Murekeraho guhindura inzu ya Daata iguriro."
Abiigiishwa be biibuka ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Urukundo mfitiye Inzu yaawe ni nk’umuriro ungurumanamo."
Abayuuda baramubaza bati, "Ni gitangaaza ki wakora ceerekana ko ufite ububaasha buturuka ku Maana bwo gukora ibi?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Nimusenye iyi Nzu y’Imaana, nanje nzayubaka mu minsi itatu."
Abayobozi b’Abayuuda baramusubiza bati, "Iyi Nzu y’Imaana yubatswe mu myaka mirongo ine n’itandatu, byashoboka ko wayubakira mu minsi itatu?"
Ariko Inzu y’Imaana Yesu yamenyeeshaga ni umubiri we.
Nuuko amaze kuzuurwa mu baapfuuye, abiigiishwa be biibuka ko yari yarabivuze, maze beemera ibyanditswe, n’ijambo Yesu yari yaravuze.
Ubwo Yesu yari i Yerusaalemu mu minsi mikuru yo Kunyurwaho, abantu benshi baaramwizeeye ku bw’ibitangaaza baaboonye akora.
Ariko Yesu we ntiyabiizeeraga, kuko yari azi abantu boose uko bari.
Ntiyagombaga kubwirwa iby’abantu, kuko we ubwe yari azi ibyo buri muntu ateekereza.
Haariho Umufarisaayo witwaga Nikodemu, wari umuyobozi w’Abayuuda.
Ijoro rimwe, asanga Yesu maze aramubwira ati, "Mwigiisha, tuuzi yuuko uri umwigiisha wavuuye ku Maana, kuko ari ntaawashobora gukora ibitangaaza ukora, atari kumwe n’Imaana."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ndakubwira ukuri yuuko, nta muntu n’umwe ushobora kubona Ubwami bw’Imaana atabyawe ubwa kabiri."
Nikodemu aramubaza ati, "Mbese umuntu ashobora kubyarwa ubwa kabiri ate kandi akuze? Mbese yakongera gusubira mu nda ya nyina, ngo abyarwe ubwa kabiri?"
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ndakubwira ukuri yuuko ntaan’umwe wakwinjira mu bwami bw’Imaana atabyawe n’amaazi n’Umwuka.
Ikibyawe n’umubiri na co ni umubiri, kandi ikibyawe n’Umwuka, ni umwuka.
Ntibigutangaaze yuuko nkubwiye ngo, ‘Mugomba kubyarwa ubwa kabiri.’
Umuyaga uhuuha weerekeza aho ushaaka, mukumva guhuuha kwawo, ariko ntimumenye aho uturuka cangwa aho weerekeza. Ni na ko uwabyawe n’Umwuka weese amera."
Nikodemu aramusubiza ati, "Mbese ibyo byashoboka bite?"
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ukaba uri umwigiisha w’Abiisirayeli, maze ntuusobaanukirwe ibi bintu?
Ndakubwira ukuri yuuko tuvuga ibyo tuuzi kandi tugahamya ibyo twaboonye, ariko ntimwakiire ibyo duhamya.
Niiba mbabwiye iby’isi ntimwizeere, nimbabwira iby’ijuru muzabyizeera mute?
Ntaawigeze kuzaamuuka aja mu ijuru, keretse uwo wamanutse ava mu ijuru, ari we Umwana w’umuntu.
Nk’uko Moose yamanitse inzoka ku giti mu butaayu, ni ko n’Umwana w’Umuntu akwiriye kumanikwa,
kugira ngo umwizeera weese abone ubugingo buhoraho.
Kuko Imaana yakunze abari mu isi caane, byatumye itanga Umwana waayo w’ikinege, kugira ngo umwizeera weese atarimbuka ahuubwo ahaabwe ubugingo buhoraho.
Koko, Imaana ntiyoohereje Umwana waayo ku isi kugira ngo aciire abayiriho urubanza, ahuubwo kwari ukugira ngo bakirizwe muri we.
Abamwizeera boose ntibaciirwa urubanza, ariko abatamwizeera boose baba baaciiriwe urubanza, kuko baba batiizeeye izina ry’Umwana w’ikinege w’Imaana.
Iyi ni yo nsharubanza, ngo, umuco waaje mu isi, ariko abantu bakunda umwijima kuruta umuco kuko ibikorwa byabo ari bibi.
Abo bakora ibibi, banga umuco, ntibaweegeera kugira ngo ibyo bakora bitagaragara.
Ariko abakora ibitunganye, baja mu muco, kugira ngo ibyo bakora bigaragare ko byakorewe mu kuubaha Imaana."
Haanyuma y’ibyo, Yesu ajaana n’abiigiishwa be mu disiturikiti y’i Yudeeya, agumayo na bo igihe kinini babatiza.
Yohaana na we yabatirizaga abantu ahiitwa Eyinoni haafi y’i tawuni ya Salimu. Kuko haari amaazi menshi, abantu baakomezaga kuuza aho Yohaana ari, bakabatizwa.
Ibyo byose byabaaye Yohaana ataraashirwa mu gihome.
Abiigiishwa ba Yohaana batangira kuja impaka n’Umuyuuda bapfa umuhango wo kwiyeza.
Basanga Yohaana baramubwira bati, "Mwigiisha, wa mugabo mwari kumwe hakurya ya Yorodaani, uwo watangagaho ubuhamya, na we arikubatiza, kandi boose bari kumusanga."
Yohaana arabasubiza ati, "Nta muntu washobora kwiha ikintu, keretse agihaawe n’Imaana.
Namwe ubwanyu mwambeera abahamya ko navuze nti, ‘Si nje Mesiya ahuubwo naaje kumuteguurira.’
Ufite umugeni aba ari umukwe. Inshuti y’umukwe imuhagarara iruhande ikamwumva, ineezezwa n’ijwi rye. Ku bw’iyo mpamvu, umuneezeero wanje urasohoye.
Ni ngombwa ko ashirwa heejuru, naho nje ngaca bugufi"
Uwaturutse heejuru ni we usumba boose. Naho uwo ku isi aba ari uw’isi kandi avuga iby’isi. Uwaturutse reero mu ijuru asumba boose.
Atanga ubuhamya bw’ibyo yaboonye kandi yumviise, ariko ntihagire uweemera ubuhamya bwe.
Umuntu weese weemera ubuhamya bwe, aba ahamije ko Imaana ari Ukuri.
Uwo Imaana yatumye avuga amagambo yaayo, kuko Imaana imuha Umwuka waayo itamugerera.
Imaana Daata ikunda Umwana waayo kandi ibintu byose yabishize mu maboko ye.
Abiizeera Umwana w’Imaana bafite ubugingo bw’iteeka ryose. Ariko abo batamwumvira ntibazaabona ubugingo, ahuubwo, bazaaguma mu mujinya w’Imaana.
Abafarisaayo bumviise ko Yesu afite abayoboke benshi kandi ko yabatizaga kurusha Yohaana.
(Icakora, Yesu ubwe ntiyigeze kubatiza umuntu weese ahuubwo ni abiigiishwa be baabatizaga.)
Umwami Yesu yumviise ibyo baavugaga, ava i Yudeeya aja i Galileeya.
Ariko byari ngombwa ko anyura i Samariya.
Nuuko agera mu tawuni y’i Samariya yitwa Sukari, yari haafi y’umurima Yaakobo yahaaye umwana we Yozefu.
Muri uwo mwanya haari umugezi wa Yaakobo. Ku bw’urugendo rureerure, Yesu yari arushe caane, nuuko yiicara iruhande rw’uwo mugezi, kandi haari nka saaha itandatu z’amanywa.
Umusamariyakazi aza kuvooma amaazi, Yesu aramubwira ati, "Mpa amaazi yo kunywa"
(Abiigiishwa be baari baagiiye mu tawuni kugura ibyokurya).
Umusamariyakazi aramusubiza ati, "Wansaba amaazi ute kandi uzi neeza ko uri Umuyuuda, nje nkaba Umusamariyakazi?" (Yavuze atyo kuko Abayuuda ntibaasangiraga n’Abasamariya.)
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Iyaaba wari uzi impaano Imaana itanga, ukamenya n’ugusaba amaazi uwo ari we, naawe uba umusabye, akaguha amaazi atanga ubugingo."
Uwo mugore aramusubiza ati, "Daatabuja, ko udafite ikivoomeesho, n’umugezi akaba ari mureemure, ayo maazi atanga ubugingo wayakuura he?
Mbese uruta sogokuruza Yaakobo wadusigiye uyu mugezi, akawunyweraho, we n’abaana be n’amatungo ye?"
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Unywa aya maazi weese azongera agire imyota,
ariko uzanywa amaazi nzaamuha, ntaazaagira imyota ukundi, ahuubwo amaazi nzaamuha, azaamubeera isooko y’amaazi idudubiza kugeza mu bugingo bw’iteeka ryose."
Uwo mugore aramusubiza ati, "Daatabuja, mpa kuri ayo maazi, ntazongera kugira imyota, ngo ngaruke hano kuvooma."
Yesu aramubwira ati, "Genda uhamagare umugabo waawe maze ugaruke."
Uwo mugore aramusubiza ati, "Nta mugabo mfite." Yesu aramubwira ati, "Uvuze ukuri yuuko udafite umugabo.
Kuko wari ufite abagabo bataanu, n’uwo ufite ubu si uwaawe. Ibyo uvuze ni ukuri."
Uwo mugore aramubwira ati, "Daatabuja mboonye ko uri umuhanuuzi.
Ba sogokuruza basengeraga kuri uyu musozi, naho mwe mukagira ngo i Yerusaalemu ni ho hakwiriye gusengerwa."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Mugore, nyizeera, dore igihe kirageze, ubwo bitazaaba ngombwa ko musengera Imaana Daata kuri uyu musozi cangwa i Yerusaalemu.
Dore mwebwe abantu b’i Samariya muramya uwo mutaazi, ariko twebwe turamya uwo tuuzi, kuko agakiza gaturuka mu Bayuuda.
Igihe kireegeereje kandi kirasohoye, ubwo abaramya Daata by’ukuri, bamuramya mu kuri bayobowe n’Umwuka, kuko Daata ashaaka beene abo bamuramya batyo.
Imaana ni Umwuka kandi abayiramya bakwiriye kuyiramya by’ukuri, bayobowe n’Umwuka."
Uwo mugore aramubwira ati, "Nzi yuuko Mesiya azaaza (ari we Kristo), kandi naamara kuuza azaatubwira byose."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ni nje Mesiya, uwo uvugana na we."

Ako kaanya abiigiishwa be baraaza maze batangaazwa n’uko Yagaaniiraga n’umugore. Ariko ntihaagira n’umwe muri bo ubaza uwo mugore ati, "Urashaaka iki?" Cangwa ngo abaze Yesu ati, "Ni iki wagaaniiraga n’uyu mugore?"
Nuuko uwo mugore asiga ikivoomeesho ce, aja mu tawuni nkuru. Maze abwira abantu ati,
"Nimuuze mureebe umuntu wambwiye ibyo nakoze byose. Aho ntiyaba ari we Kristo?"
Bava muri iyo tawuni, basanga Yesu.
Ubwo abiigiishwa be baramwingingaga bati, "Mwigiisha, gira ico urya."
Ariko Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Mfite ibyokurya mutaazi."
Abiigiishwa be batangira kubazanya bati, "Mbese hari uwamuuzaniye ibyokurya tutaraagera hano?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Gukora ibyo uwantumye ashaaka, no kurangiza umurimo we, ni byo byokurya byanje.
Mbese ntimuvuga muti, ‘Hasigaye ameezi ane igihe c’isaaruura kikagera’? Ariko ndababwira nti, nimwitegereze neeza mureebe. Dore imyaka ireeze kandi itegereje gusaaruurwa.
Umusaaruuzi ariguhembwa, maze akarundanyiriza imbuto ubugingo buhoraho, kugira ngo umubibyi n’umusaaruuzi baneezeeranwe.
Nk’uko baca umugani w’ukuri ngo, ‘Habiba umwe, hagasaaruura undi.’
Nabatumye gusaaruura ibyo mutaaruhiye, abandi baarakoze bararuha, naho mwebwe mugiiye gusaaruura ibyo baaruhiye."
Abasamariya benshi bo muri iyo tawuni beemera Yesu ku bw’ubuhamya bw’uwo mugore yavuze ati, "Yambwiye ibyo nakoze byose."
Nuuko Abasamariya bamusanga bamwinginga ngo agumane na bo, maze Yesu amarayo iminsi ebyiri.
Kandi benshi bizeera Yesu ku bw’ubutumwa bwe.
Abo bantu babwira wa mugore bati, "Si ibyo watubwiye byonyine biduteera kwizeera, ariko n’uko naatwe twiyumviye, kandi tumenye ko uyu muntu ari we Mukiza w’abari mu isi."
Iminsi ebyiri ishize, Yesu avayo aja i Galileeya.
(Kuko Yesu ubwe yari yaravugiyeyo ko nta muhanuuzi uhaabwa icuubahiro mu gihugu c’iwaabo).
Ageze i Galileeya, Abanyagalileeya baramwakiira, kuko baari baaraboonye ibyo yakoreye i Yerusaalemu mu minsi mikuru, kuko na bo baari baagiiyeyo.
Yesu asubira mu tawuni y’i Kaana muri Galileeya, aho yari yarahinduriye amaazi divaayi. Umutware w’ibwami yari afite umwana urwariye i Kaperenawumu.
Uwo mutware yumviise ko Yesu yavuuye i Yudeeya akaba ageze i Galileeya, aragenda, maze amwinginga kumanuka ngo akize umuhungu we kuko yari indembe.
Nuuko Yesu aramubwira ati, "Mutaraabona ibimenyeetso n’ibitangaaza ntimwashobora kwizeera."
Umutware aramubwira ati, "Daatabuja, banguka tujaane, umwana wanje ataraahwera."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Subirayo, umwana waawe arabaho." Uwo mutware yizeera ijambo Yesu amubwiye aragenda.
Akigenda, ahuura n’abagaragu be mu nzira bamubwira amakuru meeza ko umwana we ari muzima.
Nuuko abaza abagaragu be igihe umwana yatangiriye kooroherwa. Baramusubiza bati, "Ejo ku saaha indwi z’amanywa ni ho umuriro wamuvuuyemo."
Se w’uwo mwana wari urwaye amenya ko ari yo saaha Yesu yamubwiriye ati, "Umwana waawe ni muzima, ntaaribupfe." Nuuko uwo mutware n’umuryango we woose bizeera Yesu.
Iki caari igitangaaza ca kabiri Yesu yakoze amaze kuva i Yudeeya aja i Galileeya.
Nyuma y’ibi, haba iminsi y’ibirori by’Abayuuda, nuuko Yesu aja i Yerusaalemu.
Ubwo i Yerusaalemu haafi y’irembo ryitwa Irembo ry’Intaama haari ikidendeezi, mu ru Heburaayo ciitwa Beetsayida, kizengurutswe n’amabaraza ataanu.
Muri ayo mabaraza haabaga haryamye abarwayi benshi caane, barimo impumyi, abarema n’abandi bamugaye.
Kuko rimwe na rimwe malayika yamanukaga akaja muri ico kidendeezi, agahindura amaazi. Amaazi akimara guhinduka, umurwayi wabanzaga kukijamo yakiraga indwara iyo ariyo yoose.
Aho haari umugabo wari ufite indwara ayimaranye imyaka mirongo itatu n’umunaane.
Yesu aboonye aryamye, amenya ko ahamaze igihe kireekire, aramubaza ati, "Mbese urashaaka gukira?"
Uwo murwayi aramusubiza ati, "Daatabuja, ntaabwo mfite uwo kunshira mu kidendeezi amaazi ahinduwe, kandi iyo ngerageza kujamo, undi muntu antanga kugeramo."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Haguruka, wiikorere akarago kaawe ugende."
Muri ako kaanya uwo murwayi arakira, azinga akarago ke aragenda. Ibyo byabaaye ku munsi w’i Saabato.
Nuuko Abayuuda babwira uwo muntu wari umaze gukira bati, "Dore ni ku Saabato, ntaabwo itegeko rikwemerera kwikorera akarago kaawe."
Ariko arabasubiza ati, "Uwankijije ni we wambwiye ati, ‘Ikorere akarago kaawe ugende.’ "
Baramubaza bati, "Uwo ni nde wakubwiye ngo, ‘Ikorere akarago kaawe ugende’?"
Ariko uwo mugabo wari umaze gukira ntiyamenye uwamukijije uwo ari we, kuko Yesu yari amaze kuburira mu bantu benshi baari aho.
Nyuma yaho, Yesu amusanga mu Nzu y’Imaana aramubwira ati, "Dore waakize, ntukongere gukora icaaha ukundi kugira ngo utazaabona ishano rirutaho."
Uwo mugabo aja kumenyeesha Abayuuda yuuko ari Yesu wamukijije.
Nuuko Abayuuda batangira gutooteza Yesu kuko yakoraga ibintu nk’ibyo ku Saabato.
Ariko Yesu aravuga ati, "Daata aracaakora kugeza n’ubu, kandi nanje ndigukora."
Ibi bituma Abayuuda barushaho gushaaka kumwica, kuko ntiyishe itegeko ry’i Saabato gusa, ahuubwo yavuze ko Imaana ari Se, ubwo akaba ari kwigereranya na Yo.
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Ni ukuri, ndababwira yuuko Umwana w’Imaana ntaaco akora na kimwe ku bwe, kitari ico abona Se akora. Kuko ico Se akora ni co Umwana na we akora.
Daata akunda Umwana, akamwereka ibyo akora byose Kandi azamwereka n’ibirenze ibyo kugira ngo bibatangaaze.
Ni koko, nk’uko Daata azuura abaapfuuye akabaha ubugingo, ni ko n’Umwana aha ubugingo abo ashaaka.
Nta n’umwe Daata aciira urubanza ahuubwo ububaasha bwo guca imanza zoose yabuhaaye uwo Mwana,
kugira ngo boose buubahe Umwana nk’uko buubaha Se. Umuntu weese utuubaha uwo Mwana, aba atuubashe na Se wamutumye.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko, uwumva ijambo ryanje akizeera uwantumye aba afite ubugingo buhoraho, kandi ntaabwo azaaciirwa urubanza, ahuubwo aba avuuye mu rupfu ageze mu bugingo.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko igihe kigeze, kandi ubu kirasohoye, ubwo abaapfuuye bazumva ijwi ry’Umwana w’Imaana, maze abazaaryumva bazaabaho.
Nk’uko Daata ari we sooko y’ubugingo, ni na ko yabuhaaye Umwana we kuba isooko y’ubugingo.
Kandi amuha n’ububaasha bwo guca imanza, kuko ni Umwana w’Umuntu.
Ibyo ntibibatangaaze kuko igihe kigiiye kuuza ubwo abari mu bituuro boose bazumva ijwi rye
bakavamo. Abaakoze ibyiza, bakazuukira ubugingo, naho abaakoze ibibi bakazuukira guciirwa urubanza rw’iteeka.
Ntaaco nshobora gukora ku bwanje. Uko numviise ni ko nca imanza, kandi imanza zo nca ni iz’ubutabeera kuko ntakurikiza ibyo nkunda ubwanje, ahuubwo nkurikiza ibyo uwantumye akunda.
Ndamutse niitanzeho ubuhamya, ubwo buhamya bwaba atari ukuri.
Ariko hariho undi uhamya ibyanje, kandi nzi neeza ko ibyo ahamya kuri nje ari ukuri.
Mwohereje intumwa kuri Yohaana, na we ahamya ukuri.
Si uko nkeneye ubuhamya bw’abantu nk’ubwo, ahuubwo mbivugiye kugira ngo mukizwe.
Yohaana yari nk’itaara ryaka rikamurika, na mwe mwishiimiye umuco we kumara akaanya gato.
Nyamara njeewe, mfite ubuhamya busumba ubwa Yohaana. Imirimo yo Daata yampaaye kurangiza, ni na yo mirimo ndigukora, akaba anariyo impamiriza ko natumwe na Daata.
Kandi Daata wantumye ni we ubwe untangaho ubuhamya. Ntimwigeze kumva ijwi rye, cangwa ngo mubone ishusho ye,
kandi ntimufite ijambo rye muri mwe, kuko ntimwemeye uwo yatumye.
Mushishooza Ibyanditswe kuko mwibwira yuuko muri byo harimo ubugingo buhoraho, kandi ari byo bintangaho ubuhamya.
Ariko mukanga kunsanga kugira ngo muhaabwe ubugingo buhoraho.
Simparanira gushimwa n’abantu.
Ariko nzi yuuko ari nta rukundo rw’Imaana rubarimo.
Naaje mu izina rya Daata, ntimwanyemera, ariko hagize undi uza ahagarariye izina rye, muzamwemera.
Mbese mwakwemera mute, kandi muharanira guhaabwa icuubahiro na bagenzi baanyu, ariko mudashaakiisha icuubahiro gituruka kuri uwo wenyine uri Imaana?
Ntimuteekereze ko ari nje uzaabarega kuri Daata, uzaabarega ni Moose wo mwashizemo ibyiringiro.
Niiba mwariizeeye Moose, nanje mwagombaga kunyiizeera, kuko yanditse ibinyerekeyeho.
Ariko niiba mutiizeera ibyo Moose yanditse, muziizeera mute ibyo mbabwira?"
Haanyuma y’ibyo, Yesu aja hakurya y’inyanja ya Galileeya, ari na yo yitwa Tibeeriya.
Abantu benshi bakomeza kumukurikira, kuko baari baaboonye ibitangaaza yakoreraga abarwayi.
Yesu arazaamuuka aja ku musozi yicarayo hamwe n’abiigiishwa be.
Ubwo iminsi yo Kunyurwaho, ari yo minsi mikuru y’Abayuuda, yari yegeereje.
Yesu yuubuura amaaso abona abantu nyamwinshi baaza bamusanga, abaza Filipo ati, "Mbese imigaati yo kugaburira aba bantu turayiguraahe?"
Yesu yavuze ibi, kugira ngo agerageze Filipo kuko we ubwe yari azi ico agiiye gukora.
Nuuko Filipo aramusubiza ati, "N’ubwo twaba dufite amashilingi yahemba umukozi imibyizi y’ameezi atandatu, ntaabwo twabona imigaati yaabahaaza ngo niibura buri umwe muri bo aboneho akavungunyukira."
Umwe mu biigiishwa be wiitwaga Andereya, mwene nyina wa Simooni Peetero abwira Yesu ati,
"Aha hari umuhungu ufite imigaati y’ingano itaanu hamwe n’isamaaki ebyiri. Ariko se, ibyo byamarira iki aba bantu boose?"
Yesu aravuga ati, "Nimwicaze abantu boose." Aho hantu haari ubwatsi bwinshi, nuuko abantu bariicara, boose hamwe, baari nk’abantu ibihumbi bitaanu.
Nuuko Yesu afata iyo migaati, ayishiimira Imaana, maze ayigabira abaari biicaye. Isamaaki nazo azigenza atyo, arazibagabira, buri umwe abona ibimuhaagije nk’uko abishaaka.
Bamaze guhaaga, Yesu abwira abiigiishwa be ati, "Nimutooragure ubuvungunyukira busigaye kugira ngo hatagira ibipfa ubusa."
Nuuko bakungaanyiriza hamwe ubuvungunyukira bwasaagutse kuri ya migaati itaanu bamaze kurya, buuzuza intonga cumi n’ebyiri.
Abantu baboonye ico gitangaaza Yesu yakoze, batangira kuvuga bati, "Ni koko, uyu ni wa Muhanuuzi ukwiriye kuuza mu isi."
Yesu amenye ko bari haafi kuuza kumujaana ku gahato ngo bamugire umwami, abavamo aja ku musozi wenyine.
Bugoroobye, abiigiishwa be baramanuka baja ku nyanja.
Bafata ubwato baja haakurya ahagana i Kaperenawumu. Bwari bumaze kwijima, kandi Yesu ntaabwo yari yaakabagezeho.
Inyanja iriihinduriza kuko hahuushe umuyaga mwinshi.
Bamaze kugaasha nka kilomita itaanu cangwa itandatu, babona Yesu agendeesha ibirenge ku nyanja agana ku bwato baarimo, maze bateerwa n’ubwoba.
Ariko Yesu arababwira ati, "Ni nje, mwitiinya!"
Bashaatse kumushira mu bwato, babona ubwato bugeze ku nkengeero aho baajaga.

Bukeeye, ya mbaga y’abantu baari baasigaye hakurya y’inyanja baaza kumenya ko nta bundi bwato bwari aho. Kandi baari baaboonye ko Yesu atinjiye mu bwato n’abiigiishwa be, ariko ko abiigiishwa baari baagiiye bonyine.
Andi maato avuuye i Tibeeriya nayo aza aho baari baariiriye imigaati Umwami Yesu amaze kuyishiimira Imaana.
Nuuko abo bantu baboonye ko Yesu ndetse n’abiigiishwa be batari muri ayo mato, bafata ubwato baja i Kaperenawumu gushaaka Yesu.
Bamusanze haakurya y’inyanja, baramubaza bati, "Mwigiisha, mbese aha wahageze ryari?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Ndababwira ukuri yuuko mutarikunshaaka kuko mwaboonye ibitangaaza, ahuubwo ni uko mwariye imigaati mugahaaga.
Ntimugakorere ibyokurya bishira, ahuubwo muharanire gukorera ibyokurya bihoraho mu bugingo bw’iteeka, ubwo Umwana w’Umuntu azaabaha. Kuko ari we, Imaana Daata yashizeho ikimenyeetso."
Baramubaza bati, "Twagenza dute kugira ngo dukore imirimo Imaana ishaaka?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Umurimo Imaana ibashaakaho ni uko mwakwizeera uwo yatumye."
Baramusubiza bati, "Uradukorera ikihe gitangaaza kugira ngo tukibone maze twizeere? Uratwereka gikorwa ki?
Ba sogokuruza baariye Manu mu butaayu, nk’uko byanditswe ngo, ‘Yabagaburiye ibyokurya biturutse mu ijuru.’ "
Yesu arababwira ati, "Ndababwira ukuri yuuko atari Moose wabahaaye ibyokurya biturutse mu ijuru, ahuubwo ko ari Daata utanga ibyokurya nyakuri bituruka mu ijuru.
Kuko umugaati w’Imaana ni uwo uva mu ijuru, kandi ukaazanira isi ubugingo."
Nuuko baramubwira bati, "Daatabuja, uje uhora uduha uwo mugaati."
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Ni nje mugaati w’ubugingo. Unsanga weese ntaabwo aziigera asonza, kandi unyizeera weese ntaabwo aziigera agira imyota.
Nyamara nk’uko nababwiye, murambona ariko ntimunyizeera.
Abo Daata ampa boose bangeraho, kandi abansanga sinzaabiirukana,
kuko navuuye mu ijuru ntaazanywe no gukora ibyo nshaaka, ahuubwo nazanywe no gukora ibyo uwantumye ashaaka.
Kandi ico uwantumye ashaaka ni ukutagira n’umwe nzimiza mu bo yampaaye, ahuubwo ngo nzamuzuure ku munsi wa nyuma.
Iki ni co Daata ashaaka koko, kugira ngo abo boose babona Umwana bakamwizeera, bazaahaabwe ubugingo budashira, maze nkazaabazuura ku munsi w’imperuuka."
Maze Abayuuda batangira kwitootomba kuko Yesu yari yavuze ati, "Ni nje mugaati wamanutse mu ijuru."
Abo Bayuuda baavugaga bati, "Uyu si Yesu, mwene Yozefu, uwo tuuzi neeza se na nyina? Noone se ubu yavuga ate ati, ‘Ni nje mugaati wamanutse mu ijuru’?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Nimureke kwitootomba.
Nta we ushobora kungeraho ataazanywe na Daata wantumye, kandi nzaamuzuura ku munsi wa nyuma.
Nk’uko byanditswe n’abahanuuzi ngo, ‘Kandi boose baziigiishwa n’Imaana.’ Buri weese wumviise ibya Daata kandi akabyiga aransanga.
Si uko hari uwigeze abona Daata, uretse uwaturutse ku Maana. Uwo ni we waboonye Daata.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko, uwizeera weese afite ubugingo buhoraho.
Ni nje mugaati w’ubugingo.
Ba sogokuruza baariiriye manu mu butaayu ariko baarapfuuye.
Uyu ni umugaati uva mu ijuru, kugira ngo uwuriye weese yeekuzaapfa.
Ni nje mugaati muzima wamanutse mu ijuru. Urya kuri uyu mugaati azaabaho iteeka. Umugaati nzaatangira ubugingo bw’ab’isi ni umubiri wanje."
Abayuuda batangira kuja impaka bati, "Mbese uyu mugabo ashobora ate kuduha umubiri we ngo tuwurye?"
Nuuko Yesu arababwira ati, "Ndababwira ukuri yuuko nimutarya umubiri w’Umwana w’Umuntu, mukanywa n’amaraso ye, nta bugingo muba mufite muri mwe.
Abarya umubiri wanje, bakanywa amaraso yanje baba bafite ubugingo buhoraho kandi nzaabazuura ku munsi w’imperuuka.
Kuko umubiri wanje ni ibyokurya nyakuri, kandi amaraso yanje ni ibyo kunywa nyakuri.
Umuntu weese urya umubiri wanje, akanywa n’amaraso yanje aguma muri nje, nanje nkaguma muri we.
Nk’uko Daata uhoraho yantumye, kandi nkaba ndiho ku bwa Daata, ni na ko buri muntu weese urya umubiri wanje azaabaho ku bwanje.
Uyu ni umugaati wamanutse mu ijuru, si nk’uwo ba sogokuruza baariiye, kandi bagapfa. Ariko urya uyu mugaati azaabaho iteeka."
Ibi Yesu yabivuze igihe yiigiishirizaga mu sinagoogi y’i Kaperenawumu.
Benshi mu biigiishwa be bumviise ibyo, baravuga bati, "Iyi nyigiisho irakomeye caane, mbese n’inde washobora kuyikurikiza?"
Ariko Yesu amenye ko abiigiishwa be biitotomba, arababaza ati, "Mbese ibi mvuze birabaraakaje?
Noone se, byaba bite muboonye Umwana w’Umuntu azaamuutse aja aho yahoze mbere?
Umwuka ni we utanga ubugingo, imbaraga z’umuntu nta co zimaze. Amagambo mbabwiye ni Umwuka n’ubugingo buhoraho.
Ariko muri mwe, hari abatiizeera." Kuko uheereye keera koose, Yesu yari azi abatiizeera hamwe n’uzaamugambaanira.
Nuuko aravuga ati, "Niyo mpamvu yatumye mbabwira ko ari ntaawe ushobora kuuza kuri nje atabihaawe na Daata."
Ni co caatumye, benshi mu bayoboke ba Yesu basubira inyuma ntibongera kugendana na we.
Nuuko Yesu abaza ba biigiishwa be cumi na babiri ati, "Mbese namwe mushaaka kurekeraho kunkurikira?"
Simooni Peetero aramusubiza ati, "Mwami, mbese twaja kuri nde, ko ari wowe ufite amagambo atanga ubugingo buhoraho?
Tumaze kwemera no kumenya yuuko uri Uweera w’Imaana."
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Mbese sinabiitooranyirije, mwe cumi na babiri? Nyamara umwe muri mwe ni Sataani."
Ubwo Yesu yamenyeeshaga Yuda, mwene Simooni Isikariyoti. Kuko nuubwo yari umwe mu biigiishwa cumi na babiri, ni we wari kuzaamugambaanira.
Nyuma y’ibyo, Yesu akomeza kugendagenda muri Galileeya. Ntiyashaakaga kuja i Yudeeya kuko Abayuuda baashaakaga uburyo bwo kumwica.
Umunsi mukuru w’Abayuuda wiitwa ingando wari wegeereje.
Nuuko abavandimwe be baramubwira bati, "Va hano uje i Yudeeya, kugira ngo abiigiishwa baawe na bo bareebe imirimo ukora.
Ntaamuntu uhisha ibikorwa bye kandi ashaaka kumenyekana. Ubwo reero ukora ibintu nk’ibyo, reka isi yoose ibimenye!"
Kuko n’abavandimwe be ntaabwo bamwemeraga.
Yesu arababwira ati, "Igihe canje ntikiraagera, ariko igihe caanyu co gihoraho buri gihe.
Ab’isi ntibashobora kubanga, ariko njeewe baranyanga kuko neemeza ko ibyo bakora ari bibi.
Mwebwe nimuje mu birori. Nje sindibujeyo kuko igihe canje kitaraagera."
Amaze kubabwira ibyo, aguma i Galileeya.
Ariko abavandimwe be bamaze kuja mu birori, Yesu na we ajayo, ariko atari kumugaragaro, ahuubwo agenda rwihishwa.
Abayuuda baamushaakiraga muri ibyo birori, bakabaza bati, "Mbese ari he?"
Nuuko abantu bagera aho kongorerana kubimwerekeyeho. Ubwo bamwe baavugaga bati, "Ni umugabo mwiza," abandi bo bakagira bati, "Oya, ahuubwo ari kuyobya abantu."
Ariko nta muntu wavugaga ibihereereye kuri Yesu kumugaragaro, ku bwo gutiinya Abayuuda.
Ibirori bigeze hagati, Yesu aja mu nzu y’Imaana maze atangira kwigiisha.
Abayuuda birabatangaaza maze baravuga bati, "Bishoboka bite kugira ngo uyu mugabo agire ubwenge bwinshi kandi ataariigeze yiga?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Ibyo niigiisha ntaabwo ari ibyanje, ahuubwo ni iby’uwantumye.
Umuntu weese uhitamo gukora ibyo Imaana ishaaka, azaamenya niiba ibyo niigiisha bikomooka ku Maana, cangwa niiba mvuga ibyanje.
Abavuga ibyabo baba biishaakira icuubahiro, ariko ushaakira icuubahiro uwamutumye ni we w’ukuri, kandi ntaabinyoma bimubamo.
Mbese Moose ntiyabahaaye amategeko? Nyamara nta n’umwe muri mwe uyakurikiza. Kuki mushaakiisha uburyo bwo kunyica?"
Rubanda ruramusubiza ruti, "Wahanzweho na dayimooni! Ni nde ushaaka kukwica?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Nakoze igitangaaza kimwe, mwese muratangaara.
Moose yabahaaye umuhango wo gukebwa (ariko si kuri Moose wakomootseho, ahuubwo wakomootse kuri ba sogokuruza), maze mukeba abantu ku Saabato.
Niiba umuntu yaakebwa ku Saabato kugira ngo itegeko rya Moose mutaryica, kuki mundaakarira kuko nakijije ubuzima bw’umuntu ku Saabato?
Ntimugace urubanza mushingiye kubigaragara gusa, ahuubwo muce imanza mukurikije ukuri."
Bamwe mu bantu batuuye i Yerusaalemu baravuga bati, "Uriiya si wa mugabo bashaaka kwica?
Dore aravugira kumugaragaro, kandi nta co bamuvugaho! Aho abategetsi ntibaamenye ko ari Kristo?
Uyu mugabo tuuzi aho aturuka, ariko Kristo we naaza, nta we uzaamenya aho aturuka."
Yesu yigiishiriza mu nzu y’Imaana, avuga aranguruye ijwi ati, "Njeewe muranzi, kandi n’aho nkomooka murahaazi. Sinaaje ku bwanje, ahuubwo naaje ntumwe n’iy’ukuri yo mutaazi.
Njeewe ndamuuzi, kuko nkomooka kuri we, kandi ni we wantumye."
Nuuko bagerageza kumufata, ariko ntihaagira n’umwe umukozaho urutoki, kuko igihe kitaari caakageze.
Abantu benshi mu baari bateeraniye aho baramwemera, maze baravuga bati, "Mbese Kristo naaza, azaakora ibitangaaza biruta ibyo uyu mugabo yakoze?"
Abafarisaayo bumva ibyo rubanda ruvuga bongorerana kuri Yesu, nuuko abatware b’abaheerezabitambo hamwe n’abafarisaayo boohereza abarinzi b’inzu y’Imaana kuja kumufata.
Nuuko Yesu aravuga ati, "Ndacaari kumwe namwe igihe gito, haanyuma ngasanga uwantumye.
Muzanshaaka, ariko ntimuzambona, kandi aho nzaaba ndi, ntimuzaashobora kugerayo."
Nuuko Abayuuda barabazanya bati, "Mbese uyu mugabo agiiye kuja he, ho tutazaamubona? Aho ntaagiiye gusanga Abayuuda baataataaniye mu Bagiriki maze akiigiisha Abagiriki?
Ayo magambo avuze ngo, ‘Muzanshaaka, ariko ntimuzambona’ kandi ngo ‘Aho nzaaba ndi, ntimuzaashobora kugerayo,’ amenyeesha iki?"
Ku munsi wa nyuma w’iminsi y’ibirori, ari wo munsi mukuru usumba iyindi, Yesu arahagarara avuga mu ijwi rirenga ati, "Ufite imyota weese nansange,
kandi umuntu weese unyizeera, ni anywe, nk’uko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, ‘Imigezi y’amaazi y’ubugingo izaatemba imuturukamo.’ "
Ibyo Yesu yabivuze yeerekeje ku Mwuka Weera, uwo abamwemera baagombaga kubona. Ico gihe Mwuka Weera yari ataraaza kuko Yesu yari atarahaabwa icuubahiro.
Bamwe muri rubanda bumviise ayo magambo baravuga bati, "Uyu koko ni wa muhanuuzi."
Abandi baravuga bati, "Uyu ni we Kristo." Ariko abandi barabaza bati, "Byashoboka ko Kristo aturuka i Galileeya?
Mbese ibyanditswe ntibivuga ko Kristo azaakomooka mu rubyaro rwa Dawudi kandi akavuukira i Beetelehemu, i tawuni yo Dawudi yari atuuyemo?"
Nuuko abantu biigabamo ibice ku bwa Yesu.
Bamwe muri bo bashaaka kumufata, ariko ntihaagira umukozaho urutoki.
Ba barinzi b’Inzu y’Imaana basubira ku batware b’Abaheerezabitambo n’Abafarisaayo, nuuko babaza abarinzi bati, "Kuki mutaamufashe, mukamuuzana?"
Abarinzi na bo barabasubiza bati, "Yemwe, nta muntu n’umwe wigeze kuvuga nk’uyu mugabo!"
Abafarisaayo barabasubiza bati, "Namwe se yaabashutse?
Haaba hariho umuntu n’umwe wo mu bategetsi cangwa mu Bafarisaayo wamwemeye?
Ariko aba bantu nyamwinshi bataazi amategeko ya Moose, Imaana izaabavuma."
Umwe mu Bafarisaayo wari aho, ni Nikodemu kandi yari yariigeze kuja kureeba Yesu. Abwira bagenzi be ati,
"Mbese amategeko yaacu atwemerera guciira umuntu urubanza, atabanje guhaabwa umugisha wo kwireguura no kumenya ibyo yakoze?"
Baramusubiza bati, "Naawe se uva i Galileeya? Ushishooze neeza mu byanditswe maze urasanga ko ari ntamuhanuuzi uzaaturuka i Galileeya."
Nuuko buri umwe aja iwe.
[ Naho Yesu we aja ku musozi wa Elayoni.
Mu gitondo ca kare, Yesu agaruka mu nzu y’Imaana. Abantu boose baramusanga maze ariicara atangira kubiigiisha.
Abiigiishamategeko n’Abafarisaayo baazanira Yesu umugore wafashwe asambana, bamuhagarika imbere yaabo,
baramubwira bati, "Mwigiisha, uyu mugore yafashwe asambana.
Mu mategeko, Moose yadutegetse kwiciisha amabuye abagore nk’abo. Noone wowe urabivugaho iki?"
Ibyo baabivugiraga kugira ngo bamutegere mu byo avuga maze babone ibyo bamurega. Yesu we aruunama yandikiisha urutoki haasi.
Bakomeje kumubaza aruunamuka arababwira ati, "Muri mwe udafite icaaha, ni abe ari we ubanza kumuteera ibuye."
Yongera kuunama yandika haasi.
Babyumviise batyo, batangira kugenda umwe umwe, baheereye ku bakuru. Basiga Yesu wenyine hamwe na wa mugore amuhagaze imbere.
Yesu aruunamuka aramubaza ati, "Mugore, abaakuregaga bari he? Nta n’umwe waguciiriye urubanza?"
Wa mugore aramusubiza ati, "Nta n’umwe daatabuja." Yesu aramubwira ati, "Nanje ntaabwo nguciiriye urubanza. Genda, ariko uheereye noone ntuuzongere gukora icaaha."]
Yesu yongera kubwira Abafarisaayo ati, "Ninje muco w’isi. Unkurikira weese ntaabwo azaagendera mu mwijima, ahuubwo azaaba afite umuco w’ubugingo."
Nuuko Abafarisaayo baramubwira bati, "Ubwo ari wowe wiitangaho ubuhamya, ibyo uhamya ntaabwo ari iby’ukuri."
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Nuubwo ari nje witangaho ubuhamya, ibyo mpamya ni iby’ukuri kuko nzi iyo naturutse n’aho nja, ariko mwebwe ntaabwo muuzi aho naturutse cangwa aho nja.
Mwe muca urubanza nk’abantu, ariko njeewe ntaawe nciira urubanza.
Nuubwo naaca urubanza, naaca urw’ukuri, kuko atari njeewe uca urubanza njenyine, ahuubwo mba ndi na Daata wantumye.
Mu mategeko yaanyu, handitswe ngo ibyo abantu babiri beemeje biba ari ukuri.
Nje ubwanje niitangaho ubuhamya, kandi na Daata wantumye antangaho ubuhamya."
Baramubaza bati, "So aba heehe?" Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Ntaabwo munzi kandi na Daata ntaabwo mumuuzi. Kuko iyo muba munzi, muba muuzi na Daata."
Yesu yavuze aya magambo ubwo yigiishirizaga mu gisenge caabiikwagamo ibyo batuuriramo mu nzu y’Imaana, ariko ntihaagira umufata, kuko isaaha ntiyari yaakageze.
Yesu yongera kubabwira ati, "Ndagiiye kandi muzanshaaka, ariko muzaapfaana ibyaha byanyu. Aho ngiiye, ntimushobora kujayo."
Abayuuda barabazanya bati, "Mbese agiiye kwiyahura? Ni yo mpamvu avuze ati, ‘Aho ngiiye, ntimushobora kujayo’?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Mwebwe mukomooka haasi, njeewe nkomooka heejuru. Muri ab’iyi si, ariko njeewe ntaabwo ndi uw’iyi si.
Niyo mpamvu nababwiye ko muzaapfaana ibyaha byanyu, kandi koko nimutiizeera ko ndi we, muzaapfaana ibyaha byanyu."
Baramubaza bati, "Uri nde?" Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Ndi uwo nababwiye kuva mbere.
Mfite byinshi byo kubavugaho mbaciira urubanza, ariko uwantumye ni uw’ukuri, kandi ibyo namwumviiseho ni byo mbwira abari ku isi."
Ntibaamenya ko yababwiraga ibyerekeye kuri Se.
Nuuko Yesu arababwira ati, "Nimumara kuzaamuura Umwana w’Umuntu ku musaraba, nibwo muzaamenya ko ndi we, kandi ko ari nta co nkora ku bwanje, ahuubwo mvuga ibyo Daata yambwirije.
Kandi uwantumye turi kumwe. Ntaabwo yansize njenyine, kuko mpora nkora ibimushiimiisha."
Yesu amaze kuvuga atyo, abantu benshi baramwemera.
Nuuko Yesu abwira Abayuuda baari bamwemeye ati, "Nimukomeza kumvira ijambo ryanje, muzaaba mubaaye abiigiishwa banje nyakuri.
Kandi muzaamenya ukuri, kandi ukuri kuzaababohoora."
Baramusubiza bati, "Dukomooka kuri Aburahamu kandi ntaabwo twigeze tuba abagaragu. Uramenyeesha iki kuvuga ngo, ‘Muzaabohoorwa’?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Ndababwira ukuri yuuko umuntu weese ukora icaaha aba abaaye imbohe y’icaaha.
Umugaragu ntaabwo akomeza kuba mu muryango iteeka, ahuubwo umwana ni we uwubamo iteeka ryose.
Noone reero niiba Umwana w’Imaana ababohooye, muzaaba mubohoowe by’ukuri.
Nzi neeza yuuko mukomooka kuri Aburahamu, ariko mukaba mushaaka kunyica, kuko muteemera ijambo ryanje.
Nje mvuga ibyo naboonye kuri Daata, ariko mwebwe mu gomba gukora ibyo mwumviise kuri So."
Baramusubiza bati, "Daata ni Aburahamu." Yesu na we arababwira ati, "Iyo muba abaana ba Aburahamu, muba mukora nk’ibyo Aburahamu yakoze.
Dore murashaaka kunyica kandi mbabwiye ukuri ko numviise ku Maana. Ibyo ntaabwo ari byo Aburahamu yakoze.
Mwe murakora koko ibyo so akora." Baramusubiza bati, "Dufite Daata umwe, ari we Maana. Ntaabwo turi ibibyarirano."
Yesu arababwira ati, "Iyo Imaana iba ari yo So, muba munkunze, kuko nanje nkomooka ku Maana nkaba ndi hano. Sinaaje ku bwanje, ahuubwo ni yo yantumye.
Kuki mudasobaanukirwa ibyo mvuga? Ni uko mudashaaka kwemera ijambo ryanje.

Mukomooka kuri so, ari we Sataani, kandi murashaaka gukurikiza ibyo yiifuuza. Yahoze ari umwicanyi kuva mu ntangiriro kandi ntiyiigeze ashigikira ukuri, kuko atiigeze agira ukuri. Iyo avuga ibinyoma, aba avuga ibiri ibye, kuko ari umubeeshi kandi akaba na se w’ibinyoma.
Ariko kuko nje mbabwira ukuri, ni yo mpamvu ituma mutanyemera.
Ni nde muri mwe wanshinja icaaha? Iyo mbabwira ukuri, kuki mutanyemera?
Ukomooka ku Maana yumva amagambo y’Imaana. Impamvu ituma mutayumva reero, ni uko mudakomooka ku Maana."
Abayuuda baramusubiza bati, "Sitwabivuze ukuri ko uri Umusamariya, kandi ko hari dayimooni ikurimo?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Nta dayimooni mfite, ahuubwo nuubaha Daata, naho mwebwe mukansuzugura.
Kandi siniishaakira icuubahiro, ahuubwo hariho ugishaaka kandi ni we uca urubanza.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko, uweemera inyigiisho zanje atazaapfa."
Abayuuda baramubwira bati, "Nooneho ubu tumenye neeza ko ufite dayimooni. Aburahamu yarapfuuye, kandi n’abahanuuzi barapfa, noone wowe uravuga ngo, ‘Umuntu uzumvira ijambo ryanje ntaabwo azaapfa!’
Mbese uruta sogokuruza Aburahamu wapfuuye? Abahanuuzi na bo baarapfuuye. Wowe wiibwira ko uri nde?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Iyo niiha icuubahiro, ico cuubahiro caaba gipfuuye ubusa. Ni Daata umpa icuubahiro, uwo muvuga ko ari Imaana yaanyu,
nuubwo mutiigeze mumumenya. Ariko njeewe ndamuuzi. Ndamutse mvuze ko ntamuuzi, ubwo naaba mbaaye umubeeshi nka mwe. Ariko ndamuuzi, kandi nkurikiza ijambo rye.
Sogokuruza Aburahamu yahimbaajwe no kuzaabona igihe co kuuza kwanje, ico gihe yarakiboonye maze araneezeerwa."
Nuuko Abayuuda baramubwira bati, "Uba utari wageza imyaka mirongo itaanu, noone ngo waboonye Aburahamu?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Ndababwira ukuri, mbere yuuko Aburahamu avuuka, nari ndiho."
Nuuko batooragura amabuye yo kumuteera, ariko Yesu ariihisha asohoka mu Nzu y’Imaana.
Ubwo Yesu yagendaga, abona umugabo wavuutse ahumye.
Abiigiishwa be baramubaza bati, "Mwigiisha, uwakoze icaaha caatumye uyu mugabo avuuka ahumye ni nde? Ni we wakoze icaaha, cangwa ni ababyeyi be?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Haaba uyu mugabo cangwa ababyeyi be, ntaawakoze icaaha, ahuubwo yavuutse ahumye kugira ngo imbaraga z’Imaana zigaragarire muri we.
Tugomba gukora imirimo y’uwantumye hakiri ku manywa. Ijoro riraaje kandi muri ryo ntaawagira ico akora.
Nkiri muri iyi si, ndi umuco w’isi."
Amaze kuvuga atyo, aciira haasi maze atobeesha akondo amacandwe, agasiiga ku maaso ya wa mugabo wari uhumye
avuga ati, "Genda ukarabe amaaso yaawe mu kidendeezi ca Silowamu" (Risobaanura "gutumwa"). Nuuko uwo mugabo wari uhumye aragenda, akaraba amaaso ye, maze agaruka ari kureeba.
Abatuuranyi be n’abaamubonaga mbere agisabiriza batangira kubazanya bati, "Uyu si wa mugabo wicaraga asabiriza?"
Bamwe bakavuga bati, "Ni we." Abandi bakavuga bati, "Ntaabwo ari we, ahuubwo ni uwo basa." Maze wa mugabo arabasubiza ati, "Ni nje."
Ariko bakomeza kumubaza bati, "Byagenze bite kugira ngo ureebe?"
Arabasubiza ati, "Wa mugabo wiitwa Yesu yatobye akondo, akansiiga ku maaso maze ambwira kuja ku kidendeezi ca Silowamu kuyakaraba. Nuuko nja yo, nkimara gukaraba, ntangira kureeba."
Baramubaza bati, "Ari heehe?" Na we arabasubiza ati, "Ntaabwo mbiizi."
Nuuko uwo mugabo wari warahoze ari impumyi bamujaanira Abafarisaayo.
Kandi uwo munsi wo Yesu atoba akondo agakiza uwo umugabo ubuhumyi wari umunsi w’i Saabato.
Nuuko Abafarisaayo bongera kubaza wa mugabo uko yahumuutse. Na we arabasubiza ati, "Yansiize akondo ku maaso yanje, ndayakaraba, noone ubu ndareeba."

Bamwe mu Bafarisaayo baravuga bati, "Uyu mugabo ntaabwo akomooka ku Maana, kuko ntiyubahiriza itegeko ry’i Saabato." Ariko abandi na bo baravuga bati, "Byashoboka bite kugira ngo umunyabyaha akore ibitangaaza nk’ibi?" Maze biigabamo ibice.
Abafarisaayo bongera kubaza wa mugabo bati, "Uvuga yuuko yakuvuuye ubuhumyi, noone wowe urabivugaho iki?" Na we arabasubiza ati, "Ni umuhanuuzi."
Ariko Abayuuda banga kwemera ko uwo mugabo yari impumyi noone akaba ari kureeba kugeza ubwo batumyeho ababyeyi be
maze bakababaza bati, "Uyu si umuhungu waanyu? Muvuga ko yavuutse atareeba, byabaaye bite se, kugira ngo ubu abe ari kureeba?"
Ababyeyi be barasubiza bati, "Ico tuuzi ni uko uyu ari umuhungu waacu, kandi ko yavuutse ari impumyi,
ariko ntaabwo tuuzi uko byagiiye ngo ashobore kureeba, cangwa ngo tumenye uwamuhumuuye amaaso. Nimumwibarize namwe, kuko ni mukuru kandi yashobora kwisubiriza!"
Ababyeyi be baavuze batyo ku bwo gutiinya Abayuuda. Abo Bayuuda baari baamaze kwemeranya yuuko umuntu weese uzeerura ko Yesu ari Kristo yirukanwa mu Isinagoogi.
Ni co caatumye ababyeyi be bavuga bati, "Nimukuru, mumwibarize."
Abayuuda bongera guhamagara wa mugabo wari waravuutse ahumye ubwa kabiri, maze baramubwira bati, "Rahira imbere y’Imaana ko uribuvuge ukuri! Tuuzi yuuko uyu mugabo wakuvuuye ari umunyabyaha."
Na we arasubiza ati, "Ntaabwo nzi niiba ari umunyabyaha, ariko ico nzi kimwe, ni uko nari impumyi, noone nkaba ndeeba."
Baramubaza bati, "Yakugenjeje ate? Yahumuuye amaaso yaawe ate?"
Arabasubiza ati, "Naabibabwiye kandi ntimwabyumva. Kuki mushaaka kongera kubyumva? Mbese namwe mushaaka kuba abiigiishwa be?"
Nuuko baramutuka bamubwira bati, "Uri umwigiishwa we, ariko twebwe turi abiigiishwa ba Moose.
Tuuzi yuuko Imaana yavuganye na Moose, ariko uyu mugabo we ntaabwo tuuzi iyo aturuka."
Wa mugabo arabasubiza ati, "Ibi birantangaaje! Ntaabwo muuzi iyo aturuka, ariko yampumuuye amaaso!
Tuuzi yuuko Imaana itumva abanyabyaha, ariko yumva uyuubaha, agakora ibyo ishaaka.
Kuva isi yaaremwa, ntaawigeze kumva umuntu wahumuuye amaaso y’umuntu wavuutse ari impumyi.
Iyo uyu mugabo aba adakomooka ku Maana, ntaaco aba yashoboye gukora."
Baramusubiza bati, "Wowe wavuukiye mu byaha unabikuriramo, noone urashaaka kutwiigiisha?" Nuuko bamwirukana mu sinagoogi.
Yesu yumviise ko birukanye wa mugabo mu sinagoogi, aza kumubona maze aramubaza ati, "Mbese weemera Umwana w’Umuntu?"
Na we aramusubiza ati, "Daatabuja, mbwira uwo ari we, kugira ngo mwemere!"
Yesu aramubwira ati, "Wamuboonye, kandi ni we uvugana na we."
Wa mugabo aravuga ati, "Ndemera Nyagasani!" Niko gupfukama imbere ya Yesu, aramuramya.
Nuuko Yesu aravuga ati, "Naaje muri iyi si guca urubanza, kugira ngo abo batabona bareebe, kandi ababona bahume."
Bamwe mu Bafarisaayo baari hamwe na we babyumviise baramubwira bati, "Mbese naatwe turi impumyi?"
Yesu nawe arabasubiza ati, "Iyo muba muri impumyi, nta caaha mwajaga kugira, ariko ubwo muvuga ngo murabona, icaaha caanyu kigumyeho."
Yesu aravuga ati, "Ni ukuri, ni ukuri, ndababwira yuuko uwinjira mu rugo rw’intaama atanyuze mu irembo ahuubwo akuuririra ahandi aba ari umujuura cangwa umunyazi.
Uwinjirira mu irembo, aba ari umushumba w’intaama.
Umurinzi amukinguurira irembo, n’intaama zikumva ijwi rye. Ahamagara intaama ze mu mazina yazo, maze akazaahura .
Iyo amaze gukuuramo intaama ze, azija imbere, zikamukurikira kuko ziizi ijwi rye.
Ntaabwo zaakurikira uwo zitaazi, ahuubwo ziramuhunga kuko zitaazi ijwi rye".
Yesu yakoreesheje ico ciitegererezo ariko ntibaasobaanukirwa ibyo ababwira.
Yesu yongera kubabwira ati, "Ndababwira ukuri yuuko ari nje rembo ry’intaama.
Abambanjirije boose ni abajuura n’abanyazi, ariko intaama ntizaabumviise.
Ni nje rembo. Uwinjira anyuzeho weese azaakizwa, azinjira kandi asohoke maze abone urwuri.
Umujuura azanwa no kwiba, no kwica, no kurimbura. Nazanywe no kugira ngo abantu babone ubugingo, ndetse ngo babubone mu bwuzuye.
Ni nje mushumba mwiza. Umushumba mwiza ahara ubugingo bwe ku bw’intaama ze.
Naho umupakazi, utari umushumba kandi utari nyir’intaama, iyo aboonye inyamaaswa ije, asiga intaama agahunga, nuuko inyamaaswa ikazifata maze ikazitaatanya.
Umupakazi arahunga kuko ntaabwo yiita ku ntaama.
Ni nje mushumba mwiza. Intaama zanje ndaziizi kandi na zo zikaamenya,
nk’uko Daata anzi kandi nanje nkamenya Daata. Ndetse neemera gupfiira intaama zanje.
Mfite n’izindi ntaama zitari izo muri uyu mukumbi. Na zo ngomba kuziizana, maze zikazumva ijwi ryanje. Nuuko hakabaho umukumbi umwe, n’umushumba umwe.
Ku bw’iyo mpamvu, Daata arankunda, kuko niteguuye gutanga ubugingo bwanje kugira ngo nzaabusubirane.
Ntaawe ubunyaka, ahuubwo mbutanga ku bushaake bwanje. Mfite ubushobozi bwo kubutanga, n’ubwo kubusubirana. Iri tegeko narihaawe na Daata."
Abayuuda bongera kwicamo ibice ku bw’ayo magambo.
Benshi muri bo baaravugaga bati, "Ahanzweho dayimooni kandi yasaze. Ni kuki mumwumviriza?"
Ariko abandi bakavuga bati, "Aya ntaabwo ari amagambo y’umuntu uhanzweho na dayimooni. Mbese dayimooni yashobora guhumuura impumyi?"
Ico gihe hari umunsi wo kwibuka gutaaha Inzu y’Imaana i Yerusaalemu, kandi caari igihe c’imbeho nyinshi.
Yesu yagendagendaga mu Nzu y’Imaana, munsi y’ibaraza ryitwa irya Solomooni.
Abayuuda baramwitooroora baramubaza bati, "Uzaageza ryari kutureka mu rujijo? Tubwire neeza niiba uri Kristo."
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Narabibabwiye ntimwabyemera. Imirimo nkora mu izina rya Daata na yo intangaho ubuhamya,
ariko ntimubyemera, kuko mutari abo mu ntaama zanje.
Intaama zanje zumva ijwi ryanje. Ndaziizi kandi na zo zikankurikira.
Nziha ubugingo buhoraho, kandi ntaabwo zizaarimbuka. Ntaawe uzaazinsahura mu ntoke zanje.
Ibyo Daata yampaaye biruta ibindi byose kandi ntaawabisahura mu maboko ye.
Njeewe na Daata turi umwe."
Abayuuda bongera gutooragura amabuye ngo bayamuteere.
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Nabeeretse imirimo myiza myinshi yavuuye kuri Daata. Ni uwuhe muri yo utuma mwenda kunteera amabuye?"
Abayuuda baramusubiza bati, "Ntaabwo ari imirimo myiza tugiiye kuguteerera amabuye, ahuubwo ni ugusebya Imaana, kuko uri umuntu ukaba wishushanyije kuba Imaana."
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Ntibyanditswe mu mategeko yaanyu ngo Imaana yaravuze iti, ‘Muri imaana’?
Tuuzi neeza ko ibyanditswe ari ukuri ubuzira herezo, kandi ko Imaana yiise abo bantu imaana, anari bo baahaawe ubutumwa.
Mbese mwavuga mute ngo uwo Daata yatooranyije akamwohereza mu isi ari gusebya Imaana kuko navuze nti, ‘Ndi Umwana w’Imaana’?
Niiba ntakora imirimo ya Daata, nimureke kunyemera.
Ariko niiba nyikora, n’ubwo mutanyizeera, mwizeere iyo mirimo, kugira ngo mumenye kandi mwemere ko Daata ari muri nje nanje nkaba muri we."
Bongera gushaaka kumufata ariko arabatoroka.
Avayo yongera kuja haakurya ya Yorodaani aho Yohaana yabatirizaga mbere, agumayo.
Abantu benshi baaza aho Yesu ari, baravuga bati, "Yohaana ntaagitangaaza yakoze, ariko ibyo yavuze kuri uyu mugabo byose byari ukuri."
Maze abantu benshi baariyo baramwizeera.
Haari umugabo wari urwaye wiitwaga Laazaaro akaba yari atuuye i Beetaniya, icaaro co Mariya na mwenenyina Marita baari batuuyemo.
Mariya uwo ni we wasiize Yesu amavuta ku birenge akabihanaguza umusatsi we, kandi musaaza we Laazaaro ni we wari urwaye.
Bashiki be batuma kuri Yesu bati, "Nyagasani, inshuti yaawe ukunda irarwaye."
Yesu abyumviise, aravuga ati, "Iyo ndwara ntaabwo ari iyo kumwica, ahuubwo ni iyo guheesha Imaana ikuzo, kugira ngo Umwana waayo ahaabwe icuubahiro."
Nuubwo Yesu yakundaga Marita na mwenenyina, na Laazaaro,
yamaze iminsi ebyiri aho yari ari, amaze kumva ko Laazaaro arwaye.
Nyuma y’iyo minsi ebyiri, abwira abiigiishwa be ati, "Reka dusubire i Yudeeya."
Abiigiishwa be baramubaza bati, "Mwigiisha, Abayuuda bendaga kuguteererayo amabuye noone ushaaka gusubirayo?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Mbese umunsi nt’ufite amasaaha cumi n’abiri? Abagenda ku manywa ntaabwo basiitaara, kuko baba babona umuco w’iyi si.
Ariko abagenda mu ijoro barasiitaara, kuko umuco uba utari muri bo."
Amaze kuvuga atyo, arababwira ati, "Inshuti yaacu Laazaaro yaasinziiriye, ariko ngiiye kumukangura."
Abiigiishwa be baramubwira bati, "Nyagasani, niiba yaasinziiriye araba neeza."
Yesu yavugaga iby’urupfu rwa Laazaaro, ariko bo bagateekereza ko yamenyeeshaga gusinziira kwa buri gihe.
Nuuko Yesu arabeerurira ati, "Laazaaro yaapfuuye.
Ariko ku bwanyu neejejwe nuuko nari ntahari, kugira ngo mwizeere. Noone, nimuuze tuje aho ari."
Tomasi, witwaga Mahasa, abwira abiigiishwa bagenzi be ati, "Nimuuze naatwe tugende, dupfaane na we."
Yesu agezeyo, asanga Laazaaro amaze iminsi enye mu mva.
Kuva i Beetaniya kugera i Yerusaalemu haari bugufi, nka kilomita itatu,
kandi Abayuuda benshi baari baaje gusuura Marita na Mariya kugira ngo babahuumurize ku bwo gupfuusha musaaza waabo.
Marita yumviise ko Yesu ari kuuza, aja kumusanganira, Mariya we asigara mu rugo.
Marita abwira Yesu ati, "Nyagasani, iyo uba uri hano, musaaza wanje ntaaba yarapfuuye.
Ariko n’ubu nzi yuuko ibyo usabye byose Imaana yaabiguha."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Musaaza waawe azaazuuka."
Marita aramubwira ati, "Nzi yuuko azaazuuka ku munsi w’imperuuka."
Yesu aramubwira ati, "Ninje kuzuuka n’ubugingo. Unyizeera weese n’aho yaaba yarapfuuye, azaabaho,
kandi uriho weese unyizeera ntaabwo azaapfa. Ibyo urabyemera?"
Marita aramusubiza ati, "Yeego Nyagasani, neemera ko uri Kristo, Umwana w’Imaana, uwo yaseezeranyije kuuza mu isi."
Amaze kuvuga ibyo, Marita asubirayo maze ahamagara mwenenyina Mariya, aramwongorera ati, "Umwigiisha ari hano kandi araguhamagara."
Abyumviise, ahaguruka vuba aramusanga.
Yesu ntaabwo yari yaakageze muri ico caaro, ahuubwo yari akiri aho Marita yamusanganiriye.
Abayuuda baari na Mariya mu nzu bamuhuumuriza, baboonye asohotse vuba, baramukurikira biibwira yuuko agiiye kuririra ku mva.
Mariya ageze aho Yesu ari, amuboonye apfukama imbere ye aravuga ati, "Nyagasani, iyo uba hano, musaaza wanje ntaaba yarapfuuye."
Yesu aboonye uko Mariya arira, kandi n’Abayuuda baari bamuherekeje na bo barira, bimushengura umutima agira agahinda.
Arababaza ati, "Mbese mwamuhambye he?" Baramusubiza bati, "Nyagasani, ngwino uhareebe."
Nuuko Yesu ararira.
Maze Abayuuda baravuga bati, "Nimureebe ukuntu yamukundaga!"
Ariko bamwe muri bo baravuga bati, "Mbese uwahumuuye impumyi, yari ananiwe gutuma uyu mugabo adapfa?"
Nuuko Yesu yongera gushenguka umutima, agera ku mva. Iyo mva yari ubuvumo kandi bwari bukingiishijwe ibuye.
Yesu aravuga ati, "Ni mukuureho iryo buye." Ariko Marita, mushiki wa nyakwigendera, aramubwira ati, "Nyagasani, ubu aranuuka kuko amaze iminsi enye apfuuye."
Yesu aramubwira ati, "Sinakubwiye yuuko niweemera urabona ubwiza bw’Imaana?"
Nuuko bakuuraho ibuye. Yesu areeba heejuru maze aravuga ati, "Daata ndagushimye kuko unyumviise.
Nzi yuuko usanzwe unyumva, ariko ibi mbivugiye ku bw’abantu bahagaze hano kugira ngo bizeere ko ari wowe wantumye."
Amaze kuvuga ibyo, ahamagara mu ijwi rirenga ati, "Laazaaro, sohoka!"
Uwari warapfuuye arasohoka, amaboko n’amaguru bye bihambijwe utugozi tw’umwenda, kandi no mu maaso he hapfukiishijwe igitambaaro. Yesu arababwira ati, "Nimumuhambuure, mumureke agende."
Benshi mu Bayuuda baari baaje gusuura Mariya baboonye ibyo Yesu akoze, baramwizeera.
Ariko bamwe muri bo baja kubwira Abafarisaayo ibyo Yesu yakoze.
Nuuko abatware b’abaheerezabitambo hamwe n’Abafarisaayo bahamagaza urukiiko rukuru, baravuga bati, "Turakora iki? Uyu mugabo akomeje gukora ibitangaaza byinshi.
Nitumureka agakomezamo atyo, buri weese aramwemera, bitume Abarooma baaza kurimbura uyu mwanya waacu weera hamwe n’umuryango waacu."
Ariko umwe muri bo witwaga Kayafa, wari Umuheerezabitambo mukuru muri uwo mwaka arababwira ati, "Ntaaco muuzi na hato!
Ntimusobaanukirwa yuuko byakababeereye byiza ngo umuntu umwe apfiire abantu kuruta uko umuryango woose warimburwa."
Ibyo ntiyabivuze ku bwe, ariko kuko yari Umuheerezabitambo mukuru muri uwo mwaka, yahanuuye ko Yesu yenda gupfiira ubwoko bw’Abayuuda,
ariko si ubwo bwoko bwonyine, ahuubwo kwari ukugira ngo ahuurize hamwe abaana b’Imaana baataataanye.
Uheereye uwo munsi abategetsi b’Abayuuda baja inaama zo kwica Yesu.
Nuuko Yesu ntiyongera kugenda mu Bayuuda kumugaragaro, ahuubwo avayo aja mu tawuni yitwa Efurayimu mu gice kiri haafi n’ubutaayu, agumayo n’abiigiishwa be.
Umunsi wo Kunyurwaho kw’Abayuuda wari weegeereje, nuuko benshi bava mu byaro baja i Yerusaalemu mbere y’umunsi wo Kunyurwaho kugira ngo bakore umuhango wo kwihumaanura.
Baashaakaga Yesu maze bakabazanya bahagaze mu Nzu y’Imaana bati, "Murabiteekerezaho iki? Koko ntaaribuuze muri ibi birori?"
Abatware b’abaheerezabitambo hamwe n’Abafarisaayo baari baategetse yuuko umuntu weese uri bumenye aho Yesu ari, akwiriye kubibamenyeesha kugira ngo bamufate.
Hasigaye iminsi itandatu umunsi wo Kunyurwaho ukagera, Yesu aza i Beetaniya, aho Laazaaro, wo yazuuye mu baapfuuye yari atuuye.
Bamuzimaanira ibyokurya bya nimugorooba kandi Marita aba ari we ubigabura. Laazaaro yari umwe mu baasangiraga na Yesu.
Mariya afata icupa ry’amavuta y’agaciiro, ahuumura neeza yitwa naridi, ayasuka ku birenge bya Yesu nuuko abihanaguza umusatsi we. Inzu yoose yuuzura impumuro y’ayo mavuta.
Yuda Isikariyoti, umwe mu biigiishwa be, uwari kuzaamugambaanira aravuga ati,
"Mbese kuki aya mavuta ataaguriishijwe idinaari magana atatu maze zigahaabwa abakene?"
Ntaabwo yavuze atyo ku bwo kwita ku bakene, ahuubwo ni uko yari umujuura kandi ari we wabiikaga umufuka w’amashilingi akiiba ibyo baabiikagamo.
Yesu aravuga ati, "Nimumureke, kuko aya mavuta yayabiikiye kugira ngo anteguurire umunsi wo guhambwa.
Abakene muzaahorana na bo, ariko njeewe ntaabwo muzamporana."
Abayuuda benshi bamaze kumenya ko Yesu ari i Beetaniya, bajayo ariko batajanywe no kureeba Yesu gusa, ahuubwo kugira ngo babone Laazaaro uwo yari yarazuuye mu baapfuuye.
Nuuko abatware b’abaheerezabitambo baja inaama yo kugira ngo na Laazaaro bamwice,
kuko ari we watumaga Abayuuda benshi babaciikaho bakeemera Yesu.
Bukeeye bwaho, abantu benshi bari baaje mu minsi mikuru yo Kunyurwaho, bumva ko Yesu ari kuuza i Yerusaalemu.
Nuuko bafata amashami y’ibiti, baja kumusanganira bateera heejuru bati, "Hozaana! Hahiirwa uje mu izina rya Nyagasani. Umwami wa Isirayeli!"
Yesu aboonye icana c’indogobe aciicaraho, nk’uko byanditswe ngo,
"wiitiinya, mukoobwa w’i Siyoni. Dore, Umwami waawe araaje, yiicaye ku cana c’indogobe!"
Ubwambere, abiigiishwa be ntibaasobaanukiwe ibyo, ariko Yesu amaze kuzuuka agahaabwa ikuzo, ni ho bibutse ko ibyo bintu ari we byari byaranditsweho, ari na ko baabimugiriye.
Ba bantu benshi baari kumwe na we igihe yahamagaye Laazaaro ngo ave mu gituuro akamuzuura, bakomeza guhamya ibyo baaboonye.
Ni co caatumye abantu benshi baja kumusanganira, kuko bumviise ko yakoze ico gitangaaza.
Abafarisaayo baravugana bati, "Murabona ko turi kurushwa n’ubusa. Dore, abantu boose baramukurikiye!"
Haari Abagiriki bamwe na bo baari baaje i Yerusaalemu kuramya muri iyo minsi mikuru.
Beegeera Filipo w’i Beetsayida y’i Galileeya baramubwira bati, "Mutware, turashaaka kureeba Yesu."
Filipo aja kubibwira Andereya, maze bombi baja kubibwira Yesu.
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Igihe kirageze kugira ngo Umwana w’Umuntu ahaabwe ikuzo.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko iyo akabuto k’ingano kataguuye mu taka ngo gapfe, kaguma ari kamwe konyine, ariko iyo gapfuuye keera imbuto nyinshi.
Ukunda ubugingo bwe azaabubura, ariko utanga ubugingo bwe muri iyi si ku bwanje azaabona ubugingo buhoraho.
Unkorera weese akwiriye kunkurikira, kuko aho ndi n’umugaragu wanje ni ho azaaba. Unkorera weese, Daata azaamuha icuubahiro.
Ubu mpagaritse umutima. Noone se mvuge iki! ‘Daata, unkize iki gihe’? Oya, icanzanye ni ukugira ngo ngere kuri iki gihe c’umubabaro.
Daata, heesha izina ryawe icuubahiro." Nuuko ijwi rituruka mu ijuru riravuga riti, "Maze guheesha izina ryanje icuubahiro kandi nzongera kuriheesha ikuzo."
Abantu benshi baari bahagaze aho bumva iryo jwi maze baravuga bati, "Ni inkuba." Abandi baravuga bati, "Malayika avuganye na we."
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Iri jwi riije ku bwanyu, si ku bwanje.
Ubu igihe co guciira isi urubanza kirageze. Umutware w’iyi si agiiye kuneeshwa.
Nanje niimara kumanikwa heejuru y’isi, nziirehereza abantu boose ngo baaze aho ndi."
Ibyo yabivugiye kugaragaza urupfu yari agiiye gupfa urwo ari rwo.

Abantu nyamwinshi baramusubiza bati, "Twasomye mu bitabo by’amategeko ko Kristo azaagumaho iteeka ryose. Noone ushobora ute kuvuga ngo Umwana w’Umuntu agomba kumanikwa heejuru? Mbese uwo Mwana w’Umuntu ni nde?"
Yesu ni ko kubabwira ati, "Umuco uzaabaana namwe kumara igihe gito. Noone ni mugende hakibona kugira ngo umwijima utabatungura, kuko ugenda mu mwijima atamenya iyo agana.
Mugifite umuco, muwizeere, kugira ngo mube abaana b’umuco." Yesu amaze kuvuga atyo aragenda, arabiihisha.
N’ubwo yari yarakoreye ibitangaaza byinshi imbere yaabo, Abayuuda ntibamwizeeye.
Ibyo byabaaye kugira ngo hasohore ibyavuzwe n’umuhanuuzi Yesaaya ati, "Nyagasani, ni nde wizeeye ubutumwa twavuze? Kandi imbaraga z’Uhoraho zaahishuriwe nde?"
Ni co gituma badashobora kwizeera kuko Yesaaya yongeye kuvuga ati,
"Imaana yabahumije amaaso kandi ibanangira imitima, kugira ngo be kubona n’amaaso yaabo kandi be gusobaanukirwa mu mitima, kugira ngo batiihana nkabakiza."
Yesaaya yavuze ibyo kuko yaboonye ubwiza bwa Yesu kandi amuvugaho.
Icakora abantu benshi, ndetse no mu batware, baaramwizeeraga, ariko ntibabivuge ku kumugaragaro kugira ngo Abafarisaayo batabaca mu sinagoogi.
Baakunze gushimwa n’abantu kuruta gushimwa n’Imaana.
Nuuko Yesu avuga aranguruye ati, "Unyiizeera weese si nje aba yiizeeye, ahuubwo aba yiizeeye uwantumye.
Kandi umbona weese aba aboonye uwantumye.
Naaje mu isi ndi umuco, kugira ngo unyizeera weese ataguma mu mwijima.
Umuntu weese wumva amagambo yanje ntayakurikize si nje umuciira urubanza, kuko ntaazanywe no guciira abari mu isi urubanza, ahuubwo nazanywe no kubakiza.
Unyanga, ntiyakiire amagambo yanje afite umucaamanza we, ijambo navuze ni ryo rizaamuciira urubanza ku munsi w’imperuuka!
Kuko ntaavuze ku bwanje, ahuubwo Daata wantumye ni we wantegetse ibyo nkwiriye kuvuga nuuko nkwiriye kubivuga.
Kandi nzi neeza yuuko itegeko rye ari ryo bugingo buhoraho. Nuuko reero ibyo mvuga, mbivuga uko Daata yabimbwiye."
Mbere y’umunsi mukuru wo Kunyurwaho, Yesu yari azi ko igihe ce kigeze co kuva muri iyi si akaja kwa Se. Urukundo yakunze abe bari mu isi, ni rwo yakomeje kubakunda kugeza ku iheerezo.
Sataani yari yamaze kwemeza umutima wa Yuda mwene Simooni Isikariyoti ko amugambaanira. Nuuko bari gufungura ibya nimugorooba
Yesu, azirikanye ko Se yamweguriye ibintu byose, kandi ko yakomootse ku Maana, kandi ko agomba gusubira ku Maana,
ava ku meeza, yikuuramo umwiteero we, maze afata itaahuro arayikenyera.
Nuuko asuka amaazi ku beesani maze atangira gukarabya ibirenge by’abiigiishwa be, akabihanaguza ya taahuro yari akenyeye.
Ageze kuri Simooni Peetero, Peetero aramubwira ati, "Nyagasani, ugiiye kunkarabya ibirenge?"
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ntaabwo wamenya ibyo nkora ubu, ariko haanyuma uzaabisobaanukirwa."
Peetero ni ko kumubwira ati, "Ntuuziigera unkarabya ibirenge." Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ndamutse ntagukarabije ibirenge, ntaaco tuzaaba tugihuuriyeho."
Simooni Peetero ni ko kumusubiza ati, "Nooneho reero Nyagasani, ntunkarabye ibirenge byonyine, ahuubwo unkarabye n’amaboko ndetse n’umutwe!"
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Uwiiyuhagiye umubiri ntaabwo aba yiifuuza gukaraba ukundi, keretse ibirenge, kuko aba yiisukuuye weese. Kandi koko murasukuuwe, n’ubwo atari mwese."
Yesu yari azi ugiiye kumugambaanira, kandi niyo mpamvu yavuze ati, "Ntaabwo ariko mwese muri abeere."
Amaze kubakarabya ibirenge, yongera kwambara umwiteero we, no gusubira ku meeza, arababaza ati, "Aho musobaanukiwe ico maze kubakorera?
Munyita Umwigiisha na Nyagasani, kandi koko murashitsa, kuko ni wo ndi we.
Noone reero ubwo njeewe, Nyagasani kandi Umwigiisha mbakarabije ibirenge, namwe mugomba kuja mubikarabyanya.
Mbahaaye urugero, kugira ngo namwe muje mukora nk’uko mbakoreye.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko, nta bagaragu baruta sheebuja, kandi nta ntumwa zaaruta uwazitumye.
Nimumenya ibyo, murahiirwa muramutse mubikurikije.
Ntaabwo ari mwese mvugaho, kuko nzi abo natooranyije. Ariko ni ukugira ngo ibyanditswe byuzuzwe ngo, ‘Uwo twasangiye ibyokurya ni we wampindutse.’
Ndabibabwira ubu bitari byaba, kugira ngo nibiba, muzeemere ko ndi we.
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko, uwaakiira uwo ntumye aba anyakiiriye, kandi unyakiira aba yakiiriye uwantumye."
Amaze kuvuga atyo, Yesu ashenguka umutima maze avuga yeeruye ati, "Ndababwira ukuri, umwe muri mwe agiiye kungambaanira."
Abiigiishwa barareebana, kuko ntibaari baazi uwo yavugaga.
Umwe mu biigiishwa ba Yesu, uwo yakundaga caane, yari yiicaye haafi ye,
maze Simooni Peetero amwicira ijiisho ngo amubaze uwo yamenyeeshaga.
Nuuko wa mwigiishwa yeegeera Yesu maze aramubaza ati, "Nyagasani, uwo uvuze ni nde?"
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ni uwo ndaha ikimanyu c’umugaati maze gukoza." Nuuko amaze gukoza ikimanyu c’umugaati, agiheereza Yuda mwene Simooni Isikariyoti.
Yuda amaze kwakiira ico kimanyu c’umugaati, Sataani amwinjiramo. Yesu aramubwira ati, "Ico ugiiye gukora, gikore vuba."
Ariko nta n’umwe mu baari ku meeza wamenye icaatumye amubwira atyo.
Kuko Yuda yari asanzwe ari umubiitsi, bamwe baateekereje ko Yesu yamubwiraga ko aja kugura ibyo kwifashiisha ku umunsi mukuru, cangwa kugira ico aha abakene.
Nuuko Yuda amaze kwakiira ca kimanyu c’umugaati, ako kaanya arasohoka. Kandi haari nijoro.
Yuda amaze gusohoka, Yesu aravuga ati, "Ubu Umwana w’Umuntu ahaawe ikuzo, kandi Imaana na yo iheerewe ikuzo muri we.
Kandi ubwo Imaana iheerewe ikuzo muri we, Imaana na yo izaaha Umwana w’Umuntu ikuzo muri yo kandi igiiye kumukuza bidatinze.
Baana banje, ndacaari kumwe namwe akaanya gato. Muzanshaaka, kandi nk’uko nabwiye Abayuuda, ubu namwe ndabibabwiye nti, ‘Aho ngiiye, ntimushobora kuhaja.’
Mbahaaye itegeko risha, nimukundane. Nk’uko nabakunze, abe ari ko namwe mukundana.
Nimugirirana urukundo, ico ni co boose bazaabamenyeraho ko muri abiigiishwa banje."
Simooni Peetero aramubaza ati, "Nyagasani, ugiiye he?" Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Aho ngiiye ubu, ntuushobora kunkurikira, ariko uzankurikira ubundi."
Peetero aravuga ati, "Nyagasani, icambuza kugukurikira ubu ni iki? Niiteguuye no kugupfiira."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Witeguuye kuzampfiira? Ndakubwira ukuri yuuko isaaki itaraabika, uraba umaze kunyihakana gatatu."
Yesu arababwira ati, "Ntimuhagarike imitima yaanyu. Mwizeere Imaana, nanje munyizeere.
Mu nzu ya Daata harimo ibisenge byinshi. Iyo biba bitameze bityo, mba ntaarababwiye ko ngiye kubateguurira umwanya.
Kandi niimara kubateguurira umwanya, nzaagaruka maze mbijanire, kugira ngo aho ndi namwe abe ari ho muba.
Kandi inzira ija aho ngiiye murayiizi."
Tomasi aramubaza ati, "Nyagasani, twaba tutaazi aho ugiiye, maze tukamenya inzira ijayo?"
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ni nje nzira, n’ukuri, n’ubugingo. Ntaawe uja kwa Daata atanyuze kuri nje.
Niiba munzi, na Daata muzaamumenya. Ndetse kuva uyu munsi muramuuzi kandi mwaramuboonye."
Filipo aramubwira ati, "Nyagasani, twereke So, ibyo biraba bihaagije."
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Filipo we, n’iki gihe coose tumaranye noone ukaba utanzi? Uwamboonye weese aba yaaboonye na Daata. Noone ushobora ute kuvuga ngo, ‘Twereke So’?
Ntaabwo mwemera ko ndi muri Daata, na Daata akaba muri nje? Amagambo mbabwira sinyavuga ku bwanje, ahuubwo Daata umporamo ni we ukora imirimo ye.
Nimwemere ko ndi muri Daata na Daata akaba muri nje, ariko niiba mutabyemera, niibura nimwemezwe n’imirimo nkora.
Ndababwira ukuri, ko unyemera azaakora imirimo nkora, kandi azaakora n’ibiruta ibi, kuko ngiye kwa Daata.
Byongeye kandi, nzaakora ico muzansaba coose mu izina ryanje, kugira ngo Daata aheererwe ikuzo mu Mwana.
Nimugira ico musaba coose mu izina ryanje, nzaagikora.
Niiba munkunda, muzuubahiriza amategeko yanje.
Nanje nzaasaba Daata, na we azaabaha undi Mufasha, kugira ngo abaane namwe ibihe byose.
Uwo ni we Mwuka w’ukuri, wo ab’isi badashobora kwakiira kuko batamubona kandi batamuuzi. Ariko mwebwe muramuuzi, kuko abaana namwe, kandi azaaba muri mwe.
Sinzaabasiga mwenyine nk’imfubyi, nzaabagarukira.
Mumwanya muto, ab’isi ntibazongera kumbona, ariko mwebwe muzambona, kuko ndiho, namwe muzaabaho.
Uwo munsi muzaamenya ko mba muri Daata, kandi namwe mukaba muri nje, nk’uko nanje ndi muri mwe.
Abeemera amategeko yanje kandi bakayakurikiza ni bo bankunda, kandi abankunda bazaakundwa na Daata, nanje nzaabakunda kandi mbiyereke."
Yuda (Utari Isikariyoti) aramubaza ati, "Nyagasani, uzaatwiyereka twenyine ute, utiyeretse ab’isi?"
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Abankunda bazuubaha ijambo ryanje, kandi na Daata azaabakunda, maze nje na Daata tubasange tubaane na bo.
Utankunda weese ntaakurikiza inyigiisho yanje, kandi inyigiisho mwumva si iyanje, ahuubwo ni iya Daata wantumye.
Ibi mbibabwiye nkiri kumwe namwe,
ariko Umufasha, ari we Mwuka Weera, uwo Daata azoohereza mu izina ryanje, ni we uzaabiigiisha byose, kandi abiibutse ibyo nababwiye byose.
Mbasigiye amahoro, mbahaaye amahoro yanje. Sinyabahaaye nk’uko ab’isi bayatanga. Ntimuhagarike imitima, kandi ntimugire ubwoba.
Mwumviise mbabwira nti, ‘Ndagiiye, kandi nzaabagarukira.’ Iyaaba mwankundaga, mwakwishiimiye ko ngiiye kwa Daata, kuko Daata anduta.
Dore ibyo mbibabwiye bitari byaba, kugira ngo nibiba, muzeemere.
Sinzongera kuvugana namwe byinshi, kuko umutegetsi w’iyi si arenda kuuza. Ntabubaasha amfiteho,
ahuubwo nkora uko Daata yantegetse, kugira ngo isi imenye ko mukunda. Nimuhaguruke, tuve hano."
"Ndi umuzaabibu w’ukuri, naho Daata akaba umuhinzi.
Ishami ryose ryo muri nje riteera imbuto arikuuraho. Ishami ryose ryera imbuto araryicira kugira ngo rirusheho kwera izindi mbuto.
Mwebwe mwejejwe n’ijambo nababwiye.
Mugume muri nje, nk’uko nanje nguma muri mwe. Nk’uko ishami ridashobora kwera imbuto ku bwaryo ritari ku muzaabibu, namwe ni ko mutaashobora kwera imbuto mutagumye muri nje.
Nje ndi umuzaabibu, kandi mwe muri amashami. Uguma muri nje, nanje nkaguma muri we, yeera imbuto nyinshi, kuko tutari kumwe nta co mwashobora gukora.
Utaguma muri nje, ajugunywa nk’ishami maze akuumagatana. Amashami ameze atyo barayakungaanya, bakayajugunya mu muriro, agasha.
Nimuguma muri nje, n’amagambo yanje akaguma muri mwe, musabe ico mushaaka coose, muzaagihaabwa.
Igiheesha Daata icuubahiro ni uko mwakwera imbuto nyinshi kandi mukaba abiigiishwa banje.
Uko Daata yankunze, ni ko nabakunze. Nimugume mu rukundo rwanje.
Nimwubaha amategeko yanje, muzaaguma mu rukundo rwanje, nk’uko nanje nuubaha amategeko ya Daata, maze nkaguma mu rukundo rwe.
Ibi mbibabwiye ngira ngo umuneezeero wanje ube muri mwe, kandi ngo umuneezeero waanyu ube mwinshi.
Itegeko ryanje ngiri, mukundane nk’uko nanje nabakunze.
Ntaawagira urukundo ruruta urw’umuntu gupfiira inshuti ze.
Muri inshuti zanje, nimukora ibyo mbategetse.
Sinkibiita abagaragu, kuko umugaragu atamenya ico sheebuja akora, ahuubwo mbiise inshuti zanje, kuko nabamenyesheje ibyo numviise kuri Daata byose.
Si mwe mwantooranyije, ahuubwo ni nje wabatooranyije. Nabatumye kuja kwera imbuto, kandi ngo izo mbuto zigumeho, kugira ngo Daata azaabahe ico muzaasaba coose mu izina ryanje.
Mbategetse kugira ngo mukundane.
Abantu b’isi nibabanga, mumenye ko ari nje baabanje kwanga bataraabanga.
Iyo muba ab’isi , baari kubakunda nk’uko bakunda abaabo. Ariko kuko mutari ab’isi, ahuubwo nkaba narabatooranyije mu b’isi, ni co gituma ab’isi babanga.
Mwibuke ijambo nababwiye nti, ‘umugaragu ntaaruta sheebuja.’ Niiba bantooteza, namwe bazaabatooteza, kandi niiba baarakurikije inyigiisho yanje, n’iyaanyu bazaayikurikiza.
Ariko ibi byose bazaabibakorera babaziza izina ryanje, kuko bataazi uwantumye.
Iyo ntaaza ngo mvugane na bo, ntibaba bafite icaaha, ariko ubu ntibafite uko bakwireguura icaaha caabo.
Unyanga weese aba yanga na Daata.
Iyo ntagaragaza muri bo ibitangaaza bitiigeze gukorwa n’undi muntu weese, ntibaajaga kugira icaaha. Ariko baarabiboonye, bararenga baranyanga, hamwe na Daata.
Ibyo byabaaye kugira ngo ibyanditswe mu mategeko yaabo byuzuzwe ngo, ‘Banyanze nta co banziza.’
Ubwo Umufasha nzaabooherereza avuuye kuri Daata azaaza, ari we Mwuka w’ukuri ukomooka kuri Daata, azambeera umuhamya.
Namwe reero muzantangeho ubuhamya kuko mwabanye nanje kuva mu ntangiriro.
Ibyo mbibabwiye ngira ngo hatagira ikibaguusha.
Bazaabaca mu masinagoogi kandi igihe kigiiye kugera, aho abazaabiica baziibwira ko mu gukora ibyo bazaaba bakorera Imaana.
Ibyo bazaabikora babiteewe n’uko bataamenye Daata, nanje ntibaamenye.
Ibyo mbibabwiriye kugira ngo igihe ca byo nikigera, muziibuke ko nabibabwiye. Ibyo sinabibabwiye mbere na mbere, kuko nari kumwe namwe.
Ubu nenda gusanga uwantumye, ariko mbabajwe n’uko ntaanumwe muri mwe umbaza ati, ‘ugiiye he?’
Ariko kuko mbabwiye ibyo, imitima yaanyu yuuzuye agahinda.
Ariko ndababwira ukuri yuuko icaabagirira akamaro ari uko naagenda, kuko ntagiiye, Umufasha ntaabwo azaaza muri mwe, ariko ningenda nzamubooherereza.
Kandi naamara kuuza, azeereka ab’isi ico icaaha kimenyeesha, ico gukiraanuka bimenyeesha n’ibyo guciirwa urubanza.
Azaababwira ibyerekeye icaaha caabo, kuko batanyemeye.
Azaababwira ibyerekeye gukiraanuka, kuko ngiye kwa Daata, kandi mukaba mutakimboonye.
Azaababwira ibyerekeye urubanza, kuko umutware w’iyi si yaciiriwe urubanza.
Ndacaafite ibyo kubabwira byinshi, ariko ubu ntimwashobora kubyihangaanira.
Ubwo Umwuka w’ukuri azaaza, azaabayobora mu kuri koose, kuko atazaavuga ku bwe, ahuubwo azaavuga ibyo yumviise byose, kandi akabamenyeesha ibigiiye kubaho.
Azampeesha ikuzo, kuko azaahaabwa ku byanje maze akabibamenyeesha.
Ibyo Daata afite byose ni ibyanje, ni co gitumye mvuga ko azaafata ku byanje maze akabibamenyeesha.
Hasigaye akaanya gato, ntimwongere kumbona, maze akandi kaanya gato, mukambona."

Bamwe mu biigiishwa be batangira kubazanya bati, "Ubwo aramenyeesha iki kutubwira ati, ‘Hasigaye akaanya gato ntimwongere kumbona, maze akandi kaanya gato, mukambona.’ Kandi ngo ‘Kuko ngiiye kwa Daata’?"
Nuuko barabaza bati, "Iby’aka kaanya gato biramenyeesha iki? Ntaabwo tuuzi ico ashaaka kuvuga."
Yesu amenya ko bashaaka kumubaza, arababwira ati, "Mbese murabazanya ico namenyeeshaga ubwo navugaga nti, ‘Mukanya gato ntimuzambona, kandi akandi kaanya gato, muzambona.’?
Ndababwira ukuri yuuko mwebwe muzaarira kandi mukaganya, ariko ko ab’isi bazaaneezeerwa, mwe muzaagira umubabaro, ariko umubabaro waanyu uzaahinduka umuneezeero.
Iyo umugore agiiye kubyara, arababara kuko igihe ce kiba kigeze, ariko iyo umwana amaze kuvuuka, ntaabwo aba aciibuka ububabare, kuko aba aneejeejwe nuuko haba havuutse umuntu ku isi.
Namwe ubu mufite umubabaro, ariko nzongera kubabona, maze imitima yaanyu ineezeerwe, kandi ntaamuntu uzaabaaka umuneezeero waanyu.
Uwo munsi ntaaco muzambaza. Ndababwira ukuri yuuko, nimugira ico musaba Daata mu izina ryanje, azaakibaha.
Kugeza ubu ntaaco mwari mwasaba mu izina ryanje. Musabe muzaahaabwa, kugira ngo umuneezeero waanyu useesekare.
Ibyo mbibabwiye mu marenga. Igihe kirageze ubwo ntazongera kubabwirira mu marenga, ahuubwo nkababwira neeruye ibyerekeye Daata.
