Uwo munsi muzaasaba mu izina ryanje. Simbabwira ngo nzaabasabira kuri Daata,
kuko Daata ubwe abakundira ko mwankunze, kandi mukeemera ko nkomooka ku Maana.
Nakomootse kuri Daata maze nza mu isi, noone ngiiye kuva mu isi nsubire kuri Daata."
Abiigiishwa be baravuga bati, "Nooneho uravuga weeruye, udakoreesheje amarenga.
Ubu tumenye ko uzi byose, kandi ko bitari ngombwa kugira ico umuntu akubaza, ni co gituma twemera ko ukomooka ku Maana."
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Nooneho ubu mureemera?
Dore ubu igihe kireegeereje, ndetse kirageze, maze mugataataana, umwe akaja ukwe n’undi ukwe, maze mukansiga njenyine. Ariko ntaabwo ndi njenyine kuko Daata ari kumwe nanje.
Ibyo mbibabwiye kugira ngo mugire amahoro ku bwo kunyizeera. Mu isi muzaatootezwa, ariko nimukomere kuko naneesheje isi!"
Yesu amaze kuvuga atyo, yubuura amaaso areeba heejuru maze aravuga ati, "Daata, igihe kirageze, heesha Umwana waawe icuubahiro, kugira ngo na we aguheeshe icuubahiro,
kuko wamuhaaye ububaasha ku bantu boose, kugira ngo abo wamuhaaye boose, abahe ubugingo buhoraho.
Kandi ubwo bugingo buhoraho ni ukukumenya, wowe Maana y’ukuri yoonyine, no kumenya uwo watumye ari we Yesu Kristo.
Naguheesheje icuubahiro hano mu isi, ndangiza umurimo wampaaye gukora.
Noone ubu, Daata, imbere yaawe umpeeshe icuubahiro nk’ico nahoranye imbere yaawe, isi itaraaremwa.
Naamamaje izina ryawe mu bantu wampaaye ubakuuye mu isi. Baari abaawe urabampa, noone buubaha ijambo ryawe.
Noone ubu baazi yuuko ibyo wampaaye byose bikomooka kuri wowe,
kuko nabahaaye amagambo wampaaye, maze barayaakiira kandi bamenya ukuri yuuko nkomooka kuri wowe, kandi bakeemera ko ari wowe wantumye.
Ubu ndabasabira. Ntaabwo nsabira ab’isi, ahuubwo ndasabira abo wampaaye, kuko ari abaawe.
Abantu banje ni abaawe, kandi abaawe na bo ni abanje kandi naheerewe icuubahiro muri bo.
Ntaabwo nkiri mu isi, ariko bo bari mu isi, kandi nje ngusanga. Daata weera, abo wampaaye barindishe izina ryawe wampaaye, kugira ngo babe umwe nk’uko naatwe turi umwe.
Igihe nari kumwe na bo, nabarindaga nkoreesheje imbaraga z’izina ryawe wampaaye. Narabarinze ntihaagira n’umwe muri bo utaakara, keretse uwari waragenewe kurimbuka kugira ngo Ibyanditswe byuzuzwe.
Daata, ubu ndi haafi kugusanga, kandi ibyo mbivuze nkiri mu isi kugira ngo bagire umuneezeero wuuzuye muri bo.
Nabahaaye ijambo ryawe, maze ab’isi barabanga kuko batari ab’isi, nk’uko nanje ntari uw’isi.
Singusaba ko ubakuura ku isi, ahuubwo ndagusaba kubarinda Umubi.
Ntaabwo ari ab’isi, nk’uko nanje ntari uw’isi.
Beereze mu kuri, ijambo ryawe ni ukuri.
Uko wantumye ku isi, nanje ni ko nabatumye ku isi.
Kandi ku bw’abo narakwiyeguriye, kugira ngo na bo bakwiyegurire mu kuri.
Ntaabwo nsabira aba bonyine, ahuubwo ndasabira n’abazaanyemera babikeesha ijambo ryabo,
kugira ngo boose babe umwe. Nk’uko wowe, Daata uba muri nje, nanje nkaba muri wowe, nasabaga ko na bo bunga ubumwe muri twe, kugira ngo isi yeemere ko ari wowe wantumye.
Icuubahiro wampaaye nanje narakibahaaye, kugira ngo babe umwe nk’uko naatwe turi umwe.
Nje mba muri bo, naawe uba muri nje, kugira ngo babe umwe burundu, maze isi imenye ko wantumye, kandi ko wabakunze nk’uko wankunze.
Daata, ndashaaka ko abo wampaaye na bo babaana nanje aho ndi, kugira ngo babone ikuzo ryanje, ryo wampaaye, kuko wankunze isi itaraaremwa.
Daata utungaanye, isi ntaabwo ikuuzi, ariko nje ndakuuzi, kandi aba baazi ko wantumye.
Nabamenyesheje izina ryawe, kandi nzaakomeza kuribamenyeesha, kugira ngo urukundo wankunze rubabemo, kandi nanje mbabemo."
Yesu amaze kuvuga ayo magambo, asohoka n’abiigiishwa be, bambuka ikibaya ca Kidironi. Yesu n’abiigiishwa be binjira mu gashamba kaari muri uwo mwanya.
Yuda wamugambaaniye na we yari azi uwo mwanya kuko Yesu yakundaga kuhaja n’abiigiishwa be.
Nuuko Yuda azana abasirikare hamwe n’abapolisi yahaawe n’abatware b’abaheerezabitambo n’Abafarisaayo. Baaje biitwaje amataara, amatooki hamwe n’intwaro.
Nuuko Yesu ubwo yari azi ibigiiye kubaho byose, arabasanga maze arababaza ati, "Murashaaka nde?"
Baramusubiza bati, "Yesu w’i Nazaareeti." Yesu arababwira ati, "Ni njeewe." Yuda, umugambanyi yari ahagararanye na bo.
Yesu amaze kubabwira ati, "Ni njeewe," basubira inyuma, bagwa haasi.
Arongera arababaza ati, "Murashaaka nde?" Baravuga bati, "Yesu w’i Nazaareeti,"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Nababwiye ko ari nje. Niiba ari nje mushaaka reero, nimureke aba bagende."
Yabivuze agira ngo ijambo yavuze risohore, ati, "Mu bo wampaaye ntaan’umwe muri bo nataakaje."
Simooni Peetero yari afite inkoota nuuko ayikuurayo, ayikubita umugaragu w’Umuheerezabitambo mukuru, amuca ugutwi kw’iburyo. Uwo mugaragu yitwaga Malikosi.
Yesu abwira Peetero ati, "Subiza inkoota yaawe mu rwubati. Mbese singomba kubabazwa nk’uko Daata yabinteguuriye?"
Abasirikare, umutware waabo, hamwe n’abapolisi b’Abayuuda bafata Yesu, maze baramuboha.
Babanza kumujaana kwa Anaasi wari seebukwe wa Kayafa, Umuheerezabitambo mukuru w’uwo mwaka.
Kayafa ni we wari waragiiriye inaama Abayuuda yuuko bikwiriye ko umuntu umwe yapfiira abantu benshi.
Simooni Peetero n’undi mwigiishwa bakurikira Yesu. Kuko uwo mwigiishwa yari azwi n’Umuheerezabitambo mukuru, yinjirana na Yesu mu gikaari c’inzu y’uwo Muheerezabitambo mukuru.
Peetero we asigara ahagaze hanze inyuma y’irembo. Wa mwigiishwa wari uziranye n’Umuheerezabitambo mukuru, arasohoka avugana n’umugore warindaga irembo, nuuko yinjiza Peetero.
Wa mugore abaza Peetero ati, "Aho naawe ntiwaba uri umwe mu biigiishwa b’uriiya mugabo?" Peetero aramusubiza ati, "Oya, ntaabwo ndi we."
Abagaragu n’abapolisi baari bacanye umuriro w’amakara boota, kuko haari imbeho. Peetero na we yari kumwe na bo ahagaze yoota.
Nuuko Umukuru w’abaheerezabitambo abaza Yesu iby’abiigiishwa be n’inyigiisho ye.
Yesu arasubiza ati, "Navugiraga ku kumugaragaro, mbwira isi yoose. Nigiishirizaga mu masinagoogi no mu Nzu y’Imaana aho Abayuuda boose bateeranira. Ntaaco navuze rwihishwa.
Kuki umbaza? Baza abumviise ibyo nababwiraga, baazi ibyo navuze."
Amaze kuvuga atyo, umupolisi umwe wari uhagaze aho akubita Yesu urushi mu maaso, avuga ati, "Uko ni ko ugomba gusubiza Umuheerezabitambo mukuru?"
Yesu arasubiza ati, "Niiba mvuze ikidashitse, garagaza ikibi mvuze, kandi niiba mvuze igikwiriye, unkubitiye iki?"
Maze Anaasi yoohereza Yesu aboshwe kwa Kayafa, Umuheerezabitambo mukuru.
Simooni Peetero yari agihagaze aho kandi yota, maze baramubaza bati, "Mbese ntaabwo uri umwe mu biigiishwa be?" Arabiihakana avuga ati, "Ntaabwo ndi we."
Umwe mu bagaragu w’Umuheerezabitambo mukuru, wari mwene waabo w’umugabo Peetero yaciiye ugutwi aramubaza ati, "Sinakuboonye uri kumwe na bo muri ka gashamba?"
Peetero yongera guhakana, maze ako kaanya isaaki irabika.

Mu gitondo kare kare, bavaana Yesu kwa Kayafa bamujaana mu rugo rwa Pilaato, wari umutware w’i Rooma. Bo ntaabwo binjiye mu rugo rw’umutware kugira ngo batiihumaanya, bakabura uko barya ifunguro ryo Kunyurwaho.
Pilaato arasohoka abasanga hanze, maze arababaza ati, "Uyu mugabo muramurega iki?"
Baramusubiza bati, "Iyo uyu mugabo ataba ari umugiranaabi, ntituba tumukuuzaniye."
Pilaato arababwira ati, "Nimumujaane mumuciire urubanza mukurikije amategeko yaanyu." Abayuuda baramusubiza bati, "Ntaabwo twemerewe kugira uwo duciira urubanza rwo gupfa."
(Ibyo byabaaye kugira ngo ijambo Yesu yavuze ryerekeye urupfu rwe ryuzurizwe.)
Pilaato yongera gusubira mu rugo rwe, ahamagaza Yesu, maze aramubaza ati, "Uri Umwami w’Abayuuda?"
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Mbese ibyo ubibajije ku bwawe, cangwa ni abandi bakubwiye ibyanje?"
Pilaato aramusubiza ati, "Aho ntuugira ngo nanje ndi Umuyuuda? Beene waanyu hamwe n’abatware b’abaheerezabitambo ni bo bakunzaniye, wakoze iki?"

Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ubwami bwanje ntaabwo ari ubwo kuri iyi si. Iyo Ubwami bwanje buba ari ubwo kuri iyi si, abiigiishwa banje baba bandwanyeho kugira ngo ntashikirizwa Abayuuda. Ariko uko bimeze, Ubwami bwanje ntaabwo ari ubwa hano."

Pilaato aramubaza ati, "Noone se uri umwami?" Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Urabivuze ko ndi umwami. Iki ni co navuukiye kandi ni co canzanye mu isi, guhamya ukuri. Umuntu weese ufite ukuri muri we, yumva ijwi ryanje."
Pilaato aramubaza ati, "Ukuri ni iki?" Yesu amaze kuvuga atyo, Pilaato yongera gusohoka, asanga Abayuuda maze arababwira ati, "Nta rubanza musanganye.
Ariko musanzwe mufite umugenzo ko mbarekurira imbohe imwe mwishaakiye, ku munsi wo Kunyurwaho, murashaaka ko mbarekurira Umwami w’Abayuuda?"
Bateera heejuru bavuga bati, "Si uwo mugabo dushaaka, ahuubwo duhe Baraba!" Uwo Baraba yari umwe mubaarwanyaga ubutegetsi bw’i Rooma.
Nuuko Pilaato ajaana Yesu maze ategeka ko bamukubita ibibooko.
Abasirikare baboha ikamba ry’amahwa, barimwambika ku mutwe maze bamwambika igishuura gitukura.
Bakaaza bamubwira bati, "Turakuramutsa, Mwami w’Abayuuda!" Nuuko bakamukubita inshi mu maaso.
Pilaato yongera gusohoka maze arababwira ati, "Dore ndamubaazanira kugira ngo mbamenyeeshe yuuko nta caaha na kimwe musanganye."
Nuuko Yesu asohoka yambaye ikamba ry’amahwa n’igishuura gitukura. Pilaato arababwira ati, "Dore nguyu wa muntu!"

Abatware b’abaheerezabitambo n’abapolisi bamukubise amaaso, bateera heejuru bati, "Ni abambwe! Ni abambwe!" Pilaato ni ko kubabwira ati, "Ngaho nimumujaane abe ari mwe mumwibambira. Nje ntaacaha kimuhama musanganye."
Abayuuda barasubiza bati, "Dufite itegeko, kandi dukurikije iryo tegeko agomba gupfa, kuko yiigize Umwana w’Imaana."
Pilaato yumviise ibyo, arushaho kugira ubwoba.
Yongera kwinjira mu gikaari maze abaza Yesu ati, "Ukomooka he?" Ariko Yesu ntihaagira ico asubiza.
Pilaato ni ko kumubwira ati, "Wanze kunsubiza? Ntaabwo uzi yuuko mfite ububaasha bwo kukurekura, kandi nkagira n’ububaasha bwo kukubamba?"
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Ntabubaasha wagombaga kungiraho utabuhaawe n’Imaana. Ni co gituma uwakungabije afite icaaha kiruta icaawe."

Pilaato abyumviise agerageza gushaaka uburyo bwo kurekura Yesu, ariko Abayuuda bateera heejuru bati, "Nuurekura uyu mugabo uraba utari inshuti ya Kayisaari, kuko uwiigira umwami weese aba arwanya Kayisaari."
Pilaato ko yumviise ayo magambo, ajaana Yesu hanze maze yiicara ku ntebe y’ubucaamanza ahiitwa "Mabuye Ashashe", mu Ruheburayo hakiitwa "Gabata".
Ubwo haari umunsi wo kwiteguura ibyo Kunyurwaho, kandi haari nk’isaaha itandatu z’amanywa. Abwira Abayuuda ati, "Nguyu umwami waanyu!"
Bateera heejuru bati, "Mwice! Mwice! Mubambe!" Pilaato arababaza ati, "Mbambe umwami waanyu?" Abaheerezabitambo bakuru barasubiza bati, "Nta mwami wundi dufite keretse Kayisaari."
Nuuko Pilaato aramubaha ngo bamubambe. Nuuko bajaana Yesu.
Agenda yikoreye umusaraba, yeerekeza ahantu hiitwa "Ku Kibihanga," mu Ruheburayo hakiitwa "Gologota."
Aho ni ho baamubambiye, kandi bamubamba n’abandi babiri, umwe iburyo undi ibumoso, Yesu ari hagati yaabo.
Nuuko Pilaato yandika inyandiko ayishira ku musaraba. Yari yanditswe ngo, "Yesu w’i Nazaareeti, Umwami w’Abayuuda."
Abayuuda benshi baasomye iyo nyandiko kuko aho Yesu yabambwe haari haafi n’itawuni nkuru, kandi yari yanditswe mu Ruheburayo, mu Rulatini, hamwe no mu Rugiriki.
Abatware b’abaheerezabitambo b’Abayuuda babwira Pilaato bati, "Reka kwandika ngo, ‘Umwami w’Abayuuda,’ ahuubwo andika ngo, ‘Uyu mugabo yavugaga ko ari Umwami w’Abayuuda.’ "
Pilaato arabasubiza ati, "Ico nanditse, nacanditse."

Abasirikare bamaze kubamba Yesu, bajaana imyambaro ye maze bayigabamo kane, buri musirikare ajaana umugabane we. Bajanye n’ikanzu ye ariko iyo kanzu ntaabwo yari ifite umubariiro, ahuubwo yari iboshwe kuva heejuru kugeza haasi.

Abasirikare barabwirana bati, "Ntituyitandure, ahuubwo reka tuyikorereho ubufindo, maze tumenye uri buyijaane." Bityo huuzuzwa ibyanditswe ngo, "Bigabanyije imyambaro yanje, maze ikanzu yanje bayikoreraho ubufindo." Uko ni ko abasirikare baabigenjeje.
Iruhande rw’umusaraba wa Yesu haari hahagaze nyina, nyinawaabo, Mariya umugore wa Kilopasi, na Mariya Magadaleena.
Yesu aboonye nyina na wa mwigiishwa yakundaga bahagararanye, abwira nyina ati, "Mugore, dore umwana waawe."
Abwira wa mwigiishwa ati, "Nguyu nyoko." Uheereye ubwo, uwo mwigiishwa amujaana iwe.
Haanyuma y’ibyo, Yesu amaze kumenya ko byose birangiye, (kandi kugira ngo ibyanditswe bisohore), aravuga ati, "Mfite imyota."
Aho haari hateretse ikibindi cuuzuye divaayi ishaariira. Nuuko bahambira ku rubingo icangwe bagikoza muri ya divaayi ishaariira, maze bagishira ku munwa we.
Yesu amaze kunywa kuri iyo divaayi, aravuga ati, "Birarangiye." Nuuko yuunika umutwe maze umwuka urahera.

Kuko wari umunsi wo kwiteguurira umunsi mukuru wo Kunyurwaho, Abayuuda ntibaashaakaga ko imirambo iguma ku musaraba ku Saabato, kandi iyo Saabato yari umunsi mukuru. Maze basaba Pilaato ngo bavune amaguru yaabo, maze imirambo bayimanure.
Abasirikare baraaza bavuna amaguru y’uwambere n’ay’undi wari ubambanywe na Yesu.
Ariko baageze kuri Yesu basanga yapfuuye, ntibiirirwa bamuvuna amaguru,
ahuubwo umwe mu basirikare amutikura icumu mu rubavu, ako kaanya havamo amaraso n’amaazi.
(Uwabiboonye ni we ubihamije kugira ngo naawe weemere. Ubuhamya bwe ni ubw’ukuri kandi azi ko avuga ukuri.)
Ibyo byabaaye kugira ngo ibyanditswe bisohore ngo, "Nta gufa rye rizaavunwa."
Kandi ibindi byanditswe biravuga ngo, "Bazaarangamira uwo baateeye icumu."
Nyuma y’ibyo, Yozefu wa Arimatiya, wari umuyoboke wa Yesu rwihishwa kuko yatiinyaga Abayuuda, asaba Pilaato gukuraho umurambo wa Yesu. Pilaato arabimwemerera, nuuko araaza arawujaana.
Nikodemu, wa wundi wigeze gusanga Yesu n’ijoro, na we araaza azanye ikivange c’imibavu yari ifite uburemeezi bungana nk’ibiro mirongo itatu.
Bajaana umurambo wa Yesu maze bawuzinga mu mwenda n’imibavu, bakurikije umugenzo wo guhamba w’Abayuuda.
Aho yabambwe haari umurima, kandi muri uwo murima haarimo imva nsha itaraahambwamo umuntu weese.
Kubeera ko wari umunsi ubanziriza i Saabato, kandi ko iyo mva yari haafi, aba ariho bahamba Yesu.
Mu gitondo co ku c’umweru, Mariya Magadaleena azindukira ku mva butaraatandukana, maze asanga rya buye ryavanywe ku mva.
Agenda yirukanka asanga Simooni Peetero na wa mwigiishwa Yesu yakundaga, maze arababwira ati, "Nyagasani baamukuuye mu mva, noone ntituuzi iyo baamushize."
Peetero na wa mwigiishwa barasohoka baja ku mva.
Bombi bariiruka, ariko wa mwigiishwa asiga Peetero, amutanga kugera ku mva.
Aruunama arungurukamo, maze abona imyenda irambitse haasi, ariko ntiyinjira mu mva.
Simooni Peetero wari umukurikiye abe arahageze, arinjira. Abona imyenda irambitswe haasi,
kandi igitambaaro caari ku mutwe wa Yesu, kitarambitswe hamwe na ya myenda, ahuubwo co kizinze kiri hiirya coonyine.
Wa mwigiishwa wari wageze ku mva mbere, na we arinjira, maze areemera.
Kugeza ubwo baari bataraamenya ibyanditswe ko agomba kuzuuka mu baapfuuye.
Maze abiigiishwa basubira mu mago yaabo.
Mariya yari ahagaze ku mva arira. Akirira, aruunama arunguruka mu mva,
maze abona abaamalayika babiri bambaye imyenda yeererana, biicaye aho umurambo wa Yesu wari urambitswe, umwe ahagana ku mutwe, undi ahagana ku birenge.
Baramubwira bati, "Mugore, kuki uri kurira?" Arabasubiza ati, "Umwami wanje baamujaanye, noone nayobewe iyo baamushize."
Amaze kuvuga atyo, arahinduka areeba inyuma maze abona Yesu ahahagaze, ariko ntiyamenya ko ari we.

Yesu aramubaza ati, "Mugore, urarizwa n’iki? Urashaaka nde?" Yiibwira ko ari umukozi wo mu murima, aramusubiza ati, "Mutware, niiba ari wowe wamujaanye ahandi, mbwira aho wamushize, maze mukuureyo, mujaane."
Yesu aramuhamagara ati, "Mariya!" Arahinduka maze avuga mu ruheburaayo ati, "Rabuni!" (Kimenyeesha Mwigiisha).

Yesu aramubwira ati, "Utankoraho kuko ntaabwo nari naazaamuuka ngo nje kwa Daata, ahuubwo genda usange beene Daata maze ubabwiire uti, ‘Nzaamuutse nja kwa Daata ari we So, ku Maana yanje ari yo Maana yaanyu.’ "
Nuuko Mariya Magadaleena aragenda abwira abiigiishwa ati, "Naboonye Nyagasani." Maze abateekerereza ibyo yamubwiye.

Kuri uwo munsi nimugorooba, ari wo munsi ubanziriza icumweru, abiigiishwa baari bateeranye. Baari bikingiranyije mu nzu ku bwo gutiinya Abayuuda. Yesu araaza abahagarara hagati arababwira ati, "Nimugire amahoro"
Amaze kuvuga atyo, abeereka ibiganza bye n’urubavu rwe. Nuuko abiigiishwa baboonye Nyagasani baraneezeerwa.
Yesu yongera kubabwira ati, "Nimugire amahoro. Uko Daata yantumye, nanje ndabatumye."
Amaze kuvuga atyo, abahumeekeraho maze arababwira ati, "Ni mwakiire Umwuka Weera.
Abo muzaababarira ibyaha boose, bazaaba babibabariwe, abo mutazaabibabarira boose, bazaaba batabibabariwe."
Ariko Tomasi umwe muri ba cumi na babiri witwaga Mahasa , ntiyari kumwe na bo ubwo Yesu yaaje.

Abandi biigiishwa baramubwira bati, "Twaboonye Nyagasani." Ariko we arabasubiza ati, "Nintabona umwenge w’imisumaari mu biganza bye, kandi sinshiremo urutoki rwanje, ngo nshire n’ikiganza canje mu rubavu rwe, sinzeemera."

Hashize iminsi munaane, abiigiishwa na bwo baari bateeraniye mu nzu, nooneho Tomasi yari kumwe na bo. Nuubwo inzuugi zaari zikinze, Yesu araaza ahagarara hagati yaabo arababwira ati, "Nimugire amahoro."
Haanyuma abwira Tomasi ati, "Shira urutoki rwawe hano maze ureebe ibiganza byanje. Zana ikiganza caawe maze ugishire mu rubavu rwanje. Reka gushidiikanya ahuubwo emera."
Tomasi aramusubiza ati, "Nyagasani kandi Maana yanje!"
Yesu aramubwira ati, "Wemejwe n’uko umboonye? Hahiirwa abiizeera bataboonye."
Yesu yakoreye imbere y’abiigiishwa be ibindi bitangaaza byinshi, bitanditswe muri iki gitabo.
Ariko ibi byanditswe kugira ngo mwemere ko Yesu ari Kristo, Umwana w’Imaana, kandi ngo nimumwemera mugire ubugingo buhoraho.
Nyuma y’ibyo, Yesu yongera kubonekera abiigiishwa be ku nyanja ya Tibeeriya, maze ababonekera atya.
Simooni Peetero, na Tomasi witwaga Mahasa, na Natanayeli w’i Kaana y’i Galileeya, beene Zebedaayo, n’abandi biigiishwa babiri baari bari kumwe.
Simooni Peetero arababwira ati, "Ngiiye kuroba." Baramusubiza bati, "Turajaana." Barasohoka maze baja mu bwato, ariko muri iryo joro ntihaagira ico bafata.
Bukimara guca, Yesu ahagarara ku nkengeero, ariko abiigiishwa ntibamenya ko ari we.
Yesu arababaza ati, "Nshuti zanje, hari isamaaki mwafashe?" Baramusubiza bati, "Ntaazo."
Arababwira ati, "Nimujugunye agatimba kanyu iburyo bw’ubwato, muragira ico mubona." Nuuko barakajugunya, ariko bananirwa kugakururira mu bwato kuko isamaaki zaari nyinshi.
Wa mwigiishwa Yesu yakundaga abwira Peetero ati, "Ni Nyagasani." Simooni Peetero yumviise ko ari Nyagasani, akenyera umwenda kuko yari yambaye ubusa, maze yiiroha mu nyanja.
Abandi biigiishwa baaza ku nkengeero mu bwato, bakurura agatimba kuuzuye isamaaki. Ntaabwo baari kure y’inkengero, ahuubwo haari nka mita ijana.
Bageze imusozi, babona umuriro w’amakara, uriho isamaaki, hamwe n’umugaati.
Yesu arababwira ati, "Nimuuzane kuri izo samaaki mumaze gufata."
Simooni Peetero yinjira mu bwato maze akururira agatimba kuuzuye isamaaki nini imusozi. Zoose zaari ijana na mirongo itaanu n’itatu kandi n’ubwo zaari nyinshi, agatimba ntaabwo kaaciitse.
Yesu arababwira ati, "Nimuuze dufungure ibya mugitondo." Ntihaagira n’umwe muri abo biigiishwa utiinyuka kumubaza ati, "Uri nde?" Kuko baari baamenye ko ari Nyagasani.
Yesu yiigira imbere afata umugaati maze arawubaha, n’isamaaki azigenza atyo.
Ubwo bwari ubwa gatatu Yesu abonekera abiigiishwa be, amaze kuzuuka mu baapfuuye.

Barangije kurya amafunguro ya mugitondo, Yesu abwira Simooni Peetero ati, "Simooni mwene Yohaana, urankunda kurusha aba ngaaba?" Aramusubiza ati, "Yeego Nyagasani, uzi ko ngukunda." Yesu aramubwira ati, "Ragira abaana b’intaama zanje."
Yesu yongera kumubaza ubwa kabiri ati, "Simooni mwene Yohaana, urankunda?" Peetero aramusubiza ati, "Yeego Nyagasani, uzi ko ngukunda." Yesu aramubwira ati, "Ragira intaama zanje."

Yongera kumubaza ubwa gatatu ati, "Simooni mwene Yohaana, urankunda?" Peetero ababazwa n’uko Yesu amubajije ubwa gatatu ati, "Urankunda?" Nuuko aramusubiza ati, "Nyagasani, umenya byose, uzi ko ngukunda." Nuuko Yesu aramubwira ati, "Ragira intaama zanje.
Ndakubwira ukuri yuuko, ubwo wari ukiri muto, wariikenyezaga kandi ukaja aho ushaaka. Ariko nuumara gusaaza, uzaateega amaboko undi agukenyeze, kandi akujaane aho udashaaka."
(Yesu yavuze ibyo, ashaaka kwerekana urupfu Peetero azaapfa, bikuubahiisha Imaana.) Amaze kuvuga atyo, aramubwira ati, "Nkurikira."
Peetero areebye inyuma, abona wa mwigiishwa Yesu yakundaga abakurikiye, kandi ni wa wundi wegamiye Yesu bafungura akamubaza ati, "Nyagasani, ni nde ugiiye kukugambaanira?"
Peetero amaze kumubona, abaza Yesu ati, "Nyagasani, uyu we kandi ibye bigende bite?"
Yesu aramusubiza ati, "Niiba ari ubushaake bwanje ngo akomeze kubaho kugeza igihe nzaagarukira, bigutwaye iki? Wowe nkurikira!"

Kuva ubwo inkuru yaamamara mu muryango w’abeemera ko uwo mwigiishwa atazaapfa. Nyamara Yesu ntaabwo yabwiye Peetero yuuko uwo mwigiishwa atazaapfa, ahuubwo yaramubwiye ati, "Niiba ari ubushaake bwanje ko agumaho kugeza aho nzaazira, bigutwaye iki?"
Uyu ni we wa mwigiishwa wemeza ibyo byose kandi ni we wabyanditse, kandi tuuzi yuuko ubuhamya bwe ari ukuri.
Hari n’ibindi byinshi Yesu yakoze, nyamara byose byanditswe, ngira ngo ibitabo byakwandikwamo ntibyakwirwa mu isi.

name: Atos
chapters: Kuri Tewofilo, mu gitabo ca mbere nanditse ibintu byose Yesu yakoze kandi yiigiishije kuva agitangira umurimo we
kugeza ku munsi yazaamuukiye mu ijuru, amaze gutegeka intumwa ze yitooranyirije ayobowe n’Umwuka Weera.
Haanyuma yo kubabazwa, abonekera intumwa ze ari muzima atanga ibimenyeetso byinshi aguma kubabonekera mu minsi mirongo ine ababwira iby’Ubwami bw’Imaana.
Ubwo yari kumwe na bo abategeka kutava i Yerusaalemu, ahuubwo ko bategereza ibyo Imaana Daata yaseezeranye. Arababwira ati, "Ibi n’ibyo mwumviise mvuga,
kuko Yohaana yabatiriishije amaazi, naho mwebwe mu gihe gito muzaabatiriishwa Umwuka Weera."
Nuuko intumwa zimaze guteeranira hamwe zibaza Yesu ziti, "Nyagasani, iki ni co gihe ugiiye kugaruriramo ubwami mu Biisirayeli?"
Yesu arabasubiza ati, "Iby’ibihe n’iminsi si mwe mukwiriye kubimenya, Daata wenyine ni we ubifiteho ububaasha.
Icakora muzahaabwa imbaraga Umwuka Weera naabaazamo kandi muzambeera abahamya i Yerusaalemu, muri Yudeeya n’i Samariya, no mu mpera z’isi."
Arangije kuvuga ibyo, azaamuurwa mu ijuru bamureeba, maze igicu kiramubakingiriza ntibongera kumubona.
Ubwo yazaamuukaga, intumwa zigihanze amaaso heejuru, haboneka abagabo babiri bambaye imyenda yeera, bahagarara iruhande rwazo.
Babwira intumwa bati, "Yemwe bantu b’i Galileeya, ni iki gitumye muhagaze hano mureeba mu ijuri? Uyu Yesu ubakuuwemo akazaamuurwa mu ijuru, azaagaruka nk’uko mumuboonye aja mu ijuru."
Nuuko intumwa zisubira i Yerusaalemu zivuuye ku musozi wa Elayoni uri haafi ya Yerusaalemu hakaba urugendo rungana na kilomita imwe.

Bageze mu Tawuni nkuru, baja mu gisenge co heejuru aho baari bacumbitse. Abaariho ni aba; Peetero, Yohaana, Yaakobo, Andereya, Filipo, Tomasi, Batulumaayo, Matayo, Yaakobo mwene Alufaayo, Simooni umurwanashaka, na Yuda mwene Yaakobo.
Izo ntumwa n’abagore baarimo Mariya nyina wa Yesu na beene nyina ba Yesu, abo boose bakomeza gusengera hamwe bahuuje umutima.
Muri iyo minsi haabayeho inaama y’abiizeera, boose hamwe baari nk’ijana na makumyabiri, nuuko Peetero arahaguruka abwira abaari muri iyo naama ati,
"Bavandimwe, ibyanditswe byagombaga gusohora nk’uko Umwuka Weera yahishuuriye Dawudi ibyerekeye Yuda wayoboye abaafashe Yesu.
Kuko Yuda yari umwe muri twe, kandi agahaabwa umugabane w’uyu murimo waacu."
[Kandi uyu mugabo amaze kugura umurima ukomootse ku bihembo by’ubugambanyi bwe, yitimbura haasi, inda ye iraturika, maze amara yoose arasohoka.
Ibi byamenyeekanye mu bantu boose batuuye i Yerusaalemu, ni co caatumye uwo murima bawita Hakerudama mu rurimi rwabo, bisobaanura Umurima w’amaraso.]
"Kuko byanditswe mu gitabo ca Zaaburi ngo, ‘Urugo rwe rurakaba amatongo, ntihazaagire urutuuramo ukundi.’ Kandi ngo, ‘Reka umurimo we w’ubuheereza uhaabwe undi.’
Nuuko reero umwe mu bo twagendanaga buri gihe, ubwo Umwami Yesu yari akiri naatwe,
kuva mu gihe Yohaana yabatizaga, ukageza umunsi Yesu yazaamuuwe aja mu ijuru. Umwe muri bo agomba gutoorwa, akatwiyungaho, akabaana naatwe mu guhamya kuzuuka kwa Yesu."
Nuuko baazana amazina abiri, Yozefu wiitwaga Barisaba wo benshi baari baazi nka Yusito, hamwe na Matiyasi.
Maze basenga bavuga bati, "Nyagasani, wowe umenya imitima y’abantu boose, twereke uwo utooranyije muri aba bombi
kugira ngo abe intumwa mu cimbo ca Yuda kandi afate umurimo w’ubuheereza Yuda yataaye akaja ahamukwiriye."
Nuuko bakora ubufindo bwo gutooranya umwe muri bo, bufata Matiyasi yongerwa ku ntumwa cumi n’imwe.
Umunsi wa Pentekooti ugeze, abiizeera boose baari mu mwanya umwe.
Ako kaanya, umuriri ubatungura uvuuye mu ijuru umeze nk’umuyaga mwinshi maze wuuzura inzu baari biicayemo.
Nuuko haboneka indimi ziigabanyije zisa n’iz’umuriro, zija ku mutwe wa buri weese.
Abiizeera boose buuzura Umwuka Weera batangira kuvuga izindi ndimi, nk’uko Umwuka Weera yabahaaye ubushobozi.
I Yerusaalemu haabaga Abayuuda buubaha Imaana baari baturutse mu mahanga yoose y’isi.
Abantu benshi bamaze kumva urwo rusaku bateranira hamwe batangazwa n’uko bumvaga buri umwe avuga mu rurimi rw’iwaabo.
Baratangaara kandi baruumirwa maze barabaza bati, "Mbese aba bantu boose bavuga si Abanyagalileeya?
Bishoboka bite ko twumva bavuga indimi za kavukire z’iwaacu ?
Twe turi Abapariti, Abameedi, Abeelamu, n’abatuuye i Mesopotamiya, i Yudeeya, na Kapadokiya, Ponti no muri Asiya,
Fulujiya, Pamfiliya, Igiputi no mu bice bya Libiya byegeranye n’i Kureni, abashitsi baturutse i Rooma, Abayuuda ba kavuukire n’abatari Abayuuda ariko bayobotse idiini yaabo,
kandi n’Abakireete n’Abaharabu, turabumva bavuga mu ndimi z’iwaacu ibitangaaza Imaana ikora."
Abo bantu boose baratangaara, baruumirwa, maze barabaazanya bati, "Mbese ibi bimenyeesha iki?"
Abandi barabaseka bavuga bati, "Baasinze inzoga y’ihiira."

Ariko Peetero ahagarara n’izindi ntumwa cumi n’imwe, abwira abantu benshi n’ijwi rirenga ati, "Beene waacu b’i Yudeeya namwe mwese abatuuye i Yerusaalemu, reka ibi byose bimenyekane kandi mwumve ibyo mvuga.
Aba bantu ntaabwo baasinze, nk’uko muteekereza. Dore ubu ni saaha itatu z’igitondo.
Ahuubwo ibi mureeba byavuzwe n’umuhanuuzi Yoweri ati,
‘Imaana iravuga iti, Mu minsi y’imperuuka, Nzasuka Umwuka wanje ku bantu boose, kandi abahungu n’abakoobwa baanyu bazaahanuura, kandi n’abasore baanyu bazeerekwa, n’abasaaza baanyu bazaroota inzozi.
Muri iyo minsi abagaragu n’abaja banje, nzaabasukaho Umwuka wanje maze bahanuure.
Nzakora ibitangaaza mu ijuru heejuru n’ibimenyeetso haasi ku isi. Hazaagaragara amaraso, umuriro, n’igiho gicumba umwotsi.
Izuuba rizaahinduka umwijima, n’ukwezi guhinduke umutuku nk’amaraso mbere yuuko umunsi mukuru w’Uhoraho ugera.
Kandi umuntu weese uzambaza izina ry’Uhoraho azaakizwa.’ "

Peetero akomezamo ati, "Yemwe Biisirayeli nimutege amatwi mwumve ibyo ngiye kubabwira. Yesu w’i Nazaareeti wa muntu Imaana yemeje muri mwe n’ibikorwa by’imbaraga, ibitangaaza n’ibimenyeetso by’Imaana yabakoreye muri we, nk’uko namwe mu biizi.
Uyu muntu yarabagabijwe nk’uko Imaana yari yarabiteguuye ikabimenya bitari byaba, mwaramubambye mumwicisha amaboko y’abagome.
Ariko Imaana yamuzuuye mu bapfu, imubohoora ingoyi z’urupfu, kuko bitashobotse ko aheranwa n’imbaraga za rwo.
Kuko Dawudi yavuze ibimufasheho ati, ‘Naboonye Nyagasani ari imbere yanje buri gihe, kuko ari iburyo bwanje sinzanyeganyezwa.
Ni co gituma umutima wanje wiishimye, nkagira umuneezeero mu kuvuga kwanje, kandi umubiri wanje uzaaruhuuka ufite ibyiringiro.
Kuko utazaateererana ubugingo bwanje ikuzimu mu bapfu, cangwa ngo wemere ko Intungaane yaawe iborera mu gituuro.
Wamenyeesheje inzira zigana mu bugingo, Kubaana na we bituma nuuzura umunezeero.’ "
Peetero akomezamo ati, "Bavandimwe, ntakimbuza kubabwira neeruye ko sogokuruza Dawudi yapfuuye kandi agahambwa, igituuro ce kikaba kikiri iwaacu kugeza ubu.
Kuko yari umuhanuuzi, yari azi neeza ko Imaana yamurahiye indahiro yuuko Iziicaza umwe mu bamukomookaho ku ntebe y’ubwami.
Yeeretswe mbere y’igihe uko bizaamera nuuko avuga uko Kristo azaazuuka agira ati, ‘Ntaabwo yateereranywe ikuzimu, cangwa ngo umubiri we ubore.’
Uwo Yesu Imaana yazuuye, naatwe twese turi abahamya b’ibyo.
Yesu amaze gushirwa heejuru yiicazwa iburyo bw’ukuboko kw’Imaana, no guhaabwa na Se iseezerano ry’Umwuka Weera, ni wo asutse mureeba kandi mwumva.
N’ubwo Dawudi ataazaamuutse mu ijuru nyamara yaravuze ati, ‘Uhoraho yabwiye Umwami Yesu ati. Icara iburyo bwanje,
kugeza aho nzaahindurira abanzi baawe akabaaho ukandagizaho ibirenge byawe.’ "
"Nuuko reero, abo mu muryango wa Isirayeli boose niibamenye badashidikanya ko uwo Yesu mwabambye, Imaana yamugize Umutegetsi na Kristo."
Abantu bumviise ayo magambo ya Peetero bagira ubwoba bamubaza n’izindi ntumwa bati, "Bavandimwe, noone dukore iki?"
Peetero arabasubiza ati, "Buri muntu weese yiihane kandi abatizwe, mu izina rya Yesu Kristo kugira ngo mubabarirwe ibyaha byanyu kandi muhaabwe impaano y’Umwuka Weera.
Kuko iseezerano ari iryanyu n’abaana baanyu, n’abarikure boose n’abandi benshi nk’uko Nyagasani Imaana yaacu iziihamagarira."
Peetero akomeza kwigiisha abiihanangiriza kandi ababwira n’andi magambo menshi abahuguura ati, "Mukizwe kugira ngo muhunge igihano kiiziye inkozi z’ibibi zo muri iki gihe."
Nuuko abeemeye ubwo butumwa barabatizwa, uwo munsi abantu nk’ibihumbi bitatu biyongeye ku mubare w’abiizeera.
Baahoraga bashiishikarira inyigiisho z’intumwa no guteeranira hamwe, gusangira amafunguro hamwe no gusenga.
Abantu boose bagira ubwoba ku bw’ibitangaaza n’ibimenyeetso byinshi byo intumwa zaakoraga.
Abiizeera boose baabaga hamwe, n’ibyo bafite byose bakabigira rusange.
Baaguriishaga ibintu n’imitungo yaabo, bakagabana ibiguzi bavanye mo bakurikije ico buri umwe akeneye.
Iminsi yoose baajaga guteeranira hamwe mu Nzu y’Imaana, bagasangira amafunguro mu mago yaabo baneezerewe kandi bafite ubupfura mu mitima yaabo,
bahimbaaza Imaana kandi bagashimwa n’abantu boose. Buri munsi Nyagasani Imaana yabongeereraga ku mubare w’abakizwa.
Umunsi umwe Peetero na Yohaana barazaamuuka baja mu Nzu y’Imaana mu gihe co gusenga ku saaha cenda z’amanywa.
Haari umuntu wavuutse aremaye, baamuheekaga buri munsi bakamushira ku irembo ry’Inzu y’Imaana ryitwa Irembo Ryiza kugira ngo asabirize imfashanyo abari kwinjira mu Nzu y’Imaana.
Uwo murema aboonye Peetero na Yohaana bagiiye kwinjira mu Nzu y’Imaana, abasaba imfashanyo.
Peetero na Yohaana bamureeba amaaso ku maaso baramubwira bati, "Tureebe."
Uwo muntu uremaye abahanga amaaso, ategereje ko baagira ico baamuha.
Nuuko Peetero aramubwira ati, "Nta mashilingi mfite, ariko ico mfite reka nkiguhe, ku bw’ubushobozi nahaawe na Yesu Kristo w’i Nazaareeti, haguruka ugende."
Nuuko amufata ukuboko kw’iburyo aramuhagurutsa. Ako kaanya ibirenge by’uwo mugabo n’ubugombampuri bwe birakomera.
Maze uwo muntu arahaguruka, arasimbuka, aratambuka yinjirana na bo mu Nzu y’Imaana, agenda asimbagurika, ahimbaaza Imaana.
Abantu boose baamubona atambuka ahimbaaza Imaana,
baramumenya ko ari we wasabirizaga yiicaye ku irembo ry’Inzu y’Imaana ryitwa Irembo Ryiza. Boose birabatangaaza, buuzura umuneezeero ku bw’ibimubaayeho.
Uwo mugabo wari umaze gukira yanga kurekura Peetero na Yohaana, abantu boose biirukankira aho bari, bateeranira ku ibaraza ryitwa irya Solomooni batangaaye caane.

Peetero abiboonye atangira kubiigiisha avuga ati, "Beene waacu ba Biisirayeli kuki mutangaazwa n’ibi, cangwa se n’iki gitumye mudutumbiira, nk’aho ibi bibaaye ku bw’imbaraga zaacu, cangwa kuubaha Imaana kwacu byatumye uyu muntu ashobora gutambuuka?

Imaana ya Aburahamu, Imaana ya Isaaka, Imaana ya Yaakobo, Imaana ya basogokuruza yahaaye umugaragu waayo Yesu icuubahiro wo mwatanze muka mwihakanira, imbere ya Pilaato kandi we yari yiyemeje kumurekura.
Mwihakanye Uweera kandi ari Intungaane maze musaba ko babarekurira umwicanyi.
Mwishe Umutangabugingo, ariko Imaana imuzuura mu baapfuuye. Turi abahamya baabyo.
Ku bwo kwizeera izina rya Yesu, iryo zina ubwaryo ryatumye uyu muntu wari umurema mureeba kandi muuzi agira imbaraga, kandi ku bwo kwizeera Yesu bitumye akira nk’uko bigaragaye imbere yaanyu mwese.
Nuuko reero bavandimwe nzi yuuko mwe n’abayobozi baanyu mwari mutaazi ico mwakoraga.
Nyamara Imaana yuujuje ibyavuzwe n’abahanuuzi keera, yuuko Mesiya azaababazwa.
Nuuko reero mwihane kandi mugarukire Imaana kugira ngo ibyaha byanyu bihanagurwe,
bityo reero hazaabaho ibihe by’ububyuke mu mitima yaanyu mubihaawe na Nyagasani. Kandi igihe kimwe azaabooherereza Mesiya ari we Yesu.
Uwo akwiriye kuguma mu ijuru kugeza igihe Imaana izaagarura busha ibintu byose, ibyo Yavuze Inyuze mu bahanuuzi baayo beera bo mu bihe bya keera.
Kuko Moose yavuze ati, ‘Nyagasani Imaana yaanyu izaabatumamo umuhanuuzi uturutse muri beene waanyu umeze nkanje. Muzamwumvire mu byo azaababwira gukora byose.
Kandi umuntu weese utazumvira uwo muhanuuzi azaarimburwa, aciibwe mu muryango w’Imaana.’
Kandi n’abahanuuzi boose uheereye kuri Samweli ukageza kubaamukurikiye, na bo baahanuuye ibiri kubaho muri iyi minsi.
Namwe mukomooka ku bahanuuzi kandi muri abaragwa b’ibyo Imaana yaseezeranyije ba seekuruza baanyu, ibwira Aburahamu iti, ‘Mu rubyaro rwawe ni mwo imiryango yoose yo mu isi izaaheerwa umugisha.’
Igihe Imaana yoohereje Umugaragu waayo ni mwe yamwoherejeho bwa mbere kugira ngo abahe umugisha abahindure muve mu byaha byanyu."
Peetero na Yohaana bakivugana n’abantu, abaheerezabitambo, n’umutegeka w’abarinzi b’Inzu y’Imaana, n’Abasadukaayo baaza aho bari.
Abo bantu baari buuzuye uburakari bababajwe n’uko Peetero na Yohaana biigiishaga abantu ko Yesu yazuutse bihamya ko abaapfuuye na bo bazaazuuka.
Nuuko barabafata babashira mu gihome, ariko kuko bwari bugoroobye baraaramo kugeza mu gitondo.
Ariko abantu benshi mu bumviise ijambo ry’Imaana bariizeera. Umubare w’abiizeera uragwira ugera nko ku bantu ibihumbi bitaanu.
Bukeeye bwaho, abategeetsi b’Abayuuda, bakuru b’imiryango n’Abiigiishamategeko bateeranira i Yerusaalemu.
Haariho Anaasi Umuheerezabitambo mukuru, Kayafa, Yohaana n’Alekizanda, n’abo mu muryango w’Umuheerezabitambo mukuru boose.
Bamaze guhagarika Peetero na Yohaana hagati yaabo barababaza bati, "Mwakoresheje mbaraga ki, cangwa iriihe zina ubwo mwakiizaga uyu mugabo?"
Maze Peetero yuuzuye Umwuka Weera arabasubiza ati, "Bategetsi b’Abayuuda namwe bakuru b’imiryango,
niiba uyu munsi turikubazwa ibyiza twagiriye umurema n’uburyo yakize,

reka mwese mubimenye, n’ab’umuryango w’Isirayeli ko uyu mugabo uhagaze imbere yaanyu ari mutaraga, ku bw’imbaraga ziri mu izina rya Yesu Kristo w’i Nazaareeti uwo mwabambye, Imaana ikamuzuura mu bapfuuye.
Uyu Yesu ni we ‘buye ryanzwe namwe abuubatsi ni ryo ryahindutse iry’urufatiro.’
Nta wundi twaboneramo agakiza ukuyeho we, kuko nta rindi zina ryahaawe abantu muusi y’ijuru dukwiriye gukirizwamo."

Abagize urukiiko baboonye ukuntu Peetero na Yohaana bavuga bashize amanga, kandi biibuka ko ari abantu batiize, ahuubwo ko ari abatuurage basanzwe, barumirwa. Bageze aho biibuka ko baabaanaga na Yesu.
Kandi baboonye uwo muntu wari umurema wakize ahagararanye na bo, babura ico babasubiza babahakanya.
Nuuko abagize urukiiko bategeka Peetero na Yohaana kuva mu rukiiko kugira ngo basigare baja inaama bonyine.
Batangira kubazanya bati, "Aba bantu tubagenze dute? Baakoze igitangaaza kandi caamenyekanye hoose mu batuuye i Yerusaalemu kandi naatwe nti twabihakana.
Ariko kugira ngo bidakomeza kwamamara, tubiiyame, batazongera kuvugana n’umuntu weese baakoresheje iryo zina."
Nuuko barabahamagara, babategeka kutazongera kuvuga cangwa kwigiisha mu izina rya Yesu.
Ariko Peetero na Yohaana barabasubiza bati, "Namwe ubwanyu ni muhitemo icaaba ciiza imbere y’Imaana, kubumvira cangwa kumvira Imaana.
Kuko tutaashobora guceceka ngo twekuvuga ibyo twiboneye kandi tukabyiyumvira."
Bamaze kongera kubatiinyatinyiisha barabarekura, basanze ko nta buryo baabahana kuko abantu boose bahimbaarizaga Imaana ibyabaaye.
Uwo mugabo wakorewe igitangaaza co gukira yari afite imyaka irenze mirongo ine avuutse.
Bamaze kubarekura basanga abiizeera bagenzi baabo, babateekerereza ibyo abatware b’abaheerezabitambo, n’abakuru b’imiryango baababwiye.
Abiizeera babyumvise, bavugira hamwe mu ijwi rirenga bahuuje umutima, basenga Imaana bati, "Nyagasani Maana, ni wowe waremye ijuru n’isi, inyanja n’ibiyirimo byose,
ni wowe kandi ku bw’Umwuka Weera wavugiye mu kanwa ka sogokuruza Dawudi, umugaragu waawe uti, ‘Ni iki gitumye abanyamahanga bagira uburaakari bwinshi, n’abantu bakagira imigambi itagira umumaro?
Abaami bo mu isi bariiteguura n’abatware barakorana, kugira ngo barwanye Imaana na Kristo we.’
Kuko, Herodi na Pontiyo Pilaato, n’Abanyamahanga, n’imiryango yoose ya Isirayeli bateeraniye mur’iyi tawuni nkuru, kugira ngo barwanye Yesu umugaragu waawe Weera, wo wasiize amavuta,
kugira ngo basohoze ibyo ukuboko kwawe n’ubwenge bwawe byategetse mbere byose bitari byaba.
Noone ubu Nyagasani, reeba uko badutinyatinyisha, maze uduhereze twe abagaragu bawe, tuvuge ijambo ryawe dushize amanga.
Garagaza imbaraga zaawe maze abantu bakire indwara, reka ibitangaaza n’ibimenyeetso bikorwe mu izina rya Yesu umugaragu waawe Weera."
Nuuko barangije gusenga, umwanya baari bateeraniyemo uhinda umushitsi, boose buuzura Umwuka Weera, maze abashoboza kuvuga ijambo ry’Imaana bashize amanga.
Agatsiko koose k’abiizeera bahuuzaga umutima n’inaama. Nta n’umwe wagiraga ikintu ce bwiite kuko baasangiraga ibyo bafite byose.
Intumwa zaagiraga imbaraga nyinshi zo guhamya kuzuuka k’Umwami Yesu, kandi ubuntu bw’Imaana bwakomezaga kuba kuri bo.
Nta mukene wababagamo, kuko abaari bafite imirima cangwa amazu boose baarabigurishaga ibiguzi bivuuyemo bakabiizana.
Baabishikirizaga intumwa, na zo zikabigabanya abantu, buri muntu weese agahaabwa ico akeneye.
Haari umugabo w’Umuleevi wiitwaga Yozefu, umuvukano w’i Kupuro uwo intumwa ziise Barinaba rimenyeesha Ukomeza abandi.
Yaguriishije umurima we maze ibiguzi bivuuyemo abiizanira intumwa.
Ariko umugabo wiitwaga Ananiya, amaze kumviikana n’umugore we Safira, aguriisha umurima.
Yemeranyije n’umugore we, asigarana bimwe ku kiguzi yahaawe, ikindi gice akijaanira intumwa.
Peetero aramubaza ati, "Ananiya, ni iki gitumye Sataani agushuka ukabeesha Umwuka Weera, ugasigaza igice c’ikiguzi waguriishije umurima?

Utari wawuguriisha nti wari uwaawe? Umaze no kuwuguriisha, ibyavuuyemo ntaabwo wari ubifiteho ububaasha? Ni iki caatumye wiigiira inaama yo gukora utyo? Ntaabwo ubeeshe abantu, ahuubwo ubeeshe Imaana!"
Ananiya akimara kumva ayo magambo yiituura haasi arapfa. Abaabyumviise boose bagira ubwoba bwinshi.
Nuuko abasore baraaza, bazinga umubiri we mu mwenda maze baja kumuhamba.
Hashize nk’amasaaha atatu umugore we yinjira, ataazi ibyabaayeho.
Peetero aramubaza ati, "Mbwira niiba wowe n’umugabo waawe ikiguzi mwaguriishije umurima ari co mwazanye." Aramusubiza ati, "Yeego, ni co."
Nuuko Peetero aramubwira ati, "Ni kuki mwemeranyije kugerageza Umwuka wa Nyagasani? Dore, abavuuye guhamba umugabo waawe bageze ku muryango, naawe barakujaana."
Ako kaanya agwa imbere ye arapfa. Abasore basohoye basanga amaze gupfa, nuuko bamujaana hanze bamuhamba iruhande rw’umugabo we.
Nuuko itoorero ryose hamwe n’abaabyumviise boose bibateera ubwoba.
Ibimenyeetso n’ibitangaza byinshi byakorwaga n’intumwa mu bantu. Boose baateraniraga ku baraza rya Solomooni.
Ariko n’ubwo abantu benshi babahimbazaga caane, nta n’umwe mu batizeera watiinyuukaga kwifatanya na bo.
Nyamara, abantu benshi caane abagabo n’abagore baguma kwiyongera ku basanzwe biizeera Nyagasani.
Kubeera ko intumwa zaakoraga ibitangaaza byinshi, abantu baazanaga abarwayi mu nzira, bakabaryamiisha ku bitanda no ku birago kugira ngo Peetero naanyuraho niibura igicuucu ce kigere kuri bamwe.
Abantu nyamwinshi baakungaanaga bavuuye mu ma tawuni yizengurutse i Yerusaalemu, baazanye abarwayi n’abateewe n’abadayimooni, kandi boose bagakira.
Nuuko Umuheerezabitambo mukuru naabo yari kumwe na bo boose ari bo igice c’Abasadukaayo, buuzura ishari,
maze bafata intumwa bazishira mu gihome rusange.
Ariko nijoro malayika wa Nyagasani akiingura inzuugi z’igihome, abakuuramo arababwira ati,
"Ni mugende, muhagarare mu Nzu y’Imaana mubwire abantu ubutumwa bw’ubu bugingo busha".

Intumwa zimaze kubyumva, zinjira mu Nzu y’Imaana mu gitondo kare kare zikomeza kwigiisha. Umuheerezabitambo mukuru naabo yari kumwe na bo bahageze, bakungaanya urukiiko, hamwe n’abakuru b’imiryango ya Isirayeli, ni ko gutuma ngo bavaane intumwa mu gihome bazibaazanire.
Ariko abarinzi b’Inzu y’Imaana bagiiyeyo, ntibaabasanga mu gihome nuuko baragaruka babwira abaabatumye bati,
"Twasanze igihome gikinzwe neeza ndetse n’abarinzi bahagaze ku miryango, ariko dukinguuye ntitwagira uwo dusangamo."
Umutegeka w’abarinzi b’Inzu y’Imaana n’umutware w’abaheerezabitambo bumviise ayo magambo, baruumirwa, biibaza icaabaayeho.
Nuuko haaza umuntu arababwira ati, "Dore, ba bagabo mwashize mu gihome bahagaze mu Nzu y’Imaana bari kwigiisha abantu!"
Umutegeka w’abarinzi ajaana n’umurinzi w’Inzu y’Imaana baazana intumwa, ariko ku neeza, kuko baatiinyaga abantu ngo baabateera amabuye.
Bamaze kubaazana babahagarika imbere y’urukiiko. Umuheerezabitambo mukuru arababaza ati,
"Twabategetse kutiigiisha muri iri zina rya Yesu, noone mukwije i Yerusaalemu inyigiisho zaanyu mumaramaje ko tubarwaho amaraso y’uyu muntu."
Peetero n’izindi ntumwa barasubiza bati, "Tugomba kumvira Imaana kuruta kumvira abantu.
Imaana ya baasogokuruza yazuuye Yesu, uwo mwari mwariishe mumubambye ku giti.
Imaana yaramuzaamuuye imushira iburyo bwayo ngo abe Umuyobozi n’Umukiza kugira ngo aheeshe Abiisirayeli kwihana no kubabarirwa ibyaha.
Turi abahamya b’ibyo, hamwe n’Umwuka Weera uwo Imaana yahaaye abamwumvira."
Babyumvise, bagira umujinya mwinshi bashaaka kubiica.
Ariko mu rukiiko, umufarisaayo wiitwaga Gamaliyeli, umwiigiishamategeko, wubahwaga n’abantu boose, arahaguruka ategeka ko abo bagabo booherezwa hanze kumara akaanya gato.
Nuuko arababwira ati, "Beene waacu b’Abiisirayeli, mwitonde mumenye ibyo mugiiye gukorera bariiya bantu.
Mu minsi yashize Tewudaasi yarahagurutse, yiiyita umuntu ukomeye, abantu bangana nka magana ane baramuyoboka. Ariko yariishwe kandi abaamuyobotse boose barataataana barabura.
Nyuma ye, mu minsi y’ibaruura, haaduka Umunyagalileeya wiitwaga Yuda maze abantu benshi baramukurikira, ariko na we yariishwe, abayoboke be barataataana.
Noone, muri ibi biriho, inaama naabagiira ni uko mutagira ico mukora aba bagabo, mubiihorere. Niiba imigambi yaabo cangwa ibikorwa byabo bikomooka ku bantu ntaabwo bizaashoboka.
Ariko niiba bikomooka ku Maana, ntaabwo muzashobora kubatsinda. Mushobora kwisanga muri kurwanya Imaana!" Abagize Urukiiko beemera ibyo ababwiye.
Bahamagara intumwa barazikubita, bazitegeka kutongera kwigiisha mu izina rya Yesu maze barazireka ziragenda.
Intumwa ziva mu rukiiko zineejeejwe n’uko zaagize amahiirwe yo kugirirwa naabi zihoorwa izina rya Yesu.
Kandi ntizaasiiba kwigiisha no kuvuga ubutumwa ko Yesu ari Kristo iminsi yoose mu Nzu y’Imaana no mu mago.

Muri ico gihe ubwo umubare w’abiigiishwa wakomeje kwiyongera, Abayuuda bavuga Urugiriki batangira kwitootombera Abaheburaayo kuko batiitaga ku bapfakazi baabo mu gihe baagabaga ibyo kwifashisha bya buri munsi.
Nuuko ba cumi na babiri bakungaanya umutwe w’abiigiishwa barababwira bati, "Ntibikwiriye ko tureka kwigiisha ijambo ry’Imaana ngo duhugire mu gukemura ibibazo byo kugaba ibintu.
Noone reero bavandimwe, nimwishaakemo abagabo barindwi b’inyangamugayo, buzuuye Umwuka Weera kandi b’abanyabwenge, tubashinge uwo murimo.
Naho twebwe dukomeze kwibanda ku gusenga no kuvuga ijambo ry’Imaana."

Ico giteekerezo kineezeeza abantu boose, nuuko batooranya Sitefaano, umugabo wuuzuye Umwuka Weera no kwizeera, kandi hamwe na Filipo, Purokooro, Nikanoora, Parumena, Timoona, na Nikolayoni umunyamahanga wo muri Antiyokiya wagiiye mu diini y’Abayuuda.
Bahagarika abo bagabo imbere y’intumwa, maze zibarambikaho ibiganza zirabasengera.
Nuuko ijambo ry’Imaana rikomeza kwamamara. Umubare w’abiigiishwa ukomeza kwiyongera caane i Yerusaalemu, kandi n’abaheerezabitambo benshi bayoboka uko kwizeera.
Sitefaano, umugabo wuuzuye ubuntu n’imbaraga, yakoraga ibitangaaza n’ibimenyeetso bikomeye mu bantu.
Ariko abantu bamwe bo mu Sinagoogi yitwaga Ababohoowe, Abanyakureene, Abanyalekizanduriya, hamwe n’abandi bava Silisiya na Asiya barahaguruka baja impaka na Sitefaano.
Ariko ntibaashobora guhangana n’ubwenge bwe n’uko Umwuka Weera wamushobozaga kuvuga.
Baguririra abantu rwihishwa kuvuga bati, "Twumviise avuga amagambo yo gutuka Moose n’Imaana."
Bateera agasasamaro mu bantu, hamwe no muri bakuru b’imiryango hamwe n’Abiigiishamategeko maze bamugwa gituumo, baramufata bamujaana mu rukiiko.
Bashiraho abagabo bo kumushinja ibinyoma barahamya bati, "Uyu mugabo ntaahwema gutuka Inzu y’Imaana Yeera n’amategeko ya Moose,
kuko twamwumviise avuga ko, Yesu w’i Nazaareeti azaasenya iyi Nzu y’Imaana kandi agahindura imigenzo twahaawe na Moose."
Nuuko boose baari biicaye mu rukiiko batumbiira Sitefaano, babona mu maaso he hasa n’aha malayika.
Maze umuhereezabitambo mukuru abaza Sitefaano ati, "Ibyo bakuvugaho ni ukuri?"
Sitefaano aramusubiza ati, "Beene daata kandi babyeyi, ni munyumve, Imaana Nyir’icuubahiro yabonekeye sogokuruza Aburahamu ari i Mesopotamiya, ataraatuura i Haraani,
Iramubwira iti, ‘Va mu gihugu caawe, usige abavandimwe baawe uje mu gihugu nzaakwereka.’
Nuuko Aburahamu ava mu gihugu c’Abakalidayo aja gutuura i Haraani. Nyuma se amaze gupfa, Imaana imuvaanayo imuuzana mur’iki gihugu mutuuyemo ubu.
Imaana ntaabwo yiigeze imuhaho umugabane, haabe n’akangana ubusa, ahuubwo yamuseezeranyije kumuha iki gihugu ngo abe nyiraco n’abamukomookaho, nuubwo yari adafite umwana.
Imaana ivuga muri aya magambo ngo abazaamukomookaho bazaaba abasuhuuke mu gihugu c’abandi, bazaabahindura abareetwa babagirire naabi kumara imyaka magana ane.
Imaana iravuga iti, ‘Ariko nzaahana igihugu bazaakoreramo ubureetwa, haanyuma bazaakivamo maze bansengere aha hantu.’
Maze imuha iseezerano ryo gukebwa. Nuuko Aburahamu abyara Isaaka amukeba ku munsi wa munaane, Isaaka abyara Yaakobo, na Yaakobo abyara basogokuruza bakuru cumi na babiri.
Ba sogokuruza bagirira Yozefu ishari nuuko bamugurisha mu Igiputi, ariko Imaana ibaana na we,
Imaana imukiza amakuba yoose, Imuha gukundwa hamwe n’ubwenge imbere ya Faraawo umwami wa Igiputi, maze Faraawo amugira umutegetsi wa Igiputi n’uw’urugo rwe rwose.
Haanyuma inzara iteera mu Igiputi n’i Kanaani hoose, haba umubabaro mwinshi, nuuko ba sogokuruza babura ibyokurya.
Ariko Yaakobo yumviise ko hari ibyokurya mu Igiputi, yooherezayo baasogokuruza inshuro ya mbere.
Bagiiyeyo ubwa kabiri, Yozefu yiyanzurira beene se kandi n’umuryango wa Yozefu umenywa na Faraawo.
Nuuko Yozefu atumaho se Yaakobo n’umuryango we woose, boose hamwe baari abantu mirongo irindwi na bataanu.
Yaakobo aragenda aja mu Igiputi, maze we na ba sogokuruza bapfiirayo.
Imibiri yaabo bayigarura i Shekemu ihambwa mu mva Aburahamu yari yaraguze ku giciiro c’ifeeza na beene Hamori w’i Shekemu.
Igihe ceegereje kugira ngo iseezerano Imaana yakoreye Aburahamu risohore, umuryango waacu uriyongeera maze ugwira muri Igiputi
kugeza aho undi mwami wari utaazi Yozefu yimye ingoma.
Uwo mwami agira uburiganya bwo kurimbura agirira naabi ubwoko bwacu ahata ba sogokuruza guta abaana baabo b’impinja kugira ngo bapfe.
Muri ico gihe Moose aravuuka, yari mwiza caane imbere y’Imaana. Arererwa mu rugo rwa se ameezi atatu,
amaze gutaabwa, umukoobwa wa Faraawo aramuraruuza maze amurera nk’umwana we bwiite.
Moose yigiishwa mu buhanga bwose bw’Abiigiputi, aba umuntu ukomeye mu byo avuga no mu byo akora.
Moose amaze imyaka mirongo ine y’ubukuru ahitamo kuja gusuura abavandimwe be ari bo Biisirayeli .
Aboonye umwe muri bo agirirwa naabi n’Umwigiputi, aramurengera, aramuhoorera, yiica uwo mwigiputi.
Moose yiibwiraga ko beene waabo bamenyeraho ko ari we Imaana yatumye kubakiza, ariko bo ntibaabisobaanukirwa.
Umunsi ukurikiraho asanga Abiisirayeli babiri bari kurwana, agerageza kubakiraanura ababwira ati, ‘Yemwe bagabo, ko muri abavandimwe, kuki mugirirana naabi?’
Ariko uwarenganyaga mugenzi we asunika Moose iruhande aramubwiira ati, ‘Ni nde wakugize umutegetsi cangwa umucaamanza waacu ?
Mbese ushaaka kunyica nk’uko ejo wishe wa Mwigiputi?’
Moose yumviise ayo magambo, arahunga aja gutuura mu gihugu c’Abamidiyaani nk’umusuhuuke. Ahabyarira abahungu babiri.
Imyaka mirongo ine ishize, malayika amubonekera mu gihuru caaka umuriro mu butaayu bwo ku musozi wa Sinaayi.
Moose aboonye uwo muriro biramutangaaza, araheegeera ngo yiitegereze nuuko yumva ijwi rya Nyagasani rivuga riti,
‘Ndi Imaana ya ba sogokuruza, Imaana ya Aburahamu, ya Isaaka, na Yaakobo.’ Moose ahinda umushitsi ntiyatinyuuka kuhareeba.
Nuuko Uhoraho aramubwira ati, ‘Kuuramo ingato kuko aho uhagaze ari aheera.
Naboonye gutootezwa kw’abantu banje bari mu Igiputi, kandi numvise gutaka kwabo, namanuwe no kubatabaara. Nuuko reero ngwino ngutume mu Igiputi.’

Uwo ni we Moose wa wundi banze kumvira bati, ‘Ni nde wakugize umutegetsi cangwa umucaamanza waacu ?’ Kandi ni we Imaana yatumye kuba umutegetsi n’umutabaazi inyuze muri malayika wamubonekeye mu gihuru.
Moose ni we wabakuuye mu Igiputi amaze gukora ibitangaaza n’ibimenyeetso muri ico gihugu, ku Nyanja Itukura, kandi no mu butaayu kumara imyaka mirongo ine.
Uwo ni we Moose wabwiye Abiisirayeli ati, ‘Imaana izaabahagurukiriza umuhanuuzi ukomooka muri beene waanyu umeze nkanje.’
Moose uwo ni we wari uri mu iteeraniro mu butaayu hamwe na malayika wavuganiye na we ku musozi wa Sinaayi, hamwe na ba sogokuruza, kandi akaakiira amagambo y’ubugingo yo kuduha.
Ariko ba sogokuruza banze kumwumvira, ahuubwo baramuhigika ndetse biifuuza kwisubirira mu Igiputi,
babwira Arooni bati, ‘Turemere imaana zo kutuyobora, kuko Moose wa dukuuye mu Igiputi ntituuzi icaamubaayeho.’
Nuuko ico gihe barema igishushanyo c’ikimasa, bagitambira igitambo, maze biishiimira imirimo y’intoki zaabo.

Nuuko Imaana irabazibukiira irabareka ngo basenge inyenyeeri zo mu kireere nk’uko byanditswe mu gitabo c’abahanuuzi ngo, ‘Yeewe muryango w’Isirayeli, mbese mwigeze ku ntuura ibitambo n’amatungo abaazwe imyaka mirongo ine mwamaze mu butaayu?
Oya! Mwagendanye ihema ry’ikigirwamaana Moleki, n’inyenyeeri y’ikigirwamaana Refani, ibishushaanyo mwaremeye gusenga. Nooneho nanje nzaabiimurira hiirya ya Babuloni.’
Ba sogokuruza baari bafite ihema rigaragaza ko Imaana iri na bo mu butaayu, nk’uko yategetse ubwo yavuganye na Moose. Imutegeka kurishinga akurikije uburyo Imaana yari yamweretse.

Haanyuma ba sogokuruza baheerereekanya iryo hema kugeza igihe ca Yosuwa aba ari we ubayobora baaza gufata iki gihugu Imaana imaze kuciirukanamo abanyamahanga. Iryo hema riguma aho kugeza mu gihe ca Dawudi,
wari utonnye imbere y’Imaana maze agasaba kuubaka Inzu y’Imaana ya Yaakobo.
Ariko Solomooni ni we wuubatse Inzu y’Imaana.
Nyamara Isumbabyose ntiiba mu mazu yuubatswe n’amaboko y’abantu nk’uko umuhanuuzi yavuze ati,
‘Ijuru n’intebe yanje y’ubwami, kandi isi ni akabaaho nkandagizaho ibirenge byanje. Muzanyubakira nzu ki, ni ko Uhoraho avuga, cangwa se aho nzaaruhuukira, hazaaba hameze hate?
Intoki zanje si zo zaaremye ibyo byose?’
Yemwe bantu b’ibyigenge kandi biinangiye mu mitima bakagira n’amatwi atumva, iteeka muhakanya Umwuka Weera, uko ba sookuruza baakoraga.
Ni nde mu bahanuuzi ba sookuruza baanyu bataarenganyije? Biishe abaavuze ibyo kuuza kw’iyo Ntungane bitaraaba, noone namwe mubaaye abo kumugambaanira no ku mwica.
Kandi mwahaawe amategeko y’Imaana n’abaamalayika ariko ntimwayumvira."
Abaari aho bumviise ibyo Sitefaano avuze, buuzura uburakari, bamuhekenyera ameenyo.
Naho Sitefaano yuuzuye Umwuka Weera, atuumbiira mu ijuru abona ubwiza bw’Imaana na Yesu ahagaze i buryo bwayo.
Aravuga ati, "Dore, mboonye ijuru rikinguutse, n’Umwana w’Umuntu ahagaze iburyo bw’Imaana!"
Ariko bapfuka amatwi yaabo maze barasakuza caane, biirukira aho ari bamugwira icaarimwe.
Nuuko baramukurubana bamuvaana mu tawuni batangira kumuteera amabuye. Abaamushinjaga basigira imyiteero yaabo umusore wiitwaga Sawuli.
Bakimuteera amabuye, Sitefaano arasenga ati, "Mwami Yesu, akiira umwuka wanje."
Nuuko arapfukama avuga n’ijwi rirenga ati, "Nyagasani, ntuubabareho iki caaha." Akimara kuvuga atyo arapfa.

Sawuli na we ashigikira kwicwa kwa Siteefaano Uwo munsi Itoorero ry’i Yerusaalemu ritangira gutootezwa bikomeye, maze abiizeera Kristo boose, ukuuyeho intumwa, bataataanira mu bice by’i Yudeeya n’i Samariya.
Abantu buubahaga Imaana bahamba Siteefaano kandi baramuririra caane.
Naho Sawuli we aguma gutooteeza Itoorero ava mu rugo aja mu rundi, agakurubana abagore n’abagabo akabashira mu gihome.
Abiizeera baari baataataanye bava mu mwanya baja mu wundi baamamaza ijambo ry’Imaana.
Filipo aramanuka aja mu tawuni nkuru y’i Samariya maze yigiisha abaaho ibya Kristo.
Abantu nyamwinshi bumvirizaga ibyo Filipo avuga bahuuje umutima, bumva kandi bareeba ibitangaaza yakoraga.
Imyuka mibi yavaga mu bantu benshi isakuza caane, kandi abaari bamugaye n’abaari baremaye barakira.
Nuuko abantu bo mu tawuni y’i Samariya bagira umuneezeero mwinshi.
Haariho umugabo wiitwaga Simooni wahoze ari umupfumu muri iyo tawuni. Yatangaazaga abantu bo muri Samariya, avuga ko ari umuntu ukomeye caane.
Abantu boose, kuva kubooroheje kugera ku bakomeye baaramwumvaga bakavuga bati, "Uyu muntu arimo ububaasha bw’Imaana bwitwa Ubuhangaage."
Baakomeje kugira umwete wo kwita ku bye kuko uheereye keera baatangaazwaga n’ubwo bupfumu bwe.
Ariko abagabo n’abagore bamaze kwizeera Ubutumwa Bwiza bw’Ubwami bw’Imaana n’izina rya Yesu Kristo babwirizwaga na Filipo, barabatizwa.
Na Simooni ubwe areemera. Amaze kubatizwa, aguma kubaana na Filipo atangazwa n’ibimenyeetso n’ibitangaaza bikomeye yakoraga.
Intumwa zaari i Yerusaalemu zumviise ko ab’i Samariya baakiriye ijambo ry’Imaana, zibooheerereza Peetero na Yohaana.
Abo babiri bagezeyo basengera abiizeera kugira ngo bahaabwe Umwuka Weera.
[Kuko ari nta n’umwe muri bo wo Umwuka Weera yari yakamanukiyeho, ahuubwo baari babatijwe mu izina ry’Umwami Yesu gusa].
Nuuko Peetero na Yohaana babarambikaho ibiganza maze bahaabwa Umwuka Weera.
Simooni aboonye yuuko abo intumwa zirambitseho ibiganza bahaawe Umwuka Weera, aziizanira ishilingi,
arazibwira ati, "Nanje mumpe izo mbaraga kugira ngo uwo nzaarambikaho ibiganza ahaabwe Umwuka Weera."
Peetero aramubwira ati, "Urakarimbuka n’ishilingi zaawe, kuko uteekereza yuuko waagura impaano y’Imaana ukoresheje ishilingi!
Ntaamugabane, ntaan’umurage ufite muri ibi, kuko umutima waawe udatungaaniye Imaana.
Wihane ubwo bugome bwawe, usabe Nyagasani kugira ngo niiba bishoboka, akubabarire uwo mugambi uri mu mutima waawe.
Kuko ndikureeba wuzuuye ishari ry’ikirenga kandi uhambiiriwe n’ibyaha."
Simooni aramusubiza ati, "Munsabire kuri Nyagasani kugira ngo hatagira ikimbaho mu byo mumaze kuvuga."
Nuuko Peetero na Yohaana bamaze guhamya no kubwiriza abantu ijambo rya Nyagasani, basubira i Yerusaalemu, babwiriza Ubutumwa Bwiza mu bice byinshi by’i Samariya.
Nuuko Malayika wa Nyagasani abwira Filipo ati, "Haguruka ugende weerekeze mu majeepfo, ufate inzira imanuka iva i Yerusaalemu ija i Gaaza." [Iyi n’inzira yo mu butaayu.]

Nuuko arahaguruka, aragenda. Haariho umunyetiyopiya w’inkone wari umutware mu bwami bwa Kandake, umwamikazi wa Etiyopiya, kandi akaba ari na we wareebereraga umutungo w’umwamikazi. Yari yaaje i Yerusaalemu kuramya Imaana.
Kandi yari ari gusubira mu rugo, yiicaye mu gaare rye ari gusoma igitabo c’umuhanuuzi Yesaaya.
Nuuko Umwuka abwira Filipo ati, "Genda weegeere ririiya gaare maze ujaane na ryo."
Filipo ariiruka maze yumva wa mugabo ari gusoma igitabo c’umuhanuuzi Yesaaya. Aramubaza ati, "Mbese ibyo usoma uri kubisobaanukirwa?"
Uwo mutware aramusubiza ati, "Naabisobaanukirwa nte ntaboonye unsobaanurira?" Nuuko asaba Filipo ngo yinjire maze biicarane.
Ibyo yasomaga mu byanditswe byera byari ibi; "Yajanywe nk’intaama igiiye kubaagwa, kandi nk’uko umwana w’intaama ucecekera imbere y’uwukemura ubwoya Na we ntiyaruhije abumbuura akanwa.
Yarashinyaguriwe aciirwa urubanza rw’akarengane. Ni nde uzaasobaanura abamukomookaho? Kuko ubugingo bwe bukuuwe mu isi."
Iyo nkone ibaza Filipo iti, "Mbwira, ayo magambo umuhanuuzi yayavuze kuri nde? Yayiivuzeho cangwa yayavuze ku wundi muntu?"
Filipo atangira kuvuga aheereye kuri ibyo byanditswe, amubwiriza Ubutumwa Bwiza bwa Yesu.
Bakigenda, bagera ku maazi, nuuko iyo nkone iravuga iti, "Dore hano hari amaazi! Ikimbuza kubatizwa ni iki?"
Filipo aravuga ati, "Niiba wiizeeye n’umutima waawe woose birashoboka." Na ya nkone iti, "Niizeeye yuuko Yesu Kristo ari Umwana w’Imaana "
Iyo nkone itegeka ko igaare rihagarikwa, maze yo na Filipo baramanuka baja mu maazi, nuuko Filipo arayibatiza.
Bavuuye mu maazi, Umwuka wa Nyagasani ajaana Filipo, iyo nkone ntiyongera kumubona, maze ikomeza urugendo ineezeerewe.
Ariko Filipo yisanga ahiitwa Azoto, agenda abwira abantu Ubutumwa Bwiza muri ico gice coose kugeza aho yagereye i Kayisaariya.
Sawuli we, akomeza gukangiisha n’imbaraga kwica abiizeera ba Nyagasani. Nuuko asanga Umuheerezabitambo mukuru

maze amusaba inzandiko zo kumwanzura ku bakuru b’amasinagoogi b’i Damasiko, kugira ngo niharamuka hari umuntu aboonye ukurikira inzira ya Nyagasani, yaaba umugabo cangwa umugore, amubohe amuuzane i Yerusaalemu.
Akigenda ari haafi kugera i Damasiko, mu kamwanya, umuco uvuuye mu ijuru uramugota.
Agwa haasi maze yumva ijwi rivuga riti, "Sawuli, Sawuli, kuki untooteza?"
Sawuli aramubaza ati, "Uri nde, Nyagasani?" Iryo jwi riramusubiza riti, "Ndi Yesu, uwo utooteza.
Ariko haguruka uje mu tawuni nkuru, urabwirwa ico ukwiriye gukora."
Abagabo baari bafatanyije na we urugendo bahagarara badakoma, kuko bumvaga ijwi ariko ntibabone umuntu.
Sawuli arahaguruka, ariko n’ubwo yarambuuraga amaaso, nta co yashoboraga kureeba, nuuko baramurandata bamugeza i Damasiko.
Yamaze iminsi itatu atareeba, atarya kandi atanywa.
I Damasiko haari umwigiisha wiitwaga Ananiya. Umwami Yesu amubonekera mu nzozi aramuhamagara ati, "Ananiya." Na we arasubiza ati, "Karame, Mwami."
Umwami Yesu aramubwira ati, "Haguruka uje mu muhare wiitwa ‘Ugororotse’, maze ushaakire mu nzu ya Yuda umuntu wiitwa Sawuli w’i Tarisiya. Ubu ari gusenga,
kandi amaze kubonekerwa areeba umuntu wiitwa Ananiya yinjira iwe, akamurambikaho ibiganza kugira ngo yongere kureeba."
Ariko Ananiya aramusubiza ati, "Mwami, numvise benshi bavuga iby’uwo muntu, nuuko yagiriye naabi abantu baawe bari i Yerusaalemu.
Kandi n’ino yaje afite ububaasha yahaawe n’abatware b’abaheerezabitambo, kugira ngo abohe abo boose basenga mu izina ryawe."
Ariko Umwami Yesu abwira Ananiya ati, "Genda, kuko namutooranyije kwamamaza izina ryanje mu banyamahanga n’abaami no mu Biisirayeli.
Nje ubwanje nzamwereka uko azaababazwa, ahoorwa izina ryanje."

Ananiya aragenda maze yinjira muri ya nzu. Arambuura ibiganza bye kuri Sawuli nuuko aravuga ati, "Muvandimwe Sawuli, Umwami Yesu, wakubonekeye mu nzira uri kuuza ino, arantumye kugira ngo uhumuuke kandi wuuzure Umwuka Weera."
Ako kaanya ibintu bisa nk’ibishishwa by’isamaaki bimuva mu maaso, aheera ko arareeba, arahaguruka maze arabatizwa.
Amaze kurya, yongera kugira imbaraga. Sawuli amarana n’abiizeera iminsi myinshi i Damasiko,
maze atangiriraho kwamamaza Yesu mu masinagoogi, avuga ati, "Ni Umwana w’Imaana."

Abamwumvaga boose baaratangaaraga maze bakabazanya bati, "Uyu si we watootezaga abantu baahimbaazaga izina rya Yesu i Yerusaalemu? Kandi ntiyaaje ino kugira ngo ababohe maze abajaanire abatware b’abaheerezabitambo?"
Sawuli arushaho kugira imbaraga mu kuvuga ubutumwa kandi agatsinda impaka yajaga n’Abayuuda baari batuuye i Damasiko yeerekana ubuhamya ko Yesu ari Kristo.
Hashize igihe, Abayuuda baja imigambi yo kwica Sawuli,
ariko Sawuli aza kumenya ubugambanyi bwabo. Baarindaga amarembo y’itawuni amanywa na n’ijoro kugira ngo bamwice,
ariko abayoboke be bamujaana n’ijoro bamunyuza mu gipfumure c’uruzitiro rw’amabuye, bamwururukiriza mu giteebo.
Ageze i Yerusaalemu, agerageza kwifatanya n’abiigiishwa, ariko boose baramutinya. Ntaabwo beemeye neeza ko na we yabaaye umwigiishwa.

Nuuko Barinaba ajaana Sawuli, amugeza ku ntumwa, maze azisobaanurira uko yabonekewe na Nyagasani mu nzira akavugana na we. Ababwira n’uko Sawuli yiigiishije mu izina rya Kristo i Damasiko ashize amanga.
Nuuko Sawuli abaana na bo i Yerusaalemu agendagenda hoose, kandi yiigiisha mu izina ry’Umwami Yesu ashize amanga.
Yabwirizaga kandi akaja impaka n’Abayuuda baavugaga urugiriki, ariko bo baja imigambi yo kumwica.
Abeemera babimenye, bamujaana i Kayisaariya maze bamwohereza i Tarisiya.
Nuuko itoorero muri Yudeeya yoose, muri Galileeya, no muri Samariya rigira amahoro kandi rirakomera. Rigumya kuubaha Nyagasani rifashijwe n’Umwuka Weera, maze riragwira.
Ubwo Peetero yagendagendaga mu biizeera boose, aza no kugera ku bantu b’Imaana batuuye i Lida.
Ahasanga umugabo wiitwaga Ayineya, akaba yari amaze imyaka umunaane atava aho ari kuko yari afite ubumuga.
Peetero aramubwira ati, "Ayineya, Yesu Kristo aragukijije, haguruka uzinge uburiri bwawe!" Ako kaanya arahaguruka.
Abatuurage benshi b’i Lida na Sharoni baramubona maze bayoboka Imaana.
I Yopa haari umwigiishwakazi wiitwaga Tabita, mu rugiriki ni Dorokaasi. Yahoraga agira neeza kandi afasha abatiishoboye.
Muri iyo minsi aza kurwara maze arapfa. Bamaze kuuhagira umurambo we, bawurambika mu gisenge co heejuru.
Kuko Lida na Yopa byari byegeeranye, kandi bamaze kumenya ko Peetero ariyo, bamutumaho abagabo babiri baramusaba bati, "Nyaabuna, ngwino iwaacu kandi ntutinde."

Peetero arahaguruka, maze ajaana na bo. Ahageze, bamujaana mu gisenge co heejuru. Abapfaakazi boose baari bahagaze iruhande rwa Peetero barira, bamwereka ibiteeteeyi n’indi myenda Tabita yari yarabakoreye akiri kumwe na bo.
Peetero aboohereza hanze boose, maze arapfukama arasenga. Niko guhindukira umurambo maze aravuga ati, "Tabita, haguruka." Tabita arambuura amaaso, nuuko aboonye Peetero, areeguuka maze ariicara.
Peetero amufata ukuboko aramuhagurutsa. Niiko guhamagara abiizeera, barimo n’abapfaakazi, abeereka Tabita ari muzima.
Ibi bimenyekana muri Yopa hoose, nuuko abantu benshi biizeera Nyagasani.
Peetero amara iminsi myinshi i Yopa, acumbitse kwa Simooni, umuhazi w’impu.
I Kayisaariya haari umugabo wiitwaga Koruneliyo, akaba yari umutware w’abasirikare ijana wiitwaga Italiyana.
Yari umugabo wuubaha kandi utinya Imaana, hamwe n’ab’urugo rwe boose. Yafashaga abantu kandi agahora asenga Imaana.
Umunsi umwe nko ku gihe c’isaaha icenda z’amanywa aza kubonekerwa. Abona malayika w’Imaana yinjira iwe, aramubwira ati, "Koruneliyo!"
Atumbiira uwo malayika n’ubwoba bwinshi maze aravuga ati, "Ni iki, Nyagasani?" Malayika aramusubiza ati, "Amasengeesho yaawe n’ubuntu ugira byageze ku Maana noone yakwibutse.
Noone reero ohereza abantu i Yopa utume kuri Simooni wiitwa Peetero.
Acumbitse kwa Simooni w’umuhazi, urugo rwe ruri iruhande rw’inyanja."
Malayika wavuganaga na we amaze kugenda, ahamagara abagaragu be b’inkoramutima babiri hamwe n’umusirikare wuubaha Imaana wo mu baamukoreraga,
nuuko amaze kubabwira ibyo yeretswe byose, aboohereza i Yopa.
Bakigenda bari haafi kugera muri iyo tawuni nk’igihe c’isaaha itandatu, Peetero aja heejuru y’inzu gusenga.
Arasonza yumva ashaaka kurya, mu gihe bakimuteguurira ibyokurya, aratwarwa.
Abona ijuru rikinguutse, maze ikintu gisa nk’umwenda munini kiramanuka, gifashwe ku nshonda zaaco enye, cuururuka kigana ku isi.
Muri uwo mwenda haarimo inyamaaswa z’amooko yoose, izigendeesha amaguru ane, ibikururuka haasi n’inyoni zo mu kireere.
Nuuko yumva ijwi rivuga riti, "Peetero, haguruka wice maze urye."
Ariko Peetero arasubiza ati, "Oya Nyagasani, kuko ntaabwo nari naaryaho ikizira cangwa igihumaanya."
Iryo jwi rirongera rimubwira ubwa kabiri riti, "Ico Imaana yeemeye ko kiriibwa, ntukaciite ikizira."
Ibyo biba gatatu, maze ca kintu gisubizwa mu ijuru.
Peetero aciibaza ico ibyo yeeretswe bimenyeesha, ako kaanya ba bagabo booherejwe na Koluneriyo babe barahageze. Baayobozaga kwa Simooni kandi bahagaze ku irembo.
Barahamagara kugira ngo bamenye ko Simooni, wiitwa Peetero, acumbitse muri urwo rugo.
Peetero agiteekereza ku byo yabonekewe, Umwuka aramubwira ati, "Dore abantu batatu baragushaaka.
Noone haguruka umanuke, ujaane na bo udashidiikanya, kuko ari nje ubatumye."
Peetero aramanuka asanga abo bagabo maze arababaza ati, "Ni nje mushaaka, muzanywe n’iki?"

Baramusubiza bati, "Koruneliyo, umutware w’abasirikare ijana, kandi umukiraanutsi wuubaha Imaana, ndetse akavugwa neeza mu Bayuuda boose, yabonekewe na malayika weera ngo agutumeho uze iwe mu rugo maze yumve ibyo umubwira."
Peetero abinjiza mu nzu arabacumbikira. Bukeeye, Peetero arahaguruka ajaana na bo, kandi bamwe mu biigiishwa, b’i Yopa baramuherekeza.
Umunsi wakurikiyeho, bagera i Kayisaariya. Koruneliyo yari abategereje kandi yakoranyije beene waabo hamwe n’inshuti ze magara.
Peetero ahageze, Koruneliyo aramusanganira, yiikubita imbere ye, aramuramya.
Ariko Peetero aramuhagurutsa, aramubwira ati, "Haguruka, nanje ndi umuntu nkaawe."
Akivugana na Koruneliyo, arinjira asanga abantu benshi bahateeraniye,

arababwira ati, "Mwe ubwanyu muuzi neeza yuuko amategeko ateemera ko Umuyuuda yiifatanya cangwa ngo azindukire umunyamahanga, ariko nje Imaana yanyeretse ko ntaamuntu nkwiriye kwita ikizira cangwa igihumaanya.
Ni co caatumye muntumaho, nkaaza ntashidiikanya. Noone ndashaaka kubaza, mwantumiyeho iki?"
Koruneliyo aramusubiza ati, "Iminsi enye ishize nk’aya masaaha, isaaha cenda z’amanywa, nari ndi mu nzu yanje nsenga nuuko mu kamwanya imbere yanje habe hagaragaye umuntu wambaye imyenda irabagirana.
Aravuga ati, ‘Koruneliyo, amasengeesho yaawe yakiiriwe kandi n’ubuntu bwawe bwibutswe imbere y’Imaana.
Noone reero, ohereza abantu i Yopa maze utumeho Simooni, wiitwa Peetero, acumbitse kwa Simooni umuhazi, iruhande rw’inyanja.’
Mpeerako ngutumaho, kandi naawe ugize neeza kuba uje. Ubu twese duteeraniye hano imbere y’Imaana, kugira ngo twumve ibyo Nyagasani yagutegetse kuvuga."
Nuuko Peetero atangira kubabwira ati, "Ni ukuri menye yuuko Imaana itarobaanura,
ahuubwo mu mahanga yoose yeemera umuntu weese uyuubaha agakora ibiyitungaaniye.
Yoohereje ubutumwa ku bantu ba Isirayeli, kwamamaza Inkuru Nziiza y’amahoro baazaniwe na Yesu Kristo, ari we Mwami w’abantu boose.
Ubwo butumwa bwamamaye muri Yudeeya, buheereye i Galileeya nyuma y’umubatizo Yohaana yabwirizaga.
Imaana yasutse Umwuka Weera n’imbaraga kuri Yesu w’i Nazaareeti, akagenda akora ibyiza, agakiza boose baakandamijwe na Sataani kuko Imaana yari kumwe na we.
Turi abahamya b’ibyo yakoze byose muri Yudeeya no muri Yerusaalemu. Bamwishe bamumanitse ku giti.
Ariko Imaana imuzuura ku munsi wa gatatu kandi imwemerera kwigaragaza,
atari ku bantu boose, ahuubwo kuri twe baatooranyijwe n’Imaana kuba abahamya, kandi twasangiye na we ibyokurya n’ibyokunywa amaze kuzuuka mu baapfuuye.
Yadutegetse kwamamaza mu bantu no guhamya yuuko ari we Imaana yatooranyije kuba umucaamanza w’abazima n’abaapfuuye.
Abahanuuzi boose bahamya ko umwizeera weese ababarirwa ibyaha mu izina rye."
Peetero akivuga, Umwuka Weera amanukira kuri abo boose baari barikumva.
Abiizeera bo mu baakebwe baari bajanye na Peetero batangaazwa n’uko Umwuka Weera yamanukiye no ku banyamahanga,
kuko baabumviise bavuga mu ndimi bahimbaaza Imaana. Maze Peetero aravuga ati,
"Hari ubaasha kwima aba bantu amaazi yo kubabatiza kandi baahaawe Umwuka Weera nkaatwe?"
Nuuko abategeka kubatizwa mu izina rya Yesu Kristo. Maze abanyamahanga basaba Peetero kugumana na bo kumara iminsi mike.
Intumwa n’abiizeera baari i Yudeeya bumviise yuuko abanyamahanga na bo beemeye ijambo ry’Imaana.
Nuuko Peetero ageze i Yerusaalemu, abiizeera baakebwe baja na we impaka,
bavuga bati, "Kuki wagiiye mu badakebwe kandi ukanasangira na bo?"
Peetero atangira kubasobaanurira uko bikurikirana ati,
"Nari mu tawuni y’i Yopa nsenga, ndatwarwa maze ndeerekwa. Mbona ikintu gisa n’umwenda munini gifashwe ku nshonda enye kimanurwa mu ijuru, maze kiranyegeera.
Nshitegereje neeza mbona inyamaaswa z’amaguru ane, inyamaaswa z’inkazi, n’ibikururuka haasi, hamwe n’inyoni zo mu kireere.
Maze numva n’ijwi rimbwira riti, ‘Peetero, haguruka wice, urye.’
Ariko nje ndamusubiza nti, ‘Oya Nyagasani, nta kintu kitariibwa cangwa gihumanye nari naakoza mu kanwa kanje.’
Inshuro ya kabiri iryo jwi rivugira mu ijuru riti, ‘Ico Imaana yahumaanuye, ntukacite igihumanye.’
Ibyo byabaaye gatatu, haanyuma ibyo bintu byose bisubizwa mu ijuru.
Ako kaanya, abagabo batatu bantumweho kuva i Kayisaariya baba bageze ku rugo rwo twari turimo.
Umwuka ambwira kujaana na bo kandi no kutiitandukanya na bo. Aba beene daata na bo uko ari batandatu baramperekeza, maze twinjira mu nzu ya Koloneliyo.
Aduteekerereza uko yaboonye malayika ahagaze mu nzu ye akamubwira ati ‘Ohereza umuntu i Yopa, maze azane Simooni wiitwa Peetero.
Azaaguha ubutumwa buzaagukiza, wowe n’ab’urugo rwawe rwose.’
Igihe ntangiye kuvuga, Umwuka Weera abamanukiraho nk’uko naatwe yatumanukiyeho ubwa mbere.
Nuuko niibuka rya jambo ry’Umwami Yesu, ubwo yavugaga ati, ‘Yohaana yabatiriishaga amaazi, ariko mwebwe muzaabatiriishwa n’Umwuka Weera.’
Noone se niiba Imaana yarahaaye abanyamahanga impaano nk’iyo twahaawe ubwo twemeraga Umwami Yesu Kristo, nje ndi nde wo kuvuguruza Imaana?"
Bumviise ibyo baratuuza, maze basingiza Imaana bavuga bati, "Nooneho Imaana yahaaye n’Abanyamahanga kwihana kugira ngo na bo bahaabwe ubugingo."

Nuuko abo baari baarataatanye ku bw’akarengane kaabaayeho biteewe n’ibya Sitefaano baragenda bagera Foyinike, Kupuro n’i Antiyokiya, maze ntibaagira uwo babwiriza ijambo ry’Imaana keretse Abayuuda bonyine.
Ariko bamwe muri bo haarimo abantu b’i Kupuro n’ab’i Kureni. Bageze Antiyokiya, bavugana n’Abagiriki baamamaza ubutumwa bw’Umwami Yesu.
Ububaasha bw’Uhoraho buba muri bo, maze abantu benshi bariizeera bahindukira Nyagasani.
Iyo nkuru iza kugera ku toorero ry’i Yerusaalemu, maze boohereza Barinaba muri Antiyokiya.
Ubwo Barinaba yagezeyo akabona uko Imaana yagiriye abantu baayo ubuntu araneezeerwa, maze abiihanangiriza boose kuguma mu Mwami Yesu bamaramaje.
Koko reero uwo Barinaba yari umuntu mwiza, wuuzuye Umwuka Weera n’ukwemera. Kandi abantu benshi caane biyongera kuri abo bizeera Nyagasani.
Nuuko Barinaba aja i Taruso gushaaka Sawuli.
Amaze kumubona, amujaana muri Antiyokiya. Baamaze umwaka woose bateerana n’abiitoorero, kandi biigiisha abantu benshi. Muri Antiyokiya ni ho abiigiishwa baatangiriye kwitwa "Abakristo."
Ico gihe abahanuuzi bava i Yerusaalemu baja muri Antiyokiya.
Umwe muri bo wiitwaga Agabo arahagarara ayobowe n’Umwuka Weera, ahanuura yuuko hagiiye guteera inzara nyinshi ku isi yoose. Iyo nzara yaaje kubaho ku ngoma ya Kilawudiyo.
Abiigiishwa biiyemeza kureeba ngo buri umwe yoohereje imfashanyo ku bavandimwe baabo batuuye i Yudeeya, bakurikije ubutunzi bwa buri weese.
Ibi baarabikoze, babyoherereza bakuru b’itoorero babinyujije muri Barinaba na Sawuli.
Ico gihe, umwami Herodi atangira gutooteza bamwe bo mu itoorero.
Ategeka ko Yaakobo mwene se wa Yohaana, yiciishwa inkoota.
Aboonye ko ibyo bineejeeje Abayuuda, yongera no gufata Peetero. [Ibi byabaaye mu minsi mikuru yo gusangira Imigaati Idasembuwe.]
Herodi amaze gufata Peetero, amushira mu gihome, maze amurindiisha ubutsiko bune bw’abasirikare bane buri kamwe. Yashaakaga kumushikiriza abantu nyuma yo Kunyurwaho.
Peetero arindiwe mu gihome, ab’itoorero baamusabiraga ku Maana babishizeho umwete.

Ijoro Herodi yari bumutange ngo yiicwe, Peetero yari mu gihome asinziiririye hagati y’abasirikare babiri kandi aboheeshejwe injegeri ebyiri. Abarinzi na bo baari imbere y’umuryango w’igihome, baharinze.
Mu kamwanya, haboneka malayika wa Nyagasani, maze umuco umurika mu gihome. Malayika akora Peetero mu mbavu maze amubyutsa amubwira ati, "Haguruka vuba." Nuuko injegeri zimuva ku maboko ziragwa.
Malayika aramubwira ati, "Kenyera ukomeze, wambare ingato zaawe." Peetero arabikora nuuko malayika yongera kumubwira ati, "Ifubike umwiteero waawe, unkurikire."
Peetero arasohoka aramukurikira, ariko ntiyashobora kwiyumvisha ko ibyo byakorwaga na malayika ari byo. Yateekerezaga ko yari ari kwerekwa.

Bamaze kunyura ku barinzi ba mbere n’aba kabiri, bagera ku ruugi rw’icuuma rwerekeje mu tawuni nkuru. Urwo ruugi ruriikinguura, maze Peetero na malayika barasohoka banyura inzira imwe, mu kamwanya malayika amusiga aho.
Nuuko Peetero agarura umutima maze aravuga ati, "Nooneho menye by’ukuri yuuko Nyagasani yatumye malayika we kunkuura mu maboko ya Herodi n’ibyo Abayuuda baari bategereje kunkorera byose."
Amaze kubibona atyo, aja kwa Mariya nyina wa Yohaana wiitwaga Mariko, aho abantu benshi baari bateeraniye basenga.
Peetero akomanze ku ruugi rw’irembo, umuja wiitwaga Rooda aja kureeba.
Amenye ijwi rya Peetero, ibineezaneeza biramusaaga maze mu mwanya wo gukinguura irembo, asubira mu nzu yiiruka, avuga ko Peetero ahagaze ku irembo.
Baramubwira bati, "Waasaze!" Ariko we akomeza kubahamiriza ko ari byo. Baravuga bati, "Ni malayika we."
Ariko Peetero akomeza gukomanga. Bakinguuye irembo, baramubona maze baratangaara.
Arabamama ngo bahore, nuuko abasobaanurira uburyo Nyagasani yamukuuye mu gihome. Yongera kubabwira ati, "Ibi, mubimenyeeshe Yaakobo n’abandi biizeera." Nuuko Peetero aragenda aja ahandi hantu.
Bukeeye, haba impagarara nyinshi mu basirikare, biibaza ibyabaaye kuri Peetero.
Herodi na we amushaatse aramubura, abaza abarinzi uko byabaaye maze ategeka ko biicwa. Birangiye, Herodi ava muri Yudeeya aja i Kayisaariya maze ahamara igihe.

Herodi yari araakariye abantu b’i Tiiro n’i Sidoni. Nuuko biishirahamwe baramusanga, bamaze kubona inkunga ya Bulasito, umutware w’abakora mu nzu y’umwami, basaba umwami kwiyuzuza na bo kuko igihugu caabo caahaahiraga mu gihugu ce.
Ku munsi wateguuwe, Herodi yambara imyambaro y’ubwami, yicara ku ntebe ya caami ahiirengeereye, agaaniirira rubanda.
Abantu bakomeza guteera heejuru bati, "Ntaabwo ari umuntu uvuga, ahuubwo ni ijwi ry’ikigirwamaana!"
Ako kaanya, malayika wa Nyagasani aramukumbanya agwa haasi, maze ariibwa n’inyo arapfa, kuko ataari yahaaye Imaana icuubahiro.
Ariko ijambo ry’Imaana rikomeza gukura no kwamamara.
Nuuko Barinaba na Sawuli bamaze kurangiza umurimo waabo, bava i Yerusaalemu baazana na Yohaana, wiitwaga Mariko.
Mu itoorero rya Antiyokiya haari abahanuuzi hamwe n’abiigiisha, ari bo Barinaba, Simiyooni wiitwaga Umwirabura, Lusiyasi w’i Kureeni, Manaheni wareranywe na Herodi umutegetsi, hamwe na Sawuli.
Ubwo baaramyaga Nyagasani no kwiyiriza ubusa, Umwuka Weera yarababwiye ati, "Nimunshirire Barinaba na Sawuli ukwabo, maze baje gukora umurimo nabahamagariye."
Nuuko bamaze kwiyiriza ubusa no gusenga, barambika ibiganza kuri Barinaba na Sawuli maze baraboohereza.
Barinaba na Sawuli batumwe n’Umwuka Weera, bamanukira i Serewukiya, maze bahafatira ubwato bagana mu kirwa c’i Kupuro.
Bageze i Salamina, baamamaza ijambo ry’Imaana mu masinagoogi y’Abayuuda. Baari kumwe na Yohaana, abafasha.
Bamaze kwitooroora ikirwa coose bagera i Paafo, basangayo umupfumu w’Umuyuuda wari umuhanuuzi w’ibinyoma wiitwaga Baari Yesu.
Yari kumwe n’umutware wategekaga ico kirwa, wiitwa Serugiyo Pawulo wari umunyabwenge. Uwo mutegetsi ahamagaza Barinaba na Sawuli, ashaaka kumva ijambo ry’Imaana.
Ariko wa mupfumu Elumasi kuko ni ko izina rye risobaanura, arabahakanya agerageza kuyobya wa mutegetsi ngo atiizeera.
Ariko Sawuli ari we Pawulo, yuuzuye Umwuka Weera, atumbiira wa mupfumu,
aramubwira ati, "Wa mwana wa Sataani we, wa mwanzi w’ubutungane bwose we, wowe wuuzuye uburimanganya n’ubugome, uzaageza he kugoreka ukuri kwa Nyagasani?

Noone reero umva, ukuboko kwa Nyagasani kuraguhannye, ugiiye kuba impumyi, umare iminsi utareeba izuuba." Ako kaanya igiho c’umwijima kimutwikiira amaaso maze arindagira akabakaba ashaaka abo kumurandata.
Wa mutegetsi aboonye ibibaaye, ariizeera, atangaazwa n’inyigiisho zifashe kuri Nyagasani.
Pawulo na bagenzi be bafatira ubwato i Paafo, maze bagera i Periga yo muri Pamfiliya. Yohaana we abasiga aho, asubira i Yerusaalemu.
Ariko Pawulo na bagenzi be bava i Periga bagera Antiyokiya yo muri Pisidiya. Ku munsi w’Isaabato, baja mu isinagoogi bariicara.
Nyuma yo gusomerwa mu gitabo c’amategeko n’abahanuuzi, abayobozi b’isinagoogi babooherereza ubutumwa bati, "Bavandimwe, niiba hari ijambo ryo gukomeza abantu mufite, ngaaho nimuritange."
Pawulo arahaguruka, abacecekeesha ikiganza maze atangira kuvuga ati, "Mwa Biisirayeli mwe, n’abandi baramya Imaana, nimunyumve.
Imaana y’aba bantu ba Isirayeli yatooranyije ba sogokuruza ibaha koororokana ubwo baari abasuhuuke mu gihugu ca Igiputi, maze ku bw’imbaraga zaayo, ikabakuurayo.
Yabiitaayeho kumara imyaka mirongo ine ubwo baari mu butaayu.
Imaana imaze gutuma amahanga arindwi yo mu gihugu c’i Kanaani arimbuka, yahaaye Abiisirayeli igihugu caabo nk’umurage
kandi ibyo byose byajaanye imyaka nka magana ane na mirongo itaanu. Haanyuma Imaana ibaha abacamanza kugeza igihe c’umuhanuuzi Samweri.
Bageze aho basaba umwami wo kubayobora, nuuko Imaana ibaha Sawuli mwene Kishi, wo mu bwoko bwa Benjamiini, amara imyaka mirongo ine ku ngoma.
Imaana imaze kumukuuraho, ishiraho Dawudi nk’umwami waabo. Imutangaho ubuhamya iti, ‘Mboonye Dawudi mwene Yese, kuba inkoramutima yanje, uzaakora ibyo nshaaka byose.’
Mu rubyaro rwe ni mwo umukiza w’Abisirayeli, Yesu, akomooka nk’uko Imaana yari yarabimuseezeranyije.
Mbere yuuko Yesu aza, Yohaana yamamazaga mu Biisirayeli boose umubatizo wo kwihana.

Nuuko Yohaana ari kurangiza umurimo we, aravuga ati, ‘Muteekereza ko ndi nde? Ntaabwo ndi uwo mukeeka. Oya, ahuubwo hari ugiiye kuuza ankurikiye, kandi sinkwiriye no guhambuura udushumi tw’ingato ze.’
Bavandimwe, rubyaro rwa Aburahamu, n’abandi baramya Imaana, ubu butumwa bw’agakiza ni twe bwohererejwe.
Kuko abatuuye i Yerusaalemu n’abayobozi baabo bataamenye Yesu cangwa ngo basobaanukirwe amagambo y’abahanuuzi asomwa buri Saabato, buuzuririza ayo magambo ubwo baamuciira urwo gupfa.
Nuubwo bataaboonye impamvu yo kumuciira urwo gupfa, baasabye Pilaato kumwica.
Bamaze gukora nk’uko ibyanditswe kuri Yesu byose bivuga, abayoboke be bamumanura ku musaraba, bamushira mu mva.
Ariko Imaana imuzuura mu baapfuuye,
amara iminsi myinshi abonekera abaari baaraazanye na we kuva i Galileeya kugera i Yerusaalemu, noone ubu ni bo bahamya baabyo mu bantu.
Noone ubu tubaazaniye Inkuru Nziiza yuuko iseezerano Imaana yagiriye ba sogokuruza
ari twebwe, abaana baabo, ryujuririjwemo, ubwo yazuuye Yesu, nk’uko byanditswe muri Zaaburi ya kabiri ngo, ‘Uri Umwana wanje, uyu munsi ndakwibyariye.’
Ibyo kumuzuura mu baapfuuye, no kudasubira kubora, Imaana ibivuga muri aya magambo, iti, ‘Nzaabaha ibyiza naseezeranyije Dawudi Nzaabaha ibyiza bitagira inenge naseezeranyije Dawudi.’
Ni co gituma yarongeye kuvuga mu yindi Zaaburi ati, ‘Ntaabwo uzeemera ko Uweera waawe abora.’
Dawudi we yakoze ibyo Imaana ishaaka mu gihe ce, arapfa, ahambwa aho ba seekuruza baahambwe, maze arabora,
ariko uwo Imaana yazuuye ntaabwo yiigeze kubora.
Nooneho reero bavandimwe, mumenye yuuko ari ku bwa Yesu mwagejejweho ibabarirwa ry’ibyaha,
kandi ni ku bwe buri weese umwemera ababarirwa ibyaha byose ndetse n’ibyo bitaakababariwe n’amategeko ya Moose.
Nimwirinde reero, kugira ngo ibyo abahanuuzi baavuze bitababaho.
‘Nimureebe, mwa banyagasuuzuguro mwe! Nimutangaare maze murimbuke, kuko muri iki gihe caanyu, ngiiye gukora igikorwa, igikorwa co mutaziigera mwemera, nuubwo haagira ukibabwira.’ "
Pawulo na Barinaba basohotse, abantu babasaba kuzongera kuvuga kuri aya magambo ku Isaabato ikurikiraho.

Inaama yo mu sinagoogi irangiye, Abayuuda benshi hamwe n’abo beemeye idiini y’Abayuuda bakurikira Pawulo na Barinaba. Pawulo na Barinaba bavugana na bo kandi babashiishikariza kuguma mu buntu bw’Imaana.
Ku Isaabato yakurikiyeho, haafi abo mu tawuni boose baari baakoraniye mu isinagoogi kumva ijambo rya Nyagasani.
Ariko Abayuuda baboonye ko abantu ari benshi, bagira ishari ryinshi, maze bavuga amagambo asebya, bahinyura ibyo Pawulo yavugaga.

Nuuko Pawulo na Barinaba bavuga bashize amanga bati, "Byari bikwiriye ko ari mwe mubanza kubwirwa ijambo ry’Imaana. Ariko ubwo muryanze mukabona ko mudakwiriye ubugingo buhoraho, ubu tugiiye kubareka dusange abanyamahanga.
Kuko ni ko Nyagasani yadutegetse ati, ‘Ngushiriyeho kuba urumuri rw’Abanyamahanga, kugira ngo ujaane agakiza ku mpera y’isi.’ "
Abanyamahanga babyumviise bariishiima, maze basingiza ijambo rya Nyagasani, na benshi bari baaragenewe ubugingo buhoraho bahinduka abiizeera.
Nuuko ijambo rya Nyagasani rikwira mu gihugu coose.
