Ariko Abayuuda boosha abagore b’icuubahiro buubaha Imaana, hamwe n’abagabo b’icuubahiro b’iyo tawuni nkuru, maze babateeza Pawulo na Barinaba ngo babatooteze, kandi babiirukane mu gihugu caabo.
Ariko Pawulo na Barinaba bakunkumura umucuucu wo ku birenge byabo nk’ikimenyeetso co kubavuma, maze baja Ikoniyo.
Abiigiishwa buuzura ibyishiimo n’Umwuka Weera.
Pawulo na Barinaba bageze Ikoniyo, baahasanze nk’ibyo bahuuriye na byo Antiyokiya. Binjiye mu isinagoogi y’Abayuuda, bavuga amagambo yatumye Abayuuda n’Abagiriki benshi biizeera.
Abayuuda batiizeeye boosha abanyamahanga kandi babateeramo umutima mubi wo kugirira naabi abavandimwe.
Nuuko Pawulo na Barinaba bahamara igihe kireekire, biigiisha bashize amanga ku bwa Nyagasani wahamyaga ijambo ry’ubuntu bwe, abaha gukora ibimenyeetso n’ibitangaaza.
Ariko abantu bo muri iyo tawuni nkuru biicamo ibice, bamwe baja ku ruhande rw’Abayuuda, abandi ku rw’intumwa.
Ubwo abanyamahanga, Abayuuda n’abatware baabo baajaga inaama yo kugirira naabi intumwa no kuziteera amabuye,
zirabimenya maze zihungira i Lisitura n’i Derube, amatawuni ya Lukawoniyo, no mu gihugu kihakiikije.
Aho na ho bakomeza kuhaamamariza Inkuru Nziiza.
I Lisitura haari umugabo utaarashoboraga kugenda kuko yari yaravuutse aremaye ibirenge.
Yiicaye aho atega amatwi Pawulo avuga. Pawulo amwitegereje, abona ko afite kwizeera guhaagije kugira ngo akire,
maze avuga mu ijwi riranguruye ati, "Haguruka maze uhagarare wemye." Uwo mugabo arahaguruka, atangira kugenda.
Iyo mbaga y’abantu iboonye ibyo Pawulo akoze, iteera heejuru mu rurimi rw’Urunyalukayoniyoni iti, "Uyu munsi imaana zifite ishusho y’abantu zaatumanukiye!"
Barinaba bamwita Zewusi, naho Pawulo bamwita Herume, kuko ari we wajaga abandi imbere mu kuvuga.
Umuheerezabitambo wa Zewusi, wari ufite ingoro yaayo hirya ya tawuni nkuru gato, azana ibimasa bitaatswe ku irembo, kuko we n’abantu benshi baashaakaga gutuura izo ntumwa igitambo.
Ariko intumwa Pawulo na Barinaba babyumvise, bashishimura imyambaro yaabo nk’ikimenyeetso co guhakanya ico gikorwa maze biirukira muri ba bantu benshi, bateera heejuru bati,

"Nshuti zaacu, kuki mukora ibi? Turi abantu nka mwe, kandi tubaazaniye Ubutumwa Bwiza, ngo mureke ibyo bitabafitiye akamaro nuuko muhindukire Imaana nzima yaremye ijuru n’isi n’inyanja n’ibirimo byose.
Mu bihe byashize Imaana yeemereraga amahanga yoose gukora uko yiishaakiye,

ariko ntiyareka gutanga ibimenyeetso bihamya kugira neeza kwayo, nko kubaha imvura yo mu ijuru no kubaha umusaaruuro mu gihe gikwiriye, ikabaha ibyokurya bihaagije no kuuzuza imitima yaanyu umuneezeero."
Nuubwo izo ntumwa zaavuze aya magambo, ibyo ntibyabujije abantu benshi kubatuura ibitambo.
Ariko haaza Abayuuda bavuuye muri Antiyokiya no muri Ikoniyo maze biigarurira ba bantu benshi caane. Bateera Pawulo amabuye, maze bamukururira inyuma y’itawuni nkuru, biibwira ko yapfuuye.
Ariko abiigiishwa bamukiikije, arahaguruka asubira mu tawuni nkuru. Bukeeye avayo ajaana na Barinaba i Derube.
Pawulo na Barinaba bamaze kubwiriza Ubutumwa Bwiza muri iyo tawuni nkuru ya Derube no kuhabona abiigiishwa benshi, basubira i Lisitura no muri Ikoniyo na Antiyokiya.
Bakomeza imitima y’abiigiishwa kandi babateera umwete wo gukomeza kwizeera bababwira bati, "Ni ngombwa ko tunyura mu gutootezwa, mbere yuuko twinjira mu bwami bw’Imaana."
Bamaze kubatooranyamo abakuru mu buri toorero, basenga biyiriza ubusa, maze babaragiza Umwami Yesu uwo baari biizeeye.
Banyura i Pisidiya bagera i Pamfiliya.
Bamaze kuvuga ijambo ry’Imaana i Periga, baramanuka baja muri Ataliya.
Bavayo bafata ubwato bagaruka Antiyokiya, aho abiizeera baari baarabaragije ubuntu bw’Imaana ku bw’umurimo baari barangije.
Bagezeyo, bakoranya itoorero maze babateekerereza ibyo Imaana yabashoboje gukora byose, n’uko yuugururiye abanyamahanga irembo ryo kwizeera.
Nuuko bamarayo iminsi myinshi n’abizeera.
Nuuko abantu bamwe bava i Yudeeya baaza biigiisha abavandimwe bo muri Antiyokiya bati, "Niiba mudakebwe nk’uko umugenzo wa Moose ubitegeka, ntimubaasha gukizwa."

Nyuma yaaho, Pawulo na Barinaba baja na bo impaka zitooroshe. Nuuko Pawulo na Barinaba hamwe n’abandi muri bo batooranywa kuja i Yerusaalemu kugira ngo bagiishe inaama intumwa n’abakuru b’imiryango kubihereereye ico kibazo co gukebwa.
Nuuko booherezwa n’itoorero, banyura i Foyinike n’i Samariya, bateekerereza abavandimwe ibyo guhinduka kw’Abanyamahanga, maze ibyo bineezeeza abiizeera boose.
Bageze i Yerusaalemu, baakiirwa n’itoorero, n’intumwa, n’abakuru b’imiryango. Nuuko babateekerereza ibyo Imaana yabakoreesheje.
Ariko bamwe mu biizeera bo mu kibiina c’Abafarisaayo barahaguruka baravuga bati, "Ningombwa ko abo banyamahanga bakebwa, kandi bagategekwa kuubahiriza amategeko ya Moose."
Intumwa n’abakuru b’imiryango bateeranira hamwe kugira ngo basuuzume iyo ngoraane.

Bamaze kuja impaka nyinshi, Peetero arahaguruka arababwira ati, "Bavandimwe, muuzi neeza yuuko keera Imaana yantooranyije muri mwe, gutangaaza Ubutumwa Bwiza mu banyamahanga, kugira ngo babwumve kandi beemere.
Kandi Imaana izi imitima y’abantu yarabeemeje, igihe yabahaaye Umwuka Weera, nk’uko naatwe yamuduhaaye.
Ntaabwo yatandukanyije abanyamahanga naatwe, kuko yababariye ibyaha byabo ku bwo biizeeye.
Noone, kuki mugerageza Imaana, mukorera abo biigiishwa umutwaro wo twebwe na ba sogokuruza tutaashoboye kwikorera?
Byongeye kandi, twemera yuuko twakijijwe ku bw’ubuntu bw’Umwami Yesu, nka bo."
Nuuko ikoraniro ryose riraceceka, maze bumviriza Barinaba na Pawulo babateekerereza ibimenyeetso n’ibitangaaza byose Imaana yabakoreesheje mu banyamahanga.
Barangije kuvuga, Yaakobo aravuga ati, "Bavandimwe, nimunyumve.
Simooni abateekerereje uko Imaana yazindukiye abanyamahanga, ikabatooranyamo umuryango waayo.
Ibyo bikaba bihuuye n’ibyavuzwe n’abahanuuzi, nk’uko byanditswe ngo,
‘Haanyuma y’ibyo nzaagaruka, nuubake busha inzu ya Dawudi yasenyutse. Ahaasenyutse nzaahuubaka bundi busha, maze nyihagarike,
kugira ngo abandi bantu boose bashaakashaake Nyagasani, ndetse n’Abanyamahanga biitirirwe izina ryanje. Uwo ni Nyagasani ubivuze, uwahoze atuma ibi bintu
bimenyekana uheereye keera.’
Ni co gituma mpitamo ko tudakwiriye kurusha abo banyamahanga bari kugarukira Imaana,
ahuubwo tubandikire ngo biirinde kurya ibyatuuwe ibigirwamaana n’ubusambanyi, no kurya inyamaaswa zaanizwe, cangwa amaraso.
Erega kuva keera koose, no mu ma tawuni yoose, Moose yari afite abaamamaza ibye, kuko buri Saabato babisomeraga mu masinagoogi."

Itoorero ryose rimaze kwemeranya, intumwa na bakuru b’umuryango biyemeza kwitooranyamo bamwe ngo babatume Antiyokiya hamwe na Pawulo na Barinaba. Abooherejwe ni Yuda wiitwaga Barisaba, na Silaasi, abagabo babiri buubahwa caane mu bavandimwe.
Urwandiko baajanye rwari ruvuga ruti, "Twebwe abavandimwe baanyu, intumwa hamwe n’abakuru b’imiryango, turabaramutsa mwebwe abiizeera bo mu banyamahanga bari Antiyokiya n’i Siriya n’i Silisiya.
Twumviise ko bamwe muri twe, nuubwo tutaari tubatumye, baababwiye amagambo abaca urutege kandi ko byatumye muhagarika imitima,
twemeranyije ko dutooranya abo kuduhagararira tukababatumaho, hamwe n’abo dukunda Barinaba na Pawulo,
baahaze amagara yaabo ku bw’Umwami Yesu Kristo.
Nuuko reero tubatumyeho Yuda na Silaasi, baribuuze kubiibwirira babasobaanurira ibyo tubandikiye.
Umwuka Weera hamwe naatwe, twashimye yuuko tudakwiriye kubiikoreza umutwaro urenze ibi by’ingenzi mukwiriye gukurikiza;
kwirinda kurya inyama zaatuuwe ibigirwamaana n’amaraso, kutarya inyama z’inyamaaswa zaanizwe, hamwe no kwirinda ubusambanyi. Ibyo nimubyirinda, muzaaba mukoze neeza. Nimugire amahoro."
Nuuko abaari baatumwe baragenda bamanukira Antiyokiya. Bamaze gukoranya iteeraniro ry’abiizeera, babaha urwandiko.
Bamaze kurusoma, baneezeezwa n’ubwo butumwa bwo kubakomeza.
Yuda na Silaasi na bo ubwabo baari abahanuuzi, babwira abiizeera byinshi byo kubahuguura no kubakomeza.
Baahamaze iminsi, abiizeera babaseezerera amahoro basubira ku baabatumye.
Ariko Silaasi we ahitamo kugumayo.
Pawulo na Barinaba baguma muri Antiyokiya, bafatanyije n’abandi benshi, biigiisha kandi baamamaza ijambo rya Nyagasani.
Hashize iminsi, Pawulo abwira Barinaba ati, "Reka dusubire gusuura abiizeera bo mu ma tawuni twamamajemo ijambo rya Nyagasani, tureebe uko bahagaze mu kwizeera."
Barinaba ashaaka kujaana na Yohaana wiitwaga Mariko.
Pawulo we ntiyashiima kujaana n’uwari warabateereranye bari i Pamfiliya, ntabafashe umurimo.
Impaka zibaaye nyinshi hagati yaabo, bituma batandukana. Barinaba ajaana na Mariko bafata ubwato beerekeza i Kupuro.
Pawulo we ahitamo Silaasi barajaana. Abiizeera basabira Pawulo kandi bamuragiza ubuntu bwa Nyagasani.
Anyura muri Siriya n’i Silisiya, akomeza amatoorero.
Nuuko Pawulo agera i Derube n’i Lisitura. Haariyo umwizeera wiitwaga Timoteeyo, akaba umwana w’Umuyuudakazi wizeera, ariko se yari Umugiriki.
Yavugwagaho neeza n’abiizeera bo muri i Lisitura hamwe n’Ikoniyo.
Pawulo yashaakaga ko Timoteeyo amuherekeza, maze aramujaana baramukeba kuko Abayuuda baari batuuye muri iyo myanya, baari baazi ko se yari Umugiriki.
Ubwo baavaga mu tawuni baja mu yindi, Pawulo na Silaasi baagezaga kubiizeera ibyemezo byafashwe n’intumwa hamwe n’abakuru b’i Yerusaalemu kandi bakabasaba kubikurikiza.
Bityo reero, amatoorero akomerera mu kwizeera kandi yiiyongera buri munsi.
Pawulo na bagenzi be banyura i Furigiya n’i Galatiya, kuko Umwuka Weera yari yaababujije kuvugira ubutumwa muri Asiya.
Bageze ahateeganye na Misiya, bagerageza kuja Bitiniya, ariko Umwuka wa Yesu ntiwabeemerera.
Nuuko banyura i Misiya, baramanuka baja i Torowadi.
Muri iryo joro, Pawulo arabonekerwa, abona umugabo w’i Makedooniya amuhagaze imbere amwinginga avuga ati, "Ambuka uze i Makedooniya udufashe."
Pawulo akimara kubonekerwa, dutangira gushaaka uko twakwambuka tukaja i Makedooniya, kuko twari tumaze kumenya neeza yuuko Imaana iduhamagarira kwamamaza Inkuru Nziiza mu bantu b’aho.
Dufatira ubwato i Torowadi, tugana Samatirasi, bukeeye tuja Neyapoli,
tuvuuyeyo tuja i Filipi, ari yo tawuni nkuru mu disiturikiti ya mbere ya Makedooniya ahaategekwaga n’Abarooma. Twamaze iminsi muri iyi tawuni nkuru.
Ku munsi w’Isaabato, tuva mu tawuni tugana iruhande rw’uruuzi, ahantu ho twateekerezaga ko bahasengera. Nuuko turiicara maze dutangira kugaaniira n’abagore baari bahateeraniye.

Umugore wiitwaga Lidiya, wari usanzwe asenga Imaana, aratwumva. Yari akomooka mu tawuni nkuru ya Tiyatira kandi yari umucuruuzi w’imyenda y’imihengeri. Nyagasani amuha umutima wo gutega amatwi ibyo Pawulo yavugaga.
Amaze kubatizanywa n’abo mu rugo rwe, atwinginga avuga ati, "Niiba mubona koko ko neemera Nyagasani, nimuuze mucumbike iwanje." Nuuko atwemeza kuja iwe.
Umunsi umwe, ubwo twajaga ahantu basengera, duhuura n’umukoobwa wari umuja utuuwemo na dayimooni yatumaga aragura. Uko kuragura kwe kwatumaga baasheebuja babona inyungu nyinshi caane.
Yakurikiraga Pawulo na twe, maze agateera heejuru avuga ati, "Aba bantu ni abagaragu b’Imaana Isumbabyose, kandi bamamaza inzira y’agakiza."
Yagumaga abikora atyo kumara iminsi myinshi. Ariko Pawulo biramuraakaza, ni ko guhinduka maze abwira ya dayimooni ati, "Mu izina rya Yesu Kristo, ndagutegetse, muvemo." Ako kaanya dayimooni imuvamo.
Baasheebuja baboonye ko ibyiringiro byo gukora inyungu bitagishobotse, bafata Pawulo na Silaasi barabakurura, babajaana mu mwanya mugari imbere y’abacaamanza.
Babagejeje imbere y’abacaamanza, baravuga bati, "Aba bantu ni Abayuuda, barateera umuteekaano muke mu tawuni yaacu.
Baraamamaza imigenzo inyuranyije n’amategeko kandi twe nk’Abarooma tukaba tutayeemera cangwa ngo tuyikurikize."
Rubanda na bo batangira gukubita Pawulo na Silaasi. Abacaamanza babatanyagurizaho imyenda kandi bategeka ko babakubita inkoni.
Bamaze kubakubita birenze urugero, babashira mu gihome kandi bategeka umurinzi kubarinda abyitayeho.
Umurinzi na we mugukurikiza amategeko ahaawe, abashira mu gisenge co hagati maze amaguru yaabo ayabohera ku biti.
Nko mu gicuku, Pawulo na Silaasi bari gusenga no kuririmbira Imaana, abandi basibe bo baarabumvirizaga.
Mu kamwanya hahinda umushitsi mwinshi, isi iratigita maze imfatiro z’igihome ziranyeganyega. Imiryango y’igihome yoose irakinguuka kandi n’injegeri zaari ziboshe abasibe zoose zirashumuruka.
Umurinzi ko yakangutse akabona imiryango y’igihome yuguruwe, akuurayo inkoota kugira ngo yiyice, kuko yiibwiraga ko abasibe baatorotse.
Ariko Pawulo ateera heejuru caane, aramubwira ati, "Uramenye ntiwigirire naabi, kuko twese turi hano."
Nuuko wa murinzi asaba itaara, yiirukira mu nzu vuba, yiikubita imbere ya Pawulo na Barinaba ahinda umushitsi.
Abajaana hanze maze arababaza ati, "Batware, nkwiriye gukora iki kugira ngo nkizwe?"
Baramusubiza bati, "Emera Umwami Yesu, maze wowe n’abo mu rugo rwawe mukizwe."
Bamubwira ijambo rya Nyagasani n’abandi boose baari mu nzu ye.
Muri ico gicuku, ajaana Pawulo na Silaasi maze abooza inguma. Bidatinze, wa murinzi n’umuryango we woose barabatizwa.
Ajaana Pawulo na Silaasi iwe, arabagaburira, maze yiishiimana n’ab’urugo rwe boose kuko yeemeye Imaana.
Bumaze guca, abacaamanza batuma abapoolisi bababwira bati, "Murekure abo bagabo bagende."
Umurinzi w’igihome amenyeesha Pawulo ati, "Abacaamanza boohereje ubutumwa ngo murekurwe, ngaho reero ni musohoke maze mugende amahoro."

Ariko Pawulo aramusubiza ati, "Badukubitiye imbere y’abantu nta rubanza rwadutsinze, badushira no mu gihome kandi turi Abarooma, noone barashaaka kuturekura rwihishwa? Oya ntibishoboka! Nibiiyizire ubwabo abe aribo baturekura."
Abapoolisi na bo babwira abacaamanza ibyo Pawulo avuze, nuuko baratiinya bamaze kumva yuuko ari Abarooma,
baraaza babasaba imbabazi. Barabasohora maze babasaba kuva muri iyo tawuni.
Bamaze kuva mu gihome baja kwa Lidiya, babonanirayo n’abavandimwe barabakomeza, maze baragenda.
Pawulo na Silaasi bamaze kunyura Amfipoli na Apoloniya, bagera i Teesalonike, ahaari isinagoogi y’Abayuuda.
Pawulo yinjira mu sinagoogi nk’uko yari abimenyereye, nuuko amara amasaabato atatu aja na bo impaka, akurikije ibyanditswe.
Yasobaanuraga ibyanditswe kandi akeerekana ko Kristo yari akwiriye kubabazwa no kuzuuka mu baapfuuye ati, "Uyu Yesu naamamaza, ni we Kristo."
Bamwe muri bo barabyemera maze biifatanya na Pawulo na Silaasi. Abagiriki buubaha Imaana n’abagore b’icuubahiro benshi na bo babiiyungaho.

Ariko Abayuuda bagira ishari, bafatanya n’imihiri bavanye mu mayira biikoramo igiteero maze batangira guteera agasasamaro mu tawuni nkuru. Ubwo baahiigaga Pawulo na Barinaba ngo babajaane imbere y’abantu, bateera inzu ya Yasooni ngo babakuuremo.
Babuze Pawulo na Silaasi, bakurubana Yasooni n’abiizeera bamwe babajaanira abategetsi b’i tawuni nkuru bateera induuru, bavuga bati, "Aba bantu buubitse igihugu coose baaje na hano,
kandi Yasooni yabaakiiriye iwe nk’abashitsi. Aba boose baagomeye amategeko ya Kayisaari, bavuga yuuko hariho undi mwami wiitwa Yesu."
Abatware b’itawuni nkuru hamwe na rubanda babyumvise bibateesha umutwe.
Yasooni hamwe n’abandi bamaze kubiishingira, barabarekura barataaha.
Iryo joro, abiizeera boohereza Pawulo na Silaasi i Beroya. Bagezeyo baja mu isinagoogi y’Abayuuda.
Aba Bayuuda bo baabaakiiranye ineeza kuruta ab’i Teesalonike, kuko bo baakiiriye ubutumwa n’umutima mwiza kandi buri munsi bagasoma ibyanditswe kugira ngo bareebe niiba ari ko bimeze.
Nuuko benshi bareemera, kandi muri bo haarimo Abagirikikazi b’abanyacuubahiro hamwe n’abagabo b’Abagiriki benshi.
Ariko Abayuuda b’i Teesalonike bumviise ko Pawulo yaamamaje ijambo ry’Imaana n’i Beroya, naho bajayo ngo bateere agasasamaro muri rubanda.
Abiizeera baheerako boohereza Pawulo ku nyanja, naho Silaasi na Timoteeyo baguma aho ngaaho.
Abaari baherekeje Pawulo bamugeza Atenaayi. Amaze kubategeka kujaanira Silaasi na Timoteeyo ubutumwa bubasaba kumwiyungaho bidatinze, bamusiga aho.
Igihe Pawulo yari Atenaayi ategereje Silaasi na Timoteeyo, ababazwa no kureeba itawuni nkuru yuuzuye ibigirwamaana.
Ku bw’iyo mpamvu, buri munsi yajaga mu sinagoogi akaja impaka n’Abayuuda n’Abanyamahanga baramya Imaana, akaja no mu iguriro akaja impaka n’abantu baahanyuraga.

Kandi bamwe mu banyabwenge biitwaga Abeepikureyo n’abandi biitwaga Abasitoyiki na bo batangira kuja impaka na we. Bamwe bakavuga bati, "Iyi ndondogozi irashaaka kuvuga iki?" Abandi bakavuga bati, "Ashobora kuba ari umwigiisha w’imaana z’inyamahanga." Baabiteekerezaga batyo kuko yaamamazaga inkuru nziiza ya Yesu n’izuuka rye.
Nuuko bamujaana mu rukiiko rwabo rwitwa Areyopago, maze baramubaza bati, "Dushobora kumenya iby’iyi nyigiisho nsha waamamaza?
Ibyo utubwira turabona bidasanzwe, noone turashaaka ngo ubidusobaanurire tubimenye."
Koko reero, Abanyatenaayi n’Abanyamahanga bahatuuye, ntaakindi baakoraga keretse kuvuga cangwa kumva ibisha.
Nuuko Pawulo ahagarara imbere y’urukiiko rwa Areyopago maze arababwira ati, "Bantu ba Atenaayi, ndabona ko muri abanyadiini birenze urugero.

Kuko ubwo nanyuraga mu tawuni, nagiiye niitegereza amashusho yo muramya, nuuko muri yo mbonamo igicaaniro canditsweho ngo, ‘Ku maana itaazwi.’ Iki kimenyeesha ko muramya imaana mutaazi, noone reero iyo Maana musenga mutayizi ni yo naaje kubamenyeesha.
N’Imaana yaremye isi n’ibiyirimo byose, ni yo mugenga w’ijuru n’isi, kandi ntaabwo iba mu ngoro zuubatswe n’abantu,
cangwa ngo ifashwe n’amaboko y’abantu nk’aho hari ico ikennye, kuko ni yo iha ibiremwa byose ubugingo no guhuumeeka n’ibindi byose.
Yaremye amahanga yoose akomooka ku muntu umwe, Iyakwiza ku isi. Ni na yo yashizeho ibihe byo kubaho ndetse n’imbibi z’aho abantu bakwiriye gutuura.
Imaana yakoze ibyo kugira ngo bayishaakashaake bafite ibyiringiro byo kuyibona, nuubwo Itari kure ya buri umwe muri twe,
nk’uko, byanditswe ngo, ‘Ni yo dukeesha ubugingo bwacu, kwidagadura no kuba ico turi co.’ Ni na ko bamwe mu basizi baanyu baavuze bati, ‘Natwe turi abaana baayo.’

Ubwo reero dukomooka ku Maana, ntidukwiriye guteekereza yuuko kamere y’Imaana imeze nk’ibishushaanyo bikozwe mu izaahabu, cangwa ifeeza, cangwa amabuye, cangwa mu kindi gikomooka mu bukorikori n’ubuhanga bw’abantu.
Nuubwo Imaana yiirengagije ibyo bihe by’ubujiji bw’abantu, ubu nooneho reero irategeka abantu boose iyo bava bakagera ngo biihane,
kuko yashizeho umunsi izaaciira isi urubanza rutabeera ikoreesheje umuntu yatooranyije, kandi yabyemeje ubwo yamuzuuye mu baapfuuye."
Bumviise ibyo kuzuuka kw’abaapfuuye, bamwe bamuha urw’ameenyo, ariko abandi baravuga bati, "Tuzongera kumva ibifashe kuri ibi ikindi gihe."
Nuuko Pawulo abavamo.
Ariko bamwe muri bo biifatanya na we bariizeera, baarimo Diyoniziyo wo mu ba Areyopago n’umugore wiitwaga Damari, n’abandi.
Nyuma y’ibyo, Pawulo ava Atenaayi aja i Korinto.

Ahasanga Umuyuuda wiitwaga Akwila, ukomooka i Ponto, wari umaze igihe gito avuye Italiyani n’umugore we Purisikila, kuko Kilawudiyo yari amaze gutegeka ko Abayuuda boose bava i Rooma. Nuuko Pawulo aja kubasuura,
kuko boose baari abubatsi b’amahema, Pawulo abaana na bo bakora hamwe.
Buri Isaabato, yajaga mu isinagoogi akaja impaka agerageza kwemeza Abayuuda hamwe n’Abagiriki.
Ubwo Silaasi na Timoteeyo bahageze bavuuye i Makedooniya, Pawulo agira umwete wo kuvuga ubutumwa ahamiriza Abayuuda ko Kristo ari Yesu.
Igihe baamuhankanyaga no kumusebya, we yabakunkumuriragaho umucucu wo mu myambaro ye akababwira ati, "Amaraso yaanyu azaababarweho! Nje ndi umwere. Uheereye ubu, mfashe inzira ngiye mu banyamahanga."
Nuuko Pawulo ava kuri iyo sinagoogi aja kuba n’umugabo wiitwa Titiyo Yusitusi, wuubahaga Imaana, inzu ye yari ituuranye n’isinagoogi y’Abayuuda.
Kurisipasi wari umuyobozi w’isinagoogi n’abiiwe boose baba abayoboke biizeera Nyagasani, kandi n’abandi Banyakorinto benshi bumvaga ibyo Pawulo yiigiishaga baariizeeraga bakabatizwa.
Ijoro rimwe, Nyagasani abonekera Pawulo mu nzozi, ati, "wiitiinya, ahuubwo uvuge weguceceka,
kuko ndi kumwe na we, ntaawe uzaguhangaara ngo akugirire naabi, kuko abantu benshi muri iyi tawuni ni abanje."
Pawulo abayo kumara umwaka n’igice ari kubiigiisha ijambo ry’Imaana.
Ariko mu gihe Galiyo yari umutware muri Akaya, Abayuuda baarifatanyije bafata Pawulo bamujaana imbere y’ubucaamanza.
Baramurega bati, "Uyu mugabo yoosha abantu kuramya Imaana mu buryo bunyuranye n’amategeko."
Pawulo agiiye kugira ico avuga, Galiyo abwira Abayuuda ati, "Iyo kija kuba igikorwa kinyuranye n’amategeko gikomeye cangwa ubugome, mba naakwemera nkumva ibyo mumurega,
ariko ubwo ari ibibazo byerekeye amagambo n’amazina hamwe n’amategeko yaanyu, nimubyimarire. Sinshaaka guca urubanza rw’ibyo."
Nuuko abiirukana mu rukiiko.
Haanyuma boose bafata Sositeni, umuyobozi w’isinagoogi bamukubitira imbere y’urukiiko. Galiyo we ntihagira ico abyitaho.
Pawulo amaze igihe ari na bo, aseezera ku bavandimwe afata ubwato aja muri Siliya. Purisikila na Akwila baramuherekeza. Ageze Kenkireya abanza kwiyogoshesha, kuko yari yararahiye indahiro .
Bageze muri Efeeso, Pawulo asiga bagenzi be aho, abanza kuja mu sinagoogi agirirayo ibiganiiro n’Abayuuda.
Baamusabye kuhamara igihe kireekire na bo, arabangira,
ahuubwo abaseezeraho ababwira ati, " Nzaagaruka Imaana niibishaaka." Afata ubwato ava Efeeso.
Ageze i Kayisaariya, arazaamuka aja i Yerusaalemu kuramutsa ab’Itoorero, haanyuma aja Antiyokiya.
Amazeyo igihe kireekire, avayo anyura mu myanya itari imwe n’imwe mu gice c’i Galatiya na Furugiya abwira abiizeera amagambo yo kubakomeza.
Umuyuuda ukomooka Alekizanduriya wiitwa Apolo agera Efeeso. Yari umugabo uzi kuvuga kandi azi neeza ibyanditswe byera.
Yari yariigiishijwe Inzira ya Nyagasani, afite umwete kandi akiigiisha neeza ibyerekeye Yesu uko biri, n’ubwo we yari azi umubatizo wa Yohaana wonyine.
Atangira kuvugira mu masinagoogi ashize amanga, maze Purisikila na Akwila bamwumvise bamujaana iruhande bamusobaanurira neeza Inzira y’Imaana nyaayo.

Haanyuma Apolo ashaatse kwambuka ngo aje Akaya, abavandimwe bamubwira amagambo amukomeza nuuko bandikira abiizeera babasaba kumwakiira neeza. Agezeyo, afasha caane abaari baarabaaye abiizeera ku bw’ubuntu bw’Imaana.
Kuko yahakanyaga Abayuuda n’imbaraga muruhame, abahamiriza mu byanditswe byera ko Yesu ari we Kristo.
Igihe Apolo yari i Korinto, Pawulo yanyuze mu bihugu byo hagati agera Efeeso, aho yasanze bamwe mu biigiishwa.
Arababaza ati, "Mbese mwakiiriye Umwuka Weera igihe mwizeeraga?" Baramusubiza bati, "Oya, habe no kumenya ko hariho Umwuka Weera!"
Pawulo ni ko kubabaza ati, "Mwabatijwe mubatizo ki?" Baramusubiza bati, "Twabatijwe umubatizo Yohaana yiigiishaga."
Pawulo ati, "Yohaana yabatizaga umubatizo wo kwihana, agasaba abantu kwemera uwari ugiiye kuuza nyuma ye, ari we Yesu."
Bamaze kumva ibyo, babatizwa mu izina ry’Umwami Yesu.
Pawulo amaze kubarambikaho ibiganza, Umwuka Weera abaazaho, bavuga mu ndimi zitandukanye kandi barahanuura.
Boose hamwe baari nk’abantu cumi na babiri.
Pawulo yinjira mu isinagoogi y’Abayuuda, kandi akomeza kujayo kumara ameezi atatu, avuga ashize amanga, aja impaka n’abantu abeemeza ibyerekeye Ubwami bw’Imaana.

Ubwo bamwe muri bo biinangiye umutima bakanga kwizeera, bakavuga naabi Inzira ya Nyagasani imbere y’abantu, abavamo. Ahitamo kujaana n’abiizeera akaja abiigiishiriza buri munsi mu gisenge kinini co Tirano yiigiishirizagamo.
Ibi byakomejemo kumara imyaka ebyiri ari kwigiisha, maze ijambo rya Nyagasani rimenywa mu Bayuuda no mu Bagiriki batuuye muri Asiya.
Imaana ikora ibitangaaza bikomeye, inyuze muri Pawulo,
ku buryo ubutambaaro n’itaburiya byabaga bikoze ku mubiri we, byakozwaga ku barwayi, bagakira, kandi n’abadayimooni bakabavamo.
Nuuko Abayuuda bamwe baazereeraga mu bihugu bagerageza kwirukana imyuka mibi mu izina rya Yesu muri abo bateewe na yo, bakavuga bati, "Ndabiirukanye mu izina rya Yesu uwo Pawulo yaamamaza."
Abahungu barindwi ba Sikewa, wari Umuheerezabitambo mukuru ni bo baabikoraga.
Maze wa mwuka mubi urabasubiza uti, "Yesu ndamuuzi, na Pawulo ndamuuzi, noone mwe muri ba nde?"
Bityo uwo muntu uteewe na dayimooni arabasimbukira boose, abarusha imbaraga arabaneesha abagirira naabi kugeza ubwo bavuuye mu nzu biiruka bahungira hanze bambaye ubusa kandi bafite ibikomere.
Ibyo bimenyekanye mubatuuye Efeeso boose, hari Abayuuda n’Abagiriki bagira ubwoba, nuuko izina ry’Umwami Yesu rirasingizwa.
Abenshi mu baari bamaze kwemera, baatura kumugaragaro ibyaha byabo n’imigenzo baakoraga.
Abenshi baakoraga iby’ubukonikoni bakungaanya ibitabo byabo babitwikira mu ruhame. Babaze ibiciiro byabyo basanga bingana ibiceri by’ifeeza ibihumbi mirongo itaanu.
Nuuko ijambo ry’Imaana rikomeza gushinga imizi ihamye no kwamamara.
Nyuma y’ibyo, Pawulo yiigiira inaamayo kunyura i Makedooniya no muri Akaya akaja i Yerusaalemu. Aravuga ati, "Niimara kujayo, nkwiriye no kugera i Rooma."
Atuma muri Makedooniya babiri mu bafasha be, ari bo Timoteeyo na Erasito, ubwo we asigara muri Asiya amarayo umwanya.
Ico gihe, habaho imidugararo myinshi mu Efeeso ishingiye ku Nzira ya Nyagasani.
Umugabo wiitwa Demetiriyo wacuraga udushushanyo tw’ifeeza tw’ingoro y’ikigirwamaanakazi Aritemi, we n’abakozi be bungukiraga byinshi muri uwo mwuga.
Abo abakungaanyiriza hamwe n’abandi baakoraga uwo mwuga, arababwira ati, "Mwa bagabo mwe, muzi yuuko inyungu zaacu ziva muri ubu bucuruuzi.
Mumaze no kumenya ko atari mu Efeeso honyine, ahuubwo no muri Asiya hoose, uwo Pawulo amaze koosha rubanda rwose, ababwira ko imaana zaaremwe n’abantu atari imaana nyakuri.

Akaaga si uko ubucuruuzi bwacu bwagwa byonyine, ahuubwo n’uko ingoro y’imaanakazi yaacu ikomeye Aritemi yaasuuzugurika. Kandi n’imaanakazi yaacu igata agaciiro kandi ari yo isengwa n’abanya Asiya ndetse n’abantu b’isi yoose."
Babyumvise, bagira umujinya mwinshi, batangira guteera heejuru bati, "Aritemi y’Abanyefeeso irakomeye!"
Itawuni yoose yuuzuramo akajagaari, abantu batangira kwirukira mu nzu beerekaniramo imikino, bakururamo Gaayo na Arisitariko Abanyamasedoniya baagendanaga na Pawulo.
Pawulo na we yashaakaga kuja kwiroha muri abo bantu, ariko abiizeera ntibaamukundira.
Ndetse bamwe mu bategetsi bo muri Asiya baari inshuti ze bamwoherereza ubutumwa bamusaba kudahinguka muri uwo mwanya abantu baari bateeraniyemo.
Bamwe baasakuzaga bavuga ikintu kimwe abandi bakavuga ikindi, kuko iryo teeraniro ryose ryari mu rujijo. Abenshi muri bo nti baari baazi igitumye bateerana.

Bamwe muri rubanda bakeeka ko Alekizanda uwo Abayuuda baari basunikiye imbere y’iteeraniro ariwe nyirabayaazana. Nuuko Alekizanda ashira heejuru ukuboko kugira ngo baceceke, agerageza gusobaanurira abantu.
Ariko abantu bamaze kumenya ko ari Umuyuuda, bamara amasaaha abiri bateera heejuru bayombera icaarimwe bati, "Aritemi y’Abanyefeeso irakomeye!"

Umutegetsi w’itawuni acecekeesha abantu, arababwira ati, "Yemwe bantu bo muri Efeeso, n’inde muri mwe utaazi ko itawuni y’Abefeeso ari yo murinzi w’ingoro ya Aritemi ukomeye kandi ko igishushanyo ce caamanutse mu ijuru?
Ubwo reero ari nta waahakana ibi, mugomba gutuuza mukareka guhubuka.
Muzanye aha aba bantu batari abajuura bo mu ngoro cangwa abasebya imaana yaacu .
Noone reero niiba Demetiriyo n’abacuzi bafite uwo barega, inkiiko zirahari kandi n’abacaamanza nti babuze, ni babigaragaze baburane.
Niiba hari ikindi mushaaka kumenya, kizaatunganyirizwa mu rukiiko rusanzwe.
Ubu turi mu kaaga ko kuregwa ku bw’iyi myigaragambyo, kuko ari nta mpamvu twagaragaza yatumye dukora ibi."
Amaze kuvuga atyo, aseezera rubanda.
Imidugararo irangiye, Pawulo atumaho abiizeerwa, amaze kubabwira amagambo yo kubakomeza no kubaseezeraho, aja i Makedooniya.
Amaze kunyura muri ibyo bice no kubwira abiizeera amagambo yo kubakomeza, aja i Bugiriki
aho yamaze ameezi atatu. Igihe yashaatse gufata ubwato ngo aje muri Siriya, ni bwo yamenye ko Abayuuda bafite imigambi yo kumwica, nuuko ahitamo gusubirayo anyuze i Makedooniya.
Muri urwo rugendo, yari aherekejwe na Sopatero mwene Puro uva i Beroya, Arisitariko, Sekundo uva i Teesalonike, Gaayo uva i Derubi, Timoteeyo hamwe na Tukiko na Turofimo uva muri Asiya.
Baatubanjirije imbere, badutegerereza i Tiirowa.
Ariko twe dufata ubwato tuva i Filipi nyuma y’iminsi mikuru y’Imigaati Idasembuwe kandi mu minsi itaanu tubasanga i Tiirowa aho twacumbitse kumara iminsi irindwi.
Ku munsi wa mbere w’icumweru, ubwo twateeraniye hamwe ngo dusangire umugaati, Pawulo yari akigaaniira n’abiizeera kugeza mu gicuku kuko yari bugende bukeeye.
Mu gisenge co heejuru aho twari duteeraniye haari amataara menshi.

Umusore wiitwa Ewutiko yari yiicaye mu dirisa maze afatwa n’ibitotsi. Pawulo akomeza kugaanira. Ewutiko aganzwa n’ibitotsi maze amanuka ku gorofa ya gatatu yituura haasi, basanga amaze gupfa nuuko baramuterura.
Pawulo aramanuka, amwubarara heejuru, amufata amaboko maze aravuga ati, "Nti mugire ubwoba, ni muzima."
Birangiye, Pawulo asubira mu gisenge co heejuru. Amanyura umugaati ararya nuuko akomeza kubagaaniirira kugeza mu gitondo, aragenda.
Nuuko uwo musore bamujaana mu rugo ari muzima bibasubizamo imbaraga caane.
Twebwe dufata ubwato tugenda mbere twerekeza ahiitwa Aso, aho twari dukwiriye guhuurira na Pawulo. We yari yagennye kujayo anyuze inzira y’ubutaka.
Adusanze Aso, tumushira mu bwato, tuja i Mituleene.
Bukeeye, tuja mu bwato tugera ahateeganye n’i Kiyo. Umunsi ukurikiraho turambuka tugera i Samo, maze bukeeye bwaho tugera i Mileto.
Pawulo yari yagennye gukomezamo n’ubwato atanyuze Efeeso kugira ngo adatinda muri Asiya. Yari afite ubwira bwo kugera i Yerusaalemu, bishobotse ku munsi wa Pentekooti.
Ari i Mileto, Pawulo yoohereza ubutumwa muri Efeeso asaba kugira urukiiko n’abakuru itooreero.
Baaje, arababwira ati, "Mwe ubwanyu muuzi uko nabanye namwe igihe coose kuva naagera muri Asiya,
nkorera Uhoraho niiciishije bugufi, ndira, niihangaanira ibigeragezo biteewe n’imigambi mibi y’Abayuuda.
Ntaaco niigeze nsiga inyuma mu byo nari nkwiriye kubabwira byabagirira akamaro, mu kubwiriza ubutumwa no kubiigiisha rwatu, mva ku nzu nja ku yindi,
ntanga ubuhamya mu Bayuuda no mu Bagiriki bwo kwihanira Imaana no kwizeera Umwami waacu Yesu.
Noone ubu ngiiye i Yerusaalemu mbibwirijwe n’Umwuka , sinzi ibizambaho ngezeyo,
uretse ko Umwuka Weera agenda anyemeza muri buri tawuni yuuko gufungwa no gutootezwa bintegereje.

Ariko ku bwanje, siniita ku bugingo ngo niibwire ko ari ubw’agaciiro kuri nje. Ica ngombwa ni ukurangiza urugendo rwanje n’ubuheereza nahaawe na Yesu Kristo, bwo guhamya Ubutumwa Bwiza bw’ubuntu bw’Imaana.
Kandi ubu nzi neeza ko muri mwese abo nanyuzemo naamamaza Ubutumwa bw’ubwami bw’Imaana mutazongera kumbona ukundi.
Ni co gituma mbahamiriza uyu munsi ko amaraso yaanyu mwese atazambarwaho,
kuko ntiigeze mbahisha imigambi yoose y’Imaana.
Mwirinde ubwanyu, kandi murinde n’umukumbi woose mwaragijwe n’Umwuka Weera kandi muragire itoreero ry’Imaana yacunguje amaraso y’Umwana waayo.
Nzi yuuko niimara kugenda, imisega ifite ubukana izaabaazamo, ntiibabarire umukumbi w’Imaana.
Kandi bamwe bo muri mwe bazaagoreka ukuri kugira ngo baryosharyoshe abiizeera ngo babakurikire.
Mube maaso reero, mwibuke ko imyaka itatu namaze ntiigeze gutuuza kwigiisha buri umwe ijoro n’amanywa kandi ndira.
Ubu reero mbaragije Imaana n’ijambo ry’ubuntu bwayo, ari ryo rishobora kubuubaka no kubaha umurage w’imigisha n’abo beejejwe boose.
Ntaakintu c’umuntu weese niigeze ndarikira, ari ifeeza cangwa izaahabu cangwa imyambaro.
Murabiizi namwe ubwanyu ko nakoreeshaga amaboko yanje gushaakiisha uko naabaho na bagenzi banje.
Muri byose nababeereye intangarugero, mbeereka ko mu mirimo nk’iyo twafasha abatiishoboye, twibuka amagambo y’Umwami Yesu yavuze ati, ‘Gutanga biheesha umugisha, kuruta kwakiira.’ "
Arangije kuvuga ibyo, apfukama na bo boose, arasenga.
Boose bararira caane, baramuhoobera kandi baramusoma,
na caane baagize agahinda ku bwo ibyo yari amaze kuvuga ko batazongera kumubona. Nuuko baramuherekeza bamugeza ku bwato.
Tumaze gutandukana na bo tuja mu bwato. Dukomerezamo kimwe tuja i Kosi. Umunsi ukurikiyeho, tuja i Roode, tuvuuyeyo tuja i Patara.
Tuhasanze ubwato bwendaga kuja i Fenikiya, tubujamo buratujaana.
Tubona i Kupuro, tuhasiga ibumoso bwacu tugana i Siriya duhagarara i Tiiro, kuko ari ho bagombaga gupakururira imitwaro yari mu bwato.
Twashaatse abiizeera turababona maze tuhamara na bo iminsi indwi. Abo biigiishwa bayobowe n’Umwuka Weera babuza Pawulo gukomezamo urugendo rwo kuja i Yerusaalemu.

Iyo minsi yo kubaana na bo ishize, turahava dukomezamo urugendo. Nuuko boose n’abagore baabo hamwe n’abaana baraduherekeza batugeza haakurya y’i tawuni nkuru. Dupfukama aho ku nkengeero y’inyanja turasenga,
haanyuma duseezeranaho. Duheerako twinjira mu bwato naho bo basubira iwaabo.
Turangije urugendo rwo kuva i Tiiro, tugera i Putolemayi turamukanya n’abiizeera twahasanze maze ducumbikayo kumara umunsi umwe.
Bukeeye tuvayo tugera i Kayisaariya, maze tuja mu rugo rwa Filipo umwe mu bavugabutumwa barindwi, nuuko ducumbikayo.
Yari afite abakobwa bane ba baari, baari bafite impaano yo guhanuura.
Tuhamaze iminsi, haaza umuhanuuzi wiitwaga Agabo avuuye i Yudeeya.

Ageze aho turi afata umukenyezo wa Pawulo, awibohesha ibirenge n’amaboko, maze aravuga ati, "Umwuka Weera aravuga ati, ‘Uku ni ko Abayuuda bazaaboha nyir’uyu mukenyezo nuuko bamushikirize abanyamahanga.’ "
Tubyumvise, twe hamwe n’abantu baari aho tubuza Pawulo kuja i Yerusaalemu.
Maze Pawulo arasubiza ati, "Ikibateera kurira no kunshengura umutima n’iki? Kuko siniiteeguye kubohwa gusa, ahuubwo no gupfiira i Yerusaalemu nzira izina ry’Umwami Yesu."
Tuboonye ko Pawulo amaramaje kugenda kandi ko tutagishoboye kumuhendahenda, turamwihorera tugira tuti, "Bibe uko Nyagasani ashaaka."
Nyuma y’iyo minsi duteguura ibyacu, dutangira urugendo tugana i Yerusaalemu.
Bamwe mu biizeera bava i Kayisaariya na bo baazana naatwe batujaana kwa Munasoni w’i Kupuro wari umwizeera kuva kare, aho twagombaga gucumbika.
Tugeze i Yerusaalemu, abavandimwe batwakiira n’urugwiro.
Bukeeye tujaana na Pawulo gusuura Yaakobo, kandi bakuru b’imiryango boose baari bahari.
Pawulo arabaramutsa, arangije atangira kubateekerereza byose Imaana yamushoboje gukorera mu banyamahanga mu buheereza bwe ari nta co asiga inyuma.
Babyumviise, bahimbaaza Imaana. Baramubwira bati, "Muvandimwe, urabona ko Abayuuda benshi bamaze kuba abiizeera, kandi koboose bafite umwete wo kuzirikana amategeko.
Baamaze kumva ibigufasheho, ko wiigiisha Abayuuda batuuye mu banyamahanga kureka gukurikiza amategeko ya Moose, ngo begukeba abaana baabo, no kudakurikiza n’indi migenzo yoose y’Abayuuda.
Noone tugire dute? Ko byaja kubageraho ko waaje.
Ubu reero ugiiye gukurikiza ibyo turibukubwire. Dore dufite abagabo bane baahize umuhigo.

Biiyungeho, unyure mu muhango wo kwezwa hamwe na bo, kandi wiishurire koogosha imisatsi yaabo. Nuuko boose bamenye ko ibyo baakumviiseho bidafite ishingiro kandi ko naawe ubwawe wuubahiriza kandi ugakurikiza amategeko.

Ariko ku banyamahanga baamaze kuba abiizeera, twohereje urwandiko rwerekana iceemezo caacu, ko bakwiriye kwirinda kurya ibituuwe ibigirwamaana, kurya amaraso no kurya inyamaaswa zinizwe, hamwe no kwirinda ubusambanyi."
Nuuko Pawulo ajaana abo bagabo, umunsi ukurikiyeho amaze kwiyeza, yinjirana na bo mu Nzu y’Imaana kumenyeesha igihe iminsi yo kwezwa izaashirira, ari bwo igitambo ca buri weese kizatambirwaho.
Iminsi indwi iri bugufi kurangira, Abayuuda baturuka Asiya baari baaboonye Pawulo mu Nzu y’Imaana babyutsa agasasamaro muri rubanda. Baramufata,

bateera heejuru bavuga bati, "Yemwe b’Isirayeli mwe, ni mudutabaare! Uyu ni wa mugabo ugenda yiigiisha hoose abantu boose arwanya abantu baacu, amategeko yaacu n’uyu mwanya. Uretse n’ibyo, dore yazanye n’Abagiriki mu Nzu y’Imaana, guhumaanya aha hantu heera."
Ibi baabivuze kuko baari baaboonye Tiirofimo Umunyefeeso ari hamwe na Pawulo mu tawuni nkuru nuuko biibwira ko yamuzanye mu Nzu y’Imaana.
Haba agasasamaro mu tawuni nkuru hoose, maze abantu biirukankira gukoranira hamwe. Bafata Pawulo bamukurubana bamuvaana mu Nzu y’Imaana, ako kaanya inzuugi barazikinga.
Bakigerageza kumwica, inkuru igera ku mutware w’ingabo z’abasirikare yuuko hari imidugararo i Yerusaalemu hoose.
Ako kaanya ajaana abasirikare n’abatware baabo bariiruka bagana aho ico giteero c’abantu kiri. Abo bantu baboonye Abasirikare n’abatware baabo, barekeraho gukubita Pawulo.
Umutware w’abasirikare araaza afata Pawulo, maze ategeka ko bamuboheesha injegeri ebyiri. Arangije abaza abantu uwo ari we n’ico bamuryoza.
Bamwe muri rubanda bateera heejuru bamusubiza kimwe abandi ikindi nuuko ntihaagira ico yumva ku bw’urusaku rw’abantu, ni ko gutegeka ko bajaana Pawulo mu kigo c’abasirikare.
Pawulo ageze ku madaara, abantu baari buuzuye uburaakari bituma abasirikare bamuterura.
Rubanda baari babakurikiye bateeraga heejuru bavuga bati, "Ni mumwice!"
Bari haafi kugeza Pawulo mu kigo c’abasirikare, abwira umutware waabo ati, "Mbese ngire ico nkubwira?" Umutware w’abasirikare aramubaza ati, "Uzi Urugiriki?
Noone ntaabwo uri wa Munya Igiputi uheruutse kuyobora agatsiko k’abicanyi ibihumbi bine kuja mu butaayu?"
Pawulo aramusubiza ati, "Ndi Umuyuuda, uva i Taruso y’i Silisiya, umutuurage w’itawuni nkuru ikomeye, ndakwinginze, mpa ijambo hagire ico mbwira aba bantu."
Amwemereye kuvuga, Pawulo ahagarara ku madaara areeba abantu, arambuura ukuboko ngo baceceke. Bamaze guceceka, avugana na bo mu Ruheburayo.
Pawulo atangira avuga ati, "Bavandimwe kandi babyeyi, nimwumve uko niireguura imbere yaanyu."
Bumviise avugana na bo mu Ruheburayo , bacecekera kimwe. Nuuko akomeza kuvuga ati,

"Ndi Umuyuuda, ukomooka i Taruso y’i Silisiya, ariko nakuriye muri iyi tawuni niigiishwa na Gamaliyeli, ntoozwa gukurikiza amategeko ya ba sogokuruza yoose, mfite umwete wo gukorera Imaana, nk’uko namwe mumeze uyu munsi.
Narenganyije abiizeera Kristo kugeza ku gupfa kandi mboha abagore n’abagabo, mbashira no mu gihome.

Abaheerezabitambo bakuru n’abakuru b’urukiiko boose baabibahamiriza kuko ari bo bampaaye inzandiko zandikiwe abavandimwe b’i Damasiko, nuuko njayo kugira ngo mbohe abo baariyo mbaazane i Yerusaalemu bahanwe.
Igihe nari nkiri mu nzira ndi haafi kugera i Damasiko, kumanywa nka saaha itandatu haaza umuco w’imbaraga uturutse mu ijuru urangota.
Niikubita haasi maze numva ijwi rimbwira riti, ‘Sawuli, Sawuli, ni kuki untooteza?’
Ndasubiza nti, ‘Uri nde, Nyagasani?’ Aransubiza ati, ‘Ndi Yesu w’i Nazaareeti uwo utooteza.’
Abaari hamwe nanje babona uwo muco ariko ntibumva ijwi ry’uwavuganaga nanje.
Ndamubaza nti, ‘Nkore iki Nyagasani?’ Aransubiza ati, ‘Haguruka uje i Damasiko, ni ho uzaabwirwa ibyo ugenewe gukora.’
Kuko uwo muco mwinshi wari wampumishije amaaso, abaari hamwe nanje barandandata bangeza i Damasiko.
Umugabo wiitwaga Ananiya, wuubahaga Imaana nk’uko amategeko abisaba kandi agashimwa n’Abayuuda boose baari bahatuuye,
aza aho ndi, ampagarara iruhande, maze aravuga ati, ‘Mwene daata Sawuli, ongera ureebe!’ Ako kaanya ndahumuuka maze ndamureeba.
Nuuko arambwira ati, ‘Imaana ya ba sogokuruza yagutooranyije kugira ngo umenye ubushaake bwayo, no kubona Intungaane yaayo kandi ngo wiiyumvire ijwi ryayo,
kuko uzaayibeera umuhamya mu isi yoose w’ibyo wumviise n’ibyo waboonye.
Noone se kandi utegereje iki? Haguruka, wambaze izina rya Nyagasani, ubatizwe, kandi uhanagurweho ibyaha byawe.’
Maze gusubira i Yerusaalemu, ndi mu Nzu y’Imaana nsenga, mera nk’uroota
nuuko mbona Yesu, ambwira ati, ‘Tebuuka uve i Yerusaalemu vuba, kuko batazeemera ubuhamya untangaho.’
Nanje ndavuga nti, ‘Nyagasani, bo ubwabo baazi ko najaga mu masinagoogi yoose mpfunga kandi nkubita abakwizeera.
Ndetse n’igihe amaraso y’umuhamya waawe Sitefaano amenwa, nari mpahagaze, nshigikira ico gikorwa, ndetse ndinda imyambaro y’abamwishe.’
Nyagasani aransubiza ati, ‘Genda, kuko nzaagutuma kure mu banyamahanga.’ "
Kugeza ubu abantu baari baakomeje gutega amatwi Pawulo, nuuko bateera induuru bati, "Uwo ni akurwe ku isi! Umuntu nk’uwo ntaabwo akwiriye kubaho."
Mu guteera induuru, baateereraga imyambaro yaabo heejuru, bagatuumuurira umucuucu mu kireere.
Umutware w’abasirikare ategeka ko bamujaana mu kigo c’abasirikare nuuko abategeka kumutata bamukubita, kugira ngo bamenye impamvu nyaayo iteera rubanda kumuteerera induuru.
Ariko bamaze kumuboheesha imigozi, Pawulo abwira umutware utegeka abasirikare ijana wari uhagaze aho ati, "Mbese byemewe n’amategeko gukubita umuturage w’i Rooma ataraatsindwa n’urubanza?"
Umutware utegeka abasirikare ijana yumviise ibyo, aja kubwira mukuru w’abasirikare ati, "Ibyo ugiiye gukora ni ibiki? Uyu mugabo n’Umurooma."
Wa mukuru w’abasirikare yeegeera Pawulo aramubaza ati, "Mbwira, mbese uri Umurooma?" Pawulo aramusubiza ati, "Ndi we."
Mukuru w’abasirikare aramusubiza ati, "Byanjanye amashilingi menshi kugira ngo mbone ubwenegihugu bw’i Rooma." Pawulo aramusubiza ati, "Njeewe, navukanye ubwenegihugu bw’i Rooma."
Ako kaanya abaari bashaaka kumutata baramureka, mukuru w’abasirikare na we agira ubwoba kuko yari amaze kumenya ko Pawulo ari Umurooma akaba yaamuboshe.

Kuko umutware w’abasirikare yashaakaga kumenya ico Abayuuda baaryozaga Pawulo, bukeeye amukuuraho injegeri, ategeka abatware b’abaheerezabitambo n’abagize urukiiko rwose guhuura. Azana Pawulo amuhagarika imbere yaabo.
Pawulo atumbiira abagize urukiiko, maze arababwira ati, "Beene daata, kugeza n’uyu munsi, nta co umutima wanje unshinja imbere y’Imaana mu buzima bwanje bwose."
Nuuko Ananiya Umuheerezabitambo mukuru abyumviise, ategeka abaari bahagaze iruhande rwa Pawulo kumukubita urushi ku munwa.
Pawulo ni ko kumusubiza ati, "Imaana izaagukubita urushi wa ndyarya we! Mbese wiicaye aho kunshiira urubanza ukurikije amategeko, kandi ukayiica utegeka ko bankubita urushi?"
Abaari bahahagaze baramubaza bati, "Uri gutuka Umuheerezabitambo mukuru w’Imaana?"
Pawulo arasubiza ati, "Bavandimwe, sinamenye ko ari Umuheerezabitambo mukuru, kuko byanditse ngo, ‘Ntukavuge naabi umutware w’ubwoko bwawe.’ "

Pawulo amenye ko mu baari aho haarimo Abasadukaayo kandi abandi ari Abafarisaayo, avugira imbere y’urukiiko aranguruye ati, "Bavandimwe, ndi Umufarisaayo, umwana w’Abafarisaayo. Ndi hano mu rubanza mpoorwa kwiringira yuuko hari izuuka ry’abaapfuuye."
Amaze kuvuga ibi, habaho kutumviikana hagati y’Abafarisaayo n’Abasadukaayo maze iteeraniro ryigabamo ibice.
Abasadukaayo bavuga ko ari nta zuuka ry’abaapfuuye ribaho, nta n’abaamalayika cangwa umwuka ubaho, ariko Abafarisaayo bo biizeera ko ibyo bitatu bibaho.

Hakomeza kubaho kuyomba caane, nuuko bamwe mu biigiishamategeko b’Abafarisaayo barahaguruka barabyemeza bati, "Nta kibi tuboonye kuri uyu muntu. Noone se niiba umwuka cangwa malayika yavuganye na we?"

Izo mparana ko zaakomeje gukomera, mukuru w’abasirikare atiinya ko abantu bashobora gutanyaguza Pawulo nuuko ategeka abasirikare kumanuka bakamuvaana muri abo bantu ku gahato bakamujaana mu kigo c’abasirikare.
Muri iryo joro, Nyagasani ahagarara iruhande rwa Pawulo aramubwira ati, "Komera ushikame! Uko umaze guhamya ibyanje i Yerusaalemu ni ko ugomba kubikora n’i Rooma."
Bukeeye, Abayuuda bamwe bahuuza umugambi, barahira ko batazaagira ico barya cangwa ico banywa batabanje kwica Pawulo.
Abantu basaaga mirongo ine ni bo baari bagamije kutiica uyu mugambi.
Baja ku batware b’abaheerezabitambo n’abakuru b’imiryango barababwira bati, "Twarahiye twiyemeza kutagira ico dukoza mu kanwa tutabanje kwica Pawulo.

Noone reero, mwebwe hamwe n’abagize urukiiko mugomba kumenyeesha mukuru w’abasirikare kubazanira Pawulo, nk’aho hari ibindi mushaaka kumucondoozaho. Naatwe turaba twiteguye kumwica mbere yuuko abageraho."
Mwishwa wa Pawulo yumviise uwo mugambi wo gutega Pawulo bakamwica, ni ko kuja mu kigo c’abasirikare abwira Pawulo ibyo yumviise.
Pawulo na we ahamagara umwe mu batware bategeka abasirikare ijana aramubwira ati, "Uyu musore mujaanire mukuru w’abasirikare, kuko hari ico ashaaka kumumenyeesha."
Aramujaana, amugejejeyo abwira mukuru w’abasirikare ati, "Umusibe wiitwa Pawulo yampamagaye ansaba kukuuzanira uyu musore kuko afite ico ashaaka kukumenyeesha."
Mukuru w’abasirikare afata uwo musore ukuboko, aramwihereerana, nuuko aramubaza ati, "Ni iki ushaaka kuumenyeesha?"
Uwo musore asubiza mukuru w’abasirikare ati, "Abayuuda baamaze kwemeranya ngo bagusabe kuuzana Pawulo mu rukiiko ejo, nk’aho bagiiye kumukoraho ubucondozi nyaabwo ngo bamenye ibye.

Ariko ibyo bidatuma bakwemeza, kuko abagabo basaaga mirongo ine bagamije kumutegera mu nzira bakamwica. Baarahiye ko bataziigera kugira ico barya cangwa ico banywa batari biica Pawulo. Ubu bariteeguuye kandi bategereje ko ubemerera."
Mukuru w’abasirikare aseezerera uwo musore, amutegeka ati, "Nti hagire uwo ubwira ibyo umenyesheje."

Mukuru w’abasirikare ahamagara abatware babiri bategeka baabasirikare ijana arababwira ati, "Mwiteguure kuva aha saaha itatu z’ijoro muje i Kayisaariya. Mugendane abasirikare magana abibiri, abanyamafarashi mirongo irindwi, hamwe n’ingabo magana abiri ziitwaje amacumu.
Kandi muteguure amafarashi yo guheeka Pawulo, mumujaane, maze mumushikirize umutegetsi Felekisi amahoro."
Mukuru w’abasirikare yandika urwandiko avuga ati,
"Njeewe Kilawudiyasi Lusiya, ndakwandikira Nyakubahwa Felekisi, ndabaramutsa.
Uyu mugabo nkoherereje yafashwe n’Abayuuda bashaaka kumwica, ariko menye ko afite ubwenegihugu bw’i Rooma, nzana n’abasirikare banje turamukiza.
Nshaatse kumenya ico bamuryoza, mujaana mu rukiiko rwabo.
Nsanga bamurega impaka z’ibyerekeye amategeko yaabo, ariko nta kindi kintu na kimwe yakoze caatuma aciirwa urwo gupfa cangwa gusibwa.
Nyuma nza kubwirwa ko Abayuuda bafite umugambi wo kumwica, ni ko kumukooherereza. Ntegetse abamurega na bo kukugezaho ibirego byabo. [Nuuko murabeho .]"
Bityo reero abasirikare babikora uko baategetswe, bajaana Pawulo muri iryo joro, bamugeza Antipatirida.
Umunsi wakurikiyeho basubira mu kigo c’abasirikare nuuko abatwaye amafarashi bo bakomezamo na Pawulo.
Bageze i Kayisaariya, baha Umutegetsi Felekisi urwandiko, bamushikiriza na Pawulo.
Amaze gusoma urwandiko, Felekisi abaza Pawulo igice akomookamo, amenye ko ava i Silisiya,
aravuga ati, "Ndumva ibyawe abakurega ni bamara kugera hano." Ategeka ko arindirwa mu ngoro ya Herodi.

Hashize iminsi itaanu, Umuheerezabitambo mukuru wiitwa Ananiya agera i Kayisaariya, ari kumwe na bamwe mu bakuru b’imiryango, hamwe n’uwo kubaburanira wiitwaga Teritulo, babwira umutegetsi ibyo barega Pawulo.

Pawulo bamuzanye, Teritulo atangira kumurega avuga ati, "Nyakubahwa Felekisi, ni wowe dukeesha aya mahoro tumaze igihe kinini dufite, kandi n’ibyavuguruwe muri iki gihugu ni ku bw’umwete waawe wo kureeba ibiri imbere.
Ibi tubyakiiza yombi aho turi hoose iminsi yoose kandi turabigushiimira caane.
Ariko ntakurambiye, ndakwinginze ngo utwihangaanire wumve ibyo tukubwira muri make nk’uko ubisanganywe.
Uyu muntu twasanze ari icaago, kandi ari n’umunyarugomo mu Bayuuda boose ku isi yoose kandi ni we uyoboye agatsiko k’inyaduka z’aba Nazaareeti.
Ndetse yagerageje guhumaanya Inzu y’Imaana nuuko turamufata.
[ Kandi twari dukwiriye kuba twaramuciriye urubanza twebwe ubwacu dukurikije amategeko, ariko umusirikare mukuru wiitwa Lusiya aza n’imbaraga aramutwaka. Ategeka abaamuregaga kwitaba imbere yaawe.]
Nuumara kumucondoza, ushobora kumenya neeza ibyo tumurega byose."
Abayuuda bafatanya na we mukurega Pawulo bahamya ko ibi byose ari ukuri.
Umutegetsi Felekisi amaze kumureebura ngo agire ico avuga, Pawulo aravuga ati, "Biineejeeje kwireguura imbere yaawe kuko nzi neeza ko umaze imyaka myinshi uciira ab’iki gihugu imanza.
Nk’uko ubwawe ushobora kumenya, nti haari haashira iminsi cumi n’ebyiri ngiiye kuramiriza i Yerusaalemu.
Ntibiigeze basanga hari uwo tuja impaka mu Nzu y’Imaana cangwa ngo basange hari agasasamaro nteeza mu bantu bo mu masinagoogi cangwa mu tawuni nkuru yoose.
Kandi ntibashobora kuguhamiriza ibyo bandega aka kaanya.

Nyamara ico neemera imbere yaawe, ni uko nkorera Imaana ya ba sogokuruza nkurikije Inzira aba biita agatsiko k’abaayobye, kandi nkaba niizeera ibyanditswe mu mategeko byose n’ibyanditswe n’abahanuuzi.
Mfite ibyiringiro mu Maana, ibyiringiro byo na bo biizeera ko hazaabaho izuuka ry’abakiraanutsi n’abakiraanirwa.
Ni co gituma igihe coose mparanira kugira umutimanaama imbere y’Imaana n’imbere y’abantu.
Nyuma yo kumara imyaka myinshi, nagarutse i Yerusaalemu nzaniye umuryango waacu imfashanyo z’abakene no gutamba ibitambo.
Igihe nari ngikora ibyo, bansanga mu Nzu y’Imaana maze kwihumaanura kandi ari ntaabantu benshi turi kumwe ntaan’agasasamaro kahari.
Ariko Abayuuda bamwe bava mu gice c’Asiya baariho mu Nzu y’Imaana, nibo baagombaga kuba bari hano imbere yaawe bakandega, niiba hari ico banshinja.
Cangwa se aba bagabo bari aha ni bavuge icaaha bansanganye igihe mpagarara imbere y’urukiiko,
keretse niiba ari iri jambo navugiye imbere yaabo nti, ‘Ukuzuuka kw’abaapfuuye ni ko kunzanye imbere yaawe uyu umunsi.’ "
Nuuko Felekisi wari uzi neeza iby’iyo Nzira, asuubika urubanza avuga ati, "Lusiya mukuru w’abasirikare naaza, niho nzarangiza ibyanyu."
Ategeka umutware utegeka abasirikare ijana kuba ashize Pawulo mu gihome, ariko akamuha umudendeezo no kutabuza inshuti ze kuuza kumureebereera.
Hashize iminsi, Felekisi azana n’umugore we Durusira wari Umuyuudakazi, atumaho Pawulo maze yumviriza ibyo avuga bifashe ku kwizeera Kristo Yesu.
Kandi igihe yamugaaniriraga ibyerekeye ubutabeera, kwifata, hamwe n’ibyo guciirwa urubanza dutegereje, Felekisi agira ubwoba maze aramubwira ati, "Ba ugiiye, ninongera guteguuka, ndagutumaho."
Icakora muri ibi byose, Felekisi yiringiraga ko ahaari Pawulo yamutugira, ni co caatumaga amutumishaho kenshi akaganiira na we.
Hashize imyaka ebyiri, umutegetsi Felekisi asimburwa na Porukiyo Fesito, kandi kuko Felekisi yashaakaga kuneezeeza Abayuuda, asiga Pawulo mu gihome.
Hashize iminsi itatu Fesito amaze kugera muri ico gice, ava i Kayisaariya aja i Yerusaalemu
aho abatware b’abaheerezabitambo hamwe n’abayobozi b’Abayuuda bamwanzuriye ibyo barega Pawulo. Binginga Fesito
bamusaba kubashiimiisha agategeka ko baazana Pawulo i Yerusaalemu. Baari bafite imigambi yo kumutegera mu nzira bakamwica.
Fesito abasubiza ko Pawulo afungiwe i Kayisaariya, kandi ko we ubwe afite umugambi wo kujayo vuba.
Yongera kubabwira ati, "Nooneho reero, reka abo muri mwe bafite ububaasha baaze tujaane, nuuko niiba hari urubanza afite, mumurege."
Amaze kubaana na bo kumara iminsi umunane cangwa icumi, amanuka yeerekeza i Kayisaariya. Umunsi ukurikiraho, yiicara mu ntebe y’urukiiko ruca imanza ategeka ko bamuuzanira Pawulo.
Pawulo ahageze, Abayuuda baavuuye i Yerusaalemu baramwitooroora, bamurega ibirego byinshi bikomeye ariko ntabuhamya babifitiye.
Pawulo arireguura ati, "Sinigeze nkora ibinyuranye n’amategeko y’Abayuuda cangwa ngo nshobereze Inzu y’Imaana cangwa habe no gushobereza Umwami w’i Rooma."
Ariko Fesito we ashaatse gushiimiisha Abayuuda, abaza Pawulo ati, "Mbese ushaaka kuja i Yerusaalemu ngo abe ari yo nshiira urubanza rw’ibi bakurega?"
Pawulo aravuga ati, "Mpagaze kujurira imbere y’ubucaamanza bw’Umwami w’i Rooma kandi ni ho nkwiriye guciirwa urubanza. Ntaakibi nakoreye Abayuuda nk’uko na we ubwawe ubiizi.

Noone niiba ndi mu nshobe, hakaba hari ico nakoze caatuma niicwa, gupfa simbyanze, ariko niiba mu byo abo bayuuda bandega ari nta rubanza rumpfata, nta muntu ushobora kubangabiza. Nsaba ko njurira imbere y’ubucaamanza bw’Umwami w’i Rooma."
Fesito amaze kuja inaama n’abandi bagize urukiiko, aramusubiza ati, "Ubwo usabye kujurira ku mwami w’i Rooma, ni yo uri buje."
Hashize iminsi, umwami Agiripa na Berinike bagera i Kayisaariya kwakiira Fesito muri uwo mwanya.
Kuko baari abo kumarayo iminsi myinshi, Fesito ateekerereza umwami ibya Pawulo, avuga ati, "Aha hari umugabo wo Felekisi yasize mu gihome.
Igihe nari i Yerusaalemu, abatware b’abaheerezabitambo hamwe n’abakuru b’imiryango b’Abayuuda baamenyesheje ibye bansaba ko muciira urubanza mushinja.
Nabasubije yuuko atari umugenzo w’Abarooma kugabiza umuntu ngo yicwe atabanje guhangana n’abamurega amaaso ku yandi kandi agahaabwa n’umugisha wo kwireguura ibyo bamurega.
Ubwo baahuriye aha, sinatindiganyije, umunsi ukurikiraho niicara ku ntebe yanje y’ubucaamanza ntegeka ko banzanira uwo mugabo.
Abaamuregaga bahagurutse, ntihaagira ikirego gikomeye na kimwe bahingutsa mu byo nakeekaga.
Ahuubwo baari bafite ibyo bapfa byerekeye kutumviikana na we, ku by’idiini yaabo hamwe n’umuntu wiitwa Yesu wapfuuye, uwo Pawulo avuga ko ari muzima.
Mboonye ko nanje binyobeye, ntafite uko nashobora gucondooza ibyo bibazo, mubaza niiba ashaaka kuja i Yerusaalemu akaba ari ho aciirirwa urubanza rw’ibyo.
Ariko Pawulo asabye ko ashaaka kujurira ibwami, ntegeka ko aba afunzwe kugeza ubwo nzamwohereza ku Mwami w’i Rooma."
Agiripa abwira Fesito ati, "Nanje ubwanje nshaaka kwiyumvira uwo mugabo." Fesito na we ati, "Ejo, uzamwiyumvira."
Bukeeye, Agiripa na Berinike binjira mu rukiiko mu cuubahiro, bakiikijwe n’abasirikare bakuru, hamwe n’ibindi bikomangoma byo muri iyo tawuni nkuru.

Nuuko Fesito aravuga ati, "Mwami Agiripa, namwe mwese abari hano uyu munsi, murabona uyu mugabo wo umuryango woose w’Abayuuda bandegeye ndi i Yerusaalemu hamwe na hano, bayomba caane bavuga ko adakwiriye kubaho.
Ariko nkaba narasanze ko ari nta kintu kibi yakoze caatuma aciirwa urwo gupfa. Ansabye ko ashaaka kujurira imbere ya Nyakubahwa umwami w’i Rooma, mpitamo kumwoherezayo.

Icakora nta kirego na kimwe gifatika nakwandikira Umwami w’i Rooma kimushinja. Noone ni ko kumubaazanira mwese, na caane imbere yaawe mwami Agiripa, kugira ngo nitumara kumusuuzuma, mbone ico kwandika.
Kuko naboonye bidakwiriye koohereza umusibe ku mwami w’i Rooma nteerekanye ico aregwa."
Agiripa abwira Pawulo ati, "Uhaawe urusa rwo kugira ico wiivugaho." Nuuko Pawulo arambuura ukuboko atangira kwireguura ati,
"Nyakubahwa Agiripa, mfite amahiirwe yo kwireguura imbere yaawe ibirego byose Abayuuda bandega,
kuko usanzwe uzi imico y’Abayuuda n’ibyo bajaho impaka. Ni co gituma ngusaba ngo wiihangaane unyumve.
Abayuuda boose baazi imibeereho yanje kuva mu buto bwanje, uko nabayeho mu bantu bacu hamwe n’i Yerusaalemu.
Baranzi kuva keera, babishaatse bashobora guhamya ko nabaaye umuyoboke w’ishaka ryarushaga ayandi gukuriza amategeko y’idiini yaacu, kandi ngakurikiza umuco w’Abafarisaayo.
Noone ubu mpagaritswe aha ngo nshiirwe urubanza ku bw’ibyiringiro mfite mu seezerano Imaana yakoreye ba sogokuruza,
iseezerano ry’imiryango yaacu cumi n’ebyiri yiizeera ko izaahabwa, ikaba idahwema kuyiramya amanywa na n’ijoro. N’ibi byiringiro Nyakubahwa, byo ndegwa n’Abayuuda!
Mbese kuki muteemera ko Imaana ishobora kuzuura abaapfuuye?
Ni koko ubwanje nari niiyemeje ko nkwiriye gukora ibishoboka byose kureeba ngo izina rya Yesu Kristo w’i Nazaareeti ntiryamamaye.

Kandi koko ni byo nakoreraga i Yerusaalemu mpaawe ububaasha n’abatware b’abaheerezabitambo. Ntaabwo nafatiishije abeera benshi bashirwa mu gihome byonyine, ahuubwo no mu gihe baaciirwaga urwo gupfa, narabishigikiraga.
Akenshi mu masinagoogi yoose narabahanaga nkabahata no gusebya Imaana. Ku bw’uburaakari bukabije nari mbafitiye, nabakurikiranaga no mu matawuni akomeye yo mu yandi mahanga kubatooteza.
Ni co caatumye nja i Damasiko mpaawe uburenganzira n’abatware b’abaheerezabitambo.
Nuuko reero Nyakubahwa, zigeze isaaha itandatu z’amanywa ndi mu nzira, mbona umuco uva mu ijuru, umurika caane kuruta izuuba, urangota hamwe n’abo twari kumwe.
Tumaze kwikubita haasi, numva ijwi rimbwira mu Ruheburayo riti, ‘Sawuli, Sawuli, urantootereza iki? Uriibabariza ubusa, umeze nk’ikimasa giteera imigere umuhunda .’
Nanje ndabaza nti, ‘Uri nde, Nyagasani?’ Aransubiza ati, ‘Ndi Yesu, uwo utooteza.
Ariko, haguruka uhagarare, kuko nkubonekeye ngo nguhe umurimo wo guheereza no guhamiriza abandi ibyo uboonye kuri nje kandi n’ibyo uzaabonekerwa haanyuma.
Nzaagutabaara ngukize ubwoko bwanyu n’Abanyamahanga, bo ngiiye kukooherezamo
kugira ngo ubahumuure amaaso, bave mu mwijima baje mu muco kandi bave mu mbaraga za Sataani, bayoboke Imaana, bityo bababarirwe ibyaha kandi bahaabwe ku mugabane w’abo beejejwe no kunyizeera.’
Nyuma yaaho Nyakubahwa Agiripa, nta caari kumbuza kumvira ibyo neeretswe biturutse mu ijuru.

Mpeera mu bantu b’i Damasiko, nkurikizaho ab’i Yerusaalemu no mu byaro byose byo muri Yudeeya, hamwe no mu banyamahanga kugira ngo biihane ibyaha bahindukire Imaana, maze bakore imirimo ikwiriye abiihannye.
Ni co caatumye Abayuuda bamfatira mu Nzu y’Imaana, bagerageza kunyica.
No kugeza uyu munsi Imaana iracantabaara, noone nkaba mpagaze aha guhamiriza abakomeye n’aboroheje, nta bindi mvuga uretse ibyo abahanuuzi na Moose baavuze ko bizaaba.
Ko Kristo yagombaga kubabazwa agapfa, maze akaba ubanjirije abandi kuzuuka, akava mubaapfuuye ngo yamamaze ko ari we rumuri rumurikira Abayuuda n’Abanyamahanga."
Pawulo aciireguura, Fesito ariiyamiira ati, "Pawulo we, wataaye umutwe! Kwiga byinshi byatumye usara!"
Ariko Pawulo aramusubiza ati, "Nyakubahwa Fesito, ntaabwo ndi umusazi, ahuubwo ndi muzima kandi aya magambo mvuga ni ay’ukuri.
Kandi koko umwami Agiripa ibi byose arabiizi, ni co kinteera kuvugana na we n’umudendeezo. Ndahamya yuuko nta na kimwe muri byo ataazi kuko bitaakorewe mu bwihisho.
Mbese mwami Agiripa, weemera iby’abahanuuzi? Nzi ko ubyemera."
Umwami Agiripa abwira Pawulo ati, "Mbese uragira ngo muri aka kaanya gato wanyemeza kuba Umukristo?"
Pawulo aramusubiza ati, "Haba mu kaanya gato cangwa igihe kinini, ndasaba Imaana ngo uretse wowe gusa, ahuubwo n’abaanyumva uyu munsi boose bamere nkanje, ukuuyeho kuba muri izi njegeri."
Umwami ahagurukana n’umutegetsi mukuru hamwe na Berinike n’abo yari yiicaranye na bo.
Bakiva aho baravugana bati, "Uyu mugabo nta caaha yakoze caatuma aciirwa urwo gupfa cangwa gusibwa."
Umwami Agiripa abwira Fesito ati, "Uyu mugabo kiba arekuwe iyo aba ataarajuriye ku Mwami w’i Rooma."
Bamaze kwemeza ko dufata ubwato tukaja muri Itale, Pawulo n’abandi basibe bariimurwa bajanwa ku mutware utegeka abasirikare ijana wiitwa Juliyasi waduumiraga umutwe w’abasirikare wiitwaga Agusito.
Tuja mu bwato buvuuye Adaramatiyo, bwendaga kuja mu ma tawuni ari ku nkengeero y’inyanja ya Asiya. Nuuko tuja mu nyanja duherekejwe na Arisitarikasi, Umunyamakedooniya ukomooka i Teesalonike.
Bukeeye, tugera i Sidoni. Juliyasi agirira neeza Pawulo, amwemerera kuja mu nshuti ze, ngo zimureeberere.
Tuhavuuye, tugana kuruhande rw’ikirwa ca Kupuro, ahataari umuyaga mwinshi kuko uwo muyaga waduturukaga imbere.
Tuhavuuye, twambuka inyanja tugera ku nkengeero mu birwa bya Silisiya na Pamfiliya, maze tugera i Muura mu gice ca Lusiya.
Tukiri i Muura, umutware utegeka abasirikare ijana abona ubwato buturutse Alekizanduriya buja Itale maze abudushiramo.
Tumara iminsi tugenda buhoro buhoro, tugera haafi na Kinido ariko bibanje kutugoora. Kuko umuyaga waduteganyaga, tunyura iruhande rw’ikirwa ca Kureete ahateeganye na Solomooni.
Kuhakiikira nti byari byoroshe, maze tugera ahantu hiitwa i Myaro myiza, haafi y’itawuni nkuru ya Lasaya.

Twari tumaze gutaakaza igihe kinini tugenda kandi gukomeza urugenda mu bwato byari kudushira mu kaaga kuko n’iminsi yo kwiyiriza ubusa yari yaashize kandi igihe c’imivumba myinshi caari ceegeereje, nuuko Pawulo abagiira inaama,
avuga ati, "Batware, ndabona uru rugendo rugiiye kubamo ibyago no gupfiirwa byinshi, ari imitwaro n’ubwato ndetse n’ubuzima bwacu."
Ariko umutware utegeka abasirikare ijana yiiringira umusaare na nyir’ubwato aho kwita ku naama Pawulo yabagiiriye.

Kandi kuko ico cambu caari kitaboneye kukimaramo ayo meezi y’imbeho n’umuyaga, ni co caatumye abenshi bahuuza inaama yo kuvayo, ngo ahaari baashobora kugera i Foyinike ngo abe ari ho bamara ayo meezi y’imbeho n’umuyaga. Caari icambu co mu kirwa c’i Kureete, aheerekeye i burengerazuuba bw’amajeepfo hamwe n’iburengerazuuba bw’amajaaruguru.
Ubwo umuyaga uringaniye uva mu majeepfo watangiye guhuuha, biibwira ko bari bushikirize umugambi waabo. Niko kuzitura ubwato bagenda bakiikiye ikirwa ca Kureete, aheegeereye inkengeero.
Ariko bidantize, bateerwa n’umuyaga ukabije wiitwa Majaaruguru y’iburasirazuuba uturuka i Kureete.
Uyu muyaga ukubita ubwato bunanirwa kuwurwanya, maze turabureka bujanwa uko umuyaga ushaaka.

Nuuko tunyura iruhande rw’ikirwa ciitwa Kawuda ahaari hakingiwe umuyaga. Aha ni ho twashoboye kureeba ngo akaato gato kaari kaziritswe inyuma y’ubunini karinzwe neeza, ariko ntibyari byoroshe ku bw’imbaraga z’umuyaga.

Abasaare barabwuriza babushira mu bunini, nuuko ubunini babuzengurutsa imigozi ikomeye. Abasaare baatiinyaga ko bashobora gutaabwa ku nkengeero ya Suriti, nuuko barekurira mu maazi ibifatabwato kugira ngo ubwato bugende gahoro maze ubwato butwerwa n’umuyaga.
Dukomeza guteerwa n’inkubi y’umuyaga, bituma batangira guteerera imitwaro imwe mu nyanja.
Ku munsi wa gatatu, abasaare ubwabo bafata ibikoreesho by’ubwato, na byo babijungunya mu nyanja.
Hashize iminsi myinshi izuuba n’inyenyeeri bitaboneka, kandi n’umuyaga ukomeje kuba mwinshi, bituma twiheba ko tutari buuze kurokoka.
Bamaze igihe kinini ari nta co bakoza ku munwa, maze Pawulo ahagarara hagati yaabo aravuga ati, "Bagabo, iyo munyumvira ntimuvuge ubwato kuva i Kureete, ntimwari koonoona no guhomba ibyanyu.
Ariko nooneho ndabiihanangiriza nti, ni mukomere kuko ari ntaamuntu n’umwe uragira ico aba keretse ubwato bwonyine.
Kuko mu joro ryakeeye malayika w’Imaana ndamya kandi nkorera yanjeho,
maze arambwira ati, ‘wiitiinya Pawulo, kuko ukwiriye guhagarara imbere y’Umwami w’i Rooma, kandi ko Imaana irakurinda hamwe naabo boose mugendana mu bwato.’
Nuuko reero, nimukomere mwa bagabo mwe, kuko mfite kwizeera mu Maana ngo biraba nk’uko nabwiwe.
Icakora, hari ikirwa ubwato bugomba kuzadusukaho."
Mu ijoro rya cumi na kane tugitwarwa n’imbaraga z’umuyaga mu nyanja ya Adiriya, nka saaha itandatu z’ijoro, abasaare bakeeka ko bari bugufi kugera ku butaka.
Bajugunya mu maazi umugozi uhambiriweho icuuma, basanga uburebure bw’amaazi bureesha na mita mirongo ine. Biigiye imbere gato, babona ubureebure bureesha na mita mirongo itatu.
Batiinya ko ubwato bushobora gukubita ku rutare, maze bajugunya mu maazi ibifatabwato bine inyuma ngo ahaari bwahagarara, basaba ko bwaca vuba.
Abasaare bashaaka gutoroka mu bwato, basubiza ka kaato mu maazi, biitwaje ko bagiiye kurekurira mu maazi ibindi byo guhagarika ubwato.
Pawulo ni ko kubwira umutware utegeka abasirikare ijana ati, "Aba basaare niibataguma mu bwato, namwe ntaabwo murarokoka."
Abasirikare baca imigozi iziritse bwa bwato buto, baraburekura buragenda.
Bugiiye guca, Pawulo arabinginga kugira ngo hagire ico bafungura ababwira ati, "Dore uyu ni umunsi wa cumi na kane muhagaritse imitima, nta co mukojeje ku munwa.
Ndabibasabye, nimugire ico murya, maze mushobore kubaho. Erega ntaan’umwe muri mwe uzaagira ico aba, habe no gupfuuka agasatsi ko ku mutwe na kamwe."
Amaze kuvuga atyo, afata umugaati, awushiimira Imaana imbere yaabo boose, arawumanyura atangira kurya.
Boose bibateera ihuumure na bo batangira kurya.
[Twese hamwe twari abantu magana abiri na mirongo irindwi na batandatu mu bwato.]
Bamaze guhaaga, baroha ingano mu nyanja kugira ngo bagabanye uburemeezi bw’ubwato.
Mu gitondo, ntibamenya ahantu bageze ahaariho, ariko babona icambu cinjiye mu nyanja, bateekereza ko bishobotse ari ho bakwerekeza ubwato.
Bazitura bya bifatabwato babirekurira mu nyanja, bahambuura n’imigozi iyobora ubwato bw’inyuma, haanyuma bamaze kuzaamuura umwenda w’imbere w’umuyaga uja mo, ugatwara ubwato, bagana ku nkengeero.
Ariko ubwato bugeze ku ihuuriro ry’amaazi, bukubita ku museenyi, igihande c’imbere ciishingamo ubutanyeganyega, naho ic’inyuma gitangira gusandaazwa n’imbaraga z’imivumba.
Abasirikare bo baari bafite umugambi wo kwica abasibe boose kugira ngo hatagira uwoga mu nyanja agatoroka.
Ariko kuko umutware utegeka abasirikare ijana yari ashaaka gukiza Pawulo, ababuza gukomeza umugambi waabo. Ategeka abo baazi kooga gusimbukira mu nyanja bakababanziriza kugera ku nkengeero
nuuko abandi bakabakurikira. Bamwe bakagendera ku mbaho abandi kubimene by’ubwato. Uko ni ko boose baashoboye kugera ku nkengeero y’inyanja ari bazima.
Tumaze kugera imusozi amahoro, tumenya ko ikirwa tugezeho ciitwa Melita.
Abatuurage baaho batwakiirana urugwiro rudasanzwe. Baducaanira umuriro ngo twote kuko imvura yari itangiye kugwa kandi n’imbeho yari nyinshi.
Pawulo akungaanya umuganda w’inkwi nuuko ari kuzishira mu muriro, inzoka y’inciira isosookamo ku bw’ubushuuhe maze imwiziringa ku kiganza.
Abatuuye aho baboonye iyo nzoka imunagana ku kiganza, baravugana bati, "Uyu muntu agombe kuba ari umwicanyi. N’ubwo yakize urw’inyanja, ica urutabeera ntiimukundiye kubaho!"
Ariko Pawulo akunkumirira ya nzoka mu muriro, kandi we ntihaagira ico aba.
Bategereza kureeba ko yabyimba cangwa ko yiikubita haasi agapfa, ariko hashize umwanya mureemure babona ari ntakimuhindutseho, maze bahindura imiteekerereze yaabo batangira kuvuga ko ari imaana.
Haafi y’aho haari imirima y’umuyobozi w’ico kirwa wiitwaga Pubiliyo. Yatwakiiriye neeza aratuzimaanira kumara iminsi itatu.
Ubwo se wa Pubiliyo yari ku gasambi arwaye amacinya kandi ahinda umuriro. Pawulo aja kumusuura nuuko amaze kumusengera no kumurambikaho ibiganza, aramukiza.
Ibyo bimaze kuba, abandi barwayi boose baari kuri ico kirwa na bo baaza basanga Pawulo, abakiza indwara.
Abantu b’aho baheerako baduha icuubahiro cinshi, kandi ubwo twari tugiiye kuja mu bwato, baduha ibyo twari dukeneye ku rugendo byose.
Hashize ameezi atatu dufata ubwato bwari bwikinze kuri ico kirwa buhamaze ameezi y’imbeho n’umuyaga. Bwavaga Alekizanduriya kandi bwitiriwe ikigirwamaana ciitwa Bavandimwe b’amahasa.
Tugera i Sirakusa maze tuhamara iminsi itatu.
Tuhavuuye tugera ahiitwa Regiyo. Hashize umunsi umwe umuyaga uturutse mu majeepfo utangira guhuuha, maze ku munsi wa kabiri tugera i Peteyoli.
Aho tuhasanga abiizeera badusaba kubaana na bo kumara iminsi indwi. Nyuma tuhavuuye tugera i Rooma.
Abiizeera b’i Rooma bumviise ko tuuje, baaza kudusanganira bavuuye kure caane nko ku gatare ka Apiyo n’ahiitwa Macumbi Atatu. Pawulo ababoonye, ashiima Imaana kandi yongera gukomera.
Tugeze i Rooma, beemerera Pawulo gucumbika ukwe, ariko bamuha umusirikare wo kumurinda.

Hashize iminsi itatu, Pawulo akoranya abayobozi b’Abayuuda. Bamaze gukungaana, arababwira ati, "Bavandimwe, n’ubwo ari nta kibi nakoreye beene waacu cangwa ngo nkore ibinyuranye n’imigenzo ya ba sogokuruza, ariko bamfatiye i Yerusaalemu banshikiriza Abarooma.
Bamaze kunsuuzuma, Abarooma baashaakaga kundekura kuko baasanze nta co nakoze caatuma nshiirwa urwo gupfa.
Ariko Abayuuda babyanze, mpitamo gusaba ngo njurire imbere y’Umwami w’i Rooma, nuubwo ari nta co ndega beene waacu.
Ni yo mpamvu yatumye mbatumaho kugira ngo mvugane namwe, kuko nashizwe muri izi njegeri mpoorwa uwo Abiisirayeli bafitemo ibyiringiro."
Baramusubiza bati, "Nta rwandiko twigeze tubona ruvuuye i Yudeeya rukuvugaho. Kandi nta muvandimwe n’umwe waaje aha ngo abitumenyeshe cangwa ngo hagire ukuvuga naabi.
Icakora dushaaka kumva ico uteekereza, kuko tuuzi yuuko benshi barwanya inyigiisho z’iyo diini."

Bamaze guteguura umunsi wo guhuura na we, haaza benshi bamusanga aho yari acumbitse. Kuva mu gitondo kugera ku mugoroba abibasobaanurira, ahamya iby’ubwami bw’Imaana, agerageza no kubeemeza ibya Yesu ashingiye ku mategeko ya Moose no ku bahanuuzi.
Bamwe bemejwe n’ibyo avuga, naho abandi banga kubyemera.
Ntibaashobora kumvikana, nuuko bari gutaaha, Pawulo yongera kuvuga ati, "Ibyo Umwuka Weera yabwiye ba sogokuruza baanyu anyuriye mu muhanuuzi Yesaaya byari bishitse, ati,
‘Genda ubwire abo bantu uti, Kumva muzumva, ariko ntimuzaasobaanukirwa, kandi no kureeba muzaareeba, ariko ntimuzaabona.

Kuko aba bantu binangiye imitima yaabo, kandi bakazibya amatwi yaabo, bahumya amaaso yaabo, Kugira ngo batareeba. Naaho, amaaso yaabo yakareebye amatwi yaabo akumva, n’imitima yaabo ikagira ico isobaanukirwa nuuko bakampindukira maze nkabakiza.’
Nuuko reero mumenye ko aka gakiza k’Imaana kooherejwe mu banyamahanga, kandi bo bazaakaakiira."
[Pawulo amaze kubabwira ibyo, Abayuuda baragenda, bataaha bagiishanya impaka caane.]
Pawulo atuurayo kumara imyaka ebyiri yiibeshaho akaja yaakiira abo boose baazaga bamusanga,
yaamamaza iby’ubwami bw’Imaana kandi akiigiisha iby’Umwami Yesu Kristo ashize amanga kandi ari ntakimutanga.

name: Romanos
chapters: Njeewe Pawulo, umugaragu wa Yesu Kristo, wahamagariwe kuba intumwa kandi watooranyirijwe kwamamaza Ubutumwa Bwiza, ndabaramukije.
Ubwo Butumwa Bwiza Imaana yabuduseezeranyije keera inyuriye mu bahanuuzi baayo mu Byanditswe Byera.
Buvuga ibyerekeye Umwana waayo ukomooka mu muryango wa Dawudi mu buryo bw’umubiri
kandi akaba yareerekanywe n’ubushobozi ko ari Umwana w’Imaana mu buryo bw’Umwuka Weera bikagaragazwa n’izuuka rye mu baapfuuye, ni we Yesu Kristo Umwami waacu.
Binyuze muri we, Imaana yangiriye ubuntu bwo kuba intumwa, kugira ngo nyobore abantu bo mu mahanga yoose bizeere kandi bumvire Imaana ku bw’izina rye.
Namwe Abarooma muri abo baahamagawe n’Imaana kuba aba Yesu Kristo.
Noone reero, ndabandikiye mwebwe bakundwa b’Imaana batuuye i Rooma kandi baahamagariwe kuba abantu baayo. Ubuntu n’amahoro biva ku Maana Daata hamwe n’Umwami Yesu Kristo, bibe muri mwe.
Mbere ya byose, ndashiima Imaana yanje muri Yesu Kristo ku bwanyu mwese, kuko ukwizeera kwanyu kwamamaye ku isi hoose.
Imaana nkorera n’umutima wanje woose mu kwamamaza Ubutumwa bw’Umwana waayo, ni yo ntanze nk’umujurizi yuuko mpora mbiibuka mu masengeesho yanje,
nyisaba kugira ngo impe uburyo bwo gushobora kugera iwaanyu.
Koko nkumbuye kubonana namwe kugira ngo dusangire impaano y’Umwuka w’Imaana no kubakomeza.
Ico menyeesha ni ukugira ngo nje namwe duteerane inkunga, mukomezwe no kwizeera kwanje, nanje nkomezwe no kwizeera kwanyu.

Bavandimwe, ndashaaka ko mumenya neeza yuuko nahoze mfite iciifuuzo co kuuza iwaanyu, ariko hakagira ibikomeza kuunaniza. Nashaakaga ko ibikorwa byanje byakwera imbuto muri mwe hakaboneka abayoboke nk’uko mbikora no mu bandi banyamahanga.
Mfite inshingano yo kugeza Ubutumwa Bwiza ku bantu boose, baaba Abagiriki cangwa abatari Abagiriki, baaba abanyabwenge cangwa injiji.
Noone reero, nshiishikajwe no kwamamaza Ubutumwa Bwiza namwe abari i Rooma.
Erega Ubutumwa Bwiza ntibunkoza isoni kuko ari imbaraga y’Imaana yo gukiza abo boose biizeera bagakizwa, uheereye ku Muyuuda ukageza no ku Mugiriki.
Kuko muri bwo, ni mwo ubutungaane buva ku Maana buhishuurirwa, buheeshwa no kwizeera bugakomezwa na ko, nk’uko byanditswe ngo, "Umukiraanutsi azaabeeshwaho no kwizeera."
Kuko uburaakari bw’Imaana buhishuurwa buva mu ijuru burwanya abagomeramaana boose, n’abagizi ba naabi boose barwanya ukuri kugira ngo kutamenyekana.
Kuko bigaragara ko baazi ibifashe ku Maana, kandi ubwayo ni yo yabahishuuriye ubwo bwenge.
Kuva igihe Imaana yaremye isi, ububaasha bwayo buhoraho, n’ubumaana bwayo butagaragara, bugaragarizwa mu byo yaremye kugira ngo batagira ico biireguuza,
kuko bamenya Imaana, ariko ntibayihe icuubahiro kiyikwiriye, cangwa ngo bayishiimire, ahuubwo baabaaye abapfaapfa mu biteekerezo byabo, maze imitima yaabo itagira ubwenge icura umwijima.
Biibwira ko ari abanyabwenge, ariko baahindutse abapfaapfa.
Ubwiza bw’Imaana idapfa baabuguranye ishusho isa n’umuntu uzaapfa, isa n’ibiguruka, n’inyamaaswa zigenza amaguru ane cangwa ibikururuka haasi.
Ni co caatumye ibateererana ngo bakore ibyo imitima yaabo irarikira, bagakora ibiteeye isoni maze bigahumaanya imibiri yaabo.
Baaguranye ukuri kw’Imaana ibinyoma, baramya kandi bakorera ibyaremwe babirutiisha Imaana Rurema ubwayo, ari yo ikwiriye guhimbaazwa iteeka ryose, Amiina.
Ni yo mpamvu Imaana ibagabiza ibiteeye isoni bararikira, ndetse n’abagore na bo bagakoreesha imibiri yaabo mu guhuuza ibitsina mu buryo bunyuranye n’ubwo baaremewe.

Ni co kimwe abagabo na bo bareka guhuuza ibitsina n’abagore ahuubwo bakararikirana ubwabo. Abagabo batingana n’abagabo bagenzi baabo. Bityo reero Imaana ikabaha igihano kibakwiriye ku bw’ubukozi bw’ibibi bwabo.
Kandi ubwo banze kumenya ukuri kw’Imaana, Imaana yarabaretse ngo bagume mu biteekerezo byabo bipfuuye, kugira ngo bakore ibidakwiriye gukorwa.
Buuzuye gukiraanirwa koose, ubugome, kwifuuza kubi, urwango, ishari, ubwicanyi, intonganya, kubeesherana, kuriganya, gusebanya,
bateera urubwa, banga Imaana, ni abanyagasuuzuguro, bariiraata, bariiraariira, bahimbahimba ibibi, ntibumvira ababyeyi baabo,
ni abapfaapfa, abahemu, ni abadakunda abaabo, ni intababarira.
Baazi itegeko ry’Imaana yuuko abakora ibisa bityo bakwiriye gupfa. Ntibakomeza gukora ibyo bibi gusa, bongeraho no gushiima abandi babikora.
Nuuko reero ntaaco ufite co kwireguuza, wowe muntu uciira abandi imanza. Kuko iyo uciiriye undi urubanza uba witsindiisha ubwawe, kuko wowe uciira abandi urubanza ukora ibisa n’ibyo bakora.
Kandi ubu tuuzi neeza yuuko Imaana izaaciira urubanza abakora ibisa bityo ikurikije ukuri kwayo.
Noone se wowe muntu uciira abandi imanza bakora ibisa bityo, naawe ubikora, wiibwira ko wowe ubwawe uzaakira urubanza rw’Imaana?
Cangwa se waaba usuuzugura kugira neeza kwayo kutabarika, n’imbabazi zaayo no kwihangaana kwayo? Ntureeba ko kugira neeza kw’Imaana kukuuzanira kwihana?
Ariko kuko winangiye umutima, ukanga kwihana, uri kwibiikira igihano gikomeye ku munsi w’umujinya w’Imaana ubwo guca imanza kwayo kutabeera kuzaagaragara.
Kuko iziituura buri weese ikurikije ibyo yakoze.
Imaana izaaha ubugingo buhoraho abo baakoze neeza, bagashaaka ubwiza n’icuubahiro n’ubugingo budashira.
Ariko abo bantu biikunda, batumvira ukuri ahuubwo bakumvira gukiraanirwa, Imaana izaabiituura umujinya n’uburaakari.
Amakuba n’ibyago ni byo izaateeza buri muntu weese ukora ikibi, uheereye ku Muyuuda ukageza ku Mugiriki.
Ariko ubwiza, icuubahiro n’amahoro ni byo iziituura buri weese ukora ibyiza, uheereye ku Muyuuda ukageza ku Mugiriki.
Kuko Imaana itarobaanura ku butoni.
Abo boose bazaaba baaracumuye bataazi amategeko bazaarimbuka badahoowe amategeko, kandi abo baakoze ibyaha boose baazi amategeko bazaaciirwa urubanza hakurikijwe amategeko.
Kuko kumva amategeko byonyine ntibyatuma utungaanira Imaana, ahuubwo abumvira amategeko ni bo bazaatsindiishirizwa na yo.
Abanyamahanga badafite amategeko, iyo ku bwa kamere, bakoze ibyo amategeko asaba kandi batagira amategeko, ku bwabo baba bihindukiye amategeko.
Bagaragaza ko ico amategeko agamije canditswe mu mitima yaabo. N’umutimanaama waabo na wo ukababeera umuhamya ko ari ukuri, kandi n’ibiteekerezo bikabarwaniramo, bimwe bibashinja ibindi bibarengera.
Kandi ni na ko bizaaba ku munsi Imaana izaaciira abantu urubanza rw’ibihishwe mu mitima ikoreesheje Yesu Kristo, kandi ni na ko Ubutumwa Bwiza nahaawe bubyemeza.
Ubwo wiiyita Umuyuuda kandi ukiishingikiriza ku mategeko kandi ukiiraatana ubumwe ufitanye n’Imaana
ukamenya ibyo ishaaka, uzi guhitamo iciiza kiruta ibindi byose kuko wiigiishijwe iby’amategeko,
wiiyemera ko ari wowe waayobora impumyi, waamurikira abari mu mwijima,
waahuguura abapfaapfa, ukaba n’umwiigiisha w’injiji, kuko uzi neeza yuuko muri ayo mategeko ufite ubumenyi bwuzuye n’ukuri.
Mbese ko wiigiisha abandi ntiwiyigiishe ubwawe? Kuki ubwiriza kutiiba, kandi ukiiba?
Kuki wiigiisha abantu kwirinda ubusambanyi kandi wowe usambana, kuki wanga abaramya ibigirwamaana ariko ukambura insengero zaabyo?
Wiiraata ko uzi amategeko ariko ugasuuzugura Imaana urenga ku mategeko?
Nk’uko ibyanditswe bivuga biti, "Izina ry’Imaana ritukwa n’abanyamahanga ku bwanyu."
Ni koko gukebwa kugira ico kumara, ukurikije amategeko, ariko niiba wica amategeko, gukebwa kwawe kuba guhindutse kudakebwa.
Mbese niiba umuntu utaarakebwe akurikiza ibyategetswe n’amategeko, kudakebwa kwe ntikuzaaba kumuhwaniye no gukebwa?
Uwo udakebwe umubiri ariko akitondera amategeko azaaguciira urubanza wowe urenga kuri ayo mategeko nuubwo uyafite mu nyandiko kandi warakebwe ariko ntuyumvire.
Koko reero, ibigaragara si byo biranga Umuyuuda nyakuri, kandi gukebwa ko ku mubiri si ko gukebwa nyakuri.

Ahuubwo Umuyuuda nyakuri ni uwo ufite umutima ukiraanukira Imaana. Kandi gukebwa nyakuri si ukuubahiriza amategeko yanditswe ahuubwo ni uguhindurwa umutima n’Imaana. Umeze atyo, ntaashimwa n’abantu ahuubwo ashimwa n’Imaana.
Mbese Abayuuda barusha iki abanyamahanga? Cangwa se gukebwa bimaze iki?
Ni koko barabaruta mu buryo bwose. Mbere na mbere Abayuuda ni bo baabiikijwe amagambo yavuzwe n’Imaana.
Mbese niiba bamwe muri bo bataariizeeye, kutiizeera kwabo kwahindura ubusa gukiraanuka kw’Imaana?

Oya ntibikabeho! Ahuubwo Imaana iboneka ko ari inyakuri, nuubwo umuntu weese yaaba umunyabinyoma, nk’uko byanditswe ngo, "Mu byo uvuga uzaagaragaze ko uri intungaane, kugira ngo uzaatsinde nuuciirwa urubanza."
Ariko niiba gukiraanirwa kwacu guhamya gukiraanuka kw’Imaana tuvuge iki? Mbese tuvuge ko Imaana ikiraanirwa iyo ituraakariye ikaduhana? Ibi mbivuze nk’umuntu.
Ntibishoboka! Niiba Imaana idakiraanuka, yaazaaciira abari mu isi urubanza ite?
Niiba ibinyoma byanje bituma ukuri kw’Imaana kurushaho kugaragara, maze Imaana igahaabwa icuubahiro, ni iki gituma nshiirwa urubanza nk’umunyabyaha?
Kandi kuki tutavuga tuti, "Reka twikorere ibibi kugira ngo ibyiza bibeho," nk’uko abantu bamwe batubeeshera. Abavuga batyo bazaaciirwa urubanza rubakwiriye.
Noone se tuvuge iki? Mbese hari ico twebwe Abayuuda turusha Abagiriki? Ntaakiriho! Kuko tumaze kwitegereza ko baaba Abayuuda cangwa Abagiriki, boose bategekwa n’icaaha.
Nk’uko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Ntaamukiraanutsi waabona, habe n’umwe.
Ntaamunyabwenge waabona. Ntaan’umwe ushaaka Imaana.
Boose baarayobye, boose baahindutse imburamumaro; ntaan’umwe ukora iciiza habe n’umwe.
Amagambo aturuka mu kanwa kaabo ariica, bariganyisha indimi zaabo. Ubusabwe bw’inshiira buri mu minwa yaabo.
Akanwa kaabo kuuzuyemo amagambo yo kuvuma, ashaariira.
Biihuutira kubabaza abantu no kubiica,
kurimbuka n’umubabaro bisigara aho banyuze hoose.
Inzira y’amahoro ntibayiizi,
kuubaha Imaana ntikubarimo."
Nyamara tuuzi ko ibyo amategeko avuga byose, bibwirwa abategekwa n’amategeko kugira ngo hatagira ugira urwitwazo, maze abari mu isi boose baciirwe urubanza n’Imaana.
Kuko ari ntaan’umwe uzaatsindiishirizwa imbere y’Imaana n’imirimo itegetswe n’amategeko. Amategeko ni yo atugaragariza ko twacumuye.

Ariko nooneho hariho uburyo bwo gutungaanira Imaana buhishuuwe budatangwa n’amategeko. Uko gutungaanira Imaana ntaaho guhuuriye no kumvira amategeko, nuubwo amategeko ya Moose n’abahanuuzi yabitanzeho ubuhamya.
Gutungaanira Imaana, guheeshwa no kwizeera Yesu Kristo. Imaana ibikorera abo boose beemera ntaavanguura,
kuko boose baakoze ibyaha bigatuma badashikira ubwiza bw’Imaana,
ariko bagatsindiishirizwa n’ubuntu bwayo ku bwo gucungurwa kubonerwa muri Yesu Kristo.
Kuko Imaana yatanze Yesu ngo abe impongano yo kubabarirwa ibyaha kubamwizeera. Yabikoze kugira ngo yeerekane ubutungaane bwayo bwatumye yiirengagiza ibyaha byakozwe mbere.
Imaana yabikoze kugira ngo yeereke ab’iki gihe gutungaana kwayo no gutsindiishiriza uwo weese wiizeera Yesu.
Noone se twakwiraatiisha iki? Ntaaco. Kuko gutungaanira Imaana kwacu ntiguheeshwa no kumvira amategeko ahuubwo kugengwa no kwizeera.
Koko reero tuuzi yuuko umuntu atsindiishirizwa no kwizeera atari ugukora ico amategeko asaba.
Mbese Imaana yaba iy’Abayuuda bonyine? Ntaabwo se ari n’iy’abanyamahanga? Yeego, ni iy’abanyamahanga na bo,
kuko Imaana ari imwe rukumbi, izaaha Umuyuuda gutsindiishirizwa ku bwo kwizeera kandi n’abanyamahanga na bo bazaatsindiishirizwa ku bwo kwizeera kwabo.
Mbese amategeko tuyahindure ubusa ku bwo kwizeera? Ntibikabe! Ahuubwo turayakomeza.
Mbese noone twavuga iki kuri Aburahamu sogokuruza ku mubiri?
Niiba Aburahamu yaratsindiishirijwe abikeesheje ibikorwa, afite ibyo yiiraata, ariko ntiyabyiraata imbere y’Imaana.
Kuko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Aburahamu yiizeeye Imaana, haanyuma kwizeera kwe gutuma Imaana imwemera nk’intungaane."
Abakozi bahembwa ibihembo ku bw’imirimo bakora, ntibibahwanira no guheerwa ubuntu kuko baba baabikoreye.
Ariko reero umuntu ntiyaaba intungaane abikeesheje imirimo, ahuubwo ni ku bwo kwizeera Imaana ibabarira abanyabyaha.
Dawudi na we yavuze yeeruye ibyerekeye imigisha y’umuntu, uwo Imaana yeemera nk’intungaane atabikeesheje imirimo ye, ati,
"Hahiirwa abababarirwa ibicumuro byabo, kandi ibyaha byabo bigakuurwaho.
Hahiirwa umuntu Nyagasani atazaabaraho icaaha."
Mbese ayo mahiirwe yaseezeranyijwe Abayuuda bonyine? Cangwa n’abanyamahanga na bo? Tuvuga ko, "Kwizeera kwa Aburahamu kwatumye yeemerwa nk’intungaane."
Ibi byabaaye Aburahamu ataraakebwa, ntibyabaaye haanyuma yo gukebwa kwe ahuubwo yari ataraakebwa.

Imaana imaze kumwemera nk’intungaane yahaawe ikimenyeetso co gukebwa kigaragaza gukiraanuka kuvuuye ku kwizeera yari afite ataraakebwa kugira ngo abe seekuruza w’abizeera Imaana boose, n’ubwo baaba bataarakebwe ngo bahaabwe kuba intungaane.
Aburahamu ni seekuruza w’abaakebwe, atari ugukebwa gusa ahuubwo bakurikiza iciitegererezo co kwizeera yari afite mbere ataraakebwa.
