Ubwo Imaana yaseezeranyije Aburahamu n’urubyaro rwe kuzaaragwa isi, Imaana yarabikoze atari uko Aburahamu yumviye amategeko ahuubwo iseezerano yariheeshejwe no gukiraanuka kuva mu kwizeera.
Kuko niiba abumvira amategeko ari bo bazaahaabwa ibyaseezeranyijwe, kwizeera kwaba ari ntaamumaro gufite n’ibyaseezeranyijwe na byo bikaba ari impfaabusa.
Kuko amategeko azana uburaakari, ariko aho amategeko atari, ntaamuntu waacumura.

Ni yo mpamvu iseezeerano Imaana yahaaye Aburahamu ryari rishingiye ku kwizeera kugira ngo ribe impaano y’ubuntu ku rubyaro rwe rwose. Nyamara si abumvira amategeko bonyine ahuubwo n’abafite kwizeera nk’ukwa Aburahamu. Kuko Aburahamu ni we sogokuruza wa twese mu kwizeera,
nk’uko byanditswe ngo, "Nakugize seekuru w’amahanga menshi." Ibi byabaayeho kuko Aburahamu yiizeeye Imaana izuura abaapfuuye kandi igaha ibitariho kubaho.
Aburahamu uwo, yeemeraga kandi akiiringira ibitaakwiringirwa, kugira ngo abe seekuruza w’amahanga menshi nk’uko byanditswe ngo, "Urubyaro rwawe ruzaaba rwinshi nk’inyenyeeri zo mu kireere."
Kandi nuubwo yari ari nk’umaze imyaka ijana y’ubukuru kandi ateekereza ko umubiri we usa n’uwapfuuye, ndetse akabona na Saara yararenze igihe co kubyara, ntiyacoogoye mu kwizeera Imaana.
Ntiyiigeze ashidiikanya iseezerano ry’Imaana, ahuubwo yakomeje gukomera mu kwizeera aheereza Imaana icuubahiro.
Yari yeemejwe neeza adashidiikanya yuuko Imaana ifite ububaasha bwo gukora ico yaseezeranye.
Ni co caatumye Aburahamu, ku bwo kwizeera, Imaana yaramwemeye nk’intungaane.
Nyamara kwemerwa nk’intungaane si we byandikiwe wenyine,
ahuubwo naatwe bidufasheho, twebwe abazeemerwa n’Imaana nk’intungaane kuko twizeeye iyazuuye Yesu Umwami waacu mu baapfuuye.
Yesu uwo, yatangiwe gupfiira ibyaha byacu, maze arazuurwa kugira ngo tube intungaane.
Ubwo reero twatsindiishirijwe no kwizeera, dufite amahoro ku Maana muri Yesu Kristo Umwami waacu.
Kubwo kwizeera Kristo twashikiiriye ubuntu dushikamyemo, noone twishiimira ibyiringiro byo kuzaasangira ikuzo ry’Imaana.
Kandi si ibyo byonyine, ndetse dushiimiishwa no kubabazwa ducamo, kuko tuuzi yuuko kubabazwa kuduteera kwihangaana,
kandi kwihangaana kugateera ingeso nziiza, ingeso nziiza zikatugeza ku byiringiro,
kandi ibyiringiro ntibihemura, kuko urukundo rw’Imaana rwaseesekajwe mu mitima yaacu ku bw’Umwuka Weera twahaawe.
Ubwo twari tukiri abanyantege nke, Kristo yapfiiriye abanyabyaha, apfa mu gihe Imaana yatooranyije.
Birakomeye ko umuntu apfiira intungaane. Icakora ahari uwakwiyemeza gupfiira umunyangeso nziiza.
Ariko Imaana yo, yatweretse ukuntu idukunda ubwo Kristo yadupfiiraga kandi tukiri abanyabyaha.
Kuko dutsindiishirizwa ku bw’amaraso ya Kristo, ni co kimwe azaadukiza n’umujinya w’Imaana ugiiye kuuza.
Nyamara twari abanzi b’Imaana, ariko noone twiyunze n’Imaana ku bw’urupfu rw’Umwana waayo. Kandi reero ubwo twiyunze n’Imaana, tuzaakizwa n’ubugingo bwe.
Ariko si n’ibyo gusa, ahuubwo twishiimira Imaana muri Yesu Kristo Umwami waacu waduheesheje kuuzura na yo.
Nk’uko icaaha caaje mu isi kizanywe n’umuntu umwe, kandi n’urupfu rukaaza mu isi ruzanywe n’icaaha, ni na ko urupfu rugera ku bantu boose kuko boose baakoze ibyaha.
Amategeko ya Moose ataraatangwa, icaaha caariho mu isi, ariko ntaawe kibarwaho amategeko atariho.

Nyamara urupfu rwari rufite ubushobozi ku bantu uheereye mu gihe ca Adamu ukageza no mu gihe ca Moose, ndetse urupfu rwategekaga n’abo bataakoze icaaha kingaana n’ica Adamu ubwo yasuzuguye itegeko ry’Imaana. Adamu ni ishusho ihagarariye uwajaga kuuza.

Ariko abo bombi ntibasa, kuko impaano y’ubuntu bw’Imaana itandukanye n’ico gicumuro, uko igicumuro c’umwe caazaniye abantu benshi urupfu ni na ko ubuntu bw’Imaana n’impaano y’ubuntu bw’umuntu umwe ari we Yesu Kristo yaseesekaye kuri benshi mu bwuzuye.

Kandi ingaruka y’ubuntu bw’Imaana itandukanye n’ingaruka y’icaaha c’umuntu umwe. Kuko icaaha ca Adamu caazanye guciirwa urubanza rw’iteeka naho ubuntu bw’Imaana butuuzanira gutsindiishirizwa n’ubwo twari twarakoze ibyaha byinshi.

Koko reero, igicumuro c’umuntu umwe ari we Adamu caatumye urupfu rutegeka benshi. Ariko abo baahaawe ubuntu bw’Imaana butarondooreka n’impaano ye y’ubutungaane bazaakomeza gutsinda icaaha n’urupfu babikeesha umuntu umwe ari we Yesu Kristo.

Nuuko reero, nk’uko igicumuro c’umuntu umwe ari we Adamu caatumye abantu boose baciirwaho iteeka ni na ko igikorwa c’ubukiraanutsi bw’umuntu umwe ari we Kristo gituma abantu boose batsindiishirizwa bikabaheesha ubugingo busha.
Kandi nk’uko abantu boose baahindutse abanyabyaha ku bwo kutumvira Imaana ku muntu umwe, ni na ko benshi bazaahinduka abakiraanutsi ku bwo kumvira Imaana ku muntu umwe.
Nyamara ubwo amategeko yaaje, ibyaha byaragwiriye, ariko aho ibyaha byagwiriye, ni ho n’ubuntu bw’Imaana bwarushijeho kwiyongera kuri boose.
Nuuko reero nk’uko icaaha caategetse abantu kikabaazanira urupfu, ni na ko ubuntu bw’Imaana butegeka bukaazanira abantu gutungaana, bukabaheesha ubugingo buhoraho muri Yesu Kristo Umwami waacu.
Mbese noone tuvuge iki? Tugume gukora ibyaha kugira ngo ubuntu bw’Imaana bugwire?
Ntibikabeho! Mbese niiba twaratandukanye n’imbaraga z’icaaha, twakomeza dute gukora icaaha?
Ntimuuzi yuuko twese abaabatirijwe kuba umwe na Kristo Yesu, twabatirijwe kuba umwe na we mu rupfu rwe?
Mu kubatizwa, twahambanywe na we mu rupfu rwe, kugira ngo nk’uko Daata yazuuye Kristo mu baapfuuye ku bw’imbaraga ze, abe ari ko naatwe tugendera mu bugingo busha.
Ubwo reero twabaaye umwe na we mu gusangira urupfu nk’urwe, ni na ko tuzaaba umwe na we mu kuzuuka nk’uko yazuutse.
Kandi tumenye neeza ko umutima ukunda gukora icaaha wa keera wabambanywe na Kristo, kugira ngo umubiri w’ibyaha ukuurweho, tureke kuba imbaata z’ibyaha,
kuko uwapfuuye aba atagitegekwa n’icaaha.
Ariko niiba twarapfanye na Kristo, twizeere yuuko tuzaabaanaho na we.
Tuuzi ko Kristo yazuutse mu baapfuuye akaba atazongera gupfa ukundi, urupfu ntirukimufiteho ububaasha.
Urupfu yapfuuye, yarupfuuye rimwe rizima gutsinda imbaraga z’icaaha, naho ubwo ariho, ariho ku bwo gushiimiisha Imaana.
Ni co kimwe, namwe mwiyumvemo ko mwatsinze icaaha, mukaba mubeereyeho gushiimiisha Imaana muri Kristo Yesu.
Nuuko reero, icaaha nticongere gutegeka imibiri yaanyu izaapfa, ngo gitume mwumvira ibyo irarikira.

Kandi ibice by’imibiri yaanyu ntimukabyegurire icaaha ngo bibe intwaro zo gukora ibyaha, ahuubwo mwihe Imaana nk’abazima bavuuye mu rupfu, ibice by’imibiri yaanyu mubyegurire Imaana kugira ngo mubikoreeshe ibyo gukiraanuka.
Koko reero icaaha ntikikabategeke, kuko mutakigengwa n’amategeko, ahuubwo mugengwa n’ubuntu bw’Imaana.
Noone tugire dute? Dukomeze gukora ibyaha kuko tutagengwa n’amategeko, ahuubwo tugengwa n’ubuntu bw’Imaana? Oya ntibikabeho!
Mbese ntimuuzi yuuko uwo mwiyeguriye mukamubeera imbaata zimwumvira, muri imbaata z’uwo mwumvira uwo? Kuba imbaata z’icaaha biizana urupfu, kandi kumvira Imaana bigaheesha gukiraanuka.
Ariko Imaana ishimwe kuko mwahoze muri imbaata z’icaaha ariko noone mukaba mwarakurikije inyigiisho mwigiishijwe mubikuuye ku mutima.
Mwavuuye ku ngoyi y’ububaata bw’icaaha muhinduka imbaata zo gukiraanuka.

Ndavuga nk’umuntu mbiteewe n’intege nke zaanyu za kamere muntu. Ubwo mwari mwareeguriye imibiri yaanyu gukora ibiteeye isoni n’ubugome, abe ari ko mwegurira imibiri yaanyu kuba imbaata zo gukiraanuka kugira ngo mwezwe.
Igihe mwari imbaata z’icaaha, ntimwagengwaga no gukiraanuka.
Mbese byabunguye iki? Ibyo mwakoraga ico gihe ubu bibateera isoni kuko amaheerezo yabyo ari urupfu.
Ariko ubwo mwabohoowe mu caaha, mukaba mutegekwa n’Imaana, inyungu zaanyu n’ukwezwa mukazaabona ubugingo buhoraho.
Kuko ibihembo by’ibyaha ari urupfu, ariko impaano y’Imaana ni ubugingo buhoraho bubonerwa muri Kristo Yesu Umwami waacu.
Mbese bavandimwe, ntimuuzi yuuko amategeko agenga umuntu igihe coose akiriho gusa?
Noone reero umugore washingiwe, itegeko rimuhambiira ku mugabo we igihe akiriho, ariko iyo umugabo amaze gupfa, itegeko ryo gushingiranwa ntiriba rikimufiteho ububaasha.

Nuuko reero, iyo umugabo we akiriho akamureka, akaja kwibaanira n’undi mugabo yitwa umusambanyi, ariko iyo umugabo we apfuuye aba abohoowe ku tegeko, ni co gituma ataba umusambanyi iyo acuuwe n’undi mugabo.
Namwe reero bavandimwe ico menyeesha ni iki, ntimukigengwa n’amategeko ubwo Kristo yabapfiiriye, kugira ngo mube ab’undi ari we wazuutse mu bapfuuye maze tukazeera imbuto mu guheereza Imaana.
Ubwo twari tukiri mu caaha, irari ry’ibibi ribyutswa n’amategeko ryaduteeraga kwera imbuto z’urupfu.

Ariko noone twabohoowe ku mategeko, kuko twapfuuye ku byerekeye itegeko ryari rituboshe. Ni co gituma dukorera Imaana tutagengwa n’inyandiko y' amategeko ishaaje ahuubwo dukorera mu bugingo busha dushobozwa n’Umwuka.

Mbese noone tuvuge iki? Ngo amategeko ni icaaha? Oya ntibikabeho! Ariko sinari kumenya icaaha iyo ntakimenyeeshwa n’amategeko. Iyo itegeko ritavuga riti, "Ntuukifuuze ibintu by’abandi," sinari kumenya yuuko kwifuuza ari icaaha.
Ariko icaaha kinyuze mu mategeko, caabyukije muri nje kwifuuza koose, kuko aho amategeko atari icaaha nticaabaho.
Keera, nanje nari muzima amategeko ataraabaho, aho itegeko ryaziye icaaha kirahembuuka,
maze ndapfa. Itegeko ryagenewe kuuzana ubugingo, rinzanira gupfa mu buryo bw’umwuka.
Koko icaaha ciitwaje itegeko, kiranyosha kiranyiciisha.
Bityo reero, amategeko ni ayeera, ndetse n’itegeko ryose ni iryera, riratunganye kandi ni ryiza.

Mbese nooneho ico ciiza kibe caaranzaniye urupfu? Oya ntibikabeho! Ahuubwo icaaha caakoreesheje ikiri iciiza kugira ngo kinzanire guciirwa urubanza rw’urupfu. Mbega ukuntu icaaha ari kibi! Ceerekana ububi bwaco bwose bukabije ciitwaje itegeko.
Tuuzi neeza yuuko amategeko akomooka ku Maana, ariko ikibazo canje n’uko nkurikiza kamere muntu, nkaba imbaata y’icaaha.
Koko reero sinzi ico nkora kuko ico nshaaka gukora si co nkora, ahuubwo ico nanga akaba ari co nkora.
Ubwo reero nkora ico ntashaaka, ndemera yuuko amategeko ari meeza.
Bityo reero si nje ubikora, ahuubwo ni icaaha gituura muri nje.
Nzi neeza yuuko mu mutima wanje ntaaciiza kindimo ku bwa kamere yanje, kuko mpora nifuuza gukora iciiza ariko kugikora bikaananira.
Kuko iciiza nifuuza si co nkora, ahuubwo ikibi ntashaaka akaba ari co nkora.
Niiba reero ibyo ntifuuza gukora ari byo nkora, si nje ubikora ahuubwo ni icaaha gituuye muri nje.
Ibyo maze kubona mu buzima ni ibi: Iyo nshaatse gukora iciiza, nsanga nahisemo gukora ikibi.
Nkunda amategeko y’Imaana n’umutima wanje woose.
Ariko mbona irindi tegeko ryo mu ngingo z’umubiri wanje rirwanya itegeko ry’umutima wanje, ku buryo rituma mba imbohe y’itegeko ry’icaaha kiba mu ngingo z’umubiri wanje.
Yemwe ko mboonye ishano! Ni nde wankiza uyu mubiri unjaana mu rupfu?
Imaana ishimwe kuko ni yo yankiza muri Yesu Kristo Umwami waacu. Naho ubundi, nje mu mutima wanje ndi imbaata y’amategeko y’Imaana, ariko muri kamere ndi imbaata y’amategeko y’ibyaha.
Nuuko reero abari muri Kristo Yesu ntibaciirwaho iteeka.
Kuko itegeko ry’Umwuka w’ubugingo bwo muri Kristo Yesu ryadukuuye mu bubaata bw’itegeko ry’ibyaha n’urupfu.

Ibyo amategeko yananiwe gukora ku bw’intege z’umubiri, Imaana yarabikoze ubwo yohereje Umwana waayo afite ishusho ya kamere y’ibyaha, ngo abe igitambo c’ibyaha byo abandi baakoze maze aciiraho iteeka ibyaha bya kamere.
Imaana yakoze ibi, kugira ngo gukiraanuka kuuzanwa n’amategeko gusohozwe muri twe abatagengwa na kamere y’umubiri, ahuubwo bagengwa n’Umwuka.
Kuko abo bagengwa na kamere y’umubiri biita ku by’umubiri naho abagengwa n’Umwuka, bo biita ku by’Umwuka.
Kugengwa na kamere y’umubiri biteera urupfu, ariko kugengwa n’Umwuka biizana ubugingo n’amahoro.
Kuko iyo ibiteekerezo by’umuntu bigengwa na kamere y’umubiri, aba ari umwanzi w’Imaana, kuko atumvira amategeko y’Imaana kandi ntanazaabikore.
Kandi burya, abo bagengwa na kamere y’umubiri ntibashobora kuneezeeza Imaana.
Ariko mwebwe ntimugengwa na kamere muntu, ahuubwo mugengwa n’Umwuka ubwo Umwuka w’Imaana aba muri mwe. Umuntu udafite Umwuka wa Kristo ntaaba ari uwe.
Ariko niiba Kristo ari muri mwe, nuubwo umubiri uzaapfa ku mpamvu y’icaaha, Umwuka uzaatuma mubaho ku bwo gukiraanuka.
Niiba kandi Umwuka w’uwazuuye Yesu mu bapfuuye uba muri mwe, Uwazuuye Kristo Yesu azaazuura n’imibiri yaanyu igenewe gupfa ku bw’Umwuka waayo utuuye muri mwe.
Nuuko reero bavandimwe, dufite inshingano, ariko atari iyo kubaho nk’uko kamere muntu yaacu ishaaka ngo tubeho.
Kuko nimubaho mugengwa na kamere muntu muzaapfa, ariko niiba Umwuka ubafasha kureka ibikorwa bya kamere muntu muzaabaho.
Abo boose bayoborwa n’Umwuka w’Imaana, ni bo baana b’Imaana.
Kuko mutaahaawe Umwuka w’ububaata ubasubiza mu bwoba, ahuubwo mwakiiriye Umwuka ubahindura abaana b’Imaana bituma mubwira Imaana muti, "Daata, Daata!"
Umwuka w’Imaana ubwe wemeranya n’umwuka waacu guhamya yuuko turi abaana b’Imaana,
kandi ubwo turi abaana baayo, turi n’abaragwa, ndetse turi abaragwa b’ibyo Imaana yaseezeranyije bityo reero turi n’abasangira umurage na Kristo niiba tubaana na we ngo tuzaahabwe ikuzo na we.
Ndeeba ko kubabazwa ducamo muri iki gihe kudakwiriye kugereranywa n’ikuzo tuzaahishuurirwa.
Ndetse n’ibyaremwe byose bitegerezanya amatsiko ngo bireebe guhishuurwa kw’abaana b’Imaana.
Koko reero ibyaremwe byose biriho nta byiringiro, atari ku bushaake bwabyo, ahuubwo ari ku bushaake bw’uwabikoze. Ariko hariho ibyiringiro
yuuko ibyaremwe ubwabyo, umunsi umwe bizaavanwa mu bubaata bw’imbaraga z’urupfu bigasangira umudendeezo w’ikuzo w’abaana b’Imaana.
Tuuzi neeza yuuko ibyaremwe byose binihira hamwe, bikanababazwa nk’ibise by’umugore wenda kubyara kugeza na n’ubu.
Nyamara si ibyo biremwa byonyine ahuubwo naatwe abaahaawe umuganura w' Umwuka, tunihira mu mitima yaacu dutegereje guhindurwa abaana b’Imaana ari ko gucungurwa kw’imibiri yaacu.
Twarakijijwe ku bw’ibyiringiro, ariko iyo umaze kureeba ibyo wizeeraga ntibiba bikiri ibyiringiro. Ntaamuntu wakwiringira ico amaze kubona.
Ariko niiba twiringira kuzaabona ico tutareeba ubu, tugitegereze twihanganye.
Ni co kimwe, n’Umwuka Weera adufasha mu ntege nke zaacu. Kuko tutaazi ibyo twasaba mu gusenga, ariko Umwuka ubwe akadutakambira aniha iminiho irenze imivugire.
Kandi Imaana izi ibiri mu mitima yaacu, izi n’ibyo Umwuka yifuuza, kuko Umwuka asabira abeejejwe nk’uko Imaana ishaaka.
Kandi tuuzi ko Imaana ikorera muri byose kuuzanira ibyiza abayikunda, abo yahamagaye nk’uko yabigambiiriye.
Abo Imaana yamenye kuva keera, yanabatooranyirije kumera nk’Umwana waayo, kugira ngo uwo Mwana abe ari we uba imfura muri beene se benshi.
Abo Imaana yatooranyije keera yarabahamagaye, kandi abo yahamagaye yarabatsindiishirije, n’abo yatsindiishirije yabahaaye ikuzo.
Mbese ibyo twabivugaho iki? Ubwo Imaana iri kumwe naatwe, ni nde waturwanya?
Ubwo itaatwimye Umwana waayo, ahuubwo ikamudutangira twese, izaabura ite kutugabira ibindi byose hamwe na we?
Ni nde uzaarega abo Imaana yatooranyije? Ntaawe kuko Imaana ari yo ibaha kuba intungaane.
Mbese ni nde wabaciiraho iteeka? Ntaan’umwe kuko ni Yesu Kristo ari we wapfuuye ndetse akazuuka ubu akaba ari iburyo bw’Imaana adutakambira.
Ni nde wadutandukanya n’urukundo rwa Kristo? Mbese ni amakuba, cangwa agahinda, cangwa gutootezwa, cangwa inzara, cangwa kwambara ubusa, cangwa kuba mu kaaga, cangwa urupfu?
Nk’uko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Turiicwa umunsi ukiira baduhoora wowe, batugirira nk’intaama zaagenewe kubaagwa."
Ariko muri byose tukarushaho gutsinda, tubikeesha uwadukunze.
Koko reero nzi neeza ntashidiikanya yuuko n’ubwo haaba urupfu cangwa ubuzima, cangwa abaamalayika cangwa abategeka, cangwa ibiriho ubu cangwa ibizaaza,
cangwa ibyo heejuru cangwa iby’ikuzimu, cangwa icaaremwe ico ari co coose, nta na kimwe kizaabaasha kudutandukanya n’urukundo rw’Imaana rubonerwa muri Kristo Yesu Umwami waacu.
Ndavuga ukuri, ndi uwa Kristo, simbeesha. Umutimanaama wanje urabihamya uyobowe n’Umwuka Weera.
Mfite agahinda kenshi n’intimba idatuuza mu mutima wanje.
Koko reero nakwifuuje kuba ari nje uvumwa n’Imaana ubwanje, ngatandukana na Kristo mbiiguraana abavandimwe banje duhuuje ubwoko.
Ni bo muryango wa Isirayeli Imaana yagize abaana baayo, bagahaabwa ikuzo, n’amaseezerano n’amategeko, no kuyisenga uko ishaaka kandi no kubaha ibyiza yabaseezeranyije.
Ba seekuruza ni bo na Kristo akomookaho, ukurikije igiseekuruza c’abantu. Imaana itegeka byose ni ihimbaazwe iteeka ryose, Amiina.
Nyamara si ukuvuga ko Imaana yananiwe gusohoza ibyo yaseezeranye, kuko abakomooka kuri Isirayeli atari ko boose ari Abiisirayeli nyakuri.

Kandi abakomooka kuri Aburahamu ku mubiri si ko boose biitwa abaana b’Imaana, keretse abaavuutse ku buryo bw' amaseezerano. Kuko Imaana yabwiye Aburahamu iti, "Kuri Isaaka ni ho urubyaro rwawe ruziitwa abaawe."
Ibyo ni ukuvuga yuuko abaana baakomootse kuri Aburahamu ku buryo busanzwe atari bo biitwa abaana b’Imaana ahuubwo abaavuutse ku buryo bw’amaseezerano y’Imaana ni bo beemerwa nk’urubyaro rwe.
Kuko iri ni ryo seezerano Imaana yahaaye Aburahamu iti, "Mu mwaka utaaha, mu gihe nk’iki, nzaagaruka kandi Saara azaaba yarabyaye umwana w’umuhungu."
Si n’ibyo gusa, hari na Rebeka wabyaye abaana babiri, bombi bakaba bafite se umwe ari we Isaaka sogokuruza.
Ariko igihe abaana bataraavuuka, bataraanakora iciiza cangwa ikibi,
kandi bidaturutse ku bikorwa ahuubwo biturutse kuri yo, Imaana yabwiye Rebeka iti, "Umukuru azaaba umugaragu w’umuto"
Nk’uko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Yaakobo naramukunze naho Esawu naramwanze"
Noone se twabivugaho iki? Mbese Imaana ntiibeera? Oya ntibikabeho.
Kuko yabwiye Moose iti, "Nzaagirira imbabazi n’impuhwe uwo nshaatse."
Nuuko reero ibyo ntibiteerwa n’ubushaake bw’umuntu cangwa ku mwete afite, ahuubwo biva ku mbabazi z’Imaana.
Kuko mu byanditswe Imaana yabwiye Faraawo iti, "Dore icaatumye ngushiraho kwari ukugira ngo nzeerekanire muri wowe imbaraga zanje kandi bitume izina ryanje ryamamazwa ku isi hoose."
Bityo reero, Imaana ibabarira uwo ishaaka kandi inangira umutima w’uwo ishaaka.
Mbese noone tuvuge iki, "Ni iki gituma Imaana igaya abantu? Mbese ni nde warwanya ubushaake bw’Imaana?"
Ariko wowe muntu uri nde kugira ngo ugiishe Imaana impaka? Mbese ikibumba caabaza uwakibumbye ngo, "Kuki wambumbye utya?"
Mbese umubumbyi si we ufite ubushobozi bwo gukora mu ibumba rimwe igikoreesho c’agaciiro n’igikoreesho gisanzwe?
Ni na ko Imaana ibishaatse yaagaragaza uburaakari bwayo no kwerekana ububaasha bwayo. Nyamara Imaana yihangaaniye abantu baayiteeraga uburaakari ndetse baagenewe kurimbuka.
Ibyo yabikoreye kugira ngo igaragaze ukuntu ikuzo ryayo rihebuuje ku bo ishaaka kugirira imbabazi, abo yateguuriye ikuzo uheereye keera.
Abo kandi ni twebwe bo Imaana yahamagaye, itadutooranyije mu Bayuuda gusa ahuubwo no mu banyamahanga.
Nk’uko Imaana yabivuze mu gitabo ca Hoseya iti, "Abaahoze batari ubwoko bwanje nzaabiita ‘ubwoko bwanje’, utari inkundwakazi nzamwita ‘inkundwakazi’.
Kandi ahantu baabwiriwe ngo ‘ntimuri ubwoko bwanje,’ ni ho baziitirirwa abaana b’Imaana nzima."
Yesaaya na we yavuze aranguruye ibifashe kuri Isirayeli ati, "Nuubwo Abiisirayeli bangana n’umuseenyi wo ku nyanja, igice gito kizaaba gisigaye ni co kizaarokoka,
kuko Nyagasani atazaatinda guciira urubanza abo ku isi mu buryo bukwiriye."
Kandi nk’uko Yesaaya yahanuuye keera ati, "Iyo Nyagasani Nyiringabo atadusigira urubyaro ruke, tuba twararimbutse nk' i Sodomu, tuba twarabaaye nk' i Gomora."
Mbese ibyo twabivugaho iki? Abanyamahanga bataagerageje gushaaka ibyo gukiraanuka baaragushikiiriye, ari ko gukiraanuka guheeshwa no Kwizeera,
naho Abiisirayeli baageragezaga gukurikiza amategeko yatuma bakiraanukira Imaana, nyamara ntaabwo baageze ku nteego amategeko yari agamije.

Ni ku mpamvu ki reero? Ni ku mpamvu yuuko uko gukiraanuka bataagukuuraga ku kwizeera Kristo, ahuubwo biiringiraga ko baguheeshwa no gukurikiza ibyo amategeko asaba. Bityo bituma basiitaara kuri rya buye risiitaaza
nk’uko byanditswe ngo, "Dore nshize muri Siyoni ibuye rizaasiitaaza abantu, urutare ruzaabaguusha. Nyamara uzamwemera weese ntaazaakorwa n’isoni."
Bavandimwe ibyo niifuuriza Abiisirayeli mbikuuye ku mutima kandi mbasabira ku Maana, ni uko baakizwa.
Ndabahamiriza yuuko bafite ishaka ryo gukorera Imaana, ariko ridashingiye ku kuyimenya.
Kuko ntibaasobaanukiwe ubutungaane buturuka ku Maana, ahuubwo baashaatse gushiraho uburyo bwabo bwo kuba intungaane bityo reero ntibakurikize ubutungaane buva ku Maana.
Kuko kuuza kwa Kristo kwatumye amategeko atagira agaciiro kugira ngo umwizeera weese Imaana imugire intungaane.
Moose ubwe yanditse ibyerekeye gutungaanira Imaana bituruka ku mategeko agira ati, "Uzumvira amategeko azaabeeshwaho na yo."

Nyamara ico ibyanditswe bivuga ku byerekeye ubutungaane buvuuye ku kwizeera ni iki, "Ntuukiibaze mu mutima waawe uti, ‘Ni nde washobora kuzaamuuka mu ijuru?’ " Bimenyeesha kumanura Kristo akaaza ku isi.
"Cangwa ngo wiibaze uti, ‘Ni nde washobora kumanuka ikuzimu?’ " Bimenyeesha kuvaana Kristo mu baapfuuye.
Ico bivuga ni iki, "Ijambo ry’Imaana rirakwegeereye, riri mu kanwa kaawe no mu mutima waawe." Ni ryo jambo ryo kwizeera tubwiriza.
Kuko niwaatura n’akanwa kaawe ko Yesu ari Umwami kandi ukeemera mu mutima waawe ko Imaana yamuzuuye mu baapfuuye uzaakizwa.
Kuko umutima ari wo umuntu yizeeza bigatuma Imaana imugira intungaane naho kubyatura mu kanwa bigatuma akizwa.
Kuko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Uwizeera Kristo weese ntaazaakorwa n’isoni."
Ibi bifashe kuri buri weese, kuko ntaatandukaniro ry’Umuyuuda n’Umugiriki, boose bafite Umwami umwe kandi ni na we ugirira ubuntu abamwambaza boose.
Kuko ibyanditswe biravuga ngo, "Umuntu weese uzambaza izina rya Nyagasani azaakizwa"
Ariko se bamwambaza bate batabanje kumwemera? Kandi bamwemera bate bataariigeze ku mwumva? Mbese bamwumva bate hatabonetse umuntu wo kumwamamaza?
Ikindi kandi, abantu bamwamamaza bate ntaawe ubatumye? Ni co gituma ibyanditswe bigira biti, "Mbeega ukuntu ari byiza kureeba ibirenge by’abaazanye Inkuru Nziiza!"
Nyamara si boose bumviye Inkuru Nziiza. Nk’uko Yesaaya yavuze ati, "Nyagasani, ni nde wumviye ubutumwa bwacu ?"
Bityo reero, ugira kwizeera umaze kumva ubutumwa, kandi ubwo butumwa ni ukubwirwa ijambo rya Kristo.
Ariko noone ndabaza nti, "Mbese abantu ntibumviise ubwo butumwa? Yee, ni koko baarabwumviise." Kuko ibyanditswe biravuga ngo, "Ijwi ryabo ryakwiye ku isi yoose, ubutumwa bwageze ku mpera z’isi."

Reka nongere mbaze nti, mbese Abiisirayeli ntibaabisobaanukiwe? Moose ni we wabanje kuvuga ati, "Nzaabaharika abanyamahanga, batume mugira ishari. Nzaakoreesha ubwoko bw’abanyabwenge buke, bitume abantu banje baraakara."
Kandi na Yesaaya yabivuze yeruye ati, "Abataaranshaakaga baramboonye, niigaragarije abataariigeze bambaririza."
Ariko ku byerekeye Abiisirayeli Yesaaya arababwira ati, "Niirije umunsi woose nteze amaboko ngo naakiire ubwoko butumvira kandi bwigometse."
Nooneho reka mbaze, mbese Imaana yaaba yaranze abantu baayo? Oya! Ntibishoboka! Kuko nanje ubwanje ndi Umwisirayeli ukomooka mu rubyaro rwa Aburahamu, wo mu muryango wa Benjamiini.
Imaana ntiyanze abantu baayo yiitooranyirije kuva keera. Mbese ntimuuzi ico ibyanditswe bivuga uburyo Eliya yiitotombye ubwo yaregaga Abiisirayeli ku Maana? Yaravuze ati,
"Nyagasani, biishe abahanuuzi baawe nuuko basenya intambiro zaawe, ni nje njenyine usigaye kandi dore nanje barampiiga ngo banyice."
Mbese Imaana yamushubije iki? Yaramushubije iti, "Niisigarije abantu ibihumbi birindwi bataraapfukama ngo baramye ikigirwamaana Baali."
No muri iki gihe hari agace gato k’abantu basigaye abo Imaana yitooranyirije ku bw’ubuntu bwayo.
Imaana yabahisemo ku bw’ubuntu yabagiriye itabiteewe n’ibikorwa byabo. Kuko bitabaaye bityo ubuntu igira bwaba butakiri ubuntu nyakuri.
Noone tuvuge iki? Ico Abiisirayeli baashaakaaga ntaabwo baakiboonye, ahuubwo abaakiboonye ni agatsiko gato ko Imaana yiitooranyirije naho abandi boose Imaana yanangiye imitima yaabo.
Nk’uko byanditswe ngo, "Imaana yatumye imitima yaabo n’ibiteekerezo byabo bibura ubwenge, n’amaaso yaabo atabona n’amatwi atumva kugeza n’aya magingo."
Na Dawudi aravuga ati, "Reka amafunguro yaabo ababeere nk’umutego, bibabeere nk’ibuye ryo kubasiitaaza n’igihano kibakwiriye.
Reka amaaso yaabo ahume beekureeba, uteeze imigongo yaabo guhora ihetamye iteeka ryose."

Nuuko reero ndabaza nti, mbese ubwo Abiisirayeli baasiitaaraga kwari ukugwa buheriheri? Oya! Ntibikabeho! Kuko gucumura kwabo kwatumye agakiza kagera ku banyamahanga, kugira ngo biteere Abiisirayeli ishari.
Niiba kugwa kw’Abisirayeli kwaratumye abari mu isi baheeshwa umugisha, gucoogora kwabo kukaazanira abanyamahanga ubutunzi, mbese noone ntibizaarushaho Abayuuda boose nibiizeera bagakizwa?
Ariko ndababwira mwebwe abanyamahanga. Ni nje ntumwa Kristo yatumye ku banyamahanga, kandi niiraatiisha umurimo nahaawe
kugira ngo nteeze ishari beene waacu b’Abiisirayeli kandi mbone uko ndokora bamwe muri bo.
Koko reero niiba kwangwa kw’Abiisirayeli kwaraheesheje abari mu isi kwiyunga n’Imaana, mbese kwemerwa kwabo kuzaazana iki? Kuzaazanira ubuzima abaapfuuye.
Niiba igisate c’umugaati bagituura Imaana nk’umuganura, byerekana yuuko uwo mugaati woose na wo ari uwaayo. Kandi niiba imizi y’igiti yeejejwe, n’amashami yaaco aba yeejejwe.

Mwebwe abanyamahanga mumeze nk’amashami y’igiti ca elayo co mu ishamba yagemetswe ku giti ca Elayo giteewe. Mwagiiye mu mwanya w’ayo mashami yagikonzweho. No ku bw’iyo mpamvu, musangiye iyo migisha iva mu kuba igice c’igiti caateewe.
Nuuko reero ntuukiishire heejuru wiiraata kuri ya mashami. Wiibuke ko atari wowe ushigikiye imizi, ahuubwo imizi ni yo igushigikiye.
Ahaari wavuga uti, "Amashami yarakonzwe kugira ngo mbone uko nteerwa ku giti."
Yee ni ukuri. Ico ayo mashami yazize ni ukuteemera. Naho wowe ikiguhagaritse ni ukwizeera Kristo kwawe. Nuuko reero ntukiraate, ahuubwo utinye Imaana.
Kuko ubwo Imaana itaababariye abaagereranyijwe n’amashami ya kavuukire, naawe ntiizaakubabarira.

Hano tureeba kugira neeza kw’Imaana kandi n’uburaakari bwayo, abanze kuyumvira yarabaraakariye naho wowe wayumviye ikugirira neeza kandi izaakomeza kukugirira neeza nuuguma mu buntu bwayo. Ariko nuuteeshuka, naawe uzaakondwa nka ya mashami.
Naho Abayuuda nibareka kuteemera kwabo, bazaaba nk’amashami yakonzwe akagemekwa aho yahoze mbere. Kuko Imaana ifite ububaasha bwo kongera kubagemeka aho baahoze.

Mwebwe abanyamahanga mumeze nk’ishami kamere ryavuuye ku giti ca elayo co mu ishamba ryahaguwe haanyuma ku buryo bunyuranye n’imihingire idasanzwe y’ibiti, uteerwa ku giti ca elayo caateewe mu buryo bwiza. Mbese Abayuuda ko ari bo mashami ya kamere y’ico giti ca elayo caateewe mu buryo bwiza hari icaababuza guteerwa ku giti caabo ca elayo?

Bavandimwe, sinshaaka ko mutamenya iri banga hato mukitwara nk’aho muri abanyabwenge. Ico menyeesha ni uko bamwe mu Bisirayeli biinangiiye imitima. Ibyo bizaakomeza kugeza igihe umubare w' abanyamahanga bizeera Kristo ushitse.
Ni bwo umuryango woose wa Isirayeli uzaakizwa, nk’uko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Umukiza azaaturuka i Siyoni akuureho kugomera Imaana koose mu bakomooka kuri Yaakobo.
Iri ni ryo seezerano nzaagirana na bo, ubwo nzaabakuuraho ibyaha byabo."
Ku byerekeye Ubutumwa Bwiza, Abayuuda baabaaye abanzi b’Imaana ku bwanyu mwe banyamahanga. Ariko ku byerekeye gutooranya kw’Imaana, ni abatoni baayo ku bwa ba seekuruza.
Kuko Imaana ntiyiisubiza ibyo yatanze, cangwa ngo yiivuguruze iyo yatooranyije.
Nk’uko mwebwe abanyamahanga keera mwagomeraga Imaana, noone ubu yabagiriye imbabazi biteewe n’uko Abayuuda banze kumvira.
Bityo nabo ubu banze kumvira Imaana kugira ngo, imbabazi mwagiriwe, na bo zibaheeshe kubabarirwa.
Imaana yeemereye abantu boose kuba imbohe zo kutayumvira, kugira ngo ibabarire boose.
Mbeega uburyo ubutunzi n’ubwenge n’ubumenyi bw’Imaana burenze urugero! Imigambi yaayo ni amayobera kandi imigenzereze yaayo ntaawayimenya.
Ibyanditswe biravuga biti, "Ni nde wamenya ibyo Nyagasani ateekereza? Ni nde wamubeereye umujaanaama?
Ni nde wiigeze abanza kugira ico amuha, kugira ngo na we azaabimwituure?"
Kuko byose bikomooka ku Maana, ni yo ibeeshaho ibyo yaremye byose kandi byose byagenewe kuba ibyayo. Icuubahiro kibe ic’Imaana iteeka ryose! Amiina.

Noone reero bavandimwe, ndabiihanangiriza ku bw' imbabazi z’Imaana yatugiriye, ngo mwitange maze mube ibitambo bizima byeguriwe Imaana kandi biyishiimiisha. Ubu ni bwo buryo bukwiriye bwo kuramyamo Imaana.

Ntimukiigaane imyifatire y’ab’iki gihe turimo, ahuubwo muhinduke by’ukuri, Imaana ivugurure ibiteekerezo byanyu. Ni bwo muzaashobora kumenya ibyo Imaana ishaaka ari byo byiza biyishiimishije kandi bitunganye rwose.
Ku bw’ubuntu Imaana yangiriye, ndabwira buri umwe muri mwe kutiiteekerezaho birenze urugero muriho. Ahuubwo mukoreeshe ukuri mu gihe mwiteekerezaho mukurikije urugero Imaana yabahaaye rwo Kwizeera.
Kuko dufite ingingo nyinshi mu mubiri umwe kandi izo ngingo ntizigira umurimo umwe.
Ni co kimwe, nuubwo turi benshi, turi umubiri umwe muri Kristo, twese duhuurijwe hamwe, buri muntu akaba urugingo rwa mugenzi we.
Dufite impaano zitandukanye hakurikijwe ubuntu Imaana yatugiriye. Niiba twarahaawe impaano yo guhanuura, tuje duhanuura dukurikije ukwizeera dufite.
Niiba twarahaawe impaano yo guheereza abandi ngaaho ni tubikore, niiba twarahaawe impaano yo kwigiisha, nitwigiishe,
niiba twarahaawe impaano yo gukomeza abandi, tubakomeze, utanga, naatange ntaakindi akurikiye, uyobora abandi naabikorane umwete kandi ugira imbabazi naazigire yishiimye.
Muje mukundana mutaryarya, mwange ibibi urunuuka, mwibande ku byiza.
Mukundane urukundo rwa kivandimwe, mwubahane, buri umwe ashire imbere mugenzi we.
Mwekuba abanebwe, ahuubwo mukorere Nyagasani mufite ishaka ryinshi.
Mwishiimire ibyo mwiringiye, mwihangaane mu makuba kandi musenge igihe coose.
Bagenzi baanyu b’abakristo bakennye, mubafashiishe ku byo mufite, abantu baaje muri mwe ari basha mubacumbikire.
Musabire umugisha ababatooteza, koko mubasabire umugisha atari umuvumo.
Mwishiimane n’abiishiima, murirane n’abarira.
Muje mubaana amahoro n’abantu boose, ntimukiishire heejuru uko bidakwiriye ahuubwo mwemere gufatanya n’abaciiye bugufi. Ntimukiigire abanyabwenge.
Ntimukiituure umuntu inaabi yabagiriye. Muharanire gukora ibigaragarira abantu boose ko ari byiza.
Uko bishoboka koose, ku rwanyu ruhande, mubaane amahoro n’abantu boose.
Nshuti zanje, ntimukiihoorere ahuubwo muje mureka Imaana ibikore mu buraakari bwayo. Kuko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Guhoora no kwituura ni ibyanje, ni ko Uhoraho avuga."
Ahandi mu byanditswe haravuga ngo, "Umwanzi waawe naasonza umuhe ico kurya, naagira imyota umuhe ico kunywa, kuko nuukora utyo bizaatuma akorwa n’isoni."
Ntuukeemere ko ikibi kigutsinda, ahuubwo utsinde ikibi ukoreesheje iciiza.
Umuntu weese akwiriye kumvira abategetsi, kuko ntaabutegetsi bubaho budaturutse ku Maana, n’abategetsi bariho baashizweho n’Imaana.
Ni co gituma ugomeye abategetsi aba agomeye ico Imaana yategetse kandi abakora batyo bazaaciirwa urubanza.
Abategetsi si abo gutinywa n’abakora neeza, ahuubwo ni abakora naabi babatiinya. Mbese ushaaka kudatiinya umutegetsi? Uje ukora neeza ni bwo bazaagushiima.

Kuko abategetsi ni abagaragu b’Imaana baashiriweho kugira ngo ugere ku ciiza. Ariko nuukora naabi ugomba kumutiinya kuko ububaasha afite bwo guhana ntiyabuheerewe ubusa. Ni abagaragu b’Imaana baashiriweho guhana inkozi z’ibibi bagaragaza uburaakari bw’Imaana.
Ni yo mpamvu ukwiriye kumvira abategetsi, bidateewe no gutiinya guhanwa n’Imaana, ahuubwo ubyemejwe n’umutimanaama.
Ni co gituma mukwiriye gutanga imisoro, kuko abasoreesha ari abakozi Imaana yashizeho biitangiye gukora uwo murimo.
Muje muha buri muntu ikimugenewe. Usoreesha mumusorere, abasaba ubusuura mububahe, abakwiriye kubahwa mubuubahe.
Ntihakagire umuntu weese mubamo umwenda keretse uwo gukundana, kuko ukunda mugenzi we aba yumviye amategeko.

Kuko amategeko avuga ngo, "Ntuugasambane, ntuukiice, ntuukiibe, ntuukiifuuze ibintu by’abandi batunze". Hamwe n’ayandi mategeko yoose, akubiye muri iri jambo ngo, "Ukunde mugenzi waawe nk’uko wikunda."
Niiba ukunda mugenzi waawe ntiwamugirira naabi, nuuko reero gukunda ni ko kumvira amategeko mu bwuzuye.
Muje mukora mutyo reero kuko muzi igihe turimo, turi mu gihe co gukanguka mu bitotsi. Dore agakiza kaacu karatwegeereye kuruta igihe twatangiraga kwizeera Kristo.
Ijoro rirakuze, bugiiye guca. Nuuko reero tureke ibikorwa by’umwijima, twambare intwaro z’umuco.
Twifate neeza, nk’abagendera mu muco, tutarangwaho kuraara inkeera no gusinda, ubusambanyi, ubwomanzi, intonganya n’ishari.
Ahuubwo mwambare Nyagasani Yesu Kristo ababe haafi nk’umwambaro, kandi ntimukiishinge kamere y’imibiri yaanyu ngo ibakoreeshe ibyo irarikira.
Muje mwakiira umunyantege nke mu kwizeera, mwekumugiisha impaka ku byo yiibwira bitandukanye n’ibyanyu.
Bamwe beemera yuuko bakwiriye kurya ibyokurya byose naho abafite intege nke bakiiriira imboga gusa.
Urya byose yeegusuuzugura urobaanura, kandi urobaanura yeeguciira urubanza urya byose kuko na we Imaana yaramwakiiriye.

Uri nde wowe uciira umugaragu w’undi urubanza? Ni sheebuja waahitamo niiba akora neeza cangwa naabi. Kandi azaakora neeza kuko sheebuja, ari we Nyagasani, afite ububaasha bwo kumushigikira agakora neeza.
Abantu bamwe buubaha umunsi umwe bakawurutiisha indi, naho abandi bagasanga iminsi yoose ari kimwe. Umuntu weese agomba gukurikiza ico umutima we umubwira.

Umuntu wuubahiriza umunsi umwe akawurutiisha indi, abikorerera kuubahiisha Nyagasani. N’urya byose abikorera kuubahiisha Nyagasani kuko abishiimira Imaana. Umuntu urobaanura ibyo arya na we aba abikorera kubahiisha Nyagasani kandi agashiimira Imaana.
Koko reero ntaamuntu n’umwe muri twe ubaho ku bwe, cangwa ngo apfe ku bwe.
Niiba turiho, turiho ku bwa Nyagasani, kandi niiba dupfa, dupfa ku bwa Nyagasani. Bityo reero twabaho cangwa dupfuuye, turi aba Nyagasani.
Ni co caatumye Kristo apfa akazuuka kugira ngo abe Umwami w’abazima n’abaapfuuye.
Mbese ni iki gituma uciira umuvandimwe waawe urubanza? Kandi ni iki gituma usuuzugura umuvandimwe waawe? Tumenye ko twese tuziitaba imbere y’intebe y’Imaana iduciira urubanza.
Kuko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Uhoraho aravuga ati, ‘Ndarahiye, buri muntu azamfukamira, kandi indimi zoose zizaatura zihimbaaza ko ari nje Maana.’ "
Nuuko reero buri muntu weese azaamurikira Imaana ibyo yakoze.
Nuuko reero ntitukongere guciirirana imanza, ahuubwo duhitemo kudakora icaasiitaaza mugenzi waawe cangwa ngo kimuguushe mu caaha.
Ico nzi neeza kandi ntashidiikanya muri Nyagasani Yesu, ni uko ari ntaakintu kiriho caahumaanya umuntu ubwaco. Ariko uwaateekereza ko ikintu gihumaanya koko kiba kimuhumaanyije.
Niiba umuvandimwe waawe ateerwa agahinda n’ibyo uriiye, ntuuba ukigengwa n’urukundo. Wiirinde udatuma ibyo urya bibeera umuvandimwe waawe ibyo kumurimbura, kandi Kristo yaramupfiiriye.
Ikibabeereye ciiza ntikikavugwe n’abandi bantu nk’ikibi.
Kuko Ubwami bw’Imaana atari ukurya no kunywa, ahuubwo n’imikorere irangwa no gukiraanuka, amahoro, n’ibyishiimo duheeshwa n’Umwuka Weera.
Ukorera Kristo atyo, ashiimiisha Imaana kandi akeemerwa n’abantu.
Nuuko reero duharanire gukora ibiheesha amahoro n’ibyo gukomeza bagenzi baacu.
Ntuugasenye umurimo w’Imaana ubiteewe n’ibyokurya. Ntaabyokurya bihumaanya, ariko ikibi ni uko umuntu yarya icaatuma undi agwa mu caaha.
Ni byiza kutarya inyama cangwa kutanywa divaayi, cangwa kudakora ikindi kintu coose caasiitaaza umuvandimwe waawe.
Imyemerere yaawe kuri ibyo ibe hagati yaawe n’Imaana. Hahiirwa umuntu utiiciira urubanza ku byo yeemeye gukora.
Ariko umuntu weese urya ashidiikanya aba yiiciiriye urubanza, kuko aba ariiye ibinyuranye n’ibyo umutima we umwemeza. Kandi igikorwa coose kinyuranye n’ico umutima ukwemeza kiba ari icaaha.
Twebwe abakomeye mu kwizeera tugomba kwihangaanira abafite intege nke mu kwizeera, ntitwineezeeze ubwacu.
Buri muntu muri twe aneezeeze mugenzi we, ashaake ibyiza bimugirira akamaro bikamwubaka mu kwizeera.
Kuko na Kristo ubwe ntiyiishaakiye ibimuneezeeza, ahuubwo byamubeereye nk’uko ibyanditswe bivuga biti, "Ibitutsi baagututse ni nje byahamye."
Ibyanditswe mbere byose byandikiwe kutwigiisha kugira ngo kwihangaana no guhuumurizwa dukuura muri byo biduheeshe kwiringira ibizaaba.
Nuuko Imaana ari yo sooko yo kwihangaana no guhuumuriza, ibahe guhuuza imitima mukurikije urugero rwa Kristo Yesu,
kugira ngo mwese hamwe no mu ijwi rimwe muheeshe ikuzo Imaana Se w’Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo.
Nuuko reero buri muntu aje yaakiira mugenzi we nk’uko na Kristo ubwe yabaakiiriye kugira ngo biheeshe Imaana icuubahiro.
Ndababwira yuuko Kristo yabaaye umuheereza w’Abayuuda, kugira ngo yeerekane ubudahemuka bw’Imaana, mu gusohoza amaseezerano yagiriye ba seekuruza.
Kwari ukugira ngo abanyamahanga baheeshe Imaana icuubahiro ku bw’imbabazi yabagiriye. Nk’uko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Nzaagusingiza mu banyamahanga, kandi nzaakuririmbira indirimbo z’ishimwe."
Kandi ngo, "Mwa banyamahanga mwese mwe, nimwishiimane n’abantu baayo."
Kandi ngo, "Mwa banyamahanga mwese mwe, nimusingize Nyagasani, abantu b’amooko yoose nibamusingize!"
Yesaaya na we yarabisongeye ati, "Umuntu ukomooka mu muryango wa Yese azaaza, azaaza gutegeka abanyamahanga, ni we abanyamahanga baziiringira."
Imaana nyir’ibyiringiro ibuuzuzemo ibyishiimo n’amahoro muheeshwa no kwemera, kugira ngo mubone kwiringira ku bw’imbaraga z’Umwuka Weera.
Bavandimwe, njeewe ubwanje ndeemezwa ko mwebwe ubwanyu mwuzuye kugira neeza, mwuzuye ubumenyi bwose kandi ko mushobora no kwigiishanya.
Icakora hamwe na hamwe muri uru rwandiko nanditse nshize amanga mbiibutsa ku bw’ubuntu bw’Imaana nahaawe,

bwo kuba umukozi wa Yesu Kristo mu banyamahanga nk’umuheerezabitambo watumwe kubwiriza Ubutumwa Bwiza bw’Imaana, kugira ngo abo banyamahanga babone uko baaba ituuro ryemerwa n’Imaana kandi ryejejwe n’Umwuka Weera.
Ni yo mpamvu reero niiraata mu murimo nkorera Imaana mbishobojwe no kuba muri Yesu Kristo.
Ni ukuri sinaatinyuka kugira ico mvuga uretse ibyo Kristo yankoreesheje ngo abanyamahanga bumvire Imaana. Yabikoze mu magambo yanje ndetse no mu bikorwa byanje,
mu mbaraga z’ibimenyeetso n’ibitangaaza kandi no mu mbaraga z’Umwuka w’Imaana. Bityo reero kuva i Yerusaalemu ukiitooroora ukagera muri Iluriko, nahaamamaje Ubutumwa Bwiza bwa Kristo.
Inteego naharaniye kwari ukwamamaza Ubutumwa Bwiza mu bice byo izina rya Kristo ritaari ryakamenyekanyemo, kugira ngo ntuubaka ku rufatiro rwashizweho n’undi.
Nk’uko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Abataariigeze babwirwa ibye bazaabimenya, abataariigeze bamwumva bazaamusobaanukirwa."
Ku bw’umurimo wo ku bwiriza muri ibyo bice, ni yo mpamvu yambujije kenshi kuuza iwaanyu.
Ariko noone ubwo ndangije umurimo nari mfite mu bice by’ino, nkaba kandi nariifuuje igihe kireekire kuuza iwaanyu,
nooneho, ubwo nzaaba nja muri Sipaniya, niiringira ko nzaabanyuraho nkabasuura, kandi namwe mukampa impamba mu rugendo maze kuneezeezwa no kubazindukira akaanya gato.
Icakora, ubu ngiiye i Yerusaalemu njaaniye abeemera baaho ubufasha.
Kuko amatoorero y’i Makedooniya na Akaya biiyemeje gusorooza imfashanyo zo gufashiisha abakene bo mu beemera b’i Yerusaalemu.

Biishiimiye kubikora, kandi koko baari bafite umwenda wo kubikora. Byari bikwiriye, kuko ubwo Abayuuda basangiye n’abanyamahanga imigisha iva ku Mwuka w’Imaana, na bo bafite umwenda wo gusangira na bo ibyiza imibiri yaabo ikeneye.
Ubwo nzaaba maze kubashikiriza ibyo baashorooje byose, nzaavayo nyure iwaanyu nje i Sipaniya.
Kandi nzi yuuko ninza kubasuura nzaabaazanira umugisha ugwiriye wa Kristo.
Bavandimwe, ndabiihanangiririza ku bwa Nyagasani Yesu Kristo n’urukundo ruva ku Mwuka w’Imaana ngo mumfashe mu masengeesho munsabira ku Maana.
Munsengere, Imaana indinde abo muri Yudeeya batiizeera kandi n’imfashanyo njaanye i Yerusaalemu yakiirwe neeza n’abantu b’Imaana.
Bityo reero nzaashobore kuuza iwaanyu mfite umuneezeero maze Imaana niibishaaka mbone kuruhuuka turi kumwe.
Imaana ari yo sooko y’amahoro, ibaane namwe mwese! Amiina.
Mbashiimiye Foyibe mushiki waacu ari we Mudiyakonikazi w’itoorero ry’i Kenkireya,
kugira ngo mumwakiire muri Nyagasani nk’uko bikwiriye abeera kandi mumufashe mu byo azaaba akeneye byose. Erega na we yafashije abantu benshi nanje mbarimo.
Muntaahirize Purisikila n’umugabo we Akwila, abakozi bagenzi banje twakoranye umurimo wa Kristo Yesu.
Abo biiyemeje no gupfa kugira ngo bakize ubuzima bwanje. Si nje njenyine ubashiima ahuubwo n’amatoorero yoose yo mu banyamahanga.
Mutaashe n’itoorero rya Kristo riteeranira mu rugo rwabo. Muntaahirize n’inshuti yanje nkunda Epayineto ari we wabanjirije abo muri Asiya boose kwemera Kristo.
Mutaashe Mariya wabakoreye caane abavunikira.
Muntaahirize na Andironiko na Yuniya abavandimwe dusangiye ubwoko twari dusibwe hamwe mu gihome, intumwa zirabaazi neeza kandi beemeye Kristo mbere yanje.
Muntaahirize Ampuliyato inshuti yanje nkunda mu Mwami.
Muntaahirize na Urubano umukozi mugenzi waacu dufatanyije umurimo dukorera Kristo, hamwe na Sitaku inshuti yanje nkunda.
Mutaashe na Apele, wemewe muri Kristo. Muntaahirize abo mu muryango wa Arisitobulo.
Muntaahirize Herodiyoni umuvandimwe duhuuje ubwoko. Muntaahirize abeemera Kristo bo mu muryango wa Nakisu.
Muntaahirize Tirufayina na Tirufoosa abakora imirimo mu Mwami waacu. Muntaahirize Perusi ukundwa, wakoreye Nyagasani abishizeho umwete.
Muntaahirize Rufosi umukozi uhebuuje watooranyijwe gukora umurimo w’Umwami, na nyina wambeereye umubyeyi.
Muntaahirize na Asunkurito na Fulegooni na Herumaasi, na Patirooba n’abavandimwe bari kumwe na bo.
Muntaahirize na Filoloogo na Yuliya, na Nereyi na mushiki we, na Olumpa n’abeera boose bari hamwe na bo.
Muramukanye kandi muhooberane mu buryo bwera. Amatoorero ya Kristo yoose arabataasha.
Bavandimwe, ndabiihanangirije ngo mwirinde abaazana amacaakubiri kandi baguusha abantu bakava mu kwemera, bakanyuranya inyigiisho mwahaawe. Abameze batyo mubiirinde!
Abantu nk’abo ntibakorera Kristo Umwami waacu, ahuubwo bakorera inda zaabo. Bakoreesha amagambo yo kuryosharyosha kandi y’uburyarya bakayobya abafite imitima yooroshe.
Ukumvira Imaana kwanyu kwamamaye mu bantu boose biraaneezeeza. Ariko ico mbifuuriza ni uko muba abahanga mu gukora ibyiza kandi mukiirinda gukora ikibi.
Imaana ari yo sooko y’amahoro izaajanjagurira Sataani munsi y’ibirenge byanyu. Ubuntu bw’Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo bubaane namwe.
Timoteeyo dukorana umurimo w’Imaana arabataasha, na beene waacu duhuuje ubwoko ari bo, Lukiyosi, Yasoni na Sosipateri na bo barabataasha.
Nanje Terutiyo wanditse uru rwandiko ndabataasha muri Nyagasani.
Gaayo unshumbikiye hamwe n’abeemera bari mu itoorero riteeranira mu rugo rwe barabataasha.
Erasito umubiitsi w’isente w’itawuni nkuru n’umuvandimwe waacu Kwaruto barabataasha.
Nuuko Imaana niihaabwe ikuzo, yo ibaasha kubakomeza mu kwizeera ku bw’Ubutumwa Bwiza n’ibyo nababwirije kuri Yesu Kristo, nkurikije uguhishuurwa kw’iyobera ryahoze ari ibanga kuva keera koose.
Ariko ubu iryo banga rikaba ryarashizwe ahagaragara n’ibyanditswe n’abahanuuzi nk’uko Imaana ihoraho yabitegetse kugira ngo bimenyeshwe abantu bo mu mahanga yoose maze bumvire kandi biizeere.
Imaana yoonyine Nyir’ubuhanga n’ihaabwe ikuzo muri Yesu Kristo iteeka ryose! Amiina.

name: 1 Coríntios
chapters: Njeewe Pawulo wahamagariwe kuba intumwa ya Yesu Kristo uko Imaana yabishaatse hamwe n’umuvandimwe waacu Sositeni,

ndabandikiye mwebwe ab’itoorero ry’Imaana riri i Korinto, no kuri abo baatooranyijwe na Yesu Kristo kuba abeera hamwe n’abandi boose bari mu yindi myanya bambaza izina rya Nyagasani Yesu Kristo, ari we Mwami waabo n’uwaacu.
Ubuntu n’amahoro biva ku Maana Daata n’Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo bibe muri mwe.
Mpora nshiima Imaana ibihe byose ku bwanyu ku bw’ubuntu bw’Imaana mwahaawe binyuriye muri Yesu Kristo,
kuko muri byose Imaana yabahaaye ibintu byiza byinshi, mu byo muvuga byose no mu bwenge bwose.
Ubuhamya bufashe kuri Kristo bwashimangiwe muri mwe,
bituma mutabura impaano y’Umwuka mu gihe mutegereza guhishuurwa kwa Yesu Kristo Umwami waacu.
Ni we uzaabakomeza mu kwizeera kugeza ku mperuuka, kugira ngo muzaabe mudafite umugayo ku munsi wa Nyagasani Yesu Kristo.
Imaana idahemuka, ni yo yabahamagariye kugira umubaano n’Umwana waayo Yesu Kristo Umwami waacu.
Noone bavandimwe ndabinginga mu izina ry’Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo, kugira ngo mwese mu be bamwe kandi ntihagire amacaakubiri areebeka muri mwe, ahuubwo muhuuze imitima n’inaama.
Kuko nabwiwe n’ab’umuryango wa Kiloowe, ko haagaragaye intonganya muri mwe abizeera.

Ico menyeesha ni uko muvuga ibintu byinshi bitandukanye. Umwe aravuga ati, "Njeewe ndi uwa Pawulo," cangwa ngo, "Njeewe ndi uwa Apolo," undi na we ati, "Njeewe ndi uwa Peetero" undi na we ati, "Njeewe ndi uwa Kristo."
Mbese Kristo yagabanyijwemo ibice? Mbese ni Pawulo wababambiwe ku musaraba? Cangwa se mwabatijwe mu izina rya Pawulo?
Ndashiimira Imaana ko ari ntaan’umwe muri mwe nabatije keretse Kirisipo na Gaayo,
kugira ngo hatagira umuntu uvuga ngo mwabatijwe mu izina ryanje.
Icakora nabatije n’umuryango wa Sitefaano, kandi uretse abo, simpamya ko hari undi muntu nabatije.
Kristo ntiyanyohereje kubatiza, ahuubwo yanyohereje kwamamaza Ubutumwa Bwiza, ntakoreesheje amagambo y’ubuhanga bw’abantu, kugira ngo urupfu rwa Yesu ku musaraba rudahinduka impfaabusa.
Ubutumwa bwerekeye umusaraba wa Kristo ni ubupfu kuri abo bari kurimbuka, ariko kuri twebwe abari gukizwa, ni imbaraga z’Imaana.
Ibyanditswe biravuga biti, "Nzaarimbura ubwenge bw’abanyabwenge, kandi nzaarimbura n’ubuhanga bw’abahanga."
Noone se, umunyabwenge ari he? Umuhanga se we ari he? Mbese umunyampaka w’iki gihe ari he? Mbese ubwenge bw’iyi si Imaana ntiyaba yarabuhinduye ubupfu?
Koko reero muri ubwo bwenge bwayo, Imaana ntiyakunze ko abantu bayimenya bakoreesheje ubwenge bwabo, ahuubwo yahisemo gukoreesha ubutumwa tuvuga bwo abantu biita ubupfu, kugira ngo ikize abeemera.
Dore Abayuuda basaba ibimenyeetso byo kubeemeza, naho Abagiriki bo bagashaaka ubwenge.
Naho twebwe, twamamaza Kristo wabambwe ku musaraba, bikaba igisiitaaza ku Bayuuda n’ubupfu ku banyamahanga,
ariko ku baahamagawe, b’Abayuuda n’Abagiriki, ubu butumwa ni Kristo, ari we mbaraga z’Imaana n’ubwenge bwayo.
Ikigaragara nk’ubupfu bw’Imaana, gitambuutse kure ubwenge bw’abantu, kandi ikigaragara nk’intege nke z’Imaana, gisumba imbaraga z’abantu.

Noone reero bavandimwe, nimuzirikane uko mwari mumeze igihe Imaana yabahamagaye. Ukurikije uko abantu babibona, benshi muri mwe ntimwari abanyabwenge cangwa ibihangaage cangwa mwaravuukiye mu mago akomeye.
Ariko Imaana yatooranyije ibyo abantu biita ubupfu kugira ngo ikoze isoni abanyabwenge, Imaana yatooranyije ibinyantege nke kugira ngo ikoze isoni ibihangaage.
Imaana yatooranyije ibyo abantu b’iyi si bahinyura bagasuuzugura no kubigira ubusa, kugira ngo ihindure ubusa ibyo ab’isi bateekereza ko ari bikuru.
Imaana yabikoze kugira ngo hatagira umuntu n’umwe wiikuza imbere yaayo.
Imaana ni yo sooko y’ubuzima bwanyu muri Yesu Kristo, kandi imugira ubwenge bukomooka ku Maana, n’ubutungaane, no kwezwa, no gucungurwa,
kugira ngo bibe nk’uko byanditswe ngo, "Ushaaka kwiraata weese, niyiraatiishe ibyo Nyagasani yamukoreye."
Bavandimwe, ubwo naaje iwaanyu kwamamaza amabanga y’Imaana, sinakoreesheje amagambo akomeye, cangwa ay’ubwenge buhanitse.
Kuko nahisemo kutagira ikindi mbamenyeesha keretse Yesu Kristo wabambwe ku musaraba.
Kandi igihe naazaga iwaanyu, nari mfite intege nke, ndetse ntinya kandi mpinda umushitsi.
Kandi ntaabwo niigiishije no kwamamaza Inkuru Nziiza nkoreesheje amagambo yo kwemeza y’ubwenge bw’abantu, ahuubwo nabeemeje ku bw’ububaasha bw’Umwuka w’Imaana.
Kwizeera kwanyu reero kukaba kudashingiye ku bwenge bw’abantu, ahuubwo kukaba gushingiye ku mbaraga z’Imaana.
Icakora abamaze gukomera mu by’Umwuka, tubabwiriza ubutumwa bw’ubwenge, ariko ntaabwo ari ubwenge bw’iyi si cangwa ubwenge bw’abategeka iyi si bagiiye kurimbuka.
Ahuubwo ubwenge bwo naamamaza ni ubwenge bw’Imaana bwahishwe abantu kuva keera koose, Imaana ikabugenera kuduheesha icuubahiro.
Ntaan’umwe mu batware b’iyi si wiigeze kumenya ubu bwenge, kuko iyo baba baarabumenye, ntibaba baarabambye Umwami w’ikuzo ku musaraba.
Ahuubwo nk’uko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Ico ijiisho ritaaboonye cangwa ngo ugutwi kumve, ico umuntu atiigeze ateekereza ko caabaho, ni co Imaana yateguuriye abayikunda."
Ariko Imaana yakoreesheje Umwuka waayo kuduhishuurira amabanga yaayo, kandi Umwuka w’Imaana agenzuura byose ndetse n’amayobera y’Imaana.
Mbese ni nde wamenya ikiri ku mutima w’umuntu keretse umwuka uri muri uwo muntu? Ni na ko ari ntaamuntu waamenya iby’Imaana, keretse Umwuka waayo.
Noone reero ntaabwo ari umwuka w’iyi si twahaawe, ahuubwo twahaawe Umwuka uva ku Maana, kugira ngo tumenye impaano Imaana yaduteguuriye.
Ibi ntaabwo tubivuga mu magambo twiigiishijwe n’abantu, ahuubwo ni mu magambo twiigiishijwe n’Umwuka w’Imaana, uduha gusobaanura iby’Umwuka kuri abo basanzwe bamufite.
Umuntu utagira Umwuka w’Imaana ntaabwo ashobora kwakiira iby’Umwuka w’Imaana, ndetse kuri we abyita ubupfu. Ntaabwo ashobora kubimenya kuko bigenzuurwa n’ufite Umwuka w’Imaana wenyine.
Umuntu ufite Umwuka w’Imaana agenzuura byose, kandi we ntaawamugenzuura.
Nk’uko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Ni nde wamenye ibiteekerezo by’Uhoraho kugira ngo ashobore kumugiira inaama?" Nyamara twebwe dufite ibiteekerezo nk’ibya Kristo.
Noone bavandimwe, sinashoboye kuvugana namwe nk’ubwira abafite Umwuka w’Imaana, ahuubwo nababwiye nk’ubwira abantu bakigengwa na kamere y’umubiri, bakiri bato mu bya Kristo.
Nabagaburiye amata, sinabagaburira ibyokurya bikomeye kuko mutaari mwagashoboye kubirya. Ndetse n’ubu ntimuraabishobora,
kuko muciifata nk’abantu bakigengwa na kamere y’umubiri. Noone se niiba mugifite ishari n’intonganya muri mwe, ntaabwo muri ab’isi, kandi ntimuciitwara nk’uko abantu basanzwe babigenza?
Igihe umwe avuze ati, "Njeewe ndi uwa Pawulo," undi na we ati, "Njeewe ndi uwa Apolo," ntibiba bigaragara ko mutwaza nk’abantu basanzwe?
Mbese noone, Apolo ni iki? Kandi Pawulo ni iki? Turi abagaragu b’Imaana baatumye mwemera Kristo. Buri umwe weese muri twe akora umurimo wo Nyagasani yamuhaaye gukora.
Njeewe nateeye imbuto, Apolo ayisukiira amaazi, ariko Imaana ni yo yayikujije.
Noone reero, hari uteera imbuto cangwa uyisukiira amaazi ntaaco bari co. Imaana yo itanga gukura ni yo nkuru.
Uteera imbuto n’uyisukiira amaazi ntaaho batandukaniye kuko bombi Imaana izaabahemba ikurikije ibihwanye n’umurimo baakoze.
Twembi turi abagaragu bakorera Imaana, naho mwebwe mukaba umurima waayo. Ikindi kandi muri icuubakwa c’Imaana.
Nakoreesheje impaano Imaana yampaaye, maze nkora umurimo w’umwubatsi w’umuhanga, nshiraho urufatiro, undi muntu arwubakiraho. Icakora buri muntu agomba kwitondera uburyo arwubakiraho.
Kuko ntaamuntu waashiraho urundi rufatiro, rutari urwashizweho, kandi urwo rufatiro ni Yesu Kristo.
Noone umuntu aramutse yuubakiishije izaahabu cangwa ifeeza, cangwa amabuye y’agaciiro, cangwa ibiti, cangwa ibyatsi, cangwa ibikenyeri kuri uru rufatiro,
umurimo wa buri mwubatsi uzaagaragara ku munsi Yesu azaaza guca urubanza. Uwo munsi uzaarangwa n’umuriro, kandi uwo muriro ni wo uzaasuuzuma agaciiro ku murimo wakozwe na buri muntu.
Ibyubatswe ku rufatiro biramutse birokotse uwo muriro, umwubatsi azaahaabwa uruhembo.
Ariko umurimo uramutse wokejwe n’umuriro, umwubatsi azaahomba, ariko we ubwe azaarokoka nk’ukuuwe mu muriro.
Ntaabwo muuzi yuuko muri inzu y’Imaana, kandi ko Umwuka w’Imaana abatuuyemo?
Noone reero umuntu weese usenya inzu y’Imaana, Imaana na yo izaamusenya kuko inzu y’Imaana ireera, kandi iyo nzu y’Imaana ni mwebwe.
Ntihakagire uwiibeesha. Nihagira umuntu muri mwe wiibwira ko ari umunyabwenge muri iki gihe, akwiriye guhinduka umupfaapfa kugira ngo abone kuba umunyabwenge nyakuri.
Kuko ubwenge bw’iyi si ari ubupfaapfa imbere y’Imaana, nk’uko byanditswe ngo, "Imaana itegera abanyabwenge mu buriganya bwabo!"
Kandi ngo, "Nyagasani azi ibyo abanyabwenge bateekereza, ko bitagira akamaro."
Noone reero ntihakagire uwiraatiisha ibyo abantu bakora, kuko byose ari ibyanyu.
Yaaba Pawulo cangwa Apolo cangwa Peetero, yaaba isi cangwa ubugingo cangwa urupfu, byaba ibyo muri iki gihe cangwa ibyo mu gihe kizaaza, byose ni ibyanyu,
kandi namwe muri aba Kristo, Kristo na we akaba uw’Imaana.
Nuuko reero muje mudufata nk’abagaragu ba Kristo bashinzwe kwamamaza amabanga y’Imaana.
Kandi ico abashinzwe uwo murimo bashaakwaho ni ukuba abiiringirwa.
Ariko njeewe, igikuru si uko mwanciira urubanza cangwa ngo nduciirwe n’urukiiko rw’abantu. Nanje ubwanje siniciira urubanza.
Ntaaco umutima wanje unshinja, ariko ibyo ntibigaragaza ko ndi intungaane, ahuubwo Nyagasani wenyine ni we unciira urubanza.

Ni co gituma mutagomba kugira uwo muciira urubanza igihe kitaraagera. Mutegereze igihe Nyagasani azaazira maze agashira ku mugaragaro ibyari bihishwe mu mwijima, kandi akagaragaza imigambi yo mu mitima y’abantu. Ubwo ni bwo Imaana izaaha umuntu weese ishimwe rimukwiriye.

Bavandimwe, ibyo navuze nabyigereranyijeho njeewe na Apolo kugira ngo bibabeere urugero rwo kwigiraho ibivugwa ngo, "Ntimukarenge ku byanditswe." Kugira ngo hatagira ukuza umuntu umwe maze agahinyura undi.
Mbese ni nde wakurutiishije abandi? Imaana si yo yaguhaaye ibyo utunze byose? Noone se niiba warabihaawe, ni iki gituma wiiraata nk’aho utaabihaawe nk’impaano?
Mbese mumaze kubona ibyo mukeneye byose? Mumaze no kuba abakungu? Mbese mumaze kuba abaami nuubwo tutari bo? Icampa koko mukaba abaami kugira ngo naatwe dutegekane namwe!
Niibwira yuuko twebwe intumwa za Kristo Imaana yadushize inyuma y’abandi, nk’abaaciiriwe urubanza rwo gupfa kuko twashizwe ku ka rubanda, maze dushungeerwa n’ab’isi, abaamalayika hamwe n’abantu.
Twebwe turi abapfu kuko twemera Kristo, naho mwe muri abanyabwenge muri Kristo. Twebwe turi abanyantege nke, naho mwebwe muri abanyambaraga. Mwebwe muruubahwa naho twebwe turasuuzugurwa.
Kugeza na n’ubu turasonza tukagira n’imyota, twambaye ubusa, turakubitwa, turi inzereezi,
kandi tukaruha dukoreesha amaboko yaacu. Iyo badututse, tubasabira umugisha, iyo badutooteje, turiihangaana,
iyo badusebya, tubavugiisha neeza. Na n’ubu abantu baatugize nk’umwanda w’iyi si, kandi baduhindura nk’ibishingwe boose bajugunya.
Ibi simbibandikira kugira ngo mbakoze isoni, ahuubwo ni ukugira ngo mbiigiishe musobaanukirwe nk’abaana banje nkunda.
N’aho mwagira ibihumbi n’ibihumbagiza by’ababarera mu buzima bwanyu muri Kristo, mufite umubyeyi umwe. Ninje wababeereye umubyeyi nk’abakristo igihe mbaazanira Inkuru Nziiza.
Noone reero ndabinginga ngo mukurikize urugero rwanje.
Ni co gitumye mbooherereje Timoteeyo, umwana wanje nkunda kandi udahemuka kuri Nyagasani, kugira ngo abiibutse imitwarize yanje yo nkeesha Kristo, nk’uko niigiisha abeemera Kristo mu matoorero yoose.
Bamwe muri mwe mwateekereje ko ntazaagaruka kubasuura maze bibateera kwishira heejuru.
Ariko Nyagasani naabishaaka, nzaaza iwaanyu vuba, maze nireebere ububaasha bwo abo biiraasi bafite, atari ukugendera ku magambo yaabo gusa.
Kuko Ubwami bw’Imaana budashingiye ku magambo, ahuubwo bushingiye ku mbaraga.
Mbese ico mwahitamo ni ikiihe? Nzaaze iwaanyu niitwaje inkoni yo kubahana, cangwa nzaaze mfite umutima w’urukundo n’ubugwaneeza?
Nabwiwe inkuru y’imvaho yuuko muri mwe hari ubusambanyi bukabije, ndetse no ku buryo butaraaboneka no mu banyamahanga bataazi Imaana. Bavuga ko umugabo umwe muri mwe atunze umugore wa se.
Noone muriishira heejuru! Ahuubwo mwari kubabara, maze uwakoze ico caaha akiirukanwa muri mwe.
Kandi nuubwo ndi kure yaanyu mu mubiri, ndikumwe namwe mu mwuka, kandi nkaba naramaze guciira urubanza uwakoze ayo mahano,
mu izina rya Nyagasani Yesu nk’aho nari mpiibeereye. Nimuteeranira hamwe mu izina rya Nyagasani Yesu, nanje ngateerana namwe mu mutima,
uwo mugabo muzaamushikirize Sataani maze umubiri we urimbuke, kugira ngo ubugingo bwe buzaarokoke ku munsi wa Nyagasani.
Si byiza ko mwakwiraata! Ntaabwo muuzi yuuko agasemburo gake gatuubuura igifooto coose c’ifu?

Noone reero nimwivaanemo icaaha kimeze nk’umusemburo ushaaje, maze mube nk’umugaati musha udasembuye nk’uko musanzwe. Dore igihe c’ibirori byo Kunyurwaho kirageze, kuko Kristo ari we mwana w’intaama w’igitambo co Kunyurwaho watambwe.
Noone reero nitwizihize ibyo birori tudakoreesheje umusemburo ushaaje ari co caaha n’ubukozi bw’ibibi, ahuubwo dukoreeshe umugaati udasembuye ari wo ukuri no kutaryarya.
Mu rwandiko mperuutse kubandikira, nababwiye yuuko mutagomba kwifatanya n’abasambanyi.
Sinashaakaga kuvuga abasambanyi bo muri iyi si, cangwa abanyamururu n’abambuzi, cangwa abasenga ibishushaanyo, kuko kwitandukanya na bo boose byabasaba kuva mu isi.

Ibyo nashaakaga kubabwira ni ukutiifatanya n’umuntu wiiyita umuvandimwe muri Kristo kandi akaba ari umusambanyi, cangwa umunyamururu, cangwa usenga ibishushaanyo, usebanya, umusinzi, cangwa umwambuzi. Ndetse umuntu nk’uwo ntimugasangire na we.
Mbese hari aho mpuuriye no guciira urubanza abo hanze batari abakristo? Mbese si abo muri mwe bo mukwiriye guciira urubanza?
Imaana ni yo izaabaciira urubanza. Noone reero nimugenze nk’uko byanditswe ngo, "Nimuvaane inkozi z’ibibi muri mwe."
Igihe umwe muri mwe agize ico apfa n’umukristo mugenzi we, yahangaara ate kumurega ku bacaamanza b’abapagaani, mumwanya wo kuja ku bantu b’Imaana ngo babakiraanure?
Ntaabwo muuzi yuuko abantu b’Imaana ari bo bazaaciira ab’isi urubanza? Noone se niiba ari mwe muzaaciira ab’isi urubanza, mwananirwa mute guca imanza zooroheje?
Ntaabwo muuzi yuuko tuzaaciira abaamalayika urubanza? Niiba bimeze bityo twashobora guciira imanza abantu b’iki gihe
Niiba reero mufite imanza zimeze zityo, ni kuki muzishira mu bantu badafite ico bahuuriyeho n’itoorero?
Mbese ntaasoni mugira? Ubwo koko ntaamuntu n’umwe muri mwe ufite ubwenge bwashobora gukiraanura abakristo bagenzi baanyu?
Dore ahuubwo umukristo ajaana mugenzi we mu rukiiko maze abatiizeera bakabaciira urubanza!
Kuko mufitanye imanza zigomba guciibwa n’abaramuzi mu nkiiko, byerekana yuuko mwananiwe kwitwara nk’abakristo. Kuki mutiihanganira gukorerwa naabi? Kuki mutaakwemera kunyagwa ibyanyu?
Ahuubwo mwe ubwanyu mugirira abandi naabi ndetse mukabambura, kandi ari abakristo bagenzi baanyu.
Ntaabwo muuzi neeza yuuko inkozi z’ibibi zitazaaragwa Ubwami bw’Imaana? Muramenye ntimwibeeshe! Inkozi z’ibibi, abasenga ibishushaanyo, abasambanyi basanzwe n’abakora ibitingwa,
abajuura, abanyamururu, abasinzi, abatukana, n’abambuzi, abo boose ntibazaaragwa Ubwami bw’Imaana.
Bamwe muri mwe mwari mumeze mutyo ariko ubu mwuhagiwe ibyaha, mureezwa, kandi mugirwa intungaane imbere y’Imaana ku bwa Nyagasani Yesu Kristo, no ku bw’Umwuka Weera.

Bamwe muri mwe baravuga bati, "Neemerewe gukora ibyo niishaakiye." Nyamara ntaabwo ariko byose bifite akamaro. Nshobora kuvuga ko nemerewe gukora ibyo niishaakiye, ariko sinzeemera gutegekwa na kimwe muri byo.

Abandi baravuga bati, "Ibyokurya ni iby’inda, kandi n’inda ni iy’ibyokurya." Nyamara Imaana izaabitsemba byombi. Umubiri ntaabwo wagenewe ubusambanyi, ahuubwo wagenewe gukorera Nyagasani na Nyagasani akaba ari we uwureeberera.
Imaana yazuuye Umwami Yesu, naatwe izaatuzuura ikoreesheje imbaraga zaayo.
Ntimuuzi yuuko imibiri yaanyu ari ingingo za Kristo? Noone se mfate ingingo z’umubiri wa Kristo maze nzigire ingingo za malaaya? Oya, ntibishoboka!
Cangwa ntimuuzi yuuko usambanye na malaaya aba abaaye umubiri umwe na we? Kuko ibyanditswe biravuga ngo, "Bombi bazaaba babaaye umubiri umwe."
Ariko uwiifatanya na Nyagasani aba abaaye umwe na we.
Nimwirinde ubusambanyi! Icaha coose umuntu akora, ntikigera ku mubiri we, naho usambana aba acumuriye umubiri we bwiite.
Ntimuuzi yuuko imibiri yaanyu ari urusengero rw’Umwuka Weera utuuye muri mwe mwahaawe n’Imaana kandi mukaba ari ntaabubaasha mwifiteho ngo mwigenge?
Imaana yabacunguje ikiguzi gikomeye! Noone reero nimukoreeshe imibiri yaanyu kuyiheesha ikuzo.
Noone kubyerekeye ibyo mwanyandikiye, ni byiza ko umagabo atarongora.
Ariko kuko hariho ubusambanyi bukabije, buri mugabo agomba kugira umugore we, na buri mugore akagira umugabo we.
Umugabo ntaakwiriye kwiyima umugore we, kandi n’umugore ntaakwiriye kwiyima umugabo.
Kuko umugore ntiyigenga ku mubiri we, ahuubwo ugengwa n’umugabo we, byongeye kandi, umugabo na we ntiyigenga ku mubiri we, ahuubwo ugengwa n’umugore we.

Ntihakagire uwiyima undi, keretse mubanje kubyumviikana, kandi na bwo kumara igihe gito, kugira ngo mubone uko musenga. Ariko mugomba kongera kugira imibonano bidatinze kugira ngo mutananirwa kwifata maze Sataani akaboneraho kubashuka.
Ibyo mbabwiye mbona ko ari byo bikwiriye, ariko simbibategetse.
Nakwifuuje yuuko abantu boose baamera nkanje, ariko buri umwe afite ingabire yiihariye yahaawe n’Imaana.
Kuri abo bataraashaaka hamwe n’abo baakuuweho abo baashaakanye, ndababwira yuuko iciiza ari uko baakwigumira bonyine nkanje.
Ariko niiba badashobora kwifata, bagomba gushaaka, kuko ibyiza ari ugushaaka aho kwicwa n’irari.
Kuri abo baashaakanye, mbahaaye itegeko ritari iryanje, ahuubwo riturutse kuri Nyagasani. Umugore ntaagatandukane n’umugabo we,
ariko aramutse atandukanye na we, ntaakongere gushingirwa ku wundi mugabo ahuubwo yiiyuzuze n’umugabo we, kandi n’umugabo ntaakiirukane umugore we.
Ku bandi, ibyo ngiiye kubabwira ni ibyanje si ibya Nyagasani. Umugabo weemera Kristo aramutse afite umugore utiizeera, kandi uwo mugore akeemera kubaana na we, ntaabwo agomba kumwirukana.
Kandi umugore aramutse afite umugabo utiizeera, ntaabwo agomba gutandukana na we.

Kuko umugabo utiizeera yezwa ku bw’umugore we, kandi umugore utiizeera na we yezwa ku bw’umugabo we. Bitabaaye bityo, abaana baabo baaba badatunganye imbere y’Imaana, kandi si ko biri kuko beeguriwe Imaana.
Ariko wa wundi utiizeera Kristo ahisemo gutandukana n’uwo baashaakanye abikore. Iyo bibaaye bityo, umuvandimwe wizeera Kristo aba abohoowe, kuko Imaana yaduhamagariye kubaho mu mahoro.
Wa mugore we w’umukristo, wabwirwa n’iki ko utazaakiza umugabo waawe? Naawe wa mugabo we w’umukristo, wabwirwa n’iki ko utazaakiza umugore waawe?
Nuuko reero buri muntu akomeze kuba nk’uko Nyagasani yamugeneye, kandi amere nk’uko yari ari Imaana ikimuhamagarira kuba umukristo. Iri ni ryo tegeko niigiisha mu ma toorero yoose.
Muri mwe niiba hari uwahamagawe n’Imaana yarakebwe, ntaagomba kwigira nk’aho ataakebwe. Niiba kandi hari uwahamagawe ataraakebwa, singombwa ko akebwa.
Haaba gukebwa cangwa kudakebwa, byose ntaaco bivuze, ahuubwo igikuru ni ukuubahiriza amategeko y’Imaana.
Buri muntu agume nk’uko yari ameze igihe Imaana yamuhamagaye.
Niiba igihe wahamagawe wari imbaata, ntibikakubabaze. Ariko uramutse uboonye umugisha wo kuva mu bubaata, uzaawukoreeshe.
Uwo Nyagasani yahamagaye ari imbaata, aba yaragizwe uwiigenga na Kristo, kandi uwahamagawe na Kristo ari uwiigenga, aba abaaye imbaata ye.
Imaana yabatanzeho ikiguzi, noone reero ntimukabe imbaata z’abantu.
Bavandimwe, buri muntu agume yunze ubumwe n’Imaana nk’uko yari ameze agihamagarwa.
Ku byo mwanditse byerekeye abataraashaaka, ntaategeko mbifitiye rivuuye kuri Nyagasani, ahuubwo ndababwira igiteekerezo canje nk’umuntu Nyagasani yagiriye impuhwe.
Ngereranyije n’ibi bihe bikomeye, ni byiza ko buri muntu aguma nk’uko ari.
Niiba ufite umugore, ntuugatandukane na we. Niiba ntaamugore ufite, ntuukamushaake.

Icakora uramutse ushaatse umugore, ntaacaaha uba ukoze, kandi n’umukoobwa utaraashaaka aramutse ashingiwe, ntaacaaha aba akoze. Ariko abashingiranwa bazaagira ingoorane mu buzima bwabo, kandi ni byo nashaakaga kubarinda.
Bavandimwe, ndababwiza ukuri yuuko hasigaye igihe gito. Uheereye noone, abafite abagore babe nk’abatabafite,
kandi abarira babe nk’abatarira, n’abaneezeerewe babe nk’aho bataneezeerewe, kandi n’abacuruuza bamere nk’aho ntaaco bagira,
n’abakoreesha iby’iyi si ntibagatwarwe na byo, kuko ishusho y’iyi si igiiye gushiraho.
Ndabiifuuriza kudahagarika imitima. Udafite umugore aharanira gukora umurimo wa Nyagasani, kuko aba ashaaka gushiimiisha Imaana,
naho umugabo ufite umugore, aharanira iby’isi ngo abone uko ashiimiisha umugore we,

bityo reero akagira imitima ebyiri. Umugore utaraashaatse cangwa umukoobwa w’isugi ashiishikarira ibya Nyagasani, kugira ngo atungaane ku mubiri no ku mutima, naho umugore ufite umugabo ashiishikarira iby’isi, ashaakiisha uko yaashiimiisha umugabo we.
Ibyo mbibabwiriye kubafasha atari ukubahata, kugira ngo mukore ibitunganye kandi mwiyegurire Nyagasani ntaakibateganya.
Ariko haramutse hari umusore wiiyumviisha ko yaaba ahemukiye umukobwa yasabye aramutse atamurongoye kandi amurarikiye caane, nibashingiranwe nk’uko babishaaka, kuko ntaacaaha baba bakoze.
Niiba kandi umusore yiiyemeje mu mutima we kutarongora umukoobwa ntaawe umuhase, kandi akaba yaashobora kurinda irari rye, yaaba akoze neeza kutarongora uwo mukoobwa.
Bityo reero, umugabo urongora aba akoze neeza, ariko utarongora aba akoze neeza kurushaho.

Umugore ufite umugabo ntaabwo aba yeemerewe gushingirwa umugabo we akiriho, ariko iyo umugabo we apfuuye, umugore afite uburenganzira bwo gushingirwa ku w’undi mugabo yiishimiye weese, ariko uwo mugabo akwiriye kuba ari umukristo.
Ariko ku bwanje, yaarushaho kumererwa neeza agumye uko ari, kandi niibwira yuuko nanje mfite Umwuka w’Imaana.
Noone ndashaaka kuvuga ku byerekeye ibyokurya biterekeejwe ibigirwamaana. Ni koko, "Twese tubifiteho ubumenyi" nk’uko bivugwa. Ubwo bumenyi buteera kwiraata, naho urukundo rurakomeza.
Umuntu wiibwira ko hari ico azi, aba ntaaco yari yaamenya ukurikije ibyo akwiriye kumenya,
ariko umuntu ukunda Imaana amenywa na yo.
Noone reero kubyerekeye kurya ibyokurya byaterekeejwe ibigirwamaana, tuuzi neeza yuuko ku isi ibigirwamaana ari ubusa kandi ko ntaayindi Maana iriho keretse Imaana imwe rukumbi.
Ni ukuri koko hariho ibyo abantu biita ibigirwamaana mu ijuru no ku isi, kandi koko hariho ibigirwamaana n’ibyitwa abatware byinshi,
ariko kuri twe hariho Imaana imwe rukumbi ari yo Daata, waremye byose kandi we dukeesha kubaho, kandi hariho na Nyagasani umwe Yesu Kristo watumye ibintu byose bibaho, kandi tukabeeshwaho na we.

Ariko si ko buri muntu afite ubwo bumenyi. Bamwe bamenyereye kuramya ibigirwamaana kugeza ubu ku buryo bateekereza ko iyo bariiye ibyokurya biibwira yuuko byaterekeejwe ikigirwamaana, bityo reero umutimanaama waabo ugaciika intege maze bakiiyumvamo ko baahumanye.
Nyamara ibyokurya si byo bizaaduhuuza n’Imaana. Iyo tutabiriiye ntaaco dupfiirwa, kandi iyo tubiriiye ntaaco twunguka.
Ariko mwirinde kugira ngo ubwo burenganzira bwanyu butaaza kuguusha abanyantege nke mu caaha.
Koko se umunyantege nke akuboonye, wowe usobaanukiwe uriira mu ngoro y’ikigirwamaana, ntibyamuteera kurya ibyokurya byaterekeejwe ibigirwamaana?
Bityo reero gusobaanukirwa kwawe kuzaatuma umuvandimwe waawe wo Yesu yapfiiriye arimbuka.
Kandi nimucumura ku bavandimwe baanyu, mugatuma umutimanaama waabo udashobora guhitamo ikibi n’iciiza, muba mucumuye kuri Kristo.
Nuuko reero niiba ibyokurya ari byo biguusha umuvandimwe wanje mu caaha, sinzongera kurya inyama, kugira ngo ntamuguusha mu caaha.
Mbese simfite umudendeezo? Mbese si ndi intumwa? Mbese sinaboonye Yesu Umwami waacu ? Mbese ntimuri umusaaruuro wanje muri Nyagasani?
Niiba ku bandi ntari intumwa, niibura ndi yo kuri mwe, kuko muri ikimenyeetso canje co kuba intumwa ya Nyagasani.
Ibi ni byo niireguuza iyo abantu bansebya.
Mbese ntitugira uburenganzira bwo guhaabwa ibyo kurya n’ibyo kunywa?
Mbese twebwe ntitugira uburenganzira bwo kujaana n’umugore wiizeera nk’uko izindi ntumwa hamwe n’abavandimwe ba Nyagasani na Peetero baabigenjeje?
Cangwa se ni nje na Barinaba twenyine duhatirwa gukorera ibidutunga?
Ni nde waaba ari umusirikare, maze akiyishurira ibimutunga? Ni nde waahinga umuzaabibu maze ntaawuryeho imbuto? Cangwa se ni nde waaragira ubusho bw’inka maze ntanywe amata?
Ibyo simbivuga nshingiye ku miteekerereze y’abantu. Amategeko na yo arabihamya.
Kuko byanditswe mu mategeko ya Moose ngo, "Ntimugapfuke umunwa w’ikimasa igihe kivunga ingano." Ubwo se ibimasa ni byo Imaana yiitaho byonyine?
Cangwa se si twe yabivugiye? Ni koko ni twebwe byandikiwe, kuko uhinga n’uhuura bombi bakwiriye kubikora bafite ibyiringiro byo kugabana ku musaaruuro.
Niiba twarababibyemo imbuto z’Umwuka w’Imaana, mbese byabakomerera dusaaruye ku byo mutunze?

Kandi niiba abandi babafiteho uburenganzira bwo kugira ico bababonaho, twebwe ntitubarusha ubwo burenganzira? Nyamara ubwo burenganzira ntitwabukoreesheje, ahuubwo twihangaaniye byose kugira ngo tutaba igisiitaaza mu nzira yo kwamamaza Ubutumwa Bwiza bwa Kristo.
Mbese ntimuuzi yuuko abakora mu Nzu y’Imaana batungwa n’ibyo muri iyo Nzu, n’abatambira ku rutambiro bakagabana ku byo batambye?
Bityo reero, Nyagasani yategetse yuuko abaamamaza Ubutumwa Bwiza bagomba gutungwa na bwo.
Ariko ntaaco muri ubu burenganzira niigeze kwitwaza, kandi simbandikiye ibyo kugira ngo mugire ico mumpa. Ahuubwo naahitamo gupfa, kuruta uko umuntu yahindura ubusa uko kwiraata kwanje!
Iyo mbwirije Ubutumwa Bwiza, ntibinteera kwiraata, kuko ari umurimo ntegetswe gukora, kandi ntaamamaje Ubutumwa Bwiza naguusha ishano!
Iyo mba nkora uyu murimo ku bushaake bwanje, mba naraboonye uruhembo, ariko kuko nawuhaawe n’Imaana, mbikora nk’umurimo nshinzwe.
Noone se uruhembo rwanje ni uruuhe? Uruhembo rwanje ni ukwamamaza Ubutumwa Bwiza ku buntu, ntakurikije uburenganzira ngenewe nk’umubwirizabutumwa.
Nuubwo mfite umudendeezo kuri boose, niihinduye umugaragu wa boose kugira ngo ndusheho kwigaruriza abantu benshi mbageza kuri Kristo.
Iyo ndi n’Abayuuda, mba nk’Umuyuuda kugira ngo mbone uko mbiigarurira. Nuubwo kandi ntagengwa n’amategeko ya Moose, mba nk’ugengwa na yo kugira ngo niigarurire abagengwa na yo.

Kandi iyo ndi n’abanyamahanga, nanje mba nk’abanyamahanga badakurikiza amategeko y’Abayuuda kugira ngo mbiigarurize. Ariko ibi ntibivuga yuuko ntakurikiza amategeko y’Imaana ahuubwo nyoborwa n’amategeko ya Kristo.
Iyo ndi n’abafite intege nke mu kwizeera, niitwara nka bo kugira ngo mbiigarurize. Niigize nk’uko abantu boose bameze, kugira ngo nkoreeshe uburyo bwose kurokora bamwe muri bo.
Ibyo byose mbikorera kwamamaza Ubutumwa Bwiza kugira ngo nzaabuboneho umugabane.
Mbese ntimuuzi yuuko abarushanwa mu kwiruka boose biiruka, ariko umwe akaba ari we utsindira igihembo? Noone reero namwe nimwiruke kugira ngo muzaatsindire ico gihembo.
Umuntu weese mu irushanwa yiirinda muri byose, aharanira ikamba rishira vuba, ariko twebwe dukora umurimo waacu kugira ngo tuzaabone ikamba rihoraho iteeka.
Ni yo mpamvu ntaapfa kwiruka nk’utaazi iyo aja, kandi ni co gituma meze nk’umukinnyi w’ibikonde ukubita adahushwa.
Ahuubwo mbabaza umubiri wanje nkawukomeza, kugira ngo ntabwiriza abandi Ubutumwa, maze njeewe sineemerwe.
Bavandimwe, ndashaaka ko mwibuka ibyabaaye kuri baasogokuruza ubwo baari bayobowe na Moose barinzwe n’igicu, maze boose bakambuka Inyanja Itukura.
Mu gicu no mu nyanja nimwo boose baabatirijwe nk’abayoboke ba Moose,
maze boose barya ibyokurya bimwe bivuuye mu ijuru ku Maana,
kandi boose baasangira ico kunywa kivuuye mu ijuru. Banywereye ku rutare rw’umwuka baahaawe n’Imaana rwajaanaga na bo, kandi urwo rutare ni Kristo.
Ariko benshi muri bo ntaabwo baashiimiishije Imaana, ni co caatumye biicwa maze imirambo yaabo itaagagurizwa mu butaayu.
Ibyo byose byabeereyeho kugira ngo bitubeere iciitegererezo co kugira ngo tutararikiira ikibi nk’uko na bo baabigenjeje.
Ntimugasenge ibishushaanyo nk’uko bamwe muri bo baabigenjeje, nk’uko byanditswe ngo, "Abantu baaricaye bararya kandi baranywa, barangije barahaguruka maze barabyina."
Twirinde ubusambanyi nk’uko bamwe muri bo basambanye, bigatuma abantu ibihumbi makumyabiri na bitatu bapfiira umunsi umwe.
Kandi ntitugomba kugerageza Kristo, nk’uko bamwe muri bo baamugerageje, maze bagatsembwa n’inzoka.
Ntimukiitotombe nk’uko bamwe muri bo biitotombye, maze malayika w’urupfu akabarimbura.
Ibyo byababaayeho kugira ngo bibeere abandi iciitegererezo, kandi byandikiwe kuduhuguura kuko tugeze mu bihe by’imperuuka.
Bityo reero uwiibwira ko ahagaze, yiirinde kugira ngo atagwa.

Ntaakigeragezo na kimwe caabagezeho kidasanzwe mu bantu. Imaana ni intahemuka, kandi ntaabwo izaatuma mugeragezwa n’ibirenze ibyo mwashobora gutsinda. Ariko nimugeragezwa, Imaana izaabaha imbaraga zo kwihangaanira ibyo bigeragezo maze ibahe n’uburyo bwo kubivamo.
Nuuko reero nshuti zanje, nimugendere kure ibyo gusenga ibigirwamaana.
Ndababwira nk’abantu bafite ubwenge, noone reero namwe nimusuuzume ibyo mbabwira.
Mbese igikopu c’umugisha dukoreesha dushiimira Imaana, si ugusangira amaraso ya Kristo? Naho se umugaati tumanyura, si ugusangira umubiri wa Kristo?
Kuko hariho umugaati umwe, twese nuubwo turi benshi, turi umubiri umwe, kuko twese dusangira umugaati umwe.
Nimureebe urubyaro rwa Isirayeli. Mbese abarya ku byatambiwe Imaana ku rutambiro ntibaba bafatanyije mugukora umurimo wo ku rutambiro?
Mbese nshaaka kumenyeesha iki? Ibyokurya bituuwe ibigirwamaana hari ico bimaze? Cangwa ikigirwamaana hari ico kimaze?
Oya, ahuubwo ico menyeesha ni uko ibyo abapagaani baterekeeza babiterekeeza abadayimooni, atari Imaana babituura, kandi sinshaaka ko musangira n’abadayimooni.
Ntimushobora kunywera ku gikopu ca Nyagasani hamwe no ku gikopu c’abadayimooni, ntimushobora kurya ibyo ku meeza ya Nyagasani ngo mwongere murye ibyo ku meeza y’abadayimooni.
Cangwa se turashaaka gutuma Nyagasani agira ishari? Duteekereza ko tumurusha imbaraga?
Bamwe baravuga bati, "Twemerewe gukora ibyo twishaakiye," nyamara ntaabwo ari ko byose bidufitiye akamaro. "Twemerewe gukora ibyo twishaakiye," ariko si ko byose bitwungura.
Ntihakagire uwiishaakira inyungu ye bwite, ahuubwo aje ayishaakira abandi.
Muje murya ibyokurya biguriishwa mu iguriro byose mutabanje kubaririza kugira ngo imitima yaanyu itabaciira urubanza,
kuko isi n’ibiyirimo byose ari ibya Nyagasani.
Nihagira umuntu utiizeera Kristo ubatumira gusangira na we maze mukeemera ubwo butumire, muje murya ibyo abazimaaniye mutabanje kubaza kugira ngo imitima yaanyu itabaciira urubanza.
Ariko nihagira ubabwira ati, "Ibi byokurya byaterekeejwe ibigirwamaana," ntimukabirye kuko abibabwiriye no ku bw’umutimanaama.
Umutimanaama mvuga si uwaanyu, ahuubwo ni uwa wa muntu. Ikindi kandi, kuki umutimanaama w’undi muntu waatuma ntakora ico nshaaka gukora.
Niiba ngize ico ndya ngishiimiye Imaana, kuki abantu bansebya kubeera ibyokurya nashiimiye Imaana?
Nooneho reero, iyo murya cangwa munywa, cangwa mukora ikindi kintu coose, muje mubikorera guheesha Imaana ikuzo.
Muje mwifata mu buryo bwo kutabeera Abayuuda cangwa Abagiriki cangwa itoorero ry’Imaana igisiitaaza.
Mugomba gukurikiza urugero rwanje kuko ngerageza gushiimiisha boose muri byose, ntaharanira inyungu zanje bwite, ahuubwo mparanira inyungu za benshi, kugira ngo bakizwe.
Nuuko reero nimunkurikize, nk’uko nanje nkurikiza Kristo.
Ndabashiimira kuko muhora munyibuka muri byose kandi mugakurikiza inyigiisho nababwirije.
Ariko ndashaaka ko mumenya yuuko Kristo ari we mutwe ugenga buri mugabo, kandi umugabo akaba umutwe ugenga umugore we, naho Imaana ikaba umutwe ugenga Kristo.
Umugabo weese usenga cangwa agahanuura yitwikiiriye umutwe, aba atuubashe umutwe we ari wo Kristo.
Naho umugore usenga cangwa agahanuura atiitwikiiriye umutwe, aba atuubashe umutwe we ari wo mugabo we. Uwo mugore aba ahwanye n’uwo boogoshe umusatsi ku mutwe.

Niiba umugore atiiteze igitambaaro ku mutwe, reero n’umusatsi woose awoogoshe. Ariko kuko biteeye isoni kugira ngo umugore yoogoshe umusatsi we cangwa ngo awukemure, akwiriye kwitega igitambaaro ku mutwe.
Si ngombwa ko umugabo ya kwitwikiira igitambaaro ku mutwe kuko ari ishusho n’ubwiza bw’Imaana, naho umugore ni ubwiza bw’umugabo we.
Ni koko, umugabo ntaabwo yakomootse ku mugore, ahuubwo umugore ni we wakomootse ku mugabo.
Kandi umugabo si we waremewe umugore ahuubwo umugore ni we waremewe umugabo.
Ku bw’iyo mpamvu, umugore akwiriye kwambara igitambaaro ku mutwe we nk’ikimenyeetso kigaragaza yuuko agengwa n’umugabo we, kugira ngo bineezeeze abaamalayika.
Nyamara imbere ya Nyagasani, umugore ntiyabaho hatariho umugabo cangwa ngo umugabo abeho hatariho umugore.
Kuko nuubwo umugore yakomootse ku mugabo, umugabo na we yabyawe n’umugore, ariko ibintu byose bikomooka ku Maana.
Ngaaho namwe nimumbwire, mbese birakwiriye ko umugore asenga Imaana adatwikiiriye umutwe?
Mbese umuco kamere ubwawo ntuutwigiisha yuuko bisuuzuguritse ngo umugabo atereke umusatsi ukaba mureemure,
naho umugore, kugira umusatsi mureemure bikamuheesha icuubahiro ? Erega umugore Imaana yamuhaaye umusatsi mureemure kugira ngo utwikiire umutwe we.
Ariko hagize uteemeranya nanje kuri iyi ngingo, amenye yuuko yaaba twebwe cangwa amatoorero y’Imaana ntaawundi muco dufite utari uwo.
Ariko mu mabwiriza akurikira ntaabwo ndibubashiime, kuko amateeraniro yaanyu yo gusenga aho kubungura, abateera gusubira inyuma.
Ica mbere ca byose, iyo muteeranye nk’itoorero, numva yuuko mwigabamo ibice, kandi koko bimwe neemeranya na byo.
Ni koko hagomba kubaho ibice muri mwe, kugira ngo abatungaaniye Imaana muri mwe bagaragare.
Iyo muteeraniye hamwe, ntaabwo muba muteeranijwe no gusangira Ifunguro rya Nyagasani,
kuko iyo igihe co kurya kigeze, buri umwe atanguranwa kurya ibyo yiizaniye, bikagera naaho umwe yaakwicwa n’inzara, naho undi yiisindiye.

Mbese ntaamago mufite ngo abe ari mwo muriira cangwa munywera? Cangwa se muuzanwa no kugayiisha itoorero ry’Imaana hamwe no gukoza isoni abakene? Noone se mbabwire iki? Noone se mbashiime? Oya! Ibyo sinaabibashiimira.
Nje amabwiriza nahaawe na Nyagasani ni yo nabahaaye ngo: ijoro Umwami Yesu yagambaaniwe, yafashe umugaati,
amaze kuwushiimira Imaana, arawumaanyura maze aravuga ati, "Uyu ni umubiri wanje utanzwe ku bwanyu. Muje mukora mutya kugira ngo munyibuke."

Barangije kurya, afata igikopu maze aravuga ati, "Iki ni igikopu c’iseezerano risha ryemejwe n’amaraso yanje. Muje mubikora mutya igihe coose munywereye divaayi muri iki gikopu, kugira ngo munyibuke."
Kuko igihe murya kuri uyu mugaati mukanywera no kuri iki gikopu, muba mwamamaza urupfu rwa Nyagasani, kugeza aho azaagarukira.
Noone reero umuntu urya uyu mugaati cangwa akanywera ku gikopu ca Nyagasani mu buryo budakwiriye, azaaba acumuye ku mubiri n’amaraso bya Nyagasani.
Noone reero nimwisuuzume maze mubone kurya uwo mugaati no kunywera kuri ico gikopu.
Kuko abo boose barya kuri uwo mugaati kandi bakanywera kuri ico gikopu batabanje kuzirikana umubiri wa Kristo, Imaana izaabaciira urubanza igihe barya cangwa banywa.
Ku bw’iyo mpamvu, abenshi muri mwe bararwaye kandi bafite intege nke, naho abandi baarapfuuye.
Nyamara tubanje kwisuuzuma ubwacu, ntitwaciirwa urubanza.
Ariko duciiriwe urubanza na Nyagasani, turahanwa kugira ngo tudaciirwa urubanza rw’iteeka hamwe n’ab’isi.
Noone reero bavandimwe, igihe muteeraniriye hamwe gusangira, muje murindana.
Nihagira usonza, azaaje abanza kuriira iwe, kugira ngo nimuteerana, imyifatire yaanyu itabaviiramo guciirwa urubanza n’Imaana. Ibisigaye nzaabibabwira ubwo nzaagaruka.
Bavandimwe, sinshaaka yuuko muba murujijo mu byerekeye impaano z’Umwuka Weera.
Muuzi yuuko ubwo mwari mukiri abapagaani, mwashukwaga kandi mukayobeeshwa n’ibigirwamaana bitavuga.
Ni co gituma nshaaka yuuko mumenya ko ari ntaamuntu uyoborwa n’Umwuka w’Imaana wavuga ati, "Yesu naavumwe!" Kandi ko ari ntaamuntu wavuga ati, "Yesu n’Umwami" keretse abiheeshejwe n’Umwuka Weera.
Hariho impaano z’uburyo bwinshi, ariko Umwuka uzitanga ni umwe,
kandi hariho uburyo bwinshi bwo gukorera Imaana, ariko ni Nyagasani umwe dukorera.
Hariho uburyo bwinshi bwo gutanga ubuheereza, ariko Imaana itanga ubwo bushobozi kuri boose ni imwe.
Umwuka w’Imaana yiigaragariza mu mpaano aha buri muntu, kugira ngo bigirire boose akamaro.
Umwuka w’Imaana aha umuntu umwe ubushobozi bwo kuvuga ijambo ry’ubwenge, undi uwo Mwuka akamuha ijambo ry’ubumenyi.
Umwe uwo Mwuka akamuha kwizeera Kristo bihebuuje, undi akamuha impaano yo gukiza indwara.

Undi uwo Mwuka amuha imbaraga zo gukora ibitangaaza, undi akamuha impaano yo guhanuura, undi akamuha ubushobozi bwo kugenzuura Umwuka w’Imaana n’umwuka udaturuka ku Maana. Umwe amuha ubushobozi bwo kuvuga mu ndimi z’uburyo bwinshi, undi akamuha ubushobozi bwo kuzisobaanura.
Ariko ibyo byose bikorwa n’Umwuka umwe rukumbi, ugaba impaano zitandukanye kuri buri muntu uko yiishaakiye.
Kristo ameze nk’umubiri umwe, ugizwe n’ibice bitandukanye, kandi ibyo bice by’umubiri byose n’ubwo bitandukanye, ni umubiri umwe.
Ni co kimwe, twaba Abayuuda cangwa abanyamahanga, twaba abagaragu cangwa abiigenga, twese twabatirijwe mu Mwuka umwe tuba umubiri umwe, kandi twese twujujwe n’uwo Mwuka umwe.
Koko reero, umubiri ntaabwo ugizwe n’igice kimwe gusa, ahuubwo ugizwe n’ibice byinshi.
Ikirenge kiramutse kigize kiti, "Kuko ntari ikiganza, sindi kimwe mu bice by’umubiri," ico nticaatuma kitaba igice c’umubiri.
