Kandi ugutwi kugize kuti, "Kuko ntari ijiisho, sindi kimwe mu bice by’umubiri," ico nticaatuma kitaba igice c’umubiri.
Mbese iyo umubiri uja kuba ijiisho, ibyo kumva byari kuba bite? Kandi iyo umubiri woose uja kuba ugutwi, ibyo guhuumurirwa byari kuba bite?
Ubusanzwe, Imaana yashize buri gice c’umubiri mu mwanya waco nk’uko yabishaatse.
Mbese iyo byose bija kuba igice kimwe, umubiri wari kuba he?
Ubusanzwe hariho ibice byinshi, ariko umubiri ni umwe.
Ijiisho ntirishobora kubwira ikiganza riti, "Ntaaco umariye," cangwa ngo umutwe ubwire ikirenge uti, "Ntaaco nkwifuuriza."
Ahuubwo ibice by’umubiri bireebeka nk’aho ari ibinyantege nke, ni byo bikenewe caane,
kandi ibyo bice by’umubiri byo duteekereza ko bifite agaciiro gake ni byo twitaho kuruta ibindi, kandi ibice by’umubiri bidashirwa ku mugaragaro ni byo twitaho caane.
Nyamara ibice bibonereye kugaragara mu maaso y’abantu ntaabwo bikeneye kwitaabwaho. Imaana yashize hamwe ibice by’umubiri, irushaho guha icuubahiro ibyo bice birebeka nkaaho bigayitse,
kugira ngo umubiri utiiremamo ibice, ahuubwo kugira ngo ibice byose by’umubiri biteerane inkunga.
Igice c’umubiri iyo kibabaye, ibindi bice by’umubiri bibabarana na co, kandi iyo igice c’umubiri gihaawe icuubahiro, ibindi bice na byo byishiimana na co.
Nuuko reero mwese muri umubiri wa Kristo, kandi buri umwe ni igice c’uwo mubiri.

Dore abo Imaana yashizeho mu toorero ryayo, yabanje gushiraho intumwa, ikurikizaho abahanuuzi, ubwa gatatu ishiraho abiigiisha, haanyuma ishiraho abo gukora ibitangaaza, ikurikizaho abafite impaano zo gukiza indwara cangwa zo gufasha abandi, abaahaawe ubuyobozi, n’abo baahaawe kuvuga mu zindi indimi zitandukanye.
Mbese boose ni ko ari intumwa? Mbese boose ni ko ari abahanuuzi? Mbese ni ko boose ari abiigiisha? Mbese ni ko boose bakora ibitangaaza?
Mbese ni ko boose bafite impaano yo gukiza abarwayi? Mbese ni ko boose bavuga mu ndimi zitandukanye? Mbese ni ko boose baazi gusobaanura izo ndimi?
Nuuko reero nimuharanire impaano ziruta izindi. Maze nanje nzaabeereka inzira nziiza ihebuuje.
Nuubwo navuga mu ndimi z’abantu n’iz’abaamalayika, ariko singire urukundo, naaba meze nk’ikide kibomborana cangwa inzogera ziirangiira.

Kandi nuubwo nagira impaano y’ubuhanuuzi, ngasobaanukirwa amayobera yoose n’ubumenyi bwose, kandi nuubwo nagira ukwizeera gukomeye, kwashobora kwimura imisozi, ariko singire urukundo, ntaaco mba ndi co.
Nuubwo naatanga ibyanje byose ngo bihaabwe abakene, kandi nuubwo naatanga umubiri wanje ngo utwikwe, ariko singire urukundo, ntaaco byamarira.
Urukundo ruriihangaana, urukundo rugira neeza, urukundo ntirugira ishari, urukundo ntirwiraariira cangwa ngo rwikuririze.
Urukundo ntirukoza isoni, ntirushaaka ibyarwo, ntiruraakara, ntirugira inziika,
ntirwishiimira gukora ibibi, ahuubwo rwishiimira ukuri.
Urukundo rwihangaanira byose, rwemera byose, rwiringira byose kandi rutwihangaanisha muri byose.
Guhanuura kuzaashira, kuvuga indimi zitandukanye bizaashira, ubwenge buzaagira iherezo, ariko urukundo ntiruzaashira.
Koko reero ubwenge bwacu ntibwuzuye kandi duhanuura ibituuzuye.
Ariko igihe ibyuzuye kandi bitunganye bizaazira, ibituuzuye bidatunganye bizaashira.
Nkiri umwana, navugaga nk’umwana, ngateekereza nk’umwana, kandi nkiibwira nk’umwana. Ariko maze gukura, iby’ubwana narabiretse.
Ibyo tureeba ubu bimeze nk’ibikeezikeezi biboneka mu ndorerwamo, ariko ico gihe tuzaareebana amaaso ku yandi. Ubu ibyo nzi ni ibice, ariko ico gihe nzaamenya ibyuzuye, nk’uko Imaana inzi mu bwuzuye.
Noone ubu reero hasigaye ibi uko ari bitatu: Ukwizeera, ibyiringiro n’urukudo, ariko ikiruta byose ni urukundo.
Nimuharanire urukundo kandi mushiishikarire kugira impaano z’Umwuka, na caane impaano yo kwamamaza ubutumwa bw’Imaana.
Abavuga mu ndimi zidasobaanutse ntaabwo baba babwira abantu, ahuubwo baba babwira Imaana. Ntaawumva ibyo bavuga kuko baba bavuga amabanga bayobowe n’Umwuka.
Ariko abahanuura baba babwira abantu ibyo kubafasha, kubakomeza no kubahuumuriza.
Abavuga mu ndimi zidasobaanutse ni bo biyungura ubwabo, ariko abavuga ijambo ry’ubuhanuuzi bungura itoorero ryose.

Naakwifuuza ko mwese muvuga mu ndimi zidasobaanutse, ariko caane caane naakunda yuuko mwahanuura. Uhanuura arusha agaciiro uvuga mu ndimi zidasobaanutse, keretse hagize ushobora kuzisobaanura kugira ngo zifashe itoorero.

Noone se bavandimwe, ndamutse nje iwaanyu nkivugira mu ndimi zidasobaanutse, naaba mbafashije iki? Ntaaco mba mbafashije keretse mbabwiye ibyo Imaana yampishuuriye, cangwa ubumenyi, ubuhanuuzi n’inyigiisho bikomooka ku Maana.
Ni co kimwe n’ibiririmbiisho bitagira ubuzima nk’umwirenge cangwa inanga. Wabwirwa n’iki ikivuzwa cangwa igicurangwa, udatandukanyije amajwi yabyo?
Kandi impanda na yo ivugijwe ijwi ridasobaanutse, ni nde wakwiteguurira urugamba?
Namwe reero ni uko. Umuntu yaasobaanukirwa ate ibyo muvuga kandi indimi mukoreesha zidasobaanura amagambo? Amagambo yaanyu azaaba abaaye impfaabusa.
Ku isi hariho indimi nyinshi, kandi ntaanarumwe rudafite ico rusobaanura.
Ariko reero hagize umbwira amagambo ntasobaanukiwe muri urwo rurimi ruvugwa, uruvuga aba ambeereye umunyamahanga kandi nanje nkaba mubeereye umunyamahanga.
Noone reero ubwo muharanira kugira impaano z’Umwuka, mwibande na caane kuri izo zaabafasha kuzaamuura itoorero.
Noone reero umuntu uvuga mu ndimi zidasobaanutse, akwiriye no gusaba Imaana impaano yo gusobaanura ibyo yavuze.
Kuko iyo nsenga mu ndimi zidasobaanutse, umutima wanje uba usenga ariko ubwenge bwanje ntibugire ico bumara.
Noone se niiba bimeze bityo, nkore iki? Nzaaja nsengera mu mutima, ubundi kandi nsengane ubwenge. Nzaaririmbira indirimbo z’ishimwe mu mutima kandi nongere ndirimbane ubwenge.
Mbese uramutse ushiimiye Imaana mu mutima gusa, umuntu w’iruhande udasobaanukiwe yaashobora ate gusubiza ati, "Amiina" ku sengeesho ryo atumviise, kandi atumva ico uvuga?
Ushobora gushiima neeza caane, ariko abandi bantu ntihagire ico bunguka.
Ndashiimira Imaana kuko mwese mbarusha kuvuga mu ndimi zidasobaanutse,
ariko ndi mu masengeesho yo mu ikoraniro, naavuga amagambo ataanu yoonyine asobaanutse kugira ngo niigiishe abandi, aho kuvuga amagambo menshi mu ndimi zidasobaanutse.
Bavandimwe, ntimugateekereze nk’abaana bato, ariko mu byerekeye gukora icaaha, mugomba kuba intungaane nk’abaana naho mu miteekerereze, muje mugenza nk’abantu bakuru.

Mu gitabo c’amategeko handitswe ngo, "Nzaakoreesha abantu bavuga indimi zidasobaanutse mukubwira abantu banje, uwo ni Nyagasani ubivuze. Nzaababwira nkoreesheje akanwa k’abanyamahanga, ariko nabwo abantu banje ntibazanyumvira."

Noone reero, impaano yo kuvuga mu ndimi zidasobaanutse ntaabwo ari ikimenyeetso c’abeemera ahuubwo ni ic’abateemera, naho impaano yo guhanuura ntaabwo ari ikimenyeetso c’abateemera, ahuubwo n’ikimenyeetso c’abeemera.
Noone se abeemera boose bateeraniye hamwe maze hakagira abatangira kuvuga mu ndimi zidasobaanutse nuuko hakinjira umuntu udasobaanukiwe cangwa utiizeera, ntiyavuga ati muri abasazi?
Ariko hagize umuntu udasobaanukiwe cangwa utiizeera winjira maze agasanga buri muntu ahanuura, yakwishinja ibyaha bye ku bw’ibyo yumva.
Nyuma yuuko amabanga ahishwe mu mutima y’utiizeera ashizwe ahagaragara, azaapfukama imbere y’Imaana maze ayiramye avuga ati, "Ni ukuri koko Imaana iri muri mwe!"

Noone se bavandimwe dukore iki? Igihe muteeraniye hamwe, umwe ashobora kuyobora indirimbo, undi akiigiisha, undi agatangaaza ibyo yahishuuriwe, undi akavuga mu ndimi zidasobaanutse, kandi undi agasobaanura ibyavuzwe. Nuuko reero byose muje mubikora mu kungura itoorero.
Niiba hariho abavuga mu ndimi zidasobanutse, havuge babiri cangwa batatu gusa kandi havuge umwe umwe, nuuko habeho n’uwo kuzisobaanura.
Kandi niiba hatariho uwo gusobaanura izo ndimi, uvugira mu ndimi zidasobaanutse akwiriye guceceka akavugira mu mutima we kandi akavugana n’Imaana.
Abahanuuzi babiri cangwa batatu na bo bavuge, maze abandi basuuzume ibyo bavuga.
Ariko hagize umuntu wiicaye mu iteeraniro akagira ico ahishuurirwa, uwavugaga akwiriye kuba arekeye aho.
Kuko mwese mushobora guhanuura habanje umwe hagakurikiraho undi, kugira ngo boose biige kandi bibakomeze.
Impaano y’Umwuka w’ubuhanuuzi ikwiriye kugengwa n’uvuga ubwo buhanuuzi,
kuko Imaana itari Imaana y’akajagaari, ahuubwo ni iy’amahoro. Nk’uko bimeze mu matoorero yoose y’abantu b’Imaana,
abagore bagomba guceceka, kuko bateemerewe kuvuga, ahuubwo beemere gutegekwa nk’uko amategeko y’Abayuuda abivuga.
Baramutse hari ico biifuuza kumenya, baje babariza abagabo mu rugo, kuko biteeye isoni ko umugore avugira mu iteeraniro.
Mbese ijambo ry’Imaana rikomooka kuri mwe? Cangwa se ni mwe mwenyine ryagejejweho?
Umuntu weese wiibwira ko ari umuhanuuzi, cangwa se ko afite imbaraga z’Umwuka, niyemere ko ibyo mbandikiye ari itegeko rya Nyagasani.
Ariko naataryemera, na mwe ntimukamwiteho.
Noone reero bavandimwe, nimuharanire kubwiriza ubutumwa bw’Imaana, ariko ntimubuze abiizeera kuvuga mu ndimi zidasobaanutse.
Mugomba gukora byose neeza mu buryo bukwiriye.
Bavandimwe, ndashaaka kubiibutsa iby’Inkuru Nziiza nababwirije, maze mukayaakiira mukanayikomereramo,
ikaba ari na yo izaabakiza muramutse muyikomeje nk’uko nayibabwirije, keretse ukwizeera kwanyu kuramutse kwarabaaye imfaabusa.
Koko reero nabagejejeho ico nanje nahaawe, ari co c’ingenzi, yuuko Kristo yapfiiriye ibyaha byacu nk’uko byari byaranditswe,
kandi ko yahambwe maze ku munsi wa gatatu akazuuka nk’uko byari byaranditswe na noone,
kandi yuuko yabonekeye Peetero, haanyuma abonekera na za ntumwa cumi n’ebyiri.
Haanyuma yongeye kubonekera abavandimwe basaaga magana ataanu icaarimwe, kandi abenshi muri bo baracaariho ariko bamwe baarapfuuye.
Maze yabonekeye na Yaakobo, nyuma abonekera intumwa zoose.
Nyuma ya byose, nanje arambonekera nuubwo meeze nk’uwavuukiye imburagihe.
Kuko ndi uworoheje mu zindi ntumwa zoose, ndetse sinkwiriwe no kwitwa intumwa, kuko natooteje itoorero ry’Imaana.

Ariko ku bw’ubuntu bw’Imaana, ni co caatumye mba uko ndi, kandi ubwo buntu nahaawe ntibwabaaye impfaabusa, ahuubwo nakoze caane kuruta boose, nuubwo atari ku bwanje ahuubwo ni ku bw’ubuntu bw’Imaana buri nanje.
Uko biri koose, yaaba njeewe cangwa bo, ubwo ni bwo butumwa twamamaza kandi namwe ni bwo mwemeye.
Ubwo haamamazwa ko Yesu yazuutse mu baapfuuye, bishoboka bite ko bamwe muri mwe bavuga ko abaapfuuye batazaazuuka?
Niiba hatariho kuzuuka kw’abaapfuuye, noone reero na Kristo ntaabwo yazuutse,
kandi niiba Kristo ataarazuutse, ubutumwa twamamaza no kwizeera Kristo kwanyu biba bibaaye ubusa.
Kandi naatwe twagaragara nk’abahamya Imaana mu binyoma, kuko twahamije yuuko Imaana yazuuye Kristo kandi itaaramuzuuye niiba abaapfuuye batazaazuuka.
Kuko niiba abaapfuuye batazuuka, noone reero na Kristo ntaabwo yazuutse.
Niiba Imaana itaarazuuye Kristo, ukwizeera kwanyu muri Kristo ntikugira umumaro, mukaba mukiri mu byaha byanyu.
Bityo reero n’abaapfiiriye muri Kristo baararimbutse.
Niiba reero ibyiringiro byacu muri Kristo ari byiza muri ubu buzima gusa, twaba dukwiriye kugirirwa imbabazi kuruta abandi bantu boose.
Ariko mu by’ukuri, Kristo yazuutse mu baapfuuye, aba umuzuukambere mu baapfuuye.
Nk’uko urupfu rwazanywe n’umuntu, ni ko no kuzuuka kw’abaapfuuye kwazanywe n’umuntu.
Nk’uko boose baapfa biturutse kuri Adamu, ni na ko boose bazaazuuka mu baapfuuye biturutse kuri Kristo.
Ariko buri umwe azaazuuka mu gihe ce, uwabanje kuzuuka ni Kristo maze haanyuma abaamuyobotse bazaakurikireho, igihe co azaazira.
Nuuko hazaabaho imperuuka, Kristo atsembe ibinyabutware by’umwuka byose, ibinyabushobozi, n’ibinyabubaasha, maze yeegurire Imaana Daata Ubwami.
Kuko Kristo akwiriye gutegeka kugeza aho Imaana izaatsinda abanzi boose ikabashira munsi y’ibirenge bye.
Umwanzi uzaaheruuka gutsembwa ni urupfu.

Kuko ibyanditswe biravuga ngo, "Imaana yashize ibintu byose munsi y’ibirenge bye." Ariko iyo ivuga iti, "Byose bishizwe munsi y’ibirenge bye," biragaragara yuuko Imaana yashize ibintu byose munsi y’ibirenge bya Kristo yo itabibariwemo.
Igihe ibintu byose bizaaba bimaze kwegurirwa Kristo, ni bwo na we nk’Umwana w’Imaana aziiyegurira Imaana yamweguriye byose, kugira ngo itegeke abe byose muri boose.
Bitabaaye bityo, reka twibaze ku bantu babatirizwa abaapfuuye. Niiba koko abaapfuuye batazuuka nk’uko bamwe babivuga, ni iki gituma bababatirizwa?
Kandi kuki naatwe ubwacu twishira mu kaaga buri gihe?
Bavandimwe, buri munsi mpora mpanganye n’urupfu! Ibyo mbivuga ku bw’ishema mfite ku bwanyu kubwa Kristo Yesu Umwami waacu.

Niiba naarakurikije ibyiringiro by’abantu nkarwana n’inyamaaswa zo muri Efeeso, byamariye iki? Ariko niiba abaapfuuye batazuuka, nidukurikize iby’abantu bavuga ngo, "Nimureke twiriire kandi twinywere, kuko ejo tuzaapfa."
Ntihakagire ubayobya, kuko "Kubaana n’ababi byonoona ingeso nziiza."
Nimwisubireho mwifate uko bikwiriye, kandi mwekongera gukora ibyaha kuko bamwe muri mwe bataazi Imaana. Ibyo mbivugiye kubakoza isoni.
Ariko bamwe bazaabaza bati, "Mbese abaapfuuye bazaazuuka bate? Mbese bazaagira umubiri umeze ute?"
Mbeega injiji! Ico ubibye ntigishobora kumera ngo kibe kizima kitabanje gupfa.
Kandi ico ubiba ntigisa n’ikizeera haanyuma, ahuubwo ni akabuto gato, kaaba ak’ingano cangwa akandi kabuto koose.
Nyuma Imaana iha ako kabuto ishusho yakageneye, buri rubuto iruha akamero yarugeneye.
Kandi n’imibiri y’ibinyabuzima ntaabwo yoose isa. Abantu bagira umubiri usa ukwawo, n’inyamaaswa zikagira umubiri usa ukwazo, inyoni hamwe n’isamaaki na zo bikaba uko.
Kandi hari ibyaremwe byo mu kireere n’ibindi byo ku isi, ariko ubwiza bw’ibyo mu kireere butandukanye n’ubwiza bw’ibyo ku isi.
Izuuba rirabagirana ukwaryo, ukwezi kukarabagirana ukwako, n’inyenyeeri zikarabagirana ukwazo, ndetse n’inyenyeeri ubwazo ntizihwanyije kurabagirana.
No kuzuuuka kw’abaapfuuye ni ko kumeze. Iyo umubiri uhambwe urabora, ariko ukazaazuukira kudapfa.
Ushirwa mu butaka usuuzuguritse, ariko ukazaazuukana ikuzo. Ushirwa mu butaka ufite intege nke, ariko ukazuukana imbaraga.
Uhambwa ari umubiri ufatika, ukazuuka ari umubiri w’umwuka. Niiba hariho umubiri ufatika, hagomba reero no kubaho umubiri w’umwuka.
Ni na ko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Umuntu wa mbere, ari we Adamu yabaaye muzima", naho Adamu wa nyuma ni umwuka utanga ubugingo.
Ariko si umwuka ubanza, ahuubwo ni umubiri ufatika ubanza, maze hagakurikiraho umwuka.
Umuntu wa mbere yavuuye mu butaka, kandi yaremwe mu butaka, naho umuntu wa kabiri yavuuye mu ijuru.
Nk’uko uwaremwe mu butaka yabaaye, ni na ko ab’ubutaka bameze, kandi nk’uko uwavuuye mu ijuru ameze, ni na ko abaagenewe ijuru bazaaba.
Kandi nk’uko twambaye ishusho y’umuntu waremwe mu butaka, ni na ko tuzambara ishusho y’umuntu waturutse mu ijuru.
Noone bavandimwe, ico nshaaka kuvuga ni iki, umuntu ntaabwo ashobora kuronka umurage w’Ubwami bw’Imaana ku bw’umubiri n’amaraso, kandi ibibora ntaabwo byaragwa ibitabora.
Nimwumve mbamenere ibanga! Ntaabwo twese tuzaapfa, ahuubwo twese tuzaahindurwa ukundi,
mu kaanya gato nk’ako guhumbya, ubwo impanda ya nyuma izaavuga. Kuko impanda izaavuga, maze abaapfuuye bazuurwe badafite imibiri ibora, maze naatwe duhindurwe ukundi.
Kuko uyu mubiri ubora ukwiriye kwambikwa umubiri utabora, kandi uyu mubiri wagenewe gupfa ukwiriye kwambikwa umubiri utazaapfa.
Noone reero igihe uyu mubiri wagenewe kubora uzambikwa utabora, kandi n’uyu mubiri ugenewe gupfa ukambikwa umubiri utazaapfa, ubwo ni bwo ibyanditswe bizuuzurizwa ngo, "Urupfu ruratsinzwe burundu."
"Wa rupfu we, gutsinda kwawe kuri he? Wa rupfu we, urubuuri rwawe ruri he?"
Urubuuri rw’urupfu ni icaaha, kandi imbaraga z’icaaha ni amategeko.
Ariko Imaana ishimwe, kuko iduha gutsinda ku bw’Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo.
Nuuko reero bakundwa, nimukomere, ntimuhungabane, kandi mukomeze gushiishikarira gukora umurimo wa Nyagasani, kuko muuzi neeza yuuko ntaaco muzaakorera Nyagasani kizaaba imfaabusa.
Ku byerekeye gusorooza ishilingi zo gufasha abantu b’Imaana muri Yudeeya, mukurikize nk’uko nategetse amatoorero yo muri Galatiya.
Ku munsi wa mbere wa buri cumweru, buri muntu aje abiika ico yaashobora gusaagura ku byo yungutse, kugira ngo igihe nzaazira ataba ari ho mutangira gusorooza imfashanyo.
Ningera iyo, nzaaha inzaandiko abantu bo muzaaba mwihitiyemo, bajaane imfashanyo zaanyu i Yerusaalemu.
Kandi bibaaye ngombwa ko nanje ngenda, tuzaafatanya urugendo.
Nzaabasuura maze kunyura muri Makedooniya kuko mfite umugambi wo kuyinyuramo,
kandi ubundi ahaari nzaamarana namwe iminsi ndetse nkaba naahamara n’iminsi y’igihe c’imbeho, kugira ngo mumfashe gukomeza urugendo rwanje aho nzaaja hoose.
Sinshaaka kubabonaho gato ngo nkomeze urugendo, kuko nizeeye kuzaamarana namwe iminsi, Nyagasani naabishaaka.
Ariko nzaaguma muri Efeeso kugeza ku munsi wa Pentekooti,
kuko nuugururiwe irembo kugira ngo mpakorere umurimo w’ingirakamaro, nuubwo hariyo abandwanya benshi.
Timoteeyo aramutse aje, mureebe ngo mumwakiiranye urugwiro kugira ngo abaane namwe adatiinya, kuko akora umurimo wa Nyagasani nkanje.
Nuuko reero ntihazaagire umusuuzugura, ahuubwo muzaamufashe gukomeza urugendo rwe mu mahoro, kugira ngo angereho, kuko mutegereje we n’abandi bavandimwe.
Ku byerekeye umuvandimwe waacu Apolo, naramwinginze ngo azane n’abandi bavandimwe iwaanyu, ariko ntaabwo yabikunze na hato, nyamara naabona uburyo, azaaza.
Murabe maaso, mukomerere mu kwizeera, mube intwari kandi mukomere.
Ibyo mukora byose mubikorane urukundo.
Ikindi bavandimwe, muuzi neeza yuuko Siteefaano n’ab’urugo rwe ari bo baabanjirije abandi bo muri Akaya kwemera Kristo, kandi bakaba baariitangiye gufasha abantu b’Imaana.
Ndabinginze ngo mwemere kuyoborwa n’abantu nk’abo, hamwe n’abandi boose bafatanyije na bo imirimo n’imiruho.
Neejeejwe n’uko Siteefaano na Forotunato na Akayiku baaje hano, bagakora ico mwajaga kunkorera iyo muhaba,
kuko baruhuuye umutima wanje ndetse n’uwanyu. Nuuko muje mushiimira abantu nk’abo ibyo baakoze.
Amatoorero yo muri Asiya arabaramutsa. Akwila na Purisika, hamwe n’itoorero riteeranira mu rugo rwabo, barabataasha caane muri Nyagasani.
Abavandimwe boose barabataasha. Namwe reero muramukanye mu buryo bwa gikristo.
Njeewe Pawulo, ni nje wiyandikiye iyi ndamutso.
Nihagira umuntu udakunda Nyagasani, avumwe. Ngwino Mwami waacu.
Ubuntu bwa Nyagasani Yesu, bubaane namwe.
Urukundo rwanje rubaane namwe mwese ku bwa Kristo Yesu.

name: 2 Coríntios
chapters: Njeewe Pawulo, wagizwe intumwa ya Yesu Kristo ku bw’ubushaake bw’Imaana, hamwe na mwene daata Timoteeyo, turabandikira mwebwe ab’itoorero ry’Imaana riri i Korinto n’abantu b’Imaana boose bari muri Akaya hoose.
Nimugire ubuntu n’amahoro biva ku Maana Daata hamwe n’Umwami Yesu Kristo.
Dushiime Imaana, Se w’Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo, ari we Daata wa twese w’imbabazi n’ihuumure,
uduhuumuriza mu makuba yoose, kugira ngo naatwe dushobore guhuumuriza abandi boose bashavuye, tubahuumuriza nk’uko Imaana iduhuumuriza.
Bityo reero nk’uko dusangira na Kristo imibabaro ye yoose bihebuuje, ni na ko Imaana itugezaho guhuumurizwa bihebuuje muri Kristo.

Igihe tubabazwa, tubabazwa kugira ngo muhuumurizwe kandi mubone agakiza, kandi iyo duhuumurijwe, ni ukugira ngo namwe muhuumurizwe maze muhaabwe imbaraga zo kwihangaanira imibabaro yo natwe twihangaanira.
Ibyiringiro tubafitemo bitanyeganyezwa nuuko tuuzi ko ubwo dusangiye imibabaro, dusangiye no guhuumurizwa.
Bavandimwe, ntitwabahisha amakuba twanyuzemo turi muri Asiya. Uko twababaye bikabije, tukageza n’aho kwiheba tuuzi ngo tugiiye gupfa.
Nibyo koko, twumvaga yuuko duciiriwe urwo gupfa. Ariko ibi byabaaye kugira ngo twekwihanga amaaso ngo twiyiringire, ahuubwo twiringire Imaana yo izuura abaapfuuye.
Ni yo yaturokoye ituvaana muri ibyo byago bikomeye, kandi iracaanadukiza. Muri yo niho dushingiye ibyiringiro byacu ko izongera ikadukiza,
kandi twizeeye yuuko namwe mudufasha mukadusabira. Bityo reero ku bw’amasengeesho y’abantu benshi, Imaana ikaduha imigisha maze bigatuma benshi bayishiimira ku bwacu.

Tuneezeezwa nuuko umutima waacu uhamya yuuko ubugingo bwacu ku isi, na caane imibaanire yaacu namwe yashobojwe no kwera kutaryarya kuva ku Maana, bidateewe n’ubwenge bw’abantu, ahuubwo biteewe n’ubuntu bw’Imaana.
Ntitubandikira ibirenze ibyo mwashobora gusoma mugasobaanukirwa, kandi niizeera ko muri busobaanukirwe ibi kugeza ku musoozo,
n’ubwo ubu mudasobaanukiwe, kugira ngo kuri wa munsi Umwami Yesu azaazira, tuzaabiiraatane nk’uko namwe mutwiraatiisha.
Kuko nari niiringiye ibi reero, nagize umugambi wo kubanza kuuza kubasuura kugira ngo Imaana ikubiishemo kabiri ku migisha ibaha.
Nashaakaga kuuza kubasuura nkija i Makedooniya, ngo kandi nongere ngaruke mvuye i Makedooniya kugira ngo mumpe n’ubufasha bunshoboza gukomeza urugendo nja i Yudeeya.

Mbese ubwo nendaga gukora ntyo, narashidiikanyaga? Cangwa se mwibwira ko iyo nkora imigambi nshingira ku rugero rw’abantu, mu buryo niihakanya nkavuga nti, "Yeego, yeego," cangwa nti, "Oya, oya," mbivugira icaarimwe?
Nk’uko Imaana ari iyo kwizeerwa, ni yo njuriza yuuko tutiigeze tubajijiisha ngo tubabwire ngo, "Yeego" na "oya".
Kuko Yesu Kristo Umwana w’Imaana uwo nje na Siluwano hamwe na Timoteeyo twababwirije atiivugurura ngo yihakane ibyo yari yiyemeje, ahuubwo muri we harimo "Yeego" gusa.
Kuko muri we Imaana yuzuza amaseezerano yaayo. Ni yo mpamvu Yesu Kristo ari we "Amiina" kugira ngo Imaana ihaabwe ikuzo.
Ni yo idukomereza mu kwizeera Kristo hamwe namwe kandi ni yo Yadutooranyije ngo dukore umurimo waayo,
idushiraho ikimenyeetso, iduha Umwuka waayo mu mitima yaacu kugira ngo utubeere icemezo c’ibyiza yatugeneye.
Imaana ni yo njuriza yuuko icaatumye ntongera kuuza i Korinto ari uko ntaashaatse kubongera imibabaro.
Icakora ntitubahata ku byerekeye ukwizeera kwanyu kuko tuuzi neeza yuuko mugushikamyemo, ahuubwo dukorana namwe kugira ngo mugire kwishiima.
Noone niiyemeje kutagaruka iwaanyu ngo ntongera kubateera agahinda.
Mbese mbateeye agahinda, ni nde wanteera umuneezeero? Ni abo bo nateeye agahinda.
Ni co gituma narabandikiye urwandiko ntyo, kugira ngo ninza nteeguteezwa agahinda n’abo baakabaaye banteera umuneezeero. Kuko niiringira ko umuneezeero wanje ari wo muneezeero waanyu.
Kuko nabandikiye mfite agahinda gasaaze, umutima wanje wuuzuye umubabaro kandi ndira, atari ukugira ngo namwe mbateeze gushavura, ahuubwo ngo mumenye yuuko mbafitiye urukundo ruhebuuje.
Niiba hari umuntu wagize uwo ateera agahinda, si nje yababaje gusa ahuubwo namwe yarabababaje mu buryo butari bumwe.
Igihano abenshi muri mwe baamuhannye kirahaagije ku muntu nk’uwo.
Noone reero ubu mumubabarire kandi mumuhuumurize, kugira ngo ataaza kwicwa n’agahinda gasaaze.
Kandi ndabinginze, mumwereke urukundo mumufitiye.
Nabandikiye mbagerageza kugira ngo menye niiba mwumvira muri byose.
Umuntu weese wo muzaababarira nanje nzaamubabarira. Kuko iyo mbabarira, niiba koko hari ico nkwiriye kugirira imbabazi, mba mbabarira ku bwanyu imbere ya Kristo,
kugira ngo tweguha Sataani umwanya wo kutuguusha kuko tuuzi imigambi ye.
Ubwo nageze i Tirowa kwamamaza Ubutumwa Bwiza bwa Kristo, nasanze Umwami waacu yaranteguuriye uburyo.
Ariko nahangayikiishijwe n’uko ntaasanzeyo mwene daata Tito. Nuuko mpeerako ndabaseezera nja i Makedooniya.
Ariko Imaana ishimwe kuko ishoboza Kristo guhora atuja imbere mu kwizihiza intsinzi. Ni yo ituma twamamaza hoose impuumuro nziiza izanwa no kumumenya.
Kuko turi nk’imibavu ihuumura neeza Kristo atuura Imaana, ikagera kuri abo bakizwa hamwe n’abarimbuka.
Kuri abo barimbuka, tubanuukira nk’urupfu rubiica, ariko kuri abo bakizwa, ni impumuro nziiza ibaazanira ubuzima. Mbese ni nde waashobora gukora umurimo nk’uyu?
Ariko twe ntitumeze nk’abagenda bacuruuza ijambo ry’Imaana nk’aho ari umukimbo uciiriritse, ahuubwo kuko Imaana ari yo yadutumye, tuvuga tutaryarya imbere yaayo kandi nk’abakozi ba Kristo.
Mbese muteekereza yuuko dutangiye kongera kwishiimagiza? Cangwa se ko dukeneye kwitwaza inzandiko zitwanzura kuri mwe cangwa zibavuuyeho nk’uko bamwe babigenza?
Urwandiko rwacu rwanditswe mu mitima yaacu ni mwe, uru rwandiko rugomba kumenywa kandi rugasomwa na boose.
Biragaragara yuuko ari mwe rwandiko rwa Kristo twateguuye, rutanditswe n’ikaraamu ahuubwo rwanditswe n’Umwuka w’Imaana, kandi rutanditswe ku mpapuro ahuubwo rwanditswe ku mitima y’abantu.
Ico ni co ciizeere dufite mu Maana tubikeesha Kristo.
Yuuko ubwacu tutiihaagije ngo twiraate ko hari ico twakwishoboza ahuubwo ubushobozi bwacu buva ku Maana,
ari yo idushoboza kuba abaheereza bo mu seezerano risha, ridashingiye ku nzandiko z’amategeko ahuubwo rishingiye ku Mwuka. Kuko amategeko ariica, naho Umwuka ugatanga ubugingo.

Ayo mategeko yari inyuguti zanditswe ku bisate by’amabuye, ariko ikuzo ry’Imaana ryaragaragaye rirabagirana igihe yatangwaga ku buryo no ku maaso ha Moose haararabagiranye. Ryarabagiranaga bihebuuje ku buryo bitashobokaga ngo Abiisirayeli bakomeze kureeba Moose. Niiba reero amategeko azanira abantu gupfa iyo adakurikijwe yarazanye n’iryo kuzo rihebuuje rityo,
ikuzo ry’imirimo y’Umwuka ryo rizaaba rimeze rite?
Noone niiba amategeko azana guciibwaho iteeka yarahaawe ikuzo, imirimo izanira abantu agakiza yo izaahabwa ikuzo rihebuje kurutaho!
Ni koko amategeko yataakaje ikuzo ryayo kuko haabonetse igifite ikuzo risumbaho.
Kuko niiba haari ikuzo ku mategeko yamaze akaanya gato akoreeshwa, ico kigenewe kubaho iteeka co kizaagira ikuzo riheebuje kurutaho.
Nooneho ubwo dufite ico ciizeere, biduteera kuvuga dushize amanga.
Ntitumeze nka Moose wiitwikiiraga igitambaaro ku maaso kugira ngo Abiisirayeli batareeba ikuzo rimushiraho.
Nyamara imitima yaabo yariinangiye, no kugeza ubu ca gitambaaro kiracaatwikiiriye ku maaso haabo iyo basomerwa iseezerano rya keera. Ico gitambaaro gitwikurwa no kwizeera Kristo byonyine.
No kugeza kuri uyu munsi, iyo ibyanditswe na Moose bisomwa, ico gitambaaro gitwikiira ibiteekerezo byabo.
Ariko iyo umuntu ahindukiye Umwami ico gitambaaro kiratwikuurwa.
Umwami uvugwaho ni Umwuka, kandi aho Umwuka w’Umwami ari haba umudendeezo.
Nuuko reero twese twerekana ikuzo ry’Umwami kandi amaaso yaacu aratwikuuruye. Iryo kuzo riva ku Mwami waacu ni wo Mwuka uduhindura ngo duse na we, tuva ku rwego rumwe rw’ikuzo tuja ku rundi.
Nuuko reero ubwo twahaawe gukora uyu murimo ku bw’imbabazi z’Imaana, ntiduciika intege.

Twanga ibiteeye isoni bikorwa rwihishwa, ntitugendera mu buriganya kandi ntitugoreka ijambo ry’Imaana, ahuubwo tuvuga ukuri tweruye imbere y’Imaana kugira ngo buri muntu weese amenye mu mutima we ko turi abanyakuri.
Kandi niiba Ubutumwa Bwiza tuvuga butwikiiriwe, butwikiiririwe abarimbuka.

Ntibeemera kuko imaana mbi itegeka iyi isi yatwikiirije imitima yaabo umwijima. Niyo ituma batabona umuco ubamurikaho, uwo muco ariwo uva mu Butumwa Bwiza bw’ikuzo rya Kristo, ari we shusho ry’Imaana nyaaryo.
Erega ntituba twiyamamaza ahuubwo twamamaza Yesu Kristo ko ari we Mwami naho twe tukaba abagaragu baanyu kubwa Yesu.
Kuko Imaana yategetse ngo, "Umuco ni umurike mu mwijima," ni yo Maana yatumye umuco waayo umurikira mu mitima yaacu ukatuuzanira kumenya ikuzo ry’Imaana rimurikira mu maaso ya Kristo.
Icakora twebwe tumeze nk’ababiitse ubwo butunzi mu ibumba rimeneka, kugira ngo ububaasha buhebuuje budukorerwamo bwekutwitirirwa, ahuubwo bumenywe ko buturuka ku Maana.
Tubabazwa mu buryo bwose ariko ntidushenjagurwa, turashoberwa ariko ntitwiheba,
turatootezwa ariko Imaana ntiiduteererana, dukubitwa haasi, ariko ntidutsindwa.
Igihe coose tugendana imibabaro y’urupfu rwa Kristo, kugira ngo ubuzima bwe bugaragarire mu mibiri yaacu.
N’ubwo turi bazima, duhora turi mu kaaga ko kwicwa tuzizwa Yesu Kristo, kugira ngo ubuzima bwe bubonekere mu mibiri yaacu izaapfa.
Bityo, twe duhora dutezwe n’urupfu, naho mwe mukazaabiboneramo ubugingo bw’iteeka.
Ariko dushigikiwe n’umutima wo kwizeera nk’uko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Nariizeeye, niyo mpamvu mbyamamaza," natwe uko kwizeera niko gutuma twamamaza ubutumwa.
Tuuzi yuuko Imaana yazuuye Umwami Yesu izaatuzuurana na we, kandi ikatujaana hamwe na mwe ituuzana imbere ye.
Ibi byose biba ku bwanyu, kugira ngo ubuntu bw’Imaana bugwire muri benshi, bitume bashiima Imaana kandi bayiheeshe ikuzo.
Ni co gituma tudaciika intege. N’ubwo umubiri waacu ugenda usaaza, imitima yaacu yo ihora ihindurwa busha buri munsi.
Kandi uku kubabazwa kw’akaanya gato muri iki gihe gihita kugenewe kuduteguurira ikuzo ry’iteeka rihebuuje tuzaabona ritagereranywa n’amakuba tunyuramo ubu.
Kuko ntiduhanga amaaso yaacu kubigaragara ahuubwo twibanda kubitagaragara, kuko ibigaragara ari iby’akaanya gato, naho ibitagaragara n’iby’iteeka ryose.
Tuuzi yuuko uyu mubiri ducumbitsemo kuri iyi si ari nk’ihema, ni rizaasenywa, Imaana idufitiye inzu mu ijuru idasenyuka, itaaruubatswe n’amaboko y’abantu kandi ihoraho iteeka.
Igihe tugicumbitse muri iryo hema turatakamba, tukiifuuza kwambikwa imibiri misha ihoraho yo mu ijuru
kugira ngo nitumara kwamburwa uyu mubiri wo ku isi, tudasangwa twambaye ubusa.

Tugicumbitse muri iri hema ryo ku isi, dutaka ku bw’imibabaro ituremeerereye. Si uko twifuuza kwamburwa uyu mubiri, ahuubwo ni uko twifuuza kwambikwa umubiri tuzaahaabwa mu ijuru, kugira ngo uyu upfa usimbuurwe n’udapfa.
Imaana ni yo yaduteguuriye ibyo, iduha Umwuka waayo nk’ikimenyeetso c’umushingo uhamya ko izaabisohoza.
Bityo tukagira ubutwari, tuuzi yuuko iyo turi mu mubiri wo kuri iyi si, tuba dutuuye kure y’Umwami waacu.
Kuko tugenda tuyoborwa no kwizeera, ntituyoborwa n’ibigaragarira amaaso.
Ni koko duhora dushikamye, kandi tukarushaho gukunda ko twakwitandukanya n’uyu mubiri kugira ngo twibaanire n’Umwami waacu Yesu.
Ni co gituma tugamije kumushiimiisha twaba turi aha ku isi cangwa tutayirimo.
Kuko twese tuziitaba imbere ya Kristo guciirwa urubanza, kugira ngo buri umwe ahaabwe ibikwiriye ibyo yakoze akiri ku isi, byaba byiza cangwa bibi.
Ubu tuuzi gutiinya Nyagasani ico ari co, ni yo mpamvu dukora uko dushoboye ngo ibye tubyemeze abantu. Uko turi koose Imaana iratuuzi, kandi niiringira yuuko namwe ibyacu mubiizi neeza mu mutima.
Ibi simbivuga kugira ngo nongere kubiiyererutsaho, ahuubwo turashaaka kubaha uburyo bwo kuturaata, kugira ngo mubone ico musubiza ba bandi baraata ibigaragarira amaaso bidafite ishingiro mu mutima.
Niiba twarasaze, twasaze ku bw’Imaana, kandi niiba turi bazima, ni mwe bifitiye akamaro.
Duhatwa n’urukundo rwa Kristo, kuko twemera yuuko umwe yapfiiriye boose, ni na ko reero boose baapfuuye.
Koko yapfiiriye boose, kugira ngo ababaho, bekubaho ku bwabo, ahuubwo babeho ku bw’uwo wabapfiiriye akanabazuukira.
Ni co gituma uheereye ubu reero ari ntaamuntu n’umwe tukireeba ngo tumubare dushingiye kuri kamere muntu, n’ubwo na Kristo twigeze kumureeba dukurikije kamere muntu, ubu nti tukimureeba dutyo.
Bityo reero niiba umuntu weese yiizeeye Kristo, aba agizwe icaaremwe gisha. Ibya keera byose biba bishize. Dore byose biba bihindutse bisha!
Ibyo byose biva ku Maana, yo yiyunze naatwe inyuriye muri Kristo, ikaduha umurimo wo guhuuza abandi bantu na yo.
Kuko Imaana yanyuriye muri Kristo kugira ngo yiiyunge n’abo ku isi boose, ntiyababaraho ibicumuro byabo. Noone naatwe ni ko idushinga ubutumwa bwo guhuuza Imaana n’abantu.
Ubu reero turi intumwa za Kristo, kuko Imaana idukoreesha kubagezaho ubutumwa. Nuuko reero turabinginga mu izina rya Kristo, ngo mwiyuzuze n’Imaana.
Kristo utaarigeze akora icaaha, Imaana yamubazeho ibyaha by’abantu, kugira ngo muri we tubone kuba intungaane imbere y’Imaana.
Ubwo dukorana n’Imaana, turabinginga kugira ngo mwegupfuusha ubusa ubuntu bwayo.
Kuko iravuga iti, "Mu gihe gikwiriye, narakumviise, ku munsi w’agakiza, naragutabaaye." Noone reero, dore, iki ni co gihe gikwiriye, uyu ni wo munsi wo gukirizwamo!
Twirinda gushira igisiitaaza mu nzira y’umuntu weese, kugira ngo umurimo dukora utagira umugayo.
Ahuubwo mu byo dukora byose, tugerageza kwerekana yuuko turi abagaragu b’Imaana, mu kwihangaanira caane amakuba, imibabaro n’ibyago.
Twarakubiswe, turafungwa, duteerwa n’imidugararo, dukora ubudatuuza, turaara tudasinziiriye ndetse dushonje,
muri ibyo byose turangwa n’ubuziranenge, ubwenge, kwihangaana, n’ineeza, tuyobowe n’Umwuka Weera tukagira urukundo nyakuri.
Twamamaza ubutumwa bw’ukuri, tuyobowe n’imbaraga z’Imaana. Dufite intwaro yo gukiraanuka ari yo turwaniisha kandi ikaba ingabo idukingira.
Turuubahwa kandi tukagawa, baradusebya kandi bakadushiimagiza, batwita ababeeshi kandi turi abanyakuri,
dusa nk’intamenyekana, kandi tuuzwi neeza, dusa nk’abagiiye gupfa kandi turi bazima, dusa nk’abahanwa ariko ntitwicwe.
Duteerwa agahinda ariko tugahorana ibyishiimo, dusa nk’abakene ariko tugakenuura benshi, dusa nk’abatagira ico bafite ariko nyamara dufite byose.
Nshuti zaacu z’i Korinto, tubabwije ukuri, tubeeruriye ibiri mu mitima yaacu.
Mu mibaanire yaacu namwe, ntitwigeze kureka kwagura imitima yaacu tubagaragariza urukundo tubafitiye, ahuubwo ni mwe mwanze kudukinguurira imitima yaanyu.
Ni yo mpamvu reero inteera kuvugana namwe nk’ubwira abaana be ngo, namwe nimwagure imitima yaanyu kugira ngo mutwituure urukundo twabagiriye.
Ntimukiifatanye n’abatiizeera kandi mudahwanye na bo. Mbese ubukiraanutsi bufite isaano ki n’ubukozi bw’ibibi? Cangwa se, hariho mubaano ki hagati y’umwijima n’umuco?
Mbese Kristo ahuuriye he na Sataani? Cangwa, uwiizeera n’utiizeera bahuuriye kuki?
Mbese Inzu y’Imaana yahuuza ite n’ibigirwamaana? Kuko turi inzu y’Imaana nzima. Nk’uko Imaana yavuze iti, "Nzaatuura mu bantu banje mbaane na bo, nzaababeera Imaana, Kandi na bo bambeere umuryango."
Ni ko Uhoraho avuga ati, "Nimubavemo, nuuko mwitandukanye na bo. Ntihagire ico mukoraho gihumaanya, maze nzaabaakiira.
Nzaababeera umubyeyi, namwe mumbeere abaana, ni ko Uhoraho avuga."

Nshuti bakundwa, ayo maseezerano yoose nitwe yahaawe. Bityo reero ni mureke twiyeze twivaaneho ikintu coose gishobora guhumaanya imibiri n’imitima yaacu, dushiishikarire ubutungaane mu kuubaha Imaana.
Natwe nimuduhe umwanya mu mitima yaanyu. Dore ntaamuntu twashobereje, ntaawe twonooneye, nta n’uwo twarimanganyije.
Ibi simbivugiye kugira ngo hagire uwo nshinja icaaha, nk’uko nabivuze mbere, tubahoza ku mitima yaacu, niiyo haaba mu rupfu cangwa mubuzima turabaana.
Mbafiteho iciizeere gihaagije, kandi muhora munteera kubiiraatiisha! Mukaaga koose tunyuramo, turahuumurizwa kandi tukagira umuneezeero useesuuye.
Ndetse n’ubwo twageze muri Makedooniya, ntaabwo twigeze turuhuuka na hato, ahuubwo twahuuye n’ingorane hoose, intambara ziva hirya no hiino, hamwe no guhagarika imitima.
Ariko Imaana ihuumuriza abaciitse intege, iraduhuumuriza tuboonye Tito aje.

Si ukuuza kwe byonyine byaduhuumurije, ahuubwo n’uko yatubwiye uko mwamukomeje, ibyo bikadusubizamo intege. Yatubwiye n’ukuntu munkumbuye, ishavu mufite, n’uko mwiteguuye kundwanirira, akaba ubu birushaho kuuneezeeza.
Nuubwo urwandiko nabandikiye rwaba rwarabateeye agahinda, siniicuza ko narwanditse. Mba nariicujije mboonye uko rwabateeye agahinda umwanya muto.
Noone ubu mfite umuneezeero, icakora si uko nabateeye agahinda, ahuubwo ni uko ako gahinda kabateeye kwihana. Imaana yakoreesheje ako gahinda, bityo reero twe ntaaco twigeze tubatwara.
Kuko agahinda gateerwa no kuubaha Imaana gakurikirwa no kwihana bikabyara agakiza kandi ibyo ntaawabyicuza! Ariko agahinda gateerwa n’abantu kaazana urupfu.

Ni mureebe ibyo Imaana yabakoreye biteewe n’ako gahinda: Ukuntu kaabateeye umwete wo kwisubiraho mukiihana, uko mwashiishikariye gukora ibyiza, ukuntu kuraakara ku bw’ibyabaaye, guhagarika imitima, ibyifuuzo n’ishaka byatumye mwemera guhana uwagize naabi. Muri byose mwagaragaje ko muri abeere mu byabaaye byose.
Nuuko reero n’ubwo nabandikiye urwo rwandiko, sinabiteewe n’uwagize naabi cangwa uwagiriwe naabi. Ahuubwo, narwandikiye kubagaragariza imbere y’Imaana umwete mutugirira.
Ibyo ni byo byadukomeje. Uretse gukomezwa n’ibyo, twashiimiishijwe caane n’umuneezeero Tito yagize mumuhuumurije.
Niiba narabaraase imbere Tito, ntaabwo byigeze binkoza isoni. Ariko nk’uko ibyo twababwiye byose ari ukuri, ni na ko ibyo twanaraatiye Tito ari iby’ukuri.
Ni co gituma arushaho kubakunda, iyo yibutse uko mwese mwamwumviye, n’uko mwamwakiiriye mu cuubahiro n’igitinyiro.
Nshimiishijwe n’uko nshobora kubiringira muri byose.
Bavandimwe, twifuuza kubamenyeesha ibyerekeye ubuntu bw’Imaana yagiriye amatoorero y’i Makedooniya.
Mu gihe baageragezwaga banyura mu makuba, baagize umuneezeero uhebuuje ku buryo baagize ubuntu bagatanga caane n’ubwo baari abakene.
Ndabahamiriza yuuko baatanze uko bashoboye, ndetse bagatanga ibirenze ibyo bashoboye ku bushaake,
batwinginga caane ngo tubareke bagire uruhari mu gufasha abantu b’Imaana baari i Yudeeya.
Icakora, ntibaabigenjeje nk’uko twibwiraga, baabanje kwiyegurira Nyagasani, kandi ku bw’ubushaake bw’Imaana, naatwe baratwitangira.
Ni co caatumye dusaba Tito kurangiza umurimo w’ubuntu yari yaratangiye muri mwe.

Ubwo mukora neeza caane muri byose, haaba mu kwizeera, mu kuvuga, mu bwenge, mu gushiishikarira gufasha hamwe no mu rukundo mwatugiriye, abe ari ko murushaho no gushiishikarira kugira umwete w’umurimo wo kugira ubuntu.
Ibi simbivugiye kubategeka, ahuubwo ni ukugira ngo menye niiba mufite urukundo nyakuri ngereranyije n’umwete abandi bafite.
Musanzwe muuzi ubuntu Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo yagize, n’ubwo yari umukire, yemeye kwigira umukene ku bwanyu, kugira ngo mu bukene bwe muhinduke abakire.
Inaama naabagiira muri ibyo ni uko byakabaye byiza mukarangiza ubu ibyo mwatangiye umwaka ushize. Mwari aba mbere kugira ibyo mukora, kandi si ibyo byonyine, ahuubwo mwabikoranye ubushaake.
Nuuko kandi mubirangize, kugira ngo nk’uko mwaciiyemeje mufite ubwuzu, noone ari ko mukirangiza, mutange uko mushoboye.
Kuko niiba mufite ubwuzu bwo gutanga, Imaana izaakiira ico utanze ikurikije ibyo ufite, atari ibyo udafite.
Simvuga ntyo kugira ngo mworohereze abandi nuuko mwe muvunike, ahuubwo n’uko haabaho uburinganiza
mu gihe mufite byinshi mugaha imbabare, kugira ngo namwe nihazaaba hari ibyo mukennye bazaabibahe bityo hakabaho kunganya.
Nk’uko ibyanditswe bivuga biti, "Uwari ufite byinshi ntiyagize byinshi caane, kandi n’uwari ufite bike ntiyagize bike caane."
Mbeega ukuntu dushiimira Imaana yahaaye Tito umutima wo kwitaho nk’uko naatwe turi!
Ntaabwo yeemeye gusaba kwacu gusa, ahuubwo yari afite ubwuzu bwo kuuza iwaanyu abikunze.
Tumwohereje n’umuvandimwe ushiimwa n’amatoorero yoose kwamamaza ubutumwa bwiza.

Byongeye kandi, ni we watooranyijwe n’amatoorero kuja ajaana naatwe mu gihe dukora umurimo twashinzwe kugira ngo duheeshe Imaana ubwayo ikuzo kandi no kugaragaza umutima wo dufite wo gutanga ku bushaake.
Twirinda kugira ngo hatagira uduteera urubwa akurikije ibikorwa by’ubuntu tugira.
Ikigendererwa caacu si ugukora ibitungaanye imbere y’Umwami waacu gusa, ahuubwo ni ugukora n’ibitungaanye imbere y’abantu.
Noone tubooherereje n’undi mwene daata uwo twagerageje kenshi bikagaragara ko afite umwete muri byinshi, ariko ubu akaba arushaho kugira umwete ku bw’iciizeere abafitiye.
Na ho Tito we, ni mugenzi wanje dufatanya umurimo tubakorera, kandi abo beene daata bo, n’intumwa z’amatoorero ya Kristo bakorera guheesha Kristo ikuzo.
Nuuko reero, nimubagaragarize urukundo kandi mubeereke impamvu ziduteera kubiiraatana.
Si ngombwa yuuko mbandikira ibyerekeye imfashanyo igenewe abantu b’Imaana bari i Yudeeya.

Kuko nzi yuuko mufite umuhaati wo gutanga ku bushaake, kandi nkaba narabaraatiye abantu b’i Makedooniya, mvuga uko Abanyakaya bamaze umwaka babiiteguuye, kandi yuuko umuhaati mufite wateeye abantu umwete.
Noone mboherereje beene daata kugira ngo uko kwiraata tubiiraatiisha kwe kuzaapfa ubusa, kandi no kugira ngo mwiteguure nk’uko nababwiye.
Naho ubundi nzanye n’ab’i Makedooniya bagasanga ntaaco mwiteguuye kandi tubafitiye iciizeere, twakorwa n’isoni maze namwe mugahemuka.

Ni co caatumye niibwira yuuko nkwiriye gusaba abo beene daata ngo bambanzirize kuuza iwaanyu, kugira ngo bateguure impaano z’imfashanyo mwiyemeje gutanga, nuuko reero nzaasange mwaranyiteguuye bigaragara yuuko mwatanze mu bikunze atari ku gahato.
Mwibuke yuuko ubiba imbuto nke azaasaaruura bike, kandi ubiba imbuto nyinshi azaasaaruura byinshi.
Buri muntu akwiriye gutanga nk’uko umutima we umwemeza, atiinuubwa kandi adahaswe, kuko Imaana ikunda utanga aneezeerewe.
Kandi Imaana ifite ububaasha bwo kubaha ibyifuuzo byanyu byose, kugira ngo murusheho gukora ibyiza byose mufite ibibahaagije.
Nk’uko byanditswe ngo, "Yatanze ku buntu aha abakene, kugira neeza kwe guhoraho iteeka."
Imaana iha umubibyi imbuto, ikamugaburira ibyokurya ngo bimutunge ni yo izaabaha imbuto zo kubiba izigwize kugira ngo zirumbuuke umusaaruuro wo kugira neeza kwanyu.
Izaabagwiriza ubukungu mu buryo bwose kugira ngo mugwize ineeza, izaatuma benshi bashiima Imaana ku bwanyu babidukeesha.
Kuko umurimo wo mukora si uwo gufasha abatooranyijwe n’Imaana byonyine, ahuubwo utuma n’abandi barushaho gushiima Imaana.
Ku bw’ubuhamya bw’uyu murimo mwitangiye, benshi bazaaha Imaana icuubahiro ku bwo mwumviye ubutumwa bwiza bwa Kristo, kandi n’ineeza mwagize mu gusangira na bo hamwe n’abandi boose.
Bityo reero n’urukumbuzi rwinshi barabasengera ku bw’ubuntu bw’Imaana buhebuuje yabagiriye.
Imaana ishiimirwe ubuntu bwayo burenze urugero.
Njeewe Pawulo ubwanje ndabinginga ku bw’ubugwaneeza n’ineeza ya Kristo. Ni nje uvugwa ko niyoroheje iyo ndi imbere yaanyu, ariko igihe ntari hamwe namwe nkabakankamira.
Ndabinginga kugira ngo mbaaye nje iwaanyu neekuzaahatwa kubabwiza ubukana, kuko nzi neeza yuuko naashobora guhangaara bamwe biibwira yuuko dukurikiza kamere y’abantu.
Ni byo koko dufite umubiri w’umuntu ariko ntiturwana nk’abantu,
kuko intwaro turwaniisha zitaacuzwe n’abantu, ahuubwo n’intwaro zituruka ku Maana, zikagira imbaraga zo guseenya ibidaseenyuka. Turimbura impaka z’ibinyoma zidafite ishingiro,
tugahirika ibisiitaaza byose byishira heejuru kurwanya kumenya Imaana, kandi tugafata mpiri ibiteekerezo byose ngo byumvire Kristo.
Twiteguuye guhana uwanga kumvira weese nimuba mwumviye mumaramaje.
Mureeba ibintu mushingiye ku bigaragara imbere yaanyu. Niiba hari umuntu muri mwe wiyumvamo ko ari uwa Kristo, niyongere yiyibutse yuuko ari uwa Kristo nk’uko naatwe turi aba Kristo.
Ubu sibyankoza isoni n’ubwo naakwiraatana ububaasha dufite, ubwo Umwami waacu yaduhaaye kugira ngo tubuubake tutabaseenya.
Sinshaaka yuuko inzandiko zanje zibateera ubwoba.
Kuko bavuga bati, "Inzandiko za Pawulo zivugiisha amagambo akaze kandi akomeye, ariko iyo turi hamwe aba afite intege nke kandi amagambo ye ari ubusa."
Uvuga atyo weese akwiriye kumenya yuuko ibyo tuvuga mu nzandiko tutari hamwe ari na byo tuzaakora turi hamwe.
Ntiduhangaara kwireesheeshanya cangwa kwigereranya n’abo biivuga ho ishiimwe. Nyamara biishiriraho igipimo caabo maze bakiireesheeshanya n’abandi. Iyo bakoze batyo baba beerekana ko ari abapfaapfa.
Ariko twe, ntitwiraata birenze urugero, ahuubwo kwiraata kwacu kugarukira ku gukora umurimo Imaana yaduhaaye wo kuvuga ubutumwa kandi ngo namwe tububagezeho.
Noone reero ubwo namwe muri bamwe muri abo tugezaho ubu butumwa, ntitwigeze twiraata ngo turenge urugero ubwo twabaajeho tubaazaniye Inkuru Nziiza ya Kristo.
Ntitwiraatiisha imirimo abandi baakoze irenze urugero. Ahuubwo twiringira yuuko kwizeera kwanyu kugiiye kwiyongera nuuko dushobozwe gukora umurimo uhebuuje muri mwe.
Nibwo tuzaamamaza Inkuru Nziiza mu yindi myanya iri hirya yaanyu tutiiraatiisha imirimo yakozwe n’abandi.
Nk’uko ibyanditswe bigira biti, "Ushaaka kwiraata weese, niyiiraatane Nyagasani."
Kuko uwishiima si we ushimwa ahuubwo hashimwa uwashimwe na Nyagasani.
Icampa mukihangaanira ubugoryi bwanje ho gato. Nyaabuna nimunyihangaanire!
Mbafuuhira nk’uko Imaana ibafuuhira. Nabaseezeranyije nk’useezeranira umwari w’isugi utegereje gushingirwa ku mugabo umwe rukumbi, ari we Kristo.
Ariko mfite ubwoba yuuko muzooshwa mugateeshuka ku gukunda no gutungaanira Kristo nk’uko inzoka yooheje Eva mu mayeri.
Kuko iyo haaje umuntu ubabwira Yesu wundi atari uwo twamamaje, cangwa mukaakiira undi mwuka utari Umwuka w’Imaana mwahaawe, cangwa akabagezaho ubundi butumwa muteemeye, mumwakiira mubikunze.
Ndibwira yuuko abo biiyita intumwa z’akataraaboneka ari nta co bandusha.
Nuubwo wenda naaba ntaaratoojwe kuvuga neeza, ariko mfite ubwenge buhaagije, kandi ibyo twabibeeretse mu buryo bwose, no muri byose.
Mbese nakoze icaaha ubwo niiciishije bugufi kugira ngo mushirwe heejuru, ubwo nababwirizaga Inkuru Nziiza y’Imaana ku buntu?
Bireebeka nk’aho nanyagaga andi matoorero ubwo naakiiraga imfashanyo zaabo, kugira ngo mbone uko mbakorera ku buntu.

Ubwo nagiraga ico nkenera igihe nari kumwe namwe, ntaamuntu n’umwe niigeze ndusha ngo ngire ico musaba. Ahuubwo bagenzi banje bo muri Makedooniya ni bo bantabaaye muri ubwo bukene. Niirinze kubarusha, kandi nzaakomeza kubyirinda.
Nshingiye ku kuri kwa Kristo undimo, ntaawe uzambuza kwiraatana ibyo mu bice byo muri Akaya hoose.
Mbese ibyo mbivuze kuko ntabakunda? Imaana ni yo izi uko mbakunda.
Kandi nzaakomeza gukora uko nabigenzaga kugira ngo ntaha umwanya abo bashaaka kwitwara nk’aho bameze nka twe mu byo biiraatana.
Kuko abantu biiraata batyo aba ari intumwa z’ibinyoma, bakorera mu buriganya, biigira nk’intumwa za Kristo.
Nyamara, ntaawabagaya kuko na Sataani ubwe yihindura nka malayika w’umuco.
Nuuko reero ntaagitangaaza kihari niiba abaheereza be biihindura bakiyita abaheereza b’ubutungaane. Iheerezo ry’abo rizaahwana n’imirimo yaabo.
Ndongera kubisubiramo, ntihakagire umuntu uteekereza ko ndi umupfaapfa. Ariko reero nimushaaka kubikora, nimunyakiire nk’umupfaapfa kugira ngo mbone uko niiraataho gato.
Ibyo mvuga ubu byerekeye kwiraata ntinyutse, simbibwirijwe na Nyagasani ahuubwo mbiteewe n’ubupfaapfa bwanje.
Ubwo benshi biiraatiisha ibikorwa byabo, reka nanje niiraate.
Mwishiimira kwihangaanira abapfaapfa kuko mwebwe muri abanyabwenge.
Mwihangaanira ubashira mu bubaata, cangwa akabarimanganya, cangwa akabashira heejuru, cangwa akabakubita inshi.
Ariko nje binteera isoni kuvuga yuuko twabigizemo intege nke! Icakora ico abandi bantu batiinyuuka, nanje naaciiraatana kandi na noone ibi mbivuze nk’umupfaapfa.
Mbese si Abaheburaayo? Nanje ndi we. Mbese ni Abiisirayeli? Nanje ndi we. Mbese kandi bakomooka kuri Aburahamu? Dore nanje mukomookaho.

Mbese ni abaheereza ba Kristo? Nooneho reka mvuge nk’umusazi ariko ndabasumba boose. Nabarushije kugira umuhaati wo gukora, mbarusha inshuro nshizwe mu gihome, mbarusha gukubitwa inkoni nyinshi, ndetse mbarusha no kuba narageze mu kaaga kenshi haburaho gato ngo mpfe.
Abayuuda bankubise inkoni mirongo itatu n’icenda inshuro itaanu.
Bankubitiishije ibibando gatatu. Banteeye amabuye rimwe. Narohamye gatatu ndetse mara ijoro n’amanywa mu nyanja hagati.

Mu ngendo nyinshi, akenshi nagwaga mu kaaga gateewe n’imyuzure, ngahuura n’abambuzi, beene waacu bakanshira mu kaaga, abanyamahanga bakanshira mu kaaga, ngahuura n’akaaga ngeze mu matawuni makuru, ngahuurira n’akaaga mu butaayu, ku nyanja, ndetse nagize n’akaaga gateewe n’abiiyita abavandimwe.
Narakoze caane ndavunika, kenshi ndaara ntaryamye, ngira inzara n’imyota, akenshi nkabura ico ndya, ico kwambara, nkagira n’imbeho nyinshi.
Uretse ibindi byose, uko bwije n’uko bukeeye ishaka mfitiye amatoorero rinteera guhora mpagaritse umutima.
Iyo hagize uciika intege, bituma nanje nciika intege, kandi iyo hagize ugwa mu caaha binteera agahinda.
Niiba nkwiriye kwiraata reero, niraatiisha iby’intege nke zanje.
Imaana ari we Se w’Umwami Yesu izi ko ntabeesha na hato, isingizwe iteeka.
Ubwo nari ndi i Damasiko, umutegetsi utegekwa n’umwami Aretasi yashizeho abarinzi bo kurinda iyo tawuni kugira ngo bamfate,
ariko banshira mu giteebo maze baraanyambutsa baanyujije mu dirisha bandenza uruzitiro, nuuko ndahunga mukira ntyo.
Birakwiye yuuko niiraata nuubwo bitagira ico bimara. Noone reka mbabwire ibyo neeretswe n’ibyo nahishuuriwe n’Umwami waacu.
Hari umuntu nzi wizeera Kristo wazaamuuwe, akagezwa mu ijuru rya gatatu, imyaka cumi n’enye ishize. Icakora sinzi neeza niiba yari mu mubiri cangwa ataari mu mubiri. Imaana yoonyine ni yo ibiizi.
Kandi nzi yuuko uwo muntu, yaaba ari mu mubiri, cangwa atari mu mubiri, Imaana yoonyine niyo ibiizi,
yazaamuuwe akajanwa muri Paradizo akumva ibitavugwa, ndetse ntaamuntu wemerewe kubisubiramo.
Umuntu nk’uwo ni we naakwiraatana, naho njeewe ubwanje nta kindi nakwiraatana keretse intege nke zanje.
Icakora nshaatse kwiraata, sinaaba nd’umupfaapfa, kuko naaba ndi kuvuga ukuri. Ariko singiiye gukora ntyo kugira ngo hatagira unteekerezaho ibirenze ibyo abona nkora cangwa ibyo yumva mvuga.

Kandi kugira ngo ntaaza guteerwa no kwishira heejuru nkarenza ibikwiriye biteewe n’ibintu nahishuuriwe bitangaaje bityo, nashizwemo igisa nk’ubusabwe bw’umushuubi mu mubiri kimbeera nk’intumwa ya Sataani yo kumbabaza birenze kugira ngo niirinde kwishira heejuru.
Ibyo byatumye nsaba Nyagasani gatatu koose kugira ngo abinkize,

ariko arambwira ati, "Ubuntu ngira buraguhaagije, kuko imbaraga zanje zuuzurira ahari intege nke." Niyo mpamvu reero niiraatiisha intege nke zanje neezeerewe, kugira ngo imbaraga za Kristo zituure muri nje.
Bityo nkaba nyuzwe igihe coose nkorera Kristo haaba mu ntege nke, mu bitutsi, mu bikomeye, mu gutootezwa no mu byago kuko nzi neeza yuuko iyo mbaaye umunyantege nke ni bwo ndushaho kugira imbaraga.
Dore mpindutse umupfaapfa! Ariko nimwe mwabimpase. Kuko ibyari bikwiriye nuuko aba ari mwe mwakanshimye. Nuubwo ari nta co ndi co, za ntumwa mushiimagiza ntaaco zindusha.
Ibimenyeetso hamwe n’ibitangaaza bihamya yuuko ndi intumwa nabikoreye muri mwe niihangaana ubudahinyuka.
Mbese ni iki nakoreye andi matoorero ya Kristo co ntaabakoreye uretse ko ntaashaatse kubarusha? Nimumbabarire niiba ibyo byarababeereye ikibazo.

Ngaho reero ubu niiteguuye kuuza iwaanyu ubwa gatatu. Kandi sinzaabagoora, kuko sinshaaka ibyanyu ahuubwo nimwe nshaaka. Kuko abaana si bo bakwiriye gukenuura ababyeyi ahuubwo ababyeyi ni bo bakwiriye gukenuura abaana baabo.
Naashiimiishwa no guhara ibyo mfite byose ku bwanyu, nanje ubwanje nkiitanga kugira ngo mbafashe. Mbese urukundo munkunda rwarushaho kugabanyuka kandi nje mbakunda birenze?
Nyamara mureemera yuuko ntiigeze mbarusha. Ariko bamwe bavuga ko nabaciiye ubwenge, nkabashuka mbashira mu mutego w’ibinyoma.
Mbese koko hari ubwo niigeze mbacura ubwenge nyuriye mu bo noohereje?
Ninginze Tito kuuza iwaanyu, ari na wa muvandimwe. Mbese haaba hari inyungu Tito yabashaatsemo? Mbese ntitwakoraga n’umutima uhuuje kandi dufite ikigendererwa kimwe?
Ahaari mwibwira yuuko twaba tumaze iki gihe coose tubiireguuraho. Oya! Ahuubwo tuvugira imbere y’Imaana ibyo Kristo ashaaka kandi ibyo dukora byose nshuti dukunda, tubikora ngo bibuubake.

Kuko ndatiinya yuuko ni nza iwaanyu nzaasanga mutandukanye n’uko mbateekereza kandi namwe musange ntahwanye n’uko mwibwira. Mfite ubwoba yuuko nzaabasanga mu ntonganya, mukigirirana ishari, uburaakari no kwikunda, gusebanya no kuzimura, kwiraata hamwe n’imivurungano.
Ndatiinya ko Imaana yanje izankoza isoni imbere yaanyu ikindi gihe ningaruka, bikanteera kuririra abaacumuye mu gihe caashize bakaba batari biihana ubukozi bw’ibibi bwabo bw’irari n’ubusambanyi.
Ubu ni ubwa gatatu ngiiye kuuza kubasuura, kandi nk’uko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Urubanza rwose rukemurwa n’ubuhamya bw’abantu babiri cangwa batatu."
Nari nariihanangirije abo boose baari baaracumuye hamwe n’abandi boose ubwo nabasuuraga ubwa kabiri, kandi na noone mbisubiyemo tutari kumwe yuuko ningaruka ntazaabiihangaanira.
Muzaabona ibyemezo byose mwifuuza bihamya yuuko iyo mvuga aba ari Kristo umvugiramo, kandi si umunyatenge nke igihe abakoreeramo ahuubwo abagaragarizamo ububaasha bwe.

Kuko yabambwe ku musaraba bishingiye ku ntege nke, ariko noone ni muzima ku bw’imbaraga z’Imaana. Naatwe turi abanyantege nke nk’uko Kristo yari ari, nyamara mu gihe Kristo adukoreramo tuzaagaragarizwa imbaraga z’Imaana.
Nuuko reero mwisuuzume ubwanyu kandi mwigerageze mureebe niiba mugikomereye mu kwizeera. Mbese ntimuuzi neeza yuuko Kristo aba muri mwe? Keretse ahaari mubaaye mwaraguuye!
Ariko niizeera yuuko muzaasanga tutaraatsindwa.
Kandi turabasengera kugira ngo hatagira ikibi mukora, kitagamije kwerekana ko mwatsinze iryo suuzuma, ariko tugendereye kugira ngo mukore ibishitse nuubwo twe twaba nk’abatsinzwe.
Kuko ari ntaaco tubaasha gukora kidashingiye ku kuri keretse gushigikira ukuri kw’Imaana.
Turaneezeerwa iyo dufite intege nke naho mwe mugakomera. Nuuko tukabasengera ngo mutunganywe rwose.
Ni co gitumye mbandikira ntari kumwe namwe, kugira ngo nindamuka nje iwaanyu ntazaakoreesha ubukana mu bubaasha nahaawe na Nyagasani bwo kubuubaka atari ubwo kubaseenya.
Ahasigaye bavandimwe, murabeho. Mutungaane rwose kandi mukurikize ibyo mbasaba, mwumviikane, mubaane amahoro, nuuko Imaana idukunda kandi igatanga amahoro ibaane namwe.
Muramukanye indamutso yeera.
Abantu b’Imaana boose barabataasha.
Ubuntu bw’Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo, n’urukundo rw’Imaana, no gusangira Umwuka Weera bibaane namwe mwese.

name: Gálatas
chapters: Njeewe Pawulo wahamagariwe kuba intumwa bidakomootse ku bantu cangwa ku bushobozi bwabo ahuubwo bikomootse kuri Yesu Kristo n’Imaana Daata yamuzuuye mu baapfuuye,
hamwe n’abiizeera turi kumwe boose, turabaramutsa mwebwe abo mu matoorero y’i Galatiya.
Tubiifuurije ubuntu n’amahoro biva ku Maana Daata no ku Mwami Yesu Kristo,
watanze ubugingo bwe ku bw’ibyaha byacu kugira ngo adukize iki gihe kibi ca noone nk’uko Imaana Daata yabishaatse.
Icuubahiro kibe ic’Imaana iteeka ryose! Amiina.
Ntangaajwe n’uko mu gihe gito mutangiye kuva kuwabahamagaye abiteewe n’ubuntu mwagiriwe na Kristo, maze mukeemera ubundi butumwa.
Nyamara ntaabundi butumwa bubaho, ahuubwo hariho abantu baahagurukiye kubayobya no gushaaka guhindura Ubutumwa Bwiza bwa Kristo.
Ariko reero hagize undi muntu ubabwiriza ubutumwa butandukanye n’ubwo twabagejejeho, n’aho yaaba twebwe cangwa malayika uvuuye mu ijuru, avumwe!
Nk’uko twababwiye mbere, na n’ubu mbisubiyemo, uzaababwiriza ubutumwa butandukanye n’ubwo mwakiiriye, avumwe!
Mbese muteekereza ko niifuuza gushimwa n’abantu cangwa n’Imaana? Aho ntimuteekereza ko mparanira kuneezeeza abantu? Mbaaye ngerageza kuneezeeza abantu sinaaba nkiri umugaragu wa Kristo.
Bavandimwe, reka mbamenyeeshe yuuko Ubutumwa Bwiza nababwirije budakomooka ku bantu.
Sinigeze mbuhaabwa n’umuntu weese kandi sinabwigiishijwe n’umuntu, ahuubwo ni Yesu Kristo wabumpishuuriye.
Mwumviise uko nagenzaga nkiri umuyoboke w’idiini y’Abayuuda. Natooteje itoorero ry’Imaana ntaawe ngirira imbabazi nshaaka kuritsemba.
Narushije benshi bo mu bwoko bwacu tungana gukurikiza idiini y’Abayuuda, kandi nabarushaga kugira umuhaati wo gushira imbere imigenzo twasigiwe na ba sogokuruza.
Ariko Imaana yantooranyije ntaraavuuka, impamagarira kuyikorera ku bw’ubuntu bwayo. Yahisemo
kumpishuurira Umwana waayo, kugira ngo naamamaze Ubutumwa Bwiza mu banyamahanga. Siniigeze nja kugiisha inaama umuntu weese kugira ngo menye ico gukora,
habe no kuja i Yerusaalemu kubaza abambanjirije kuba intumwa, ahuubwo nagendeye kimwe muri Araabiya kandi mvuuyeyo nsubira i Damasiko.
Nuuko imyaka itatu ishize ndazaamuuka nja i Yerusaalemu gusuura Peetero, marana na we iminsi cumi n’itaanu.
Ariko sinigeze mbona izindi ntumwa keretse Yaakobo mwene se w’Umwami waacu.
Ibyo mbandikiye byose ni ukuri, Imaana irabiizi ko ntabeesha!
Haanyuma y’urwo ruzinduko, nagiiye mu bice binini bya Siriya na Silisiya.
Muri ibyo bihe, abo mu matoorero ya Kristo y’i Yudeeya ntaabwo baari baakamboonyeho.
Ukuuyeho baari baarumviise abamvugagaho bati, "Waawundi wadutootezaga keera asigaye yaamamaza ukwizeera yarwanyaga."
Nuuko bahimbaaza Imaana ku bwanje.
Haanyuma y’imyaka cumi n’enye nsubira i Yerusaalemu ndi hamwe na Barinaba, niitwaza Tito.

Nagiiyeyo kuko Imaana yari yampishuuriye ko njayo. Nuuko ngiraho inaama y’umwihereero n’abayobozi b’itoorero mbasobaanurira ubutumwa mbwiriza abanyamahanga. Kwari ukugira ngo ntaba nararuhiye ubusa cangwa kongera kwiruhiriza ubusa.
Ariko na Tito uwo twari kumwe ntibiigeze bamuhata gukebwa nuubwo yari Umugiriki.
Nyamara hariho indyarya ziiyita abiizeera zinjiye muri twe rwihishwa zigendereye kugenzuura umudendeezo dufite muri Kristo Yesu, kugira ngo zidushire mu bubaata.
Ariko ntitwigeze tuzumvira na hato kugira ngo ukuri k’Ubutumwa Bwiza kugume muri mwe kudahinyutse.
Ariko abandi biitwa abayobozi (ico bari co ntibindeeba, kuko Imaana itarobaanura ku butoni), abo bayobozi ntaaco baanyongeereyeho ku byo niigiishaga.
Ahuubwo baaboonye ko Imaana yampaaye umurimo wo kubwiriza ubutumwa mu banyamahanga nk’uko Peetero na we yahaawe umurimo wo kubwiriza mu baakebwe.
Kuko uwahaaye Peetero kuba intumwa mu baakebwe ni na we wampaaye kuba intumwa mu banyamahanga.

Yaakobo, Peetero na Yohaana ari bo biitwa inkingi z’umuryango w’Imaana, bamaze kumenya impaano nahaawe nje na Barinaba badukora mu ntoki, nk’ikimenyeetso co gufatanya no kwemera ko njeewe na Barinaba tuja mu banyamahanga naho bo bakaguma mu baakebwe.
Ikintu kimwe baatwihanangirije kwari ukuja twibuka abakene kandi ari na co nanje nashiishikariye gukora.
Igihe Peetero yaazaga muri Antiyokiya, namuhakanyije kumugaragaro kuko byari bigaragara ko ari mu nshobe.
Mbere y’uko abantu baturutse kwa Yaakobo bahagera, Peetero yasangiraga n’abanyamahanga. Aho baagereyeyo, abiivaanamo, arabaneena kuko yatiinyaga abaashigikiraga gukebwa.
Nuuko n’abandi bakristo b’Abayuuda biiyunga kuri Peetero mu buryarya, bigeze aho Barinaba na we yoshwa na bo mu kuryarya kwabo.

Ariko mboonye ko batari gukurikiza ukuri k’Ubutumwa Bwiza, mbwira Peetero boose babireeba nti, "Niiba wowe Umuyuuda wiifata nk’abanyamahanga, ntiwiifate nk’Abayuuda, ni iki gituma uhata abanyamahanga gukurikiza imigenzo y’Abayuuda?"
Koko twebwe turi Abayuuda kavuukire, ntituri abanyamahanga b’abanyabyaha.

Ariko tuuzi yuuko umuntu adatsindishirizwa n’imirimo itegetswe n’amategeko ahuubwo atsindishirizwa no kwizeera Yesu Kristo, bidateewe no kuubahiriza amategeko kuko ntaan’umwe utsindishirizwa abikeesheje imirimo itegetswe n’amategeko.
Mbese, niiba dushaaka gutsindishirizwa muri Kristo, ariko naatwe ubwacu tugasangwa turi abanyabyaha, ibyo bivuga ko Kristo ari we utuma abantu bagwa mu byaha? Oya ntibikabeho!
Ariko niiba nongera kugengwa n’amategeko naretse, mba neerekanye ko ndi umunyabyaha.
Nyamara njeewe napfuuye kubyerekeye kuubahiriza amategeko, kugira ngo mbeho ku bw’Imaana. Nabambanywe na Kristo ku musaraba,
ariko noone si nje uriho, ahuubwo ni Kristo uriho muri nje. Ubuzima mbamo muri uyu mubiri, mbubamo mbishobozwa no kwizeera Umwana w’Imaana, wankunze, akanyiitangira ku musaraba.
Nje sinaasuuzugura ubuntu bw’Imaana, kuko niiba gutungaanira Imaana kuzanwa no kuubahiriza amategeko, kimenyeesha ko Kristo yapfiiriye ubusa.
Yemwe Bagalatiya b’abapfaapfa mwe! Mbese ni nde wabaroze? Ntimwagaragarijwe urupfu Yesu Kristo yapfuuye ku musaraba?
Nshaaka ko mumbwira iki gusa: Mbese kuubahiriza amategeko ni co caabaheesheje Umwuka Weera cangwa se ni uko mwumviise Ubutumwa mukiizeera?
Mbese muri abapfaapfa mutyo? Mwatangiranye n’Umwuka w’Imaana, noone muheruukanye no gukorera mu mbaraga z’umubiri.?
Mbese ibyo mwanyuzemo mubabara, byababeereye imfaabusa? Ni ukuri hari ico byabamariye!
Mbese Imaana ibaha Umwuka waayo, igakora ibitangaaza muri mwe ibiteerwa n’uko mwubahiriza amategeko cangwa n’uko mwumviise Ubutumwa mukiizeera?
Ni na ko byabaaye kuri Aburahamu, "Yiizeeye Imaana, bituma Imaana imwemera nk’umukiraanutsi."
Nuuko reero mumenye yuuko abaana ba Aburahamu nyakuri ari abo biizeera Imaana.

Kandi ibyanditswe byari byaragaragaje yuuko Imaana izatsindishiriza abanyamahanga ku bwo kwizeera kwabo. Kandi ibyanditswe byatangaaje Ubutumwa Bwiza kuri Aburahamu mbere y’igihe, ngo, "Muri wowe imiryango yoose yo mu isi izaguheerwamo umugisha."
Nuuko reero, abo beemera Kristo bahaabwa umugisha nk’uko Aburahamu yawuhaawe ku bwo kwizeera.
Naho abiishingikiriza ku kuubahiriza amategeko baba bari mu muvumo, kuko byanditswe ngo, "Havumwe umuntu weese udakurikiza ibyanditswe byose mu gitabo c’amategeko."
Ubu birasobaanutse yuuko ari nta muntu utsindishirizwa n’amategeko imbere y’Imaana, kuko byanditswe ngo, "Umukiraanutsi azaabeeshwaho no kwizeera."
Nyamara amategeko ntaaco ahuuriyeho no kwizeera, ariko reero ibyanditswe biravuga ngo, "Uzuubahiriza amategeko, azaabeeshwaho na yo."
Kristo yaducunguye kugira ngo dukizwe umuvumo w’amategeko, ahinduka ikivume ku bwacu, nk’uko byanditswe ngo, "Havumwe umuntu weese umanitswe ku giti."
Muri Kristo Yesu, Imaana yahaaye umugisha abanyamahanga usa n’uwo yaseezeranyije Aburahamu, kugira ngo ku bwo kwizeera, twe abeemera, tuzaahaabwe Umwuka Weera twaseezeranyijwe.

Bavandimwe, reka mbabwire nkurikije urugero mu buzima busanzwe: Iyo abantu babiri bagize ico beemeranya maze bagakora amaseezerano, bagashiraho ukuboko, ntaamuntu ushobora kuyiica cangwa ngo agire ico yongeraho.
Imaana yakoranye iseezerano na Aburahamu n’urubyaro rwe. Ibyanditswe ntibivuga ko ari "Imbyaro" nk’aho ari abantu benshi, ahuubwo ni "urubyaro rwawe", bimenyeesha umuntu umwe weenyine ari we Kristo.

Ico nshaaka kuvuga ni iki: Imaana yakoze iseezerano na Aburahamu kandi irarikomeza. Itegeko ryahaawe Moose haanyuma y’imyaka magana ane na mirongo itatu, ntiryakwica iryo seezerano cangwa ngo ririkuureho.
Kuko niiba umurage ushingiye ku tegeko, ntuuba ukivuuye ku byaseezeranyijwe. Ariko Imaana yawuhaaye Aburahamu binyuze mu iseezerano.

Noone se amategeko agamije iki? Yongereweho kugira ngo agaragaze ibicumuro kugeza ubwo urubyaro rwagenewe ibyaseezeranyijwe ruzaazira. Kandi yahaaye abaamalayika amategeko kuyaha Moose ari we muhuuza w’Imaana n’abantu.
Ariko umuhuuza yiifuuzwa iyo abantu bareenze umwe, kandi Imaana ni imwe
Mbese ubwo bimeze bityo, amategeko ahakanya amaseezerano y’Imaana? Oya ntibikabeho! Kuko iyo amategeko aba yabeeshaho abantu, buri muntu yaagahindutse intungaane imbere y’Imaana ku bwo kuyumvira.
Ariko ibyanditswe bivuga yuuko abari mu isi boose bari mu bubaata bw’icaaha, nuuko reero impaano Imaana yaduseezeranyije yo kutubaatuura, ibonerwa mu kwizeera Yesu Kristo igahaabwa abo beemera.
Icakora uko kwizeera kutaraaza, twari turi imbohe kandi turinzwe n’amategeko dutegereje kwizeera kwari kugiiye guhishuurwa.
Bityo reero amategeko yaraturinze kugira ngo tudakora ikibi kugeza ubwo Kristo yaaziye, kugira ngo dutsindishirizwe no kwizeera.
Ubwo reero kwizeera kwamaze kuuza, ntituciifuuza kuyoborwa n’amategeko,
kuko mwese muri abaana b’Imaana mubiheeshejwe no kwizeera Kristo Yesu.
Nk’uko benshi muri mwe mwabatijwe muri Kristo ni na ko mufite ubumwe na Kristo.
Noone reero ntihakiriho Umuyuuda cangwa Umugiriki, imbaata cangwa uwiigenga, umugabo cangwa umugore, kuko mwese muri umwe muri Kristo Yesu.
Ubwo reero muri aba Kristo, ni mwe rubyaro rwa Aburahamu, muri n’abaragwa b’iby’Imaana yaseezeranyije.
Ariko nshaaka kumenyeesha ngo, iyo umubyeyi apfuuye agasigira umwana we umurage, uwo mwana akiri muto ntaaho aba atandukaniye n’umugaragu, nuubwo ari we nyir’ibintu byose.
Akiri muto aguma mu maboko y’abamurera n’abashinzwe ibintu bye kugeza igihe caategetswe na se.
Ni ko naatwe twari tumeze tukiri bato. Twari imbaata, tugengwa n’imyuka mibi itegeka iyi si.
Maze ko igihe gikwiriye caageze, Imaana yoohereje Umwana waayo wabyawe n’umugore, kandi avuuka agengwa n’amategeko y’Abayuuda,
kugira ngo acungure abaari bakigengwa n’amategeko maze tubone kuba abaana b’Imaana.
Kandi kuko muri abaana b’Imaana, ni co caatumye yoohereza Umwuka w’Umwana waayo mu mitima yaacu uhora utakamba uti, "Daata, Daata."
Nuuko reero, ntuukiri umugaragu ahuubwo uri umwana, kandi reero ubwo uri umwana waayo, Imaana yakugize umuragwa waayo.
Mbere mutaraamenya Imaana, mwari imbaata, mukorera ibigirwamaana bitabaho.

Ariko noone, ubwo mwamenye Imaana, ndetse na yo ikaba ibaazi, ni iki gituma musubira inyuma mu bya keera mukumvira imyuka mibi idafite imbaraga n’umumaro? Ni iki gituma mushaaka kongera kuba imbaata zaabyo?
Mwubahiriza iminsi ikomeye, ameezi, ibihe, n’imyaka.
Munteeye ubwoba yuuko ibyo nabakoreye byose naaba naravunikiye ubusa.
Ndabinginze bavandimwe, mumere nkanje, kuko nanje meze nkamwe. Nta kibi mwigeze munkorera.
Muriibuka neeza yuuko icaatumye mbona uburyo bwo kwamamaza Ubutumwa Bwiza muri mwe ubwambere ari uko nari ndwaye.

Ariko nuubwo umubiri wanje wari utameze neeza, ukababeera ikigeregezo, ntimwigeze mumpinyura cangwa ngo munyange. Ahuubwo mwanyakiiriye nka malayika w’Imaana, ndetse munyakiira nk’abaakiira Kristo Yesu.
Ico gihe mwari munyishiimiye caane! Icaatumye muhinduka ni iki? Iyo bishoboka muba mwaranogooyemo amaaso yaanyu mukayampa.
Mbese ubu mpindutse umwanzi waanyu ku bwo kubabwira ukuri?
Abo biigiisha b’ibinyoma beerekana yuuko babiitaayeho caane, nyamara ibigendererwa byabo si byiza, kuko ico bashaaka n’ukuntandukanya namwe, kugira ngo abe ari bo mwitaho.
Nihagira umuntu ugira umwete wo gukora ibyiza, naabikore igihe coose, atari igihe ndi kumwe namwe coonyine.
Baana banje, nk’uko umugore uri ku bise ababara, ni ko nanje mbabazwa namwe kugeza igihe kamere ya Kristo izaagaragarira muri mwe.
Icampa ubu nkaba ndikumwe namwe, ngahindura uburyo mvugana namwe, kuko ibyanyu bimpangayikiishije.
Ngaaho nimumbwire mwebwe abashaaka gutwarwa n’amategeko, mbese ntimwumva ibyo amategeko avuga?
Byanditswe yuuko Aburahamu yari afite abahungu babiri, umwe yamubyaranye n’umuja, undi amubyarana n’umugore we.
Yabyaranye n’umuja nk’uko bisanzwe mu buryo bw’umubiri, naho umwana w’umugore we yavuutse ku bw’iseezerano ry’Imaana.

Imivuukire y’aba bahungu bombi ni nk’umugani w’incaamarenga. Aba bagore bombi bahagarariye amaseezerano abiri. Umugore umwe ari we Hagari wabyariye abaana be mu bubaata ahagarariye iseezerano ryakorewe ku musozi wa Sinaayi.
Hagari uhagarariye umusozi wa Sinaayi wo muri Araabiya, agereranywa n’i tawuni nkuru ya Yerusaalemu y’ubu iri mu bubaata n’abantu baayo boose.
Naho undi mugore, ahagarariye Yerusaalemu yo mu ijuru yiigenga, kandi ni we mubyeyi waacu.

Kuko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Ishiime yewe mugore w’ingumba utaariigeze ubyara! Rangurura maze uvuze impudu z’umuneezeero, wowe utaariigeze umenya ububabare bw’ibise Kuko abaana b’intaabwa ari benshi kuruta ab’umugore w’inkundwakazi w’umugabo we atiigeze areka."
Nuuko reero bavandimwe, namwe muri abaana b’iseezerano nk’uko Isaaka yari ari.
Kandi uko byabaaye ico gihe, uwavuutse ku bwa kamere y’umubiri yatootezaga uwavuutse ku bw’Umwuka, na n’ubu ni ko bimeze.
Ariko se ibyanditswe bivuga iki? "Irukana umuja n’umuhungu we, kuko umwana w’umuja atazaagabana umurage n’umwana w’umugore wiigenga."
Nuuko reero bavandimwe, ntaabwo tukiri abaana b’umuja ahuubwo turi abaana b’umugore wiigenga.
Umudendeezo dufite ni uko Kristo yatubohooye. Nuuko reero nimuhagarare mushikamye, mwirinda gusubira mu bubaata.
Nimwumve! Njeewe Pawulo ndababwira yuuko nimwemera gukebwa, Kristo ntaaco yaaba akibamarira.
Kandi ndongera kwihanangiriza umugabo weese wemera gukebwa yuuko akwiriye gukurikiza amategeko yoose.
Mwebwe abashaaka gutsindishirizwa n’amategeko mwitandukanyije na Kristo, kuko mwaguuye mukava mu buntu bw’Imaana.
Ariko twebwe ku bw’imbaraga z’Umwuka w’Imaana no kwizeera, dufite ubwuzu bwo kwakira ibyiringiro byo gukiraanuka Imaana yaduseezeranyije.
Iyo turi muri Kristo, gukebwa cangwa kudakebwa ntaaco bimaze, ahuubwo igikuru ni ukwizeera kugaragarira mu rukundo.
Mbese ko mwakoraga neeza, ni nde wababujije gukurikiza ukuri?
Beene uko kooshwa ntikwaturuka kuwabahamagaye.
Nk’uko bivugwa ngo, "Igituubuura gike gituma ifu y’ingano ituubuuka." Ni na ko ijambo rito rishobora kubahindura mwese.
Niizeye ntashidiikanya yuuko ku bwa Nyagasani mutazaateekereza ukundi, kandi ubayobya, akabaazanira guhagarika imitima weese, Imaana izaamuhana.
Mbese Bavandimwe, niiba nkibwiriza ko gukebwa ari ngombwa, ni iki gituma ngitootezwa? Iyo mba nigiisha ibyo, ubutumwa bw’umusaraba mbwiriza buba ari ntaawe buteeye ikibazo.
Icampa abo bababuza amahoro bashaaka ko mukebwa baakwikona.

Naho mwebwe bavandimwe, mwahamagariwe kuba ab’umudendeezo. Ariko umudendeezo mwahaawe mureke kuwuhindura urwitwazo rwo gukora ibyo kamere y’imibiri yaanyu irarikira, ahuubwo buri weese akorere mugenzi we abiteewe n’urukundo.
Kuko amategeko yoose abumbiye muri rimwe ngo, "Ukunde mugenzi waawe nk’uko wiikunda."
Ariko reero, niiba mwifata nk’inyamaaswa, mugashikagurana, mugaconcomerana, muramenye ntimuzaamarane.
Ndababwira nti; nimuyoborwe n’Umwuka, ni bwo mutazaakora ibyo kamere irarikira.
Kuko kamere irarikira ibyo Umwuka yanga, kandi ibyo Umwuka ushaaka bitandukanye n’ibyo kamere ishaaka. Ni co gituma ibyo mushaaka gukora atari byo mukora.
Ariko niiba muyoborwa n’Umwuka, ntimuba mugihatwa gukurikiza amategeko.
Dore ibikorwa bya kamere biriigaragaza, ni ubusambanyi, gukora ibiteeye isoni, ubwomanzi,
gusenga ibishushaanyo, kuroga, kwangana, amakimbirane, ishari, uburaakari, intonganya, ubutumviikana, amacaakubiri,
umujinya, ubusinzi, kwiyandarika mu byo kunywa n’ubuheeheesi, n’ibindi bisa bityo. Ndabiihanangiriza nk’uko nabibabwiye kare, yuuko abakora ibisa bityo, ntaamurage bazaahaabwa mu Bwami bw’Imaana.
Ariko reero, imbuto z’Umwuka ni urukundo, umuneezeero, amahoro, kwihangaana, ubugwaneeza, ubupfura, kwiringirwa,
kwiciisha bugufi no kwirinda. Ibimeze bityo ntaamategeko abihana.
Aba Kristo Yesu baabambye kamere yaabo y’umubiri, n’ingeso mbi ndetse n’irari ku musaraba.
Niiba tubeeshwaho n’Umwuka, tuje tuyoborwa n’Umwuka.
Twekwishira heejuru cangwa ngo twenderanye, cangwa ngo tugirirane ishari.
Bavandimwe, nihagira ugwa mu caaha, mwebwe abayoborwa n’Umwuka mumugarure mumworoheye, ariko namwe mwirinde kugira ngo mutagwa mu bishuko.
Mwakiirane imitwaro, bityo reero muzaaba mwumviye amategeko ya Kristo.
Umuntu niyibwira ko akomeye, kandi ari ntaaco ari co, uwo aba yiibeesha.
Buri muntu akwiriye gusuuzuma ibikorwa bye, nuuko ibyo bikorwa bye atari ibya mugenzi we ni byo bizaamuraata.
Kuko buri muntu agomba kwikorera umutwaro we.
Abiigiishwa ijambo ry’Imaana bakwiriye gusangira n’abiigiisha baabo ku byiza bafite.
Ntimukibeeshe, kuko Imaana ntinnyegwa. Ibyo umuntu abiba ni byo azaasaaruura.
Ubiba imbuto zishiimiisha kamere ye, azaasaaruura urupfu. Naho ubiba imbuto zishiimiisha Umwuka w’Imaana, azaasaaruura ubugingo buhoraho.
Ntitukarambirwe gukora ibyiza, kuko nitudacoogora, tuzaasaaruura igihe kigeze.
Nuuko reero, igihe coose tuboonye uburyo, tuje tugirira abantu boose neeza, ariko caane caane ab’umuryango w’abiizeera.
Nimwitegereze inyugute nini nkoreesha mbandikira n’ukuboko kwanje!
Abo babahata gukebwa, ni abashaaka kwiraatana ibikorwa by’umubiri ariko babikora kugira ngo badatootezwa bazize umusaraba wa Kristo.
Nyamara nabaakebwe ubwabo ntibuubahiriza amategeko, ahuubwo bashaaka ko mukebwa kugira ngo babone uko biiraata ku bw’uwo muhango, bityo reero bavuge ko muri abiigiishwa baabo.

Naho njeewe ntaakindi nakwiraatiisha, ukuuyeho umusaraba wa Nyagasani Yesu Kristo. Urupfu rwa Yesu ku musaraba rwatumye mbona ko ubuzima bw’iyi si ari imfaabusa maze nanje mpinduka ubusa kuri ubwo buzima.
Kuko gukebwa cangwa kudakebwa ntaaco bimaze, ahuubwo igikuru ni ukuba icaaremwe gisha.
Naho abakurikiza iri tegeko mu mibeereho yaabo, amahoro n’imbabazi bibaane na bo kandi bibaane na Isirayeli y’Imaana.
Ndangiza, kuva ubu, ntihakagire undusha, kuko mfite inkovu ku mubiri wanje zigaragaza ko ndi umugaragu wa Yesu.
Bavandimwe, ubuntu bw’Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo bubaane n’imitima yaanyu. Amiina.

name: Efésios
chapters: Njeewe Pawulo, uwo Imaana yagize intumwa ya Kristo, ku bw’ubushaake bwayo, Ndabandikira mwebwe abantu b’Imaana bari muri Efeeso, biizeera Kristo Yesu.
Mugire ubuntu n’amahoro bituruka ku Maana Daata wa twese no ku Mwami Yesu Kristo.
Imaana, kandi Se w’Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo ishiimwe, kuko yaduheereye muri Kristo imigisha yoose y’Umwuka wo mu ijuru.
Yadutooranyije binyuze muri we isi itaraaremwa, kugira ngo tube intungaane n’abaziranenge. Ku bw’urukundo rwayo,
Imaana yari yarahisemo kutugira abaana baayo tubikeesha Yesu Kristo, ku bw’ineeza n’ubushaake bwayo.
Noone reero, reka dusingize Imaana ku bw’ubuntu buhebuuje ari yo mpaano yaduheereye ubuntu, ibinyujije mu Mwana waayo w’inkoramutima.
Ni we waduheesheje gucungurwa ku bw’amaraso ye, tukababarirwa ibicumuro byacu, ku bw’ubuntu bwe buhebuuje
bwo yaduseesekajeho. Ku bw’ubuhanga n’ubumenyi bwe bwose,
Imaana yatumenyesheje ibanga ry’ubushaake bwayo, ikora ico yari igambiriye ikurikije imirimo Kristo yakoze.
Umugambi wo Imaana izuuzuza igihe kigeze, ni ugukoranyiriza hamwe ibintu byose muri Kristo, ari ibiri mu ijuru cangwa ibiri ku isi.
Imaana ikora ibintu byose nk’uko ibishaaka, yadutooranyirije kuba abaayo twunze ubumwe na Kristo nk’uko yari yarabigambiiriye kuva keera.
Imaana yabikoze kugira ngo twebwe abaabanje kwizeera Kristo, duhimbaaze ikuzo ryayo.

Namwe reero abamaze kumva ijambo ry’ukuri, ari ryo Nkuru Nziiza yabaazaniye gukizwa, mwahindutse abaana b’Imaana. Mwemeye Kristo maze Imaana ibashiraho ikimenyeetso caayo c’Umwuka Weera yari yarabaseezeranyije.
Uwo Mwuka ni co ceemezo ko tuzaabona ico Imaana yaseezeranyije abantu baayo, kandi iki kiduhamiriza yuuko Imaana izaaha abaayo umudendeezo wuzuye. Reka duhimbaaze ikuzo ryayo!
Maze kumva uko mwizeera Umwami Yesu n’urukundo mufitiye abantu b’Imaana boose, ni co gituma
nanje mbashiimira Imaana ubudahwema, nkabiibuka mu masengeesho yanje.
Ndasaba Imaana y’Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo, ari yo Daata w’ikuzo, kubaha Umwuka uzaabaha ubwenge no kubahishuurira Imaana, kugira ngo murusheho kuyimenya.
Ndasaba ko imitima yaanyu yakinguuka ikabona, kugira ngo mumenye ibyiringiro byo mwahamagariwe, kandi mumenye n’icuubahiro gihebuuje yaseezeranyije abaana baayo,
kandi mumenye uko imbaraga z’ububaasha zikorera muri twe abiizeera. Izi mbaraga zidukoreramo, ni nazo mbaraga zihebuuje
yakoreesheje ubwo yazuuye Yesu mu baapfuuye maze ikamwicaza iburyo bwayo mu mwanya wo mu ijuru.
Kristo yashizwe heejuru y’abatware, abanyabushobozi, abanyabubaasha, n’abategetsi boose bo mu ijuru, ndetse n’izina rye rishirwa heejuru y’andi mazina y’ubushobozi muri iki gihe, no mu gihe kizaaza.
Imaana yahaaye Kristo ububaasha bwo gutegeka ibintu byose, kandi imugira umutwe w’itoorero.
Itoorero ni umubiri wa Kristo kandi ni co cuuzuzo kuri Kristo, na Kristo ubwe akuuzuza ibintu byose ahantu hoose.
Namwe mwari mwarapfuuye muzize ibicumuro n’ibyaha byanyu.
Ico gihe ni byo mwabagamo, mukurikije imigenzereze mibi y’isi, no kuubahiriza umutegetsi w’imbaraga w’imyuka mibi ari we ukorera mu bantu batumvira Imaana.
Kandi naatwe twese twari tumeze nka bo, dukurikiza irari ry’imibiri yaacu n’ibyo imitima yaacu yiiteekerereje. Mu buryo bwacu bwa kamere, twari abo kubabazwa n’umujinya w’Imaana, nk’abandi boose.
Ariko imbabazi z’Imaana ni nyinshi, kandi n’urukundo idukunda rurahebuuje,
nuubwo twari twarapfuuye tuzize ibicumuro byacu, yadushubije ubugingo hamwe ku bw’ubumwe bwacu na Kristo. Erega mwakijijwe ku bw’ubuntu bwayo.
Kuko Imaana yatuzuuranye na Kristo Yesu, itwicazanya na we mu ijuru tubikeesha Kristo Yesu.
Ibyo yabikoze kugira ngo mu bihe bizaaza byose yeerekane ubuntu bwayo butagira akagero, ikoreesheje urukundo yadukunze binyuze muri Yesu Kristo.
Koko mwakijijwe n’ubuntu ku bwo kwizeera Yesu Kristo, kandi si imbaraga zaanyu zaabikoze, ahuubwo ni impaano y’Imaana,
bidaturutse no ku mirimo yaanyu, kugira ngo hatagira ubyiraatiisha.
Kuko Imaana ari yo yatugize ico turi co, yaturemeye imirimo myiza muri Kristo Yesu, yo yateguuye keera kugira ngo iturange mu kubaho kwacu.

Nuuko reero, mwebwe banyamahanga ku mubiri, abo Abayuuda biitaga "abataarakebwe" maze bo bakiiyita "abaakebwe" Kuko gukebwa kimenyeesha umuhango wo gukeba igice c’ubugabo, nimwibuke reero uko keera mwari mumeze.

Ico gihe ntimwari mufite Kristo. Mwari abanyamahanga kandi ntimwari muri ab’umuryango wa Isirayeli. Ntaaho mwari muhuuriye n’amaseezerano Imaana yagiriye abantu baayo, kandi mwari mutuuye muri iyi si nta byiringiro mufite kandi mutaazi Imaana.
Ariko ubu ubwo mwunze ubumwe na Kristo Yesu, mwebwe abaabaga kure y’Imaana, mwigijwe haafi yaayo n’amaraso ya Kristo.
Koko Kristo ubwe yatuuzaniye amahoro ubwo yunze Abayuuda n’abanyamahanga bakaba umwe. Yakoreesheje umubiri we gukuuraho igisiika caabatandukanyaga kigatuma bahora bari abanzi.
Yakuuyeho itegeko ry’Abayuuda hamwe n’amabwiriza ya ryo, kugira ngo iyi miryango ebyiri ayihindure umwe musha muri we, nuuko azane amahoro.
Ku bw’urupfu rwe rwo ku musaraba, abo bombi Kristo yabunze n’Imaana maze abagira umubiri umwe, bityo arandura urwango rwari hagati yaabo.
Noone reero Kristo yaraaje maze yamamaza Inkuru Nziiza y’amahoro kuri boose, kuri mwe abanyamahanga, baari kure y’Imaana, hamwe n’Abayuuda, baari haafi n’Imaana.
Twese reero, Abayuuda n’abanyamahanga, dushobora kwegeera imbere y’Imaana Daata turi mu Mwuka umwe, tubikeesha Kristo.
Bityo reero ntimukiri abanyamahanga n’abiimukiira, ahuubwo musangiye ubwenegihugu n’abantu b’Imaana, ndetse mukaba muri bamwe bo mu muryango waayo.
Namwe mwubatswe ku rufatiro rwubatswe n’intumwa n’abahanuuzi, ariko ibuye ry’imfuruka ni Kristo Yesu ubwe.
Ni we ushoboza inzu yoose guteeranywa neeza maze igahinduka urusengero rwera rwa Nyagasani.
Reero muri we ni mwo mwe hamwe n’abandi mwubakwa mu buryo bw’Umwuka, kugira ngo mube inzu yo gutuurwamo n’Imaana.
Ni co gituma njeewe Pawulo ndi umusibe ku bwa Kristo Yesu ku bwanyu abanyamahanga.
Ngira ngo mwumviise yuuko Imaana yanshinze kubakorera uyu murimo ku bw’ubuntu bwayo.
Imaana yampishuuriye ibanga ry’umugambi waayo nk’uko nabyanditse muri make,
kandi nimubisoma muribuuze gusobaanukirwa ukuntu nasobaanukiwe iryo banga rya Kristo.
Mu bihe bya keera, iri banga ntiryigeze rimenyeshwa abaana b’abantu, nk’uko ubu rimaze guhishuurirwa intumwa ze zeera, ikoreesheje Umwuka waayo.

Umugambi w’iryo banga ni uko abanyamahanga na bo ari abaragwa bumurage w’Imaana kimwe n’Abayuuda ku bw’Ubutumwa Bwiza. Ni ingingo z’umubiri umwe kandi basangiye ku seezerano Imaana yakoze muri Kristo, babikeesha Inkuru Nziiza.
Nagizwe umugaragu wo kwamamaza Ubutumwa Bwiza nkurikije ubuntu bw’Imaana nahaawe, ku bw’imbaraga zaayo zikorera muri nje.
Nuubwo ari njeewe urutwa n’uworoheje caane mu bantu b’Imaana boose, Imaana yampaaye umugisha wo kujaanira abanyamahanga Ubutumwa Bwiza bwa Kristo ari bwo butunzi butarondooreka,
no gusobaanurira abantu uko ibanga ry’umugambi w’Imaana rigiiye gushirwa mu bikorwa. Imaana yaremye ibintu byose, yahishe iryo banga ryayo uheereye keera koose,
kugira ngo abo muri iki gihe, abategetsi, n’ibikomangoma byo mu ijuru, bamenyeshwe n’itoorero, ubwenge bw’Imaana bw’uburyo bwinshi.
Uku ni ko Imaana yuujurije umugambi waayo uhoraho inyuriye muri Kristo Yesu Umwami waacu.
Mu kunga ubumwe na Kristo no kwizeera dufite muri we, biduheesha kwegeera Imaana tudatiinya.
Nooneho reero ndabinginga ngo mudacoogora biteewe n’uko mbabazwa ku bwanyu, kuko ari byo bibaheesha icuubahiro.
Ni co gituma mfukama imbere y’Imaana Daata,
uwo imiryango yoose yo mu ijuru n’iyo ku isi yiitirirwa.
Ndasaba Imaana nyir’ikuzo n’ububaasha bwose kubateera imbaraga no gukomeza imitima yaanyu, ibigiriishije Umwuka waayo
kandi ndasaba ngo Kristo atuure mu mitima yaanyu mubikeesha ukwizeera kwanyu, ubwo muri gushoora imizi no gushikama mu rukundo.
Ndasaba kugira ngo mwebwe hamwe n’abantu b’Imaana boose, mugire imbaraga zo kumenya yuuko urukundo rwa Kristo ruhebuuje,
no kumenya yuuko urukundo rwe rurenze ukwitegereza, kugira ngo mushobore gusendeerezwamo kamere yoose y’Imaana.
Noone reero, dukwiriye gushiima Imaana yo ikoreesha imbaraga zaayo muri twe, igakora ibirenze ku byo twasaba, ndetse n’ibyo twakwibwira.
Ni ihaabwe ikuzo mu itoorero no muri Kristo Yesu ibihe byose, n’uko ibihe biha ibindi. Amiina.
Noone reero, njeewe umusibe wa Nyagasani, ndabinginga kugira ngo muje mugenza uko bikwiriye, mukurikije ibyo mwahamagariwe.
Mwiciishe bugufi, mugire ukwiyorosha, kandi mwihangaane. Mugaragaze urukundo rwanyu mu kwihangaanirana muri byose.
Muharanire kurinda ubumwe butangwa n’Umwuka w’Imaana, n’amahoro abahuuza.
Hariho umubiri umwe n’Umwuka umwe, nk’uko ico mwiringira ari kimwe, ari na co Imaana yabahamagariye.
Hariho Nyagasani umwe, ukwizeera kumwe, umubatizo umwe,
Imaana imwe kandi Daata wa twese, usumba boose, ukorera muri boose, kandi agatuura muri boose.
Buri umwe muri twe yahaawe urugero rw’impaano imukwiriye, nk’uko Kristo yayimugeneye.
Ni na ko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Ubwo yazaamuutse aja mu ijuru, yajaanye abanyagwa benshi, yahaaye abantu impaano."
Noone se, "Yazaamuutse mu ijuru" bisobaanura iki? Bisobaanura yuuko yabanje kumanuka akagera ikuzimu.
Bityo reero, uwamanutse ni we wazaamuutse, aja heejuru y’amajuru yoose, kugira ngo yuzure hoose.
Ni we watanze impaano zo kugira ngo bamwe babe intumwa, abandi abahanuuzi, abandi abavugabutumwa, abandi abashumba n’abiigiisha.
