Ibyo yabikoze kugira ngo ateguurire abantu b’Imaana gukora umurimo waayo, no gukomeza umubiri wa Kristo.
Bityo twese tuzunga ubumwe mu kwizeera no kumenya Umwana w’Imaana, tukaba abantu bahamye, bageze ku rugero rwuzuye rwa Kristo.
Ubwo ntituzaaaba tukiri abaana batwarwa n’imivumba no guhuuhwa n’imiyaga yoose ihindagurika, ari yo myigiishirize y’abantu bashukana, bakayobya abandi bakoreesheje uburyarya bihimbiye.
Ahuubwo nituvuga ukuri tugakurikiza umutima w’urukundo, tuzaakurira mu bumwe na Kristo, ari we mutwe.
Ni we ugenga ingingo zoose z’umubiri zihuurizwa hamwe, n’umubiri woose ugafatwa n’ingingo ziwugize. Bityo buri rugingo rukoze umurimo rushinzwe, umubiri woose urakura maze ukiiyubakira mu rukundo.
Dore ibi ni byo mbabwira kandi neemeza biturutse kuri Nyagasani; ntimugakomeze kwifata nk’abataazi Imaana, bakurikiza ibiteekerezo byabo bitagira umumaro,
n’ubwenge bwabo bukaba ari ntaaco busobaanukirwa. Biitandukanyije n’ubugingo Imaana itanga, ku bw’ubujiji bwabo n’imitima yaabo yiinangiye.
Ntibakigira isoni na hato. Ubu bariyandarika, bagakora ibiteeye isoni byose biteerwa n’irari ntaaco batiinya.
Ibyo si byo mwigiishijwe ubwo mwigiishwaga kumenya Kristo!
Ni koko mwumviishije ibimufasheho, kandi nk’abayoboke be mwigiishijwe ukuri gusangwa muri Yesu.
Noone reero nimwiyambure kamere yaanyu ya keera, yategekaga imigenzereze yaanyu, igatuma mwangiizwa n’ibyifuuzo by’iryo rari.
Nimuvugurure imitima yaanyu maze muhinduke basha mu biteekerezo,
kandi mwambare kamere nsha y’ishusho y’Imaana, murangwa n’ubuzima nyakuri butungaanye hamwe n’ubuziranenge.
Noone reero, nimuciike ku binyoma, buri muntu abwire mugenzi we ukuri, kuko twese turi ingingo z’umubiri wa Kristo.
Kandi nimuraakara ntibibateere gukora icaaha, ndetse izuuba ntirikarenge mugifite uburaakari,
kandi ntimugahe Sataani amahiirwe yo kubashuka.
Abiibaga barekeraho kwiiba, ahuubwo batangire kwihaatira gukoreesha amaboko yaabo, kugira ngo babone uko bafasha abakene.
Ntimugakoreeshe amagambo mabi, ahuubwo mukoreeshe amagambo meeza yaakuubaka ubugingo bw’abandi nk’uko babikeneye, kugira ngo abayumva abagirire akamaro.
Kandi ntimukaraakaze Umwuka Weera, kuko uwo Mwuka ni ikimenyeetso Imaana yabashizeho kizaabaranga ku munsi wo gucungurwa kwanyu.
Mwivaanemo gushaariirana koose n’umujinya, no kuraakara, n’intonganya, n’itimwe,
ahuubwo mugirirane impuhwe n’ineeza, mubabarirane nk’uko Imaana yabababariye binyuze muri Kristo Yesu.
Ubwo reero muri abaana b’Imaana ikunda caane, muje mugerageza kuba nka yo.
Kandi muje mukundana nk’uko Kristo yadukunze agatanga ubuzima bwe ku bwacu nk’ituuro n’igitambo gihuumura neeza kigashiimiisha Imaana.
Ubwo muri abaana b’Imaana, ntibikwiriye ko ingeso mbi nk’ubusambanyi, kwiyandarika, no kurarikira ibintu, birangwa muri mwe.
Kandi ntibikwiriye ko mukoreesha amagambo ateeye isoni, akoreeshwa n’abapfaapfa, n’amashengo adakwiriye, ahuubwo muje mushiima Imaana.

Koko reero mumenye neeza yuuko ari nta musambanyi, cangwa ukora ibiteeye isoni, cangwa umunyamururu [kuko umururu ari uburyo bumwe bwo guhindura iby’isi ibigirwamaana], uzaagira umugabane mu Bwami bwa Kristo n’ubw’Imaana.
Ntihakagire ubashukiisha amagambo atagira aho ashingiye, kuko ibikorwa nk’ibyo biizana umujinya w’Imaana maze bigatuma ihana abatayumvira.
Nuuko reero ntimugafatanye n’abantu nk’abo.
Namwe ubwanyu mwari mu mwijima, ariko ubwo mwahindutse mukaba aba Nyagasani, muri mu muco. Nooneho reero, nimugenze nk’abaana b’umuco,
kuko umuco ni wo uzana umusaaruuro w’ingeso nziiza zoose, ubutungaane, n’ukuri.
Nimushishooze kumenya ibishiimiisha Nyagasani.
Ntimukiivange mu bikorwa bitagira akamaro, kuko ari iby’umwijima, ahuubwo muje mubishira kumugaragaro.
Ibyo bikorwa byabo bikorwa rwihishwa biteeye isoni no kubivugaho.
Ariko iyo byose bishizwe kumugaragaro, imiteerere yabyo nyakuri iboneka neeza,
kuko ikigaragajwe coose kiba kibaaye umuco. Ni co gituma bivugwa ngo, "Yewe usinziiriye, kanguka, maze uzuuke uve mu baapfuuye, nuuko Kristo azaakumurikire."
Nuuko reero, mwirinde mu mibeereho yaanyu. Ntimukabe nk’injiji, ahuubwo mube nk’abanyabwenge.
Mukoreeshe neeza igihe mufite, kuko iminsi ari mibi.
Noone reero mureke kuba abapfu, ahuubwo mumenye ico Nyagasani ashaaka ngo mukore.
Ntimugasindiishwe na divaayi, yaatuma mukora ibidakwiriye, ahuubwo mwuzure Umwuka.
Mubwirane amagambo ya Zaaburi, n’indirimbo z’ibisingizo, n’izikomooka ku Mwuka, muririmba kandi mucurangira Nyagasani mubikuuye ku mutima.
Mu izina ry’Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo, muje muhora mushiima Imaana Daata.
Muje mwubahana mubiteewe no kuubaha Kristo.
Bagore, mwubahe abagabo baanyu nk’uko mwubaha Nyagasani.
Kuko umugabo ni we mutwe w’umugore nk’uko Kristo ari umutwe w’itoorero, ari ryo mubiri we.
Nk’uko reero itoorero ryubaha Kristo, ni ko namwe bagore mugomba kuubaha abagabo baanyu muri byose.
Bagabo, mukunde abagore baanyu nk’uko Kristo yakunze itoorero akaritangira ubugingo bwe.
Ibyo yabikoze kugira ngo yeeze itoorero akoreesheje ijambo rye n’amaazi,
maze aryigarurize ribengerana kandi ritagira inenge, nta mipfunyo cangwa ikindi kintu kitaboneye.
Uko ni ko abagabo bagomba gukunda abagore baabo nk’uko bakunda imibiri yaabo. Umugabo ukunda umugore we aba yiikunda ubwe.
Koko reero, abantu ntibanga imibiri yaabo, ahuubwo barayigaburira kandi bakayireeberera, nk’uko Kristo agenzereza itoorero rye,
kuko turi ingingo z’umubiri we.
Ibyanditswe biravuga biti, "Ni co gituma umugabo azaasiga se na nyina akiifatanya n’umugore we, nuuko abo babiri bakaba umubiri umwe."
Iryo ni ibanga rikomeye ry’ukuri, ariko nje mvuga yuuko rivuga kuri Kristo n’itoorero rye.
Nuuko reero namwe, buri mugabo akwiriye gukunda umugore we nk’uko yiikunda, kandi buri mugore akuubaha umugabo we.
Baana, muje mwumvira ababyeyi baanyu kuko ari byo bikwiriye abari muri Nyagasani.
"Wubahe so na nyoko" ni ryo tegeko rya mbere rijaana n’iseezerano:
"kugira ngo bizaakugendere neeza, maze uramire ku isi."
Namwe kandi ba se b’abaana, ntimukaraakaze abaana baanyu, ahuubwo mubarere neeza mubiigiisha ibya Nyagasani.
Namwe mbaata, muje mwumvira ba shoobuja bo ku isi kandi mubuubahe mubikuuye ku mutima nk’abuubaha Kristo.
Muje mubikora bidateewe n’uko babareeba byonyine, mushaaka ngo babashiime, ahuubwo muje mubikora n’umutima umwe nk’abagaragu ba Kristo mubikuuye ku mutima nk’uko Imaana ibishaaka.
Muje mukorera ba shoobuja n’umutima umwe nk’abakorera Nyagasani, mutari nk’abakorera abantu.
Mumenye yuuko Nyagasani azaahemba buri muntu, yaaba imbaata cangwa uwiigenga, akurikije imirimo myiza yakoze.
Namwe bakoreesha, muje mugirira mutyo abagaragu baanyu, mureke kubakangiisha ibihano. Mumenye yuuko mwebwe n’abagaragu baanyu musangiye Shoobuja wo mu ijuru, utarobaanura abantu ku butoni.
Ahasigaye reero, nimukomezwe n’imbaraga zihebuuje za Nyagasani.
Mwambare intwaro zoose ziturutse ku Maana, kugira ngo muzaashobore guhangana n’uburiganya bwa Sataani.
Kuko ntiturwana n’abantu, ahuubwo turwana n’imyuka mibi itegeka ikireere, ibikomangoma n’ibihangaage, n’abategeka iyi si y’umwijima.
Nuuko reero nimwambare intwaro z’Imaana, kugira ngo umunsi mubi ni ugera, muzaashobore guhangana n’igiteero c’umwanzi, kandi intambara n’irangira, muzaahagarare mudatsinzwe.
Nuuko reero nimuhagarare kigabo, mukenyere ukuri nk’umushumi, kandi mwambare gukiraanuka nk’icuuma gikingira igituuza.
Naho ingato zo mu birenge byanyu, zibe umwete wo kwamamaza Inkuru Nziiza y’amahoro.
Igihe coose, muje mwitwaza ingabo yo kwizeera, kuko ari yo muziifashiisha kuzimya imyambi igurumana, iraswa n’umubi.
Nimwakiire agakiza nk’ingofero y’icuuma, kandi n’ijambo ry’Imaana nk’inkoota muhaabwa n’Umwuka.
Igihe mukora ibyo, muje musenga, musaba Imaana kubafasha. Muje musenga buri gihe muyobowe n’Umwuka. Ku bw’ibyo, mugume muri maaso kandi muhore musabira abantu b’Imaana.
Nanje munsabire kugira ngo nimbumbuura akanwa, Imaana impe ubutumwa bukwiriye, kugira ngo mvuge nshize amanga menyeeshe abantu ibanga ry’ubutumwa bwiza.
Ubwo butumwa ni bwo mpagarariye n’ubwo ndi mu gihome. Icampa nkavuga ubutumwa nshize amanga nk’uko bikwiriye.
Tukiko, umuvandimwe waacu dukunda kandi umugaragu wiringirwa mu murimo wa Nyagasani, azaababwira uko meze, kugira ngo mumenye uko meze.
Ni co gitumye mubatumaho kugira ngo ababwire uko twese tumeze, hamwe no kubakomeza.
Amahoro n’urukundo hamwe no kwizeera bikomooka ku Maana Daata n’Umwami Yesu Kristo, bihorane n’abavandimwe biizeera.
Ubuntu bw’Imaana bubaane n’abo boose bakunda Umwami Yesu Kristo n’urukundo rudateezuuka.

name: Filipenses
chapters: Njeewe Pawulo na Timoteeyo abagaragu ba Yesu Kristo, Turabandikira mwebwe bantu b’Imaana mwese bo muri Filipi beemera Kristo Yesu hamwe n’abayobozi b’itoorero n’abadiyakooni.
Ubuntu n’amahoro biva ku Maana Daata hamwe n’Umwami Yesu Kristo bibe muri mwe.
Nshiima Imaana igihe coose mbateekerejeho,
kandi igihe coose mbasengeye, bimpa umuneezeero
kuko mwakomeje gufatanya nanje mu kwamamaza Ubutumwa Bwiza bwa Kristo uheereye ubwo mwabwumviise kugeza na n’ubu.
Ndahamya neeza ntashidiikanya ko iyatangiye umurimo mwiza muri mwe izaawurangiza rwose kugeza ku munsi Yesu Kristo azaagaruka.
Mbahoza ku mutima kandi koko birakwiriye ko mbateekerezaho ntyo kuko mukomeje gusangira nanje ubuntu bw’Imaana ubu ndi mu gihome, ndetse n’igihe nshigikira Ubutumwa Bwiza mpamya ko ari ubw’ukuri.
Imaana ni yo njuriza ko mpora mbakumbuye mbiteewe n’urukundo rwa Kristo rundimo.
Isengesho ryanje ni ukugira ngo urukundo rwanyu rurusheho kugwira kandi mushobore kumenya no gusobaanukirwa,
kugira ngo mushobore gutooranya iciiza kiruta ibindi. Nibwo muzaaba abeere kandi inyangamugayo ku munsi Kristo azaagaruka.
Nuuko ubuzima bwanyu burangweho umusaaruuro w’imbuto z’ubutungaane zitangwa na Yesu Kristo weenyine kugira ngo Imaana ihaabwe ikuzo kandi ihimbaazwe.
Bakundwa, nshaaka ko mumenya yuuko ibyambaayeho byatumye ubutumwa bwiza bwamamara.
Kandi ku bw’ibyo, abarinzi b’i bwami n’abandi bantu boose bari hano baazi neeza yuuko nsibwe ndyora Kristo.
Ndetse gusibwa kwanje kwatumye abiizeera boose bakomerera mu Mwami bituma batiinyuuka igihe coose barikuvuga ijambo ry’Imaana.
Ni ukuri bamwe babwiriza ibya Kristo babiteewe n’ishari hamwe no gushaaka kurushanwa, ariko abandi babwiriza ibya Kristo n’umutima mwiza.
Aba babwiriza ubutumwa babiteewe n’urukundo, kuko baazi neeza yuuko natooranyirijwe kurwanira Ubutumwa Bwiza.
Abandi baamamaza ibya Kristo babiteewe n’uko biishaakira inyungu zaabo bwiite.
Ariko ibyo ntaaco bitwaye. Baaba babikorana imigambi mibi cangwa myiza, ubutumwa bwa Kristo buri kwamamazwa mu buryo bwose kandi ku bw’iyo mpamvu, ndabyishiimiye kandi nzaahora niishiima.
Kuko nzi yuuko ku bw’amasengeesho yaanyu, no gufashwa n’Umwuka utangwa na Yesu Kristo, ibi bizamviiramo kubohoorwa.

Ico niifuuza kandi mfitiye iciizeere ni ukugira ngo ntazaakorwa n’isoni mu buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose, ahuubwo mu kuvuga nshize amanga kwanje, Kristo ashirwe heejuru mu mibeereho yanje, ubu no kugeza iteeka ryose naaba ndi muzima cangwa mfuuye.
Kuko ku bwanje kubaho ni Kristo kandi gupfa ni inyungu.
Ariko reero niiba kubaho mu mubiri ari co kizaateera gukomeza kwera imbuto z’umurimo wanje sinzi ico naahitamo.
Birankomereye guhitamo muri byombi. Kuko niifuuza caane kuva muri uyu mubiri nkabaana na Kristo kandi ni byo byambeera byiza bihebuuje,
ariko kuguma mu mubiri ni byo by’ingirakamaro kuri mwe.
Nuuko reero ubwo maze kwemezwa, nzi neeza yuuko nzaagumana namwe kugira ngo nkomeze kubafasha mwese gukura ndetse no kugira umuneezeero wo kwizeera kwanyu.
Kandi kugira ngo ninongera kugaruka iwaanyu, muzaarusheho kugira impamvu zo kwishiimira muri Kristo ku bw’ibyo ari gukora muri nje.

Ikiruta byose, mukwiriye gukora ibikwiranye n’ubutumwa bwiza bwa Kristo kugira ngo niiyo naaba nje kubasuura cangwa sinze, nzumve ko mukomereye mu mwuka umwe, muhuuje umugambi kandi murwanira hamwe ku bwo kwizeera Ubutumwa Bwiza.
Ntimugateerwe ubwoba n’abanzi baanyu ahuubwo igihe coose muzaahore mufite ubutwari kuko iki ni co kizaabagaragariza ko bagiiye kurimburwa naho mwe mukarokoka kuko ni Imaana ibaha intsinzi.
Kuko mutaahaawe umugisha wo kwizeera Kristo gusa, ahuubwo mwahaawe no kubabazwa ku bwe.
Turi hamwe mu rugamba. Mwitegereje urugamba narwanye mu gihe caashize kandi murabiizi ko nkirurimo na n’ubu.
Ubwo reero ubuzima bwanyu muri Kristo bubaha gukomera, urukundo rwe rukabahuumuriza, mufite ubumwe n’Umwuka kandi mugirirana impuhwe n’imbabazi.
Ngaaho nimunsendeerezemo umuneezeero muhuuje ibiteekerezo hamwe n’urukundo kandi mwibwira bimwe mu mitima yaanyu no mu biteekerezo.
Ntimukagire ico mukora mubiteewe no kwikunda cangwa kwishira heejuru, ahuubwo mu kwiciisha bugufi kwanyu umuntu weese yibwire ko mugenzi we amuruta.
Umuntu weese muri mwe ye kwita ku byifuuzo bye gusa ahuubwo azirikane n’iby’abandi.
Mugire umutima nk’uwari muri Kristo.
We, nuubwo yari afite kamere y’Imaana, ntiyiigeze ateekereza ko guhwana n’Imaana ari ikintu co kugundiira,
ahuubwo yiiyambuye icuubahiro ce, ajaana kamere y’umugaragu. Avuukira mu ishusho y’umuntu. Kandi amaze kuboneka afite ishusho y’umuntu,
yiiciisha bugufi kandi arumvira, kugeza ku gupfa ndetse apfa urupfu rwo ku musaraba.
No ku bw’iyo mpamvu, Imaana na yo yamushize heejuru caane kandi imuha izina riruta ayandi mazina yoose,
kugira ngo mu izina rya Yesu, amavi yoose apfukame, yaaba ay’ibiremwa byo mu ijuru cangwa ibyo ku isi n’ibyo munsi y’isi,
kandi buri rurimi rwature ko Yesu Kristo ari Umwami, ngo Imaana Daata ihaabwe ikuzo.
Nuuko reero bakundwa, nk’uko mwahoze munyumvira ndi kumwe namwe ubu murusheho kunyumvira ubwo ntari kumwe namwe. Mugaragaze ibikorwa by’agakiza kaanyu mutiinya kandi mwubaha Imaana,
kuko Imaana ni yo ikorera muri mwe kandi ibashoboza gushaaka no gukora ibyo yiishiimira.
Mukore byose mutiitotomba kandi mutagiishanya impaka,
kugira ngo mube abeere kandi intungaane. Mube abaana b’Imaana batagira inenge hagati y’abantu b’iki gihe b’indyarya hamwe n’abahemu, bo mumurikira nk’inyenyeeri muri iyi isi.
Ni ku bwo gushikama ku jambo ry’ubugingo kwanyu ko nziiraatana ku munsi wo Kristo azaagarukiraho yuuko ntiirukiye ubusa cangwa ngo nkorere ubusa.
Ariko nuubwo amaraso yanje yaaba ayo gusukwa ku itambiro nk’igitambo ngo abe ituuro ry’ukwizeera kwanyu, nzaabyishiimira kandi namwe mwishiimane nanje.
Namwe ni uko, mukwiriye kwishiima kandi mugasangira nanje umuneezeero.
Mfite ibyiringiro mu Mwami Yesu ko nzaabatumaho Timoteeyo bidatinze kugira ngo nshobore guhuumurizwa n’inkuru yaanyu.
Ntaawundi mfite nka we uziita ku byanyu.
Abandi boose baharanira inyungu zaabo aho kwita ku bya Yesu Kristo.
Ariko muuzi neeza uko Timoteeyo yagaragaje agaciiro ke, uko we nanje nk’umwana na se, twakoranye mu kwamamaza Ubutumwa Bwiza.
Niringiye kuzaamubatumaho vuba niimara kumenya ibigiiye kumbaho hano.
Kandi ndizeera mu Mwami ko nanje ubwanje nzaaza kubareeba bidatinze.
Nateekereje yuuko ari ngombwa ko naabooherereza mwene daata Epafura, dufatanyije umurimo kandi turwana hamwe urugamba. Ni intumwa yaanyu kandi ni we unkorera ibyo nkennye.
Amaze igihe yiifuuza kubareebaho kandi ahangayikiishijwe n’uko mwumviise ko arwaye.
Ni koko yararwaye bikabije kugeza ubwo yari agiiye gupfa. Ariko Imaana yamugiriye imbabazi, kandi atari we gusa, ahuubwo nanje kugira ngo ntongera undi mubabaro ku wo nari nsanganywe.
Ndashiishikarira kumubooherereza kugira ngo mushobore kongera kwishiima mumuboonye kandi nanje nshire agahinda.
Nuuko reero mumwakiirane umuneezeero mu Mwami kandi muje mwubaha abantu nkaabo,
kuko yahaze ubuzima bwe kugeza ubwo yari agiiye gupfa azize umurimo wa Kristo, kugira ngo angezeho ubufasha bwo mwe mutaari kungezaho.
Ibisigaye bavandimwe, mwishiimire mu Mwami. Sindambirwa kubandikira nsubiramo ibyo niigeze kubandikira igihe bibafitiye akamaro.
Mwirinde abo bantu biitwara nk’imbwa, mwirinde abagizi ba naabi, mwirinde abo bakeba umubiri.
Ni twe twakebwe by’ukuri kuko turamya Imaana mu Mwuka kandi tukiishiimira muri Kristo Yesu aho kwiringira iby’umubiri,
nuubwo nanje ubwanje mfite impamvu zo kwiringira iby’umubiri. Niiba hari undi weese ufite impamvu zo kwiringira iby’umubiri, njeewe ndazimurusha,
kuko nakebwe ku munsi wa munaane, ndi uwo mu bwoko bwa Isirayeli mu muryango wa Benjamiini, ndi Umuheburaayo wavuukiye mu Baheburaayo, kandi ku byerekeye amategeko ndi Umufarisaayo,
nari mfite ishaka mu gutooteza itoorero, kandi ku byerekeye gutungaana kuzanwa n’amategeko nari inyangamugayo.
Nyamara ibyo nabaraga nk’inyungu byose mbibara ko ari igihombo ku bwa Kristo.

Ndetse ibintu byose mbibara nk’igihombo iyo mbigereranyije n’agaciiro gakomeye ko kumenya Kristo Yesu nk’Umwami wanje. Ku bwe, neemeye guhara ibyari inyungu zanje byose mbibara nk’ibishingwe kugira ngo ndonke Kristo
kandi mboneke muri we ntafite gutungaana kwanje kuzanwa n’amategeko ahuubwo kuzanwa no kwizeera Kristo ari ko gutungaana kuva ku Maana gushingiye ku kwizeera.
Niifuuza kumenya Kristo no kumenya imbaraga zo kuzuuka kwe kandi no gusangira na we imibabaro nkaba nka we no mu rupfu rwe,
kugira ngo nibishoboka nzaagere ku izuurwa ry’abaapfuuye.
Si ukuvuga ko maze kuba ico niifuuza kuba cangwa se ko maze kugera ku nteego, ahuubwo nkomeza guharanira kubona uruhembo rwo Kristo yatsindiye akanyigaruriza.
Bakundwa, sinteekereza ko maze kukigeraho ariko kimwe nkora, ni ukwibagirwa ibiri inyuma ngaharanira gusingiira ibiri imbere.
Mparanira kugera ku nteego kugira ngo mpaabwe igihembo co mu ijuru nahamagariwe n’Imaana muri Kristo Yesu.
Nooneho reero abo boose bakuze mu by’Umwuka bakomeze guhuuza umutima kandi niiba hari uteekereza ukundi kuntu ku kintu ico ari co coose, Imaana izaabibahishuurira.
Ico dusabwa ni ugukomeza ico tumaze kubona.
Bavandimwe, mugere ikirenge mu canje kandi mukurikize abo boose bakurikiza iciitegererezo twabeeretse.
Nk’uko nababwiye ibi kenshi, na n’ubu nkaba mbibabwira ndira, benshi bakomeje kuba abanzi b’umusaraba.
Iherezo ryabo ni ukurimbuka, kuko imaana yaabo ni inda, ibiteeye isoni ni byo biiraatana kandi imitima yaabo bayihoza ku by’isi.
Ariko twebwe iwaacu ni mu ijuru, kandi ni ho Umukiza dutegereje azaava, ari we Mwami Yesu Kristo.
Azaahindura imibiri yaacu y’intege nke ipfa, ayigire imibiri y’ikuzo nk’uwe, akoreesheje ubushobozi afite bumubaashiisha gutegeka ibintu byose.
Nuuko reero bavandimwe nkunda kandi nkumbuye, mwebwe muneezeero wanje kandi kamba ryanje, muhagarare mushikamye mutyo mu Mwami.
Ndinginga Ewudiya hamwe na Sintike guhuuza umutima nkabavandimwe mu Mwami.

Kandi naawe dufatanyije umurimo, ndagusaba gufasha aba bagore kuko baafatanyije nanje kurwanira umurimo w’Ubutumwa Bwiza hamwe na Kilimenti n’abandi twakoranye abo amazina yaabo ari mu gitabo c’ubugingo.
Muhore mwishiimira mu Mwami. Ndongera kubivuga nti, mwishiime!
Ubugwaneza bwanyu bumenywe na buri umwe. Umwami ari haafi kugaruka.
Ntimukagire ico mwiganyira ahuubwo muri byose mumenyeeshe Imaana ibyo mukeneye byose muyisenga, muyinginga kandi muyishiima.
Kandi amahoro Imaana itanga, aruta uko umuntu yakwibwira azaarinda imitima yaanyu n’ibiteekerezo byanyu muri Kristo Yesu.

Ibisigaye bakundwa, ikintu coose c’ukuri, ikintu coose co kuubahwa, ikintu coose gikiraanuka, ikintu coose kiboneye, ikintu coose c’igikundiro, ikintu coose gishimwa, niiba hari iciiza gihebuuje kandi hakabaho igikwiriye ishimwe, abe ari co muhoza ku mutima.
Mukomeze gukora ibyo mwize, ibyo mwakiiriye, ibyo mwumviise hamwe niibyo mwaboonye muri nje nuuko Imaana y’amahoro izaabaana namwe.
Niishimye caane mu Mwami kuko ubu haanyuma y’igihe kinini mwongeye kunzirikana. N’ubundi mwaranzirikanaga ariko mukabura uburyo bwo kubyerekana.
Si ukuvuga ko nshaatse kwerekana ngo ndakennye kuko maze kwiga kunyurwa n’ibyo mfite.
Nzi kubaho mfite biike kandi nzi no kubaho mfite ibisaaze. Muri byose kandi mu buryo bwose, niize ibanga ryo kubaho mu buzima bwose, naaba mpaaze cangwa nshonje, naaba mfite byinshi cangwa nkennye.
Nshobozwa byose na Kristo umpa imbaraga.
Muri byose, mwagize neeza kumfasha mu mibabaro yanje.
Nk’uko mubizi mwa Bafilipi mwe, mu gihe co Ubutumwa Bwiza bwatangiye kubwirizwa mvuye Makedooniya, ntaarindi toorero ryafatanyije nanje mu byo gutanga no guhaabwa ukuuyeho mwe.
Kuko n’igihe nari ndi i Tesalonike, mwanyoherereje ubufasha mumpa ibyo nari nifuuza kandi mwabikoze kenshi.
Simvuga ibi kuko nshaaka impaano zaanyu ahuubwo nshaaka ko murushaho kunguka.
Maze kubona ibihagije ahuubwo mfite ibinsaaze. Ndahaagijwe rwose ubwo maze guhaabwa imfashanyo mwanyoherereje kuva kuri Epafura, ituuro rihuumura neeza, igitambo ceemewe kandi gishimwa n’Imaana.
Kandi Imaana nkorera izaabahaaza ibyo mukeneye byose nk’uko ubutunzi bw’ikuzo ryayo buri, muri Kristo Yesu.
Nuuko Imaana Daata ihaabwe ikuzo iteeka ryose. Amiina.
Muntaahirize abantu b’Imaana boose muri Kristo Yesu. Abavandimwe turi kumwe barabataasha.
Ab’Imaana boose na caane abo mu rugo rw’umwami w’i Rooma barabataasha.
Ubuntu bw’Umwami Yesu Kristo bubaane namwe mwese.

name: Colossenses
chapters: Njeewe Pawulo, Intumwa ya Kristo Yesu ku bw’ubushaake bw’Imaana, na Timoteeyo mwene daata,
turabandikiye mwebwe abantu b’Imaana, kandi bavandimwe baacu biizeerwa muri Kristo bari i Kolosaayi. Imaana Daata ibagirire ubuntu n’amahoro.
Igihe tubasabira, duhora dushiima Imaana Se w’Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo,
kuko twumviise uko mwizeera Yesu Kristo n’urukundo mufitiye abantu b’Imaana.
Uko kwizeera kwanyu gushingiye ku byiringiro by’ibyiza mwagenewe mu ijuru. Ibyo byiringiro mwabanje kubimenyeeshwa n’ijambo ry’ukuri, ari bwo Butumwa Bwiza mwagejejweho.
Nk’uko ubwo butumwa bwamaze gukwira ku isi hoose kandi bukagira ingaruka nziiza, ni na ko bimeze no muri mwe, uheereye igihe mwabwumviise kandi mugasobaanukirwa by’ukuri ubuntu bw’Imaana.
Iby’ubuntu bw’Imaana mwabyigiye kuri Epafura mugenzi waacu dufatanya umurimo. Ni umukozi udahemuka wa Kristo ukora mu mwanya waanyu.
Ni we watumenyeesheje ibyerekeye urukundo mufite muyobowe n’Umwuka Weera.
Ni co gituma naatwe tudasiiba kubasengera uheereye igihe twumviise ibyo, dusaba ngo Imaana ibuuzuzemo ubwenge bwo kumenya ubushaake bwayo, ubuhanga no gusobaanukirwa bitangwa n’Umwuka waayo.
Bityo, muzaashobora kubaho nk’uko Umwami waacu abishaaka kandi muhore mukora ibimushiimiisha. Ubuzima bwanyu buzeera imbuto z’ibikorwa byiza by’uburyo bwose mwiyongera kurushaho mu kumenya Imaana.
Kandi turabasengera ngo Imaana ibahe gukomera koose kuva mu mbaraga z’ikuzo ryayo, kugira ngo bibashoboze kwiteguurira kwihangaanira byose mudacoogora kandi mufite umuneezeero,
mushiimira Imaana Daata yabahaaye kugabana ku murage wagenewe abantu baayo mu muco.
Imaana yaradukijije ituvaana mu butware bw’umwijima, itujaana mu Bwami bw’Umwana waayo ikunda,
ari na we dukeesha gucungurwa kandi ari ko kubabarirwa ibyaha byacu.
Kristo ni we shusho y’Imaana itareebwa n’amaaso. Ni we mfura yaayo mu byaremwe byose.

Kuko Imaana yaremye ibintu byose biri mu ijuru no mu isi inyuriye muri we, hari ibigaragara n’ibitagaragara, bwaba ubwami cangwa ubutegetsi, abategetsi cangwa imbaraga, byose byaremwe na we kandi ni we byaremewe.
Kristo yabaayeho mbere ya byose, kandi ni we uhuuriza byose hamwe.
Ni we mutwe w’umubiri we, ari wo toorero. Ni we ntangiriro kandi ni we wabanjirije boose kuzuuka kugira ngo afate umwanya w’ibanze muri byose.
Imaana yashimye ko kuuzura kwayo koose kuba mu Mwana waayo,
kandi uwo Mwana waayo ni we Imaana yanyuriyemo kugira ngo yiiyuzuze n’ibintu byose, byaba ibyo mu isi cangwa ibyo mu ijuru, mu kuuzana amahoro ibikeesha amaraso Umwana waayo yamennye ku musaraba.
Noone namwe abaari baariitandukanyije n’Imaana mukaba abanzi baayo ku bw’ibibi birangwa n’ibikorwa hamwe n’ibiteekerezo byanyu,
ubu Imaana yiiyunze namwe inyuriye mu rupfu rw’umwana waayo, watanze umubiri we kugira ngo ibaheeshe guhagarara imbere yaayo muri abeera, badafite inenge cangwa umugayo.

Icakora mukwiriye gukomeza kwizeera kwanyu gushingiye ku musinge ukomeye kandi ntimwemere kunyeganyezwa ngo muteeshuke ku byiringiro mwahaawe ubwo mwumviise ubutumwa bwiza. Ubu ni bwo Butumwa Bwiza bwo njeewe Pawulo mbeereye umugaragu, bwamamajwe mu isi yoose.
Ubu, neejeejwe n’uko mbabazwa ku bwanyu, iyo umubiri wanje utootezwa, mba nuuzuza ibyasaaze igihe Kristo yababarizwaga umubiri we, ari wo toorero.
Imaana yantooranyije kuba umuheereza w’itoorero kandi ni yo yampaaye uyu murimo ku bwanyu, kugira ngo naamamaze ijambo ry’Imaana mu bwuzuye.
Iryo banga ryari ryarahishwe uheereye keera kandi n’ibihe byose ariko ubu rimaze guhishuurirwa abantu b’Imaana.

Imaana ifite umugambi wo guhishuurira abanyamahanga ikuzo ry’iryo banga ry’agaciiro ifitiye abantu boose. Iryo banga ni uko mufite umwuka wa Kristo muri mwe bigatuma mugira ibyiringiro byo kuzaabona ku mugabane w’ikuzo ry’Imaana.
Kristo uwo ni we twamamaza, dukoreesha ubwenge bwose uko bishoboka kubuurira no kwigiisha abantu boose kugira ngo tugeze buri umwe imbere y’Imaana amaze gukura muri Kristo.
Ni co gituma nduha kandi ngaharanira ibi nkoreesheje imbaraga zoose mpaabwa na Kristo.
Niifuuza yuuko mumenya ukuntu mbaharanira mwe ab’i Kolosaayi, hamwe n’ab’i Lawodikeya kandi n’abandi boose batarambonaho.
Ibi mbikora kugira ngo imitima yaabo ihuumurizwe kandi bagire ubumwe mu rukundo, maze barusheho gusobaanukirwa kandi bagire ubwenge bw’ibanga ry’Imaana, ari ryo Kristo ubwe.
Muri we ni mwo ubuhanga n’ubwenge bw’Imaana buhishwe.
Mbabwiye ibyo kugira ngo hatagira ubabeeshabeesha n’amagambo y’ibinyoma.
N’ubwo ntari kumwe namwe, mbahoza ku mutima, kandi biraaneezeeza kubona mushishikariye gukomerera mu kwizeera Kristo.
Nuuko reero nk’uko mwakiiriye Kristo Yesu Umwami waacu, abe ari ko mukomeza kugendera muri we mu buzima bwanyu bwose,
mushooreye imizi muri we kandi ubugingo bwanyu bwubakiwe kuri we, nk’uko mwigiishijwe kandi mushiima Imaana ubudasiiba.
Muramenye ntihakagire ubanyagiisha ubwenge n’inyigiisho z’abantu cangwa ngo mubeeshwe n’imigenzo karande y’abantu hamwe no gutegekwa n’imbaraga z’imyuka itegeka isi idashingiye kuri Kristo.
Kuko ibyuzuye mu bumaana byose bibonerwa muri Kristo wabaaye umuntu,
kandi namwe mwahaawe ubugingo bwuzuye muri we. Ni we mutware w’ubutegetsi n’ubushobozi bwose.
Kandi ku bwa Kristo mwakebwe mu buryo bw’umwuka, bituma muvanwa mu mbaraga z’icaaha gishingiye kuri kamere.
Ubwo mwahambanywe na we igihe mwabatizwaga, ni na ko mwazuukanye na we mu kwizeera imbaraga z’Imaana yamuzuuye mu baapfuuye.
Kandi ubwo mwari mwarapfuye muzize ibyaha byanyu no kudakebwa, Imaana yatuzuuriye hamwe na Kristo, igihe yatubabariye ibicumuro byose,
ihanagura ibyatwanditsweho bidushinja ku bw’amategeko tutaakurikije, nuuko bibambwa ku musaraba.
Kuri uwo musaraba ni ho Kristo yatsindiye ubutware bw’imyuka mibi itegeka, akabuhemurira ku mugaragaro, akereekana intsinzi muri byose.
Nuuko reero, ntihakagire ubaciira urubanza mu byerekeye ibyo murya cangwa ibyo munywa, cangwa ibyerekeye iminsi y’ibirori, iboneka ry’ukwezi cangwa Isaabato.
Ibyo byose n’igishushaanyo c’ibizaaza, naho ukuri nyaako ni Kristo.
Kandi ntihakagire ubaciira urubanza yiiyerekana ko akomeye ku bwo kwerekwa kudasanzwe no gusenga abamalayika. Uwigira atyo, aba akurikije ibiteekerezo bye bya kamere muntu.
Abo biitandukanyije na Kristo kandi ari we mutwe w’umubiri. Kristo ni we ugaburira umubiri woose kandi ni we rufatiro rw’ingingo n’imitsi yoose, bikayiteera kumera neeza nk’uko Imaana ibishaaka.
Niiba reero mwarapfanye na Kristo, mudategekwa n’imyuka mibi itegeka iyi si, mbese ni kuki muciifata nk’aho muri ab’isi? Ni kuki mukomeza kugengwa n’amategeko nk’aya,
ngo "ntuugafate iki," cangwa "ntuukaroze kiriya," cangwa ngo "ntuugakore kuri kino"?
Ibyo byose bitaakaza agaciiro iyo bimaze gukoreeshwa, n’amategeko n’inyigiisho z’abantu gusa.

Ni koko kuubahiriza aya mategeko bisa nk’aho ari bwo buryo bukwiriye. Bituma urebeka nk’aho ukunda Imaana caane no kwiciisha bugufi hamwe no kwifata. Nyamara akaba ntambaraga bifite mu kurwanya irari ry’umubiri.
Niiba reero mwarazuukanye na Kristo, muharanire ibyo mu ijuru, aho Kristo yiicaye ku ntebe y’ubwami, iburyo bw’Imaana.
Muhoze umutima ku byo mu ijuru atari ku byo mu isi,
kuko mwapfaanye na Kristo kandi ubugingo bwanyu bukaba buhishwe hamwe na Kristo mu Maana.
Igihe Kristo we bugingo bwanyu nyakuri azeerekanwa, ni ho namwe muzeerekanwa na we, mufite ikuzo rye.

Nuuko reero, nimwitandukanye n’irari ryanyu ry’iby’isi ribarimo, nk’ubusambanyi, gukora ibiteeye isoni, kurarikira ibibi, kurarikira ibirenze kubyo mufite, kuko iyo mugize mutyo, muba mushira imbere ubutunzi bw’isi, ari ko kuramya ibigirwamaana.
Ku bw’ibyo, umujinya w’Imaana ugiiye kuuzira abo batayumvira.
Kandi namwe ubwanyu mwagenzaga mutyo keera mugikora ibyo bibi .
Ariko ubu mukwiriye kuzinukwa ibyo bintu byose, nk’uburaakari, umujinya, itimwe, no gutukana, kandi ntihakagire amagambo ateeye isoni ava mu kanwa kanyu.
Ntimukabeesherane kuko mwiyambuye kamere yaanyu ya keera hamwe n’imigenzereze yaayo
mukambara kamere nsha, ivugururirwa no gusobaanukirwa kwanyu hamwe n’ishusho nk’iryuwayiremye.

Muri iryo vugururwa, ntihaba hakiriho gutandukanya Umugiriki n’Umuyuuda, uwakebwe n’utaarakebwe, umunyamahanga ugayitse cangwa injiji, imbaata cangwa uw’umudendeezo, ahuubwo Kristo ni byose kandi ari muri boose.
Naho mwebwe, abo Imaana yatooranyije, ikabagira abeera kandi ab’igikundiro, mukwiriye kugira imbabazi, ineeza, kwiciisha bugufi, ubugwaneeza hamwe no kwihangaana.
Mwihangaanirane kandi niiba umwe agize ico apfa n’undi mubabarirane. Nk’uko Umwami waacu yabababariye, abe ari ko namwe mubabarirana.
Kandi kuri ibyo byose, mwongereho urukundo, ni rwo ruduhuuriza hamwe mu gutungaana rwose.
Nuuko reero, ni mureke amahoro ya Kristo agenge imitima yaanyu, kuko ari yo mwahamagariwe ngo mube umwe. Kandi muje muhora mushiima.

Maze mwemerere ijambo rya Kristo kuuzura mu bugingo bwanyu rwose, mugire n’ubwenge bwo kwiigiishanya no kugiirana inaama. Muje mushiimira Imaana mu mitima yaanyu muyiririmbira Zaaburi, ibisingizo n’izindi ndirimbo mubwirijwe n’Umwuka.
Kandi ico muzaavuga coose n’ibyo muzaakora byose, mubikore mu izina ry’Umwami Yesu, mushiima Imaana Daata mubikeesha Kristo.
Bagore, mwubahe abagabo baanyu kuko ari byo mukwiriye gukora nk’abakristo.
Bagabo, mukunde abagore baanyu kandi ntimukabagirire umwaga.
Baana, muje mwumvira ababyeyi baanyu muri byose, kuko ari byo bishiimiisha Imaana.
Babyeyi, ntimukaraakaze abaana baanyu kugira ngo badaciika intege.
Namwe bagaragu muje mwumvira ba shoobuja bo ku isi muri byose, ntimubikore ari uko babareeba kugira ngo mubaneezeeze, ahuubwo muje mubikora mubikuuye ku mitima yaanyu kandi mwubaha Imaana.
Ibyo mukora byose, muje mubikora mubikuuye ku mutima nk’abakorera Nyagasani atari ugukorera abantu,
ubwo muuzi yuuko Nyagasani azaabahemba umurage yabageneye kandi Kristo ni we shoobuja mukuru mukorera.
Ukora ibibi weese azaabihanirwa kuko Imaana itarobaanura ku butoni.
Namwe abafite abo mukoreesha mubahe ibikwiriye n’ibitunganye, mwibuka yuuko namwe mufite shoobuja wo mu ijuru.
Mukomeze gusenga, muba maaso kandi mushiima.
Kandi natwe mudusengere kugira ngo Imaana iduteguurire uburyo bwo kuvuga ijambo ryayo, twamamaze ubutumwa bw’ibanga rya Kristo, ariyo mpamvu itumye ndi mu gihome.
Nuuko reero munsengere kugira ngo mvuge iryo jambo uko bikwiriye.
Muje mugira ubwenge mu buryo mwifata ku bataazi Kristo, mukoreesha neeza igihe mufite.
Amagambo muvuga aje arangwa n’ineeza, nk’ibyokurya birimo umuunyu, kugira ngo mumenye uko mukwiriye gusubiza buri umwe.
Tukiko, mwene Daata ukundwa kandi umwiringirwa dukorana umurimo w’Umwami waacu Kristo, azaababwira ibimfasheho byose.
Ico ni co gitumye mubooherereza, kugira ngo abamenyeeshe uko turi kandi abakomeze.
Azanye na Oneesimaasi, mwene Daata wizeerwa kandi umwe muri mwe. Bari bubabwire iby’ino byose.
Arisitariko wo dusibwe hamwe arabataasha, na Mariko mubyara wa Barinaba arabataasha. Naaza iwaanyu, muzamwakiire neeza mukurikije ibyo mwabwiwe.
Na Yesu wiitwa Yusito arabataasha. Aba ni bo boonyine mu Bayuuda beemeye Kristo dufatanya umurimo wo kwamamaza Ubwami bw’Imaana kandi baaramfashije caane.

Epafura uvuuka iwaanyu arabataasha, na we ni umugaragu wa Kristo Yesu. Ahora ashiishikariye kubasengera, kugira ngo mushikame kandi mutungaane rwose, mumenye neeza mudashidiikanya ibyo Imaana ishaaka byose.
Mufiteho ubuhamya yuuko agira umwete wo kubakorera, mwebwe hamwe n’ab’i Lawodikeya n’ab’i Hiyerapoli.
Luka umuvuuzi ukundwa, hamwe na Dema barabataasha.
Mutaashe abavandimwe bari i Lawodikeya, na Numfa hamwe n’itoorero riteeranira mu nzu iwe.
Kandi uru rwandiko nimumara kurusomerwa, ruzaasomerwe n’itoorero ry’i Lawodikeya, namwe muzaasome uruzaava i Lawodikeya.
Mubwire Arukipo muti, "Ureebe ngo ushikirije umurimo wahaawe gukorera Nyagasani."
Ni njeewe Pawulo wiyandikiye iyi ndamutso. Kandi muje mwibuka yuuko nsibwe. Ubuntu bw’Imaana bube muri mwe.

name: 1 Tessalonicenses
chapters: Njeewe Pawulo na Silaasi, na Timoteeyo, turabandikiye mwebwe abo mu itoorero rya Teesalonike, biizeera Imaana Daata n’Umwami Yesu Kristo. Ubuntu n’amahoro bibe muri mwe.
Duhora dushiima Imaana ibihe byose kandi tubasabira uko dusenga.
Imbere y' Imaana Daata, twibuka imirimo yaanyu yo kwizeera, n’uko urukundo rubateera umuhaati wo gukora, n’uko ibyiringiro byanyu mu Mwami Yesu Kristo birushaho gushinga imizi.
Bavandimwe tuuzi neeza yuuko Imaana ibakunda kandi ikaba yarabatooranyije kuba abaayo.

Kuko Ubutumwa Bwiza tutaabubagejejeho mu magambo gusa ahuubwo twabwamamaje dukoreesheje imbaraga z’Umwuka Weera twerekana uko twemera yuuko Inkuru Nziza ari ukuri koko. Muuzi neeza ukuntu twifataga ubwo twari kumwe, yuuko kwari ukugira ngo tubafashe.
Namwe mwaratwigaanye, mwigaana na Nyagasani n’ubwo mwatootejwe caane, mwakiiranye ijambo ry’Imaana ibyishimo biva ku Mwuka Weera.
Ni co caatumye muba ico kureeberaho c’abeemera boose bari i Makedooniya no muri Akaya.
Muri mwe ni mwo ijambo ry’Imaana ryumviikaniye. Ntiryageze i Makedooniya no muri Akaya hoonyine, ahuubwo mu myanya yoose ukwizeera Imaana kwaraamamaye ku buryo bitari ngombwa kubivugaho.
Abantu boose bavuga uko mwatwakiiriye, n’ukuntu mwagarukiye Imaana, mukareka ibigirwamaana, kugira ngo mukorere Imaana nzima kandi y’ukuri,
kandi no gutegereza Umwana waayo uzaava mu ijuru, uwo yazuuye mu baapfuuye ari we Yesu udukiza uburakari bw’Imaana bugiiye kuuza.
Bavandimwe, ubwanyu muuzi yuuko kuuza kubasuura kwacu kutaabaaye imfaabusa.
Nuubwo twamaze kubabazwa no guhemurirwa i Filipi nk’uko mubiizi, Imaana yaduhaaye ubutwari bwo kubabwira Ubutumwa Bwiza bwayo nuubwo abantu benshi baaduhakanyaga.
Inyigiisho zaacu muri mwe ntaabwo zishingiye ku buyobe cangwa imigambi mibi, cangwa ngo tugire uwo tubeesha.
Ahuubwo yaboonye ko tubikwiriye, iduha umurimo wo kuvuga Ubutumwa Bwiza, ntitubuvugira gushiimiisha abantu, ahuubwo ni ugushiimiisha Imaana yo ireeba ibiri mu mitima yaacu.
Nk’uko mubiizi ntitwigeze kubabwira amagambo yo kuryosha inkuru kandi Imaana izi yuuko tutaabiihishemo ngo tugirire ibyanyu umururu.
Nta na rimwe twigeze dushaaka gushimwa n’abantu, haaba muri mwe cangwa mu bandi,
nuubwo twe nk’intumwa za Kristo twagombaga kugira ibyo tubasaba. Ariko twiciishije bugufi muri mwe nk’uko umubyeyi areeberera abaana be.
Ku bw’urukundo rwinshi tubafitiye, twagize umuhaati wo kutabagezaho Ubutumwa Bwiza gusa, ahuubwo no gutanga ubugingo bwacu ku bwanyu kuko mwatubeereye inkoramutima.
Bavandimwe, muriibuka uko twakoze turuha ijoro n’amanywa kugira ngo hatagira uwo turusha ubwo twababwirizaga ubutumwa.
Muri abahamya kandi n’Imaana irabiizi ko imyifatire yaacu kuri mwe abiizeera, yari ikiraanuka, ikwiriye kandi itagira umugayo.
Nk’uko mubiizi, twafashe buri muntu muri mwe nk’uko umubyeyi afata abaana be.
Twarabakomeje, turabahuumuriza kandi tubingingira gutunganira Imaana, ari na yo ibahamagarira kubona umwanya mu Bwami bwayo n’ikuzo ryayo.

Ni co gituma duhora dushiima Imaana ubudahwema, kuko mwakiiriye ijambo ry’Imaana twabaazaniye. Ntimwaryakiiriye nk’ijambo ry’abantu, ahuubwo mwaryakiiriye nk’ijambo ry’Imaana kandi rikorera muri mwe abiizeera.
Bavandimwe, ibi byababaayeho ni byo byabaaye no ku matoorero y’Imaana yo muri Yudeeya, byabaye ku bantu baariyo biizeeraga Kristo Yesu. Mwababajwe n’abantu baanyu nk’uko na bo baababajwe n’Abayuuda.
Biishe Umwami Yesu hamwe n’abahanuuzi kandi naatwe baradutooteza. Ntaabwo bashiimiisha Imaana kandi bahakanya buri muntu weese.
Batubuza kubwiriza abanyamahanga ngo bakizwe, bakaguma kugwiza ibyaha byabo, ariko noone, uburaakari bw’Imaana bwabagezeho.

Ariko twebwe bavandimwe, ubwo twatandukanyijwe namwe igihe gito mu buryo bw’umubiri, nyamara tubahoza ku mutima, kandi twiyongeye kubakumbura caane bituma twifuuza ko twongera kubonana namwe imbona nkubone.
Twashaatse kongera kugaruka iwaanyu. Ndetse njeewe Pawulo nagerageje kugaruka inshuro nyinshi ariko Sataani ntiyabitwemerera.
Mwaduteeye ibyiringiro n’umuneezeero kandi nimwe kamba ryo tuziiraatana imbere y’Umwami Yesu ubwo azaaba agarutse.
Koko ni mwe cuubahiro caacu n’ibyishiimo byacu.
Haanyuma, tuboonye ko tutaashobora kubyihangaanira, duhitamo gusigara twenyine muri Atenaayi.
Nuuko dutuma Timoteeyo umuvandimwe kandi umukozi w’Imaana mugenzi waacu mu kwamamaza ubutumwa bwa Kristo. Twamuboherereje ngo abe ari we ubakomeza no kubateera umwete wo gushikama mu kwizeera kwanyu,
kugira ngo hatagira usubira inyuma akava mu kwizeera abiteewe n’aya makuba turimo. Ni ukuri mwe ubwanyu muuzi neeza ko twagenewe kuzaayacamo
Ubwo twari tukiri kumwe namwe, twababwiye mbere y’igihe yuuko tugiiye gutootezwa kandi nk’uko mubiizi neeza ni ko byabaaye.
Ni co gitumye aho naniriwe kwihangaana mboherereje Timoteeyo kugira ngo azaamenyeeshe uko muhagaze mu kwizeera. Nateekereje ko umushukanyi yaaba yarabashutse, ibyo twakoze bikaba imfaabusa.

Noone ubu Timoteeyo atugezeho avuuye iwaanyu, kandi atuuzaniye inkuru nziiza y’ibyo kwizeera n’urukundo rwanyu. Yatubwiye yuuko muhora mutwibuka, mukanadukumbura mushaaka kutureeba nk’uko naatwe tubyifuuza.
Ku bw’iyo mpamvu bavandimwe, kwizeera kwanyu kwaraduhumurije mu mibabaro no mugutootezwa kwacu.
Ubu turumva turi bazima nimukomeza gushikama muri Nyagasani.
Mbese Imaana twayishiima dute ku bwanyu ku bw’umuneezeero muduteera imbere yaayo?
Dusenga ijoro n’amanywa kugira ngo Imaana iduhe kwongera kubonana namwe maze tubongerere kubikibuze mu kwizeera kwanyu.
Turasaba ngo Imaana Daata ubwayo n’Umwami Yesu baduteguurire inzira yo kugera iwaanyu.
Namwe Nyagasani abongerere kandi abaseesekazeho urukundo mufitanye, n’urwo mufitiye abantu boose nk’uko naatwe tubakunda.
Nyagasani akomeze imitima yaanyu mu butungaane kandi mwekugira umugayo imbere y’Imaana Daata, kugeza igihe Umwami waacu Yesu azaazana n’abeera be boose.

Nuuko bavandimwe, ibisigaye turabinginga tubahuguura mu izina ry’Umwami waacu Yesu kugira ngo nk’uko twabiigiishije mwifate mu buryo bushiimiisha Imaana, nk’uko musanzwe mubikora, ariko ubu reero mukwiriye kurushaho.
Muuzi neeza ibyo twabiigiishije ku bw’ububaasha twahaawe n’Umwami Yesu.
Ico Imaana ibashaakaho ni ukwezwa kwanyu, mukiirinda ubusambanyi,
buri muntu akamenya kurinda umubiri we mu buryo butungaanye kandi bwiyubashe,
mudatwarwa n’irari nk’uko abantu bataazi Imaana babigenza.
Kandi ntihakagire umuntu weese ugirira naabi umukristo mugenzi we cangwa ngo amurimanganye. Ibi twabibabwiye mbere kandi tubaamagirira twihanikiiriye, ko Nyagasani azaahana abakora ibyo.
Kuko Imaana itaaduhamagariye ubukozi bw’ibibi, ahuubwo yaduhamagariye ubutungaane.
Ni co gituma umuntu weese usuzugura ibyo twiigiisha, ataba asuzuguye ububaasha bw’umuntu, ahuubwo aba asuuzuguye Imaana ibaha Umwuka waayo Weera.
Ibyerekeye urukundo rwa kivandimwe, ntimugomba kubyandikirwa, kuko mwe ubwanyu Imaana ni yo yabiigiishije gukundana.
Kandi ni koko mukunda abiizeera boose bari muri Makedooniya, turabahuuguura kugira ngo mukomeze gukora mutyo ndetse murusheho.
Mugire umwete wo kuja mutuuza, mukore ibibareeba, kandi mukoreeshe amaboko yaanyu, nk’uko twababwiye.
Bityo reero muziiheesha agaciiro mu batiizeera, kandi mudafite ico mukennye.
Bavandimwe, dushaaka ko mumenya ibyerekeye abaasinziiriye kugira ngo mutababara nk’abandi badafite ibyiringiro.
Ubwo twemera ko Yesu yapfuuye kandi yazuutse, abe ari ko twemera ko Imaana izaazana abaapfuuye beemera Yesu.
Ico tubabwira ubu n’ijambo rya Nyagasani yuuko twebwe abiizeera bakiriho, baasigaye kugeza ubwo Umwami azaazira, tutazabanziriza na hato abaasinziriye.
Kuko Nyagasani ubwe, azaategeka n’ijwi riranguruye hamwe n’ijwi rya malayika mukuru, niry’impanda y’Imaana, nuuko abaapfuuye biizeeye Kristo abe ari bo babanza kuzuuka.
Haanyuma, naatwe abazaaba bakiriho muri ico gihe, tujaananwe na bo mu bicu gusanganira Umwami mu kireere. Bityo tuzaabaane na Nyagasani iteeka ryose.
Nuuko reero muje muhumurizanya muri ayo magambo.
Bavandimwe, ibyerekeye ibihe n’iminsi ntimukeneye ko mbibandikira.
Kuko mwe ubwanyu muzi neeza ko umunsi w’Umwami uzaaza nk’uko umujuura aza nijoro.
Ubwo abantu bazaaba bavuga bati, "Dufite amahoro n’umuteekaano," niho kurimbuka kuzaabaazaho nk’uko ibise bitungura umugore wenda kubyara, kandi ntibazaabona ubuhungiro.
Ariko mwebwe bavandimwe, ntimukiri mu mwijima ku buryo uwo munsi wabatungura nk’umujuura.
Kuko mwese muri abaana b’umuco n’abaana b’amanywa, ntituri ab’ijoro cangwa ab’umwijima.
Noone reero reka twegusinzira nk’abandi, ahuubwo tube maaso, kandi tugire ibiteekerezo bizima.
Kuko abasinziira basinziira nijoro, n’abasinda basinda nijoro.

Ariko twebwe abiizeera ubwo turi ab’amanywa, tuje tugira ibiteekerezo bizima, twambaye kwizeera n’urukundo nk’icuuma gikingira igituuza, kandi dufite ibyiringiro byo kuzaabona agakiza nk’ingufiiri y’icuma.
Kuko Imaana itatugeneye kurimburwa n’uburaakari bwayo, ahuubwo yadutooranyirije kubona agakiza kabonerwa m’Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo,
wadupfiiriye kugira ngo ni tuba tukiriho cangwa dusinziiriye tuzaabaane na we.
Nuuko reero, muhuumurizanye kandi muteerane inkunga nk’uko musanzwe mubikora.
Turabinginga bavandimwe kugira ngo muje mushiima imirimo y’abo babashinzwe kandi babayobora mu buzima bwa gikristo,
mubuubahe mu rukundo ku bw’umurimo babakorera. Kandi namwe ubwanyu muje mubaana mu mahoro.
Kandi turabahuguura bavandimwe, muje mucaaha inkorabusa, mukomeze abaciika intege, mufashe abatiishoboye, mwihangaanire boose.
Ntihakagire uwiituura undi inaabi yamugiriye, ahuubwo muharanire kugirirana ineeza, ndetse muyigirire boose.
Muje mwishiima iteeka,
musenge ubudasiiba.
Mu bibaho byose mushiime Imaana, kuko ari byo Imaana ibashaakaho muri Kristo Yesu.
Ntimugahagarike Umwuka Weera
kandi ntimugahinyure amagambo y’ubuhanuuzi,
ahuubwo mugenzuure byose, mugundiire ibyiza,
mwange ikibi coose.
Turasaba Imaana ubwayo itanga amahoro ngo ibeeze mu buryo bwose, irinde umwuka waanyu, n’ubugingo n’umubiri, kugira ngo bitazaabaho umugayo kugeza ku kugaruka k’Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo.
Imaana yabahamagaye ntiihemuka, ibyo yavuze izaabikora.
Bavandimwe, mudusabire.
Muramukanye n’abavandimwe boose muguhooberana kutaryaya.
Ndabihanangiririza nkomeje, ku bw’ububaasha nahaawe na Yesu Kristo muzaasomere uru rwandiko abavandimwe boose.
Ubuntu bw’Umwami Yesu bubaane namwe.

name: 2 Tessalonicenses
chapters: Njeewe Pawulo, na Silaasi na Timoteeyo, turabandikiye mwebwe ab’itoorero ry’i Teesalonike biizeera Imaana Daata n’Umwami Yesu Kristo.
Turabiifuuriza ubuntu n’amahoro biva ku Maana Daata no ku Mwami Yesu Kristo.
Bavandimwe, birakwiriye ko dushiima Imaana ibihe byose ku bwanyu, ku bwo kwizeera kwanyu kwiyongeera, n’urukundo mufitanye rukarushaho kugwira.
Ni yo mpamvu twe ubwacu tubiiraatana mwe abiizeera bari mu matoorero y’Imaana kubeera ubudacoogora no kwizeera kwanyu n’ubwo mutootezwa mugahuura no kubabazwa k’uburyo bwose ariko mukabyihangaanira.
Ibi byose byerekana ko Imaana iciira abantu urubanza rutabeera, kandi gutootezwa kwanyu kwagenewe kwerekana ko mukwiriye Ubwami bw’Imaana kandi ari na bwo mubabarizwa.
Ni koko birakwiriye yuuko Imaana yituura amakuba ababababaza,
kandi mwebwe abababazwa, Imaana izaabaha kuruhuukana naatwe ubwo Umwami Yesu azaagaragazwa ava mu ijuru azanye n’abaamalayika be bakomeye
n’umuriro ugurumana, ahane abanze kwemera Imaana kandi ntibumvire Ubutumwa Bwiza bw’Umwami waacu Yesu.
Abo bazaahaabwa igihano co kurimbuka iteeka ryose. Baziirukanwa imbere y’Imaana no mu bwiza bw’imbaraga ze,
igihe Yesu azaaza guhaabwa ikuzo n’abantu be kuri uwo munsi, kandi ashiimagizwe mu bazaaba baaramwemeye boose. Namwe muzaaba muri abo kuko mwemeye ubuhamya bwacu.

Ni co gituma tubasengera iteeka kugira ngo Imaana yaacu ibahe kuba mu buzima bukwiriye guhamagarwa kwayo, kandi ku bw’ububaasha bwayo ibahe gukora ibyiza byose mwiyemeje gukora, n’imirimo yaanyu yoose iva mu kwizeera,
kugira ngo muhimbaaze izina ry’Umwami Yesu, kandi namwe muhimbaazwe nawe, mubikeesha ubuntu bw’Imaana yaacu n’ubw’Umwami Yesu Kristo.
Bavandimwe, ibyerekeye kugaruka k’Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo, n’uko tuzaateerana nawe, turabasaba

kugira ngo mutajijwa cangwa ngo mugire ubwoba mubiteewe na bamwe bavuga ko umunsi wo kugaruka kwa Kristo wageze, bakurikije ko baba baarabihishuuriwe n’Umwuka, inyigiisho, ubuhanuuzi cangwa inzandiko bateekereza ko ari twe twazaanditse.
Ntihakagire umuntu weese ubabeesha mu buryo bwose, kuko uwo munsi utazaagera abantu batari baagomera Imaana bikabije n’umugomeramaana akagaragara ari we wagenewe kurimbuka.
Uwo azaarwanya kandi yiishire heejuru y’iciitwa imaana coose cangwa igisengwa, kugira ngo yiicare mu Nzu y’Imaana maze yiigaragaze ko ari we Maana.
Mbese ntimwibuka ko ibi nabibabwiye nkiri kumwe namwe?
Kandi dore muuzi ikimuzitiye ubu, kuko atazaahishuurwa igihe ce kitaraagera.
Kuko amayobera y’ubugome yatangiye gukora, ariko ntaazaahishuurwa keretse uyabuza ubu akuuweho,
ni bwo wa Mugomeramaana azaagaragazwa. Nuuko Umwami Yesu amurimbuze umwuka uva mukanwa ke, no kuboneka kw’ikuzo rye.
Kuuza k’umugomeramaana kuzaarangwa n’imirimo ya Sataani, igaragarira mu bubaasha bwose, n’ibimenyeetso n’ibitangaaza by’ibinyoma,
kandi azaabeesha mu buryo bwose abo baagenewe kurimbuka, kuko banze kwakiira ubutumwa bw’ukuri bwo kubarokora.
No ku bw’iyo mpamvu Imaana mu mbaraga zaayo izaabateera ubuyobe bukomeye nuuko beemere ibinyoma,
kugira ngo abo boose banze kwemera ukuri, bakiishiimira gukiraanirwa, baciirwe urubanza.

Bavandimwe kandi bakundwa b’Umwami waacu, dukwiriye guhora dushiima Imaana ku bwanyu, kuko Imaana yabatooranyije uheereye mbere na mbere kugira ngo muzaabone agakiza gaheeshwa no kwezwa kuva ku Mwuka no kwizeera ukuri.
Ni co gituma yarabahamagaye ikoreesheje Ubutumwa Bwiza twamamaza kugira ngo muzaasangire ikuzo n’Umwami Yesu Kristo.
Nuuko reero bavandimwe, muhagarare mushikamye mu byo mwizeera kandi mukomeze inyigiisho z’uruheererekane twabiigiishije, ari mu magambo cangwa mu rwandiko twabandikiye.
Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo ubwe, hamwe n’Imaana Daata wa twese, wadukunze maze ku bw’ubuntu atugirira akaduha guhuumurizwa kuzaahoraho n’ibyiringiro byiza,
babahe ihuumure kandi no gukomera mu mirimo myiza yoose mukora n’amagambo muvuga.
Ibisigaye bavandimwe mudusabire kugira ngo ijambo rya Nyagasani ryamamare hoose vuba kandi ryakiirwe nk’uko riri muri mwe.
Musenge kugira ngo Imaana idukize abantu b’abagome n’abagiranaabi kuko ntaabwo ariko buri muntu weese afite kwizeera.
Ariko Nyagasani ntaahemuka, azaakomeza abarinde umubi.
Kandi dufite ibyiringiro muri Nyagasani tudashidiikanya yuuko ibyo tubategeka mubikora kandi ko muzaanabikomeza.
Nyagasani ayobore imitima yaanyu kumenya urukundo rw’Imaana no kwihangaana gutangwa na Kristo.
Bavandimwe, turabategeka mu izina ry’Umwami Yesu Kristo kwirinda umwizeera weese wanga gukora kandi udakurikiza inyigiisho twabahaaye.
Muuzi neeza ubwanyu ukuntu mukwiriye kutwigaana, kuko tutiigeze tuba inkorabusa ubwo twari namwe.
Ntitwigeze kurya ibyokurya by’umuntu tutabyishuriye, twakoze buri gihe kugira ngo hatagira n’umwe muri mwe turusha.
Si ukuvuga ko tutaari tubifitiye uburenganzira, ahuubwo kwari ukugira ngo tubabeere urugero kugira ngo mudukurikize.
Ubwo twari tukiri kumwe namwe twarabategetse tuti, "Umuntu weese udashaaka gukora ntaakarye."
Twumviise yuuko muri mwe harimo abanebwe batagira ico bakora ahuubwo bakiivanga mubitabafasheho.
Abameze batyo tubategetse kandi tubasabye mu izina ry’Umwami Yesu Kristo ngo baje bakorana ituuze, batungwe n’ibyo baaruhiye ubwabo.
Namwe bavandimwe ntimugacoogore gukora neeza.
Kandi nihagira umuntu utumvira ibyo tuvuze muri uru rwandiko, mu mwirinde ntimugafatanye na we, kugira ngo amware.
Icakora ntimukamufate nk’umwanzi waanyu, ahuubwo mumugiire inaama nk’umwizeera mugenzi waanyu.
Nuuko reero Umwami w’amahoro ubwe aje abaha amahoro igihe coose, muri byose. Nyagasani abaane namwe mwese.
Njeewe Pawulo iyi ni yo ndamutso yanje kandi nanditse n’ukuboko kwanje, ni co kimenyeetso mu nzandiko zanje zoose, uku ni ko nandika.
Ubuntu bw’Umwami Yesu Kristo bubaane namwe mwese.

name: 1 Timóteo
chapters: Njeewe Pawulo, intumwa ya Kristo Yesu ku bw’itegeko ry’Imaana Umukiza waacu na Kristo Yesu ari we byiringiro byacu,
Ndakwandikiye Timoteeyo, umwana wanje nyakuri mu kwizeera. Ubuntu, imbabazi n’amahoro biva ku Maana Daata na Kristo Yesu Umwami waacu, bibaane naawe.
Ndagusaba kuguma muri Efeeso nk’uko nabikubwiye ubwo najaga i Makedooniya, kugira ngo ubuze abantu bamwe kwigiisha inyigiisho zidashitse.
Ubabwire bareke ibiteekerezo bitagira ishingiro no gukurikirana intonde z’ibiseekuruza zitagira iherezo. Ibyo biizana impaka z’urudaca, aho gushigikira umugambi w’Imaana ushingiye ku kwizeera.
Ikigendererwa c’aya mabwiriza ni ukwenegeza urukundo rukomooka ku mutima usukuuye, umutimanaama ukeeye, no kwizeera kutaryarya.
Bamwe biitandukanyije n’izo nyigiisho z’ukuri maze biishira mu magambo atagira ico amaze.
Bashaaka kuba abiigiishamategeko y’Imaana, kandi bataazi ibyo bavuga n’ibyo beemeza.
Tuuzi neeza yuuko amategeko ari meeza igihe akoreeshejwe mu buryo bukwiriye.

Twibuke yuuko amategeko ataashiriweho intungaane, ahuubwo ko yashiriweho abatayuubaha n’ibyigomeke, n’abateemera Imaana n’abanyabyaha, n’abatari intungaane naabo batuubaha Imaana, n’abiica ba se na ba nyina, n’abatemu,
abasambanyi n’ibitingwa , abacuruuza abantu, ababeeshi, abatanga ubujurizi bw’ibinyoma, n’abandi boose bakora ibinyuranye n’inyigiisho nzima.
Izo nyigiisho zihuuje mu butumwa bwiza nashinzwe kwamamaza, ari yo Nkuru Nziiza ikomooka ku Maana nyiri ikuzo n’ihiirwe.
Ndashiima Kristo Yesu Umwami waacu wampaaye imbaraga, kuko yanyizeeye maze akantoorera gukora umurimo we,
nuubwo mbere nari umuntu utuka Imaana, ngatooteza abayoboke baayo, ndetse nkaba umunyarugomo. Ariko nahaawe imbabazi kuko ibyo byose nabikoraga mbiteewe n’ubujiji kandi ntagira kwizeera.
Maze ubuntu bw’Umwami waacu bunsendeeramo hamwe no kwizeera n’urukundo rubonekera muri Kristo Yesu.
Iri jambo rivuga ko Kristo Yesu yazanywe mu isi no gukiza abanyabyaha, kandi muri bo nkaba ndi uwa mbere, ni iry’ukuri kandi rikwiriye kwemerwa na boose.

Ariko ku bw’iyo mpamvu narababariwe, kugira ngo Yesu Kristo yeerekanire muri nje umunyabyaha wa mbere, ukwihangaana kwe kuuzuye, bityo reero mbeere urugero abagomba kuzamwemera boose bagahaabwa ubugingo buhoraho.
Umwami w’ibihe byose udapfa, kandi utagaragara, ari we Maana imwe rukumbi, ihaabwe icuubahiro kandi ihimbaazwe iteeka ryose, Amiina.
Mwana wanje Timoteeyo, dore nguhaaye iyi nyigiisho nkurikije ubuhanuuzi bwa keera bwahanuuye ibyawe, kugira ngo nubukurikiza, bugushoboze kurwana intambara nziiza,
ufite ukwizeera n’umutimanaama utungaanye. Abantu bamwe ntaabwo baakurikije uwo mutimanaama waabo, maze bibaviiramo kutongera kwizeera.
Muri bo ni nka Himeneyo na Alekizanda, abo neeguriye Sataani kugira ngo biigireho kutazongera gutuka Imaana.
Mbere ya byose ndabiihanangiriza mwese ko mugomba kwambaza Imaana, mukayisenga, mukayitakambira kandi mukayishiimira ku bw’abantu boose.
Muje musabira abaami n’abandi bayobozi b’inzeego zo heejuru, kugira ngo tugire amahoro n’ituuze twubaha Imaana kandi turi inyangamugayo.
Ibyo birakwiriye kandi biratungaanye imbere y’Imaana Umukiza waacu,
yo ishaaka ko abantu boose baakizwa kandi bakamenya ukuri.
Kuko hariho Imaana imwe, ni na ko hariho umuhuuza w’abantu n’Imaana umwe, ni Kristo Yesu, ari we muntu
wiitanzeho igitambo kuba inshungu y’abantu boose. Ubwo bwari ubuhamya mu gihe gikwiriye yuuko Imaana ishaaka ko buri muntu weese akizwa.
Ico ni co natoorewe nk’umubwiriza n’intumwa kandi ndavuga ukuri, simbeesha. Kandi nk’umwigiisha w’abanyamahanga mu byerekeye ukwizeera n’ukuri.
Noone reero, ndashaaka ko buri hoose abagabo batungaaniye Imaana basenga beerekeje amaboko yaabo heejuru, kandi badafite uburaakari cangwa impaka.
Kandi ndashaaka ko abagore na bo baakwambara neeza imyambaro ikwiriye, atari ukuboha imisatsi no kwambara imitaako ya zaahabu, amasimbi, cangwa imyambaro y’igiciiro kinini,
ahuubwo bakiirimbiisha ibikorwa byiza, nk’uko bikwiriye abagore biiyemeza ko buubaha Imaana.
Umugore agomba kwiga acecetse kandi agaciisha make rwose.
Sineemerera umugore kwigiisha cangwa gutegeka umugabo, agomba guceceka,
kuko Adamu ni we waremwe mbere ya Eva,
kandi Adamu si we wohejwe, ahuubwo umugore ni we wohejwe maze acumura ku Maana.
Nyamara umugore azaakirizwa mu rubyaro rwe, aramutse akomeje kwizeera, akagira urukundo, gutungaanira Imaana no kwifata neeza.
Iri jambo rikurikira ni iry’ukuri ngo: Niiba umuntu ashaaka kuba umwepisikopi, aba yiifuuje umurimo mwiza caane.
Umwepisikopi agomba kuba ari inyangamugayo, afite umugore umwe, atararikira ibirenze, agomba kwifata, kandi akiyubaha, agomba kugira ubupfura, kandi akamenya kwigiisha neeza,
agomba kuba atari umusinzi, atari umurwanyi, ntaabe umunyamahaane, kandi adakunda isente.
Agomba kuba azi kureeberera ab’urugo rwe neeza, no gutooza abaana be kumvira no kuubaha mu buryo bwose.
Noone se niiba umuntu ataashobora kuyobora urugo rwe, yayobora ate itoorero ry’Imaana?
Ntaabwo akwiriye kuba ari umuntu uhindukiye Kristo vuba, kugira ngo ataaza kwishira heejuru maze Imaana ikamuciira urubanza nk’uko yaruciiriye Sataani.
Kandi akwiriye kuba ari umugabo wubahwa n’abo hanze y’itoorero, kugira ngo adahinyuka akagwa mu mutego wa Sataani.
Abadiyakooni na bo bagomba kuba ari abantu b’inyangamugayo, batari indyarya, batanywa inzoga nyinshi, cangwa ngo bararikire isente.
Bagomba gukomera ku iyobera ryo kwizeera bafite umutima ukeeye.
Bakwiriye kubanza baasuuzumwa, maze baasangwa batagira umugayo, bakeemererwa gukora nk’abadiyakooni.
Abagore baabo na bo bakwiriye kuba inyangamugayo, ntibabe abanyamazimwe, ahuubwo bakaba abatararikira ibirenze kandi bakaba abiiringirwa muri byose.
Umudiyakooni akwiriye kuba umugabo ufite umugore umwe gusa, kandi akamenya gutegeka neeza abaana be n’abo mu rugo rwe boose,
kuko abakora umurimo w’ubudiyakooni neeza, bibaheesha umwanya w’icuubahiro kandi bigatuma bashira amanga mu kwizeera Kristo Yesu.
Mfite ibyiringiro byo kuuza iyo vuba, ariko igituma nkwandikiye ibyo ni ukugira ngo,
nindamuka ntinze, ube uzi uko umuntu akwiriye kwifata mu muryango w’Imaana, ari wo toorero ry’Imaana nzima, kandi inkingi ishigikiye ukuri kwayo.

Ntawabishidiikanya, ibanga ry’ubukristo bwacu rirakomeye: Kristo yagaragaye mu ishusho ry’umuntu, Umwuka Weera umwerekana nk’intungaane, kandi abonwa n’abaamalayika, yaamamazwa mu mahanga, yiizeerwa mu isi yoose, kandi azaamuurwa mu ikuzo.
Ariko Umwuka Weera avuga yeruye ko mu bihe bizaaza bamwe baziihakana ukwizeera maze bakayoboka imyuka iyobya n’inyigiisho z’abadayimooni.
Inyigiisho nk’izo zisaakaazwa n’abanyabinyoma, ab’imitima yaabo yapfuuye ikaba itagishobora gutandukanya ikibi n’iciiza, nk’aho yokejwe n’icuuma kigurumana.
Babuza abantu kurongorana no kutarya ibyokurya bimwe, kandi Imaana yarabiremeye kwakiiranwa ishimwe n’abo biizeera kandi bakamenya ukuri.
Koko reero, ikintu coose caaremwe n’Imaana ni ciiza, kandi nta na kimwe kigomba kuba umuziro, iyo caakiiranywe ishimwe,
kuko kiba ceejejwe n’ijambo ry’Imaana hamwe no gusenga.
Ibi byose nubisobaanurira abiizeera, uzaaba ubaaye umugaragu mwiza wa Yesu Kristo, utunzwe n’amagambo yo kwizeera n’inyigiisho nziiza wakurikije.
Uje wiirinda imigani itari iy’Imaana ifite ibiteekerezo bibi bitagira ishingiro bikomooka kuri baasookuruza, ahuubwo wiitooze kuubaha Imaana.
Imyitoozo ngororamubiri ifite akamaro kuri bike, ariko kwitooza kuubaha Imaana byo bigira umumaro muri byose, kuko ari byo birimo iseezerano ry’ubugingo turimo n’ubw’igihe kizaaza.
Iri jambo ni iry’ukuri kandi rikwiriye kwemerwa rwose.
Koko reero, igituma twemera kugooka tukiihaahaata, ni uko dufite ibyiringiro ku Maana nzima, ari yo Mukiza w’abantu boose, caane caane abo biizeera.
Ibi ni byo ugomba kwibandaho kandi ukiigiisha.
Ntihakagire usuuzugura ubusore bwawe, ahuubwo ubeere abiizeera ico kureeberaho mu magambo, mu myifatire, mu rukundo, mu kwizeera, n’umutima utungaanye.
Kugeza aho nzaazira, uje ugira umwete wo gusomera abantu ibyanditswe byera, kubwiriza no kwigiisha.
Ntukiirengagize impaano y’Umwuka ikurimo, iyaguheerewe mu buhanuuzi ubwo abakuru baakurambikagaho ibiganza.
Ibyo uje ubishira mu bikorwa, kandi ubyiteho, kugira ngo boose bareebe iteerambere ryawe.
Wite ku myifatire yaawe no kubyo wiigiisha. Ukomeze kugenza utyo, kuko n’ubikora, uziikiza ubwawe, kandi ukize n’abandi bagutega amatwi.
Ntukabwire naabi umusaaza, ahuubwo uje uvugana na we nk’umubyeyi, naho abasore uje ubatwara nka beene so,
abakeecuru uje uvugana na bo nka ba nyoko, naho inkumi nka bashiki baawe, kandi byose ubikorane umutima usukuuye.
Uzaaje wubaha abapfaakazi b’imburabure.

Ariko umupfaakazi aramutse afite abaana cangwa abuuzukuru, bagomba kubanza biigiishwa kwita ku muryango waabo, maze bakiituura ababyeyi baabo ineeza baabagiriye, kuko ibyo ari byo bishiimiisha Imaana.
Umupfakazi w’imburabure wiirwanaho, yiiringira Imaana. Agahora ayiiyambaza no kuyisenga amanywa na ni joro.
Naho umupfaakazi wiibeera mu kudamarara, aba apfuuye ahagaze.
Ibyo na byo uje ubibategeka, kugira ngo babe inyangamugayo.
Kandi umuntu aramutse atareebereye ab’umuryango we, na caane ab’urugo rwe, uwo aba asubiye inyuma mu byo kwizeera Kristo ndetse akaba arutwa n’utiizeera.
Umugore ugomba gushirwa ku rutonde rw’abapfaakazi, ni uwo utari haasi y’imyaka mirongo itandatu kandi akaba yari yarashingiwe ku mugabo umwe gusa.

Agomba kuba azwiho imirimo myiza, nko kurera abaana be neeza, kwakiira abashitsi mu rugo rwe, akaba yaraheereje abantu b’Imaana aciiye bugufi, agafasha imbabare, kandi agashiishikarira gukora ibikorwa byiza mu buryo bwose.
Abapfaakazi bakiri bato ntimuzaabashire ku rutonde, kuko iyo irari ryabo ribateeye kureka Kristo, bumva bashaaka kongera gushingirwa,
maze bagashirwaho urubanza rwo kwica amaseezerano yaabo ya mbere.
Byongeye kandi, biiga kuba imburamukoro, bakazereera imihana. Uretse kuba imburamukoro, baba abanyamazimwe no kwiteerera mu bitabafasheho, bakavuga ibidakwiriye.
Ni co gituma nshaaka ko abapfaakazi bato baashingirwa, bakabyara abaana, bakareeberera amago yaabo, kugira ngo badaha abanzi baacu urwitwazo rwo kudusebya.
Koko reero hari bamwe mu bapfaakazi bato baamaze guteeshuka bagakurikira Sataani.
Niiba hari umugore wizeera ufite umuvandimwe w’umupfaakazi, agomba kumufasha, kugira ngo yorohereze itoorero na ryo ribone uko ryafasha abo bapfaakazi b’imburabure.
Abakuru b’itoorero bayobora neeza, na caane abo baamamaza ijambo ry’Imaana no kwigiisha bakwiriye guhaabwa icuubahiro gikwiriye,
kuko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Ntuugahambiire umunwa w’ikimasa mu gihe kivunga ingano." kandi ngo "Umukozi akwiriye uruhembo."
Ntuugapfe kwemera ibyo barega umukuru w’umuryango, keretse abaaye ashinjwa n’abantu babiri cangwa batatu.
Kuri abo bakomeje gukora ibyaha, uje ubahanira imbere y’abandi boose, kugira ngo na bo batiinye.
Ndakwihanangiriza imbere y’Imaana na Kristo Yesu n’abaamalayika baatooranyijwe, kugira ngo ukurikize aya mabwiriza utagira aho ubogamiye, cangwa ngo ugire uwo ubeera mu byo ukora.
Ntukiihuutire kwimika umuntu kuba umukozi w’Imaana, kandi ntukiivange mu byaha by’abandi, ahuubwo wowe ukomeze kwibeera intungaane.
Utazongera kunywa amaazi yoonyine, ahuubwo uje unywa na ka divaayi gake kubeera igifu caawe no guhora urwaragurika.
Ibyaha by’abantu bamwe biragaragara maze bikababanziriza imbere bataraaciirwa urubanza, naho ibyaha by’abandi bigaragara nyuma.
Na ni ko n’imirimo myiza igaragara, kandi iramutse itagaragaye, ntishobora kuguma ihishwe.
Abo boose bari ku ngoyi y’ububaata bagomba kwemera ko ba sheebuja bakwiriye icuubahiro coose, kugira ngo hatagira uvuga naabi Imaana n’inyigiisho zaacu.

Abo bafite ba sheebuja biizeera Kristo ntibakabasuuzugure biitwaje ko ari abavandimwe baabo muri Kristo, ahuubwo bagomba kurushaho kubaheereza, kuko abungukira muri iyo mirimo ari abiizeera nk’abo n’abakundwa. Dore ibyo ugomba kwigiisha kandi ukaamamaza.
Uziigiisha ibitandukanye kandi ntiyemere amagambo ashitse y’Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo n’inyigiisho zuubahiisha Imaana,
uwo aba ari umwiraasi, kandi utagira ico azi, agakunda impaka z’urudaca n’uruyombo. Ibyo ni byo bivamo ishari, intonganya, gutukana, gukeekanaho ibibi,
n’impaka z’urudaca ziteerwa n’abantu boonoonekaye ubwenge, batakimenya ukuri, bagateekereza yuuko kuba umukristo byabaviiramo inyungu.
Ni koko reero, kuba umukristo birimo inyungu nyinshi, na caane iyo umuntu anyuzwe n’ibyo afite.
Erega ntaaco twazanye mu isi, kandi nta co tuzaayivaanamo.
Noone reero, igihe dufite ibyokurya n’ibyo kwambara, tugomba kunyurwa na byo.
Ariko abo bashaaka kuba abatunzi, bagwa mu mutego maze bagashukwa n’irari, rigatuma barimbuka.
Kuko gukunda isente ni yo nkomooko y’ibibi byose. Abantu bamwe baararikiye ubutunzi, barayoba, ntibongera kwizeera Imaana maze bibaviiramo umubabaro mwinshi.
Ariko wowe muntu w’Imaana, ibyo uje ubyirinda. Uje uharanira ubutungaane, kuubaha Imaana, kwizeera, urukundo, kwihangaana, n’ubwitonzi.
Uje urwana intambara nziiza yo kwizeera, maze wironkere ubugingo buhoraho, ubwo wahamagariwe nk’uko wabyiyemeje igihe wahamyaga ukwemera kwawe mu ruhame rwa benshi.
Imbere y’Imaana iha byose ubugingo n’imbere ya Kristo Yesu wahamije ku mugaragaro ukwemera kwe imbere ya Pontiyo Pilato, ngutegetse
kuubahiriza itegeko utagira amakemwa n’umugayo kugeza aho Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo azaazira.
Igihe gikwiriye nikigera, Yesu Kristo azaagaragazwa n’Imaana ari yo ikwiriye ishimwe ikaba n’umutegeka weenyine kandi anari we Mwami w’abaami n’Umutware w’abatware.
Ni yo yoonyine idapfa, ikaba mu muco udahangarwa. Ntaamuntu wiigeze kuyibona kandi ntaawe waashobora kuyibona. Icuubahiro n’ubutware budashira bibe ibyayo. Amiina.
Utegeke abatunzi bo muri iki gihe kutiiraata, cangwa ngo bashire ibyiringiro byabo ku butunzi bushira vuba, ahuubwo biringire Imaana iduha ibintu byose mu bwinshi kugira ngo imitima yaacu yizihirwe.
Bagomba gukora neeza, bagakungahara mu bikorwa byiza, babe abanyabuntu, kandi biiteguuye gutanga ku byabo batiitangiiriye itama.
Bityo reero, bazaaba biizigamiye ubutunzi bw’urufatiro rwiza mu gihe kizaaza, kugira ngo babone uko baronka ubugingo nyakuri.
Timoteeyo, uje urinda ico waragijwe. Uje wiirinda amagambo adakwiriye kandi atagira umumaro n’impaka zo bamwe biibeesha bakiita ubumenyi,
kuko hari bamwe biivuga ko bafite ubwo bumenyi, bikaba byarabateeye kwitandukanya n’inzira yo kwizeera. Ubuntu bw’Imaana bubaane namwe.

name: 2 Timóteo
chapters: Njeewe Pawulo, intumwa ya Kristo Yesu nk’uko Imaana yabishaatse, ku bw’iseezerano ry’ubugingo bubonerwa muri Kristo Yesu,
kuri Timoteeyo, umwana wanje nkunda caane. Ubuntu, imbabazi, n’amahoro biva ku Maana Daata na Kristo Yesu Umwami waacu, bibe kuri wowe.
Ndashiima Imaana yo nkorera n’umutima ukeeye, nk’uko ba sogokuruza baabigenzaga. Mpora nkwibuka buri uko nsenga amanywa n’ijoro.
Iyo niibutse amarira yaawe, numva ngukumbuye nkiifuuza kukubona, kugira ngo ngire umuneezeero.
Niibuka ukwizeera kwawe kutaryarya, nk’uko nyogokuru Loyida, na nyoko Ewunike baari bafite, noone nkaba ntashidiikanya yuuko uko kwizeera kuri no muri wowe.
Ku bw’iyo mpamvu ndakwibutsa kubyutsa impaano y’Imaana ikurimo ngo yaake, yo wahaawe igihe nkurambikaho ibiganza.
Kuko Imaana ntiyaduhaaye Umwuka w’ubwoba, ahuubwo yaduhaaye Umwuka w’imbaraga n’urukundo no kwifata.
Ntukagire isoni zo kuba umuhamya w’Umwami waacu, cangwa ngo ugirire isoni, nje umusibe nzira Umwami Yesu. Ahuubwo wifatanye nanje mu kubabazwa ku bw’Ubutumwa Bwiza, ufashijwe n’imbaraga z’Imaana.
Yaradukijije, iduhamagarira kuba abaayo burundu, bidaturutse ku mirimo yaacu, ahuubwo ibiteewe n’umugambi waayo, n’ubuntu yatugiriye. Ubwo buntu yabuduheereye muri Kristo Yesu mbere y’ibihe byose,
ariko ubu bukaba bwaraduhishuuriwe igihe Umukiza waacu Yesu Kristo yigaragaje. Yatsinze imbaraga z’urupfu, maze agaragaza ubugingo no kudapfa akoreesheje Ubutumwa Bwiza.
Ubwo butumwa ni bwo nashiriweho kuba umubwiriza, intumwa n’umwigiisha.
Ni yo mpamvu ituma mbabazwa ntya. Ariko ntibinteera isoni, kuko nzi uwo niiringira, kandi sinshidiikanya yuuko ashoboye kurinda ibyo yanshinze kugeza umunsi azaagarukira.
Uje ukomeza inyigiisho z’ukuri wanyumviyeho, bityo urangwe no kwizeera n’urukundo muri Kristo Yesu.
Uje urinda ibyiza waragijwe, ubifashijwemo n’Umwuka Weera utuura muri twe.
Uzi neeza yuuko abo muri Asiya boose banteereranye, ubariyemo Fugelo na Herumogene.
Nyagasani naagirire umuryango wa Onesifooro imbabazi, kuko yampuumurije kenshi, kandi ntaakorwe n’isoni kuko nari mu gihome.
Ubwo yageze i Rooma, yagize umwete wo kunshaaka kandi arambona.
Nyagasani amuhe kuzaabona imbabazi ku munsi wa nyuma! Kandi uzi neeza ibyo yankoreye muri Efeeso.
Noone reero mwana wanje, ukomerere mu buntu bubonerwa muri Kristo Yesu.
Kandi amagambo wumviise mvuga mubahamya benshi, uyamenyeeshe abantu biiringirwa kandi bazaashobora kubyigiisha abandi.
Uje ufatanya n’abandi kwihangaanira imibabaro, nk’umusirikare mwiza wa Kristo Yesu.
Ukora ubusirikare ahora ashaaka kuneezeeza sheebuja kandi ntiyivanga mu buzima bwa gituurage.
Umukinnyi wiiruka mu marushanwa, na we ntiyatsindira umudaari, keretse akurikije amategeko y’umukino.
Kandi umuhinzi wakoze umurimo ugaragara ni we ukwiriye kubanza yaganura ku byo yasaaruuye.
Uzirikane ibyo mvuga, kuko Nyagasani azaaguha kubimenya byose.
Uje wibuka Yesu Kristo ukomooka mu muryango wa Dawudi, akaba yarazuuwe mu baapfuuye, nk’uko Inkuru Nziiza niigiisha ibihamya.
Iyo Nkuru Nziiza ni yo mpoorwa, ngatootezwa, kugera ubwo mboheeshwa iminyururu nk’umugome. Nyamara, ijambo ry’Imaana ryo ntiribohwa.
Ni co gituma nihangaanira byose mbigirira abaatooranyijwe n’Imaana, kugira ngo na bo bashobore kuronka agakiza kaba muri Kristo Yesu, hamwe n’ikuzo rihoraho.
Iri jambo ni iryo kwizeerwa ngo: "Niiba twarapfanye na we, tuzaabaana na we.
Nidukomeza kwihangaana, naatwe tuzaategeka hamwe na we. Nitumwihakana, na we azaatwihakana.
Nuubwo twamuhemukira, we azaaguma ari intahemuka, kuko atabaasha kwivuguruza."
Uje wibutsa abantu bawe ibyo, kandi ubiihanangirize imbere y’Imaana ko bareka kurwanira amagambo kuko ari ntaakamaro bifite, ahuubwo ko bigirira naabi abayumva.
Uje ugira umwete wo kwishira imbere y’Imaana nk’ushimwa na yo, umukozi utagira icaamuteera isoni, ushobora gusobaanura neeza ijambo ry’ukuri.
Uje wirinda ibiganiiro bitagira umumaro, kuko amagambo nk’ayo atuma abantu bakomeza kugomera Imaana.
Inyigiisho nk’izo zimeze nk’igisebe c’umufunzo kirya umubiri. Abagabo biigiisha ibimeze bityo ni, Humenayo na Fileto.
Baataaye inzira y’ukuri bavuga ko izuuka ryarangije kubaho, maze ibyo bigatuma ukwizeera kwa bamwe guhungabana.

Nyamara urufatiro rw’Imaana rukomeye ntirwanyeganyezwa, kandi kuri rwo handitsweho aya magambo ngo, "Nyagasani azi abe," kandi ngo, "Umuntu weese wambaza izina rya Nyagasani agomba kurekeraho gukora ibibi."

Mu nzu ngari ntihabamo ibikoreesho by’izaahabu n’ifeeza byonyine ahuubwo habamo n’ibikozwe mu biti no mu ibumba, bimwe bigaharirwa gukoreeshwa ku minsi y’icuubahiro, naho ibindi bikagenerwa ku minsi isanzwe.
Umuntu weese reero wirinda gukora ibibi navuze, azaaba igikoreesho c’icuubahiro, gitunganyirijwe gukoreeshwa umurimo mwiza woose, kuko azaaba yeguriwe kandi ari ingirakamaro kuri nyir’inzu.
Uje wirinda irari rya gisore, ahuubwo ukurikirane ubutungaane, kwizeera, urukundo, n’amahoro, ufatanyije n’abambaza Imaana n’umutima ukeeye.
Wirinde impaka ziteerwa n’ubupfu hamwe n’ubujiji, kuko uzi neeza ko zivamo amahaane.
Nk’umugaragu wa Nyagasani, ntaabwo ugomba kuba umunyamahaane ahuubwo ugomba kuba umugwaneeza kuri boose, ukaba n’umwigiisha mwiza kandi wihangaana,
ukagorora abaguhakanya n’ubwitonzi. Imaana ishobora kubaha umugisha wo kwihana bakamenya ukuri,
bityo reero bagashobora kwisubiraho bakava mu mutego wa Sataani, wari warabagize imbohe akabakoreesha ico yishaakiye.
Ugomba kumenya yuuko mu minsi y’imperuuka hazaabaho ibihe bikomeye.
Hazaabaho abantu biikunda, abakunda isente, abiiraasi, abanyamaryo, abatukana, abatumvira ababyeyi baabo, intashiima, abatuubaha Imaana,
abadakunda abaabo, abagome batababarira abandi, ababeesherana, abahubuka, abanyarugomo, abadakunda ibyiza,
abagambanyi, ibyihebe, abuuzuye ubwibone, abakunda ibibaneezeeza aho gukunda Imaana,
abiitwara nk’abuubaha Imaana, ariko bagahinyura imbaraga zaayo. Abameze batyo uje ubiirengagiza.
Bamwe muri bo bakunda gusesera mu mago y’abandi bakiigaruriza abagore b’ibyomanzi, baaheranywe n’ibyaha maze bagatwarwa n’irari ry’uburyo bwose.
Abo bagore bahora bagerageza kwiga ibintu bisha ariko ntibashobore kumenya ukuri kw’Imaana.
Nk’uko Yanesi na Yambure baahakanyije Moose, ni na ko abo bantu barwanya ukuri. Bafite ubwenge bwonoonekaye no kwemera kudashitse.
Ariko ntaabwo bazaateera imbere caane, kuko ubupfu bwabo buzaagaragarira imbere ya boose, nk’uko byagendeye Yanesi na Yambure.
Ariko wowe Timoteeyo, wakurikije inyigiisho yanje, imyifatire yanje, n’ibyo ngamije gukora mu buzima bwanje. Wakurikije kwizeera kwanje, kwihangaana kwanje, urukundo rwanje, n’ubudacoogora bwanje.
Uzi kandi n’ukuntu natootejwe ndetse nkababarizwa mu bice bya Antiyokiya, Ikoniyo n’i Lisitura. Mbega ukuntu nihangaaniye gutootezwa! Nyamara ibyo byose ni Nyagasani wabinkijije.
Ni koko, abashaaka guhora baramya Imaana bari muri Kristo Yesu boose, bazaatootezwa.
Naho abagiranaabi n’indyarya bazaarushaho kuba babi, bayobya abandi kandi na bo abandi babayobya.
Ariko wowe Timoteeyo, ukomerere mu kuri wiigiishijwe kandi ko wemeye udashidiikanya. Uzi neeza uwakwigiishije,
kandi uzi yuuko kuva mu buto bwawe wamenye ibyanditswe byera bishobora kukumenyeesha ubwenge bwakuyobora ku gakiza kabonerwa mu kwizeera Kristo Yesu.
Ibyanditswe byera byose byahuumeetswe n’Imaana kandi bifite umumaro wo kwigiisha ukuri, kwamagana inyigiisho mbi, kugorora umuntu no kumutooza gutungaanira Imaana,
kugira ngo ukorera Imaana weese abe ashitse kandi afite ibimukwiriye mu gukora imirimo myiza yoose.
Ndakwihanangirije imbere y’Imaana na Kristo Yesu, uzaagaruka gutegeka nk’Umwami maze agaciira abazima n’abaapfuuye imanza,
amamaza ijambo ry’Imaana, ukomeze kuryigiisha mu gihe ciiza no mu gihe gikomeye, uje wereka abantu inshobe zaabo kandi wamagane ibyaha byabo, ariko ubahuuguure kandi ubiigiishe ufite kwihangaana.
Kuko igihe kizaaza aho abantu baziima amatwi inyigiisho zishitse, ahuubwo bakurikize ibyifuuzo byabo maze biishaakire abiigiisha benshi bazaababwira ibyo bashaaka kumva.
Bazaaja biica amatwi ngo batumva ukuri, ahuubwo bakurikize inyigiisho zitagira ishingiro.
Ariko wowe, uje uba maaso buri gihe, wihangaanire kubabazwa, ukore umurimo w’ivugabutumwa, maze urangize umurimo washinzwe n’Imaana.
Naho njeewe, igihe c’ubuzima bwanje gutaaha kirasohoye, ubwo ubuzima bwanje bugiiye gutangwa nk’igitambo.
Narwanye intambara nziiza, irushanwa nagombaga kwiruka nararirangije, kandi narinze ukwizeera.
Ahasigaye, mbikiwe ikamba ryateguuriwe intungaane, iryo Nyagasani, umucaamanza utabeera azampa uwo munsi. Si nje azaariha njenyine, ahuubwo azaariha n’abo boose bategereje ukwigaragaza kwe.
Ugerageze kungeraho vuba.
Demasi yarantaaye aja i Teesalonike kuko yakunze iby’isi ya noone. Kiresikesi na we yagiiye i Galatiya, Tito aja i Dalumatiya.
Luka ni we wenyine ukiri kumwe nanje. Ushaake Mariko maze umunzanire kuko amfitiye akamaro mu murimo wanje.
Tushiko namwohereje muri Efeeso.
Nuuza, uzanzanire umwiteero nasize i Turowadi kwa Karupo hamwe n’ibitabo, caane caane ibikozwe mu ruhu.
Alekizanda, umucuzi w’imiringa yankoreye naabi caane. Nyagasani azaamuhanire ibikwiranye n’ibyo yakoze.
Naawe ugomba kumwirinda kuko yarwanyije caane ibyo twigiishaga.
Ubwo niireguuraga mu rukiiko ubwa mbere, nta muntu n’umwe wanshigikiye, ahuubwo boose baaranteereranye. Imaana ntiikabibaryoze!
Ariko Nyagasani yambaaye haafi, maze arankomeza, kugira ngo nshobore kwamamaza Ubutumwa Bwiza maze n’Abanyamahanga boose babwumve. Nuuko ankuura mu kanwa k’intare.
Nyagasani azankiza ikibi coose kandi andinde kugeza mu Bwami bwe bwo mu ijuru. Icuubahiro kibe ice, iteeka ryose, Amiina.
Untaahirize Purisikila na Akwila, n’ab’urugo rwa Onesiforo.
Erasito yasigaye i Korinto, naho Tirofimo namusize i Mileto arwaye.
Uzaagerageze kuuza mbere y’igihe c’imbeho. Ewubulo hamwe na Pudensi na Lino na Kilawudiya n’abandi bakristo ba hano i Rooma baragutaasha.
Nyagasani abaane naawe. Ubuntu bw’Imaana bubaane namwe, Amiina.

name: Tito
chapters: Njeewe Pawulo, umugaragu w’Imaana n’intumwa ya Yesu Kristo, watooranyijwe kandi agatumwa gufasha intoore z’Imaana mu kwizeera no kuzimenyeesha ubwenge bw’ukuri buhuuje no kuubaha Imaana.
Uko kuri gutanga ibyiringiro by’ubugingo buhoraho, ubwo Imaana itabeesha yaseezeranyije uheereye keera koose.
Kandi mu gihe yagennye, yaduhishuuriye ijambo ryayo ari bwo butumwa nahaawe kwamamaza mbitegetswe n’Imaana Umukiza waacu.
Ndakwandikiye Tito umwana wanje nyakuri nabyaye mu kwizeera dusangiye. Ubuntu n’amahoro biva ku Maana Daata wa twese, no kuri Yesu Kristo Umukiza waacu, bibaane naawe.
Impamvu yatumye ngusiga i Kureete ni ukugira ngo utungaanye ibyo nasize, kandi ngo utooranye abakuru b’itoorero kuva muri buri tawuni nkuru nk’uko nagutegetse.
Umukuru w’itoorero akwiriye kuba umuntu utagira umugayo, afite umugore umwe, afite abaana bizeera kandi batavugwaho ubukubaganyi cangwa kutumvira.
Kuko umwepisikopi ari we ushinzwe umurimo w’Imaana, akwiriye kutabaho umugayo, ntaabe umwiraasi cangwa afite uburaakari burenze, ntaabe umusinzi cangwa umunyamwaga kandi ntaabe umuntu ukunda isente.
Ahuubwo akwiriye kugira ubupfura mu kwakiira abaaza iwe, agakunda ibyiza, akwiriye kugira ibiteekerezo bizima, akaba intungaane n’umuyoboke ku Maana kandi akifata.
Akwiriye gukomeza inyigiisho zo kwizeerwa nk’uko ziigiishwa, kugira ngo abone uko ahuguuza abandi inyigiisho ziboneye kandi no gutsinda abahakana izo nyigiisho.
Kuko hariho benshi b’ibyigomeke, bavuga ibitagira umumaro kandi b’ababeeshi na caane abo biigiisha ko abiizeera bagomba gukurikiza umuhango w’Abayuuda wo gukebwa.
Abongaabo bakwiriye kubuzwa kwigiisha kuko bahubanganya imiryango myinshi igihe baba biigiisha ibiguuye kugira ngo babone inyungu mu bo biigiisha.
Umwe muri bo w’umuhanuuzi waabo yaravuze ati, "Abanyakureete ni ababeeshi, n’inyamaaswa zuuzuye ubugome, n’abanyanda nini b’abanyabute."
Ubwo buhamya ni ubw’ukuri. Ku bw’iyo mpamvu ukwiriye kubacaaha ukomeje kugira ngo bagire ukwizeera gushitse,
kandi beekongera kumva imigani y’ibinyoma y’Abayuuda n’amategeko y’abantu bateemera ukuri.
Kuri abo bantu bafite imitima itungaanye imbere y’Imaana, buri kintu ni ciiza, ariko abo banduye kandi batiizeera ntanakimwe kibatungaanira, kuko boonoonekaye ubwenge n’umutimanaama.
Bavuga ko baazi Imaana, ariko ibyo bakora bikabihakanya. Imaana yanga beene abo urunuuka. Kuko ntibayumvira kandi ntaakintu ciiza coose baakora.
Ariko wowe Tito uje wiigiisha ibikwiranye n’inyigiisho ishitse.
Uje wiigiisha abasaaza kwifata, kwiyubaha, kugira ibiteekerezo bizima, bashikamire mu kwizeera, no mu rukundo, no kwihangaana.
Ni co kimwe, abakeecuru na bo bagomba kwiyubaha bagatungaanira Imaana mu ngeso zaabo, biirinde amazimwe no gusinda. Ahuubwo baje biigiisha abandi ingeso nziiza,
kugira ngo batooze abagore bakiri bato gukunda abagabo baabo n’abaana baabo
kwifata, no kwirinda gusambana, bagakorera ingo zaabo, bakagira neeza, bakagandukira abagabo baabo kugira ngo badatukiisha ijambo ry’Imaana.
Abasore na bo uje ubashishikariza kuja biifata.
Wowe ubwawe, uje ubabeera ico kureeberaho ciiza mu byo ukora byose, mu kwigiisha kwawe uje uba inyangamugayo, ugire umwete,
wiigiishe amagambo y’ukuri adahinyuka kugira ngo abo bahakanya ibyo wiigiisha bamware babure ikibi batuvugaho.
Abagaragu na bo ubiigiishe kugandukira ba sheebuja no kubashiimiisha muri byose, biirinde kuja impaka,
no kwiba, ahuubwo bahore ari beeza kandi biringirwa, kugira ngo buubahiishe muri byose inyigiisho z’Imaana Umukiza waacu.
Kuko ubuntu bw’Imaana bumaze kugaragara, bukaazanira abantu boose agakiza.
Ubwo buntu butwigiisha kurekeraho kugomera Imaana, kudatwarwa n’irari ry’iby’isi, ahuubwo turangwe no kwifata, kuba mu butungaane, no kuubaha Imaana
mu gihe tugitegereje umunsi muhiire dufitiye ibyiringiro ubwo ikuzo ry’Imaana yaacu ikomeye kandi Umukiza waacu Yesu Kristo rizaagaragara.
Uwo ni we wadupfiiriye kugira ngo adukize gukiraanirwa koose kugira ngo tube ubwoko bwe bwejejwe kandi bushiishikariye gukora iciiza coose.
Ibyo ni byo ukwiriye kwigiisha abiizeera, ubahuguure, kandi ubahane nk’ufite ubushobozi bwose. Ntihakagire ugusuuzugura.
Uje wiibutsa abiizeera kugandukira abatware n’abafite ubushobozi, bakabumvira, no guhora biiteguuye gukora ikintu ciiza coose,
ntibagire uwo bavuga naabi kandi birinde gutongana, ahuubwo beerekane ubugwaneeza ku bantu boose.
Kuko naatwe keera twari ibigoryi, tutumvira, twarayobejwe, turi mu bubaata bw’irari ry’ibibi n’ibineezeeza, tugira itimwe n’ishari, twangwa kandi naatwe twangana.
Ariko igihe Imaana Umukiza waacu yagaragaje kugira neeza kwayo n’urukundo ifitiye abantu baayo,
yaradukijije, itabiteewe n’uko twakoze ibiyitungaaniye, ahuubwo yadukijije ibiteewe n’imbabazi zaayo, iduha kuvuuka ubwakabiri no guhindurwa basha n’Umwuka Weera.
Imaana yadusaakaajeho Umwuka Weera ikoreesheje Yesu Kristo Umukiza waacu,
Kugira ngo dutsindiishirizwe n’ubuntu bwayo, maze tube abaragwa bafite ibyiringiro byo kuzaabona ubugingo buhoraho.

Iryo jambo ni iryo kwizeerwa. Ndashaaka ko ukomeza gushimangira ibyo mu kwigiisha kwawe, kugira ngo abantu boose biizeera Imaana bashishikarire gukora ibyiza. Izi nyigiisho ni nziiza bihebuuje kandi zifitiye abantu boose akamaro.
Nyamara wirinde impaka zitagira umumaro n’ibyerekeye amaseekuruza, n’intonganya, n’imbuuranya zishingiye ku mategeko, kuko ntaaco bimaze kandi bikaba ari ubusa.
Nihagira umuntu uca ibice mu biizeera, maze wamwamagirira ubwa mbere n’ubwa kabiri ntiyumve, uzaatandukane na we.
Uzi neeza yuuko umuntu nk’uwo aba yarayobye, ni umunyabyaha kandi ibibi akora ni byo bimushinja.
Ninkoherereza Aritemasi cangwa Tukiko kugufasha, naawe uziihuutire kunsanga i Nikopoli kuko ari ho nahisemo kumarira igihe c’imbeho.
Zena umuhanga mu by’amategeko na Apolo uzaabafashe uko ushoboye mu rugendo rwabo kugira ngo batazaagira ico babura.
Kandi abiizeera Kristo bakwiriye gushiraho umwete bagakora imirimo myiza kugira ngo babone uko bakenuura abandi, bityo reero bareke kuba imburamumaro.
Abo turi kumwe boose baragutaasha. Naawe utaashe abadukunda boose dusangiye kwizeera. Ubuntu bw’Imaana bubaane namwe mwese.

name: Filemom
chapters: Njeewe Pawulo, washizwe mu gihome mpoorwa Yesu Kristo, na mwene Daata Timoteeyo, Turakwandikiye wowe Filimooni inshuti yaacu dukunda kandi uwo dufatanyije gukora umurimo wa Kristo,
na mushiki waacu Afiya, na Arukipo uwo dufatanyije urugamba, hamwe n’itoorero riteeranira mu rugo rwawe.
Tubiifuuriza ubuntu n’amahoro biva ku Maana Daata n’Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo.
Mwene Daata Filimooni, igihe coose nkwibuka mu masengeesho, mpora nshiima Imaana yanje
kuko numva bavuga urukundo ufitiye abantu b’Imaana boose n’ukuntu wiizeera Umwami Yesu.
Nkaba ngusengera ngo uko gusangira kwizeera kwawe kukubeere ukw’ingirakamaro kandi gutume urushaho kumenya iciiza coose kiri muri twe co duheeshwa no kuba muri Kristo.
Ni koko mwene Daata, naneejeejwe caane kandi nkomezwa n’urukundo rwawe, yuuko wahuumurije abantu b’Imaana.
Ku bw’ibyo reero, nakagutegetse nshize amanga nka mwene daata muri Kristo gushikiriza inshingano zaawe,
ariko ku bw’urukundo ngufitiye, mpisemo kugusaba nkwinginga. Njeewe Pawulo ibi mbikoze nk’umugabo mukuru kandi ubu nkaba ndi mu gihome nzira Kristo.
Ndakwingingira umwana wanje muri Kristo, Onesimaasi, uwo nabyaye mu mwuka ndi umusibe.
Mbere, nta kamaro yari agufitiye, ariko ubu adufitiye akamaro twembi.
Ndamukooherereje reero, umwakiire nk’inkoramutima yanje.
Nashaakaga kugumana nawe hano ngo ankorere mu mwanya waawe ndi mu gihome mpoorwa Ubutumwa Bwiza,
