ariko nahisemo kutagira ico nkora utabinyemereye, kugira ngo ineeza wagira uyigire ku gushaaka kwawe atari ku gahato.
Ahaari, icaatumye agutorokaho igihe gito ni ukugira ngo akugarukire muzaabane burundu,
atakiri imbaata ahuubwo aruta imbaata, ari umuvandimwe muri Kristo ukundwa. Njeeweho, ni ko amereye, naawe ni ko azaakumerera ndetse arusheho, ari ku by’umubiri cangwa kuri Nyagasani.
Nuuko reero niiba weemera ko dufatanyije umurimo, umwakiire nk’uko waakaanyakiriye.
Niiba hari uko yagushobereje, cangwa akaba hari ico yakunyaze, ube ari nje ubibaraho.
Njeewe Pawulo, mbyiyandikiye n’ukuboko kwanje: nzaabyishura. Sinarinkwiriye kukwibutsa yuuko wowe ubwawe uri umwenda wanje.
Nuuko reero mwene Daata, ndakwinginze weemere gusaba kwanje ku bwa Nyagasani, maze nka mwene Daata muri Kristo uhuumurize umutima.
Nkwandikiye niringiye yuuko uzanyumvira, nzi neeza yuuko uzaakora n’ibiruta ibyo mvuze.
Ikindi kandi, unteguurire igisenge c’abashitsi, mfite ibyiringiro ko amasengeesho yaanyu azaasubizwa bakandekura nkabagarukamo.
Epafura, uwo dusibwe hamwe turyora Yesu Kristo aragutaasha,
na Mariko, Arisitariko, Dema hamwe na Luka dusangiye umurimo, na bo baragutaasha.
Ubuntu bw’Umwami Yesu Kristo bube muri mwe. Amiina.

name: Hebreus
chapters: Keera Imaana yavuganye na ba sogokuruza kenshi kandi mu buryo bwinshi inyuriye mu bahanuuzi,
ariko muri iki gihe ca nyuma, yavuganye naatwe ibinyujije mu Mwana waayo wo yatooranyije kuba umuragwa w’ibintu byose kandi Imaana yaremye isi inyuriye muri we.

Ni we werekana kurabagirana kw’ikuzo ry’Imaana kandi akaba ari we shusho rigaragaza kubaho kw’Imaana ndetse no gukomereesha byose imbaraga z’ijambo rye. Amaze kurangiza inteego yo kubabarira ibyaha, yiicara mu ijuru iburyo bw’Imaana Ikomeye.
Umwana yashizwe heejuru kuruta abaamalayika nk’uko izina Imaana yamuhaaye riruta iryabo.
Kuko ntaan’umwe mu baamalayika Imaana yabwiye iti, "Uri Umwana wanje, uyu munsi mbaaye So." Cangwa iti, "Nzaamubeera Se, kandi na we ambeere Umwana."
Ariko igihe Imaana yari igiiye koohereza Umwana waayo w’imfura mu isi, yaravuze iti, "Abaamalayika b’Imaana boose bakwiriye kumuramya."
Ku byerekeye abaamalayika, Imaana yaravuze iti, "Igira abaamalayika baayo imiyaga, kandi abagaragu baayo ikabagira ibirimi by’umuriro."
Naho ibyerekeye ku Mwana, ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Ubwami bwawe Maana, buzaahoraho iteeka ryose. Uzaategekeesha abantu baawe ubutabeera.
Ukunda ibitungaanye ukanga ubugome. Ni yo mpamvu Imaana, ari yo Maana yaawe, yagutooranyije ikagusiiga amavuta y’umuneezeero w’icuubahiro co heejuru kiruta ico yahaaye bagenzi baawe."
Ibyanditswe birongera bikavuga ngo, "Nyagasani, mbere na mbere waremye isi kandi ukoreesha ibiganza byawe kurema ijuru.
Ibyo bizaashiraho ariko wowe uzaahoraho, byose bizaasaaza nk’imyambaro.
Uzaabizinga nk’umwiteero, kandi bizaahindurwa nk’imyambaro. Ariko wowe ntuuhinduka, kandi imyaka y’ubugingo bwawe ntiigira iherezo".
Ariko se ni nde mu baamalayika wo Imaana yabwiye iti, "Icara iburyo bwanje kugeza ubwo nzagira abanzi baawe nk’akabaaho ukandagizaho ibirenge"?
Mbese abaamalayika boose si imyuka ikora umurimo w’Imaana ikaba yaratumwe gufasha abagenewe guhaabwa agakiza?
Ni co gituma dukwiriye kurushaho kugira umwete wo kwita ku byo twumviise kugira ngo tutaaza kuyoba.
Kuko niiba ubutumwa bwamamajwe n’abaamalayika bwari ubw’ukuri kandi abo boose banze kubukurikiza bagahaabwa igihano gikwiriye,
noone se tuzaarokoka dute nitwirengagiza ako gakiza gahebuuje? Umwami Yesu ubwe ni we wabanje kwamamaza ako gakiza kandi abamwuviise baahamije yuuko ari ukuri.
Naho Imaana yo yongereye ubuhamya bwayo ku bwabo ikoreesheje ibimenyeetso n’ibitangaaza n’ibindi bikorwa bitangaaje bitari bimwe na bimwe hamwe n’impaano z’Umwuka Weera, izo itanga nk’uko ibishaatse.
Imaana ntiyahaaye abaamalayika kuba abategetsi b’isi izaaza, ari yo si tuvuga.
Ahuubwo mu byanditswe hari ahavuga ngo, "Maana mbese ni iki caatuma uzirikana ikiremwamuntu? Ikiremwamuntu gusa, mbese byatuma uciitaho?"
Waramuremye umushira haasi y’abaamalayika akaanya gato; wamwambitse ikamba ry’ikuzo n’icuubahiro,

kandi umugira umutegetsi w’ibintu byose. Bivuga ko Imaana yahaye ikiremwamuntu gutegeka ibintu byose, kimenyeesha ngo ntaanakimwe yasize. Ariko muri ibi bihe ntibiraagaragara ko byose bitegekwa na we.

Nyamara tubona Yesu, waciishijwe bugufi akaba haasi y’abaamalayika kumara igihe gito, ko ari we wambitswe ikuzo n’icuubahiro ku bw’umubabaro w’urupfu yanyuzemo kugira ngo ku bw’ubuntu bw’Imaana asogongerere abantu boose urupfu.

Byari bikwiriye ko Imaana ari yo dukeesha kurema ibintu byose kandi ikabibeeshaho, itungaanya Yesu imunyujije mu mubabaro kugira ngo igarure abaana baayo basangire ku ikuzo ryayo. Kuko Yesu ni we ugeza abantu ku gakiza.
Koko reero uweeza n’abeezwa boose basangiye Se. Ni co gituma Yesu adakorwa n’isoni kubiita beene Se
avuga ati, "Nzaamamaza izina ryawe kuri beene daata, nzagusingiriza hagati y’iteeraniro ryabo."
Kandi arongera ati, "Imaana ni yo nziringira." Kandi ati, "Dore ndi hano hamwe n’abaana Imaana yampaaye."
Ubwo reero abaana bahuuje umubiri n’amaraso, Yesu na we yahuuje byose na bo kugira ngo ku bw’urupfu ashobore kurimbura umwanzi Sataani ari we ufite ubutware bw’urupfu,
kandi muri ubwo buryo abohoore abo boose baahoze mu bubaata ubuzima bwabo bwose babiteewe no gutiinya urupfu.
Kuko bisobaanutse neeza ko Yesu ataaje gufasha abaamalayika, ahuubwo ko yaaje gufasha urubyaro rwa Aburahamu.
Ku bw’iyo mpamvu, yagombaga guhinduka akamera nka beene Se mu buryo bwose kugira ngo abe Umuheerezabitambo Mukuru w’imbabazi kandi indahemuka ku murimo w’Imaana ngo abe impongano y’ibyaha by’abantu.
Ubwo na we ubwe yabanje kugeragezwa no kubabazwa, ashobora gutabaara abo boose bageragezwa.
Nuuko reero bavandimwe, intungaane dufatanyije umuhamagaro uva ku Maana, muzirikane ko Yesu, Intumwa kandi Umuheerezabitambo Mukuru w’ibyo twizeera,
yari umwiringirwa ku Maana yamutooranyije nk’uko na Moose yari umwiringirwa mu nzu y’Imaana.
Nyamara Yesu akwiriye guhaabwa ikuzo kuruta Moose nk’uko umwubatsi abona icuubahiro kiruta ic’inzu ubwayo.
Kuko inzu yoose igira uwayubatse, ariko umwubatsi w’ibintu byose ni Imaana.
Moose yari umwiringirwa nk’umugaragu mu nzu y’Imaana yoose kugira ngo agaragaze ibyo Imaana yari kuzaavuga nyuma y’igihe.
Ariko Kristo we ni umwiringirwa nk’Umwana ushinzwe gutegeka inzu y' Imaana. Iyo nzu y’Imaana ni twe turamutse tugize ubutwari kandi tugakomerera mu byo twiringiye.
Nuuko reero nk’uko Umwuka Weera avuga, "Nimwumva ijwi ry’Imaana uyu munsi,
ntimwinangire imitima nk’uko baasogokuruza babigenjeje, bakangomera ubwo bangeragezaga bari mu butaayu.
Baasogokuruza baarangerageje, ni ko Imaana ivuga, nuubwo bari baaraboonye ibikorwa byanje kumara imyaka mirongo ine.
Ni co caatumye ngirira uburaakari ab’ico gihe nkavuga nti, ‘Imitima yaabo ihora iyoba, kandi ntibaraamenya imigenzereze yanje.’
Nuuko mu buraakari bwanje ndiirahira nti, ‘Ntibazinjira mu buruhuukiro bwanje.’ "
Nuuko reero bavandimwe, mwirinde kugira ngo hatagira umuntu n’umwe muri mwe ugira umutima mubi utiizeera, ukamuteera kwitandukanya n’Imaana nzima.
Ahuubwo mukomezanye buri munsi, igihe coose hakiri "uyu munsi" kugira ngo hatagira umuntu n’umwe muri mwe winangira umutima abiteewe n’uburiganya bw’icaaha.
Kuko twabaaye umwe na Kristo, niiba koko dukomerera mu byiringiro byacu bya mbere kugeza ku mperuuka.
Nk’uko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo: "Nimwumva ijwi ry’Imaana uyu munsi, ntimwinangire imitima nk’uko baasogokuruza baari bameze igihe baagomeye Imaana."
Noone se ubu ni ba nde bumviise ijwi ry’Imaana kandi bakarenga bakayigomera? Si abo boose baavuuye muri Igiputi bayobowe na Moose?
Ariko se ni ba nde Imaana yaraakariye kumara imyaka mirongo ine? Si abo baakoze ibyaha, imirambo yaabo igahera mu butaayu?
Kandi se ni ba nde Imaana yiirahiye ko batazinjira mu buruhuukiro bwayo, niiba atari abanze kuyumvira?
Noone reero tubona ko bataashoboye kwinjira muri bwo biteewe no kuteemera kwabo.
Nuuko reero, ubwo iseezerano ryo kwinjira mu buruhuukiro bw’Imaana rikiriho, tube maaso kugira ngo hatagira umuntu n’umwe muri mwe usangwa adashobora kurigeraho.
Koko naatwe Ubutumwa Bwiza bwatugezeho nk’uko na baasogokuruza baabwumviise, ariko nyamara ubutumwa bumviise ntaaco bwabamariye kuko bataabwakiiranye umutima wiizeeye hamwe n’abaabwumviise.

Noone reero twebwe abiizeeye Kristo tuzinjira muri ubwo buruhuukiro bwo Imaana yaduseezeranyije, nk’uko yavuze iti, "Ndahiranye uburaakari nti, ‘Ntibazinjira mu buruhuukiro nari kuzaabaha,’ " Ibyo Imaana yarabivuze nuubwo umurimo waayo wari wararangiye ikirema isi.
Kuko hari ibyanditswe byerekeye uwo munsi wa karindwi bivuga biti, "Imaana yaruhuutse imirimo yaayo yoose ku munsi wa karindwi."
Kandi nabwo ibyanditswe birongera biti, "Ntibazinjira mu buruhuukiro nari kuzaabaha."
Nooneho reero ubwo uburuhuukiro busigaye bukinguuriwe bamwe kugira ngo babwinjiremo, kandi abaakeera bumviise Ubutumwa Bwiza bakaba bataarabwinjiyemo ku bwo kutumvira,
Imaana yongera gushiraho undi munsi, ari wo "uyu munsi", ivugira mu kanwa ka Dawudi hashize igihe kireekire, muri aya magambo iti, "Uyu munsi, nimwumva ijwi ry’Imaana, ntimwinangire imitima."
Kuko iyo Yosuwa aba yarabaashije kubageza mu buruhuukiro, Imaana ntiyajaga kuvuga iby’undi munsi w’uburuhuukiro haanyuma.
Nuuko reero, Isaabato ari bwo buruhuukiro, iracaabiikiwe abantu b’Imaana.
Kuko abo binjira mu buruhuukiro bw’Imaana, ni abo baba baaruhuutse imirimo yaabo nk’uko Imaana yaruhuutse iyaayo.
Nuuko reero ni tugire umwete wo kwinjira muri ubwo buruhuukiro, kugira ngo hatagira umuntu ugwa akurikije iciitegererezo ca ba bandi co kutumvira.

Ni koko Ijambo ry’Imaana ni rizima kandi rifite imbaraga, rityaye kurusha inkoota ifite impande ebyiri. Rihinguranya mu muntu rikagera mu mahuuriro y’ubuzima n’umwuka, no ku y’ingingo n’umushokoora. Rishoboye kugenzuura ibyo umutima wiibwira n’ibyo ugambiiriye.
Kandi ntaacaaremwe gihishwe imbere y’Imaana, ahuubwo byose biratwikuruwe nk’ibyambaye ubusa imbere y’uwo tuzaatangaho umwanzuro w’ibyo twakoze.
Nuuko reero ubwo dufite Umuheerezabitambo Mukuru ukomeye wagiiye mu ijuru, ari we Yesu Umwana w’Imaana, dukomeze ibyo twizeera kandi twatura.
Kuko dufite Umuheerezabitambo Mukuru utananirwa kubabarana naatwe mu ntege nke zaacu, ndetse yageragejwe mu buryo bwose nkaatwe kandi we ari ntaacaaha yakoze.
Nuuko reero twegeere intebe y’ubuntu dushize amanga kugira ngo dushobore kwakiira imbabazi kandi tubone ubuntu bwo kudufasha mu gihe gikwiriye.
Umuheerezabitambo Mukuru weese atooranywa mu bantu, kandi agashirwaho guhagararira abantu imbere y’Imaana, umurimo we ukaba gutuura amatuuro no gutamba ibitambo by’ibyaha byabo.
Ubwo na we ari umunyantegenke muri byinshi, ashobora kwihangaanira abakora ibyaha ku bwo kudasobaanukirwa hamwe n’abaayobye.
Kandi ku bw’iyo mpamvu, na we agomba gutamba ibitambo by’ibyaha bye hamwe n’iby’abandi.
Ntaamuntu washobora kwiha ico cuubahiro co kuba Umuheerezabitambo Mukuru ahuubwo agihaabwa n’Imaana ari yo imuhamagaye nk’uko byagenze kuri Arooni.
Ni ko na Kristo atiihaaye ico cuubahiro co kuba Umuheerezabitambo Mukuru, ahuubwo yatooranyijwe n’Imaana yamubwiye iti, "Uri Umwana wanje, uyu munsi mbaaye So."
Kandi nk’uko yavuze n’ahandi iti, "Uri Umuheerezabitambo Mukuru iteeka ryose nka Melikisedeki."
Iminsi yoose Yesu yamaze ku isi yasengaga yinginga kandi afite ishavu n’amarira menshi, atakambira Imaana, yo ifite ubushobozi bwo kumukiza urupfu, maze iramwumva kuko yayiiyeguriye.
Nuubwo yari Umwana w’Imaana, imibabaro yanyuzemo yamwigiishije kumvira.
Kandi amaze gutunganywa rwose, yabaaye isooko y’agakiza k’iteeka ryose kagenewe abo boose bamwumvira,
nuuko Imaana ni ko kumugira Umuheerezabitambo Mukuru wo mu buryo bwa Melikisedeki.
Kubyerekeye iby’Umuheerezabitambo Mukuru, dufite byinshi byo kuvuga bikomeye gusobaanura kubeera yuuko mutinda gusobaanukirwa.
Kandi nuubwo mwari mukwiriye kuba muri abiigiisha, mukeneye umuntu wo kongera kubiigiisha ibyerekeye ingingo z’ibanze z’ubutumwa bw’Imaana. Mwifuuza amata atari ibyokurya bikomeye,
kuko umuntu weese ubeeshejweho n’amata aba akiri uruhinja, aba ataraasobaanukirwa gutandukanya ikibi n’iciiza.
Naho ibyokurya bikomeye ni iby’abantu bakuze, baamaze gutoozwa bakamenya gutandukanya ikibi n’iciiza.

Nuuko reero, mureke dukomeze guteera imbere mu nyigiisho zikwiriye abakuze kandi tureke guhora ku nyigiisho za mbere zeerekeye Kristo, ntidukwiriye kwirirwa twongera gusubiramo inyigiisho zeerekeye kwihana ibikorwa bibi no kwizeera Imaana,
inyigiisho zeerekeye umubatizo no kurambikwaho ibiganza, kuzuuka kw’abaapfuuye n’urubanza rw’iteeka.
Kandi ni ko tugiiye kubigenza Imaana ibaaye ibitwemereye.
Kuko bidashoboka yuuko twakongera kugarura abo bantu ngo biihane, abaari baaramaze kumurikirwa n’umuco, bagasogongera ku mpaano iva mu ijuru kandi bagahaabwa n’Umwuka Weera,
ndetse bakanasogongera no ku bwiza bw’ijambo ry’Imaana hamwe n’imbaraga z’igihe kizaaza,
haanyuma bagasubira inyuma. Bo ubwabo baba bongera gusubiza Umwana w’Imaana ku musaraba bakamukoza isoni kumugaragaro.
Iyo ubutaka bunyoye amaazi haanyuma bukabyarira ababuhinga imbuto z’ingirakamaro, Imaana iba ibuhaaye umugisha.
Naho iyo bumezemo amahwa n’amatovu, ntaaco buba bukimaze. Buba bushigaje kuvumwa kandi amaheerezo yaabwo ni ugutwikwa.
Nyamara nshuti dukunda, nuubwo tuvuga dutyo, dufite ibyiringiro tudashidiikanya yuuko ibyanyu bimeze neeza kurusha ibi kuko mukora ibikwiranye n’agakiza.
Kuko Imaana ntiirenganya, ntiyiibagirwa imirimo yaanyu n’urukundo mwerekanye ku bwayo, mufasha abantu baayo na n’ubu mukaba mukibafasha.
Ico twifuuza ni ukugira ngo buri muntu weese akomeze kugira uwo mwete kugeza ku mperuuka kugira ngo ibyo mwiringiye bibaashe gusohora,
kugira ngo mutaba abanebwe, ahuubwo mube nk’uko abiizeera Imaana biihangaana nyuma bikabaheesha umurage w’ibyo Imaana yabaseezeranyije.
Igihe Imaana yaseezeranyije Aburahamu iseezerano, yariirahiye ubwayo kuko itaari ifite uwundi uyisumba uwo yari kurahira,
irahira iti, "Ni ukuri nzaaguha umugisha kandi nzaagwiza abazaagukomookaho."
Kandi na ni ko byabaaye, Aburahamu yashikirijwe iseezerano ku bwo kwihangaana.
Ubusanzwe abantu barahira umuntu ubarusha gukomera kandi iyo ndahiro ikababeera icemezo co gukemura impaka ziri hagati yaabo.
Bityo reero, Imaana na yo yashaatse kurushaho kugaragariza abaragwa b’iseezerano ko imigambi yaayo ari impamo, ni co caatumye ahamya iseezerano akoreesheje indahiro,
kugira ngo mu bintu bibiri bidahinduka, byo Imaana idashobora kubeesha ngo yivuguruze, bidukomeze caane twebwe abamaze kubona ubuhungiro muri yo ngo tugere ku byiringiro tuzaahaabwa.
Ibyo byiringiro turabifite, ni byo nkingi y’ubugingo bwacu, ibyiringiro bihinguranya umwenda ukingiriza bikagera aheera caane
aho Yesu watubanjirije yinjiye amaze kuba Umuheerezabitambo Mukuru w’iteeka ryose mu buryo bwa Melikisedeki.

Melikisedeki uwo yari umwami w’i Salemu akaba n’umuheerezabitambo w’Imaana Isumbabyose. Ni we wahuuye na Aburahamu ubwo yatabaarukaga avuuye ku rugamba atsinze abaami bane n’ingabo zaabo nuuko amuha umugisha.

Kandi Aburahamu amuha kimwe ca cumi c’iminyago yatsindiye mu ntambara. Ica mbere izina Melikisedeki risobaanurwa ngo "Umwami Nyir’ubutungaane", kandi ko yari umwami w' i Salemu, izina rye ryamenyeeshaga "Umwami uzana amahoro."

Nta byanditswe bivuga kuri se cangwa nyina wa Melikisedeki, habe no ku giseekuruza, cangwa no ku kuvuuka kwe cangwa iheerezo ry’ubugingo bwe. Agereranywa n’Umwana w’Imaana, ahora ari umuheerezabitambo iteeka ryose.
Nuuko namwe nimwitegereze uburyo uwo muntu akomeye. Na sogokuruza Aburahamu yamuhaaye kimwe ca cumi c’ibyo yari yaanyaze mu ntambara.

Kandi abaakomootse kuri Leevi ari bo baahaawe umurimo w’ubuheerezabitambo, bafite itegeko ryo gusorooza kimwe ca cumi kuva mu bantu, ni ukuvuga beene waabo nuubwo na bo boose baakomootse kuri Aburahamu.
Ariko Melikisedeki utaarakomootse ku rubyaro rwa Leevi, yasorooje kimwe ca cumi kuva kuri Aburahamu, amuha n’umugisha kandi ari we wari warahaawe amaseezerano.
Ntaawe ushidiikanya ko uworoheje ahaabwa umugisha n’ukomeye.
Byongeye kandi, abaheerezabitambo basorooza kimwe ca cumi ni abantu bapfa, ariko Melikisedeki we arabasumba kuko ibyanditswe bihamya ko ahoraho.
Kandi ni ukuvuga ngo igihe Aburahamu yatanze kimwe ca cumi, Leevi, wo urabyaro ruhaabwa kimwe ca cumi rukomookaho, na we ubwe yaragitanze,
kuko Leevi yari ataraavuuka akiri mu mubiri wa seekuruza Aburahamu igihe yahuuye na Melikisedeki.

Niiba gutunganywa kwaraazanywe n’ubuheerezabitambo bw’Abaleevi ari yo nkomooko y’amategeko yahaawe Abiisirayeli, ntaakundi kwifuuza ko haboneka undi muheerezabitambo wo mu murongo wa Melikisedeki atari uwo mu murongo wa Arooni.
Kuko iyo habaayeho ihinduka mu buheerezabitambo, amategeko na yo aba akwiriye guhinduka.
Kandi Umwami waacu ari we uvugwaho ibi byose akomooka mu wundi muryango. Ntaawe muri uwo muryango wiigeze gukora umurimo w’ubuheerezabitambo.
Biraazwi neeza yuuko Umwami waacu yakomootse mu muryango wa Yuda kandi Moose ntiyiigeze avuga uyu muryango igihe yavugaga ku baheerezabitambo.
Ndetse birushaho kugaragara ubwo haabonetse undi Muheerezabitambo umeze nka Melikisedeki.
Yagizwe umuheerezabitambo atari ku bw’amategeko n’amabwiriza y’abantu, ahuubwo ni ku bw’imbaraga z’ubugingo butagira iheerezo.
Kuko ibyanditswe bibihamya ngo, "Uri umuheerezabitambo iteeka ryose, mu murongo wa Melikisedeki."
Nuuko reero, itegeko rya mbere ryakuuweho ku bw’imbaraga nke zaaryo, nta n’umumaro ryari rifite,
kuko amategeko ataagize ico atungaanya ahuubwo twahaawe ibindi byiringiro byiza ari byo biduheesha kwegeera Imaana.
Ibi byahamijwe n’indahiro, kuko abandi baagizwe abaheerezabitambo baahaawe uwo murimo nta ndahiro bakoze,
ariko Yesu we yabaaye umuheerezabitambo ku bw’indahiro ubwo Imaana yamubwiye ati, "Uhoraho ararahiye kandi ntaaziigera yiivuguruza, ‘Uri umuheerezabitambo iteeka ryose’."
Kandi Yesu ni we uhamya neeza yuuko iryo seezerano ari ryiza.
Byongeye kandi, umubare w’abaheerezabitambo ba mbere wari mwinshi kuko baabujijwe n’urupfu gukomezamo imirimo yaabo,
ariko Yesu, ari we ufite ubuheerezabitambo budashira, azaakomezamo umurimo we iteeka ryose.
Ni co gituma igihe coose afite ubushobozi bwo gukiza abeegeera Imaana banyuze muri we kuko ahora abeereyeho kubavuganira ku Maana.
Kuko byari bikwiriye ko tugira umuheerezabitambo mukuru umeze atyo, weera, utagira inenge, udahumanyijwe, witandukanyije n’abanyabyaha kandi yahaawe icuubahiro gihebuuje mu ijuru.

Ntaabwo agomba kubanza yatamba ibitambo byo guhongerera ibyaha bye buri munsi nk’uko abandi baheerezabitambo babigenza ngo abone no guhongerera ibyaha by’abandi bantu. Ibi yabikoze rimwe kandi biba iby’igihe coose igihe yiitanzeho igitambo ubwe.

Kuko itegeko rya Moose ryatooranyaga abanyantege nke kuba ari bo baba abaheerezabitambo bakuru naho iseezerano ry’Imaana ryakozwe n’indahiro ari ryo ryaje nyuma y’amategeko, ryatooranyije Umwana w’Imaana washiriweho kuba intungaane iteeka ryose.
Ingingo nkuru mu byo tuvuga ni iyi, dufite Umuheerezabitambo Mukuru, wiicaye iburyo bw’Intebe y’Ubwami ikomeye yo mu ijuru.
N’Umuheereza Mukuru ukorera aheera caane kandi no mu ihema nyakuri iryo Nyagasani yashizeho atari undi muntu weese urishizeho.
Kuko Umuheerezabitambo Mukuru weese atooranyirizwa guheereza amatuuro n’ibitambo. Ni yo mpamvu, bikwiriye ko uyu Muheerezabitambo Mukuru na we agira ico yaatuura.
Iyo aza kuba ari ku isi, ntaabwo yari kuba Umuheerezabitambo na hato, kuko hari abaheerezabitambo bagenewe gutuura amatuuro bakurikije amategeko.

Imirimo bakora ni ikigereranyo kigaragaza ibyo mu ijuru. Igihe Moose yari agiiye kurema ihema Imaana yaramubwiye iti, "Mu byo uri bukore byose, ureebe ngo ukurikije iciitegererezo weeretswe ku musozi."
Ariko Yesu ubu amaze guhaabwa ubuheereza buruta ubw’abandi baheerezabitambo, kuko ni we uduhuuza n’Imaana mu seezerano rihebuuje ryayo rishingiye ku maseezerano ahebuuje aruta aya keera.
Kuko iyo iseezerano rya mbere ritaaza kugira inenge, ntibyakabaaye ngombwa ko hashaakwa irindi rya kabiri.
Ariko Imaana igaya abantu baayo ibabwira iti, "Dore iminsi igiiye kuuza, ni ko Uhoraho avuga, ubwo nzaashiraho iseezerano risha n’inzu ya Isirayeli hamwe n’inzu ya Yuda.
Ntirizaaba nk’iryo naseezeranye na ba seekuruza umunsi nabafashe ukuboko nkabakuura mu gihugu ca Igiputi, kuko ntibaagumye mu iseezerano ryanje nuuko bigatuma ntabiitaho. Ni ko Uhoraho avuga.

Iri ni ryo seezerano nzaaseezerana n’inzu ya Isirayeli nyuma y’iyo minsi, ni ko Uhoraho avuga. Nzaashira amategeko yanje mu biteekerezo byabo, kandi nyandike ku mitima yaabo, kandi nzaaba Imaana yaabo na bo bazaaba abantu banje.
Kandi ntibaziigiishanya cangwa ngo babwirane bati, ‘Menya Uhoraho’ kuko boose bazaamenya, uheereye ku woroheje muri bo ukageza ku ukomeye.
Nzaabababarira ibicumuro byabo, ibyaha byabo sinzaabyibuka ukundi."
Ubwo Uhoraho yavuze iseezerano risha, ni ukuvuga ngo, iryambere ntirigikoreeshwa. Kandi ikitagikoreeshwa kiba gishaaje, kikaba ari ico kuvaho burundu.
Iseezerano rya mbere na ryo ryari rifite amabwiriza yo kuramya kandi n’aheera ho baasengera hano ku isi.
Kuko ihema ryaruubatswe, iryo hanze ryari ryitwa Aheera. Ni mwo haari igitereko c’itaara, imeeza hamwe n’imigaati yatuuwe Imaana.
Inyuma y’umwenda ukingiriza, haari ihema ryitwa Aheera caane.

Muri ryo haabagamo urutambiro rw’izaahabu rwo gucaaniraho imibavu hamwe n’isanduku y’iseezerano isiizwe izaahabu impande zoose. Iyo sanduku yabagamo inkongooro irimo manu, inkoni ya Arooni yari yarashibutseho amababi kandi n’ibisate by’amabuye bibiri byanditsweho amategeko y’iseezerano.
Heejuru y’iyo sanduku haariho amashusho y’abakerubi b’icuubahiro. Amababa yaabo yatwikiiraga intebe y’imbabazi. Icakora iki si co gihe co kuvuga ibi byose mu magambo arambuuye.
Ibyo iyo bimaze guteguurwa, abaheerezabitambo buri gihe baja mu ihema rya mbere gukora imihango yaabo,

ariko Umuheerezabitambo Mukuru wenyine ni we uja mu ihema rya kabiri kandi na we ajayo rimwe gusa mu mwaka. Kandi ntiyinjiragamo atajaanye amaraso yo kwitambira igitambo c’ibyaha bye hamwe no gutambira ibyaha by’abantu baakoze batabigennye.
Nooneho reero, Umwuka Weera atugaragariza neeza ko inzira ija Aheera h’Imaana itaraakingurwa igihe ihema ryo hanze rigihagaze.
Iki ni igishushaanyo kigaragaza ibihe turimo ubu. Ceerekana ko amatuuro n’ibitambo by’inyamaaswa bidashobora gutungaanya umutima w’umuntu uramya Imaana,
kuko bishingiye ku byokurya, n’ibyo kunywa kandi hamwe no ku mihango y’uburyo bwinshi yo guhumaanura. Ibi byose ni amategeko yo ku mubiri yashizweho kugeza igihe Imaana izaashiriraho uburyo busha.

Ariko Kristo amaze kuuza nk’Umuheerezabitambo Mukuru w’ibyiza bimaze kuuza, ihema ryo akoreramo riratangaaje kandi ntaanenge rifite. Ni ihema ritaakozwe n’intoki z’abantu, ni ukuvuga ngo si iryo muri ibi byaremwe byo mu isi.

Ubwo Kristo yinjiye mu ihema kandi akinjira Aheera caane rimwe rizima, ntiyajaanye amaraso y’ihene n’ibimasa ngo ayatambe mo nk’ibitambo, ahuubwo yajaanye amaraso ye bwite ngo abone kuducungura iteeka ryose.
Niiba amaraso y’ihene nay’ibimasa hamwe no kuminjagirwaho igitaazi c’inyana byashobora kweza umuntu wahumanyijwe kugira ngo umubiri we uhumaanuke,
mbese amaraso ya Kristo yo azaatweza bingana bite? Ku bw’Umwuka w’iteeka wiitanze nk’igitambo kitagira inenge ku Maana, akeeza imitimanaama yaacu kuva mu byaha kugira ngo dukorere Imaana nzima!

No ku bw’iyo mpamvu, Kristo ni we muhuuza w’iseezerano risha, kugira ngo abo baahamagawe babone guhaabwa umurage w’iteeka ryose waseezeranyijwe kuko haabaayeho urupfu rucungura abaacumuye mu gihe c’iseezerano rya mbere.
Iyo habaayeho kuraga, hakwiriye kugaragazwa ko uwaraze uwo murage yapfuuye,
kuko umurage ntaaco uba uvuze igihe nyakuwuraga akiri muzima. Ugira amakuru iyo nyakuraga amaze gupfa.
Ni co caatumye n’iseezerano rya mbere rigira amakuru kuko haari hamaze kumenwa amaraso.

Igihe Moose yari amaze kubwira Abiisirayeli amategeko yoose nk’uko ari, yafashe amaraso y’ibimasa n’ay’ihene ayavanganya n’amaazi nuuko ayaminjagira ku gitabo c’amategeko hamwe no ku bantu boose akoreesheje ubwoya bw’intaama butukura hamwe n’urubingo.
Aravuga ati, "Aya ni yo maraso y’iseezerano ayo Imaana yabategetse kuubahiriza."
Ni co kimwe, Moose yarongeye aminjagira amaraso kuri rya Hema Ryera hamwe no ku bintu byose bikoreeshwa mu kuramya.
Ni koko ukurikije amategeko, haafi ibintu byose byezwa n’amaraso kandi ibyaha bibabarirwa ari uko amaraso abanje kumenwa.
Ibyo bintu bivuzweho kandi ari byo bishushaanya ibyo mu ijuru nyaabyo, byari bikwiriye kwezwa muri ubwo buryo. Naho ibintu byo mu ijuru ubwabyo bikwiriye kwezwa n’ibitambo biruta ibyo.
Kuko Kristo atinjiye Aheera haakozwe n’amaboko y’abantu, ari ho hagaragazaga Aheera nyaaho ho mu ijuru. Ahuubwo yinjiye mu ijuru ubwaryo aho ubu aduhagarariye imbere y’Imaana.
Kandi ntiyinjiyemo ngo yiituure nk’igitambo inshuro nyinshi nk’uko umuheerezabitambo Mukuru yinjiraga Aheera Caane buri mwaka ajanye amaraso atari aye.

Kuko iyo biiza kuba bityo, aba yari akwiriye kubabazwa inshuro nyinshi uheereye ku kuremwa kw’isi. Ahuubwo ubu yabonetse rimwe rizima kumperuuka y’ibihe kugira ngo akuureho icaaha mu buryo bwo kwitamba.
Kandi nk’uko biri ko umuntu yagenewe gupfa rimwe haanyuma agaciirwa urubanza,
ni na ko Kristo, amaze gutambwa rimwe ngo akuureho ibyaha bya benshi azaaboneka ubwa kabiri, ataazanywe no gukuuraho ibyaha ahuubwo azanywe no gukiza abo bamutegereje n’ubwuzu.

Ubwo amategeko ari igishushaanyo gusa kigaragaza ibyiza bigiiye kuuza akaba ateerekana ukuri kw’ibintu nyaabyo, ni na ko atabaasha gutungaanya umuntu weegeera Imaana amutungaanyisha ibitambo bya buri gihe bitambwa buri mwaka.
Kuko mu by’ukuri iyo abantu baramya Imaana baba baaratungaanyijwe bakava mu byaha, ntibaakabaaye bumva bashinjwa n’icaaha ukundi, kandi ntaakundi gutamba ibitambo kwakongeye kubaho.
Ariko ibi bitambo bya buri mwaka biba ari ibyo kwibutsa abantu ibyaha byabo.
Kuko ntibishoboka yuuko amaraso y’ibimasa n’ay’ihene yaakuuraho ibyaha.
Ni yo mpamvu igihe Kristo yari agiiye kuuza mu isi yabwiye Imaana ati, "Ntiwanyuzwe n’ibitambo hamwe n’amatuuro, ariko wanteguuriye umubiri wo gutamba.
Ntuushiimiishwa n’inyamaaswa zootswa kugicaaniro cangwa ibitambo bikuuraho ibyaha.
Nuuko Kristo aravuga ati, ‘Dore ndaaje Maana, nzanywe no gukora ugushaaka kwawe, nk’uko byanyanditsweho mu gitabo c’amategeko.’ "
Igihe Kristo yavuze ati, "Ntiwanyuzwe cangwa ngo wishiimire ibitambo n’amatuuro, ibitambo byokejwe n’ibitambo byo gukuuraho ibyaha" ibi bitambwa nk’uko amategeko abitegeka,
yarongeye aravuga ati, "Dore ndaaje Maana, nzanywe no gukora ugushaaka kwawe." Ni ko Imaana yakuuyeho ibitambo bya keera ibisimbuuza igitambo ca Kristo.
Kuko ari ubushaake bw’Imaana kuba twareejejwe tubiheeshejwe n’uko umubiri wa Yesu Kristo watambwe rimwe kandi bikaba iby’iteeka ryose.
Buri muheerezabitambo ahora umunsi ku wundi akora uwo muhango wo gutamba ibitambo bidahinduka inshuro nyinshi ariko bitabaasha gukuuraho ibyaha.
Ariko igihe Kristo yari amaze gutamba igitambo kimwe c’iteeka ryose co gukuuraho ibyaha, yiicara iburyo bw’Imaana,
kandi kuva ico gihe aracaategereje kugeza ubwo Imaana izaashira abanzi be munsi y’ibirenge bye.
Kandi ku bw’igitambo kimwe, Kristo yeejeje abo baatunganyijwe kuva mu byaha iteeka ryose.
Kandi koko Umwuka Weera ni ko aduhamiriza, abanza kuvuga ati,
"Iri ni ryo seezerano nzaagirana na bo nyuma y’iyo minsi, ni ko Uhoraho avuga. Nzaashira amategeko yanje mu mitima yaabo, kandi nzaayandika mu biteekerezo byabo,"
Arongera aravuga ati, "Sinzongera kwibuka ibyaha byabo kandi n’ibikorwa byabo bibi sinzaabyibuka ukundi."
Bityo reero ahari ukubabarirwa ibyaha ntihaba hakiriho kongera gutamba ibitambo by’ibyaha.
Nuuko reero beene daata ubu dufite umudendeezo wo kwinjira Aheera caane ku bw’amaraso ya Yesu.
Yatwugururiye inzira nsha kandi y’ubugingo inyura mu mwenda ukingirije Aheera, ari wo mubiri we,
kandi dufite Umuheerezabitambo ukomeye ushinzwe Inzu y’Imaana.
Nuuko reero mureke twegeere Imaana dufite umutima w’ukuri no kwizeera guhamye, n’imitima yaacu isukuuwe itagira ico idushinja kandi n’imibiri yaacu na yo yuhagiwe n’amaazi asukuuwe.
Dukomeze kwatura ibyo twiringiye tutanyeganyega kuko uwaduseezeranyije ari umwizeerwa.
Kandi tuzirikane bagenzi baacu, duteerane umwete wo gukundana no kugira ibikorwa byiza.
Twe kwirengagiza guteeranira hamwe nk’uko bamwe baabigize akamenyeero ahuubwo turusheho gukomezanya nkuuko mubona umunsi w’Umwami wegeereje.
Kuko niiba dukomeza gukora ibyaha kandi twaramaze kumenya ukuri, ntaagitambo co gukuuraho ibyaha kiba gisigaye,
ahuubwo ikiba gisigaye n’ugutegerezanya ubwoba urubanza rugiiye kuuza hamwe n’umuriro ukaze uzaatsemba abahakanya Imaana.
Umuntu weese wiicaga itegeko rya Moose baaramwicaga ntakumugirira imbabazi igihe yabaga ashinjwe n’abahamya babiri cangwa batatu.

Noone se niiba byari bimeze bityo, bizaagendekera bite abo baasuuzuguye Umwana w’Imaana, bagateesha agaciiro amaraso y’iseezerano ry’Imaana yabatunganyije kuva mu byaha kandi bagatuka Umwuka utanga ubuntu! Mbese muteekereza ko igihano bazaahaabwa kitazaaba gikabije kuruta iby’abandi?
Kuko tuuzi uwavuze ati, "Guhoora ni ukwanje, ni nje uziituura." Kandi arongera aravuga ati, "Uhoraho ni we uzaaciira urubanza abantu be."
Biteeye ubwoba kugwa mu maboko y’Imaana nzima.
Mwibuke uko byari bibamereye mu gihe caashize. Muri iyo minsi ubwo umuco w’Imaana wari umaze kubaviira, mwarababajwe ariko murihangaana ntimwemera gutsindwa n’urwo rugamba.
Rimwe na rimwe mwaratukwaga kumugaragaro kandi mugatootezwa, ubundi mwahoraga mwiteguuye kwiyunga kuri abo baatootezwaga.

Mwasangiraga umubabaro n’imbohe kandi n’igihe ibyo mwari mufite byose byanyazwe, mwihangaaniye igihombo ndetse murabyishiimira kuko mwari muuzi yuuko mufite ubundi butunzi buruta ubwo kandi buzaahoraho iteeka ryose.
Nuuko reero ntimugacoogore kuvuga mushize amanga kuko ari byo bizaabaheesha ingororano ikomeye.
Mukwiriye kwihangaana kugira ngo nimumara gukora ubushaake bw’Imaana, muzaahaabwe ibyo mwaseezeranyijwe.
Kuko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Hasigaye akaanya gato, uwo ugiiye kuuza agasohora kandi ntaabwo azaatinda.
Umukiraanutsi azaabeeshwaho no kwizeera, ariko naasubira inyuma, ntaabwo nzamwishiimira."
Twe ntituri mu basubira inyuma bikabateera kurimbuka, ahuubwo turi muri abo bafite kwizeera kandi baakijijwe.
Kwizeera ni ukumenya neeza tudashidiikanya ko tuzaabona ibyo twiringiye kandi ni uguhamirizwa ko ibyo tutari twabona ari iby’ukuri.
Ni koko, kwizeera ni ko kwatumye, baasogokuruza bashimwa n’Imaana.
Ni ukwizeera gutuma dusobaanukirwa yuuko isi yaremwe n’ijambo ry’Imaana, bityo reero ibigaragara bikaba byarakozwe mu bintu bitagaragara.

Kwizeera ni ko kwatumye Abeeli atambira Imaana igitambo gishimiishije kuruta ica Kayini. Ku bw’uko kwizeera, Imaana yamwemeye nk’intungaane na yo ubwayo ishiima amatuuro ye. Abeeli n’ubwo yapfuuye ariko ku bwo kwizeera kwe, na n’ubu aracumviikana.

Kwizeera ni ko kwatumye Henoki ajanwa mu ijuru atanyuze mu rupfu kandi ntaamuntu wongeye kumubona kuko Imaana yari yamuzaamuuye. Ibyanditswe bivuga ko mbere yo kuzaamuurwa kwa Henoki, yari yaneejeeje Imaana.
Kandi ntaawaneezeeza Imaana adafite kwizeera, kuko umuntu weese weegeera Imaana akwiriye kwemera ko iriho kandi ko ihemba abayishaaka.

Kwizeera ni ko kwatumye Nowa yiita ku mabwiriza y’Imaana ku byerekeye ibyari bigiiye kuba nuubwo we yari ataraabibona. Nowa yuubahirije Imaana nuuko yuubaka inkuge yo we hamwe n’umuryango we baarokokeyemo. Ku bw’ibyo, isi yaciiriweho urubanza maze Nowa ahaabwa umurage wo kuba intungaane abiheeshejwe no kwizeera.
Kwizeera ni ko kwatumye Aburahamu yuubaha igihe Imaana yamuhamagaye kuja mu mwanya wo yari yaraseezeranyije kuzaamuha nk’umugabane. Nuuko Aburahamu aragenda ataazi iyo aja.
Ku bwo kwizeera, yatuuye mu gihugu Imaana yari yaramuseezeranyije nk’umusuhuuke. Yatuuye mu mahema nk’uko Isaaka na Yaakobo na bo baabigenjeje, ari na bo basangiye uwo mugabane w’iseezerano.
Kuko Aburahamu yari ategereje kuzaatuura mu tawuni nkuru yo Imaana yashushaanyije kandi yiiyubakiye, itawuni nkuru ifite imfatiro zikomeye.
Kwizeera ni ko kwatumye Aburahamu yitwa umubyeyi n’ubwo yari ashaaje kandi na Saara n’ubwo yari ingumba, yararenze igihe co kubyara. Yiizeeye Imaana, isohoza iseezerano ryayo.
N’ubwo Aburahamu yasaga nk’umukambwe wenda gupfa, muri we haakomootse urubyaro rwinshi rungana n’inyenyeeri zo mu kireere kandi rutabarika nk’umuseenyi wo ku nkengeero y’inyanja.

Abo boose baapfuuye bagifite kwizeera ntibaari baagahaawe ibyo Imaana yari yarabaseezeranyije ariko baabireebeye kure kandi barabyakiira ndetse bahamya ko ari abanyamahanga kandi abagenzi kuri iyi si.
Abavuga batyo, baba bagaragaza neeza ko bashaaka igihugu caabo bwite.
Ntibiigeze baguma guteekereza igihugu baari baaravuuyemo. Iyo baguma kugiteekereza, baba baraboonye uburyo bwo gusubirayo.
Ahuubwo biifuuzaga igihugu ciiza kiruta ico baari bavuuyemo ari co mu ijuru. No ku bw’ico, ntaabwo Imaana ikorwa n’isoni zo kwitwa Imaana yaabo kuko ni yo yabateguuriye itawuni bazaatuuramo.
Igihe Aburahamu yashizwe ku kigeragezo, kwizeera yari afite byatumye yeemera gutamba Isaaka. Nuubwo yari yarahaawe iseezerano, yari yiiteguuye gutamba umwana we w’ikinege
uwo Imaana yari yaramubwiye iti, "Kuri Isaaka ni ho urubyaro rwawe ruzaakwitirirwa."
Aburahamu yiizeeraga ko Imaana ishobora kuzuura uwapfuuye ikamugira muzima. Kandi koko ubigereranyije, Isaaka yagarurijwe Aburahamu nk’uzuutse.
Kwizeera ni ko kwatumye Isaaka aha Yaakobo na Esaawu umugisha w’ibihe bizaaza.
Kwizeera ni ko kwatumye Yaakobo ataraapfa aha buri muhungu wa Yozefu umugisha. Yabikoze yishingikirije ku nkoni ye kandi aramya Imaana.
Kwizeera ni ko kwatumye Yozefu avuga ibyo kuva muri Igiputi kw’Abisirayeli igihe yari agiiye gupfa kandi atanga n’amabwiriza yeerekeye uko bazaagenza umubiri we.
Kwizeera ni ko kwatumye ababyeyi ba Moose bamuhisha kumara ameezi atatu amaze kuvuuka. Baboonye ko umwana ari mwiza ntibatiinya kurenga ku tegeko ry’umwami.
Kwizeera ni ko kwatumye Moose yanga kwitwa umuhungu w’umukoobwa wa Faraawo igihe yari amaze gukura.
Yashimye kubabazwa hamwe n’abantu b’Imaana kuruta kuneezeerwa mu gukora icaaha by’igihe gito.
Yiiyumviishije ko kubabazwa by’agashinyaguro kubwa Kristo byari bifite agaciiro kuruta ubutunzi bwose bw’Abiigiputi kuko we yatumbiiraga ibihembo by’ibihe bizaaza.
Kwizeera ni ko kwatumye Moose ava muri Igiputi adatiinya uburaakari bw’umwami. Kuko yiihangaanye nk’aho areeba Imaana itagaragara bituma adasubira inyuma.

Kwizeera ni ko kwatumye Moose ashiraho kwizihiza Kunyurwaho kandi agategeka yuuko habaho kuminjagira amaraso ku nzuugi kugira ngo malayika ushinzwe kurimbura ataaza kwica abaana b’imfura bo mu b’Isirayeli.
Kwizeera ni ko kwatumye Abiisirayeli bashobora kwambuka Inyanja Itukura nk’abanyura ku butaka bwumuutse naho Abiigiputi bagerageje kuhanyura, bararohama.
Kwizeera ni ko kwatumye ibisiika by’i Yeriko biriduka ubwo Abiisirayeli babizengurutse kumara iminsi irindwi.
Kwizeera ni ko kwatumye Rahabu wari malaaya adapfiira mu bantu batuubahaga Imaana kuko yaakiiriye neeza intasi zo muri Isirayeli.
Mbese ikindi co naavuga ni iki? Ntaagihe gihaagije naabona co kuvuga ibya Gideyoni, Baraki, Samusoni, Yefuta, Dawudi, Samweli hamwe n’iby’abahanuuzi.
Ku bwo kwizeera, baarwanye intambara z’ibihugu kandi baratsinda. Baakoze ibitungaanye, baazanira abantu ubutabeera kandi bahaabwa ibyo Imaana yari yarabaseezeranyije. Baazibiranyije iminwa y’intare,
bazimya imiriro iteeye ubwoba, ntibiicwa n’inkoota. Baari bafite intege nke ariko babona imbaraga, baba intwari mu ntambara kandi batsinda ingabo z’abanyamahanga.

Ku bwo kwizeera, hari abagore baakiriye beene waabo baari baarapfuuye bakazuurwa bakongera guhaabwa ubugingo. Abandi banze kuba ab’umudendeezo baapfuuye batootezwa kugira ngo bazuurirwe kubona ubugingo burushaho kuba bwiza.
Bamwe barashinyagurirwa kandi barakubitwa naho abandi baaraboshwe bajanwa mu nzu y’imbohe.
Bamwe baateewe amabuye kugeza ku gupfa, baciibwamo kabiri, biiciishijwe inkoota. Bajanwa bambitswe impu z’intaama n’ihene, ntaaco bafite, bababazwa kandi batootezwa.
Ntibyari bikwiye ko baba mu isi! Baazereeraga nk’impunzi mu butayu no mu misozi bagatuura mu buvumo no mu myobo iri mu butaka.
Nuubwo aba boose Imaana yashimye kwizeera kwabo, baapfuuye bataraabona ibyo yabaseezeranyije,
kuko Imaana yari yaragambiiriye integuura iruta iyo twibwira. Umugambi waayo kwari ukugira ngo tuzaatungaanyirizwe hamwe na bo.

Naatwe reero, ubwo twitooroowe n’igicu c’abahamya bakomeye, mureke dushire iruhande ikituremeerereye coose hamwe n’icaaha coose gihora kitwiziringaho, kandi nimureke dusiganwe mu marushanwa twateganyirijwe dufite kwihangaana.

Dukomeze guhanga amaaso yaacu kuri Yesu uwo kwizeera kwacu gushingiyeho uheereye kuntangiro ukageza ku iheerezo. Yiihangaaniye umusaraba ku bw’umuneezeero yari abiikiwe, ntiyiita ku isoni byari kumuteera igihe yabambwaga ku musaraba, noone ubu yiicaye iburyo bw’Intebe y’Ubwami y’Imaana.
Muteekereze ibyo yanyuzemo, uko yababajwe, yangwa n’abanyabyaha kugira ngo mudaciika intege kandi mukananirwa.
Igihe murwanya icaaha, nti muba muraagera aho kwicwa.
Mbese mwibagiwe amagambo yo gukomeza ayo Imaana ibabwira nk’abaana baayo iti, "Mwana wanje, wumvirize igihe Uhoraho agucaaha, kandi ntuuciike intege igihe Uhoraho aguhana.
Kuko Uhoraho acaaha umuntu weese akunda, kandi agahana umuntu weese wo yeemera nk’umwana we."
Mwihangaanire kubabazwa ko mucamo kuko ari igihano kiva kuri Daata. Iyo mubabazwa, byerekana yuuko Imaana irikubafata nk’abaana baayo. Mbese hari umwana wiigeze kubaho ntaahanwe na se?
Iyo udahanwa n’Imaana nk’uko abandi baana bagenzwa, kimenyeesha yuuko uba utari umwana waayo nyakuri, ahuubwo uba uri ikibyarirano.
Ikindi kandi, niiba ba daata baatubyaye mu buryo bw’umubiri, baduhana kandi tukabuubaha, ntibikwiriye yuuko turushaho kuganduukira Imaana yatubyaye mu mwuka tukabaho?
Kuko ba daata baatubyaye mu mubiri baaduhannye kumara akaanya gato babona yuuko ari byo bikwiriye kuri bo, ariko Imaana iduhana ku bw’ubwiza bwacu kugira ngo dusangire ku kwera kwayo.
Igihe duhanwe, muri ako kaanya bigaragara ko tubabaye mumwanya wo kwishiima, ariko haanyuma abatoojwe muri ubwo buryo, bikabaviiramo umusaaruuro w’amahoro n’ubutungaane.
Nuuko reero nimushire heejuru amaboko yaanyu atentebutse kandi mwongere imbaraga amavi yaanyu aciitse intege.
Nimukomeze ku gendera mu nzira igororotse kugira ngo ibirenge byanyu byaremaye bitongera gucumbagira ahuubwo bikire.
Mugerageze kubaana n’abantu boose amahoro kandi no kwezwa kuko ntaamuntu uteejejwe uziigera areeba Uhoraho.
Mwirinde kugira ngo hatagira usubira inyuma akava mu buntu bw’Imaana. Ntihakagire umuntu uhinduka nk’igiti gikura kikeera imbuto zishaariira, kigateera akaaga ku bw’ubusabwe bwaco.
Ntihagire umuntu n’umwe uba umusambanyi cangwa ngo yange kuubaha Imaana nka Esawu waguraanye uburenganzira bwe bwo kuba umwana w’imfura isahaane imwe gusa y’ibyokurya.
Murabiizi ko haanyuma, igihe yashaatse kwakiira umugisha kuva kuri se, ntiyeemerewe kuko ntiyari agishoboye guhindura ibyakozwe nuubwo yawushaatse arira.

Mwe reero ntimuri nk’Abiisirayeli ba keera ngo mube mwegeereye wa musozi ubaasha gukorwaho n’intoki. Aho ni ho baabonaga umuriro ugurumana n’umwijima w’icuraburindi kandi bakumva n’umuyaga w’ishuheeri,
n’impanda zivuga hamwe n’ijwi ry’amagambo ateera abaaryumviise gusaba kutongera kumva irindi jambo,
kuko ntibaagashoboye kwihangaanira amategeko avuga ati, "Nihagira ufata kuri uyu musozi weese aziciishwa amabuye, naaho yaaba inyamaaswa, muzayigenze mutyo."
Uwo mwanya wari uteeye ubwoba ku buryo na Moose yavuze ati, "Ndigutitira kandi mfite ubwoba!"
Ahuubwo muuje ku Musozi wa Siyoni, itawuni nkuru y’Imaana nzima ari yo Yerusaalemu yo mu ijuru, hamwe n’iteeraniro ry’abaamalayika batabarika bari mu birori.
Muuje mu iteeraniro ry’umuneezeero ry’abaana b’imfura b’Imaana, abo amazina yaabo yanditswe mu ijuru. Muuje ku Maana, umucaamanza w’abantu boose kandi n’imyuka y’abakiraanutsi batungaanyijwe rwose.
Muuje kuri Yesu, umuhuuza w’Imaana n’abaagengwa b’iseezerano risha, mwegeereye amaraso yaminjagiwe aduseezeranya ibintu byiza byinshi kuruta amaraso ya Abeeli.
Nuuko reero mube maaso kandi ntimwicire amatwi uvuga. Kuko niiba abo banze kumva uwatanze ubutumwa bw’Imaana ku isi bataaraciikanyije, twebweho tuzaarokoka dute nitwanga kumvira uvugira mu ijuru.
Ico gihe ijwi ryayo ryatitije isi, ariko ubu yaseezeranyije ngo, "Ngiiye kongera kunyeganyeza isi, ariko si yo yoonyine gusa ahuubwo nzaanyeganyeza n’ijuru."
Ayo magambo ngo "Ngiiye kongera," yeerekana yuuko ibyaremwe bigiiye gutitizwa bigakuurwaho kugira ngo ibyo bitabaasha kunyeganyezwa bishobore kugumaho.
Noone reero, ubwo turi kwakiira Ubwami butabaasha kunyeganyezwa, mureke duheereze Imaana ishimwe. Tuyituure ineeza kandi tuyiramye uko ibikwiriye, tuyuubaha kandi tuyitiinya,
kuko Imaana yaacu ni nk’umuriro utwika.
Mukomeze gukundana urukundo rwa kivandimwe nk’abakristo.
Ntimwirengagize gucumbikira abashitsi, kuko mu gukora mutyo bamwe baakiira abaamalayika batabiizi.
Mwibuke abari mu bihome nk’aho namwe mwakabaaye muri na bo. Mwibuke n’abari gutootezwa nk’aho namwe mwakabaaye muri gutootezwa.
Abantu boose buubahe ugushingiranwa kandi uburiri bw’abashaakanye bwe kwanduzwa kuko Imaana izaaciira urubanza abasambanyi n’abaheeheesi.
Murinde ubuzima bwanyu mwe gukunda amashilingi kandi munyurwe n’ibyo mufite kuko Imaana yavuze iti, "Sinzaabasiga kandi sinzabateererana"
Ni co gituma tuvuga dushizamanga tuti, "Uhoraho ni we mufasha wanje, Sinzaatiinya. Mbese ni nde wagira ico antwara?"
Mwibuke abayobozi baanyu ba keera baababwirije ijambo ry’Imaana. Muzirikane uko babaayeho nuuko mukurikize urugero rwo kwizeera kwabo.
Yesu Kristo uko yari ari ejo n’uyu munsi ni ko ari kandi ni ko azaahora iteeka ryose.

Ntimugateeshwe inzira n’inyigiisho z’inzaaduka z’uburyo bwinshi ngo zibateeshe kuyoboka inzira nziiza. Kuko ni byiza ko umutima usubizwamo intege n’ubuntu bw’Imaana kuruta kuubahiriza amategeko yeerekeye ibyokurya kuko n’abo bayuubahiriza ntaaco yiigeze abafasha.
Dufite itambiro ryo abashinzwe kureeberera ihema badafite uburenganzira bwo kurya ku bitambirwa ho.
Kuko imibiri y’izo nyamaswa zo amaraso yaazo yazanwaga aheera azanywe n’Umuheerezabitambo Mukuru nk’ibitambo by’ibyaha, bitwikirwa hanze y’inkambi.
No ku bw’iyo mpamvu, na Yesu yapfiiriye hanze y’irembo ry’itawuni nkuru kugira ngo ashobore kweza ibyaha by’abantu akoreesheje amaraso ye bwite.
Nuuko reero dusohoke tuje hanze y’inkambi dusangire na we agashinyaguro.
Kuko nta tawuni nkuru yo dufite izaabaho igihe coose hano ku isi ariko dutegereje itawuni nkuru iteguuwe kuzaaza.
Nooneho reero dukomeze gutambira Imaana igitambo c’ishimwe muri Kristo, ari co mbuto z’iminwa yatura ko Kristo ari Umwami.
Ntimwirengagize gukora ibyiza kandi no gusangira ibyo mufite kuko ibitambo nk’ibyo bishiimiisha Imaana.

Mwubahe abayobozi baanyu kandi mubumvire kuko barinda imitima yaanyu ubudasinziira kandi bazaatanga umwanzuro w’uwo murimo bashinzwe. Nimubuubaha, bazaakora umurimo waabo baneezeerewe ariko nimutabikora, uwo murimo bazaawukora bababaye kandi bitume hatagira ico bibamarira.
Mukomeze kudusengera. Twizeera tudashidiikanya yuuko dufite umutimanaama waacu utaduciira urubanza kuko twifuuza guhora dukora ibikwiriye igihe coose.
Kandi ndabiihanangiriza ngo murusheho kunsengera kugira ngo Imaana ingarure iwaanyu vuba.
Nuuko Imaana y’amahoro yo yazuuye Umwami waacu Yesu, umushumba w’intaama ukomeye, ikamuvaana mu baapfuuye ku bw’amaraso y’iseezerano ry’iteeka ryose,
ibagwizemo ibyiza byose kugira ngo mushobore gukora ugushaaka kw’Imaana kandi igume gukorera muri twe ibiyishiimiisha inyuriye muri Yesu Kristo. Icuubahiro kibe ica Kristo iteeka ryose. Amiina.
Bavandimwe ndabinginga kugira ngo mwihangaanire ijambo ryanje ryo kubahuguura kuko mbandikiye muri make.
Ndashaaka yuuko mumenya ko mwene daata Timoteeyo yafunguuwe kandi nangeraho vuba, tuzaazana kubasuura.
Muramutse abayobozi boose hamwe n’abeera boose. Abo mu Italiya bari kubaramutsa.
Ubuntu bw’Imaana bubaane namwe mwese.

name: Tiago
chapters: Njeewe Yaakobo, umugaragu w’Imaana n’Umwami Yesu Kristo, ndabaramutsa mwebwe abantu b’Imaana bo mu bwoko cumi na bubiri bwa Isirayeli bataataaniye mu isi yoose.
Bavandimwe, nimuhuura n’ibibagerageza bitandukanye, muje muneezeerwa,
kuko muuzi neeza yuuko kugeragezwa ko kwizeera kwanyu guteera kwihangaana.
Kandi mureebe ngo kwihangaana kwanyu gukomejemo ubudacoogora, kugira ngo mukure mu by’umwuka mu bwuzuye mutabuzeho na gato.
Niiba muri mwe hari ukeneye ubuhanga, abusabe Imaana izaabumuha, kuko Imaana iha abantu boose ku buntu.
Ariko ni usenga, uje wiizeera udashidiikanya na gato kuko ushidiikanya ameze nk’umuvumba wo mu nyanja ujanwa n’umuyaga aho wiishaakiye.
Umuntu weese umeze atyo yeekwibwira ko hari ico Nyagasani azaamuha,
kuko umuntu weese ushidiikanya ntawamwiringira.
Uwiizeera Kristo weese w’umukene yiishiime igihe Imaana imushize heejuru,
kandi n’abatunzi biizeera Kristo biishiime igihe Imaana ibaciishije bugufi. Kuko ubutunzi bw’umukire buzaashira nk’uko ibimori byo mu murima bihunguka bigashiraho.

Iyo izuuba rirashe rifite ubushuhe bwinshi ryotsa ikimera, ubumori bwaco bugahunguka maze ubwiza bw’ico kimera bukabura. Uko ni ko umutunzi na we azaarinda apfa agishaakashaaka ubutunzi mu byo akora byose.
Hahiirwa umuntu wiihangaanira ibimugerageza, kuko naamara gutsinda ibyo bigeragezo azaahaabwa igihembo c’ubugingo buhoraho bwo Imaana yaseezeranyije abayikunda.
Umuntu niyooshwa agakora icaaha, ntaakavuge ati, "Imaana ni yo inyoheje," kuko Imaana idashobora kooshwa n’ikibi cangwa ngo igire uwo ishuka.
Ahuubwo umuntu ashukwa n’ibyo ararikira bikamukurura maze bikamuteera ibyifuuzo bibi,
maze iryo rari ryamara kuba ikirenga, rigateera umuntu gukora icaaha, nuuko ico caaha kikamuuzanira urupfu.
Bavandimwe nkunda, ntimukabeeshwe.
Ubupfura bwose hamwe n’impaano itungaanye bikomooka mu ijuru ku Maana yaremye umuco wo mu ijuru. Ni yo idahinduka cangwa ngo iteere umwijima biteewe n’impindahinduka.
Ku bw’ubushaake bwayo, yatubyaye ubwa kabiri ikoreesheje ijambo ryayo ry’ukuri, kugira ngo tubone umwanya wa mbere mu byaremwe byose.
Bavandimwe nkunda muzirikane ibi, umuntu weese aje yiihuutira kumva, ariko atinde kuvuga kandi atinde kuraakara.
Kuko umuntu uraakaye adakora ibitungaaniye Imaana.
Nuuko reero murekeraho gukora ikibi coose n’ubugome bwose. Muganduukire Imaana kandi mwemere ijambo ryabibwe mu mitima yaanyu kuko rifite imbaraga zo gukiza ubugingo bwanyu.
Ntimwibeeshe ngo mwumve iryo jambo gusa, ahuubwo murishire mu bikorwa.
Kuko uwumva ijambo ry’Imaana gusa ntaarishire mu bikorwa, ameze nk’umuntu wiireebera mu ndorerwamo.
Iyo amaze kwireeba, aragenda, uwo mwanya akiibagirwa uko asa.
Ariko umuntu weese uzirikana itegeko ritungaanye ari ryo ritanga umudendeezo, kandi akarikomeza, atari ukuryumva gusa akaryibagirwa, ahuubwo akarikurikiza, ni we uzaabona umugisha mu byo akora byose.
Niiba hari uwiibwira ko ari umunyeediini ariko ntaashobore kurinda ururimi rwe, aba yiibeesha kandi idiini rye rikaba ari ntaaco rimaze.
Idiini ritungaaniye Imaana kandi ritagira inenge ni ugufasha imfubyi n’abapfaakazi kandi no kwirinda kutanduzwa n’iby’isi.
Bavandimwe, nk’abantu biizeera Umwami Yesu Kristo ari we Nyirikuzo, ntimukwiriye kuvanguura murobaanura ku butoni.
Mbese umuntu wambaye imyambaro y’agaciiro kanini n’impeta y’izaahabu mu rutoki aje mu iteeraniro ryanyu, maze hakaaza n’umukene wambaye imyambaro y’ibishwangi,

nuuko reero amaaso mu kayahanga uwambaye imyambaro y’agaciiro kanini akaba ari we mwakiira muvuga muti, "Mwicare aha heeza," naho wa mukene wambaye imyambaro y’ibishwangi mukamubwira muti, "Weeho hagarara hariiya cangwa wiicare haasi."
Mukoze mutyo muba mwizanyemo amacaakubiri kandi mukaba abacaamanza bateekereza ibidakwiriye.
Nimwumve bavandimwe nkunda, Imaana yatooranyije abakene bo muri iyi si kugira ngo babe abatunzi mu kwizeera kandi babe abaragwa b’Ubwami Imaana yaseezeranyije abayikunda.
Ariko dore mwebwe musuuzugura abakene. Abakire si bo babakandamiza, bakabajaana imbere y’umucamanza?
Abakire si bo basebya izina ryiza rya Kristo mwitiriwe?
Nyamara niiba mukurikiza itegeko nk’uko byanditswe ngo, "Ukunde mugenzi waawe nk’uko wiikunda", muba mukoze neeza.
Ariko niiba murobaanura abantu ku butoni, muba mukoze icaaha kandi mugashinjwa n’itegeko ko mwaryishe.
Umuntu weese wuubahiriza amategeko yoose agateeshuka kuri rimwe aba ayiishe yoose.
Kuko uwavuze ati, "Ntuugasambane" ni we wavuze ati, "Ntuukiice." Niiba reero udasambana ariko ukiica na bwo uba wiishe amategeko yoose.
Muje muvuga kandi mukore nk’abantu baazi neeza ko Imaana izaabaciira urubanza ikurikije amategeko azanira abantu umudendeezo.
Kuko Imaana itazaagirira imbabazi umuntu weese utagirira abandi imbabazi. Ariko umuntu weese ugira imbabazi na we Imaana izaamugirira imbabazi ku munsi w’urubanza.
Bavandimwe, byamarira iki umuntu uvuga ko afite kwizeera kandi kutarangwa n’ibikorwa? Mbese uko kwizeera kwashobora kumukiza?
Niiba hari umuvandimwe udafite ico kwambara cangwa ico kurya gihaagije,
maze hakagira umwe muri mwe umubwira ati, "Genda amahoro, wambare ushuuhe, urye kandi uhaage." Ayo magambo aba amaze iki utamuhaaye ibyo akeneye?
Bityo reero, ukwizeera koonyine kudafite ibikorwa kuba gupfuuye.
Ariko umuntu ashobora kuvuga ati, "Wowe ufite ukwizeera naho njeewe mfite ibikorwa." Nyereka kwizeera kwawe kutagira ibikorwa, nanje nkwereke ibikorwa bigaragaza ukwizeera kwanje.
Mbese wemera ko hariho Imaana imwe rukumbi? Ni byiza rwose! Ariko n’abadayimooni barabyemera ndetse bagahinda umushitsi.
Wa mupfaapfa we, ntureeba ko kwizeera kutagira ibikorwa ari ntaaco kumaze?
Mbese sogokuruza Aburahamu ntiyatsindishirijwe n’ibikorwa ubwo yagiiye gutamba umwana we Isaaka ku gicaaniro?
Ntuureeba ko kwizeera kwe kwagendanaga n’ibikorwa bye, kandi kwizeera kwe kujuririjwe n’ibikorwa bye?
Kandi ibyanditswe byarasohoye ngo, "Aburahamu yiizeeye Imaana kandi ku bwo kwizeera kwe Imaana imwemera nk’intungaane," bityo reero, Aburahamu yitwa inshuti y’Imaana.
Murabona reero ko umuntu adatsindishirizwa no kwizeera byonyine ahuubwo ko atsindishirizwa n’ibikorwa bye.
Ni na ko byagendeye Rahabu wari indaya, yatsindishirijwe n’ibikorwa bye, ubwo yacumbikiye abagabo b’Abiisirayeli baari baaje gutata, akabafasha gutoroka, abanyujije mu yindi nzira.
Nuuko reero nk’uko umubiri udafite umwuka uba upfuuye, ni na ko kwizeera kutagira ibikorwa kuba gupfuuye.
Bavandimwe, si ngombwa ko benshi muri mwe baaba abiigiisha. Muuzi neeza yuuko twebwe abiigiisha tuzaaciirwa urubanza rukomeye ruruta urw’abandi.
Kuko twese dukora inshobe nyinshi. Ariko niiba hari umuntu udashobya mu byo avuga, uwo aba ari intungaane kandi yaashobora no kugenga umubiri we woose.
Iyo dushize icuuma co kuyobora ifaraashi mu kanwa kaayo kugira ngo itwumvire tuyijaane iyo dushaaka, dushobora no kuyobora umubiri waayo woose.
Dore n’ubwato bwo mu nyanja, n’ubwo ari bunini, butwarwa n’umuyaga uhuuha caane. Ingashi ntooya caane ni yo ibwerekeza aho umusare ashaaka ngo buje.
Ururimi na rwo ni ko ruri, ni agace gato k’umubiri ariko rukiiraatana ibikorwa bikomeye. Reeba ukuntu ishamba rinini ribamo ibiti byinshi ariko rigatwikwa n’akarimi gato k’umuriro.
Kandi koko ururimi rw’umuntu na rwo ni nk’umuriro, kandi n’isooko y’ibibi. Rwanduza umubiri woose n’ububi bwarwo. Rutwikiisha imibeereho yaacu yoose n’umuriro rurahura ikuzimu.
Abantu bashobora gutooza inyamaaswa n’ibiguruka, n’ibikururuka n’ibyo mu nyanja byose,
ariko ururimi rwo ntaamuntu washobora kurutegeka. Rwuzuye ububi budahwema n’uburozi bwica!
Ururimi ni rwo dukoreesha duhimbaaza Imaana Daata, kandi ni rwo tuvumiisha abantu baaremwe mu ishusho y’Imaana.
Amagambo yo guheesha umugisha n’amagambo yo kuvuma aturuka mu kanwa kamwe. Bavandimwe, ntibikwiriye kumera bityo.
Mbese amaazi meeza hamwe n’amaazi akereeta yaava mu mugezi umwe?
Bavandimwe, mbese igiti c’umutiini caakwera imbuto za elayo, cangwa umuzaabibu wakwera imbuto z’umutiini? Ni co kimwe isooko irimo umuunyu idashobora kuvamo amaazi meeza.
Mbese ni nde muri mwe w’umunyabwenge kandi w’umuhanga? Nabigaragaze mu byo akora mu kwiciisha bugufi, mu bugwaneeza kandi n’ubuhanga.
Ariko niiba mu mitima yaanyu huzuyemo ishari rikabije, no kwikunda, ntimukiiraate ngo mufite ubwenge kuko muba mwibeesha.
Ubwenge nk’ubwo ntibuva mu ijuru, ahuubwo ni ubw’isi, na kamere y’umuntu, ndetse na Sataani.
Iyo abantu bafite ishari no kwikunda, habaho imidugararo n’ibikorwa bibi by’uburyo bwose.

Ariko ubwenge buva mu ijuru ni ubuziranenge, ni ubw’amahoro, ni ubw’ineeza, bwemera kugirwa inaama, bwuzuye imbabazi, bwera imbuto z’ibikorwa byiza, ntibugira aho bubogamiye kandi ntibugira uburyarya.
Kandi iyo umunyamahoro aheesheje abandi amahoro, havamo umusaaruro wo gukiraanuka.
Mbese ibiteera intonganya n’intambara muri mwe ni ibiki? Aho ntibiterwa n’ibyifuuzo byo kwineezeeza bibarimo?
Murararikira, ariko ntimugire ico mubona bigatuma mwica. Mukararikira ibyo mudashobora kugeraho, bikabaazanira gutongana no kurwana. Ntibona ico mushaaka kuko mutagisaba Imaana.
Kandi n’iyo musabye ntaaco mubona kuko musaba mugamije ibyifuuzo bibi, mushaaka ibyo kuneezeeza irari ryanyu.
Yemwe bantu batiringirwa mwe, ntimuuzi yuuko gukunda iby’isi bituma uba umwanzi w’Imaana? Umuntu weese uhitamo gukunda ibineezeeza by’isi aba abaaye umwanzi w’Imaana.
Mbese muteekereza ko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Imaana yashizemo umwuka wuzuye kurarikiira," byandikiwe ubusa?
Ariko nuubwo bimeze bityo, Imaana irushaho kutugirira imbabazi. Ibyanditswe biravuga biti, "Imaana irwanya abiibone, ariko ikagirira ubuntu abiiciisha bugufi."
Nuuko reero, muganduukire Imaana, murwanye Sataani, na we azaabahunga.
Nimwegeere Imaana na yo izabeegeera. Nimusukuure ibiganza byanyu mwabanyabyaha mwe, mweze imitima yaanyu mwaryarya mwe.
Nimuganye, mushavure kandi murire. Amaseka yaanyu ahinduke amarira kandi n’umuneezeero waanyu uhinduke agahinda.
Nimwiciishe bugufi imbere ya Nyagasani ni bwo izaabashira heejuru.

Bavandimwe, ntimugasebanye. Umuntu weese usebya undi cangwa akamuciira urubanza aba asebya amategeko kandi aciiriye amategeko urubanza. Ariko nuuciira amategeko urubanza ntaabwo uba uyakurikije, ahuubwo uba wiigize umucaamanza.
Imaana yoonyine ni yo itanga amategeko kandi igaca n’imanza. Ni yo yoonyine ishobora gukiza kandi ikarimbura. Wowe wiibwira ko uri nde waaciira mugenzi waawe urubanza?
Nimwumve yemwe bantu bavuga muti, "Uyu munsi cangwa ejo, tuzaaja mu tawuni ruunaaka tumareyo umwaka, ducuruuze kandi tubone inyungu,"
nyamara mudateekereje uko ubuzima bwanyu buzaabaho ejo. Mumeze nk’igiho kigaragara umwanya muto kigaheerako kikaamuuka.
Ahuubwo mwari mukwiriye kuvuga muti, "Nyagasani naabikunda tuzaabaho dukore ibi na biriiya."
Ariko mwishira heejuru mwiraata. Nyamara ubwo bwiraasi ni bubi.
Nuuko reero umuntu uzi ico gukora gikwiriye maze ntaagikore, aba acumuye.
Nimwumve mwa bakire mwe, nimurire kandi muborooge kuko mugiiye kugira ibyago.
Ubutunzi bwanyu bwaraboze n’imyambaro yaanyu iriiwe n’ibiseesamuzinga.
Izaahabu hamwe n’ifeeza zaanyu ziriiwe n’ingese. Kandi gukereba kwazo ni ko kuzaabashinja, kurye imibiri yaanyu nk’umuriro. Mwabiikiye ubutunzi bwanyu iminsi y’imperuka.
Nimwumve! Ibihembo by’abakozi baasaaruuye imirima yaanyu mwarabibimye. Dore barataka caane, kandi Imaana Nyiringabo yumviise gutaka kwabo.
Mwatuuye muri iyi si mudamaraye, muriishiima, maze mukora ibyo mushaaka byose. Aho bigeze mumeze nk’ibimasa bibyibushe bitegereje kubaagwa.
Mwaciiriye intungaane urwo gupfa, ntizaabarwanya, muraziica.

Nuuko bavandimwe nkunda, mwihangaane kugeza aho Umwami Yesu azaazira. Nimureebe ukuntu umuhinzi yiihangaana ategereza imyaka yabibye mu butaka kugira ngo yeere. Ayitegereza yiihangaanye kugeza igihe izaabonera imvura y’urugaryi n’iy’itumba.
Namwe reero nimutegereze mwihangaanye, mukomeze kugira ibyiringiro kuko kuuza k’Umwami Yesu kwegeereje.
Bavandimwe, ntihagire uwiitotombera undi kugira ngo mudaciirwa urubanza. Dore umucaamanza ari bugufi.
Bakundwa, kubyerekeye kubabazwa no kwihangaana, reka abahanuuzi b’Imaana batubeere urugero kuri byo.
Abo twita abanyamahiirwe ni abo biihangaanye. Mwumviise ibyo kwihangaana kwa Yobu, kandi muuzi ibyo Nyagasani yamukoreye haanyuma. Kuko Uhoraho ni umunyambabazi kandi afite impuhwe nyinshi.

Ariko bavandimwe, ikiruta byose ni iki; ntimukarahire ijuru cangwa isi, cangwa n’indi ndahiro yoose, ahuubwo muje muvuga muti, "Yeego" niiba ari "Yeego" cangwa se, "Oya" niiba ari "Oya" kugira ngo mudaciirwaho iteeka.
Mbese hari ubabaye muri mwe? Ni asenge Imaana. Hariho uneezeerewe? Ni aririmbe indirimbo zo guhimbaza Imaana.
Muri mwe harimo urwaye? Ni ahamagaze abakuru b’itoorero bamusengere kandi bamusiige amavuta bakoreesheje ububaasha baahaawe na Nyagasani.
Kandi nibasengera umurwayi biizeeye, Nyagasani azaamukiza amuzaahuure. Nuubwo yaaba yarakoze ibyaha, Imaana izaabimubabarira.
Mwaturirane ibyaha byanyu kandi musabirane kugira ngo mukire. Isengeesho ry’umuntu w’intungaane rigira ububaasha, kandi Imaana irikoreesha umurimo waayo.
Dore Eliya yari umuntu nka twe, asenga n’umwete kugira ngo imvura itagwa, haanyuma koko imvura imara imyaka itatu n’ameezi atandatu itagwa.
Arongera asenga Imaana koohereza imvura, nuuko ijuru riguusha imvura ubutaka bwera imbuto zaabwo.
Bavandimwe, niiba hari umuntu muri mwe wayobye akava mu nzira y’ukuri, nuuko undi muntu akamuyobora akagaruka,
mukwiriye kumenya yuuko ugaruye umunyabyaha, akamukuura mu nzira yari yarayobeyemo, azaaba akijije ubugingo bw’uwo munyabyaha urupfu kandi atume ababarirwa ibyaha bye byose.

name: 1 Pedro
chapters: Njeewe Peetero, intumwa ya Yesu Kristo, ndabandikiye mwebwe abo Imaana yatooranyije, bari mu buhungiro baataataaniye mu bice bya Ponto, Galatiya, Kapadokiya, Asiya hamwe na Bituniya.
Imaana Daata yabatooranyije nk’uko yari yarabiteguuye kandi mwezwa n’Umwuka Weera kugira ngo mwumvire Yesu Kristo kandi mwezwe n’amaraso ye. Ubuntu n’amahoro bigwire muri mwe.
Nihasingizwe Imaana, ari we Se w’Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo! Ku bw’imbabazi zaayo nyinshi, yaduhaaye ubugingo busha ubwo yazuuye Kristo Yesu mu baapfuuye. Ubu nibwo butwuzuzamo ibyiringiro bizima,
kugira ngo tuzaabone imigisha idashobora kwangirika, kwandura cangwa gucucuka, iyo mwabiikiwe mu ijuru.
Kwizeera Imaana kwanyu gutuma murindwa n’ububaasha bwayo kugeza ubwo muzaabona agakiza kaateguuwe kuzaahishuurwa mu gihe c’imperuuka.
Nimwishiime ku bw’ibyo reero, n’ubwo byaba ngombwa ko ubu mubabazwa n’ibibagerageza umwanya muto.

Ibyo bigeragezo bigamije guhamya ko kwizeera kwanyu ari uk’ukuri. Ni izaahabu yangirika ikebereeshwa umuriro, ni na ko kwizeera kwanyu gusumbya izaahabu agaciiro kugomba kugeragezwa kugira ngo kurame. Nuuko muzaahaabwa ishimwe n’ikuzo, n’icuubahiro igihe Yesu Kristo azaagaragazwa.
Kristo we muramukunda n’ubwo mutaraamubona, kandi n’ubwo mutaamubona ubu, muramwizeera kandi mufite ibyishiimo bitarondooreka,
kuko muba mwakiira ibihembo byo kwizeera kwanyu, ari ko gakiza k’ubugingo bwanyu.
Ibyerekeye ako gakiza, ni byo abahanuuzi baagerageje gukurikirana no gucondooza maze bahanuura ibyerekeye ubuntu Imaana yari kuzaabagirira.

Baagerageje gucondooza ngo bamenye igihe bizaabeera n’uko bizaaba bimeze igihe Umwuka wa Kristo uri muri bo yabeeretse abahamiriza mbere y’igihe ababwira ibyo kubabazwa kwa Kristo n’ikuzo rye rihebuuje azaahaabwa nyuma yaho.

Imaana yahishuuriye abo bahanuuzi yuuko batiikorera ubwabo ahuubwo ko ari mwe bakorera. Ibyo ni byo mumaze kubwirwa n’abaababwirije Inkuru nziiza bayobowe n’Umwuka Weera uva mu ijuru. Ibi ni byo abaamalayika na bo biifuuza kumenya.
Nuuko reero ni mwiteguure, kandi mwirinde, mushire ibyiringiro byanyu ku migisha Yesu Kristo azaabaha igihe azaagaragazwa.
Nimube nk’abaana bumvira, kandi mureke gukurikiza irari mwari mufite keera mukiri mu bujiji.
Ahuubwo nk’uko uwabahamagaye ari uweera, namwe ubwanyu mube abeera mu migenzereze yaanyu yoose.
Kuko ibyanditswe bivuga biti, "Nimube abeera, kuko ndi uweera."
Ubwo mwiyambaza Imaana muyita So, ari we uciira abantu boose urubanza atarobaanura ahuubwo agendera kumikorere yaabo, muje mumutiinya mu minsi musigaranye hano ku isi.
Muuzi yuuko ibyo mwacungujwe ngo muve mu ngeso mbi zaanyu mwarazwe na ba sogokuruza baanyu atari ibintu bita agaciiro nk’ifeeza cangwa izaahabu,
ahuubwo mwacungujwe amaraso ya Kristo y’igiciiro cinshi, nk’ay’umwana w’intaama utagira inenge cangwa ubwandu.
Imaana yari yaratooranyije Kristo isi itaraaremwa, ariko iza kumugaragaza muri ibi bihe bya nyuma ku bwanyu.
Kristo ni we utuma mwemera Imaana yamuzuuye mu baapfuuye kandi imuha ikuzo kugira ngo kwizeera kwanyu n’ibyiringiro byanyu bishingire ku Maana.
Noone reero ubwo mwejejwe mu mitima yaanyu ku bwo kumvira ukuri kugira ngo mugire urukundo nyaarwo rwa kivandimwe, nimukundane caane mubikuuye ku mutima.
Kuko mu ijambo ry’Imaana rizima kandi rihoraho iteeka, mwavuutse bundi busha mutaabyawe n’imbuto ibora, ahuubwo mubyawe n’imbuto ihoraho iteeka.
Kandi byanditswe ngo, "Abari mu mubiri boose bameze nk’ibyatsi kandi ikuzo ryabo rikaba nk’iry’ibimori by’ibyatsi. Ibyatsi biraraba, n’ibimori bigahunguka,
ariko ijambo ry’Uhoraho rizaahoraho iteeka." Iri jambo reero ni ryo Nkuru Nziiza mwamenyeeshejwe.
Nuuko reero nimwikuureho ikibi coose, mwekongera kubeesha cangwa ngo mugire uburyarya cangwa ishari no gutukana.
Mumere nk’abaana bakimara kuvuuka, muje muhora mwifuuza amata meeza y’Umwuka ari ryo jambo ry’Imaana, kugira ngo atume mukurira mu gakiza
niiba koko mwarasogongeyeho mukumva ubwo bwiza bwa Nyagasani.
Nimumuuzeho, ni we buye rizima ryanzwe n’abantu ariko rigatooranywa n’Imaana nk’irifite agaciiro gakomeye mu maaso yaayo.
Nimuuze nk’amabuye mazima maze mukoreeshwe mu kuubaka inzu y’Umwuka, kugira ngo mube ubwoko bw’abatambyi beera, batamba ibitambo Imaana ishiima muri Kristo Yesu bayobowe n’Umwuka.
Nk’uko ibyanditswe bivuga biti, "Dore nshize muri Siyoni ibuye natooranyije, ngo ribabeere iryo gukomeza imfuruka, ry’agaciiro kenshi, Kandi umwizeera weese ntaabwo azaakozwa isoni."
Mwebwe abeemeye Kristo, muzi yuuko ari uw’agaciiro kenshi, naho abo bateemere bizaababeera nk’uko byanditswe ngo, "Ibuye abuubatsi banze ni ryo ryabaaye iry’akamaro gakomeye,"
kandi ngo, "Iryo ni ryo buye rizaasiitaaza abantu, n’urutare ruzaabaguusha." Basiitaazwa n’uko banze kumva ijambo rye nk’uko baari baarabigenewe.
Ariko mwebweho muri ubwoko bwatooranyijwe. Muri abatambyi b’Umwami, kandi ishanga ryera, kugira ngo mwamamaze ibikorwa bitangaaje by’uwabahamagaye kuva mu mwijima mukagera mu muco w’agatangaza.
Mbere ntimwari ubwoko bw’Imaana, ariko ubu muri ubwoko bwayo, Mbere ntimwari mwakagiriwe impuhwe, ariko ubu mwarazigiriwe.
Bakundwa, ndabihanangiriza, nk’abanyamahanga kandi abagenzi kuri iyi si, kugira ngo mwirinde irari muteerwa n’umubiri rigahora rirwanya ubugingo.
Mugire imyifatire myiza mu banyamahanga, kugira ngo n’ubwo babasebya nk’aho muri inkozi z’ibibi, babone imirimo yaanyu myiza nuuko bahe Imaana ikuzo igihe izaazira guca urubanza.
Kubwo kuubaha Nyagasani, muje mwumvira ubutegetsi bwose bwashizweho n’abantu, yaba umwami nyir’igihugu,
cangwa abatware bategeka na we, bo atuma guhana abakora ibidashitse no guhemba abakora ibishitse.
Kuko ni bwo bushaake bw’Imaana kugira ngo mu gukora ibyiza mucecekeeshe ubujiji bw’abapfaapfa.
Mwe nk’abagaragu b’Imaana, nimubeho nk’abantu bafite umudendeezo, ariko ntimuhindure uwo mudendeezo waanyu urwitwazo rwo gukora ibibi.
Nimwubahe abantu boose, mukunde umuryango w’abizeera, mwubahe Imaana kandi muhe umwami icuubahiro.
Bagaragu, nimwumvire ba shoobuja kandi mubuubahe mubikuuye ku mutima, kandi atari abeeza n’ababagirira ineeza gusa ahuubwo n’abo babafata naabi.
Imaana izaabibashiimira nimwihangaanira imibabaro no kubabazwa ku bwayo.
Niiba mwihangaanira gukubitwa babaryoza gukora ibibi, muzaabibonamo nyungu ki? Ariko nimwihangaanira kubabazwa mukora ibishitse muzaashimwa n’Imaana.
Kandi ni co mwahamagariwe, kuko Kristo yababajwe ku bwanyu, abasigira urugero kugira ngo mugere ibirenge byanyu mu bye.
Ntaacaaha yakoze, kandi ntiyiigeze avuga ibinyoma.
Ubwo yatukwaga, ntaawe yiigeze asubiza naabi, kandi ubwo yababazwaga, ntaawe yiigeze akangiisha, ahuubwo yiiragije Imaana, ari yo mucaamanza utabeera.
We ubwe yiikoreye ibyaha byacu mu mubiri we abibambanwa ku musaraba kugira ngo tuve mu byaha tubeho mu butungaane. Ibikomere bye ni byo byabakijije.
Kuko mwari mwarazimiye nk’intaama, ariko ubu mugarukiye umushumba kandi umurinzi w’ubugingo bwanyu.

Nuuko reero ni co kimwe namwe bagore, muje mwumvira abagabo baanyu, kugira ngo n’ubwo bamwe muri bo baaba batiizeera ijambo ry’Imaana, babaashe guhindurwa ari nta co babwiwe, ahuubwo babiteewe n’imigenzereze myiza y’abagore baabo,
baboonye imyifatire yaanyu itungaanye hamwe n’uko mwiyubaha.
Umurimbo waanyu weekuba uw’inyuma ngo musibe imisatsi yaanyu, no kwambara imitaako y’izaahabu cangwa imyenda y’akarusho.
Ahuubwo umurimbo waanyu ube uwo mu mutima, ari wo murimbo ugaragaza ubwiza buhoraho, ubugwaneeza n’ubucureera ufite agaciiro kenshi imbere y’Imaana.
Uku ni ko byahoze na keera. Abagore b’intungaane biiringiraga Imaana, bakiirimbiisha kumvira abagabo baabo.
Na Saara yuubahaga Aburahamu akamwita umutware we. Namwe muba mubaaye abakoobwa be igihe mukora neeza mudatiinya ikibakanga icaari co coose.

Ni co kimwe namwe bagabo, mwite ku bagore baanyu mu gihe muri kumwe mu buzima bwanyu, mubuubaha kuko ari igitsina gifite intege nke, kandi na bo ni abaragwa b’impaano nziiza y’ubugingo buhoraho. Mukore ibyo kugira ngo hatagira igitangiira amasengeesho yaanyu.
Ahasigaye, ni muhuuze imitima, mugirirane impuhwe, mukundane, mugire umutima wiiyoroheje kandi mwiciishe bugufi mu biteekerezo.
Ntimukiituure inaabi mwagiriwe cangwa ngo musubize ababatuka, ahuubwo mwifuurize imigisha ababagenza batyo. Kuko iki ni co mwahamagariwe, kugira ngo muragwe umugisha.
Nk’uko ibyanditswe bivuga biti, "Ushaaka ubugingo bwiza no kubona igihe ciiza, ni arinde ururimi rwe rutavuga ikibi kandi arinde n’iminwa ye kugira ngo itavuga ibinyoma.
Ni ahinduke ave mu byaha akore ibyiza. Ni ashaakiishe amahoro kandi ayaharanire.
Kuko Uhoraho ahoza ijiisho rye kubakiraanutsi, kandi yumva amasengeesho yaabo. Ariko areeba igitsuuri inkozi z’ibibi."
Mbese ubu ni nde uzaabagirira naabi nimuba mufite umwete wo gukora ibyiza?
Ariko nuubwo mwababazwa ku bwo gukora ibishitse, mwabona umugisha. Ntimugatiinye ibyo babakangiisha, kandi ntimugahagarike imitima.
Nimwubahe Kristo mu mitima yaanyu ababeere Umwami. Muhore mwiteguuye gusubiza umuntu weese usaba ibisobaanuro by’ibyiringiro mufite,
kandi mubikorane kwiciisha bugufi no kuubaha. Mugire umutima ukeeye, kugira ngo nibabasebya, abo babatuka babaryoza imyifatire yaanyu myiza muri Kristo bazaakorwe n’isoni.
Kuko icaaruta n’ukubabazwa ku bwo gukora ibyiza, niiba uko kubabazwa ari ubushaake bw’Imaana, kuruta kubabazwa ku bwo gukora ibibi.
Kuko Kristo na we yababajwe rimwe ku bw’ibyaha bya boose, we yari intungaane apfiira abanyabyaha, kugira ngo abahuuze n’Imaana. Yiishwe mu buryo bw’umubiri, ariko ahindurwa muzima mu mwuka,
nuuko aja kubwiriza imyuka yari imbohe.
Iyi yari ya myuka y’abo batumviye Imaana ubwo yayiihangaaniraga mu minsi yo Nowa yuubakaga ubwato bunini. Abantu bake bagera ku munaane nibo baarokowe n’amaazi.

Kandi ayo maazi ni ikimenyeetso c’umubatizo weerekana ko mukijijwe. Si ugukurwaho umwanda ku mubiri, ahuubwo n’iseezeerano uba ukoreye Imaana n’umutima ukeeye. Uwo mubatizo ni wo ubakiza ku bw’izuuka rya Kristo Yesu,
wazaamuutse akaja mu ijuru kandi akaba yiicaye iburyo bw’Imaana. Ni we urigutegeka abaamalayika n’abafite ubushobozi n’imbaraga mu ijuru.
Nooneho reero ubwo Kristo yababajwe mu mubiri, namwe mugomba kwikomereza kuri ico giteekerezo kuko umuntu weese ubabazwa mu mubiri aba atandukanye n’icaaha.
Uheereye ubu reero mugomba kumara iminsi mushigaje muri ubu buzima mudategekwa n’irari ry’umubiri ahuubwo mukurikiza ibyo Imaana ishaaka.

Mumaze igihe gihaagije mukora ibyo abataazi Imaana bakunda gukora, no kugira ingeso mbi zoose, n’irari, ubusinzi, kwineezeeza mubyo kunywa n’ubuheeheesi, hamwe n’imihango igayitse yo gusenga ibigirwamaana.
Noone ubu abo mwabikoranaga batangazwa no kubona mutagifatanya na bo mu ngeso mbi zikabije, bigatuma babasebya.
Nyamara bazaatanga umwanzuro imbere y’Imaana, yo yiiteguuye guciira urubanza abazima n’abaapfuuye.
Ni yo mpamvu abaapfuuye na bo baabwirijwe ubwo Butumwa Bwiza, kugira ngo n’ubwo baaciiriwe urubanza bakiri mu mubiri nka buri umwe, ni babaho mu buryo bw’Umwuka, babeho nk’Imaana.
Iheerezo rya byose riri haafi. Nuuko reero mwifate kandi mube maaso kugira ngo mushobore gusenga neeza.
Ikiruta byose, mukundane urukundo rudashira, kuko urukundo rutwikiira ibyaha byinshi.
Muje mugirirana ubupfura mutiinuubwa.
Buri umwe abe umureeberezi mwiza wo kurinda impaano zitandukanye Imaana yabahaaye, muzikoreeshe kugira ngo zungukire buri umwe nk’uko n’Imaana yazibahaaye.

Umuntu weese uvuga, agomba kuvuga nk’uvuga amagambo y’Imaana nyaayo, kandi uheereza agomba kubikora n’imbaraga Imaana itanga kugira ngo Imaana ihaabwe ikuzo mu bintu byose muri Kristo Yesu. N’ihaabwe ikuzo n’ububaasha uko ibihe bisimbuurana iteeka. Amiina.
Bakundwa, ntimugatangaazwe n’ibigeragezo bibabaza mucamo muri iki gihe, nk’aho ari ibidasanzwe bibagwiriye.
Ahuubwo muneezeezwe n’uko mufatanyije imibabaro ya Kristo, kugira ngo namwe muzaaneezeerwe bihebuuje igihe ikuzo rye rizaagaragazwa.
Nimutukwa muhoorwa izina rya Kristo, murahiirwa kuko Umwuka w’ikuzo ari wo Mwuka w’Imaana uba ubariho.
Ariko nihagira umuntu muri mwe ubabazwa, ntakababazwe kubeera ko ari umwicanyi, umujuura, umugiranaabi, cangwa ngo azire kwivanga mu by’abandi.
Ariko nihagira uwo muri mwe ubabazwa kuko ari umukristo, ntibikamukoze isoni, ahuubwo aheeshe Imaana ikuzo kuko ari umukristo.
Kuko igihe co guca urubanza kirageze kandi rubanjirije ab’umuryango w’Imaana. Noone se ubwo rubanjirije muri twe, iheerezo ry’abatumvira Ubutumwa Bwiza bw’Imaana rizaamera rite?
Kandi nk’uko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Niiba bikomereye intungaane gukizwa, bizaagendera bite abatuubaha Imaana n’abanyabyaha?"
Noone reero, reka abo bababazwa bahoorwa gukora ibyo Imaana ishaaka, biiragize Umuremyi udahemuka, kandi bakomeza gukora ibyiza.
Njeewe umwe mu bakuru b’itooreero kandi umuhamya w’ibyo kubabazwa kwa Kristo, nkaba nzaagabana ku mugabane w’ikuzo tuzaagaragarizwa, ndihanangiriza abakuru b’itooreero bari muri mwe
kuragira umukumbi mwaragijwe n’Imaana kandi muwiteho mutiinuubwa ahuubwo n’umutima ukunze nk’uko Imaana ishaaka ngo mubikore. Mukore umurimo waanyu mutiishaakira inyungu ahuubwo mubyitangiye.
Ntimutegekeeshe igitugu abo mushinzwe kuyobora, ahuubwo mubeere uwo mukumbi icokureeberaho.
Nuuko igihe mukuru w’abashumba aziigaragaza, muzaahaabwa ikamba ry’ikuzo ritangirika.
Namwe abakiri bato, mukwiriye kumvira abakuru, kandi mwese mukwiriye guca bugufi muri byose mukora hamwe, nk’uko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo, "Imaana irwanya abiibone, ariko igaha umugisha abaca bugufi."
Nuuko reero mwiciishe bugufi imbere y’Imaana nyir’ububaasha kugira ngo igihe ni kigera izaabashire heejuru.
Muyeegurire ibibahagaritsa imitima byose, kuko ibiitaho.
Mwirinde kandi mube maaso, kuko umwanzi waanyu Sataani ahora azereera nk’intare itontoma ishaaka uwo ya conshomera.
Mumurwanye kandi mushikame mu kwizeera kuko muuzi yuuko abavandimwe baanyu ku isi yoose bari kunyura mu mubabaro nk’uwo.
Kandi nimumara kubabazwa akaanya gato, Imaana nyir’ubuntu bwose, yabahamagariye kuba mu ikuzo rihoraho muri Kristo, izaabasubiza imbaraga ibashigikire, ibakomeze kandi ibahe urufatiro rukomeye.
Ubutware bube ubwayo iteeka ryose, Amiina.

Mbandikiye aya magambo make mfashijwe na Silaasi, wo njaana nk’umuvandimwe muri Kristo w’intahemuka. Nanditse nshaaka kubakomeza no kubeemeza ko ubu ari ubuntu bw’Imaana nyaabwo. Nimububemo mushikamye.
Ab’itoorero ry’i Babilooni, baatooranyijwe nkamwe kandi na Mariko umwana wanje barabataasha.
Nimuhaane indamutso y’urukundo. Amahoro abe muri mwe mwese abari muri Kristo.

name: 2 Pedro
chapters: Njeewe Simooni Peetero, umugaragu kandi intumwa ya Yesu Kristo, ndabandikiye mwebwe abaamaze kwakira kwizeera kw’agiciiro nk’uko naatwe twakiiriye binyuriye mu butungaane bw’Imaana yaacu n’Umukiza waacu Yesu Kristo.
Ubuntu n’amahoro muheeshwa no kumenya Imaana n’Umwami waacu Yesu bigwire muri mwe.
Imbaraga za kamere y’Imaana zaaduhaaye ibyifuzwa byose mu bugingo bwacu no kuubaha Imaana, tubiheeshejwe no kumenya uwaduhamagaye ku bw’ikuzo rye n’ubugwaneeza.
Bityo iduha amaseezerano y’agaciiro akomeye, kugira ngo muri yo, muzaabone uko muhunga ubugira naabi bwo mu isi buuzanwa n’irari, nuuko mubone uko musangira ibiikorwa bya kamere y’Imaana.
Ku bw’iyo mpamvu, mukwiriye gukora ibishoboka, mu kongera ubugwaneeza ku kwizeera, ubugwaneeza mukongeraho ubumenyi,
ubumenyi mwongereho ukwifata, ukwifata mwongereho ukwihangaana, ukwihangaana mwongereho kuubaha Imaana,
kuubaha Imaana mwongereho kubaana kwa kivandimwe, nuuko kubaana kwa kivandimwe mwongereho urukundo.
Kuko ibi byose ni biba muri mwe kandi bikabagwiramo, muzaagira umwete no gukora neeza mu kumenya Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo.
Kuko umuntu weese udafite ibyo ntaareeba kure kandi ameze nk’impumyi, akiibagirwa yuuko yeejejwe agakuurwaho ibyaha bye bya keera.
Nuuko reero bavandimwe, mushiishikarire guhamya, gutooranywa no guhamagarwa kwanyu, kuko nimubigenza mutyo, ntimuziigera musiitaara na hato.
Bityo reero, bizaabaheesha uburenganzira bwuzuye bwo kwinjira mu Bwami bw’iteeka bw’Umwami waacu kandi Umukiza Yesu Kristo.
Ni co gituma mfite umwete wo guhora mbibutsa ibyo byose, n’ubwo musanzwe mubiizi kandi mugashinga imizi mu kuri mwakiiriye.
Nteekereza ko bikwiriye kugira ngo igihe coose nkiri muri iyi si nkwiriye guhora mbibibutsa
ubwo nzi neeza yuuko ngiye kuva muri iyi si bidatinze, kandi koko ni nk’uko Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo yabiinyeruriye.
Kandi nzaakora ibishoboka byose kugira ngo niimara kuva muri iyi si, muzaashobore kubyibuka igihe coose.
Kuko ntaabwo twakurikije imigani y’imihimbano ubwo twabamenyeeshaga iby’imbaraga no kuuza k’Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo, ariko turi abahamya babyo kuko twiboneye n’amaaso yaacu ikuzo rye.
Kuko yahaawe icuubahiro n’ikuzo kuva ku Maana Daata ubwo ijwi ry’ikuzo rihebuuje ryamuujeho, rivuga riti, "Uyu ni Umwana wanje nkunda, unyizihiza."
Twe ubwacu twumviise iri jwi riva mu ijuru, ubwo twari hamwe na Yesu Kristo ku musozi weera.

Noone turushaho gushira iciizeere mu butumwa bwahanuuwe. Kandi namwe muzaaba mugize neeza nimubwitaho kuko ni nk’itaara ryaka, rikamurika ahari umwijima. Ubwo butumwa mukwiriye kubushiraho umwete bukarinda buca nuuko inyenyeeri yo mu gitondo ikarasira mu mitima yaanyu.
Mbere ya byose mukwiriye gusobaanukirwa ko ubuhanuuzi bwose mu byanditswe byera atari insobaanura y’umuntu ku bwe,
kuko ari nta buhanuuzi bwahanuuwe ku bw’ubushaake bw’umuntu, ahuubwo ko ari abagabo n’abagore baayobowe n’Umwuka Weera kuvuga ijambo rivuuye ku Maana.

Nk’uko abahanuuzi b’ibinyoma babaayeho mu bantu ba Isirayeli, ni ko no muri mwe hazaadukamo abiigiisha b’ibinyoma. Bazaabaazamo rwihishwa bazanye inyigiisho ziyobya abantu, zikabaroha mu nzira yo kurimbuka. Ndetse biihakane na Yesu Kristo wabacunguye, maze ibyo bibageze ku kurimbuka kwa vuba vuba.
Ukuuyeho ibyo, benshi bazaakurikiza ingeso zaabo mbi zikojeje isoni, kandi ku bw’inyigiisho zaabo benshi bazaasebya inzira y’ukuri.
Kandi ubusambo bwabo buzaabateera kubabwira amagambo biihimbiye ngo bababonemo inyungu. Nyamara urubanza rwabo rwaraciiwe kuva keera, kandi ubarimbura ari maaso.
Imaana ntiyababariye abaamalayika ubwo baayicumuyeho, ahuubwo yabajugunye mu muriro w’iteeka, nuuko ibaboheesha injegeri mu mwijima w’ikuzimu aho bazaaba kugeza ku munsi wo guciirwa urubanza.
Kandi Imaana ntiyababariye abo ku isi mu gihe ca keera, ahuubwo yatsembeesheje umwuzure abaayiiyobagije, naho Nowa wabwirizaga ubutumwa bw’ubutungaane hamwe n’abandi bantu barindwi gusa, bararokoka.
Ikindi gihe, Imaana yaciiriye urubanza amatawuni makuru ya Sodomu na Gomora, iyatsembeesha umuriro ahinduka igitaazi maze iyagira akabarore keerekana uko bizaabeera abo batayuubaha.
Imaana yarokoye Looti, umugabo w’intungaane wari warashavujwe n’imibeereho n’ingeso mbi z’abanyabyaha.
Uyu mugabo w’intungaane yari abatuuyemo, ariko buri munsi yashengurwaga umutima ubwo yabonaga kandi akumva ubukozi bw’ibibi bwabo.
Nuuko reero Uhoraho azi uburyo bwo kuvaana abamwubaha mu bigeragezo, hamwe no guteguura no guhana abakiraanirwa bategereje umunsi wo guciirwa urubanza

na caane abo bakurikiza irari baterwa na kamere y’umubiri, n’abo bahinyura gutegeka kw’Imaana. Abo biigiisha b’ibinyoma biigiisha bashize amanga kandi biitanze, ntibatiinya gutuka no gusebya abaahaawe ikuzo bo mu ijuru.
Nyamara n’ubwo abaamalayika barusha abiigiisha b’ibinyoma imbaraga n’ububaasha, ntibashinja abaahaawe ikuzo babatuka imbere ya Nyagasani.

Ariko aba biigiisha b’ibinyoma bameze nk’inyamaaswa zidateekereza kandi zitagira ubwenge, zikaba zibeereyeho gutegwa no kwicwa. Bavuga naabi ibyo badasobaanukiwe, kandi bazaarimburwa nk’izo nyamaaswa,

bazaababazwa baryora gukora ibibi. Baneezeezwa no gukora kwineezeeza irari ry’imibiri yaabo kumanywa izuuba riva, ariko igihe basangira namwe mu minsi mikuru bakoza isoni kandi bagateesha agaciiro, kuko bashiimiishwa n’uburimanganya bwabo.
Amaaso yaabo yuuzuye ubusambanyi kandi ntibasiiba gukora ibyaha. Baguusha abafite intege nke mu mutego. Imitima yaabo yatoojwe kurarikira ubusambo, bityo bakaba ibivume.
Baataaye inzira igororotse, bayoba bakurikiye inzira ya Balaamu mwene Bewori wakunze isente zo yaboonye mu buryo budakwiriye,
ariko akaba yaraamagiriwe ku bw’icaaha ce. Indogobe ye itavuga, yavugiye mu ijwi ry’abantu yamagirira uwo muhanuuzi ibikorwa bye by’ubasazi.
Abo biigiisha b’ibinyoma ni nk’imigezi itagira amaazi kandi bameze nk’igiho gihuuhwa n’umuyaga. Imaana yabageneye umwanya w’umwijima w’icuraburindi.
Bavuga amagambo y’ubwibone atagira shinge na rugero, kandi bagakoreesha irari ribi ry’umubiri waabo kuresha abantu bamaze kwitandukanya n’icaaha, bakabayobya.
Babaseezeranya umudendeezo, ariko bo ubwabo ari imbaata z’ingeso mbi kandi zizaabarimbura. Kuko umuntu weese aba imbaata y’ikintu coose caamutsinze.

Kuko niiba baariitandukanyije n’ubwandu bw’isi ubwo baaje kumenya Umwami waacu kandi Umukiza Yesu Kristo, nuuko reero bakongera kubwizingiramo bakaneeshwa, abantu nk’abo imibeereho yaabo ya nyuma izaba mibi kurusha iya mbere.
Kuko byakabaaye byiza iyo baba bataarayobotse inzira y’ubutungaane, kuruta uko baaba bamaze kuyiyoboka, bagasubira inyuma, bagasuuzugura amategeko yeera baahaawe.
Ibiba bibabaayeho bihamya uko iyi migani iciibwa, iti, "Imbwa isubira inyuma ikarya ibyo yarutse," cangwa ngo, "Ingurube yuuhagiwe isubira kuja kwigaragura mu byondo."
Bakundwa, uru ni urwandiko rwa kabiri mbandikira. Mu nzandiko zombi, ngerageza gukangura imitima yaanyu itagira ibiteekerezo bibi mbiibutsa
ko mukwiriye kwibuka amagambo yavuzwe n’abahanuuzi beera mu gihe caashize hamwe n’amategeko y’Umwami kandi Umukiza yavuze akoreesheje intumwa zaanyu.
Ic’ibanze, mukwiriye kumenya ko mu minsi ya nyuma hazaaza ababannyega, babashinyagurira, bagakurikiza irari ryabo
kandi bavuga bati, "Mbese ntiyaseezeranye ko azaagaruka? Noone ari he? Dore uheereye igihe ba sogokuruza baapfiiriye, ibintu byose bikomeza kuba nk’uko byari bimeze kuva isi ikiremwa!"
Ubwo bakiirengagiza nkana yuuko mu ntagiriro Imaana yakoreesheje ijambo ryayo kurema ijuru n’isi. Isi yaremwe ikuuwe mu maazi kandi ikazengurukwa na yo.
Byongeye kandi, amaazi y’umwuzuure ni yo yarengeye isi mu gihe ca keera, ikarimbuka.
Ariko Imaana ikoreesheje iryo jambo yategetse ijuru n’isi biriho ubu kugumaho kugeza igihe izaaciira urubanza. Nibwo Imaana izaabitwika n’umuriro, nuuko abatayuubaha barimburwe.
Ariko bakundwa ntimwirengagize uku kuri, ko kuri Nyagasani umunsi umwe uhwanye n’imyaka igihumbi kandi imyaka igihumbi ikaba nk’umunsi umwe.
Nyagasani ntaatinda gukora ibyo yaseezeranyije nk’uko bamwe bibwira ko atinze, ariko arabiihangaanira, yuuko adashaaka kugira ngo hagire urimbuka ahuubwo ko boose baakwihana ibyaha byabo.
Kandi umunsi w’Uhoraho uzaaza nk’uko umujuura aza, nuuko ijuru rizimirane n’urusaku rwinshi, hamwe n’ibiririmo byose biyongere mu muriro, naho isi n’ibiyikorerwamo byose bishiriire.
Ubwo reero ibyo byose bizaarimburwa muri ubwo buryo, imyifatire yaanyu ikwiriye kuba ite? Mukwiriye kuba abaziranenge kandi buubaha Imaana,
mutegereje umunsi wo kugaruka k’Uhoraho mukawutebuutsa. Kuri uwo munsi ijuru rizaagurumira riyonge kandi n’ibirimo byose bizaayongera mu muriro.
