Ariko nk’uko yaduseezeranyije, dutegereje ijuru risha n’isi nsha, ahatuura ubukiraanutsi.
Nuuko reero bakundwa, mugitegereje ibyo, mukwiriye kugira umwete ngo uwo munsi muzaasangwe mu mahoro, mutagira umugayo cangwa inenge.
Kandi mumenye ko kwihangaana k’Umwami waacu ari ko gakiza. Mwene Daata Pawulo na we yabandikiye akoreesheje ubuhanga yahaawe.

Pawulo yanditse avuga kuri ibi mu nzandiko ze zoose. Mu izo nzandiko, harimo bimwe biruhije gusobaanukirwa, ibyo injiji n’abadafite kwizeere guhamye basobanya, nk’uko bagenza n’ibindi ibyanditswe byera, bikabaazanira kurimbuka.
Noone reero bakundwa, ubwo mubimenye mbere y’igihe, mwirinde kuyobeeshwa n’ububeeshi bw’abanyabyaha nuuko mukava ku ishingiro ryanyu.
Ariko mukurire mu buntu no kumenya Umwami waacu kandi Umucunguzi Yesu Kristo. Naahaabwe ikuzo ubu n’iteeka ryose. Amiina.

name: 1 João
chapters: Tubandikiye ibyerekeye Jambo utanga ubugingo wahozeho uheereye mbere na mbere, uwo twumviise, uwo twiboneye n’amaaso yaacu, uwo twitegereje kandi tukamufataho n’intoki zaacu.
Ubu bugingo bumaze guhishuurwa, twarabuboonye kandi turabuhamya, ni bwo bugingo buhoraho tubabwira bwahoranye na Daata kandi bwaduhishuuriwe.
Ibyo twaboonye n’ibyo twumviise ni byo tubagaragariza kugira ngo namwe mugirane ubumwe naatwe kuko mu by’ukuri, ubwo bumwe tubufatanyije na Daata hamwe n’Umwana we Yesu Kristo.
Tubandikiye ibi kugira ngo umuneezeero waacu wuzure.
Ubu ni bwo butumwa twumviise buvuuye kuri Kristo kandi ni bwo twamamaza, yuuko Imaana ari umuco kandi muri yo ntamwijima ubamo na hato.
Niiba reero tuvuga yuuko dufatanyije na yo kandi tukagendera mu mwijima, tuba tubeesha kandi tudakurikiza ukuri.
Ariko tugendeye mu muco nk’uko na yo iri mu muco, tuba tugiranye umubaano kandi amaraso ya Yesu atuvaanaho ibyaha byose.
Nituvuga yuuko ari ntaacaaha dufite tuba twibeesha kandi ntaakuri kuba kuri muri twe.
Ariko nitwatura ibyaha byacu, Imaana yiiringirwa kandi itabeera izaatubabarira ibyaha kandi itweze ibibi byose.
Nituvuga yuuko tutaacumuye, tuba twise Imaana umubeeshi kandi ijambo ryayo riba ritaturangwamo.
Baana banje, ibi mbibandikiye kugira ngo mudakora icaaha. Ariko nyamara nihagira ukora icaaha, dufite umurengezi utuvugira kuri Daata, ari we Yesu Kristo umukiraanutsi.
Kandi Kristo ubwe ni we gitambo c’ibyaha byacu kandi si ibyaha byacu byonyine ahuubwo n’iby’abantu boose bari ku isi.
Ikitugaragariza neeza yuuko tuuzi Imaana, ni uko twubahiriza amategeko yaayo.
Umuntu weese uvuga ko azi Imaana kandi ntiyuubahirize amategeko yaayo, aba ari umubeeshi kandi nta kuri aba afite.
Ariko umuntu weese wuubahiriza ijambo ry’Imaana, ni ukuri urukundo rwayo ruba rumaze kuuzura muri we. Ikitugaragariza yuuko turi muri yo ni iki,
uvuga ko aguma muri yo, agomba kugenza nk’uko Yesu yagenzaga.
Bakundwa, simbandikira itegeko risha, ahuubwo ni itegeko rya keera ryo mwahoranye kuva mbere y’igihe. Iryo tegeko rya keera ni ijambo mwumviise.
Nyamara iri tegeko mbandikira ni risha kuko ukuri kwa ryo kuboneka muri Kristo kandi no muri mwe. Kuko umwijima ushize, umuco nyakuri ukaba uri kumurika.
Umuntu weese wiibwira ko ari mu muco ariko akanga mwene se cangwa mushiki we, aba akiri mu mwijima.
Ukunda mwene se cangwa mushiki we aba ari mu muco kandi muri we ntampamvu yaatuma asiitaara.
Ariko uwanga mwene se, aba ari mu mwijima kandi agendera mu mwijima, ntaamenye inzira yo kunyuramo kuko umwijima umuuzanira ubuhumyi.
Baana banje ndabandikiye, kuko ibyaha byanyu byababariwe ku bwa Kristo.
Namwe bakuru ndabandikiye, kuko muuzi uwahozeho kuva mbere na mbere. Namwe rubyiruko ndabandikiye, kuko mumaze kuneesha umubi.

Ndabandikiye baana banje, kuko muuzi Daata wa twese. Ndabandikiye bakuru, kuko muuzi uwahozeho kuva mbere na mbere. Ndabandikiye rubyiruko, kuko mufite imbaraga kandi ijambo ry’Imaana rikaba rihamye muri mwe, kandi mukaba mwaraneesheje umubi.
Ntimugakunde isi cangwa ibiyirimo. Umuntu ukunda iby’isi, aba adakunda Daata.
Kuko ibiri mu isi byose, nk’irari ry’umubiri, irari ry’amaaso n’ubwibone bw’ubukire bidaturuka kuri Daata wa twese ahuubwo bituruka mu isi.
Kandi isi n’ibyo abantu bayiifuuzamo birigushira ariko abo bakora ibyo Imaana ishaaka, bazaahoraho ibihe byose.
Baana banje, iki n’igihe ca nyuma! Nk’uko mwumviise yuuko urwanya Kristo ari kuuza, ubu abarwanya Kristo bamaze kuuza. Ni byo bitwemeza yuuko iki ari igihe ca nyuma.
Abo bantu baatuvuuyemo kuko ntibaari abaacu. Iyo baba abaacu, ntibaari kuva muri twe. Nyamara baakuwe muri twe kugira ngo bitugaragarizwe ko batari abaacu nyakuri.
Ariko mwebwe mwasiizwe amavuta n’Uwera kandi mwese muuzi ukuri.
Simbandikiye kuko mutaazi ukuri, ahuubwo mbandikiye kuko muhoze mukuuzi kandi mukaba muuzi ko ntaakinyoma gituruka mu kuri.
Mbese umunyabinyoma ni nde? Ni uwo uvuga ko Yesu atari Kristo. Uwo ni we urwanya Kristo, uhakana Daata hamwe n’Umwana.
Kuko uwo weese uhakana Umwana w’Imaana aba ahakanye n’Imaana, ariko uweemera uwo Mwana aba yemeye na Se.
Mureke ibyo mwumviise kuva mbere na mbere bigume muri mwe. Kuko ubutumwa mwumviise kuva mbere na mbere nibuguma mu mitima yaanyu, ni bwo muzaaguma mu Mwana w’Imaana hamwe na Se.
Kandi iseezerano yaduseezeranyije, ni ubugingo buhoraho.
Ibi ni byo mbandikiye ku byerekeye abo bashaaka kubayobya.

Ariko mwebweho Kristo yabahaaye Umwuka we uguma muri mwe. Ni yo mpamvu mutiifuuza undi muntu wo kubiigiisha. Kandi nk’uko Umwuka ubiigiisha byose akaba ari iby’ukuri atari ibinyoma, mubyubahirize kandi mugume muri Kristo.
Na noone baana banje, mugume muri Kristo kugira ngo n’amara guhishuurwa, tuzaashire amanga kandi twekuzaakorwa n’isoni imbere ye ubwo azaaza.
Niiba muuzi ko Kristo ari intungaane, ni bwo mushobora no kumenya neeza yuuko umuntu weese ukora ibitungaanye yabyawe na we.
Nimureebe urukundo ruhebuuje Daata yadukunze rwatumye twitwa abaana b’Imaana, kandi koko turi bo. Impamvu ituma ab’isi batatuuzi nuuko batiigeze kumumenya.
Bakundwa, ubu turi abaana b’Imaana kandi ico tuzaaba co ntikiraamenyeekana. Ariko ico tuuzi ni uko ubwo Yesu aziiyerekana tuzaamera nka we kuko tuzaamureeba uko ari.
Kandi umuntu weese ufite ibyo byiringiro muri Kristo yiiyeze nk’uko Kristo ari uweera.
Umuntu weese ukora icaaha aba yiishe itegeko ry’Imaana kandi gukora icaaha n’ukwica itegeko.
Muuzi neeza yuuko Kristo yazanywe no gukuuraho ibyaha kandi nta caaha yiigeze akora.
Umuntu weese ukora ico Kristo ashaaka ntaakora icaaha, ahuubwo ukomeza gukora icaaha aba ataaramuboonye cangwa ataraamumenya.
Baana banje, ntihakagire umuntu ubayobya. Umuntu weese ukora ibitungaanye aba ari intungaane nk’uko na Kristo ari intungaane.
Umuntu weese ukora icaaha aba ari umwana wa Sataani, kuko Sataani yahoze ari umunyabyaha uheereye mbere na mbere. Umwana w’Imaana yahishuuriwe kugira ngo atsembe imirimo ya Sataani.
Abaana b’Imaana boose ntibakora ibyaha kuko imbuto y’Imaana iguma muri bo. Ntibakora ibyaha kuko ari abaana b’Imaana.
Intandukano y’abaana b’Imaana hamwe n’abaana ba Sataani ni iyi, abo boose badakora ibitungaanye cangwa ntibakunde beene se, ntaabwo ari abaana b’Imaana.
Ubu ni bwo butumwa mwumviise kuva mbere na mbere yuuko dukwiriye gukundana.
Ntitumere nka Kayini wari uwa Sataani maze akiica murumuna we. Mbese ni iki caatumye yiica murumuna we? Ni uko ibikorwa bye byari bibi kandi ibya murumuna we ari byiza.
Bavandimwe, ntimugatangaazwe n’uko ab’isi babanga.
Tuuzi neeza yuuko twavuye mu rupfu tugashirwa mu bugingo biteewe nuuko dukundana. Umuntu weese udakunda aguma mumbaraga z’urupfu.
Umuntu weese udakunda umuvandimwe we aba ari umwicanyi, kandi muuzi yuuko abiicanyi batazaabona ubugingo buhoraho.
Igituma tumenya urukundo ico ari co n’uko Kristo yatanze ubugingo bwe ku bwacu. Ni ko naatwe dukwiriye gutanga ubugingo bwacu kubeera abavandimwe baacu.
Mbese ni gute umuntu ufite ubutunzi bw’isi ariko akaba ataafasha umuvandimwe we ubukeneye avuga ko akunda Imaana?
Baana banje, ntimukundane mu magambo no ku rurimi gusa ahuubwo mukundane mu kuri no mu bikorwa.
Uko ni ko tuzaamenya ko turi ab’ukuri. Ni na ko tuzaashobora guhagarara imbere y’Imaana nta co dutiinya.
Igihe coose imitima yaacu iduciira urubanza, tumenya yuuko Imaana isumba imitima yaacu kandi ikamenya buri kimwe.
Bakundwa, igihe imitima yaacu idafite ico idushinja, tuba dushize amanga imbere y’Imaana,
kandi duhaabwa ico dusabye kuko twubahiriza amategeko y’Imaana no gukora ibiyishiimiisha.
Ico idutegeka ni ukwizeera Umwana waayo Yesu Kristo no gukundana nk’uko yadutegetse.
Abubahiriza amategeko y’Imaana baguma muri yo, na yo ikaguma muri bo. Kandi ikitugaragariza yuuko iri muri twe, n’Umwuka yaduhaaye.
Bakundwa, ntimukiizeere buri mwuka woose, ahuubwo mugenzuure imyuka kugira ngo mumenye neeza niiba iva ku Maana kuko abahanuuzi bibinyoma bamaze kugwira mu isi.
Uku ni ko mushobora kumenya Umwuka w’Imaana: umuntu weese uhamya ko Yesu Kristo yigize umuntu, uwo ni wo ufite Umwuka uva ku Maana.
Ariko umuntu weese uteemera Yesu aba adafite Umwuka uva ku Maana. Uwo aba afite umwuka wu urwanya Kristo, uwo mwumviise yuuko ugiiye kuuza kandi ubu ukaba umaze kugera mu isi.
Baana banje, mukomooka ku Maana kandi mwatsinze abo bahanuuzi b’ibinyoma kuko Umwuka ubarimo aruta uri mu b’isi.
Abo bahanuuzi b’ibinyoma ni ab’isi kandi ab’isi barabumvira kuko bavuga iby’isi.
Twebwe dukomooka ku Maana. Umuntu weese uzi Imaana aratwumvira ariko uwo weese udakomooka ku Imaana ntaabwo atwumvira. Aha ni ho tumenyera Umwuka w’ukuri n’umwuka uyobya.
Bakundwa, mureke dukundane kuko urukundo ruva ku Maana. Ukunda weese yabyawe n’Imaana kandi azi Imaana.
Udakunda weese ntaazi Imaana kuko Imaana ni urukundo.
Kandi Imaana yaduhishuuriye urukundo rwayo ubwo yoohereje Umwana waayo w’ikinege mu isi kugira ngo aduheeshe ubugingo.
Uru ni rwo rukundo nyakuri, si ukuvuga ngo twakunze Imaana, ahuubwo ni yo yadukunze ubwo yoohereje Umwana waayo kugira ngo atubeere igitambo c’ibyaha byacu.
Bakundwa, ubwo Imaana yadukunze urukundo ruhebuuje, naatwe dukwiriye gukundana.
Ntaamuntu wiigeze kubona Imaana, ariko ni dukundana, Imaana iba iri muri twe kandi urukundo rwayo rugatunganyirizwa muri twe.
Iki ni co kitumenyeesha yuuko tuba muri yo na yo ikaguma muri twe, kuko yaduhaaye Umwuka waayo.
Twarabiboonye kandi turabihamya ko Daata yoohereje Umwana we kuba Umukiza w’abari mu isi.
Umuntu weese waatura ko Yesu ari Umwana w’Imaana, Imaana iguma muri we kandi na we akaguma muri yo.
Naatwe tumaze kumenya ndetse no kwizeera urukundo Imaana idufitiye. Imaana ni urukundo kandi abafite urukundo baguma mu Maana na yo ikaguma muri bo.
Urukundo rutunganywa muri twe kugira ngo tuzaabone ubutwari ku munsi w’imperuuka, kandi n’ukuri koko tuzaabubona kuko ubugingo bwacu muri iyi si bumeze nk’uko Kristo ameze.
Aho urukundo ruri ntaabwoba na busa buhaba, ahuubwo urukundo nyakuri rwirukana ubwoba. Kuko ubwoba buteerwa no guteekereza ko tuzaahanwa, bityo reero ufite ubwoba ntaagira urukundo nyakuri.
Igituma dukunda nuuko Imaana yabanje kudukunda.
Umuntu weese uvuga ko akunda Imaana ariko akanga umuvandimwe we aba ari umunyabinyoma. Kuko uwanga umuvandimwe yiiboneye n’amaaso ye, ntiyaakunda Imaana ataraabona.
Itegeko Imaana yaduhaaye ni iri: abakunda Imaana bakwiriye no gukunda abavandimwe baabo.
Umuntu weese wiizeera ko Yesu ari Kristo, aba ari umwana w’Imaana kandi umuntu weese ukunda umubyeyi akunda n’umwana.
Iyo dukunze Imaana kandi tukuubahiriza amategeko yaayo, ni bwo tumenya ko dukunda abaana b’Imaana.
Kuko urukundo rw’Imaana ari ukuubahiriza amategeko yaayo. Kandi amategeko y’Imaana ntaabwo arusha,
kuko umuntu weese wabyawe n’Imaana ashobora kuneesha isi. Kandi tunesha isi n’ukwizeera kwacu.
Mbese ni nde washobora gutsinda isi? Ni uwo weese wiizeera yuuko Kristo ari Umwana w’Imaana.
Yesu Kristo yabatijwe n’amaazi kandi yamennye amaraso ye igihe apfa. Ntiyaaje ku bw’amaazi yoonyine ahuubwo ni ku bw’amaazi n’amaraso, Umwuka ni we umutangaho ubuhamya kandi Umwuka ni ukuri.
Hari ibimenyeetso bitatu bibihamya:
Umwuka, amaazi n’amaraso. Kandi ibi nk’uko ari bitatu birahuuje.
Niiba twemera ubuhamya bw’abantu, ubw’Imaana bwo burahebuuje, kuko yahamije ibyerekeye Umwana waayo.
Abo beemera Umwana w’Imaana ni bo bafite ubwo buhamya mu mitima yaabo. Ariko abateemera Imaana baba bayiise umunyabinyoma kuko bateemera ubuhamya Imaana yatanze ku Mwana waayo.
Kandi ubu ni bwo buhamya; Imaana yaduhaaye ubugingo buhoraho kandi ubwo bugingo bubonerwa mu Mwana waayo.
Ufite Umwana w’Imaana afite ubwo bugingo, naho udafite Umwana w’Imaana ntaabugingo afite.
Mbandikiye ibi mwebwe abizeera izina ry’Umwana w’Imaana, kugira ngo mumenye yuuko mufite ubugingo buhoraho.
Kandi ubu dushize amanga imbere y’Imaana, kuko tuuzi neeza yuuko iduha ico tuyisabye coose gihuuje nuuko ishaaka.
Kandi niiba tuuzi neeza yuuko Imaana itwumva iyo tuyisabye, tuuzi ko iduha ico tuyisabye.

Nuubona umuvandimwe waawe akora icaaha kitamwiciisha, umusengere ku Maana kugira ngo imuhe ubugingo, niiba koko ico caaha atari ico kumwiciisha. Ariko hariho icaaha ciiciisha, beene uwo simvuga ko mumusabira.
Ubukozi bw’ibibi bwose ni icaaha, ariko hari icaaha kiticiisha.
Tuuzi yuuko abaabyawe n’Imaana badakora ibyaha ahuubwo Umwana w’Imaana arabarinda, umwanzi ntaabakoreho.
Tuuzi yuuko turi abaana b’Imaana nuubwo isi yoose iri mu maboko y’umubi.
Tuuzi yuuko Umwana w’Imaana yaaje kandi akaduha gusobaanukirwa Imaana y’ukuri. Ndetse turi umwe niyo Maana y’ukuri n’Umwana waayo Yesu Kristo. Ni yo Maana y’ukuri n’ubugingo buhoraho.
Baana banje, mwirinde ibigirwamaana.

name: 2 João
chapters: Njeewe Mukuru w’itoorero, ndakwandikiye umubyeyi watooranyijwe hamwe n’abaana baawe bo nkunda by’ukuri. Nyamara si nje njenyine ahuubwo n’abo boose baazi ukuri barabakunda,
kuko ukuri kuguma muri twe kandi kuzaahora muri twe iteeka ryose.
Ubuntu, imbabazi n’amahoro biva ku Maana Daata no ku Mwana waayo Yesu Kristo, bibaane naatwe mu kuri no mu rukundo.
Narishimye caane gusanga bamwe mu baana baawe bagendera mu kuri nk’uko Daata yabidutegetse.
Noone reero, mubyeyi, ndagusaba kugira ngo twese dukundane. Iri si itegeko risha nkwandikira ahuubwo ni iryo dusanganywe.
Urukundo mvuga, ni ukubaho dukurikiza amategeko y’Imaana. Iri ni ryo tegeko mwumviise kuva mbere na mbere kandi mukwiriye kurikurikiza.
Abiigiisha b’ibinyoma bamaze kugwira mu isi, abo bateemera ko Yesu Kristo yaje mu buryo bw’umubiri. Umuntu weese umeze atyo ni umunyabinyoma kandi ni urwanya Kristo.
Mube maaso kugira ngo mutaaza gupfiirwa ibyo twakoreye, ahuubwo muzaahaabwe ingororano zaanyu mu bwuzuye.
Umuntu weese uteemera inyigiisho za Kristo ahuubwo akazirengaho, aba adafite Imaana mu mutima we. Naho umuntu weemera izo nyigiisho, uwo ni we ufite ubumwe n’Imaana Daata n’Umwana.
Nihagira ubaazaaho atazanye inyigiisho za Kristo, ntimuzamwakire iwaanyu. Ntimuzaanamubwire muti, "Ni amahoro,"
kuko uwaakiira umuntu nk’uwo aba afatanyije na we mu mirimo ye mibi.
Nuubwo mfite byinshi byo kubandikira, sinshatse kubibamenyeesha nkoreesheje urupapuro n’ikaramu ahuubwo niringiye ko nzaaza nkavugana namwe amaaso ku yandi, kugira ngo umunezeero waacu wuuzure.
Abaana ba mwene nyoko watooranyijwe baragutaasha.

name: 3 João
chapters: Njeewe Mukuru w’itoorero ndakwandikiye Gaayo nshuti yanje nkunda by’ukuri.
Nshuti yanje nkunda, nkwifuriza imibeereho myiza n’ubuzima bwiza nk’uko umutima waawe umeze neeza.
Nariishimye caane ubwo abavandimwe bamwe bangezeho bakambwira uko ushikamye mu kuri nk’uko wahoze ubigenza.
Ntaakinshiimiisha nko kumva abaana banje bagendera mu kuri.
Nshuti yanje nkunda uri umwiringirwa mu mirimo ukorera abavandimwe baawe, nuubwo baaba ari abanyamahanga.
Baatanze ubuhamya imbere y’itoorero iby’urukundo wabagiriye. Nyaabuna ubafashe uko bishoboka kugira ngo bakomeze urugendo rwabo mu buryo bwo gushiimiisha Imaana.
Kuko baatangiye urugendo rwabo kubwa Kristo, bataakiira ubufasha kuva mu bateemera Kristo.
Noone reero twebwe abeemera Kristo dukwiriye kubashigikira kugira ngo na bo bafatanye naatwe gukorera ukuri.
Hari ico nandikiye itoorero, ariko Diyotirefesi ukunda kwishira heejuru nk’umuyoboyozi ntaabwo aha agaciiro ibyo mvuga.

Noone reero nindamuka nje, nzaashira kumugaragaro ibyo akora mu buryo bwo kudusebya. Kandi ibyo birego ntibihaagije, ahuubwo yanga no kwakiira abiizeera kandi akabuza n’ababishaaka, akabiirukana mu itoorero.
Bakundwa, ntimwigaane ikibi ahuubwo mwigaane iciiza. Umuntu weese ukora iciiza aba aturuka ku Maana ariko uwo weese ukora ikibi aba ataraabona Imaana.
Naho Demetiriyo, abantu boose bahamya ibyiza bye kandi ukuri na ko kurabihamya. Naatwe ubwacu turabihamya kandi muuzi neeza yuuko ubuhamya bwacu ari ubw’ukuri.
Mfite byinshi byo ku kwandikira ariko sinshaaka ko mbikwandikira nkoreesheje ikaraamu n’urupapuro,
ahuubwo niiringiye ko nzaakubona vuba, ni bwo tuzaavugana amaaso ku yandi.
Amahoro abe kuri wowe. Inshuti zikooherereje indamutso. Uramutse inshuti ubaana na zo buri umwe mu izina rye.

name: Judas
chapters: Njeewe Yuda, umugaragu wa Yesu Kristo kandi mwene se wa Yaakobo, ndabandikiye mwebwe abaahamagawe, bakundwa n’Imaana Daata kandi bakarindwa na Yesu Kristo.
Imbabazi, amahoro, n’urukundo bigwire muri mwe.
Bakundwa, niteguurira kubandikira ibyerekeye agakiza dusangiye, naboonye ari ngombwa ko mbandikira mbashiishikariza guharanira ukwizeera mwahaawe n’Imaana rimwe n’iteeka ryose.

Kuko hari abantu bamwe batuubaha Imaana baabaseseyemo rwihishwa, bagahindura ukundi ubutumwa bw’ubuntu bw’Imaana yaacu kugira ngo babone uko bashira imbere ubukozi bw’ibibi bwabo, kandi ntibeemere umutegetsi n’Umwami waacu umwe ari we Yesu Kristo. Ariko keera byanditswe yuuko bazaaciirwa urubanza rw’iteeka.
Noone ubu nkaba niifuuza kubiibutsa n’ubwo mubiizi neeza yuuko Uhoraho yatabaaye abantu Biisirayeli rimwe ryonyine akabakuura mu gihugu ca Igiputi, ariko nyuma akarimbura abo boose batamwemeye.

Kandi n’abaamalayika bataagumye mu myanya Imaana yabahaaye, bakiikuura mu ciicaro caabo, Uhoraho yababoheesheje injegeri z’iteeka, abashira mu mwijima w’ikuzimu aho bategereje umunsi wo guciirwaho urubanza rw’iteeka.

Ni co kimwe n’abantu bo mu tawuni y’i Sodomu na Gomora n’amatawuni makuru batuuranye, abo bantu na bo biifashe nk’abo baamalayika biivanga mu bikorwa by’ubusambanyi no kugira irari ry’umubiri ridakwiranye na kameremuntu, bakaba baarahanwe bagatwikwa mu muriro w’iteeka kugira ngo babe ico kureeberaho.
Muri ubwo buryo, abo biigiisha b’ibinyoma bagira ibirooto bituma bangiiza imibiri yaabo, bagasuuzugura ubutegetsi bw’Imaana, ndetse bagatuka n’abaamalayika.
Nyamara na malayika mukuru Mikayile ubwo yajaga impaka na Sataani batonganira umurambo wa Moose, ntiyahangaaye guciira Sataani urubanza amutuka, ahuubwo yaravuze ati, "Imaana izaaguhane"
Ariko abo bantu bapfa gutuka ico badasobaanukiwe coose, bameze nk’inyamaaswa zitagira ubwenge, ibyo bintu badasobaanukirwa ni byo bibarimbura.
Bazaabona ishano! Kuko bakurikira inzira ya Kayini, kandi bakagwa mu buyobe bwa Balaamu wacumujwe no gukurikira inyungu. Na bo baagomeye Imaana nk’uko Koora yagomye, kandi ku bw’ibyo, bazaarimburwa.

Abo bantu baaza kuzambya gusangira kwanyu kwa kivandimwe. Bagasangira namwe nta soni kandi buuzuza inda zaabo gusa batiitaaye ku bandi. Bameze nk’ibicu bihuuhwa n’umuyaga ariko ntibigwishe imvura, kandi ni nk’ibiti biteera imbuto no mu gihe c’isaaruura, byaranduwe nuuko reero bikazaapfa kabiri.
Ibikorwa byabo biteeye isoni byiyerekana nk’uko inyanja yivumbagatanya igacura ifuro, bameze nk’inyenyeeri zizereera, zaagenewe umwijima w’icuraburindi iteeka ryose.
Kandi aba biigiisha b’ibinyoma ni bo Henoki wa karindwi mu maseekuruza kuva kuri Adamu, yahanuuyeho ati, "Dore Uhoraho azanye n’abeera be ibihumbi n’ibihumbi,
guciira abantu boose urubanza no gushinja ibikorwa by’ubugomeramaana byose baakoze mu buryo budatungaaniye Imaana n’amagambo ashaariiriye abanyabyaha batuubaha Imaana baavuze bayituka."
Abo bantu bahora biitotomba kandi baveeba abandi. Bagengwa n’irari ryabo, bagahora bavuga amagambo y’ubwibone kandi bakaryosharyosha abandi kugira ngo bababoneho inyungu.
Mwebweho bakundwa, mukwiriye kwibuka ibyo Intumwa z’Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo zaavuze.
Zaarababwiye ziti, "Mu bihe bya nyuma hazaabaho abasetsi, bakurikiza irari ry’ubugomeramaana bwabo."
Aba ni bo bantu bagengwa na kamere y’umubiri, ari nta Mwuka w’Imaana ubarimo bakabateeramo amacaakubiri.
Ariko mwe bakundwa, mukomeze gushikamira ku kwizeera kwanyu kwera kandi musenge muyobowe n’Umwuka Weera,
kandi mukomeze gukunda Imaana mutegereje Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo ngo abageze ku bugingo buhoraho ku bw’imbabazi ze.
Nuuko reero mugirire impuhwe abashidikanya,
murokore abandi mubasahuye mu muriro kandi abandi mubagirire impuhwe ariko zivanze n’ubwoba, ndetse mwange imyambaro yaabo yandujwe n’irari ry’ibyaha byabo.
Imaana, ari yo ibaasha kubarinda kugwa mu caaha, no kubahagarika imbere y’ubwiza bwayo mudafite inenge ahuubwo muneezeerewe bihebuuje,
Imaana imwe yoonyine ari yo Mukiza waacu tubikeesha Umwami waacu Yesu Kristo, ihaabwe ikuzo, ubushobozi, ubutware, n’ububaasha, uheereye keera koose, kugeza ubu n’iteeka ryose! Amiina.

name: Apocalipse
chapters: Iki gitabo ni ibyahishuuwe na Yesu Kristo, byo Imaana yamuhaaye kugira ngo yeereke abagaragu baayo ibigomba kubaho vuba. Ibi Yesu yabimenyeesheje umugaragu we Yohaana amutumyeho malayika we,
kandi Yohaana ahamya ko ibyo yaboonye byose ari ijambo ry’Imaana n’ubuhamya bwa Yesu Kristo.
Hahiirwa umuntu usomera amagambo y’ubu buhanuuzi mu ruhame rw’abeemera, kandi hahiirwa n’abumva bagakurikiza ibyanditswemo, kuko igihe ceegeereje.

Njeewe Yohaana, ndabandikiye mwebwe abo mu matoorero arindwi yo muri Asiya. Nimugire ubuntu n’amahoro bituruka ku Maana iriho, Imaana yahozeho, Imaana izaahoraho, kandi bituruka ku myuka irindwi iri imbere y’intebe ye y’Ubwami,
no kuri Yesu Kristo, umuhamya wiringirwa, wabanjirije abandi kuzuuka, kandi akaba umutware w’abaami bo ku isi. Koko Kristo aradukunda kandi yadukijije ibyaha byacu igihe amena amaraso ye.
Yaduhaaye gutegeka nk’abaami kandi aduha guheereza Imaana Se nk’abaheerezabitambo. Icuubahiro n’ubutware bibe ibye iteeka ryose, Amiina.
Dore aziye mu bicu! Buri muntu azaamubona, ndetse n’abaamuteeye icumu agapfa bazaamubona. Abantu boose bo ku isi bazaacura umuboroogo ku bwe. Koko ni ko bizaaba. Amiina!
Nyagasani Imaana Ishoborabyose, iriho, iyahozeho kandi izaahoraho, iravuga iti, "Ni nje ntangiriro nkaba n’iheerezo."
Njeewe Yohaana, mwene so musangiye gutootezwa n’ubwami no kwihangaana muri Yesu, nashizwe mu kirwa ciitwa Patimo kubwo kwamamaza ijambo ry’Imaana n’ubuhamya bwa Yesu.
Ku munsi wa Nyagasani ntwarwa n’Umwuka, maze numva ijwi rirenga nk’impanda inyuma yanje
rivuga riti, "Ibyo ubona ubyandike mu gitabo maze ucooherereze amatoorero yo muri aya ma tawuni makuru: Efeeso, Simuruna, Perigamo, Tuwatira, Saridi, Filadelifiya, na Lawodikeya."
Maze ndahindukira ngo ndeebe uwamvugiishaga, nuuko mbona ibitereko by’amataara birindwi by’izaahabu,
kandi hagati y’ibyo bitereko by’amataara mpabona usa n’Umwana w’Umuntu, yambaye ikanzu ndende, umushumi wa zaahabu uzengurutse igituuza ce.
Umusatsi we n’umutwe we weereranaga nk’ubwoya bw’umweru, cangwa nk’urubura, amaaso ye yari nk’ibirimi by’umuriro,
ibirenge bye byarabagiranaga nk’icuuma gikozwe mu muringa utungaanyirijwe mu ruganda, naho ijwi rye ryari rimeze nk’iry’amaazi menshi asuuma.
Mu kuboko kwe kw’iburyo yari afashe inyenyeeri ndwi, naho mu kanwa ke hagasohoka inkoota ityaye impande zombi. Mu maaso he haasaga nk’izuuba ryo kumanywa y’ihangu.
Ko namuboonye, niikubita imbere ye nk’upfuuye. Ariko andambikaho ukuboko kwe kw’iburyo, avuga ati, "Wiitiinya! Ninje ntangiriro nkaba n’iheerezo,
kandi ndi muzima. Nari narapfuuye, noone dore ndi muzima kugeza iteeka ryose. Mfite ububaasha bwo kuzuura abaapfuuye bakongera kubaho kandi mfite n’ibishumuruzo by’ikuzimu.
Nuuko reero, andika ibyo uboonye, ibiriho ubu, n’ibigiiye kubaho haanyuma.

Naho ibyerekeye amayobera y’inyenyeeri ndwi zo waboonye mu kiganza canje c’iburyo, hamwe n’ibitereko by’amataara birindwi by’izaahabu, dore ico bisobaanura: inyenyeeri ndwi ni abaamalayika b’amatoorero arindwi, kandi ibitereko by’amataara birindwi ni amatoorero arindwi."

Arambwira ati, "Andikira malayika w’itoorero rya Efeeso uti, ‘Ubu ni bwo butumwa buvuuye kuri uwo ufashe inyenyeeri ndwi mu kiganza ce c’iburyo, akagendera hagati y’ibitereko by’amataara birindwi by’izaahabu.
Nzi imirimo yaawe, nzi n’ukuntu uvunika n’uko wiihangaana. Nzi kandi ko udashobora kwihangaanira inkozi z’ibibi. Wagenzuuye abo biiyita intumwa kandi batari zo, maze usanga ko babeesha.
Nzi kandi ko wiihangaanye, ukababazwa ku bw’izina ryanje, kandi ntiwaciika intege.
Ariko mfite ico nkunenga: ni uko waretse urukundo wagiraga mbere ukiinyemera.

Nuuko reero, ibuka aho wakuurije kugwa maze wiihane, kandi wongere gukora ibikorwa nk’ibya mbere. Bitabaaye bityo ngo wiihane, ngiiye kuuza aho uri maze nkuure igitereko c’itaara ryawe mu mwanya waaco.
Nyamara hari n’ico ngushiimira: ni uko wanga ibikorwa by’Abanikolayiti, nk’uko nanje mbyanga.
Ufite amatwi niyumve ibyo Umwuka abwira amatoorero. Uzaatsinda weese, nzamwemerera kurya ku mbuto z’igiti c’ubugingo kiri muri paradizo y’Imaana’ "
Andikira malayika w’itoorero rya Simuruna uti, "Ubu ni bwo butumwa buvuuye kuri wa wundi w’intangiriro akaba n’iherezo, uwari warapfuuye noone akaba ari muzima.
Nzi ingoorane zaawe n’ubukene bwawe, nuubwo uri umukungu mu mutima. Nzi n’ukuntu uvugwa naabi n’abiiyita Abayuuda kandi batari bo, ahuubwo ikoraniro ryabo ryategekwaga na Sataani.

Ntuutiinye ibyo ugiiye kubabazwa. Dore Sataani agiiye kujugunya bamwe muri mwe mu gihome kugira ngo mugeragezwe, kandi muzaababazwa kumara iminsi cumi. Uzaabe umwiringirwa kugeza ku gupfa, maze nanje nzaaguha ikamba ry’ubugingo.
Ufite amatwi weese niyumve ibyo Umwuka abwira amatoorero. Uzaatsinda weese ntaaziigera ababazwa n’urupfu rwa kabiri."
Andikira malayika w’itoorero rya Perigamo uti, "Ubu ni bwo butumwa buvuuye kuri wa wundi ufashe inkoota ityaye impande zombi.

Aho utuuye ndahaazi, ni aho intebe y’ubwami bwa Sataani iri. Ariko kandi wakomeje izina ryanje, maze ntiwiihakana ko unyizeera, ndetse no mu gihe ca Antipasi umuhamya wanje udahemuka wiiciwe iwaanyu, aho Sataani atuuye.

Ariko reero mfite bike nkunenga: hari abantu bamwe muri mwe bakurikiza inyigiisho ya Balaamu, wa wundi wiigiishije Balaki kuyobya Abiisirayeli bakagwa mu caaha, barya inyama zaaterekeewe ibigirwamaana no kwishira mu bikorwa by’ubusambanyi.
Naawe ufite abantu bakurikiza inyigiisho z’Abanikolayiti.
Noone reero wiihane kuko bitabaaye bityo, ngiiye kuuza vuba maze mbarwanye n’inkoota iva mu kanwa kanje.

Niiba reero ufite amatwi, umva ico Umwuka abwira amatoorero! Uzaatsinda weese, nzaamuha ku manu yahishwe, kandi muhe n’ibuye ryera, ryanditsweho izina risha ritaazwi n’umuntu weese keretse uwo uzaaba arihaawe."

Andikira malayika w’itoorero rya Tuwatira uti, "Ubu ni bwo butumwa bw’Umwana w’Imaana, ufite amaaso ameze nk’ibirimi by’umuriro, kandi ufite ibirenge bisa nk’icuuma gikozwe mu muringa urabirana nyuma yo gutunganyirizwa mu ruganda.
Nzi ibikorwa byawe. Nzi urukundo rwawe, ukwizeera kwawe, ubuheereza bwawe, n’ukwihangaana kwawe. Nzi yuuko imirimo ukora ubu isumba iyo wakoze mbere.

Ariko ibi ni byo nkunenga: worohera uriiya mugore Yezebeeli wiiyita umuhanuuzikazi w’Imaana maze inyigiisho ze zikayobya abagaragu banje zibashoora mu bikorwa by’ubusambanyi no kurya ibyokurya byatuuwe ibigirwamaana.
Namuhaaye igihe co kwihana, ariko ntaashaaka kwihana ngo areke ubusambanyi bwe.
Dore ngiiye kumujugunya kugitanda c’uburibwe, kandi n’abamusambanya nzaabateera amagoorwa akaze, baramutse batiihannye ibibi baakoranye na we.
Kandi abayoboke be nzaabiica, maze amatoorero yoose amenye ko ari nje umenya ibiteekerezo hamwe n’ibyifuuzo bya buri muntu. Nziituura buri umwe muri mwe nkurikije ibyo yakoze.
Ariko abandi mwese b’i Tuwatira, mutiigeze kuyoboka izi nyigiisho mbi, kandi ntimwige ibyo abo bandi biita ‘amabanga ya Sataani’, sinzaabagerekaho undi mutwaro.
Mukomeze ico mufite kugeza aho nzaazira.
Uzaatsinda weese agakomeza gukora imirimo yanje kugeza ku ndunduro, nzaamuha ububaasha bwo gutwara amahanga.
Ayo mahanga azaayategekeesha agahato, nk’ujanjagura ibibindi by’ibumba.
Bazaabona ububaasha nk’ubwo nahaawe na Daata, kandi uzaatsinda, nzaamuha inyenyeeri yaaka mu gitondo.
Ufite amatwi weese niyumve ibyo Umwuka abwira amatoorero."
"Andikira malayika w’itoorero rya Saridi uti, ‘Ubu nibwo butumwa buvuuye kuri uwo ufite imyuka ndwi y’Imaana n’inyenyeeri ndwi. Nzi imirimo ukora. Wiitwa ko uri muzima ariko warapfuuye.
Kanguka ukomeze ibyo ugifite bitaraapfa, kuko nasanze ibikorwa byawe imbere y’Imaana bidatungaanye.
Nuuko reero wiibuke ibyo wiigiishijwe n’ibyo wumviise, maze ubikurikize kandi wiihane. Naho niiba utabaaye maaso, nzaaza nk’umujuura, kandi ntuuzaamenya igihe nzaakugereraho.
Icakora, uracaafite abantu bake i Saridi batanduje imyambaro yaabo. Bazaagendana nanje bambaye ibyera, kuko babikwiriye.

Abazaatsinda urugamba ni bo bazambikwa imyambaro yeera, kandi sinzaasangura amazina yaabo mu gitabo c’ubugingo. Nzaatangaaza amazina yaabo kumugaragaro imbere ya Daata hamwe n’imbere y’abaamalayika ko baari abayoboke banje.
Ufite amatwi niyumve ico Umwuka abwira amatoorero.’ "

"Andikira malayika w’itoorero rya Filadelifiya uti, ‘Aya ni yo magambo y’uweera kandi w’ukuri, ufite igishumuruzo c’inzu ya Dawudi, ukinguura ntihagire n’umwe ukinga, kandi ukinga ntihagire n’umwe ukinguura.

Nzi imirimo ukora. Dore nshize imbere yaawe umuryango ukinguuye, uwo hataagira n’umwe waashobora kuwukinga. Nzi neeza yuuko ufite imbaraga nke, ariko ukaba wararinze ijambo ryanje, kandi ntiwiihakane izina ryanje.

Dore nzaakwegurira abo bantu b’ikoraniro rya Sataani biiyita abaatooranyijwe n’Imaana kandi atari bo, ahuubwo ari ababeeshi. Dore ngiiye kubakuuzanira bapfukame imbere yaawe maze bamenye yuuko ngukunda.
Kuko wakurikije amabwiriza yanje yo kwihangaana, nanje nzaakurinda igihe co kugeragezwa kigiiye kuuza ku isi yoose, kugerageza abayituuye.
Dore ngiiye kuuza bidatinze, ukomeze ico ufite kugira ngo hatagira ukwaka ikamba ryawe.

Abazaatsinda, nzaabagira inkingi mu Nzu y’Imaana yanje, kandi ntibaziigera bayivamo. Nzaabandikaho izina ry’Imaana yanje, n’izina ry’Ururembo rw’Imaana yanje, ari rwo Yerusaalemu nsha yamanutse mu ijuru iva ku Maana yanje, ndetse mbandikeho n’izina ryanje risha.
Ufite amatwi, niyumve ico Umwuka abwira amatoorero.’ "
"Andikira malayika w’itoorero rya Lawodikeya uti, ‘Aya ni amagambo ya Amiina, umudahemuka kandi umuhamya w’ukuri, akaba n’inkomooko y’ibyaremwe n’Imaana byose.
Nzi imirimo ukora, ntuukonje kandi ntuushuushe. Iyaaba niibura wari ukonje cangwa ushuushe!
Noone reero ubwo uri akazuyaazi, ukaba udakonje cangwa ngo ushuuhe, ngiiye kukuruka uve mu kanwa kanje.
Uravuga uti: Ndi umukire, nateeye imbere kandi ntaaco niifuuza. Ariko ntuumenye yuuko uri imbabare yo kubabarirwa, umukene, impumyi kandi ko wambaye ubusa.

Noone reero nkugiiriye inaama yo kunguraho izaahabu yayungurujwe n’umuriro kugira ngo ube umukire. Ungureho n’imyambaro yeera kugira ngo wambare maze uhishe ubwambure bwawe kugira ngo butareebeka. Kandi ugure n’umuti wo gusiiga ku maaso yaawe kugira ngo ureebe.
Njeewe abo nkunda ndabacaaha kandi nkabagiira inaama. Nuuko reero, nimugire umwete kandi mwihane.
Dore mpagaze ku muryango ndakomanga. Nihagira uwumva ijwi ryanje agakinguura uruugi, nzinjira maze dusangire.
Kuri abo bazaatsinda, nzaabaha umwanya biicarane nanje ku ntebe yanje y’ubwami, nk’uko nanje natsinze nkaba niicaranye na Daata ku ntebe ye y’ubwami.
Ufite amatwi niyumve ico Umwuka abwira amatoorero.’ "

Nyuma yo kubona ibyo, nongera kubonekerwa maze mbona umuryango w’ijuru ukinguuye. Numva rya jwi nabanje kumva rivugana nanje rimeze nk’iry’impanda, rivuga riti, "Zaamuuka uze hano, maze nkwereke ibigomba kubaho haanyuma y’ibi."
Muri ako kaanya ntwarwa n’umwuka, maze mbona intebe y’ubwami iteretswe mu ijuru, hari uyiicayeho.
Uwari uyiicayeho yasaga n’amabuye abangerana ya yasipi na sarudoni, kandi umukororombya usa n’ibuye ry’agaciiro rya simaragido wari wiitoorooye iyo ntebe.
Iyo ntebe yari yiitooroowe n’izindi ntebe makumyabiri n’enye, kandi zaari ziicaweho n’abakuru makumyabiri na bane, bambaye amakanzu yeera kandi ku mitwe yaabo bambaye amakamba y’izaahabu.
Kuri iyo ntebe y’ubwami haaturukagaho imirabyo, amajwi hamwe n’umuhindo w’inkuba, kandi imbere y’iyo ntebe y’ubwami haakaga amataara arindwi, ari yo myuka ndwi y’Imaana.
Imbere y’iyo ntebe y’ubwami hakaba ikintu gisa n’inyanja y’ikirahuri kibonerana. Iyo ntebe yari yiitooroowe kandi ikiikijwe ku mpande zombi n’ibinyabuzima bine, byuzuyeho amaaso imbere n’inyuma.
Ikinyabuzima ca mbere caasaga nk’intare, ica kabiri gisa nk’ikimasa, ikinyabuzima ca gatatu caari gifite mu maaso hasa nk’ah’abantu, naho ica kane caareebekaga nk’igisiiga kiguruka.

Buri kinyabuzima muri ibyo uko ari bine, caari gifite amababa atandatu, kandi byuzuye amaaso impande zoose hamwe no munda. Kumanywa na nijoro, ntibyaruhuukaga kuririmba biti, "Uweera, uweera, uweera, ni Nyagasani Imaana Ishoborabyose, uwahozeho, uriho kandi uzaahoraho."
Kandi buri uko ibyo binyabuzima byahaga ikuzo n’icuubahiro n’ishimwe uwari wiicaye ku ntebe y’ubwami, Uhoraho iteeka ryose,
ba bakuru makumyabiri na bane baapfukamaga imbere y’uwo wiicaye ku ntebe y’ubwami maze bakaramya Uhoraho iteeka ryose, bakajugunya haasi amakamba yaabo imbere ya ya ntebe, baririmba bati,
"Nyagasani Maana yaacu, ukwiriye guhaabwa icuubahiro n’ikuzo n’ububaasha, kuko ni wowe waremye byose, kandi ku bw’ubushaake bwawe biraremwa maze bibaho."
Nuuko mu kiganza c’uwiicaye ku ntebe y’ubwami, mbona umuzingo w’igitabo wanditswemo munda n’inyuma, ufungiishijwe ibimenyeetso birindwi.
Mbona malayika w’igihangage abaza mu ijwi rirenga ati, "Ni nde ukwiriye guca ibimenyeetso maze akabumbura uwo muzingo w’igitabo?"
Ariko ntihaagira n’umwe, yaaba uwo mu ijuru cangwa uwo ku isi cangwa uw’ikuzimu washoboye kubumbuura uwo muzingo cangwa ngo awureebemo.
Maze ndarira caane kuko hataabonetse ukwiriye kubumbuura uwo muzingo w’igitabo cangwa ngo awureebemo.

Nuuko umwe mu bakuru arambwira ati, "Reka kurira. Dore, Intare yo mu muryango wa Yuda, ukomooka kuri Dawudi atsinze urugamba, kugira ngo abumbuure uwo muzingo w’igitabo hamwe n’ibimenyeetso byawo birindwi."

Nuuko mbona hagati ya ya ntebe y’ubwami n’ibinyabuzima bine no muri ba bakuru Umwana w’Intama ahagaze asa nk’uwabaazwe. Yari afite amahembe arindwi n’amaaso arindwi, ari yo myuka ndwi yo Imaana yoohereje mu isi yoose.
Nuuko Umwana w’Intaama araaza maze yaakiira wa muzingo w’igitabo caari mu kiganza c’iburyo c’uwari wiicaye ku ntebe y’ubwami.

Amaze kwakiira wa muzingo w’igitabo, bya binyabuzima bine na ba bakuru makumyabiri na bane bapfukama imbere y’Umwana w’Intaama, buri umwe afashe inanga n’amabakure ya zaahabu yuuzuyemo imibavu, ari yo masengeesho y’abeera.

Baririmba indirimbo nsha, bavuga bati, "Ni wowe ukwiriye kwakiira uwo muzingo w’igitabo kandi ukwiriye no kuvaanaho ibimenyeetso biwufunze, kuko waratambwe maze ku bw’amaraso yaawe ucungura abantu ubagarurira Imaana bavuuye muri buri muryango, buri rurimi, buri gihugu, no mu mahanga yoose, kandi
wabagize abantu b’ubwami bw’Imaana, ubagira abaheerezabitambo bo guheereza Imaana, kandi baziima ingoma maze bategeke isi."
Nuuko ndareeba maze numva ijwi ry’abaamalayika benshi biitoorooye ya ntebe hamwe na bya binyabuzima na ba bakuru, umubare waabo wari ibihumbi n’ubuhumbagiza.
Baaririmbaga mu majwi aranguruye bati, "Umwana w’Intaama watambwe ni we ukwiriye guhaabwa ububaasha, ubukire n’ubuhanga n’imbaraga n’icuubahiro n’ikuzo n’ibisingizo!"

Maze numva buri kiremwa coose co mu ijuru no mu isi, n’ikuzimu no mu nyanja n’ibiyirimo byose biririmba biti, "Ishimwe n’icuubahiro n’ikuzo n’ubutware bibe iby’uwiicaye ku ntebe y’ubwami n’Umwana w’Intaama iteeka ryose!"
Maze bya binyabuzima bine birasubiza biti, "Amiina!" Ba bakuru na bo buubarara haasi maze baramya Imaana n’Umwana w’Intaama.
Nuuko mbona Umwana w’Intaama amena kimwe muri bya bimenyeetso birindwi, maze numva kimwe muri bya binyabuzima bine gihamagara caane mu ijwi nk’iry’inkuba kiti, "Ngwino!"
Ndareeba, maze mbona ifaraashi y’umweru! Uwari uyiicayeho yari afite umuheto, maze ahaabwa ikamba, nuuko aza ari umutsinzi, kandi agamije guhora atsinda.
Umwana w’Intaama amennye ikimenyeetso ca kabiri, numva ikinyabuzima ca kabiri gihamagara kiti, "Ngwino!"
Maze hasohoka indi faraashi itukura caane. Uwari uyiicayeho yahaawe ububaasha bwo kuvaana amahoro ku isi, kugira ngo abantu batsembane, nuuko ahaabwa inkoota nini.
Umwana w’Intaama amennye ikimenyeetso ca gatatu, numva ikinyabuzima ca gatatu gihamagara kiti, "Ngwino!" Ndareeba, maze mbona ifaraashi y’umukara! Uwari uyiicayeho yari afite umunzaani mu ntoki ze.

Maze numva ikimeze nk’ijwi hagati y’ibyo binyabuzima bine kivuga kiti, "Ikiro kimwe c’ingano zisanzwe kigurwe uruhembo rw’umubyizi, naho ibiro bitatu by’izindi ngano bigurwe uruhembo rw’umubyizi, ariko amavuta ya elayo na divaayi ntimubikoreho!"
Umwana w’Intaama amennye ikimenyeetso ca kane, numva ijwi ry’ikinyabuzima ca kane rivuga riti, "Ngwino!"

Maze ndeebye, mbona ifaraashi y’igitare igaajuutse! Uwari uyiicayeho yari yiitwa Rupfu, kandi Kuzimu yari amukurikiye. Nuuko bahaabwa ububaasha kuri kimwe ca kane c’abatuuye ku isi, ngo babiiciishe inkoota, inzara, indwara z’icoorezo, hamwe n’inyamaaswa z’inkazi zo ku isi.
Nuuko Umwana w’Intaama amennye ikimenyeetso ca gataanu, mbona munsi y’igicaaniro imyuka y’abiishwe bahoowe ijambo ry’Imaana n’ubuhamya bwo baari baaratanze.
Bataka mu ijwi rirenga bati, "Nyagasani Ushoborabyose, uweera w’ukuri! Uzaageza ryari kudaciira urubanza abantu batuuye isi no guhoorera amaraso yaacu baamennye?"
Nuuko buri umwe ahaabwa ikanzu y’umweru babwirwa kuruhuuka ikindi gihe gito, kugeza aho umubare w’abagaragu bagenzi baabo n’abavandimwe baabo bagiiye kwicwa nka bo uzuuzurira.

Ndareeba maze mbona Umwana w’Intaama amena ikimenyeetso ca gatandatu. Habaho umushitsi mwinshi caane, maze izuuba rihinduka umukara nk’umwambaro bambara mu cuunamo, naho ukwezi koose guhinduka nk’amaraso.
Inyenyeeri zo mu kireere zigwa ku isi, nk’uko imbuto z’umutiini zikiri mbisi zigwa iyo zihuushwe n’umuyaga mwinshi.
Ikireere gikuurwaho nk’uko umuzingo w’igitabo wiizinga, nuuko imisozi n’ibirwa bikuurwa mu myanya ya byo.
Maze abaami b’isi, abatware n’abakuru b’ingabo n’abakire n’abanyembaraga, imbaata n’abiigenga, boose biihisha mu buvumo no mu bitare byo mu misozi.
Baahamagaraga imisozi n’ibitare babibwira bati, "Nimutugweho maze muduhishe amaaso y’Uwiicaye ku ntebe y’ubwami hamwe n’umujinya w’Umwana w’Intaama,
kuko umunsi ukomeye w’umujinya waabo ugeze, kandi ni nde waashobora kuwurokoka?"

Haanyuma mbona abaamalayika bane bahagaze mu nshonda enye z’isi, bakumiiriye imiyaga enye yo ku isi kugira ngo hatagira umuyaga n’umwe muri yo uhuuha ku isi cangwa mu nyanja cangwa no ku giti na kimwe.
Maze mbona undi malayika azaamuuka ava iburasirazuuba, afite akabonero k’Imaana nzima, maze ahamagara mu ijwi rirenga ba baamalayika bane baari baahaawe ububaasha bwo kwangiiza isi n’inyanja,
maze arababwira ati, "Ntimwangiize isi cangwa inyanja cangwa ibiti mbere yuuko tumara gushira akabonero ku ruhanga rwa buri mugaragu w’Imaana yaacu."
Maze numva ko umubare w’abaashizweho ikimenyeetso c’Imaana ku ruhanga ari ibihumbi ijana na mirongo ine na bine kandi baari bavuuye mu miryango cumi n’ebyiri ya Isirayeli.

Abantu bo mu muryango wa Yuda baashizweho ikimenyeetso baari ibihumbi cumi na bibiri, abo mu muryango wa Rawubeeni baari ibihumbi cumi na bibiri, abo mu muryango wa Gadi baari ibihumbi cumi na bibiri,
abo mu muryango wa Asha baari ibihumbi cumi na bibiri, abo mu muryango wa Nafutaali baari ibihumbi cumi na bibiri, abo mu muryango wa Manase baari ibihumbi cumi na bibiri,
abo mu muryango wa Simiyooni baari ibihumbi cumi na bibiri, abo mu muryango wa Leevi baari ibihumbi cumi na bibiri, abo mu muryango wa Isakari baari ibihumbi cumi na bibiri,
abo mu muryango wa Zabulooni baari ibihumbi cumi na bibiri, abo mu muryango wa Yozefu baari ibihumbi cumi na bibiri, abo mu muryango wa Benjamiini baari ibihumbi cumi na bibiri.

Haanyuma y’ibyo ndareeba maze mbona abantu benshi caane batabarika, bo mu mahanga yoose no mu miryango yoose, no mu mooko yoose, no mu ndimi zoose, bahagaze imbere y’intebe y’Ubwami n’imbere y’Umwana w’Intaama, bambaye amakanzu y’umweru kandi bafashe amashami y’amatanda mu ntoki zaabo.
Bateera heejuru mu ijwi rirenga bati, "Agakiza kava ku Maana yaacu yiicaye ku ntebe y’Ubwami, no ku Mwana w’Intaama!"
Nuuko abaamalayika boose bahagarara biitoorooye ya ntebe y’Ubwami na ba bakuru hamwe na bya binyabuzima bine, maze biikubita haasi buubarara imbere ya ya ntebe y’Ubwami, maze baramya Imaana,
baririmba bati, "Amiina! Ibisingizo n’ikuzo n’ubuhanga n’ishimwe n’icuubahiro, imbaraga n’ububaasha bibe iby’Imaana yaacu iteeka ryose! Amiina."
Maze umwe mu bakuru arambaza ati, "Mbese aba bambaye amakanzu y’umweru ni bande kandi baturutse he?"
Nanje ndamusubiza nti, "Daatabuja, ni wowe ubiizi." Na we arambwira ati, "Aba n’abaanyuze muri kwa gutootezwa gukaze. Baameshe amakanzu yaabo bayeeza mu maraso y’Umwana w’Intaama.
Ku bw’iyo mpamvu, bari imbere y’intebe y’ubwami y’Imaana, kandi bamuramya amanywa na nijoro mu nzu yaayo, maze uwiicaye ku ntebe y’Ubwami akazaabarindiisha ihema rye.
Ntibazongera gusonza no kugira imyota ukundi, kandi ntibaziicwa n’izuuba cangwa icookeere coose,
kuko Umwana w’Intaama wiicaye hagati y’intebe y’Ubwami azaababeera umushumba, kandi azaabayobora ku migezi y’amaazi y’ubugingo, kandi Imaana izaahanagura amarira yoose ku maaso yaabo."
Ubwo Umwana w’Intaama yavanyeho ikimenyeetso ca karindwi, habaho guceceka mu ijuru kumara nk’igice c’isaaha.
Nuuko mbona ba baamalayika barindwi bahora bahagaze imbere y’Imaana, bahaabwa impanda ndwi.

Undi malayika wari ufite icotero gikozwe mu zaahabu ahagarara iruhande rw’igicaaniro. Ahaabwa imibavu myinshi kugira ngo yongerwe ku masengeesho y’abeera boose maze ayituura ku tambiro ry’izaahabu riri imbere ya ya ntebe y’ubwami.
Maze umwotsi w’imibavu urazaamuuka, hamwe n’amasengeesho y’abeera, biva mu biganza bya malayika wari uhagaze imbere y’Imaana.
Nuuko wa malayika afata ca cotero, acuuzuzamo umuriro arahuye ku tambiro, maze akijugunya ku isi. Inkuba zirahinda, habaho urusaku, imirabyo irarabya, n’isi ihinda umushitsi.
Maze ba baamalayika barindwi baari bafite za mpanda ndwi biiteguura kuzivuza.

Malayika wa mbere avuza impanda ye, maze haaza urubura n’umuriro bivanze n’amaraso, bijugunywa ku isi. Kimwe ca gatatu c’isi kirasha, na kimwe ca gatatu c’ibiti kirasha, n’ibyatsi bibisi byose birasha.
Malayika wa kabiri avuza impanda ye, maze ikintu kimeze nk’umusozi munini waaka umuriro kijugunywa mu nyanja.
Kimwe ca gatatu c’inyanja gihinduka amaraso, kimwe ca gatatu c’ibinyabuzima bituura mu nyanja kirapfa, kandi kimwe ca gatatu c’amaato kirarimburwa.
Malayika wa gatatu avuza impanda ye, maze inyenyeeri nini yaaka nk’itooki, imanuka mu ijuru maze igwa kuri kimwe ca gatatu c’inzuuzi no ku migezi y’amaazi.
Iyo nyenyeeri yiitwaga "Rushaariira". Kimwe ca gatatu c’amaazi kirashaariira, maze abantu benshi biicwa n’ayo maazi kuko yashaariiraga.

Nuuko malayika wa kane avuza impanda ye, maze kimwe ca gatatu c’izuuba na kimwe ca gatatu c’ukwezi, na kimwe ca gatatu c’inyenyeeri birakubitwa, maze kimwe ca gatatu c’iceererezi ca byo kiriijima, ku buryo kimwe ca gatatu c’umunsi n’ic’ijoro byacuze umwijima.

Nuuko ndareeba, maze numva impungu yagurukiraga heejuru mu kireere ivuga mu ijwi rirenga iti, "Mbeega ishano! Mbeega ishano! Mbeega ishano abatuuye isi bazaabona, ubwo ijwi rizaava mu mpanda zizaavuzwa n’abaamalayika batatu basigaye!"
Nuuko malayika wa gataanu avuza impanda ye. Mbona inyenyeeri yari yamanutse mu ijuru ikagwa ku isi, maze ihaabwa igishumuruzo co kuugurura ikuzimu.
Iyo nyenyeeri ko yuuguruye umuhonga , hacucumukamo umwotsi mwinshi, nk’umwotsi uva mu tanuura nini, maze izuuba n’ikireere bizimiishwa n’uwo mwotsi w’ikuzimu.
Nuuko muri uwo mwotsi havamo inzige zija ku isi, maze zihaabwa ububaasha nk’ubw’indyaniishamiriizo yo ku isi.
Zaabwiwe kutoonoona ibyatsi, ibimera bibisi, cangwa ibiti byo ku isi, keretse abo bantu batagira ikimenyeetso c’Imaana ku ruhanga rwabo boonyine.
Izo nzige zaahaawe ububaasha bwo kubababaza kumara ameezi ataanu, ariko ntizeemererwa kubiica, kandi uko kubababaza kwari nk’uko indyaniishamiriizo ibabaza umuntu iyo imurumye.
Muri iyo minsi, abantu bazaashaaka urupfu ariko ntibazaarubona, baziifuuza gupfa, ariko urupfu ruzaabahunga.
Izo nzige zaari zimeze nk’ifaraashi zambariye urugamba. Ku mitwe yaazo haari igisa nk’ikamba ya zaahabu, naho mu maaso haazo haasaga nk’ah’abantu.
Ubwoya bwazo bwasaga nk’umusatsi w’abagore, naho ameenyo yaazo akamera nk’ay’intare.
Ibituuza byazo byari bikingirijwe n’igisa nk’icuuma, naho urusaku rw’amababa yaazo rwari rumeze nk’urusaku rw’amagaare y’amafaraashi menshi agiiye ku rugamba.
Zaari zifite imiriizo isa nk’iy’indyaniishamiriizo n’imbuuri mu miriizo yaazo, kandi muri iyo miriizo hakabamo ububaasha bwo kugirira naabi abantu kumara ameezi ataanu.
Zifite umwami uzitegeka, ari we malayika ukuriye umuhonga, mu Ruheburaayo yiitwa Abadoni naho mu Rugiriki akiitwa Apoliyoni.
Icaago ca mbere kirarangiye. Dore hagiiye gukurikiraho ibindi byago bibiri.
Nuuko malayika wa gatandatu avuza impanda ye, maze numva ijwi riturutse mu mahembe ane y’itambiro rya zaahabu riri imbere y’Imaana.
Iryo jwi ribwira malayika wa gatandatu riti, "Rekura abaamalayika bane babohewe ku ruuzi runini rwa Efurate."
Nuuko ba baamalayika bane bararekurwa, kuko kuri iyo saaha, uwo munsi, uko kwezi, n’uwo mwaka, baari abo kwica kimwe ca gatatu c’abantu.
Nabwiwe yuuko umubare w’abasirikare barwanira ku mafaraashi baari miliyoni magana abiri.

Dore uku ni ko neeretswe mu nzozi, ayo mafaraashi n’abayagenderagaho. Abaayagenderagaho baari bambaye ibyuma bikingira igituuza bisa n’umuriro, n’ubururu nka safiro n’umuhondo nk’amazuuku. Imitwe y’ayo mafaraashi yari imeze nk’imitwe y’intare, kandi mu kanwa kaayo haavagamo umuriro, umwotsi, n’amazuuku.
Kimwe ca gatatu c’abantu ciicwa n’ibyo byorezo bitatu, ari byo umuriro, umwotsi n’amazuuku bivuuye mu kanwa k’ayo mafaraashi.
Kuko imbaraga z’ayo mafaraashi zaaturukaga mu minwa no mu miriizo yaayo, imiriizo yaayo yasaga n’inzoka ifite imitwe yo yakoreeshaga kugirira abantu naabi.

Abantu baari basigaye batiishwe n’ibyo byorezo, ntibaaretse kuramya ibyo biikoreye n’intoki zaabo cangwa ngo bareke kuramya abadayimooni n’ibishushaanyo bikozwe mu izaahabu no mu ifeeza, no mu miringa no mu mabuye no mu biti, bitabaasha kureeba cangwa kumva cangwa kugenda.
Maze banga no kwihana ibyaha byabo by’ubwicanyi no kuroga, hamwe n’ubusambanyi n’ubujuura.
Nuuko mbona undi malayika ukomeye amanuka ava mu ijuru yizingiranyije mu gicu, kandi umukororombya wari ku mutwe we. Mu maaso he haari hasa n’izuuba, kandi ibirenge bye byasaga nk’inkingi z’umuriro.
Yari afite akazingo k’igitabo mu ntoki ze kabumbuuye. Ashira ikirenge ce c’iburyo ku nyanja, ic’ibumoso agishira ku butaka,
maze ateera heejuru mu ijwi riranguruye, nk’iry’intare itontoma. Amaze guteera heejuru, inkuba ndwi nazo zirahinda.
Izo nkuba ndwi zimaze guhinda, nari ndi haafi kwandika, ariko numva ijwi rivugira mu ijuru riti, "Ibyo izo nkuba ndwi zivuze ubigire ibanga, ntubyandike!"
Maze mbona wa malayika wari uhagaze ku nyanja no ku butaka amanika ukuboko kwe kw’iburyo, akwerekeza ku ijuru
maze arahira mu izina ry’Uhoraho iteeka ryose, uwaremye ijuru n’ibiririmo, n’isi n’ibiyirimo, n’inyanja n’ibiyirimo, avuga ati, "Ntakindi gihe gisigaye,
ahuubwo igihe co malayika wa karindwi azaavugiriza impanda ye, iyobera ry' Imaana ni ho rizuuzurizwa, nk’uko yabibwiye abagaragu be hamwe n’abahanuuzi."
Nuuko rya jwi nari numviise rituruka mu ijuru ryongera kumbwira riti, "Genda ufate umuzingo w’igitabo ubumbuuwe uri mu ntoki za malayika uhagaze ku nyanja no ku butaka."
Nuuko nsanga wa malayika musaba kumpa ako kazingo k’igitabo, maze nawe aransubiza ati, "Gashikiire maze ukarye. Kazaagushaariirira mu nda yaawe, ariko karyoherere nk’ubuuki mu kanwa kaawe."
Nuuko mfata ako kazingo k’igitabo ngakuuye mu kiganza ca malayika maze ndakarya. Mu kanwa kanje karyohereraga nk’ubuuki, ariko maze kukarya, mu nda yanje harashaariirirwa.
Maze barambwira bati, "Ugomba kongera guhanuura iby’amahanga n’amooko n’indimi n’abaami."
Nuuko mpaabwa inkoni imeze nk’igiti co gupimiisha, maze barambwira bati, "Ngwino upime Inzu y’Imaana n’itambiro kandi ubare n’abasengeramo,
ariko igikaari kiri hanze y’Inzu y’Imaana ukireke wekugipima kuko caahaawe abanyamahanga, kandi azaacundagura itawuni nkuru yeera kumara ameezi mirongo ine n’abiri.
Nzaaha abahamya banje babiri ububaasha bwo guhanuura kumara iminsi igihumbi kimwe na magana abiri na mirongo itandatu, bambaye imyambaro nk’iy’icuunamo."
Abo bahamya ni bo biti bibiri by’umutiini n’ibitereko by’amataara bibiri, bihagaze imbere y’Umwami w’isi.
Kandi hagize umuntu ushaaka kugirira naabi abo bahamya, umuriro uzaabava mu kanwa maze utsembe abanzi baabo. Umuntu weese ushaaka kubagirira naabi, uko ni ko agomba kuziicwa.

Bafite ububaasha bwo guhagarika ikireere, kugira ngo imvura itagwa mu minsi yo bazaaba bahanuura, kandi bafite ububaasha bwo guhindura amaazi amaraso, n’ubwo guteeza isi ibyorezo by’uburyo bwinshi, uko babishaaka.
Igihe bazaaba barangije gutanga ubuhamya, ikinyamaaswa kizaamuutse kivuuye ikuzimu kizaabarwanya, kibatsinde kandi kibiice.
Imirambo y’abo bahamya babiri izaarambarara mu nzira y’itawuni nkuru y’icaamamare, yiitwa Sodomu na Igiputi mu mvugo y’amarenga, ari naho Umwami waabo yabambiwe.
Abantu bo mu bihugu byose, n’amooko yoose, n’indimi zoose, n’amahanga yoose, bazaamara iminsi itatu n’igice, batumbiira iyo mirambo kandi beekwemera ko ishirwa mu mva.
Abari mu isi baziishiimira urupfu rw’abo bahamya bombi, baneezeerwe, bahaane impaano, kuko abo bahamya bombi baari baarababaje abatuuye ku isi.
Ariko nyuma y’iminsi itatu n’igice, umwuka w’ubuzima uturuka ku Maana winjira muri abo bahamya babiri. Barahaguruka maze abaababoonye boose bateerwa n’ubwoba bwinshi caane.
Nuuko bumva ijwi riranguruye riturutse mu ijuri rivuga riti, "Nimuuze hano!" Nuuko abo bahamya bazaamuuka mu bicu baja mu ijuru, abanzi baabo babareeba.

Ako kaanya habaho umushitsi w’ikirenga, maze kimwe ca cumi c’iyo tawuni nkuru kirariduka. Abantu ibihumbi birindwi biicwa na wa mushitsi, maze abasigaye bateerwa n’ubwoba basingiza Imaana yo mu ijuru.
Icaago ca kabiri kirarangiye. Dore icaago ca gatatu kirenda kuuza vuba.
Malayika wa karindwi avuza impanda, nuuko mu ijuru humviikana ijwi rirenga, rivuga riti, "Ubwami bw’isi bubaaye Ubwami bw’Umwami waacu n’ubwa Kristo, kandi aziima ingoma iteeka ryose."
Nuuko ba bakuru makumyabiri na bane biicara ku ntebe zaabo imbere y’Imaana, buubama haasi maze baramya Imaana,
bavuga bati, "Turagushiima, Nyagasani Maana Ishoborabyose, wowe uriho kandi wahozeho, kuko wakoreesheje ububaasha bwawe bukomeye maze wima ingoma yaawe.

Amahanga yuuzuye ikiraakari, ariko uburaakari bwawe buragaragara, kandi igihe ni ico guciira imanza abaapfuuye, no guhemba abagaragu baawe, b’abahanuuzi n’abantu baawe n’abo boose batiinya izina ryawe, abooroheje n’abakomeye, n’igihe co kurimburiramo abarimbura isi."
Nuuko Inzu y’Imaana iri mu ijuru irakinguurwa, maze isanduku y’iseezerano iboneka muri iyo Nzu y’Imaana. Ubwo habaho imirabyo, guhinda kw’inkuba, umushitsi, n’urubura rwinshi.
Nuuko ikimenyeetso gikomeye kigaragara mu ijuru. Mbona umugore wambaye izuuba, ukwezi kuri munsi y’ibirenge bye, kandi ku mutwe yari yambaye ikamba ry’inyenyeeri cumi n’ebyiri.
Yari atwite kandi atakiishwa n’ibise byo kubyara.
Nuuko mu ijuru hagaragara ikindi kimenyeetso. Caari ikiyoka kinini kandi gitukura, gifite imitwe irindwi n’amahembe cumi, n’ikamba kuri buri mutwe.

Umuriizo waaco ukondoorera haasi kimwe ca gatatu c’inyenyeeri zo mu ijuru kizijugunya ku isi. Nuuko ico kiyoka gihagarara imbere y’uwo mugore wari weegeereje kubyara, kugira ngo kirye umwana akimara kuvuuka.
Nuuko abyara umwana w’umuhungu, uzaategekeesha amahanga yoose inkoni y’icuuma. Ico kiyoka nticaariiye uwo mwana, ahuubwo yarasahuwe ajanwa mu ijuru ku Maana no ku ntebe yaayo y’ubwami.
Uwo mugore ahungira mu butaayu, mu mwanya wo Imaana yari yaramuteguuriye, ngo abe ariho areebeererwa kumara iminsi igihumbi magana abiri mirongo itandatu.
Nuuko habaho intambara mu ijuru. Mikayeli n’abaamalayika be barwanya ca kiyoka. Ikiyoka na co ciifatanya n’abaamalayika baaco kubarwanya,
ariko biratsindwa, kandi ntibyongera kugira umwanya mu ijuru.

Ca kiyoka kinini kijugunywa haasi, hamwe n’abaamalayika baaco, ari co ya nzoka ya keera yiitwa Umwanzi cangwa Sataani, wa wundi uyobya abo ku isi yoose. Yajugunywe ku isi hamwe n’abaamalayika be boose.

Haanyuma numva ijwi rirenga riturutse mu ijuru, rivuga riti, "Nooneho igihe c’agakiza kirasohoye. Gisohoranye n’ububaasha n’Ubwami bw’Imaana yaacu hamwe n’ubutware bwa Kristo waayo, kuko umurega wahoraga arega abavandimwe baacu ku Maana yaacu buri gihe ajugunywe haasi.
Abavandimwe baacu baamutsindiishije amaraso y’Umwana w’Intaama hamwe n’ijambo ry’ubutumwa bwabo. Ntibaakunze amagara yaabo, kuko baari biiteguuye gutanga ubuzima bwabo ngo biicwe.

Nuuko reero, ishiime wa juru we, namwe mwese abarituuyemo! Naho mwebwe mutuuye ku isi n’inyanja, muguushije ishano, kuko Sataani yabamanukiye afite umujinya mwinshi, kuko azi yuuko ashigaje igihe gito!"
Ca kiyoka kiboonye ko kijugunywe ku isi, gitangira guhiiga wa mugore wabyaye umwana w’umuhungu.
Ariko uwo mugore ahaabwa amababa abiri y’igisiiga kinini, kugira ngo aguruke aje mu butaayu, aho azaarindirwa kumara imyaka itatu n’igice, kugira ngo ico kiyoka kitagira ico kimutwara.
Nuuko ca kiyoka giciira amaazi ameze nk’uruuzi inyuma ya wa mugore, kugira ngo umwuzure umutembane.
Ariko isi iramutabaara, ubutaka buraasama maze bumira rwa ruuzi rwari rwaciiwe kuva mu kanwa ka ca kiyoka.
Nuuko ikiyoka kiraakarira wa mugore, maze kiragenda ngo kirwanye abasigaye b’urubyaro rwe, buubahiriza amategeko y’Imaana kandi bagakomerera ku buhamya bwa Yesu.
Haanyuma ca kiyoka gihagarara ku museenyi wo ku nkengeero y’inyanja.
Nuuko mbona ikinyamaaswa kizaamuuka mu nyanja. Caari gifite amahembe cumi n’imitwe irindwi. Buri hembe ryaco ryari rifite igitaako, kandi buri mutwe waaco wariho izina rituka Imaana.

Ico kinyamaaswa naboonye caari gisa n’ingwe, amajanja yaaco asa n’ay’idubu, naho urwasaya rwaco ari nk’urw’intare. Nuuko ca kiyoka giha ico kinyamaaswa ububaasha bwaco, intebe yaaco y’ubwami n’ubutegetsi bukomeye.
Umwe muri ya mitwe yaaco wareebekaga nk’uwakomeretse caane, ariko ico gisebe caari caarakize. Nuuko ab’isi boose baratangaara maze bayoboka ca kinyamaaswa.
Boose baramya ico kiyoka, kuko caahaaye ico kinyamaaswa ububaasha, nuuko baramya n’ico kinyamaaswa bavuga bati, "Ntaamuntu ufite imbaraga nk’iz’iki kinyamaaswa. Ntaan’uwakirwanya ngo agishobore."
Nuuko ico kinyamaaswa ceemererwa kwiraata no kuvuga amagambo yo gutuka Imaana, kandi gihaabwa ubwo bubaasha kumara ameezi mirongo ine n’abiri.
Gitangira gutuka Imaana, gituka izina ryayo n’aho ituuye, n’abo boose batuuye mu ijuru.
Ceemerewe kurwanya abantu b’Imaana no kubatsinda, gihaabwa n’ububaasha ku mooko yoose n’abantu boose n’indimi zoose n’amahanga yoose.
Abari mu isi boose bazaakiramya, keretse abo amazina yaabo yanditswe mu gitabo c’ubugingo isi itaraaremwa, anari co gitabo c’Umwana w’Intaama wiishwe.
"Nimwumve reero, niiba mufite amatwi!
Niiba Imaana yarageneye umuntu kujanwa mu bunyage, azaajanwa mu bunyage. Kandi uwagenewe kwiciishwa inkoota aziiciishwa inkoota. Abantu b’Imaana reero, barasabwa kwihangaana no kwizeera."
Nuuko mbona ikindi kinyamaaswa gituruka mu butaka. Caari gifite amahembe abiri ameze nk’ay’umwana w’intaama kandi kikavuga nk’ikiyoka.
Gikoreesha ububaasha bwose bw’ikinyamaaswa ca mbere na co kibireeba, maze gihata abantu bo mu isi boose kuramya ca kinyamaaswa ca mbere, caari caarakize igisebe.
Ikinyamaaswa ca kabiri gikora ibitangaaza, kugeza n’aho kimanura umuriro kuva mu ijuru ukagwa ku isi, abantu boose babireeba.

Bityo reero kiyobya abantu batuuye ku isi ku bwo kwemererwa gukora ibitangaaza ikinyamaaswa ca mbere kibireeba. Nuuko kibabwira gukora igishushaanyo c’ikinyamaaswa caari caarakomerekejwe n’inkoota, kikarenga kikabaho.
Nuuko ikinyamaaswa ca kabiri ceemererwa guhuumeekera muri ico gishushaanyo c’ikinyamaaswa, kugira ngo gishobore kuvuga kandi ciice abadashobora kukiramya.
Ico kinyamaaswa gihata abantu boose, abooroheje n’abakomeye, abakire n’abakene, abiigenga n’imbaata, gushirwaho ikimenyeetso ku kiganza c’iburyo cangwa ku ruhanga,
kugira ngo hatagira uweemererwa kugura cangwa kuguriisha adafite ico kimenyeetso, ari co zina ry’ico kinyamaaswa cangwa umubare uhagarariye iryo zina.
Aha hiifuuzwa ubwenge bwinshi. Umunyabwenge reero n’abare umubare w’ico kinyamaaswa kuko ari umubare uhagarariye izina ry’umuntu. Umubare waaco ni magana atandatu mirongo itandatu n’itandatu.
Nuuko mbona Umwana w’Intaama ahagaze ku musozi wa Siyoni. Yari ari n’abantu ibihumbi ijana na mirongo ine na bine, baari bafite izina rye ndetse n’irya Se byanditswe ku buhanga bwabo.
Haanyuma numva ijwi riturutse mu ijuru rimeze nk’iry’amaazi menshi kandi rimeze nk’inkuba ihinda caane. Iryo jwi numviise ryari rimeze nk’iry’abacuranzi bacuranga inanga zaabo.

Abo bantu ibihumbi ijana na mirongo ine na bine baririmba indirimbo nsha imbere y’intebe y’ubwami n’imbere y’ibinyabuzima bine n’imbere y’abakuru. Ntaamuntu washoboye kwiga iyo ndirimbo keretse ba bantu ibihumbi ijana na mirongo ine na bine, abo Imaana yacunguye mu isi.
Abo bagabo ntaabwo biyanduje no gusambana n’abagore kuko baari isugi. Bakurikira Umwana w’Intaama aho agiiye hoose. Ni abantu baacunguwe mu bandi nk’umuganura w’Imaana n’Umwana w’Intaama.
Ntibiigeze kuvuga ibinyoma, ni abaziranenge.
Nuuko mbona undi malayika agurukira hagati mu kireere, afite Ubutumwa Bwiza bwo kubwira abantu bo ku isi, abo mu mahanga yoose, ab’amooko yoose, ab’indimi zoose n’ibihugu byose.
Avuga mu ijwi rirenga ati, "Nimwubahe Imaana kandi muyihe icuubahiro, kuko igihe caayo co guca imanza kirageze. Nimuramye iyaremye ijuru n’isi hamwe n’inyanja n’imigezi y’amaazi."

Nuuko malayika wa kabiri akurikira malayika wa mbere, avuga ati, "Iraguuye, iraguuye Babilooni, itawuni nkuru y’icaamamare! Yanywesheje abantu baayo divaayi ikarishe y’irari ry’ubusambanyi, ari yo divaayi izana uburaakari bw’Imaana."

Nuuko undi malayika wa gatatu akurikira abaamalayika ba mbere babiri, maze avuga mu ijwi rirenga ati, "Abaramya ikinyamaaswa hamwe n’igishushaanyo caaco bagashirwaho ikimenyeetso ku gahanga cangwa ku kiganza caabo,
bazanywa ku divaayi y’uburaakari bw’Imaana, yasutswe mu gikopu c’uburaakari bwayo itavanze. Bazaababazwa n’umuriro ugurumana imbere y’abaamalayika beera hamwe n’imbere y’Umwana w’Intaama.
Umwotsi w’umuriro bazaababarizwamo uzaahora ucumba iteeka ryose. Abaramya ikinyamaaswa n’ishusho yaaco n’abazaashirwaho ikimenyeetso c’izina ryaco, ntibaruhuuka kubabazwa amanywa na n’ijoro."
Ibi byose bimenyeesha ko abantu buubaha amategeko y’Imaana, bagakomeza gukurikiza ibya Yesu, bakwiriye kwihangaana.

Nuuko numva ijwi riturutse mu ijuru rimbwira riti, "Andika uti, ‘Uheereye ubu, hahiirwa abapfa bapfiira muri Nyagasani Yesu!’ " Umwuka w’Imaana na we aravuga ati, "Ni koko, bazaaruhuuka imibabaro yaabo, kuko imirimo yaabo ibaherekeza."
Nuuko ndareeba maze mbona igicu ceererana. Uwari kuri ico gicu yasaga nk’Umwana w’Umuntu, yambaye ikamba ry’izaahabu ku mutwe we kandi yari afite umuhoro utyaye mu kiganza ce.

Undi malayika ava mu Nzu y’Imaana, ahamagara uwari wiicaye ku gicu n’ijwi rirenga amubwira ati, "Koreesha umuhoro waawe maze usaaruure, kuko igihe co gusaaruura kigeze, kandi imyaka yo ku isi yo gusaaruurwa ireeze."
Nuuko uwari wiicaye heejuru y’igicu atemeesha umuhoro we, maze imyaka yo ku isi irasaaruurwa.
Haanyuma undi malayika ava mu Nzu y’Imaana yo mu ijuru, kandi na we yari afite umuhoro utyaye.

Nuuko undi malayika wari ufite ububaasha ku muriro aturuka mu tambiro, maze ahamagara uwari afite umuhoro utyaye mu ijwi rirenga ati, "Koreesha umuhoro waawe utyaye maze ugese ibirundo by’imizaabibu y’isi, kuko imbuto zaayo zihiiriranye!"
Nuuko uwo malayika atemeesha umuhoro we utyaye maze asaaruura imbuto z’imizaabibu y’isi, azijugunya mu rwengero rw’uburaakari bw’Imaana.
Iyo mizaabibu ikamirwa hanze y’itawuni nkuru, maze mu rwengero havamo ikidendeezi c’amaraso kingana na kilomita magana atatu ubureebure hamwe na mita ebyiri kuja haasi.
Nuuko mbona mu ijuru ikindi kimenyeetso gikomeye kandi gitangaaje. Caari abaamalayika barindwi bafite ibyago birindwi ari byo byanyuma, kuko muri byo uburaakari bw’Imaana ni mwo buzaashirira.

Maze mbona ikimeze nk’inyanja y’ikirahuri kivanze n’umuriro. Nongera kubona abaatsinze ca kinyamaaswa n’ishusho yaaco hamwe n’umubare w’izina ryaco, bahagaze iruhande rw’iyo nyanja y’ikirahuri, bafite inanga z’Imaana mu ntoki zaabo,

maze baririmba indirimbo ya Moose, umugaragu w’Imaana hamwe n’indirimbo y’Umwana w’Intaama bati, "Nyagasani Maana Ishoborabyose, ibikorwa byawe birakomeye kandi biratangaaje! Mwami w’amahanga yoose, inzira zaawe ziratungaanye kandi ni iz’ukuri!
Nyagasani, ni nde utazaatiinya kandi ntaahimbaaze izina ryawe? Kuko ni wowe weenyine weera. Amahanga yoose azaaza maze akuramye, kuko ibikorwa byawe bitungaanye bigaragajwe."
Haanyuma mbona mu ijuru Inzu y’Imaana yarimo ihema ry’ubuhamya ikinguuka,
maze muri ya Nzu y’Imaana havamo ba baamalayika barindwi bafite bya byago birindwi, bambaye imyenda y’umweru itanduye kandi irabagirana. Ibituuza byabo byari bikingirijwe n’imishumi y’izaahabu.
Nuuko kimwe muri bya binyabuzima bine giha abo baamalayika barindwi amabakure arindwi yuuzuye uburaakari bw’Imaana ihoraho iteeka ryose.
Ya Nzu y’Imaana yuuzura umwotsi w’ikuzo n’imbaraga by’Imaana, ntihaagira n’umwe ushobora kwinjira mu Nzu y’Imaana kugeza aho ibyago birindwi by’abaamalayika barindwi byarangiriye.
Nuuko numva ijwi riranguruye rituruka mu Nzu y’Imaana ribwira ba baamalayika barindwi riti, "Nimugende maze musuke ku isi ayo mabakure arindwi y’uburaakari bw’Imaana."

Malayika wa mbere aragenda maze asuka ku isi ibyari biri mu bakure ye nuuko abantu baari bafite ikimenyeetso c’ikinyamaaswa kandi bakaramya n’igishushaanyo caayo, bafatwa n’ibisebe by’imifunzo bibabaza caane.
Malayika wa kabiri asuka mu nyanja ibyari biri mu bakure ye, maze inyanja yoose ihinduka nk’amaraso y’umuntu wapfuuye, nuuko ikinyabuzima coose caari kiri mu nyanja kirapfa.
Malayika wa gatatu asuka mu nzuuzi n’imigezi y’amaazi ibyari biri mu bakure ye, maze bihinduka amaraso.
Nuuko numva malayika ushinzwe amaazi abwira Imaana ati, "Uri umutabeera wa Weera we, wowe uriho kandi wahozeho, kuko waciiye urubanza utabeera.
Baamennye amaraso y’abantu b’Imaana n’ay’abahanuuzi, noone ubahaaye amaraso ngo bayanywe. Bahaawe icaari kibakwiriye."
Nuuko numva ijwi riturutse ku tambiro rivuga riti, "Yeego Nyagasani Maana Ishoborabyose, uca imanza z’ukuri n’ubutabeera!"
Malayika wa kane asuka ibyari biri mu bakure ye ku zuuba, maze Imaana yeemerera izuuba kookeesha abantu umuriro wa ryo.
Abantu bookejwe n’ubushuuhe bwinshi, maze batuka izina ry’Imaana yari ifite ububaasha bwo guteeza ibi byago, kandi ntibiihana no guha Imaana icuubahiro.
Malayika wa gataanu asuka ibyari biri mu bakure ye ku ntebe y’ubwami bwa ca kinyamaaswa, ubwami bwaco buhinduka umwijima, maze abantu bahekenya indimi zaabo kubeera ububabare,
nuuko batuka Imaana yo mu ijuru, babiteewe n’ububabare n’ibisebe, kandi ntibiihana ibikorwa byabo bibi.
Malayika wa gatandatu asuka ibyari biri mu bakure ye mu ruuzi runini rwa Efurate, maze amaazi yarwo arakama kugira ngo hateguurwe inzira y’abaami baturuka iburasirazuuba.
Nuuko mbona imyuka mibi itatu imeze nk’imitubu iva mu kanwa ka ca kiyoka, mu kanwa ka ca kinyamaaswa no mu kanwa ka wa muhanuuzi w’ibinyoma.
Iyo ni ya myuka y’abadayimooni ikora ibitangaaza, igasanga abaami bo mu isi yoose, kugira ngo ibakoranyirize kuzaaja mu ntambara kuri wa munsi ukomeye w’Imaana Ishoborabyose.
(Nyagasani aravuze ati, "Dore! Ndaaje nk’umujuura! Hahiirwa uba maaso agahora yambaye, kugira ngo atagenda yambaye ubusa, maze abantu bakabona ubwambure bwe akamwara.")
Nuuko ya myuka ikoranyiriza hamwe ba baami, mu mwanya wiitwa Harimagedoni mu rurimi rw’Uruheburaayo.
Malayika wa karindwi asuka ibyari biri mu bakure ye mu kireere, maze ijwi riranguruye rituruka ku ntebe y’ubwami mu Nzu y’Imaana, riravuga riti, "Birarangiye!"
Nuuko haaza imirabyo, urusaku no guhinda kw’inkuba, n’imishitsi. Ntihiigeze kubaho umushitsi nk’uyu kuva abantu baaba ku isi. Uyu ni wo mushitsi ukomeye wabaayeho kuruta iyindi yoose.

Itawuni nkuru y’icaamamare isadukamo gatatu, nuuko amatawuni makuru y’amahanga yoose araseenyuka. Imaana ntaabwo yiibagiwe Babilooni y’icaamamare, nuuko iyiha kunywera ku gikopu cuuzuye divaayi y’uburaakari bwayo.
Nuuko ibirwa byose birahunga, n’imisozi yoose irabura.
Urubura ruremeereye, rungana n’ibilo mirongo itaanu buri rumwe, rumanukira abantu ruvuuye mu ijuru, kugeza ubwo batuka Imaana ku bw’ico caago c’urubura caari gitinyiishije caane.

Nuuko umwe muri ba baamalayika barindwi baari bafite amabakure arindwi araaza maze arambwira ati, "Ngwino nkwereke igihano Imaana igiiye guha ya ndaaya kaabuhariwe, ari yo tawuni y’icaamamare yuubatswe ku nkengeero y’amaazi magari.
Abaami bo ku isi baasambanye na yo, kandi abantu bo ku isi basindiishwa no kunywa divaayi y’ubusambanyi bwayo."
Nuuko ntwarwa mu mwuka, maze wa malayika anjaana mu butaayu. Mbona umugore yiicaye ku kinyamaaswa gitukura, cuuzuyeho amazina atuka Imaana, kandi gifite imitwe irindwi n’amahembe cumi.

Uwo mugore yari yambaye umwenda w’umuhengeri n’umutuku, kandi arimbiishijwe n’izaahabu, amabuye y’agaciiro n’amasimbi. Mu kiganza ce yari afite igikopu ca zaahabu cuuzuyemo amahano n’imyanda y’ubusambanyi bwe.
Mu ruhanga rwe haari handitswe izina ry’amayoberane ngo: "Babilooni ikomeye, nyina w’indaaya n’ibizira byo ku isi."
Nuuko mbona ko wa mugore yasinze amaraso y’abeera n’amaraso y’abaahoowe Yesu. Ko namuboonye, ndatangaara caane.
Ariko malayika arambaza ati, "Utangaajwe n’iki? Ndakumenera ibanga ry’uriiya mugore n’iry’ikinyamaaswa kimuheetse, gifite imitwe irindwi n’amahembe cumi.

Ikinyamaaswa waboonye ciigeze kubaho ariko ubu ntikikiriho. Ubu kigiiye kuva imuhonga kugira ngo kirimburwe. Abatuuye ku isi bo amazina yaabo atanditswe mu gitabo c’ubugingo kuva isi itaraaremwa, bazaatangaara nibabona ico kinyamaaswa, kuko ciigeze kubaho, noone kikaba kitakiriho, ariko kikazongera kubaho.
Aha ni ho hakwiriye ubwenge n’ubuhanga: Iyo mitwe irindwi ni yo misozi irindwi uwo mugore yiicayeho, kandi ikaba n’abaami barindwi.
Bataanu muri abo baami ntibakiriho, umwe ari ku ngoma ubu, naho undi ntaaraaza, kandi naaza agomba kuzaaba umwami akaanya gato.
Kandi ico kinyamaaswa caabaayeho ariko kikaba kitakiriho, ni umwami wa munaane, ni umwe muri ba bandi barindwi kandi agiiye kurimburwa.
Ya mahembe cumi waboonye ni abaami cumi batari baatangira gutegeka, ariko bakazaahaabwa ububaasha bwo gutegeka nk’abaami hamwe n’ikinyamaaswa kumara akaanya gato.
Boose uko ari icumi baahuuje umugambi wo kwegurira ikinyamaaswa ububaasha n’ubushobozi bwabo.
Bazaarwanya Umwana w’Intaama, ariko we hamwe n’abo yahamagaye, abo yatooranyije n’abayoboke be b’indahemuka bazaabatsinda, kuko ari Umwami w’abaami n’Umutegetsi w’abategetsi."
Malayika yongera kumbwira ati, "Amaazi waboonye ya ndaaya yiicayeho, ni amahanga, abantu, amooko n’indimi z’abo ku isi yoose.
Amahembe cumi waboonye, hamwe n’ikinyamaaswa, bizanga iyo ndaaya. Bizaayambura ibyo ifite yambare ubusa. Bizaarya inyama zaayo maze ibisigarizwa bitwikwe mu muriro.
Kuko Imaana yashize mu mitima yabyo umugambi wo gufatanyiriza hamwe maze bigaha ikinyamaaswa ububaasha bwo gutegeka, kugeza igihe amagambo y’Imaana azaasohorera.
Uwo mugore waboonye ni itawuni nkuru y’icaamamare itegeka abaami bo ku isi."
Haanyuma yo kureeba wa mugore wari wiicaye ku kinyamaaswa gitukura, mbona undi malayika amanuka mu ijuru. Yari afite ububaasha bukomeye, maze isi imurikirwa n’ububengerane bw’ikuzo rye.

Nuuko arangurura ijwi rirenga ati, "Babilooni iraseenyutse, iraseenyutse Babilooni itawuni nkuru y’icaamamare! Yahindutse ubutaaho bw’abadayimooni n’imyuka mibi yoose, kandi inyoni n’inyamaaswa zoose zihumaanya ni ho zicumbika.
Amahanga yoose yanyooye divaayi ikaze y’uburaakari bw’ubusambanyi bwayo. Abaami bo ku isi baasambanye na yo, kandi n’abacuruuzi bo ku isi baakungahajwe n’ubukire butagira urugero."
Nuuko numva irindi jwi rivugira mu ijuru riti, "Bantu banje, nimusohoke muri Babilooni! Kugira ngo mutiivanga mu byaha byayo, maze mugasangira na yo ibihano biyigenewe!
Kuko ibyaha byayo byirundanyije bikagera ku ijuru, kandi Imaana yiibutse ibikorwa byayo bibi.
Nimuyikorere ibihwanye n’ibyo yakoze, kandi muyituure ibyo yabakoreye inshuro ebyiri. Muyuuzuririze mu gikopu ico kunywa gikaze inshuro ebyiri kuruta ico yuuzuririzaga abandi.

Aho Babilooni yagejeje yiiha ikuzo no kudamarara, abe ari ho mugeza kuyiteeza umubabaro n’agahinda. Kuko ikomeza kwibwira iti, ‘Dore niicaye ku ngoma yanje nk’umwamikazi! Si ndi umupfaakazi, kandi sinteze kuzaagira agahinda!’
Kuko Babilooni yiikujije ityo, igiiye kugwirwa n’ibyago vuba, ari byo, urupfu, icuunamo n’inzara. Kandi izaatwikwa n’umuriro, kuko Nyagasani Imaana, uyiciira urubanza ari umunyambaraga."
Maze abaami bo ku isi baari baarasambanye n’iyo ndaaya bakadamarara na yo, bazaayiririra baborooge ubwo bazaaabona umwotsi w’umuriro uyitwika.

Bazaahagarara kure, kubwo gutiinya kubabazwa hamwe na yo, maze bavuge bati, "Mbeega ishano! Mbeega ishano! Babilooni, itawuni nkuru y’icaamamare kandi y’igihangaage kubona igihano caawe kiiziye mu saaha imwe yoonyine! "
Abacuruuzi bo ku isi na bo bazaayiririra baje mu cuunamo, kuko ntaawe uzaaba akigura ibicuruuzwa byabo,

by’izaahabu, ifeeza, n’amasaro meeza, amasimbi, imyambaro y’umweru n’itukura ikozwe mu bitambaro bihenze, amooko y’ibiti byose bihuumura neeza, ibikozwe mu meenyo y’inzovu no mu biti bihenze, umuringa, ubutare n’ibuye ryiza ryitwa mabo,
ibyatsi bihuumura, ibirungo, imibavu n’ububaane, divaayi n’amavuta ya elayo, ifu nziiza n’ingano, inka n’intaama, amafaraashi n’amagaare, ndetse n’abacakara n’ubuzima bw’abantu.
Abacuruuzi bazaabwira iyo ndaaya bati, "Ibyo umutima waawe wiifuuzaga byagukuuweho, n’ubutunzi n’ibishiimiisha amaaso yaawe byose bigushizeho, kandi ntuuzongera kubibona!"
Abacuruuzi b’ibyo bintu baari baarakijijwe no gucuruuriza muri iyo tawuni nkuru, bazaahagarara hirya, batiinya kubabazwa hamwe na yo. Bazaarira kandi baborooge,
maze bavuge bati, "Mbeega ishano! Mbeega ishano! Itawuni nkuru y’icaamamare yari yambaye imyenda y’agaciiro, y’umweru n’umutuku, kandi igataakwa n’izaahabu, n’amabuye y’agaciiro, hamwe n’amasimbi!
Noone mu saaha imwe yoonyine, ubwo bukungu bwayo bwose bukaba burimbutse!" Bakuru b’amaato n’abayagenderamo boose, abasaare n’abacuruuriza ku nyanja, bahagarara hiirya
maze baboonye umwotsi wo gutwikwa kwayo bateera hejuru bavuga bati, "Nta tawuni nkuru yiigeze kuba icaamamare nk’iyi!"

Nuuko biisiiga umucuucu ku mitwe yaabo, bateera heejuru barira kandi baborooga bati, "Mbeega ishano! Mbeega ishano uboonye wa tawuni we nkuru y’icaamamare! Ubukungu bwawe bwari bwarakijije abafite amaato ku nyanja boose! Ariko noone dore mu saaha imwe yoonyine byose birarimbutse!
Ishiime wa juru we, kuko iyi tawuni nkuru yaseenyutse! Nimwishiime namwe beera b’Imaana hamwe n’intumwa n’abahanuuzi! Kuko Imaana yahannye Babilooni iyiryoza ibyo yabakoreye."

Nuuko malayika w’igihangaage afata ibuye ringana n’urusyo runini maze arijugunya mu nyanja avuga ati, "Uku ni ko itawuni nkuru y’igihangange Babilooni izaahananturirwa haasi maze ntiizongere kuboneka ukundi.

Muri wowe, ntihazongera kumviikana amajwi y’abacuranzi b’inanga n’abaririmbyi, n’abavuzi b’imyirenge n’impanda! Ntaamuhanga mu bucuruuzi ubwo ari bwo bwose uzongera kuboneka iwaawe, kandi ijwi ry’urusyo ntirizongera kumviikana ku bwo kubura ico gusya.

Urumuri rw’itaara ntiruzongera kumurika iwaawe ukundi, kandi amajwi y’umukwe n’umugeni ntaazongera kumviikana. Abacuruuzi ni bo baari bakomeye mu si yoose, kuko amahanga yoose yari yarayobejwe n’ubupfumu bwawe!"
Babilooni yarahanwe kuko yamennye amaraso y’abahanuuzi n’ay’abeera b’Imaana hamwe n’abo boose biiciwe mu isi.
Haanyuma yo kuvuga kwa malayika w’igihangange, numva ikimeze nk’amajwi arenga y’inteeko y’abantu mu ijuru, bavuga bati, "Nihasingizwe Imaana! Agakiza, icuubahiro, n’ububaasha ni iby’Imaana yaacu.
Ubucaamanza bwayo ni ubw’ukuri n’ubutabeera. Yaciiriye urubanza ya ndaaya y’icaamamare yahumanyije abo mu isi n’ubusambanyi bwayo. Imaana yayihannye kuko yiishe abagaragu baayo."
Barongera bati, "Ni hasingizwe Imaana! Umwotsi uva muri iyi tawuni y’icaamamare uzaacumbeeka iteeka ryose!"
Nuuko ba bakuru makumyabiri na bane na bya binyabuzima bine barapfukama maze baramya Imaana yiicaye ku ntebe y’ubwami, bavuga bati, "Amiina. Nihasingizwe Imaana!"
Nuuko ijwi rirenga rituruka kuri ya ntebe y’ubwami rivuga riti, "Nimusingize Imaana yaacu, mwa bagaragu baayo mwese mwe, namwe abayuubaha, abooroheje n’abakomeye!"

Nuuko numva ikimeze nk’ijwi ry’inteeko y’abantu benshi, n’irimeze nk’iry’amaazi menshi n’irimeze nk’inkuba ihinda caane, rivuga riti, "Nihasingizwe Imaana! Kuko Nyagasani Imaana yaacu, Ishoborabyose iri ku ngoma.
Nitwishiime tuneezeerwe kandi tumuhimbaaze, kuko ubukwe bw’Umwana w’Intaama busohoye, kandi n’umugeni we akaba yiiteguuye.
Yahaawe kwambara umwenda mwiza w’agaciiro urabagirana kandi utanduye." (Koko reero uwo mwenda mwiza w’agaciiro ni ibikorwa byiza by’abantu b’Imaana.)
Nuuko malayika arambwira ati, "Andika uti, ‘Hahiirwa abatumiwe mu bukwe bw’Umwana w’Intaama.’ " Maze yongera kumbwira ati, "Aya ni amagambo y’ukuri y’Imaana."

Nuuko mfukama imbere ye ngo muramye, ariko arambwira ati, "Reka, ntuubikore! Ndi umugaragu mugenzi waawe hamwe n’abo bavandimwe bamamaza ukuri ko Yesu yagaragaje. Ahuubwo Imaana abe ari yo uramya! Koko reero, ubuhamya bwa Yesu ni umwuka w’ubuuhanuuzi."
Haanyuma mbona ijuru rikinguuye, maze mbona ifaraashi y’umweru! Uwari uyiicayeho yiitwa Mudahemuka na Munyakuri, kandi agaca imanza no kurwana intambara akurikije ubutabeera.
Amaaso ye yari nk’ibirimi by’umuriro, kandi yari yambaye amakamba menshi ku mutwe we. Yari afite izina rimwanditsweho, ariko ntaawundi wari uriizi keretse we ubwe.
Yari yambaye ikanzu yiinitswe mu maraso, kandi izina rye yiitwaga Jambo w’Imaana.
Ingabo zo mu ijuru ziramukurikira, ziicaye ku mafaraashi y’umweru kandi zambaye imyenda myiza y’agaciiro y’umweru isukuuwe.

Mu kanwa ke havamo inkoota ityaye, yo kuzaarimbuza amahanga. Azaabategekeesha inkoni y’icuma, kandi azaacundagura imbuto z’imizaabibu mu rwengero havemo divaayi y’uburaakari bukaze bw’Imaana Ishoborabyose.
Ku gishuura ce no kukibero ce haari handitsweho iri zina: "Umwami w’abaami n’Umutegetsi w’abategetsi."
Nuuko mbona malayika ahagaze mu zuuba, maze ahamagara ibinyoni bigurukira heejuru mu kireere mu ijwi rirenga ati, "Nimuuze maze mukoranire gusangira ifunguro ry’Imaana rihebuuje,
murye inyama z’abaami, inyama z’abasirikare bakuru, inyama z’ibihangaage, inyama z’amafaraashi n’iz’abayagenderaho, n’inyama z’abantu boose, baaba abiigenga cangwa imbaata, abooroheje n’abakomeye."
Nuuko mbona ca kinyamaaswa n’abaami bo ku isi hamwe n’ingabo zaabo bakoraniye kurwanya uwiicaye ku faraashi n’ingabo ze.

Maze ico kinyamaaswa kirafatwa, hamwe n’umuhanuuzi w’ibinyoma wari warakoreye imbere yaaco ibimenyeetso byo yayobeesheje abaashizweho ikimenyeetso c’ico kinyamaaswa n’abaaramyaga igishushaanyo caaco. Ico kinyamaaswa hamwe n’umuhanuuzi w’ibinyoma bajugunywa mu nyenga y’umuriro ugurumana ari bazima.
Abandi biiciishwa inkoota ivuuye mu kanwa k’uwiicaye ku faraashi, maze ibisiiga byose bihaaga inyama zaabo.
Nuuko mbona malayika amanuka ava mu ijuru afite mu ntoki ze igishumuruzo c’ikuzimu, hamwe n’urujegeri runini.
Afata ca kiyoka, ari co ya nzoka ya keera yiitwaga Umwanzi cangwa Sataani, maze arakiboha ngo kimare imyaka igihumbi,

nuuko akijugunya ikuzimu, arahafunga maze ashiraho ico kuhafatanya, kugira ngo kitazongera kuyobya amahanga kugeza aho imyaka igihumbi izaashirira. Nyuma y’imyaka igihumbi, malayika azaarekura ico kiyoka kumara igihe gito.

Nuuko mbona intebe z’ubwami, maze abaziicayeho bahaabwa ububaasha bwo guca imanza. Haanyuma mbona imyuka y’abantu baaciiwe imitwe bazize kuba abahamya ba Yesu n’ijambo ry’Imaana. Ntibiigeze kuramya ico kiyoka cangwa ishusho yaaco kandi ntibiigeze bashirwaho ikimenyeetso caaco mu ruhanga cangwa mu biganza. Nuuko barazuuka maze bategeka na Kristo kumara imyaka igihumbi.
[Abandi baapfuuye bo ntibaazuutse imyaka igihumbi itaraashira.] Iryo ni ryo zuuka rya mbere.

Hahiirwa abo Imaana izaazuura muri iryo zuuka rya mbere, kuko ari abaayo bwiite. Urupfu rwa kabiri ntaabubaasha rubafiteho, ahuubwo bazaaba abaheerezabitambo b’Imaana na Kristo, kandi bazaategeka hamwe na we imyaka igihumbi.
Imyaka igihumbi n’ishira, Sataani azaarekurwa ave mu gihome,
maze aje kuyobya amahanga yo mu mpande zoose z’isi ari zo ziiswe Gogi na Magogi, kugira ngo ayakoranyirize hamwe ngo baje mu ntambara. Umubare waabo ni nk’umuseenyi wo ku nyanja.
Nuuko baraaza bakwira isi yoose maze bagota inkambi y’intoore z’Imaana hamwe n’itawuni nkuru ikundwa. Ariko umuriro umanuka mu ijuru urabatwika.
Sataani wari warabayobeje ajugunywa mu nyanja y’umuriro ugurumana, iyo ya nyamaaswa n’umuhanuuzi w’ibinyoma byari byarajugunywe. Uwo muriro uzaabababaza amanywa n’ijoro iteeka ryose.
Nuuko mbona intebe nini y’ubwami yeera de hamwe n’uyiicayeho. Isi n’ijuru biramuhunga ntibyongera kuboneka.

Nuuko mbona abaapfuuye, abakomeye n’abooroheje bahagaze imbere ya ya ntebe y’ubwami, maze ibitabo birarambuurwa. Ikindi gitabo, ari co gitabo c’ubuzima na co kirarambuurwa. Abapfuuye baciirwa imanza hakurikijwe ibikorwa byabo, nk’uko byanditswe muri ibyo bitabo.
Inyanja irekura abaapfuuye baari bayirimo, Urupfu n’ikuzimu na byo birekura abaapfuuye baari babirimo maze boose baciirwa imanza hakurikijwe ibyo baakoze.
Nuuko Urupfu n’Ikuzimu bijugunywa mu nyanja y’umuriro. Iyo nyanja y’umuriro ni rwo rupfu rwa kabiri,
kandi umuntu weese wo izina rye ryari ritanditswe muri ico gitabo c’ubugingo yajugunywe muri iyo nyanja y’umuriro.
Maze mbona ijuru risha n’isi nsha, kuko ijuru rya mbere n’isi ya mbere byari byavuuyeho, kandi n’inyanja yari itakiriho.
Mbona i tawuni nkuru yeera, Yerusaalemu nsha, iva mu ijuru ku Maana, iteguuwe nk’uko umugeni arimbiishwa agiiye gusanganira umugabo we.

Nuuko numva ijwi rirenga riturutse ku ntebe y’ubwami rivuga riti, "Dore ubu, urugo rw’Imaana ruri mu bantu kandi Imaana igiiye gutuura na bo kandi babe abaayo. Imaana ubwayo izaabaana na bo kandi ibe Imaana yaabo.
Izaahanagura amarira yoose ku maaso yaabo. Ntihazongera kubaho urupfu, kandi agahinda no kurira no kubabara na byo ntibizongera kubaho, kuko ibyambere byose bizaaba birangiye."
Nuuko uwari wiicaye ku ntebe y’ubwami aravuga ati, "Dore byose mbihinduye bisha." Yongera kumbwira ati, "Andika ibyo nkubwira kuko ari iby’ukuri no kwizeerwa."
Nuuko arambwira ati, "Birarangiye! Ni nje Alufa na Omega, intangiriro n’iheerezo. Abafite imyota nzaabaha kunywa ku maazi y’ubugingo ntaaco batanze.
Abazaatsinda intambara, ibi nzaabibaha nk’umurage, kandi nzaababeera Imaana, na bo bambeere abaana.

Ariko abanyabwoba, abatiizeera, abandujwe n’ibizira, abiicanyi, abasambanyi, abarozi, abaramya ibishushaanyo, n’abanyabinyoma boose, umugabane waabo uzaaba mu nyanja y’umuriro ugurumana, ari rwo rupfu rwa kabiri."
Nuuko umwe muri ba baamalayika barindwi baari bafite amabakure arindwi yuuzuyemo ibyorezo bya nyuma birindwi, araaza maze aravuga ati, "Ngwino nkwereke umugeni uzaaba umugore w’Umwana w’Intaama."
Nuuko Umwuka w’Imaana anzaho, maze wa malayika anjaana ku musozi munini kandi mureemure, anyereka itawuni nkuru yeera ari yo Yerusaalemu imanuka iva mu ijuru ku Maana.
Yarabagiranaga n’ikuzo ry’Imaana, ikabengerana nk’ibuye ry’agaciiro kenshi, nk’ibuye rya yasipi ribonerana nk’ikirahuri c’umucaaca n’umutuku.
Yari izengurutswe n’igisiika gikomeye kandi kireekire caane, hamwe n’amarembo cumi n’abiri. Kuri buri rembo haari malayika urinda kandi handitsweho izina rimwe ryo mu miryango ya Isirayeli.
Iburasirazuuba haariho amarembo atatu, mu majaaruguru amarembo atatu, mu majeepfo amarembo atatu, n’iburengerazuuba amarembo atatu.
